termDefinitions.meaningEn: QA stands for quality assurance, the role or team responsible for testing and quality gates.

scenario: Round 4 里 Sai 明确认可了两个故事：Gemini Express 三周 deadline 自我 unblock，和 Meta 用 LLM 起草 justification 让 drop-off 降约 2%。
scenario_en: In Round 4 Sai explicitly validated two stories: the Gemini Express three-week deadline where you unblocked yourself, and the Meta LLM-assisted justification draft that cut drop-off by about two percent.
q: 这两个故事该被排到哪些 LP 的首选位？
q_en: Which leadership principles should these two stories be filed under?
options: 第一个配 Deliver Results / Ownership，第二个配 Customer Obsession
第一个配 Learn and Be Curious，第二个配 Have Backbone
两个都配 Ownership，因为都是主动做了分外的事
第一个配 Bias for Action，第二个配 Insist on the Highest Standards
options_en: The first goes to Deliver Results and Ownership, the second to Customer Obsession.
The first goes to Learn and Be Curious, the second to Have Backbone.
Both go to Ownership, since both involved doing more than assigned.
The first goes to Bias for Action, the second to Insist on the Highest Standards.
tradeoff: 按 LP 归档 vs 临场匹配：归档让每个故事有固定槽位，代价是剩下的 LP 还要补故事；临场匹配灵活，但两轮已经证明会卡在起手。
why: Gemini Express 是紧 deadline 下自己 unblock 并留下文档；LLM 起草是替客户把开放式字段变简单，两个故事的落点不同。
why_en: Gemini Express maps to Deliver Results and Ownership, while the LLM-draft story maps to Customer Obsession and Invent and Simplify.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官把题面明显往别的准则引（例如问你怎么赢得对方信任），按题面走，不要硬塞预设槽位。
optionMeanings: 按交付与客户价值两条线归档。
按学习和据理力争两条线归档。
把两个都归到主动担责一条线。
按行动速度和高标准归档。
optionMeanings_en: Files them under delivery and customer value.
Files them under learning and standing your ground.
Files both under taking initiative.
Files them under speed of action and high standards.
optionDirectness: 一个是三周内交付并顺手补文档，一个是替客户消化开放式字段。
两个故事里都没有和人正面争执的情节。
都归一条准则就重演了跨轮撞车。
两个故事的核心都不是速度或质量门槛。
optionDirectness_en: One delivered in three weeks and left a doc behind, the other absorbed an open-ended field for the customer.
Neither story contains an actual head-on disagreement.
Filing both under one principle recreates the cross-round collision.
Neither story is really about speed or a quality bar.
optionScenarioImpacts: 两个已验证的故事各自占住一个高频槽。
会把强故事放进不匹配的题面里。
第二轮讲时听起来像重复。
面试官会问「快在哪 / 高标准体现在哪」。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Two validated stories each hold a high-frequency slot.
You'd drop strong stories into questions they don't fit.
The second telling would sound like a repeat.
He'd ask what exactly was fast or what the high bar was.

scenario: 有 senior 工程师质疑：「直接预填字段就行了，为什么要拉 modeling 团队做 LLM 起草？成本高多了。」面试官问的是最终 cost/return 划不划算。
scenario_en: A senior engineer challenged you: why pull in the modeling team for an LLM draft when a simple prefill would do far more cheaply? The interviewer is asking whether the cost/return finally paid off.
q: 回答「划不划算」时，最该先给哪句？
q_en: What should the first sentence of the cost/return answer be?
options: 说明预填只适合已知字段，开放式字段填不好会被审核拒、用户就流失
算账：3–4 个 engineer-day，换来这一步 drop-off 降约 2%
强调 token 成本可以忽略不计，因为线上本来就有 AI agent 在跑大量的客户对话
说这是 PM 定的优先级，团队讨论后一致同意做，所以按计划推进
options_en: Explain that prefill only works for known fields, while a badly written open-ended field gets rejected and the user churns.
Do the math: three to four engineer-days bought about a two percent drop in drop-off at that step.
Stress that token cost is negligible because an AI agent was already handling a large volume of customer conversations.
Say the PM set the priority and the team agreed, so you executed the plan.
tradeoff: 先算账 vs 先讲机制：算账让对方直接判断划不划算，代价是数字必须站得住；先讲机制解释了为什么要做，但没回答「值不值」。
why: 成本质疑要用两个可比的数回答：3–4 个 engineer-day 对约 2% 的 drop-off 改善；token 成本可忽略是补充，不是主论点。
why_en: A cost challenge needs two comparable numbers — three to four engineer-days against a two percent drop-off improvement — with the token cost as a footnote.
whenOtherWins: 如果对方质疑的是方案能不能 work（而不是成本），那先讲「开放式字段预填不了」的机制才是正解。
optionMeanings: 先解释为什么便宜方案不成立。
先给投入与产出的两个数。
先排除掉一项被担心的成本。
把决策依据交给流程和他人。
optionMeanings_en: Starts by explaining why the cheap option doesn't hold.
Starts with the two numbers on both sides of the ledger.
Starts by eliminating one feared cost item.
Hands the decision basis to process and other people.
optionDirectness: 机制论证很强，但他问的是最终账目。
他问 cost/return，两个数直接构成这笔账。
token 成本只是成本项之一，撑不起结论。
把判断推给别人会削弱 ownership 信号。
optionDirectness_en: The mechanism argument is strong, but he asked about the final ledger.
He asked for cost versus return, and these two numbers are the ledger.
Token cost is only one line item and can't carry the conclusion.
Deferring the judgment to others weakens the ownership signal.
optionScenarioImpacts: 他会再问一次「所以值不值」。
他能当场判断，Sai 的原话是「一周工程量绝对值得」。
他会追问那另外几个成本项呢。
这个故事会失去你自己的判断色彩。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: He simply asks again whether it was worth it.
He can judge on the spot — Sai's words were that a week of engineering is definitely worth it.
He asks what about the other cost items.
The story loses any trace of your own judgment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一名工程师一天的工作量，用来估算功能成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An engineer-day is one engineer's work for one day, the unit used to size the cost of a feature.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先检索真实业务上下文再交给模型生成，让输出有依据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RAG stands for retrieval-augmented generation, where real context is retrieved first so the model's output stays grounded.

scenario: Gemini Express 的紧 deadline 故事被 Sai 评为「excellent, great answer」，靠的是结果段的两个数。
scenario_en: Sai called the Gemini Express deadline story an excellent answer, and what carried it were the two numbers in the result section.
q: Gemini Express 紧 deadline 故事里必须说出的两个数字是什么？
q_en: Which two numbers must the Gemini Express deadline story include?
text: 项目窗口只有 {{三周}}，buddy 请假后我自己 ramp up；交付自动化 pipeline 后，数据科学家每天省约 {{2 小时}} 手工出报表，并留下一份新人文档。
text_en: The project window was only {{three weeks}} and my onboarding buddy went on leave; after the automated pipeline shipped, the data scientists saved about {{2 hours}} a day of manual reporting.
why: 结果段必须落到数字上：三周窗口说明压力，每天省两小时说明收益——被认可的那个版本就是带这两个数的。
why_en: The result has to land on numbers — a three-week window for the pressure and two hours a day for the payoff — which is exactly the version that got praised.

scenario: Amazon 对 Dive Deep 的官方说法是：领导者深入各个层级、关注细节、频繁审计，当指标和实际情况不符时保持怀疑。
scenario_en: Amazon's official wording for Dive Deep is that leaders operate at all levels, stay connected to the details, audit frequently, and are skeptical when metrics and reality differ.
q: 照这个定义，Dive Deep 题最想听到你讲什么？
q_en: Given that definition, what does a Dive Deep question most want to hear?
options: 你能背出系统里每个组件的实现细节，说明你确实深入读过代码
你怀疑过一个看起来正常的指标，并挖到了它掩盖的真实问题
你在多个层级都做过事：既写代码又参与设计评审和上线值班
你建了完善的监控和 dashboard，让团队能随时看到系统的健康状态
options_en: That you can recite the implementation details of every component, proving you really read the code.
That you distrusted a metric that looked fine and dug out the real problem it was hiding.
That you worked at several levels — writing code, joining design reviews and taking on-call.
That you built solid monitoring and dashboards so the team can always see system health.
tradeoff: 讲「怀疑指标」vs 讲「我很懂细节」：前者正对 Dive Deep 的评分点，代价是必须有数据支撑的推理链；后者只能证明熟悉度。
why: Dive Deep 的核心信号是对指标保持怀疑：讲一次指标说没事、你不信、然后挖出真因的经历——P99 那个故事正好是这个形状。
why_en: The core Dive Deep signal is being skeptical of a metric — a time the dashboard said fine, I didn't believe it, and I dug out the real cause.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官问的是 Insist on the Highest Standards，那「我建了完善监控」这类故事反而更贴题。
optionMeanings: 把 Dive Deep 理解成记忆力和熟悉度。
把 Dive Deep 理解成对指标的怀疑与验证。
把 Dive Deep 理解成参与层级的广度。
把 Dive Deep 理解成可观测性建设。
optionMeanings_en: Reads Dive Deep as recall and familiarity.
Reads it as distrusting a metric and verifying it.
Reads it as breadth across levels of work.
Reads it as building observability.
optionDirectness: 熟悉细节是前提，但官方措辞落在「怀疑」上。
官方定义里那句「指标与实际不符时保持怀疑」正是这条。
跨层级参与更贴近 Ownership 的描述。
建监控是高标准和运营能力，不是怀疑本身。
optionDirectness_en: Familiarity is a prerequisite, but the official wording lands on skepticism.
This is exactly the clause about being skeptical when metrics and reality diverge.
Working across levels reads closer to Ownership.
Building monitoring shows standards and operations, not skepticism itself.
optionScenarioImpacts: 会讲成一段技术介绍，缺少判断。
面试官拿到他这一轮要考的那个信号。
会被归到别的准则下评分。
故事会停在建设，没有根因发现。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It becomes a technical tour with no judgment in it.
He gets exactly the signal this round is assigned to score.
It gets scored under a different principle.
The story stops at construction and never finds a root cause.

scenario: Amazon loop 里通常有一位 bar raiser：来自招聘团队之外、经过专门训练，负责横向定级把关，在录用决定上有一票否决。
scenario_en: An Amazon loop usually includes a bar raiser: a trained interviewer from outside the hiring team who calibrates level across the company and can veto the hire.
q: 知道这一点，故事的讲法该怎么调整？
q_en: Knowing that, how should you adjust the way you tell a story?
options: 假设听众不懂你的业务：一句话交代产品是什么，再进技术判断
多用公司内部术语，展示你在大厂真实系统里的一线经验
把最强的故事留给这一轮，其他轮用次一级的故事就够了
重点讲跨团队协作，因为外组的面试官更关心你能不能融入新团队
options_en: Assume the listener doesn't know your domain: one sentence on what the product is, then the technical judgment.
Use more internal jargon to show hands-on experience inside a real large-scale system.
Save your strongest story for this round and let the others get second-tier material.
Emphasize cross-team collaboration, since an outside interviewer cares most about whether you'll fit in.
tradeoff: 先给一句产品背景 vs 直接进技术：给背景让外组听众跟得上，代价是占掉十几秒；直接进技术更紧凑，但对方可能全程在猜业务。
why: bar raiser 来自外组，对你的业务零上下文；开场一句话把产品说清，再讲技术判断，否则再好的故事他也评不了分。
why_en: The bar raiser comes from outside with zero context on my product, so one sentence of what it is has to come before the technical judgment.
whenOtherWins: 如果这一轮是同组的人（比如 HM 就在你要去的团队），业务背景可以更快带过，把时间放在技术深度上。
optionMeanings: 为零上下文听众补一句业务定义。
用内部术语展示一线经验。
按轮次分配故事强度。
把重点放在协作与文化契合。
optionMeanings_en: Adds one line of business context for a zero-context listener.
Uses internal jargon to display hands-on experience.
Allocates story strength by round.
Shifts the emphasis to collaboration and culture fit.
optionDirectness: 外组听众要先知道产品是什么，才能判断技术难度。
内部缩写在外组听来是噪声，会拉低可理解度。
你不知道哪一轮是 bar raiser，按轮分配等于赌。
bar raiser 的职责是定级把关，不是文化契合面试。
optionDirectness_en: An outside listener needs to know what the product is before he can judge the difficulty.
Internal abbreviations sound like noise outside the company and lower comprehension.
You don't know which round is the bar raiser, so allocating by round is a gamble.
The bar raiser's job is level calibration, not a culture-fit screen.
optionScenarioImpacts: 他能跟上，并把故事对到某个准则上。
他要花注意力解码术语，判断被推迟。
可能把最强故事浪费在同组的那一轮。
技术深度这条线会被讲薄。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: He can follow along and map the story onto a principle.
He spends attention decoding jargon and postpones judgment.
You may spend the strongest story on an in-team round.
The technical depth thread gets thin.

termDefinitions.meaning: Amazon loop 里来自外组、受过训练的面试官，负责横向定级并可否决录用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bar raiser is a trained interviewer from outside the hiring team who calibrates the hiring bar across Amazon and can veto an offer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 招聘经理，通常就是你要加入的团队的负责人。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HM stands for hiring manager, usually the leader of the team you would join.

scenario: Amazon 的 BQ 追问通常挖三到四层：为什么选这个方法、什么数据支撑这个决定、如果重来你会怎么做。
scenario_en: Amazon behavioral probing usually goes three or four layers deep: why that approach, what data informed the decision, and what you would do differently.
q: 准备一个故事时，最该提前写好哪三句？
q_en: Which three sentences should you write in advance for each story?
options: 三句不同长度的开场：30 秒版、90 秒版、3 分钟版，按剩余时间灵活选
方案选择的理由、支撑决定的那个数据、以及重来会改的那一步
三个不同的结果指标，防止面试官对第一个数字不感兴趣
三个能顺势带出的其他 LP，方便把这个故事复用到别的问题上
options_en: Three openers of different lengths — thirty seconds, ninety seconds, three minutes — picked by time remaining.
Why you chose the approach, which data backed the decision, and the one step you'd change if you did it again.
Three different outcome metrics, in case the interviewer isn't interested in the first number.
Three other principles you can pivot to, so the story can be reused on other questions.
tradeoff: 预写三句 vs 现场想：预写让每个追问 2–3 句就能收口，代价是每个故事的准备量翻倍；现场想省事，但 Round 1 的追问正是这样拖到 25 分钟的。
why: 这三问几乎每轮都会来（Round 1 就连问了之前的流程是什么、加快还是拖慢、重来会怎样），预先写好就不会被拖长。
why_en: These three probes come up nearly every round, so writing the answers in advance keeps the follow-ups from stretching the whole story.
whenOtherWins: 如果追问明显偏技术实现（比如 token 量级、schema 长什么样），预写的三句不够用，得靠故事里真实的技术细节。
optionMeanings: 按时间长度准备多个版本。
按最常见的三层追问准备答案。
准备备用的结果指标。
准备把故事迁移到别的准则。
optionMeanings_en: Prepares several versions by length.
Prepares answers for the three most common probes.
Prepares backup outcome metrics.
Prepares to migrate the story to other principles.
optionDirectness: 长度问题靠控时解决，追问内容还是空的。
这三问正是 Round 1 追到的那三问。
换指标不能回答「什么数据支撑了决定」。
一个故事跨准则复用，正是跨轮撞车的来源。
optionDirectness_en: Length is a pacing problem, and the content of the probes would still be missing.
These are literally the three probes Round 1 used.
Swapping metrics doesn't answer which data drove the decision.
Reusing one story across principles is precisely what causes cross-round collisions.
optionScenarioImpacts: 开场很顺，追问仍然现场硬想。
每个追问 2–3 句收口，编码时间保住了。
对话会绕在数字上，离决策越来越远。
同一个故事又会出现在多位面试官的笔记里。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The opening flows and the probes are still improvised.
Each follow-up closes in two or three sentences and coding keeps its time.
The conversation circles around numbers and drifts away from the decision.
The same story shows up in several interviewers' notes again.

scenario: Amazon 2026-06-23 Course Schedule：我刚讲完「建邻接表 + 入度数组，入度 0 全部入队，出队再给邻居减度」，面试官问「你这个拓扑排序用的是哪种遍历？」
scenario_en: Amazon, June 23, Course Schedule: right after I described building an adjacency list plus an in-degree array, seeding a queue with every in-degree-zero node and decrementing neighbours, the interviewer asked which traversal my topological sort used.
q: 入度数组 + 队列的 Kahn 算法，该报成 BFS 还是 DFS？
q_en: In-degree array plus a queue — do I call Kahn's algorithm BFS or DFS?
options: DFS：沿一条先修链一路钻到最深，回头再换分支
两者都不是：拓扑排序是贪心排序，不算图遍历
BFS：队列按层剥掉入度 0 的节点，逐层扩展
看容器：用 deque 算 BFS，用 list 算 DFS
options_en: DFS: dive down one prerequisite chain to the deepest node, then back up and try another branch.
Neither: topological sort is a greedy ordering, not really a graph traversal.
BFS: a queue peels off the in-degree-zero nodes layer by layer.
It depends on the container — a deque makes it BFS, a plain list makes it DFS.
tradeoff: BFS vs DFS：Kahn 用队列换来「层」这个语义，代价是拿不到 DFS post-order 那种子树结构。
why: 队列 + 一层层处理 = BFS；递归或栈 + 先走到最深 = DFS。Kahn 靠入度和队列驱动，形状就是 BFS。
why_en: Kahn's algorithm runs off an in-degree array and a queue, so it is BFS — queue and layers mean BFS, recursion and depth-first mean DFS.
whenOtherWins: 改用递归 + visited/递归栈、把 post-order 反过来输出，那才是 DFS 版拓扑排序，此时报 DFS 才对。
optionMeanings: DFS 的形状：递归或显式栈，一条路走到底。
把拓扑排序当成独立算法族，不归入遍历。
Kahn 的形状：入度 0 入队，逐层剥离。
把命名寄托在容器的具体写法上。
optionMeanings_en: The DFS shape: recursion or an explicit stack, one branch to the bottom.
Treats topological sort as its own family, outside traversal.
The Kahn shape: in-degree zero enqueued, peeled level by level.
Pins the name on which container you happened to use.
optionDirectness: 描述的是 DFS 版拓扑排序，不是入度法。
错在分类层：拓扑序确实由一次遍历产出。
抓住了「队列 + 层」这条判别线。
错在依据：deque 也能当栈，容器不定名。
optionDirectness_en: Describes the DFS variant of topological sort, not the in-degree method.
Wrong at the taxonomy level: the ordering does come out of one traversal.
Catches the real discriminator — queue plus layers.
Wrong basis: a deque can also act as a stack, so the container names nothing.
optionScenarioImpacts: 我当天就是这么答的，被追问两次仍没改口。
回避了面试官真正想听的那个分类。
一句话报对名，不用再听 Are you sure。
把话题带去 API 细节，名字仍然没定。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: That is exactly what I said on the day, and I kept it after two nudges.
Dodges the classification the interviewer was actually probing.
Names it right in one line, so no second 'are you sure'.
Drags the talk into API detail while the name stays unsettled.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用入度数组加队列做拓扑排序的算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kahn's algorithm topologically sorts a directed acyclic graph using an in-degree array and a queue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 广度优先搜索：用队列一层层向外扩展。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Breadth-first search explores a graph layer by layer using a queue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度优先搜索：递归或栈先走到最深再回溯。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Depth-first search goes as deep as it can along one branch before backtracking.

scenario: 同一个术语我翻过两次车：Amazon 6/23 把 Kahn 叫成 DFS，Amazon Round 4 又给 BFS 编了个错理由。需要一句随时能背出来的判别。
scenario_en: I have missed this label twice: I called Kahn's algorithm DFS in the June 23 Amazon round, and gave BFS a wrong justification in onsite Round 4. I need a one-line test I can recite.
q: 被问「你用的是哪种遍历」时，用哪一句当场判别 BFS 和 DFS？
q_en: What one-line test tells BFS from DFS when the interviewer asks which traversal I used?
text: 判别一句话：队列 + 一层层处理 = {{BFS}}；递归或栈 + 先走到最深 = {{DFS}}。所以入度 + 队列的 Kahn 算法属于 {{BFS}}。
text_en: The one-liner: queue plus level-by-level means {{BFS}}; recursion or a stack going deepest-first means {{DFS}}. So Kahn's in-degree-and-queue algorithm is {{BFS}}.
why: 判别靠的是「用什么容器推进 + 展开顺序」，不是题目名字。背成一句话，被追问时不用现场推。
why_en: The test is what container drives the frontier and in what order it expands, not what the problem happens to be called.

scenario: 面试官追问：「除了你写的入度法，拓扑排序还能怎么写？两者有什么不一样？」我需要说清 DFS 版的辅助状态和输出顺序。
scenario_en: Follow-up: besides the in-degree method you wrote, how else can topological sort be done, and how do the two differ? I need the DFS variant's bookkeeping and output order.
q: Kahn 版和 DFS 版拓扑排序，最主要的差别在哪一项？
q_en: What is the main difference between the Kahn version and the DFS version of topological sort?
options: DFS 版能处理有环图，Kahn 版必须先保证无环
辅助状态与出序：Kahn 用入度计数，DFS 反转 post-order
DFS 版是 O(n log n)，Kahn 版是 O(n + m)，量级不同
Kahn 版只能判断能否完成，拿不到具体的课程顺序
options_en: The DFS version works on cyclic graphs while Kahn's needs an acyclic graph up front.
Bookkeeping and output order: Kahn counts in-degrees, DFS reverses its post-order.
The DFS version is O of n log n while Kahn is O of n plus m, so the orders differ.
Kahn's version only answers yes-or-no and cannot produce the actual course order.
tradeoff: Kahn vs DFS：Kahn 的出队顺序直接就是拓扑序，DFS 省掉入度数组，代价是要反转 post-order 并盯递归深度。
why: 两版时间空间都是 O(n + m)，真正的差别是辅助状态（入度数组 vs 递归栈）和出序方式（出队序 vs 反转 post-order）。
why_en: Both run in O of n plus m; what really differs is the bookkeeping — an in-degree array versus a recursion stack — and how the order falls out.
optionMeanings: 认为两版对环的容忍度不同。
把差别定位在状态与出序两处。
认为 DFS 版多了一次排序开销。
认为入度法只能做可行性判定。
optionMeanings_en: Claims the two variants tolerate cycles differently.
Locates the difference in bookkeeping and output order.
Claims the DFS variant pays an extra sorting cost.
Claims the in-degree method only decides feasibility.
optionDirectness: 错在能力边界：两版都靠自己检测环。
抓住了实现层真正分叉的两处。
错在复杂度：DFS 版没有排序步骤。
错在输出：LC 210 就是用 Kahn 返回顺序。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong about capability: both variants detect the cycle themselves.
Pins the two places where the implementations actually fork.
Wrong on complexity: the DFS variant sorts nothing.
Wrong on output: LeetCode 210 returns the order with Kahn's.
optionScenarioImpacts: 会被追问「那 Kahn 怎么发现环」而卡住。
能顺势报出两版量级相同这句加分话。
复杂度说错，比叫错名字扣得更多。
把自己写过的解讲小了，白丢一个加分点。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Invites 'then how does Kahn find a cycle' and stalls me.
Lets me add the bonus line that both variants share one bound.
A wrong complexity costs more than a wrong label.
Undersells the solution I actually wrote and drops a point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后序：DFS 中一个节点的所有后继都处理完之后才记录它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Post-order records a node only after all of its descendants have been finished in a depth-first search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 回边：DFS 里指向当前递归栈中某个节点的边，出现即有环。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A back edge points to a node still on the recursion stack, which means the graph has a cycle.

scenario: 面试官说「你用 DFS 写一遍拓扑排序」。我要在递归里同时完成两件事：检测环、产出拓扑序。
scenario_en: The interviewer says: now write the topological sort with DFS. Inside the recursion I have to do two things at once, detect the cycle and produce the ordering.
q: DFS 版拓扑排序里，靠什么状态判定有环？
q_en: In the DFS version of topological sort, which piece of state proves there is a cycle?
options: 碰到已经被 visited 标记过的任意节点，就说明有环
递归深度超过节点总数 n 时判定有环
碰到仍在递归栈上的节点，也就是三色法里的灰色
回溯结束后拓扑序长度小于 n，说明有环
options_en: Hitting any node already marked visited means there is a cycle.
A recursion depth greater than the node count n means there is a cycle.
Hitting a node still on the recursion stack, the grey colour in the three-colour scheme.
After backtracking, an ordering shorter than n means there is a cycle.
tradeoff: 单个 visited vs 加递归栈：只用 visited 省一个数组，代价是把「已完成」和「正在访问」混成一类，环就查不出来。
why: DFS 要区分两种「见过」：已完成可以直接跳过，仍在栈上才是回边即有环。只用一个 visited 会把交叉边误判成环。
why_en: Depth-first search must separate finished nodes from nodes still on the recursion stack, because only an edge back into the stack is a real cycle.
whenOtherWins: 如果我写的是 Kahn 版，就没有递归栈可看，那时的环判据才是「出队计数小于 n」。
optionMeanings: 只用一个 visited 集合区分见过与没见过。
拿递归深度当环的信号。
三色法：白未访、灰在栈上、黑已完成。
用最终序列长度反推是否有环。
optionMeanings_en: Uses a single visited set to split seen from unseen.
Treats recursion depth as the cycle signal.
Three colours: white unvisited, grey on the stack, black finished.
Infers the cycle from the length of the final ordering.
optionDirectness: 错在粒度：交叉边也指向 visited，会误报环。
错在信号：链长 n 也能压满深度，却不是环。
灰色等于祖先节点，指向它的边就是回边。
这是 Kahn 的判据，DFS 里当不上主判据。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong granularity: a cross edge also points at a visited node and would false-alarm.
Wrong signal: a chain of n nodes fills the same depth without being a cycle.
Grey means an ancestor, so an edge into it is a back edge.
That is Kahn's test; in DFS it cannot be the primary check.
optionScenarioImpacts: 在菱形依赖的图上会当场报出不存在的环。
深链的合法输入被判成不可完成。
同一趟递归里既判环又攒出待反转的序列。
方向对但用错版本，面试官会继续追问。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It would report a phantom cycle on a diamond-shaped dependency graph.
A legal long chain gets rejected as unfinishable.
One pass both detects the cycle and builds the sequence to reverse.
Right instinct, wrong variant, so the follow-up keeps coming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 三色法：白=未访问、灰=在递归栈上、黑=已完成，用来区分回边和交叉边。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The three-colour scheme marks nodes white when unvisited, grey while on the recursion stack, and black once finished.

termDefinitions.meaning: 交叉边：指向另一棵已完成子树的边，不构成环。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross edge points into an already finished subtree and does not create a cycle.

scenario: Amazon 6/23：算法我讲对了，但把口头思路翻成代码时卡了约 5 分钟，面试官问「Are you stuck?」——卡点就是建邻接表和入度数组这两行。
scenario_en: Amazon, June 23: my verbal plan was right, but turning it into code took about five minutes and the interviewer asked if I was stuck. The blocker was the adjacency list and in-degree array lines.
q: Kahn 模板里，遍历 prerequisites 的那一行该同时更新哪两个结构？
q_en: In the Kahn template, which two structures does the single pass over prerequisites update?
options: 邻接表记 pre → course，同时给 course 的入度加一
邻接表记 course → pre，同时给 course 的入度加一
邻接表记 pre → course，同时给 pre 的入度加一
只建邻接表，入度等到 BFS 出队时再现算
options_en: The adjacency list stores pre to course, and course's in-degree goes up by one.
The adjacency list stores course to pre, and course's in-degree goes up by one.
The adjacency list stores pre to course, and pre's in-degree goes up by one.
Build only the adjacency list and compute in-degrees later during the BFS.
tradeoff: 顺依赖建边 vs 反向建边：顺着建让入度等于未满足的先修数，代价是边方向和输入元组正好相反，写的时候要停一秒对齐。
why: 边要顺着「先修 → 后修」，入度才等于「还欠多少门先修」；入度加在被指向的那门课上，一趟循环两件事同时做完。
why_en: Point each edge from prerequisite to course so a node's in-degree counts the prerequisites it still owes, and bump the in-degree of the node the edge points at.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目给的是「course → 它的先修列表」并要求反向输出，那就该建反向边，入度加在 pre 上。
optionMeanings: 边顺依赖方向，入度记欠账。
边反着建，入度却仍加在后修上。
边方向对，入度加错了端点。
把入度计算推迟到遍历阶段。
optionMeanings_en: Edges follow the dependency direction and in-degree records what is still owed.
Edges are reversed but the in-degree still lands on the course.
Edge direction is right but the in-degree lands on the wrong endpoint.
Defers the in-degree computation to the traversal phase.
optionDirectness: 入度归零恰好等于「先修都上完了」。
错在方向：减度会去减先修，队列永远推不动。
错在端点：起点入度被抬高，队列一开始就空。
错在时机：没有初始种子，循环根本起不来。
optionDirectness_en: In-degree zero then means exactly that all prerequisites are done.
Wrong direction: decrements hit prerequisites, so the queue never advances.
Wrong endpoint: source nodes get non-zero in-degree and the queue starts empty.
Wrong timing: with no seed nodes the loop cannot start at all.
optionScenarioImpacts: 两行写完直接进 BFS 循环，不再卡壳。
跑起来 done 恒为 0，要现场调试很久。
队列种子为空，函数直接返回 False。
还得回头补一趟统计，时间又被吃掉。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Two lines and the BFS loop can start, no stalling.
At runtime done stays zero and I burn minutes debugging live.
The seed queue is empty and the function just returns false.
I still have to add a counting pass and lose the time anyway.

termDefinitions.meaning: 入度：指向某节点的边数；在课程题里等于这门课还没上完的先修数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In-degree is the number of edges pointing at a node, which here means how many prerequisites a course still needs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 邻接表：每个节点存一条出边列表，空间 O(n + m)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An adjacency list stores an out-edge list per node and uses space proportional to nodes plus edges.

scenario: 面试官在我写完 Kahn 之后问复杂度。n 门课、m 条先修边，两种写法答案相同，我要一口气报完并说清依据。
scenario_en: After I finished Kahn's algorithm the interviewer asked for the complexity. With n courses and m prerequisite edges both variants give the same answer, and I should state it in one breath with the reason.
q: n 个节点 m 条边的拓扑排序，时间和空间各是多少、依据是什么？
q_en: For a topological sort over n nodes and m edges, what are the time and space costs and why?
text: 每个节点入队出队各一次、每条边被减度一次，所以时间是 {{O(n + m)}}；邻接表加入度数组加队列，空间是 {{O(n + m)}}。这个量级 {{BFS 版和 DFS 版相同}}。
text_en: Each node is enqueued and dequeued once and each edge is relaxed once, so time is {{O(n + m)}}; the adjacency list plus in-degree array plus queue give {{O(n + m)}} space, and this bound is {{the same for the BFS and DFS variants}}.
why: 复杂度不是背的，是数出来的：节点各进出一次、边各扫一次。报完量级顺带说「两版相同」，能挡掉「那 DFS 更快吗」这个追问。
why_en: I do not memorise the bound, I count it — every node enters and leaves once and every edge is scanned once, and both variants land on the same figure.

scenario: in-degree / out-degree 我一直混：phone screen 卡过一次，onsite Round 4 之后我自己写下的第一条 action item 就是「复习拓扑排序的 in-degree / out-degree」。
scenario_en: I keep mixing up in-degree and out-degree: it cost me time in a phone screen, and the first action item I wrote after onsite Round 4 was to review it.
q: 课程图里「这门课还欠几门先修」对应的是入度还是出度？
q_en: In a course graph, is how many prerequisites a course still owes the in-degree or the out-degree?
options: 出度，因为一门课解锁的后续课越多它越关键
入度，指向它的边数就是它还欠的先修数
两者之和，先修和后继都会阻塞这门课
出度，队列里要先放出度为 0 的末端课
options_en: Out-degree, because a course that unlocks more later courses matters more.
In-degree: the number of edges pointing at it is how many prerequisites it still owes.
The sum of both, since prerequisites and successors each block the course.
Out-degree, because the queue should start from terminal courses with out-degree zero.
tradeoff: 入度 vs 出度：入度记「欠账」所以能当就绪信号，出度记「影响面」只能拿来排优先级。
why: 边从先修指向后修时，指进来的边就是欠账，入度归零 = 可以上了。出度说的是它上完能解锁多少门，跟能不能开始无关。
why_en: With edges running from prerequisite to course, incoming edges are the debt, so in-degree hitting zero is the ready signal while out-degree only says how much it unlocks.
whenOtherWins: 如果我按「后修 → 先修」反向建图，欠账就变成出度，此时该盯出度归零——方向变了判据跟着变。
optionMeanings: 出度：从这个节点射出的边数。
入度：射向这个节点的边数。
把两个度数加起来当阻塞量。
以为种子节点是出度为 0 的末端课。
optionMeanings_en: Out-degree is the number of edges leaving the node.
In-degree is the number of edges arriving at the node.
Adds the two degrees together as one blocking count.
Assumes the seed nodes are terminal courses with out-degree zero.
optionDirectness: 把重要性和就绪条件混成同一件事。
欠账清零就是就绪，正是入队条件。
错在语义：后继再多也不妨碍这门课开课。
错在起点：末端课恰恰是最后才能上的。
optionDirectness_en: Conflates importance with readiness.
Debt hitting zero is readiness, which is exactly the enqueue rule.
Wrong semantics: having many successors never blocks the course itself.
Wrong seed: terminal courses are the ones you can only take last.
optionScenarioImpacts: 写出的减度循环会去更新错误的一端。
入队条件和减度对象一次说清，不再卡壳。
数组变成无意义的度数和，判据失效。
队列从终点出发，整个拓扑序反了。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The decrement loop then updates the wrong endpoint.
The enqueue rule and the decrement target both come out clean.
The array becomes a meaningless degree sum and the test breaks.
The queue starts at the sinks and the whole ordering comes out backwards.

termDefinitions.meaning: 出度：从一个节点射出的边数，在课程图里等于它能解锁的后续课数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Out-degree counts the edges leaving a node, which here means how many later courses it unlocks.

scenario: 四门课 A B C D，边是 A→C、B→C、C→D。Kahn 跑完之后我要用一个量回答「能不能上完」，而不是再跑一次检测。
scenario_en: Four courses A B C D with edges A to C, B to C and C to D. After Kahn's loop finishes I need one quantity that answers can I finish, not a second detection pass.
q: Kahn 跑完之后，用什么判定图里有环？
q_en: Once Kahn's loop ends, what tells me the graph has a cycle?
options: 队列提前枯竭，出队计数停在小于 n
任何一个节点的入度在循环中被减成负数
邻接表里出现了起点终点相同的自环边
队列在某一层同时出现两个入度 0 的节点
options_en: The queue dries up early and the dequeue count stops below n.
Some node's in-degree gets decremented below zero during the loop.
The adjacency list contains a self-loop whose two endpoints coincide.
Two in-degree-zero nodes sit in the queue at the same time.
tradeoff: 计数判据 vs 再跑一趟检测：靠 done 计数不多花一分钱，代价是它只说「有环」，不说环在哪。
why: 环上的节点入度永远降不到 0，队列会提前枯竭。出队计数小于 n 就是环的证据，不需要第二趟遍历。
why_en: Nodes on a cycle never reach in-degree zero, so the queue dries up early and a dequeue count below n is the proof.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Q0["队列 A,B · 入度 C=2 D=1"] --> Q1["弹 A · C 减到 1"]
  Q1 --> Q2["弹 B · C 减到 0 入队"]
  Q2 --> Q3["弹 C · D 减到 0 入队"]
  Q3 --> Q4["弹 D · done=4=n 无环"]
  Q2 -.->|"若 D 反指回 C"| QX["队列空 done=2<4 有环"]
optionMeanings: 用出队计数和 n 比对。
拿负入度当异常信号。
只查自环这一种特例。
把同层多节点当成分叉异常。
optionMeanings_en: Compares the dequeue count against n.
Treats a negative in-degree as the anomaly.
Only checks the self-loop special case.
Reads several same-layer nodes as a branching anomaly.
optionDirectness: 环上节点的入度卡住不降，计数必然缺口。
错在状态：每条边只减一次，减不到负数。
错在覆盖面：长度大于 1 的环全被漏掉。
错在语义：同层多个 0 度是正常的并行分支。
optionDirectness_en: Cycle nodes keep a non-zero in-degree, so the count must fall short.
Wrong state: each edge decrements once, so it never goes negative.
Wrong coverage: every cycle longer than one node is missed.
Wrong semantics: several zero-degree nodes just mean parallel branches.
optionScenarioImpacts: 一个 done == n 的比较就收尾，代码干净。
断言永不触发，有环时静默返回错答案。
A→C→D→A 这种环照样报「能上完」。
无环图被误判成有环，正确输入被拒。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: One done equals n comparison closes the function cleanly.
The assertion never fires and a cyclic graph silently passes.
A cycle like A to C to D back to A still reports finishable.
An acyclic graph is rejected as cyclic and valid input fails.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自环：起点和终点是同一个节点的边，本身就是长度 1 的环。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A self-loop is an edge whose source and target are the same node, which is a cycle of length one.

scenario: Amazon Round 4 汇率题：我写的 BFS 队列种子有两处小错，面试官 Sai 当场替我抓了出来——一处是元素结构，一处是数值字面量。
scenario_en: Amazon onsite Round 4, the currency-rate problem: my BFS seed had two small defects that Sai caught for me, one in the element shape and one in the numeric literal.
q: 累积汇率的 BFS，队列初值该写成什么？
q_en: For a BFS that accumulates an exchange rate, what should the initial queue element be?
options: deque([source])，累积汇率另用一个字典单独维护
deque([(source, 1)])，同币种兑换率就是 1
deque([(source, 1.0)])，元素是币种和累积汇率的二元组
deque([(source, target, 1.0)])，把目标币种一起带进元素
options_en: deque([source]), keeping the accumulated rate in a separate dictionary.
deque([(source, 1)]), since converting a currency to itself is exactly one.
deque([(source, 1.0)]), where each element pairs a currency with the accumulated rate.
deque([(source, target, 1.0)]), carrying the target currency inside every element.
tradeoff: 元组带累积值 vs 旁挂字典：元组让每条路径自带汇率、出队即可返回，代价是同一币种多路径到达时要靠 seen 收口。
why: 队列元素必须是 (币种, 累积汇率) 二元组，初值写 1.0——整数 1 会让后续乘除走整数路径、把汇率精度截断。
why_en: Each queue element pairs a currency with the running rate, and the seed must be one point zero so the arithmetic never falls back to integer maths.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目只问「两种货币是否可达」不要数值，那队列只放币种、不带累积值反而更省。
optionMeanings: 队列只存币种，汇率放外部映射。
结构对但用了整数字面量。
币种与累积汇率同行，出队即可判定。
把全程不变的 target 塞进每个元素。
optionMeanings_en: The queue holds only currencies while rates live in a side map.
Right shape but an integer literal.
Currency and running rate travel together so a dequeue can decide.
Stuffs the invariant target into every element.
optionDirectness: 错在状态归属：多路径到达时旁挂字典会互相覆盖。
错在类型：金额与汇率默认要用浮点字面量。
路径值随节点走，不需要额外结构。
错在冗余：target 全程不变，逐元素复制只增内存。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong ownership: with several paths to one currency the side map overwrites itself.
Wrong type: money and rates default to float literals.
The path value rides along with the node, so no extra structure is needed.
Redundant: the target never changes, so per-element copies only cost memory.
optionScenarioImpacts: 出队后还要多查一次字典才能算下一跳。
在整数除法的语言里 1/rate 会被截断成 0。
面试官不用再提示队列元素的问题。
面试官会问「target 为什么在元素里」，白花时间。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Every dequeue needs an extra lookup before the next hop.
In a language with integer division one over rate truncates to zero.
Sai would not have needed to point at that line.
Invites 'why is target in the element' and burns time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 双端队列：两头都能 O(1) 增删，BFS 用它做先进先出队列。

scenario: Amazon Round 4，Sai 问「为什么用 BFS 不用 DFS？」我答「想找最短路径」——教练复盘判定这个理由是错的：题目只要算出汇率数值。
scenario_en: Amazon Round 4, Sai asked why BFS instead of DFS. I said I wanted the shortest path; my coach flagged that reason as wrong, because the problem only asks for the numeric rate.
q: 汇率题被问「为什么 BFS 不是 DFS」，正确的回答方向是什么？
q_en: When asked why BFS rather than DFS on the currency problem, what is the right line to take?
options: 因为要找最少中转次数的路径，BFS 保证跳数最少
因为 DFS 递归深度不可控，货币图很容易爆栈
两者都成立——只要汇率数值，我选 BFS 是好写好早停
因为 BFS 的时间复杂度低于 DFS，边多时更快
options_en: Because I need the fewest-hop path and BFS guarantees the smallest hop count.
Because DFS recursion depth is unbounded and a currency graph would blow the stack.
Either works — the problem only wants the rate, and I picked BFS for easy code and easy early exit.
Because BFS has a lower time complexity than DFS when the graph has many edges.
tradeoff: BFS vs DFS：这题两者都对，BFS 换来逐层早停和无递归深度顾虑，DFS 换来更短的代码。
why: 题面没有要求最少中转，只要求算出兑换数值，所以两种遍历都成立。说「都行 + 我选它的实际理由」，比编一个最短路理由稳。
why_en: The problem never asks for the fewest conversions, only the rate, so both traversals are valid and I should say why I picked mine instead of inventing a shortest-path reason.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目改成「用最少的中转币种完成兑换」，BFS 的最少跳数性质才真正成为选它的理由。

错在规模：全球货币约两百种，深度不是风险。
先对齐题目要什么，再谈自己的偏好。
错在事实：两种遍历都是 O(M + N)。

Wrong scale: with about two hundred currencies depth is no risk.
Aligns with what the problem asks, then states a preference.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Early stopping returns as soon as the dequeued node is the target, without expanding the rest of the queue.

scenario: 汇率数据是一串 {from, to, rate} 记录，但查询可能问反方向：文件给了 USD→GBP，请求却问 GBP→USD。
scenario_en: The rate feed is a list of from-to-rate records, but a query can ask the reverse direction: the feed gives USD to GBP and the request asks GBP to USD.
q: 把成对汇率喂进邻接表时，反方向的边该怎么建？
q_en: When loading paired rates into an adjacency list, how should the reverse edge be built?
options: 只建正向边，反向查询时在 BFS 里临时取倒数
正向边存 rate，反向边存 1/rate，两条都建
正向边存 rate，反向边也存 rate，方向由调用方换算
只建正向边，反向查询直接返回哨兵值 -1
options_en: Store only the forward edge and take the reciprocal on the fly during BFS.
Store rate on the forward edge and its reciprocal on the reverse edge, building both.
Store rate on both directions and let the caller invert it when needed.
Store only the forward edge and return the sentinel minus one for reverse queries.
tradeoff: 预建双向边 vs 查询时取倒数：预建让读路径只做乘法，代价是边数翻倍、且 ingest 时就得挡住 rate 为 0 的脏数据。
why: 兑换天然双向，A→B 是 rate 就意味着 B→A 是 1/rate。在低频 ingest 阶段把两条边建好，高频读路径就只剩一次乘法。
why_en: Conversion is inherently two-way, so a rate from A to B means one over that rate from B to A, and building both edges at ingest keeps the hot read path to a single multiply.
whenOtherWins: 如果买入价和卖出价不同（真实外汇有点差），反向边就不能用 1/rate，必须由数据源分别给两条边。
codeSample:
from collections import defaultdict

def ingest_rate(conversions):
    graph = defaultdict(list)
    for c in conversions:                  # conversions = list of maps
        f, t, rate = c["from"], c["to"], c["rate"]
        if rate <= 0:                      # ingest 阶段挡脏数据
            continue
        graph[f].append((t, rate))
        graph[t].append((f, 1.0 / rate))   # 反向边取倒数
    return graph

错在正确性：GBP→USD 会算出放大而不是折算。
错在覆盖面：一半的合法查询被判成无解。

One low-frequency write buys a read path that only multiplies.

termDefinitions.meaning: 点差：买入价和卖出价之间的差额，真实外汇里两个方向并不互为倒数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The bid-ask spread is the gap between buying and selling prices, which is why real currency rates are not exact reciprocals.

scenario: 汇率图是双向的：USD→GBP 建了边，GBP→USD 也建了边。Sai 追问「你这个 seen 集合是干什么用的？」
scenario_en: The currency graph is bidirectional: an edge from USD to GBP implies one back. Sai asked what my seen set was actually for.
q: 汇率 BFS 里去掉 seen 集合会发生什么？
q_en: What happens to the currency BFS if I drop the seen set?
options: 结果仍然正确，只是队列变长、多算一些冗余路径
队列在 USD 和 GBP 之间反弹，不会终止
返回的汇率会偏小，因为路径被重复乘了倒数
只有图里存在三角环时才出问题，两点图是安全的
options_en: The result stays correct, the queue just grows and recomputes redundant paths.
The queue bounces between USD and GBP and never terminates.
The returned rate comes out too small because reciprocals get multiplied twice.
It only breaks when the graph has a triangle, so a two-node graph is safe.
tradeoff: 去重 vs 枚举全部路径：seen 保证终止和线性复杂度，代价是同一币种只留第一条到达路径，拿不到全部可行兑换链。
why: 双向边意味着任意两个币种之间天然存在一个长度 2 的环，没有 seen 就会 USD→GBP→USD 无限反弹。入队即标记，保证每个节点最多进队一次。
why_en: Because every edge is bidirectional, any two currencies already form a two-step cycle, so without the seen set the search ping-pongs forever.
diagram:
flowchart LR

  G -->|"1/rate"| U
  U -.->|"无 seen: 无限来回"| G

把 seen 读成终止条件。
把 seen 读成影响数值正确性。
认为只有长环才需要去重。
optionMeanings_en: Reads the seen set as a pure performance tweak.
Reads the seen set as the termination guarantee.
Reads the seen set as affecting numeric correctness.
Assumes only longer cycles need deduplication.

双向边构成长度 2 的环，必须靠去重收口。
错在症状：数值不会漂，程序先挂在循环里。
错在最小反例：两个节点就已经成环。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong degree: it does not slow down, it never stops.
Bidirectional edges form a two-step cycle that only deduplication closes.
Wrong symptom: the value never drifts because the loop hangs first.

termDefinitions.meaning: seen：已入队集合，节点入队时立刻加入，避免同一节点被反复扩展。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The seen set records nodes as they are enqueued so no node is ever expanded twice.

scenario: Amazon Round 4：我一开始写成一个方法同时收 conversions + source + target。Sai 把场景讲清——汇率文件每天 ingest 一次，查询在运行时随时来。
scenario_en: Amazon Round 4: my first version took conversions, source and target in one method. Sai reframed it — the rate file is ingested once a day while queries arrive continuously at runtime.
q: 低频 ingest、高频查询的汇率服务，接口该怎么拆？
q_en: For a rate service with low-frequency ingest and high-frequency queries, how should the interface split?
options: 一个方法收全部输入，内部按参数是否为空决定走写还是读
写方法返回一张新图，读方法每次由调用方把图传进来
拆成类：ingest_rate 写图，exchange_rate 只读
读方法每次调用时顺带 ingest 最新文件，保证查询永远读到最新数据
options_en: One method takes everything and branches on which arguments are empty.
The writer returns a fresh graph and the caller passes it into every read.
Split into a class: ingest_rate writes the graph and exchange_rate only reads it.
Every read also re-ingests the latest file so a query always sees current data.
tradeoff: 读写分离 vs 单一方法：拆开让高频读路径只剩一次 BFS，代价是要显式管理共享状态 self.graph 的替换时机。
why: 写和读的频率差好几个数量级，就该拆成两个方法共享一份内存图：ingest 低频重建，exchange_rate 高频只读。这一步是 Sai 眼里的资深信号。
why_en: Writes and reads differ by orders of magnitude in frequency, so they become two methods over one shared in-memory graph.
whenOtherWins: 如果这是个一次性脚本、算完就退出，那不拆、一个函数从头跑到尾反而更省事。

flowchart LR

  I -->|"整图重建"| G[("self.graph")]
  G -->|"BFS 读"| X["exchange_rate 高频读"]

类持有图，两个方法各管一侧。

Wrong ownership: state drifts to the caller and every call site manages its own.

termDefinitions.meaning: ingest：把外部数据源读进来并转成内存结构的写入阶段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ingest is the write phase that reads an external feed and turns it into an in-memory structure.

scenario: Amazon Round 4：ingest 时我两次飘向「增量合并新汇率」，Sai 两次把我拉回来——全球货币约两百种，每个周期整份文件都会到。
scenario_en: Amazon Round 4: twice I drifted toward merging new rates incrementally, and twice Sai pulled me back — there are only about two hundred currencies and the whole file arrives each cycle.
q: ingest 一份完整汇率文件时，该整图重建还是做增量 delta？
q_en: When ingesting a complete rate file, should I rebuild the whole graph or apply an incremental delta?
options: 整图重建：输入小且每周期整份到达，不留陈旧边
增量合并：只更新变动的币种对，省下重建的 CPU
增量合并加定期全量对账，兼顾性能与正确性
整图重建，但保留旧图里新文件没提到的币种对兜底
options_en: Rebuild the whole graph: the input is small, arrives complete each cycle, and leaves no stale edges.
Merge incrementally: touch only the changed pairs and save the rebuild cost.
Merge incrementally plus a periodic full reconciliation for both speed and correctness.
Rebuild the graph but keep old pairs that the new file no longer mentions.
tradeoff: 全量重建 vs delta：重建换来「内存里没有上一版残留」这个强保证，代价是每次都要重新分配整张邻接表。
why: 判据是状态大小和改动比例：输入完整、状态小、每周期整份到达就该重建。delta 只在状态很大而改动很小时才划算。
why_en: The heuristic is state size versus change ratio: a small state that arrives complete each cycle should just be rebuilt, and deltas only pay off on huge state with tiny diffs.
whenOtherWins: 如果图有上亿条边、每次只到几千条变更，重建的代价就压过一切，此时才该做 delta 并额外处理删除。
optionMeanings: 每次 ingest 丢掉旧图，从新输入重建。
在旧图上按币种对逐条打补丁。
以 delta 为主，另加一条全量校正路径。
重建为主但合并旧图里的遗留边。
optionMeanings_en: Each ingest drops the old graph and rebuilds from the new input.
Patches the existing graph pair by pair.
Delta as the main path with a periodic full correction.
Rebuilds but merges leftover edges from the old graph.
optionDirectness: 输入小且完整时，重建把陈旧状态整类问题消掉。
错在代价评估：这里的重建成本本来就可忽略。
错在复杂度：为不存在的性能问题加了两条路径。
错在语义：下架的币种对会永远活在图里。
optionDirectness_en: With a small complete input, rebuilding removes the whole class of stale-state bugs.
Wrong cost model: the rebuild here is already negligible.
Wrong complexity: two code paths for a performance problem that does not exist.
Wrong semantics: delisted pairs would live in the graph forever.

scenario: Sai 让我给汇率 BFS 报复杂度。M 种货币、N 条汇率边，我要说清「为什么是线性」而不只是背一个符号。
scenario_en: Sai asked for the complexity of my currency BFS. With M currencies and N rate edges I need to say why it is linear, not just recite a symbol.
q: M 种货币、N 条汇率边的 BFS，时间和空间各是多少？
q_en: For a BFS over M currencies and N rate edges, what are the time and space costs?
text: 有 seen 集合时每种货币最多入队一次、每条边最多扫一次，时间是 {{O(M + N)}}；队列和 seen 各存不超过 M 个币种，空间是 {{O(M)}}。双向边让 N {{翻倍但不改变量级}}。
text_en: With the seen set each currency is enqueued at most once and each edge scanned once, so time is {{O(M + N)}}; the queue and seen set hold at most M currencies, so space is {{O(M)}}. Bidirectional edges {{double N without changing the order}}.
why: 线性的依据是 seen：它把「每个节点至多访问一次」变成保证。顺带说一句双向边只把 N 翻倍、不改量级，能挡掉「建两条边不是更慢吗」。
why_en: The seen set is what makes it linear, and mentioning that bidirectional edges only double N heads off the follow-up about the extra edges.

scenario: Amazon Round 4 进阶追问：「边是加权的、你要的是数值最优的兑换率，而不只是最少跳数，算法怎么改？」我先抛了 A*，自己都说不太合适，被提示才落到 Bellman-Ford。
scenario_en: Amazon Round 4 follow-up: if the edges are weighted and you want the numerically best rate rather than the fewest hops, how does the algorithm change? I floated A star, admitted it did not fit, and only reached Bellman-Ford after a nudge.
q: 要「数值最优兑换率」而不是最少跳数时，该换成哪类算法？
q_en: To get the numerically best conversion rate instead of the fewest hops, which family of algorithm do I switch to?
options: A*，用启发式把搜索导向目标货币，比 BFS 更快收敛
加权最短路：Bellman-Ford 或 Dijkstra
带优先队列的 BFS，按累积汇率从大到小出队即可
对所有路径做 DFS 枚举，取乘积最大的那条
options_en: A star, using a heuristic to steer the search toward the target currency and converge faster than BFS.
A weighted shortest-path algorithm such as Bellman-Ford or Dijkstra.
BFS with a priority queue, popping in descending order of accumulated rate.
Enumerate every path with DFS and keep the one with the largest product.
tradeoff: BFS vs 加权最短路：BFS 优化的是跳数，换算法后优化的是路径乘积，代价是复杂度从 O(M+N) 升到 O(M·N)。
why: BFS 只在「每条边代价相同」时最优，一旦要比较路径的汇率乘积，就得进最短路家族；有负权或要检测套利环时只有 Bellman-Ford 成立。
why_en: BFS is only optimal when every edge costs the same, so comparing rate products means moving to the shortest-path family and reaching for Bellman-Ford.
whenOtherWins: 如果货币图极大且有可靠的地理或流动性启发式，A* 那种目标导向搜索才有用武之地——但它解决的是搜索速度，不是最优性。
optionMeanings: A*：带启发函数的目标导向搜索。
最短路家族：按权重松弛出全局最优。
把 BFS 队列换成按累积值排序的堆。
穷举所有路径再取最大乘积。
optionMeanings_en: A star is a goal-directed search driven by a heuristic function.
The shortest-path family relaxes weights to a global optimum.
Swaps the BFS queue for a heap ordered by accumulated value.
Enumerates every path and keeps the largest product.
optionDirectness: 错在工具类别：它加速搜索，不改变最优性判据。
换的是优化目标：从跳数变成路径乘积；非负权时 Dijkstra 也行。
方向接近但缺少松弛，遇负权会锁死错误答案。
错在规模：路径数随环的存在爆炸，可能不终止。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong tool class: it speeds up search without changing what counts as optimal.
It changes the objective from hop count to path product, and Dijkstra works when no weight is negative.
Close in spirit but without relaxation it locks in a wrong answer on negative weights.
Wrong scale: the number of paths explodes once a cycle exists and it may not terminate.

termDefinitions.meaning: A*：用启发函数估计到目标的剩余代价，优先扩展看起来更近的节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A-star search uses a heuristic estimate of the remaining cost to the goal so it expands the most promising nodes first.

termDefinitions.meaning: 松弛：若经过某条边能得到更优的距离，就更新终点的当前最优值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Relaxation updates a node's best-known distance whenever going through a given edge turns out to be better.

termDefinitions.meaning: Bellman-Ford：反复松弛所有边 V-1 轮的单源最短路算法，可处理负权。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bellman-Ford is a single-source shortest-path algorithm that relaxes every edge V minus one times and tolerates negative weights.

scenario: 汇率沿路径是相乘的，最短路算法沿路径是相加的。Round 4 的加分点我没自己抛出来：把乘法问题变成加法问题的那一步变换。
scenario_en: Rates multiply along a path while shortest-path algorithms add along a path. The bonus point I failed to volunteer in Round 4 is the transform that turns multiplication into addition.
q: 把「汇率乘积最大」变成标准最短路问题，边权该怎么取？
q_en: To turn 'maximise the product of rates' into a standard shortest-path problem, what should the edge weight be?
options: 取 1 / rate 作边权，最小化倒数之和
取 -log(rate) 作边权，最小化权重之和
取 log(rate) 作边权，最小化权重之和
取 rate 本身作边权，最大化权重之和
options_en: Use one over rate as the weight and minimise the sum of reciprocals.
Use minus log of rate as the weight and minimise the sum of weights.
Use log of rate as the weight and minimise the sum of weights.
Use the rate itself as the weight and maximise the sum of weights.
why: log 把乘法变成加法：最大化 ∏rate 等价于最大化 Σlog(rate)，再取负号就变成标准的「最小化 Σ(-log rate)」，最短路的答案就是最优兑换率。
why_en: Taking logs turns the product into a sum, and the minus sign flips maximisation into the minimisation that shortest-path algorithms already solve.
codeSample:
import math

# 汇率相乘 → 权重相加
w = -math.log(rate)          # rate>1 → w<0；rate<1 → w>0

# 一条路径的权重和
# sum(-log r_i) = -log(∏ r_i)
# 权重和最小  ⇔  汇率乘积最大
best_rate = math.exp(-total_weight)   # 反解回汇率

# 负权环 sum < 0 ⇔ ∏ rate > 1 ⇔ 存在套利

负对数：把乘法结构映射成可相加的代价。
正对数：方向对但没有翻成最小化问题。
直接用汇率当权重并求最大和。

Negative logarithm maps the multiplicative structure onto additive costs.
Plain logarithm: right idea but never flipped into a minimisation.

唯一能让「和最小」严格对应「积最大」的取法。
错在符号：最大化 Σlog 才对应最优，最小化会取反。
错在结构：路径上汇率是连乘，加起来没有意义。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong algebra: minimising a sum of reciprocals is not the same as maximising a product.
The only transform under which a minimal sum exactly matches a maximal product.
Wrong sign: maximising the sum of logs is the optimum, minimising inverts it.
Wrong structure: rates compound along a path, so adding them means nothing.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A logarithm turns a product into a sum because the log of a times b equals the log of a plus the log of b.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负权环：环上所有边的权重之和为负，在这里等价于绕一圈能赚钱。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A negative cycle is a loop whose edge weights sum to less than zero, which here means going round the loop makes money.

scenario: 把边权取成 -log(rate) 之后，面试官问：「如果你的算法报告说图里有负权环，业务上意味着什么？」
scenario_en: After switching the edge weights to minus log of rate, the interviewer asks what it means for the business if the algorithm reports a negative cycle.
q: -log 权重下出现负权环，业务含义是什么、该怎么处理？
q_en: Under minus-log weights, what does a negative cycle mean in business terms and how should the code react?
options: 数据里有一条汇率是负数，应该在 ingest 阶段过滤掉
存在套利环：绕一圈换回原币种能变多，最优汇率无下界
图不连通，说明这两种货币之间没有可行的兑换链
浮点误差累积导致的假阳性，加一个极小的容差即可
options_en: Some rate in the feed is negative and should be filtered out at ingest.
There is an arbitrage cycle: going round it returns more of the starting currency, so the optimum is unbounded.
The graph is disconnected, meaning no conversion chain exists between the two currencies.
It is a false positive from accumulated floating-point error, so add a small tolerance.
tradeoff: 报错退出 vs 直接返回环：把负环当异常上报最安全，代价是放弃了「这条环本身就是可交易信号」的商业价值。
why: 环上 Σ(-log rate) < 0 等价于 ∏rate > 1，绕一圈钱变多。此时「最优兑换率」在数学上无上界，算法必须先报出这个环而不是继续松弛。
why_en: A negative cycle means the rates around the loop multiply to more than one, so the best rate is unbounded and the algorithm must report the loop instead of relaxing forever.
optionMeanings: 把负权误读成负的汇率数值。

termDefinitions.meaning: Dijkstra：用优先队列每次取最近未定型节点的单源最短路算法，要求边权非负。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dijkstra repeatedly settles the nearest unfinished node from a priority queue and requires non-negative edge weights.

termDefinitions.meaning: Floyd-Warshall：三重循环枚举中转点的全源最短路动态规划，时间 O(V³)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Floyd-Warshall is a triple-loop dynamic program that computes shortest paths between all pairs of nodes in cubic time.

scenario: 教练在白板上把最短路分成单源和全源两类，问我汇率题属于哪一类。题面是「给 source 和 target，算出兑换率」，且 ingest 每天只跑一次、查询高频。
scenario_en: My coach split shortest paths into single-source and all-pairs on the whiteboard and asked which one the currency problem is. The prompt gives one source and one target, ingest runs daily and queries are frequent.
q: 「给定 source 和 target 算兑换率」该用单源还是全源算法？
q_en: Given one source and one target, is this a single-source or an all-pairs problem?
options: 全源：反正 ingest 时要遍历整张图，顺便算完所有点对最省事
单源：每次查询只关心一个起点，从它出发松弛即可
都不适用：只有两个具名币种，直接暴力枚举路径更快
全源：货币只有两百种，O(V³) 完全跑得动
options_en: All-pairs: ingest already walks the whole graph, so computing every pair at once is simplest.
Single-source: each query cares about one starting currency, so relax outward from it.
Neither: with only two named currencies, brute-forcing the paths is faster.
All-pairs: there are only two hundred currencies, so cubic time runs fine.
tradeoff: 单源按需算 vs 全源预计算：单源每次查询自己算、内存只存图；全源在 ingest 时一次性付出 O(V³)，换来查询 O(1) 但要存 V² 张表。
why: 题面是单点到单点，查询时从 source 松弛一次就够。全源不是错，而是另一种权衡：把成本挪到 ingest，正好配合读写分离——值得作为延伸提出来。
why_en: The prompt asks one source to one target, so relaxing outward from that source is enough, while all-pairs is a different tradeoff that moves the cost into ingest.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务要反复查任意两种货币且汇率一天只变一次，那在 ingest 时跑一次 Floyd-Warshall、把结果表缓存起来更划算。

查询时从给定起点做一次松弛。
放弃最短路框架改用穷举。
以规模小为由默认选全源。
optionMeanings_en: Computes every pair once during the write phase.
Relaxes outward from the given source at query time.
Abandons the shortest-path framing for brute force.
Defaults to all-pairs on the grounds that the graph is small.
optionDirectness: 错在默认：没需求就预计算 V² 张表是过度设计。
查询形状就是单点到单点，直接对上。
错在方法：有环的图上枚举路径不收敛。
跑得动不等于该跑，取舍要由查询模式决定。

The query shape is exactly one source to one target.
Wrong method: enumerating paths on a cyclic graph does not converge.
Feasible is not the same as warranted; the query pattern decides.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单源最短路：固定一个起点，算它到其余所有节点的最短距离。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Single-source shortest path fixes one starting node and computes the shortest distance to every other node.

scenario: 我说「加权最优就用 Dijkstra」，面试官反问：「你的边权是 -log(rate)，而 USD→EUR 的 rate 可能大于 1，你确定吗？」
scenario_en: I said Dijkstra handles the weighted optimum, and the interviewer pushed back: your weights are minus log of rate and some rates exceed one, so are you sure?
q: 边权取 -log(rate) 之后，为什么不能默认用 Dijkstra？
q_en: Once the weights are minus log of rate, why can't I default to Dijkstra?
options: 因为 Dijkstra 只能跑无向图，而汇率图是有向的
因为 rate > 1 时 -log(rate) 为负，前提被破坏
因为 Dijkstra 需要提前知道目标节点，这里目标是变量
因为对数结果是浮点数，而 Dijkstra 的优先队列只接受整数键
options_en: Because Dijkstra only runs on undirected graphs while the rate graph is directed.
Because a rate above one makes minus log of rate negative, which breaks the precondition.
Because Dijkstra needs the target node up front and here the target is a variable.
Because a logarithm yields a float and Dijkstra priority queues only accept integer keys.
tradeoff: Dijkstra vs Bellman-Ford：Dijkstra 近线性但要求边权非负，Bellman-Ford 慢到 O(V·E)，换来负权可用和负环可检测。
why: Dijkstra 靠「已出堆的节点不会再变短」这条贪心不变量，负权边会让一个更晚发现的路径反超，不变量失效。汇率里 rate>1 的边天然带来负权。
why_en: Dijkstra assumes a settled node can never get cheaper, and a negative edge breaks that invariant, which is exactly what a rate above one produces.
whenOtherWins: 如果能保证所有边权非负——比如把汇率全部归一化到不超过 1，或题目只有手续费这种正代价——Dijkstra 就是更快的选择。

scenario: Round 4 里 Sai 抓到我把累积汇率初值写成整数 1。这是金融系统的题，数值类型不是随手写的细节。
scenario_en: In Round 4 Sai caught me seeding the accumulated rate with an integer one. This is a financial system, so the numeric type is not an incidental detail.
q: 写汇率或金额相关的代码时，数值类型该怎么选？
q_en: When writing code that touches rates or money, how should I pick the numeric type?
options: 全程用 float，只在最后输出时四舍五入到两位小数
全程用整数分单位，汇率也按万分之一存成整数
比例计算用浮点，入账金额落库用 Decimal
用 float 但每步都加一个极小容差，避免比较出错

Store everything as integer cents and keep rates as integer ten-thousandths.

why: 汇率是比例、需要连乘，用浮点字面量就够；但入账金额要能精确到分且可复现，那一层换成十进制定点。先写 1.0 不写 1，是这条规则最小的落点。
why_en: Rates are ratios that get multiplied so floats are fine, but booked amounts need exact decimal cents, and writing one point zero instead of one is the smallest form of that rule.
whenOtherWins: 如果整个系统只做记账加减、不做连乘比例，那从头到尾用整数分单位最省事，连 Decimal 都不需要。

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Binary floating point stores fractions as powers of two, so nought point one is only approximated and the error accumulates.

scenario: Anytime AI 编码热身：二分查找我写出了死循环，运行时卡住，当场没定位到是哪一行。
scenario_en: Anytime AI coding warm-up: my binary search hit an infinite loop at runtime and I could not spot the offending line on the spot.
q: 闭区间二分里，哪一行的写法会直接造成死循环？
q_en: In a closed-interval binary search, which line is the one that actually causes the infinite loop?
options: mid 写成 (left + right) // 2 而不是 left + (right - left) // 2
循环条件写成 while left <= right 而不是 left < right
把 left = mid + 1 写成 left = mid，区间不再收缩
初始 right 写成 len(nums) 而不是 len(nums) - 1
options_en: Computing mid as left plus right over two instead of left plus half the gap.
Writing the loop condition as while left is at most right instead of strictly less than.
Writing left equals mid instead of left equals mid plus one, so the interval stops shrinking.
Initialising right to the array length instead of the length minus one.
tradeoff: 闭区间 vs 半开区间：闭区间三处必须配套（<=、mid+1、mid-1），换来最好记；半开区间允许 right = mid，但循环条件必须改成 <。
why: 死循环的唯一根因是区间没收缩：当 left == right 时 mid 恒等于 left，写 left = mid 就永远停在原地。+1 / -1 保证每轮至少排除一个元素。
why_en: The loop only hangs when the interval stops shrinking, because with left equal to right the midpoint never moves unless you add one.
whenOtherWins: 找左边界那种下界二分里，right = mid 是对的——但此时循环条件必须是 while left < right，两者要成套换。
optionMeanings: 溢出保护的写法差异。
循环条件的开闭差异。
指针更新没有跨过 mid。
初始右端点的取值差异。
optionMeanings_en: A difference in overflow-safe arithmetic.
A difference in whether the loop bound is inclusive.
A pointer update that fails to step past the midpoint.
A difference in the initial right endpoint.
optionDirectness: 在 Python 里整数无上限，这只影响 C/Java。
配合 mid±1 时 <= 才是对的，单独换会漏掉末元素。
两端相遇时 mid 落回 left，指针原地不动。
会越界读取，但报错退出而不是挂住。
optionDirectness_en: Python integers are unbounded, so this only matters in C or Java.
With mid plus or minus one the inclusive bound is correct; changing it alone drops the last element.
When the pointers meet the midpoint falls back onto left and nothing moves.
It reads out of bounds, which raises and exits rather than hanging.
optionScenarioImpacts: 改了它程序照样挂住，浪费调试时间。
改成 < 之后单元素数组会被漏掉，答案变错。
这就是我当天那行，改成 mid + 1 立刻通过。
会看到 IndexError，比死循环更容易定位。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Changing it leaves the program hanging and wastes debugging time.
Switching to a strict bound drops single-element arrays and returns the wrong answer.
That was my line on the day, and mid plus one fixed it immediately.
It raises an index error, which is far easier to locate than a hang.

termDefinitions.meaning: 闭区间：搜索范围包含 left 和 right 两端，对应 while left <= right。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A closed interval includes both endpoints, which pairs with a loop condition of left at most right.

scenario: 二分是最常见的热身题，我却在 Anytime AI 现场写挂了。需要一个「三处必须配套」的记忆锚，写的时候一眼自检。
scenario_en: Binary search is the most common warm-up and I still broke it live at Anytime AI. I need a three-part memory anchor I can self-check at a glance.
q: 标准闭区间二分，哪三处写法必须成套出现？
q_en: In the standard closed-interval binary search, which three lines must appear as a matched set?
text: 闭区间三件套：循环条件 {{while left <= right}}、右移写 {{left = mid + 1}}、左移写 {{right = mid - 1}}；任何一处不配套就要么死循环、要么漏掉末元素。复杂度 {{O(log n)}}。
text_en: The closed-interval trio: the loop condition {{while left <= right}}, the right move {{left = mid + 1}} and the left move {{right = mid - 1}}; break the set and you either hang or miss the last element. The cost is {{O(log n)}}.
why: 三处是一个整体：条件决定区间开闭，两处更新决定是否收缩。写完扫一眼这三行，比事后调试死循环快得多。
why_en: The three lines are one unit — the condition sets the interval type and the two updates decide whether it shrinks — so scanning them beats debugging a hang.

scenario: 面试官把题改成「返回第一个大于等于 target 的下标」——数组里 target 可能重复出现，要的是最左边那个位置。
scenario_en: The interviewer changes the ask to the index of the first element at least as large as the target, where the target may repeat and the leftmost position is wanted.
q: 求下界（第一个 >= target 的位置）时，模板要怎么改？
q_en: For a lower bound — the first index whose value is at least the target — how does the template change?
options: 保持 while left <= right，命中时直接返回 mid
保持 while left <= right，命中时把 right = mid 继续向左缩
改成 while left < right，右端写 right = mid 不减一
改成 while left < right，命中时 left = mid 继续向右缩
options_en: Keep the inclusive loop and return mid as soon as a match is found.
Keep the inclusive loop but set right to mid on a match and keep shrinking leftward.
Switch to a strict loop and move the right pointer to mid without subtracting one.
Switch to a strict loop but set left to mid on a match and keep shrinking rightward.
tradeoff: 找到即返回 vs 收敛到边界：前者代码短但只对唯一元素成立，后者多跑几轮，换来重复元素下的确定边界。
why: 下界的关键是「不排除 mid 本身」，所以右端写 right = mid；一旦不再减一，循环条件必须换成 left < right，否则 left==right 时又卡死。
why_en: A lower bound must keep the midpoint as a candidate, so the right pointer moves to mid, and that forces the strict loop condition to avoid hanging.
whenOtherWins: 如果数组保证元素互不相同、且只问「在不在」，那闭区间模板命中即返回反而更短更快。
optionMeanings: 沿用闭区间模板并提前返回。
闭区间条件配上不减一的右移。
半开收敛：保留 mid 为候选，逼到唯一位置。
半开条件配上不加一的左移。
optionMeanings_en: Reuses the inclusive template with an early return.
Pairs the inclusive condition with a right move that does not subtract one.
Strict convergence: keeps mid as a candidate and narrows to a single index.
Pairs the strict condition with a left move that does not add one.
optionDirectness: 错在语义：重复元素时返回的是任意一个，不是最左。
错在配套：<= 加 right = mid，left==right 时死循环。
保留 mid 才能收到最左位置；另一侧仍写 left = mid + 1。
错在方向：left = mid 在长度 2 的区间上不收缩。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong semantics: with duplicates it returns an arbitrary match, not the leftmost.
Mismatched set: an inclusive bound with right equal to mid hangs when the pointers meet.
Keeping mid is what converges on the leftmost index, while the other side still moves to mid plus one.
Wrong direction: left equal to mid fails to shrink a two-element window.
optionScenarioImpacts: 在有重复值的数组上答案不稳定，测试会随机挂。
又写出一次死循环，和上次是同一个病根。
同一个模板还能改出上界，只换比较符。
循环卡住，和闭区间那次的失败模式一样。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: On arrays with duplicates the answer is unstable and tests fail intermittently.
It reproduces the same hang as before from the same root cause.
The same shape yields the upper bound by flipping the comparison.
The loop sticks in exactly the way it did the first time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下界：第一个不小于 target 的位置，C++ 的 lower_bound、Python 的 bisect_left 都是它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lower bound is the first position whose value is not less than the target, matching bisect_left in Python.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上界：第一个严格大于 target 的位置，对应 Python 的 bisect_right。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An upper bound is the first position whose value is strictly greater than the target, matching bisect_right in Python.

scenario: Alterion 技术面：我写 Trie 的 insert 时直接给每个字符建新节点，面试官提示「you're overriding each character with a new tri node」我才发现。
scenario_en: Alterion technical interview: my Trie insert created a fresh node for every character until the interviewer pointed out that I was overwriting each character with a new node.
q: Trie 的 insert 里，创建新节点之前必须先做什么？
q_en: In a Trie insert, what has to happen before a new node is created?
options: 先检查 node.children 里是否已有这个字符，有就复用
先把当前节点的 is_end 置为 False，避免把前缀误判成词尾
先检查整个单词是否已存在，存在就直接返回
先按字母表大小预分配 26 个子节点槽位
options_en: Check whether the character already exists in node.children and reuse it if so.
Reset the current node is_end flag to false so a prefix is not mistaken for a word end.
Check whether the whole word already exists and return early if it does.
Pre-allocate twenty-six child slots according to the alphabet size.
tradeoff: 复用已有子节点 vs 每次新建：复用是 Trie 共享前缀的全部意义所在，新建则等于把树退化成一堆互不相干的链。
why: Trie 的价值就是共享前缀。不检查就新建，会把已有子树整个换掉，所有共享该前缀的词一起消失——这是这道题最常见的 bug。
why_en: A Trie exists to share prefixes, so creating a node without checking replaces an entire subtree and silently deletes every word under that prefix.
whenOtherWins: 如果结构不是 Trie 而是每个词一条独立链（比如只统计词频的链表桶），那不检查直接建反而没有副作用。
optionMeanings: 存在即复用，不存在才新建。
把词尾标记当成需要清理的状态。
在插入前做一次完整的存在性查询。
按字母表预留固定宽度的子节点数组。
optionMeanings_en: Reuse when present, allocate only when absent.
Treats the word-end flag as state that needs clearing.
Runs a full existence lookup before inserting.
Reserves a fixed-width child array sized to the alphabet.
optionDirectness: 共享前缀的唯一保障，也是这题的正确写法。
错在方向：is_end 只该置 True，清掉等于删词。
错在必要性：复用逻辑本身已经天然幂等。
这是空间换时间的实现细节，救不了覆盖 bug。
optionDirectness_en: The one guarantee that prefixes stay shared, and the fix this problem wants.
Wrong direction: is_end should only ever be set, and clearing it deletes words.
Unnecessary: the reuse logic is already idempotent by construction.
A space-for-time detail that does nothing about the overwrite bug.
optionScenarioImpacts: 插入 car 之后再插 cart，两个词都还在。
插完 car 再插 cart 会把 car 从结果里抹掉。
多一次 O(L) 查询，正确性没变。
内存涨到 26 倍，覆盖问题原样存在。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Insert car then cart and both words survive.
Inserting cart after car would erase car from the results.
Adds one linear lookup without changing correctness.
Memory grows twenty-six fold and the overwrite bug is untouched.

termDefinitions.meaning: Trie：按字符逐层分叉的前缀树，共享公共前缀，用于自动补全和前缀查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A trie is a prefix tree that branches one character at a time and shares common prefixes, used for autocomplete and prefix lookup.

termDefinitions.meaning: is_end：标记这个节点是否是某个完整单词的结尾，区别于纯前缀节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The is_end flag marks whether a node terminates a complete word rather than being only a prefix.

scenario: Alterion 第二个 bug 在 starts_with 的 DFS 里，也是面试官提示「must be something in the DFS」才找到。词典里有 car / cart / cape，查询前缀 ca。
scenario_en: The second Alterion bug lived in the DFS inside starts_with, and again the interviewer had to say the problem must be in the DFS. The dictionary holds car, cart and cape, and the query prefix is ca.
q: starts_with(prefix) 返回所有匹配词，正确的两步是什么？
q_en: To make starts_with return every matching word, what are the two correct steps?
options: 从根 DFS 整棵树，把以 prefix 开头的词筛出来
先走到前缀终点节点，再从它 DFS 收集所有 is_end 路径
先走到前缀终点节点，返回它 children 里的所有直接子节点
对词典里每个词逐个做 startswith 判断并收集
options_en: Run a DFS from the root over the whole tree and filter the words that start with the prefix.
Walk to the node at the end of the prefix, then DFS from there collecting every is_end path.
Walk to the node at the end of the prefix and return all of its immediate children.
Test every word in the dictionary with a startswith check and collect the matches.
tradeoff: 先定位再 DFS vs 全树扫描：定位把搜索范围从整棵树压到一棵子树，代价是要先处理「前缀不存在」的提前返回。
why: 两步是分开的：第一步按前缀逐字符下潜，中途缺字符就返回空；第二步从那个节点 DFS，沿途累积字符串，遇到 is_end 就收一条。
why_en: The two steps are separate — walk down character by character and bail out if a character is missing, then depth-first from that node collecting every path that ends a word.
whenOtherWins: 如果只查一次、词典又很小，直接遍历词表做前缀匹配更省事——建 Trie 的成本还不如省下的那点查询时间。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  R((root)) --> C["c"]
  C --> A["a · 前缀 ca 终点"]
  A --> R2["r · is_end=True → car"]
  R2 --> T["t · is_end=True → cart"]
  A --> P["p"]
  P --> E["e · is_end=True → cape"]
optionMeanings: 不定位，直接全树遍历后过滤。
定位到前缀节点后再做子树 DFS。
只取一层子节点，不往下递归。
完全绕开 Trie，回到线性扫描。
optionMeanings_en: Skips the walk and filters after traversing everything.
Locates the prefix node first, then depth-first over that subtree.
Takes only one level of children without recursing.
Bypasses the trie entirely and scans linearly.
optionDirectness: 错在范围：把 O(子树) 做成 O(全树)，前缀树白建了。
定位加子树遍历，正好是 Trie 的设计意图。
错在深度：cart 这种更长的词一个都收不到。
错在结构：查询成本回到 O(词数 × 词长)。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong scope: it turns a subtree walk into a whole-tree walk and wastes the trie.
Locate then walk the subtree is exactly what a trie is built for.
Wrong depth: longer words such as cart are never collected.
Wrong structure: query cost falls back to word count times word length.
optionScenarioImpacts: 词典变大后查询明显变慢，面试官会追问。
ca 能一次收齐 car、cart、cape 三个词。
查 ca 只返回 r 和 p 两个字符，不是单词。
面试官会问「那你为什么要建 Trie」。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Queries slow down visibly as the dictionary grows and that draws a follow-up.
The prefix ca returns car, cart and cape in one pass.
Querying ca returns the letters r and p rather than words.
It invites the question of why the trie was built at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 子树：以某个节点为根的整棵下挂结构，前缀查询只需遍历它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A subtree is everything hanging below a given node, and a prefix query only needs to traverse that part.

scenario: 面试官在我写完 Trie 后问复杂度。词典有 N 个词、查询词长 L、字符集 26，我要说清「为什么和词数无关」。
scenario_en: After I finished the Trie the interviewer asked for complexity. With N words in the dictionary, a query of length L and a 26-letter alphabet, I need to explain why the word count drops out.
q: Trie 的 insert / search 复杂度是多少，为什么和词典大小无关？
q_en: What are the insert and search costs of a trie, and why do they not depend on dictionary size?
text: insert 和 search 都只沿一条路径走 L 步，每步在 children 里做一次哈希查找，所以是 {{O(L)}}，与词数 N {{无关}}。starts_with 还要加上子树遍历，是 {{O(L + 结果总字符数)}}；最坏空间 {{O(N × L)}} 个节点。
text_en: Insert and search walk one path of length L doing a constant-time child lookup at each step, so both are {{O(L)}} and {{independent of}} the word count N. A prefix query adds the subtree walk, giving {{O(L plus the total characters returned)}}, and worst-case space is {{O(N times L)}} nodes.
why: 路径长度只由词长决定，所以词典再大查询也不变慢——这正是自动补全选 Trie 而不是遍历词表的理由。代价是节点数会随不共享前缀的词线性膨胀。
why_en: The path length depends only on the word, so a bigger dictionary does not slow lookups, and that is exactly why autocomplete uses a trie.

scenario: Convoke 现场编码（Google Doc，无 IDE）：「不用内置 dict 实现一个字典」。我先说哈希集加链表，方向对，接着跑偏到跳表，被问「Python 的字典怎么实现的」时重建不出机制。
scenario_en: Convoke live coding in a Google Doc with no IDE: implement a dictionary without using a dict. I started with a hash set plus linked list, which was right, then drifted to a skip list and could not reconstruct the mechanism when asked how Python's dict works.
q: 「不用 dict 实现 dict」，该给出的核心机制链是什么？
q_en: For 'implement a dictionary without a dictionary', what is the core mechanism chain to state?
options: 跳表：多层索引让查找降到 O(log n)，插入时随机决定层数
平衡二叉搜索树：按 key 排序，查找插入都稳定 O(log n)
有序数组加二分查找：查找 O(log n)，插入时整体后移
哈希函数算出桶下标，桶内挂链表处理冲突，平均 O(1)
options_en: A skip list: layered indexes bring lookup to logarithmic time and each insert picks a random height.
A balanced binary search tree: keys stay sorted and both lookup and insert are logarithmic.
A sorted array with binary search: lookup is logarithmic and inserts shift the tail.
A hash function gives the bucket index, each bucket chains its collisions, and lookup is constant on average.
tradeoff: 哈希表 vs 有序结构：哈希换来平均 O(1) 的按 key 访问，代价是彻底放弃顺序——范围查询和「最小的 key」都做不了。
why: 字典的语义是按 key 直接定位，核心链是 hash(key) → 取模得桶下标 → 桶内链表比对 key。平均 O(1)，全冲突退化 O(n)。
why_en: A dictionary means locating a value straight from its key, so the chain is hash the key, mod it into a bucket index, then walk that bucket's list.
whenOtherWins: 如果接口除了 get/put 还要「按 key 顺序遍历」或「找区间内的所有 key」，那有序结构才对，哈希表天然做不到。
optionMeanings: 跳表：概率型多层链表，保持 key 有序。
平衡树：靠旋转维持高度，key 保持有序。
有序数组：紧凑存储，靠二分定位。
哈希表：算下标直达，冲突挂在桶里。
optionMeanings_en: A skip list is a probabilistic layered linked list that keeps keys ordered.
A balanced tree keeps height bounded by rotations and keeps keys ordered.
A sorted array stores compactly and locates by bisection.
A hash table computes the slot directly and parks collisions in the bucket.
optionDirectness: 错在前提：跳表要求 key 可比较有序，字典的 key 不必有序。
有序性是额外成本，字典语义里没人要它。
错在写入：每次插入平均搬一半元素，put 退化成 O(n)。
按 key 直达正是字典的定义，顺序是被主动放弃的。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong premise: a skip list needs comparable ordered keys, which a dictionary does not require.
Ordering is an extra cost that the dictionary contract never asks for.
Wrong on writes: each insert shifts half the array, making put linear.
Direct key access is the definition of a dictionary, and ordering is deliberately given up.
optionScenarioImpacts: 我当天就是跑到这里，之后再也接不回哈希。
答得像在讲 TreeMap，面试官要的是 hashmap。
put 一慢，面试官立刻会问「那插入呢」。
顺着这条链能直接往下写 get / put / delete。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: That is where I drifted, and I never got back to hashing.
It answers as if describing a TreeMap when a hash map was asked for.
Slow puts invite an immediate 'and what about inserts' follow-up.
The chain leads straight into writing get, put and delete.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跳表：在有序链表上叠多层索引的概率型结构，查找期望 O(log n)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A skip list layers probabilistic express lanes over a sorted linked list, giving logarithmic expected lookup.

termDefinitions.meaning: 哈希冲突：两个不同的 key 算出同一个桶下标，必须用额外机制区分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash collision happens when two different keys land in the same bucket and need an extra mechanism to tell apart.

scenario: Convoke 要我把「不用 dict 实现 dict」写出来。我在大量提示下才到「哈希码 → 数组下标」，但没能写完实现。
scenario_en: Convoke asked me to actually implement a dictionary without a dict. With heavy prompting I reached hash code to array index but never finished the implementation.
q: 用数组加链地址法手写字典，get 的三步是什么？
q_en: Implementing a dictionary by hand with an array and chaining, what are the three steps of get?
options: 哈希 key 得下标 → 桶内链表比对 key → 返回 value
遍历所有桶 → 在每个桶里比对 key → 命中返回 value
哈希 key 得下标 → 直接返回该下标存的 value
哈希 key 得下标 → 从该下标向后线性探测直到找到相等的 key
options_en: Hash the key to an index, compare keys inside that bucket, then return the value.
Walk every bucket, compare keys inside each one, and return the match.
Hash the key to an index and return whatever value sits at that index.
Hash the key to an index, then probe forward linearly until an equal key turns up.
tradeoff: 链地址 vs 开放寻址：链地址把冲突关在桶里、删除简单，代价是每个节点多一个指针、缓存局部性差。
why: 关键是第二步：哈希只能定位到桶，不能证明 key 相等——不同 key 可能同桶。必须在桶内逐个比对 key，才能保证返回的是对的 value。
why_en: Hashing only narrows you to a bucket, so the key comparison inside that bucket is what proves you found the right entry.
whenOtherWins: 如果实现改成开放寻址，那第三个动作就换成线性探测——桶里不挂链表，冲突直接顺延到下一个空槽。
optionMeanings: 定位到桶后仍要在桶内确认 key。
放弃哈希定位，退回全表扫描。
把桶当成只能装一个条目的槽。
开放寻址的探测流程。

Abandons hashing and falls back to a full scan.

The probing routine used by open addressing.

错在效率：哈希算了却没用，get 变成 O(n)。
错在冲突：两个 key 同桶时后写的会覆盖前一个。

面试官会问「那哈希是干什么的」。
两个 key 撞桶时静默返回错误的 value。
桶里挂着链表却去探测下一个槽，逻辑自相矛盾。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It leads straight into put and delete so the implementation can finish.

termDefinitions.meaning: 链地址法：每个桶挂一条链表，冲突的条目依次追加在同一个桶里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Separate chaining gives every bucket its own list so colliding entries are appended to the same bucket.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开放寻址：冲突时按固定规则探测下一个空槽，所有条目都住在数组本体里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Open addressing probes for the next free slot on a collision so every entry lives inside the array itself.

scenario: 面试官追问：「你这个手写字典什么时候需要扩容？」常见阈值是负载因子约 0.75，也就是条目数除以桶数超过 3/4。
scenario_en: Follow-up: when does your hand-written dictionary need to grow? The usual threshold is a load factor around nought point seven five, meaning entries divided by buckets exceeds three quarters.
q: 负载因子超过约 0.75 就扩容，这个阈值挡住的是什么？
q_en: Resizing once the load factor passes about nought point seven five — what does that threshold protect against?
options: 挡住内存浪费：桶太多会让数组本身占用超过条目本身
挡住哈希函数退化：负载高时哈希值分布会变得不均匀
挡住链变长：平均每桶条目数上升，查找变慢
挡住整数溢出：下标取模在桶数过小时会算出负数
options_en: It prevents wasted memory, since too many buckets make the array itself outweigh the entries.
It prevents hash degradation, because hash values spread less evenly under high load.
It stops chains from growing: average entries per bucket rise and lookups slow down.
It prevents integer overflow, because the modulo can go negative when the bucket count is too small.
tradeoff: 低负载因子 vs 高负载因子：阈值调低查找更快，代价是空桶更多、内存更浪费；调高省内存但链变长。
why: 负载因子 = 条目数 / 桶数，它直接就是「每个桶平均挂几个」。超过约 3/4 后冲突概率明显上升，扩容并重新散列把平均链长压回接近 1。
why_en: The load factor is entries over buckets, which is literally the average chain length, so resizing keeps lookups near constant time.
optionMeanings: 把阈值读成内存占用的上限。
把阈值读成哈希函数质量的保护。
把阈值读成平均链长的上限。
把阈值读成算术安全检查。
optionMeanings_en: Reads the threshold as a memory ceiling.
Reads the threshold as protecting hash quality.
Reads the threshold as a cap on average chain length.
Reads the threshold as an arithmetic safety check.
optionDirectness: 方向反了：扩容是把桶变多，本身增加内存。
哈希函数的分布和装了多少条目无关。
0.75 直接就是平均每桶条目数的上限。
取模的符号问题和负载因子没有关系。
optionDirectness_en: Backwards: resizing adds buckets and therefore uses more memory.
A hash function's distribution does not change with how full the table is.
The figure is literally a cap on average entries per bucket.
Modulo sign issues have nothing to do with the load factor.
optionScenarioImpacts: 会得出「不该扩容」的相反结论。
把话题引向哈希函数，答不到扩容的动机。
能顺势说出「扩容要重新散列所有条目」。
把性能问题答成了正确性问题。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It leads to the opposite conclusion, that resizing is unnecessary.
It steers toward hash quality and never reaches the reason for resizing.
It sets up the natural next line that resizing rehashes every entry.
It answers a performance question as if it were a correctness one.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负载因子：条目数除以桶数，等于每个桶平均挂几个条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The load factor is the number of entries divided by the number of buckets, which equals the average entries per bucket.

termDefinitions.meaning: 重新散列：扩容后桶数变了，所有条目都要按新桶数重算下标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rehashing recomputes every entry's slot after the bucket count changes during a resize.

scenario: 面试官问「Python 的字典是怎么实现的」——我当时答不上来。教科书讲的是桶挂链表，而 CPython 走的是另一条路。
scenario_en: The interviewer asked how Python's dictionary is implemented and I could not answer. Textbooks teach per-bucket lists while CPython took a different route.
q: CPython 的 dict 用的是链地址法还是开放寻址？
q_en: Does CPython's dict use separate chaining or open addressing?
options: 链地址法，和教科书里的哈希表实现一致
先链地址，桶内条目过多时转成红黑树
两者混用：小字典用开放寻址，超过阈值自动切换到链地址
开放寻址：冲突时按扰动序列探测下一个槽，无链表指针
options_en: Separate chaining, the same as the textbook hash table.
Chaining first, converting a bucket to a red-black tree once it grows too long.
A mix: small dicts use open addressing and switch to chaining past a size threshold.
Open addressing: collisions probe a perturbed sequence of slots with no list pointers.
tradeoff: 开放寻址 vs 链地址：开放寻址省掉每条目一个指针、缓存更友好，代价是删除要留墓碑标记、且负载一高性能塌得更快。
why: CPython 用开放寻址加扰动探测，并从 3.6 起把「稀疏索引表 + 紧凑条目数组」拆开，顺带保住了插入顺序。教科书的链地址是另一种实现，讲的时候要分清。
why_en: CPython uses open addressing with a perturbed probe sequence rather than per-bucket lists, and since Python 3.6 a sparse index table fronts a compact entry array.
optionMeanings: 认为 CPython 照搬教科书结构。
描述的是 Java 8 之后的树化优化。
认为按规模在两种策略间切换。
冲突时在数组内探测下一个可用槽。
optionMeanings_en: Assumes CPython copies the textbook structure.
Describes the tree-conversion optimisation added in Java 8.
Assumes the strategy switches with table size.
Probes for the next usable slot inside the array itself.
optionDirectness: 错在实现：CPython 桶里没有链表指针。
错在语言：树化是 Java 的做法，不是 Python 的。
错在机制：CPython 只有一种冲突策略。
抓住了 CPython 把条目全放在数组里这一点。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong implementation: CPython buckets carry no list pointers.
Wrong language: tree conversion is a Java move, not a Python one.
Wrong mechanism: CPython has exactly one collision strategy.
Catches the fact that CPython keeps every entry inside the array.
optionScenarioImpacts: 讲通用哈希表可以，回答「Python 的」就跑偏。
细节很足但答错了语言，比不答更刺眼。
编了一个不存在的自适应机制。
能顺势说出 3.6 之后为什么字典有序。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Fine for hash tables in general but wrong for the Python question.
Rich detail about the wrong language stands out worse than silence.
Invents an adaptive mechanism that does not exist.
It sets up the follow-on about why dicts became ordered in three point six.

termDefinitions.meaning: 扰动探测：CPython 用哈希值的高位参与下一个槽的计算，减少聚集。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Perturbed probing mixes the high bits of the hash into each next slot to reduce clustering.

termDefinitions.meaning: 墓碑：开放寻址里删除条目时留下的标记，保证探测链不被截断。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tombstone marks a deleted slot in open addressing so the probe chain is not cut short.

scenario: Amazon phone screen：表单字段名用点号表示嵌套，如 contact.phone.area，要返回嵌套对象。思路我对了，但实现时变量命名混乱、递归基线没说清，面试官得逐行引导。
scenario_en: Amazon phone screen: form field names use dot notation such as contact.phone.area and must become a nested object. My approach was right but the naming was inconsistent, the base case was unclear, and the interviewer had to walk me through lines.
q: 把 a.b.c = v 这样的扁平路径写进嵌套字典，最干净的写法是什么？
q_en: What is the cleanest way to write a flat path like a.b.c equals v into a nested dictionary?
options: 对每一层用 try/except KeyError 捕获缺失并补建中间层
逐层 node.setdefault(key, {})，末段赋值
先把路径全展开成一串嵌套字面量，再用 update 合并进结果
递归到最深层再回溯，一层层把子字典包回父字典
options_en: Wrap each level in try and except KeyError to catch what is missing and create it.
Descend with node.setdefault of key and an empty dict, assigning at the last segment.
Expand the whole path into nested literals first, then merge them into the result with update.
Recurse to the deepest level and on the way back wrap each child dict into its parent.
tradeoff: 迭代 setdefault vs 递归：迭代三行、没有基线要讲，代价是不如递归直观地体现「路径」结构。
why: setdefault 一次完成「没有就建、有就复用」，循环体只有一行，基线问题直接消失。这个模式在表单序列化、配置扁平化、接口响应规范化里反复出现。
why_en: setdefault creates the level if missing and reuses it otherwise, so the loop body is one line and there is no base case to explain.
whenOtherWins: 如果每一层还要做校验或类型转换，递归版本更好——因为可以在每层插入自己的处理逻辑，而不是塞进一行 setdefault。
optionMeanings: 用异常控制流补建缺失层。
用 setdefault 边下潜边补层。
先造完整嵌套结构再做深合并。
递归下潜后在回溯阶段组装。
optionMeanings_en: Uses exception control flow to create missing levels.
Descends and creates levels in one setdefault call.
Builds the full nested shape first and deep-merges it.
Recurses down and assembles on the way back up.
optionDirectness: 错在代价：缺层是常态不是异常，异常路径成了主路径。
一行同时覆盖建与复用，循环体不用分支。
错在合并：内置 update 是浅合并，同名父键会被整个替换。
错在方向：回溯组装会丢掉已存在的兄弟键。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong cost model: missing levels are the norm, so the exception path becomes the main path.
One call covers both create and reuse, so the loop needs no branch.
Wrong merge: the built-in update is shallow and replaces a whole shared parent key.
Wrong direction: assembling on the way back drops sibling keys that already exist.
optionScenarioImpacts: 三层嵌套要写三层 try，代码比递归还长。
十行内写完，面试官不用逐行引导。
contact.phone 和 contact.email 会互相覆盖。
同一个 contact 下的第二个字段会丢。

It fits in ten lines and nobody has to walk me through it.
Fields like contact.phone and contact.email overwrite each other.
The second field under the same parent disappears.
