叫富者愈富反馈回路，用时间衰减或位置去偏削弱自我强化
叫训练-服务偏差，缓解方法是上特征存储统一两端计算逻辑
叫过拟合，缓解方法是加 L2 正则和 dropout 并早停
options_en: It's cold start; mitigate by giving new items more training data and an impression quota.
It's a rich-get-richer feedback loop; use time-decay or position-debiasing to weaken self-reinforcement.
It's training-serving skew; mitigate with a feature store that unifies both computation paths.
It's overfitting; mitigate with L2 regularization, dropout and early stopping.
optionExplanations: 冷启动是「新物品没数据」，这里是「热门被系统性放大压制新品」的动态回路，成因不同。
对；热门度→曝光→点击→更热门是自我强化环，时间衰减降旧点击权重、位置去偏扣掉排位红利，才能给新内容机会。
训练-服务偏差是特征在训练和线上算得不一致，与这里的热门度自我放大无关。
过拟合是模型记训练集噪声，跟热门度特征造成的曝光反馈回路是两码事。
optionExplanations_en: Cold-start is 'new items lack data'; this is a dynamic loop where popular items are systematically amplified and suppress new ones — different cause.
Correct — popularity→exposure→clicks→more popularity is a self-reinforcing loop, so time-decay lowers old-click weight and position-debiasing removes the placement bonus to give new content a chance.
Training-serving skew is features computed inconsistently between training and serving, unrelated to popularity self-amplification.
Overfitting is memorizing training-set noise, a different thing from the exposure feedback loop caused by popularity features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 热门度特征自我强化：高 CTR→多曝光→多点击→更高 CTR，压制新内容、降低多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rich-get-richer is a self-reinforcing popularity loop: high CTR to more exposure to more clicks to higher CTR, suppressing new content.

termDefinitions.meaning: 扣掉「排在前面本身带来的点击」，估计物品的真实吸引力而非排位红利。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Position-debiasing removes clicks caused merely by high placement to estimate an item's true appeal rather than its rank bonus.

scenario: 你要给排序加最能提升个性化的一类信号。全局物品 CTR 说这个物品普遍受欢迎，但答不出「这个用户是否会喜欢它」。
scenario_en: You want the single most personalization-boosting signal for ranking. Global item CTR says an item is popular overall but can't say 'will this user like it.'
q: 哪类特征最能直接编码个性化相关性？
q_en: Which feature category most directly encodes personalized relevance?
why: cross 特征（用户×物品）最强：是否点过/买过这个物品、用户在该物品类目上的历史 CTR、用户向量与物品向量的余弦相似度——它们直接编码「这个用户对这个物品」的相关性。全局 CTR 只说物品热，cross 才说这个用户在不在乎。
why_en: Cross features (user×item) are most powerful: prior click/purchase, user's CTR on this item's category, user-item embedding cosine — they encode personalized relevance directly.
tradeoff: cross 特征(直接编码个性化相关性、最强 vs 需 serving 时 join、延迟敏感)
options: contextual 特征（时间/设备/地点）最能编码个性化相关性
cross 特征（用户×物品）：点过/买过、用户对该类目 CTR、向量相似度
item 全局热门度特征最能编码「这个用户」对物品的相关性
user 人口统计特征（年龄/国家/语言）最能编码用户对具体物品的相关性
options_en: Contextual features (time / device / location) best encode personalized relevance.
Cross features (user×item): prior click or purchase, user CTR on the category, embedding similarity.
Global item popularity features best encode how relevant an item is to this particular user.
User demographics (age / country / language) best encode a user's relevance to a specific item.
whenOtherWins: 如果检索阶段还没有具体候选物品（只做粗召回），来不及算 user×item 交叉，就先靠 user 和 item 侧特征，cross 留到精排。
optionExplanations: contextual 刻画请求环境（几点、什么设备），不含「这个用户对这个物品」的关系，编码不了个性化相关性。
对；cross 把用户和物品拼在一起，直接回答「这个用户对这个物品的相关性」，是个性化最强的一类信号。
全局热门度是 item 特征、对所有用户一样，天然无法区分「这个用户」是否喜欢。
人口统计是粗粒度 user 特征，只说用户是谁、不说对具体物品的关系，个性化相关性弱。
optionExplanations_en: Contextual describes the request environment (time, device), not the 'this user to this item' relationship, so it can't encode personalized relevance.
Correct — cross joins user and item to answer 'this user's relevance to this item' directly, the strongest personalization signal.
Global popularity is an item feature identical across users, inherently unable to tell whether 'this user' likes it.
Demographics are coarse user features saying who the user is, not their relation to a specific item, so personalized relevance is weak.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户×物品关系特征（是否点过、类目 CTR、向量相似度），直接编码个性化相关性，最强但需 serving 时组装。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross feature encodes the user×item relationship (prior click, category CTR, embedding similarity), the most powerful personalization signal, assembled at serving time.

scenario: 1 亿用户 × 1000 万物品，你想预计算所有用户×物品交叉特征放进特征存储，直接查表。
scenario_en: 100M users × 10M items; you want to precompute all user×item cross features into a feature store and just look them up.
q: 为什么不能预计算全部交叉特征，正确做法是什么？
q_en: Why can't you precompute all cross features, and what's the right approach?
why: 1 亿×1000 万=10^15 对，预计算存不下。只能在 serving 时对检索出的 top-k 候选（几百到几千个）现场算交叉，或用 ANN 近似。
why_en: 100M×10M is 10^15 pairs, infeasible to precompute, so assemble cross features at serving time only for the top-k retrieved candidates or via ANN.
options: 可以全部预计算，10^15 对现代对象存储轻松装下，直接查表最快
1 亿×1000 万=10^15 对不可行；只对 top-k 候选在 serving 时算
把 KV 集群横向扩到几百个分片就能存下全部交叉特征，靠加机器解决容量、不必限制候选数量
把交叉特征全丢掉，只用 user 和 item 特征，反正 cross 可有可无
options_en: Precompute them all — 10^15 pairs fit fine in modern object storage, and lookups are fastest.
100M×10M = 10^15 pairs is infeasible; compute cross only for the top-k candidates at serving time.
Just scale the KV cluster out to a few hundred shards and it can hold every cross feature — throw more machines at capacity instead of capping candidates.
Drop cross features entirely and keep only user and item features — cross is optional anyway.
optionExplanations: 10^15 对远超任何存储与预计算能力，「轻松装下」是数量级误判，这条路根本走不通。
对；全量组合爆炸，只能把交叉特征推迟到已缩小的 top-k 候选上现场算，或用 ANN 近似，控制在每请求可承受的计算量。
几百个分片也远不够装下 10^15 对，问题是组合爆炸的数量级，不是分片数——堆硬件解决不了指数增长。
cross 是最强的个性化信号，丢掉它排序质量大跌，因噎废食，不是正确取舍。
optionExplanations_en: 10^15 pairs far exceeds any storage or precompute capacity; 'fit easily' is an order-of-magnitude misjudgment — this path is a dead end.
Correct — the full cross product explodes, so defer cross features to the already-narrowed top-k candidates computed on the fly, or approximate with ANN, keeping per-request compute affordable.
Even a few hundred shards fall far short of 10^15 pairs; the problem is the combinatorial magnitude, not shard count — hardware can't fix exponential growth.
Cross is the strongest personalization signal; dropping it tanks ranking quality — self-defeating, not a correct tradeoff.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：不精确比对全量、快速找出向量空间里最相似的候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) quickly finds the most similar candidates in vector space without an exact full comparison.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索阶段先缩小到最相关的 k 个物品，昂贵的交叉特征只在这批上算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-k candidates are the k most relevant items narrowed by retrieval, on which expensive cross features are computed.

tradeoff: cross 特征在 serving 时对 top-k 现算(保个性化威力、吃延迟) vs 全量预计算(查表快但 10^15 对存不下)

scenario: 你要把「小时」（0-23）作为特征喂模型。用整数编码时，模型看到 23（晚 11 点）和 0（午夜）相差 23，认为它们极不相近，但它们其实只差 1 小时。
scenario_en: You feed 'hour' (0-23) as a feature. With integer encoding, the model sees 23 (11 PM) and 0 (midnight) as 23 apart — very dissimilar — though they're only 1 hour apart.
q: 该怎么编码小时才能让模型理解它的周期性？
q_en: How should you encode the hour so the model grasps its periodicity?
why: 用循环编码 sin(2π·hour/24) 与 cos(2π·hour/24) 把 24 小时铺到单位圆，23 点和 1 点自然相近。整数编码把周期量当线性量，模型学不到首尾相接。
why_en: Cyclically encode the hour as sin(2π·hour/24) and cos(2π·hour/24), mapping 24 hours onto a circle so 11 PM and 1 AM are close.
tradeoff: 循环编码 sin/cos(保周期、首尾相接) vs 整数编码(把周期量当线性、23 与 0 被当成极远)
options: 直接用整数 0-23 输入模型，模型自己能学出 23 点和 0 点相邻，无需特殊处理
用循环编码：sin(2π·h/24) 与 cos(2π·h/24) 两个特征
把小时 one-hot 成 24 维，每个小时一列，就能表达周期性
把小时标准化到 [0,1] 区间，线性缩放之后周期问题自然消失
options_en: Feed the raw integer 0-23; the model figures out on its own that 11 PM and midnight are adjacent.
Cyclically encode it as two features, sin(2π·h/24) and cos(2π·h/24).
One-hot the hour into 24 dimensions, one column per hour, to express periodicity.
Normalize the hour to [0,1]; after linear scaling the periodicity problem disappears.
whenOtherWins: 如果用树模型（如 XGBoost）且把小时当纯类别切分，one-hot/分桶也能工作；sin/cos 的周期优势主要在依赖距离/线性的模型上明显。
optionExplanations: 整数编码把 23 和 0 摆成相距 23 的两端，模型默认它们极不相似，学不出首尾相邻，正是要避免的。
对；sin/cos 一对把时间放上单位圆，23 点与 1 点坐标接近，模型天然理解「跨午夜是相邻的」，是周期特征的标准编码。
one-hot 丢掉了顺序和相邻关系，23 和 0 变成两个无关维度，同样表达不了周期相邻。
线性缩放仍是线性量，0 和 0.96（23 点）依旧被当成两端，周期问题没解决只是换了刻度。
optionExplanations_en: Integer encoding places 23 and 0 as endpoints 23 apart, so the model assumes they're very dissimilar and can't learn the wrap-around — exactly what to avoid.
Correct — the sin/cos pair puts time on a unit circle so 11 PM and 1 AM have nearby coordinates, letting the model natively grasp that crossing midnight is adjacent — the standard cyclic encoding.
One-hot discards order and adjacency, turning 23 and 0 into two unrelated dimensions, still not expressing cyclic adjacency.
Linear scaling stays linear, so 0 and 0.96 (11 PM) remain endpoints; the periodicity problem is unsolved, just rescaled.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把周期量（小时、星期、角度）映射成 sin/cos 一对特征，铺到单位圆上以保留首尾相邻。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cyclic encoding maps a periodic value (hour, weekday, angle) to a sin/cos pair on a unit circle, preserving wrap-around adjacency.

scenario: 把小时（0-23）循环编码成两个连续特征，让模型理解 23 点和 0 点相邻。
scenario_en: Cyclically encode the hour (0-23) into two continuous features so the model sees 23:00 and 00:00 as adjacent.
q: 补全循环编码小时的两个公式：
q_en: Fill in the two formulas for cyclically encoding the hour:
text: hour_sin = {{sin}}(2π·hour/24)，hour_cos = {{cos}}(2π·hour/24)；周期用 {{24}} 归一，把小时铺到单位圆上，23 点与 1 点坐标相近。
text_en: hour_sin = {{sin}}(2π·hour/24), hour_cos = {{cos}}(2π·hour/24); normalize by the period {{24}} to place hours on a unit circle so 11 PM and 1 AM are close.
why: sin 和 cos 一起才能唯一定位圆上的点（单用 sin 会让上午下午同值），除以周期 24 把 0-23 映满整圈。它的下游用途：任何有日周期、周周期的行为特征（时段、星期几）都用这招，让模型学到「时间是环形的」。
why_en: sin and cos together uniquely locate a point on the circle, normalized by the 24-hour period, so the model treats time as circular.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把周期量除以其周期（小时用 24、星期用 7）再乘 2π，映满一整圈。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Period normalization divides a cyclic value by its period (24 for hours, 7 for weekdays) times 2π to span the full circle.

scenario: 特征 user_click_count_30d 在训练时由夜间批处理 SQL 算，在生产里由实时流式计数器算。两边的窗口边界和迟到事件处理不同，值悄悄不一致，模型上线后精度下降却查不出代码改动。
scenario_en: Feature user_click_count_30d is computed by nightly batch SQL in training but a real-time streaming counter in production. Their window boundaries and late-event handling differ; values silently diverge and accuracy drops with no code change.
q: 这是什么问题，为什么这么隐蔽？
q_en: What is this problem, and why is it so stealthy?
why: 训练-服务偏差：同一特征训练用批 SQL、服务用流式计数，窗口边界与迟到事件处理不同，值悄悄不一致。隐蔽在于不报错、无代码 diff，只有数值在漂。
why_en: It's training-serving skew: the same feature computed by two code paths (batch SQL vs streaming) diverges silently with no error, so serving values differ from training and performance degrades.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  T["训练: 夜间批 SQL"] --> V1["click_count_30d = A"]
  S["服务: 流式计数器"] --> V2["click_count_30d = B"]
  V1 --> D{"A ≠ B 悄悄漂"}
  V2 --> D
  D --> P["线上精度下降、无报错"]
options: 是数据漂移：输入分布随时间自然变化，与两端特征计算逻辑无关，重训即可
是训练-服务偏差：同一特征训练用批 SQL、服务用流式，值悄悄不一致
是过拟合：模型记住了训练集里的噪声，一换到生产数据就掉点
是标签泄漏：训练时用了未来信息，离线指标虚高、线上达不到
options_en: It's data drift: the input distribution shifts naturally over time, unrelated to computation paths.
It's training-serving skew: the same feature comes from batch SQL in training and streaming in serving.
It's overfitting: the model memorized noise in the training set and drops on production data.
It's label leakage: future information leaked into training, inflating offline metrics only.
optionExplanations: 数据漂移是外部输入分布变了；这里输入没变，是同一特征被两套代码算出不同值，成因在计算逻辑不一致。
对；训练和服务两条计算路径不一致，同名特征值不对齐，模型吃到与训练不同的分布，且悄无声息，是生产 ML 的头号隐坑。
过拟合是模型泛化问题；这里模型没问题，是喂进来的特征值在两侧算得不一样。
标签泄漏发生在训练标签用了未来信息，属于另一类问题，和「同一特征两套算法」无关。
optionExplanations_en: Data drift is the external input distribution changing; here the input is unchanged — the same feature is computed to different values by two code paths, a logic mismatch.
Correct — the two computation paths disagree, same-named feature values misalign, the model sees a distribution unlike training, and it's silent — the number-one production ML pitfall.
Overfitting is a generalization problem; here the model is fine, but the fed feature values are computed differently on the two sides.
Label leakage is future info in training labels — a different problem, unrelated to 'one feature, two computations.'

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 同一特征在训练与线上服务用不同逻辑计算，值悄悄不一致，导致模型无声退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is the same feature computed by different logic in training vs serving, diverging silently and degrading the model.

tradeoff: 两套独立实现(各自最优、批快流实时) vs 单一特征定义(两端一致、根除偏差但多一层基础设施)

scenario: 你想根治「同一特征在训练和服务算得不一样」的偏差，不想再维护两套各写一遍的批处理和流式代码。
scenario_en: You want to root out 'same feature, different values in training vs serving' skew without maintaining two hand-written batch and streaming implementations.
q: 该上什么基础设施，它怎么消除偏差？
q_en: What infrastructure fixes this, and how does it eliminate skew?
why: 上特征存储（Feast/Tecton/Hopsworks）：它提供一个统一的特征计算层，训练和服务消费同一份特征定义、拿到一致的值——一次定义、两端一致，从根上消除训练-服务偏差，而不是靠两套代码去对齐。
why_en: Use a feature store (Feast/Tecton/Hopsworks): one feature definition consumed by both training and serving guarantees consistent values, eliminating skew at the source.
tradeoff: 特征存储(一次定义、两端一致、根除偏差 vs 引入一层基础设施与运维)
options: 给批处理和流式两套代码各自补充更多单元测试和 CI 检查，靠测试把两边的输出长期对齐
上特征存储（Feast/Tecton）：训练与服务共用同一份特征定义
把所有特征都改成请求时实时算，训练时也现算，彻底放弃预计算
只在服务端算特征，训练直接复用线上打点日志，不需要统一层
options_en: Add more unit tests and CI checks to the batch and streaming code paths separately, and let testing keep the two outputs aligned long-term.
Adopt a feature store (Feast/Tecton): training and serving consume one shared feature definition.
Convert every feature to request-time computation, computing on the fly in training too.
Compute features only on the serving side and reuse production logs for training — no unified layer.
optionExplanations: 测试和 CI 能抓到部分不一致，但两套独立代码总会在窗口边界、迟到事件上再次分叉，治标不治本。
对；特征存储用同一份定义供训练与服务共享，从源头保证同名特征算得一样，是消除偏差的标准架构答案。
全改请求时实时算会把大量批特征塞进服务延迟预算，不现实，也没必要——统一定义即可，不必牺牲预计算。
只在服务端算、训练复用日志能减一部分偏差，但缺统一定义层，特征演进和回填仍会漂，不如特征存储系统化。
optionExplanations_en: Tests and CI catch some mismatches, but two independent code paths will diverge again at window boundaries and late events — treating symptoms, not the cause.
Correct — a feature store shares one definition across training and serving, guaranteeing same-named features compute identically at the source — the standard architectural answer to skew.
Converting everything to request-time compute crams many batch features into the serving latency budget — impractical and unnecessary; a shared definition suffices without sacrificing precomputation.
Serving-only compute reusing logs removes some skew but lacks a unified definition layer, so feature evolution and backfill still drift — less systematic than a feature store.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一的特征计算与存取层（Feast、Tecton、Hopsworks），训练与服务共享同一份定义，消除偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store is a unified feature computation/serving layer (Feast, Tecton, Hopsworks) sharing one definition across training and serving to eliminate skew.

scenario: 训练一个 1 月 5 日的样本时，特征 user_click_count_30d 你直接用了今天（比如 3 月）查到的当前值，而不是 1 月 5 日当时的 30 天计数。离线指标看着特别好。
scenario_en: Training a Jan-5 example, you use feature user_click_count_30d's current value looked up today (say March) instead of the 30-day count as of Jan 5. Offline metrics look great.
q: 这违反了什么原则，后果是什么？
q_en: Which principle does this violate, and what's the consequence?
why: 违反时点正确性：1 月 5 日的样本必须用「截至 1 月 5 日」的特征值，用今天的值等于把未来信息泄漏进训练。后果是离线指标虚高、上线达不到。
why_en: It violates point-in-time correctness: a Jan-5 example must use the feature as of Jan 5, and using today's value leaks future info, inflating offline metrics that don't hold in production.
options: 违反数据最小化：用了过多历史数据，删掉旧数据就能修
违反时点正确性：用了「未来」的特征值，信息泄漏、上线达不到
违反特征归一化：值没缩放到同一量纲，做一次标准化就好了
没违反任何原则，用最新值总是更准确、更贴近现实的做法
options_en: It violates data minimization: too much history was used; deleting old data fixes it.
It violates point-in-time correctness: a 'future' value leaks information, so production underperforms.
It violates feature normalization: values aren't on one scale; standardizing them fixes it.
It violates nothing — using the latest value is always more accurate and closer to reality.
optionExplanations: 问题不是数据太多，而是取错了时间点——用了样本时间之后才有的值，删旧数据解决不了泄漏。
对；训练必须还原样本发生时刻的特征快照，用今天的值让模型偷看未来，离线漂亮、线上崩，是典型的时间泄漏。
归一化是量纲问题，跟「用了未来时点的值」无关，标准化改变不了泄漏。
线上预测时未来值根本不存在，「用最新值」在训练里制造了服务时拿不到的信息，恰恰是错误做法。
optionExplanations_en: The problem isn't too much data but the wrong timestamp — using a value that exists only after the sample time; deleting old data doesn't fix leakage.
Correct — training must reconstruct the feature snapshot at the sample's moment; today's value lets the model peek at the future, great offline and broken in production — classic temporal leakage.
Normalization is a scaling issue, unrelated to 'using a future-time value'; standardizing can't undo leakage.
At serving time the future value doesn't exist, so 'use the latest value' manufactures information unavailable in production — precisely the error.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个训练样本的特征必须用「事件发生时刻」的值，不能用之后才有的值，防止未来信息泄漏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Point-in-time correctness means each training example's features use values as of the event time, not later values, preventing future-info leakage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时用到了预测时刻拿不到的信息（如未来值），使离线指标虚高、线上达不到。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data leakage is using information at training time that's unavailable at prediction time (e.g. future values), inflating offline metrics beyond production.

scenario: 你想用用户年龄、地理位置做特征，但隐私合规要求不能精确存储个人的确切年龄和精确定位。
scenario_en: You want to use user age and location as features, but privacy compliance forbids storing exact age and precise geolocation.
q: 该怎么处理人口统计特征以满足隐私要求？
q_en: How should you handle demographic features to satisfy privacy?
why: 对人口统计特征做粗化：年龄存成区间桶（如 25-34），地理存成区域/城市而非精确经纬度。粗化在保住信号（年龄段、大致地区对行为仍有预测力）的同时去掉可识别到个人的精度，是合规常见做法。
why_en: Coarsen demographics: store age as buckets (e.g. 25-34) and location as region rather than exact geo, keeping predictive signal while removing individually identifying precision.
tradeoff: 粗化(去可识别精度、保住段级信号) vs 精确存储(信号略强但违反隐私)
options: 精确存储确切年龄和经纬度，信号最强，隐私问题让法务去处理
对人口统计做粗化：年龄存区间桶、地理存区域，保住段级信号
完全删掉所有人口统计特征，凡涉及用户属性的一律不进模型
把确切年龄哈希成随机数存储，既满足隐私又完整保留信息
options_en: Store exact age and lat/long for the strongest signal and let legal deal with the privacy question.
Coarsen demographics: age into buckets, location into regions, keeping segment-level signal.
Delete every demographic feature — nothing about user attributes should enter the model at all.
Hash the exact age into a random number, which is private yet keeps the information intact.
optionExplanations: 精确存储确切年龄和定位直接违反隐私要求，「交给法务」不是工程上的合规特征设计。
对；粗化到年龄段和区域，既满足不存精确个人信息的合规要求，又保住对行为有预测力的段级信号，是标准折中。
一刀切全删过度保守，年龄段/大致地区这类粗粒度信号本可合规使用，白白丢掉有用信息。
哈希确切年龄会破坏顺序和距离（25 和 26 哈希后毫无关系），信号全毁，且哈希≠匿名化。
optionExplanations_en: Storing exact age and location directly violates privacy, and 'let legal handle it' isn't compliant feature engineering.
Correct — coarsening to age buckets and regions meets the no-precise-PII requirement while keeping segment-level signal predictive of behavior — the standard compromise.
Deleting everything is over-conservative; coarse signals like age bucket and rough region can be used compliantly, so this wastes useful information.
Hashing exact age destroys order and distance (25 and 26 become unrelated), ruining the signal, and hashing isn't anonymization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把精确属性降到区间/区域粒度（年龄段、城市），去掉可识别个人的精度但保留段级信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Coarsening lowers precise attributes to bucket/region granularity (age band, city), removing identifying precision while keeping segment-level signal.

scenario: 排序时有两个 CTR 类特征：物品的全局 CTR，和「这个用户在这个物品类目上的历史 CTR」。
scenario_en: Ranking has two CTR-type features: the item's global CTR, and 'this user's historical CTR on this item's category.'
q: 全局物品 CTR vs 用户-类目 CTR，各回答什么问题？
q_en: Global item CTR vs user-category CTR — what does each answer?
why: 全局物品 CTR 是 item 特征，回答「这个物品是否普遍受欢迎」；用户-类目 CTR 是 cross 特征，回答「这个用户是否在乎这个类目」。前者对所有用户一样，后者才编码个性化——一个热门物品未必是这个用户想要的。
why_en: Global item CTR (item feature) answers 'is this item popular overall,' while user-category CTR (cross feature) answers 'does this user care about this category.'
tradeoff: 全局物品 CTR(物品热度、对所有人相同) vs 用户-类目 CTR(个性化、编码这个用户的偏好)
options: 两者都是点击率，数值范围和计算方式完全相同，只是分组维度不同，换着用没有实质区别
全局 CTR 答「物品是否普遍受欢迎」；用户-类目 CTR 答「这个用户是否在乎」
全局 CTR 是个性化信号、用户-类目 CTR 是全局信号，两者正好相反
用户-类目 CTR 只是全局 CTR 除以用户数，本质上是同一个量
options_en: Both are click-through rates with the same value range and computation, just grouped differently — swapping them makes no real difference.
Global CTR answers 'is this item popular at all'; user-category CTR answers 'does this user care'.
Global CTR is the personalized signal and user-category CTR is the global one — exactly reversed.
User-category CTR is just global CTR divided by the user count, so it's the same quantity.
optionExplanations: 两者虽然都算点击率，但分组维度决定了粒度——一个跨所有用户聚合、一个绑定具体用户，回答的问题根本不同，不能互换。
对；全局 CTR 是物品热度、对谁都一样，用户-类目 CTR 把用户和类目交叉、编码个性化偏好，这正是 cross 强于 item 的原因。
说反了：全局是 item 侧非个性化信号，用户-类目才是 cross 侧个性化信号。
用户-类目 CTR 是对特定用户在特定类目上的点击率，不是全局量的简单缩放，两者不可互推。
optionExplanations_en: Both are click-through rates, but the grouping dimension sets the granularity — one aggregates across all users, the other binds a specific user, so they answer fundamentally different questions and aren't interchangeable.
Correct — global CTR is item popularity identical for everyone, while user-category CTR crosses user and category to encode personalized preference, which is why cross beats item.
Backwards: global is the non-personalized item-side signal, and user-category is the personalized cross-side one.
User-category CTR is a specific user's click rate on a specific category, not a simple scaling of the global quantity — they can't be derived from each other.

termDefinitions.meaning: 物品在所有用户上的平均点击率，是 item 侧热度信号，对每个用户相同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Global CTR is an item's average click-through rate across all users, an item-side popularity signal identical for everyone.

termDefinitions.term: user-category CTR / 用户-类目点击率
termDefinitions.meaning: 特定用户在特定物品类目上的历史点击率，是 cross 侧个性化信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: User-category CTR is a specific user's historical click rate on a specific item category, a personalized cross-side signal.

scenario: 四类特征各有典型计算方式和主要坑：user、item、cross、contextual。面试要能一句话点出每类的计算模式和它最容易踩的坑。
scenario_en: Each feature category has a typical compute pattern and main pitfall: user, item, cross, contextual. In an interview you should name each category's compute pattern and its main pitfall in one line.
q: 四类特征的计算模式和主要坑，哪个对应正确？
q_en: Which correctly matches each category's compute pattern and main pitfall?
why: 每类的坑直接来自它的计算模式：user 批+流→聚合不一致；item 批周期→热门度陈旧；cross 在线 join→延迟；contextual 请求时→时区/locale 缺失。
why_en: User = batch+stream (skew pitfall); item = periodic batch (stale popularity); cross = online join at serving (latency); contextual = request-time (timezone/locale pitfalls).

rows: 聚合不一致→训练服务偏差

options: user=请求时/时区；item=在线 join/延迟；cross=夜间批预计算/存储不够；contextual=批+流/陈旧
user=批+流/聚合不一致；item=批周期/热门度陈旧；cross=在线 join/延迟；contextual=请求时/时区
user=离线批/陈旧；item=批+流/聚合不一致；cross=请求时提取/locale 缺失；contextual=在线 join/延迟
user/item/cross/contextual 全部请求时实时算，坑统一是尾延迟，离线只落训练数据
options_en: user = request-time / timezone; item = online join / latency; cross = nightly batch / storage; contextual = batch+stream / staleness.
user = batch+stream / aggregation mismatch; item = periodic batch / stale popularity; cross = online join / latency; contextual = request-time / timezone.
user = offline batch / staleness; item = batch+stream / aggregation mismatch; cross = request-time / missing locale; contextual = online join / latency.
All four are computed live at request time, the single pitfall is tail latency, and offline only lands training data.
optionExplanations: cross 无法预计算全部（组合爆炸 10^15），它的坑是 serving 时 join 的延迟不是存储，这条与本章相反。
对；四类的计算模式各异、坑各不同，一一对应正是这张表的价值：坑直接由计算模式决定。
contextual 是请求环境（几点、什么设备），必须请求时提取，离线批算根本拿不到当前请求的上下文。
cross/contextual 适合请求时算，但 user/item 聚合放请求时算延迟爆炸，「四类都实时」是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Cross can't be fully precomputed (10^15 explosion), and its pitfall is serving-time join latency, not storage — this reverses the chapter.
Correct — the four categories have distinct compute patterns and distinct pitfalls, and the one-to-one mapping is the table's value: each pitfall follows from its compute pattern.
Contextual is the request environment (time, device) that must be extracted at request time; offline batch can't obtain the current request's context.
Cross/contextual suit request-time compute, but computing user/item aggregates at request time blows up latency, so 'all four real-time' is wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征在哪算、多久算一次（批/流/请求时），决定它的新鲜度、成本和主要故障坑。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A compute pattern is where and how often a feature is computed (batch/stream/request-time), setting its freshness, cost, and main pitfall.

tradeoff: 特征新鲜度 vs 计算成本与延迟：越靠请求时算越新鲜但吃 serving 延迟，越靠批算越便宜但陈旧且易与线上不一致

q: 把「面试里讨论特征」的五步框架排成从系统枚举到点出取舍的正确顺序：
q_en: Order the five-step framework for discussing features in an interview, from systematic enumeration to naming a tradeoff:
steps: 按 user/item/cross/contextual 四类系统枚举特征
给出具体特征名 + 计算模式（如「30 天点击数经流式聚合、由特征存储支撑」）
主动指出训练-服务偏差，提出用特征存储/共享计算图解决
提到时点正确性：按事件时间快照特征以防泄漏
点出一个取舍（如 cross 最强但增延迟 → 对 top-k 预计算或用 ANN）
why: 五步递进：先按四类系统枚举 → 落到具体特征+计算模式 → 主动 flag 训练-服务偏差并给特征存储方案 → 补时点正确性防泄漏 → 收尾点一个取舍。主动提偏差、时点正确性和取舍，正是从「会报特征名」到「有生产成熟度」的分水岭。
why_en: Enumerate by four categories, name concrete features with compute patterns, flag training-serving skew with a feature store, mention point-in-time correctness, then name one tradeoff.

termDefinitions.term: shared computation graph / 共享计算图
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练和服务复用同一套特征计算逻辑（如特征存储提供），从根上避免偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shared computation graph reuses one feature-computation logic across training and serving (as a feature store provides), avoiding skew at the root.

scenario: cross 特征最强，但要在 serving 时把用户向量和物品向量现场 join 计算，而排序有单位数毫秒的延迟预算，无法对所有物品都算。
scenario_en: Cross features are strongest but require a serving-time join of user and item vectors, while ranking has a single-digit-ms latency budget and can't compute them for every item.
q: 该怎么在保留 cross 特征威力的同时控住延迟？
q_en: How do you keep cross features' power while controlling latency?
why: 只对检索出的 top-k 候选算 cross 特征，或用 ANN 近似最相似候选——把「1 亿×1000 万」的组合缩到每请求几百到几千个候选再算交叉，威力保留、延迟可控。这就是「cross 最强但增延迟」这个取舍的标准解法。
why_en: Compute cross features only for the top-k retrieved candidates or approximate with ANN, shrinking the combinatorics to a few thousand per request while keeping the power.
tradeoff: 只对 top-k 算 cross(保威力、控延迟) vs 对全量算 cross(威力全但延迟爆炸)
options: 对全部物品都在 serving 时算 cross 特征，威力最大，延迟靠加机器扛
只对检索出的 top-k 候选算 cross 特征，或用 ANN 近似
彻底放弃 cross 特征，只用 user 和 item 特征以保延迟
把 cross 特征全部离线预计算所有用户×物品对，serving 只查表
options_en: Compute cross features at serving time for every item — maximum power — and absorb latency with more machines.
Compute cross features only for the top-k retrieved candidates, or approximate them with ANN.
Drop cross features altogether and use only user and item features to protect the latency budget.
Precompute every user×item cross feature offline so serving is a pure lookup.
optionExplanations: 对全量物品现场算 cross，候选上百万，单位数毫秒预算根本扛不住，加机器也压不住组合爆炸。
对；先检索缩到 top-k 再算 cross，把最贵的计算只花在最相关的几千个候选上，既保 cross 威力又落在延迟预算内。
放弃 cross 会丢掉最强的个性化信号、排序质量大跌，为省延迟牺牲太多，不是最优取舍。
全量预计算 10^15 对不可行（组合爆炸），这条路存储和计算都走不通，前面已排除。
optionExplanations_en: Computing cross for all items means millions of candidates, which a single-digit-ms budget can't sustain, and more machines can't beat the combinatorial explosion.
Correct — retrieve to top-k first, then compute cross, spending the most expensive computation only on the few thousand most relevant candidates — power kept, within budget.
Dropping cross discards the strongest personalization signal and tanks ranking quality, sacrificing too much to save latency — not the best tradeoff.
Precomputing all 10^15 pairs is infeasible (combinatorial explosion), a dead end in storage and compute, already ruled out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次预测允许的最大耗时（排序常为单位数毫秒），限制了能在请求时做多少计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A latency budget is the max time a prediction may take (often single-digit ms for ranking), capping how much request-time computation is possible.

scenario: 欺诈系统里 user_transaction_count_7d 训练时用夜间批 SQL 算、生产用实时流式计数器算。上线后精度下降，但欺诈模式并没有变化。
scenario_en: In a fraud system user_transaction_count_7d is computed by nightly batch SQL in training but a real-time streaming counter in production. Precision drops in production with no change in fraud patterns.
q: 精度下降最可能的根因是什么？
q_en: What's the most likely root cause of the precision drop?
why: 根因是训练-服务偏差：同一个 7 天计数特征用批 SQL 和流式两套逻辑算，窗口边界、迟到交易处理不同 → 训练与线上特征值分布不一致，模型吃到不一样的输入而退化。欺诈模式没变，说明不是数据漂移，而是特征计算路径不一致。
why_en: It's training-serving skew: the 7-day count computed by batch SQL vs a streaming counter diverges, so serving feature values differ from training and precision drops.
options: 欺诈者升级了手法，属于概念漂移，与特征计算路径无关，重训即可
训练-服务偏差：7 天计数批 SQL 与流式两套逻辑，值不一致
模型容量不够，7 天计数的非线性没学到，需要换更大的网络
标签噪声太高，最近的欺诈样本被误标，需要重新标注
options_en: Fraudsters upgraded their tactics — that's concept drift, unrelated to feature computation; just retrain.
Training-serving skew: the 7-day count comes from batch SQL in training and a streaming counter online.
The model lacks capacity to learn the non-linearity of the 7-day count, so use a bigger network.
Label noise is too high — recent fraud samples were mislabeled and need re-annotation.
optionExplanations: 题目明说欺诈模式没变，排除了概念漂移；下降来自特征在两侧算得不一样，不是攻击手法变了。
对；同名特征两套计算路径在窗口边界和迟到交易上分叉，线上值偏离训练分布，模型无声退化——典型训练-服务偏差。
容量不够不会表现为「上线才掉、模式没变」，换大模型解决不了两侧特征值不一致。
标签噪声影响的是训练质量，与「线上特征算得和训练不同」这个部署期偏差无关。
optionExplanations_en: The prompt says fraud patterns are unchanged, ruling out concept drift; the drop comes from features computed differently on the two sides, not new tactics.

Correct — the same-named feature's two compute paths diverge at window boundaries and late transactions, so serving values leave the training distribution and the model silently degrades — classic training-serving skew.
Insufficient capacity wouldn't show as 'drops only after launch, patterns unchanged,' and a bigger model can't fix mismatched feature values on the two sides.
Label noise affects training quality, unrelated to the deployment-time skew of 'serving computes the feature differently than training.'

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入与标签的关系随时间变化（如欺诈手法升级），区别于计算不一致的训练-服务偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concept drift is the input-label relationship changing over time (e.g. new fraud tactics), distinct from computation-mismatch training-serving skew.

tradeoff: 训练-服务偏差(同一特征两套实现、值悄悄不一致) vs 数据/概念漂移(输入分布真变了)：前者修计算路径，后者靠重训

scenario: 同样是回答特征题，什么细节能让面试官判断你有生产 ML 的成熟度，而不只是会背特征名？
scenario_en: For the same feature question, which details signal production-ML maturity rather than just reciting feature names?
q: 哪些做法能体现「资深级」的特征讨论？(多选)
q_en: Which practices signal a 'senior-level' feature discussion? (multiple)
why: 资深信号来自操作性细节：主动 flag 训练-服务偏差并提特征存储、提时点正确性防泄漏、给具体特征名+计算模式并点出一个取舍。只报「用点击数」这类裸特征名，是初级表现。
why_en: Senior signals are operational: flag training-serving skew with a feature store, mention point-in-time correctness, and name concrete features with compute patterns and a tradeoff.
options: 主动指出训练-服务偏差并提议用特征存储/共享计算层
提到时点正确性：按事件时间快照特征以防未来信息泄漏
给具体特征名 + 计算模式，并点出一个取舍（如 cross 最强但增延迟）
尽量多堆特征名、越多越好，不谈计算模式和取舍
options_en: Proactively flag training-serving skew and propose a feature store / shared computation layer.
Mention point-in-time correctness: snapshot features as of the event time to prevent future-info leakage.
Give concrete feature names + compute patterns, and name one tradeoff (e.g. cross is strongest but adds latency).
Pile on as many feature names as possible, the more the better, with no compute patterns or tradeoffs.
optionExplanations: 对；主动提偏差和特征存储，说明你懂特征在训练和线上会算不一致这个头号生产坑。
对；点出时点正确性，显示你知道离线指标可能因未来泄漏而虚高，是防坑意识。
对；具体特征+计算模式+一个取舍，把回答从名词清单升级成有工程判断的讨论。
错；只堆名词不谈计算模式和取舍恰恰是初级表现，面试官更想听操作性细节而非特征清单长度。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — proactively raising skew and a feature store shows you understand the number-one production pitfall of inconsistent train/serve computation.
Correct — naming point-in-time correctness shows you know offline metrics can be inflated by future leakage — pitfall awareness.
Correct — concrete features plus compute patterns plus one tradeoff upgrades the answer from a noun list to a discussion with engineering judgment.
Wrong — piling on names without compute patterns or tradeoffs is exactly the junior tell; interviewers want operational detail, not list length.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在设计里主动处理偏差、泄漏、延迟、监控等生产问题的能力，是资深工程师的标志。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Operational maturity is proactively handling skew, leakage, latency, and monitoring in a design — a hallmark of senior engineers.

scenario: 面试要设计推荐/搜索的候选检索,你要先讲清 embedding 在系统里扮演什么角色。
scenario_en: Designing candidate retrieval for recs/search, you first explain what role embeddings play in the system.
q: embedding 是什么,在 ML 系统里主要支撑什么?
q_en: What is an embedding, and what does it mainly power in an ML system?
why: embedding 把内容编码成稠密向量,用相似度支撑候选检索与个性化。面试深度不在选模型,而在它怎么流经存储、索引、版本与重建。
why_en: An embedding encodes content into a dense vector that powers retrieval and personalization by similarity, and the interview depth is really about how it flows through storage, indexing, versioning, and rebuild.
diagram:
flowchart LR R["原始内容
文本/图像/物品"] --> E["embedding 模型"] E --> V["稠密向量"] V --> A["ANN 检索
候选生成/个性化"]
options: embedding 是一种数据库,专门用来存放图片和视频文件
embedding 是一种压缩算法,唯一目的是省下存储空间
embedding 是模型最后一层分类头,直接输出预测标签,不产生可比较的中间表示
把原始内容编码成稠密向量,用相似度支撑候选检索与个性化
options_en: An embedding is a kind of database specialized for storing image and video files.
An embedding is a compression algorithm whose only purpose is saving storage space.
An embedding is the model's final classification head that outputs a predicted label directly, producing no comparable intermediate representation.
It encodes raw content into a dense vector, powering candidate retrieval and personalization by similarity.
optionExplanations: embedding 是内容的向量表示,可以存进向量库,但它本身不是存储系统。
省空间只是副作用;它的目的是把语义放进一个可以互相比较的向量空间。
分类头给的是离散标签,拿不到可以两两算相似度的连续向量,做不了候选检索。
对;稠密向量 + 相似度检索是它的核心用途,资深深度落在生命周期上。
optionExplanations_en: An embedding is a vector representation of content; it can live in a vector DB but isn't storage itself.
Saving space is a side effect; the goal is putting semantics into a mutually comparable vector space.
A classification head gives a discrete label, not a continuous vector you can compare pairwise, so it cannot drive retrieval.
Correct — dense vectors plus similarity retrieval are the core use, and seniority shows in the lifecycle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把原始内容(文本/图像/物品)映射成的稠密向量,语义相近的内容向量也相近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding maps raw content (text/image/item) into a dense vector where semantically similar content has nearby vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 维度不高但每维都有值的向量(如 128 维浮点),用向量相似度衡量语义接近程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dense vector has every dimension filled with a value (e.g. 128-dim floats), with similarity measuring semantic closeness.

scenario: 要给一个领域(如电商商品搜索)选 embedding:直接用公开预训练模型,还是在领域数据上训一个。
scenario_en: Choosing embeddings for a domain (e.g. e-commerce product search): use a public pre-trained model or train one on domain data.
q: 预训练 embedding vs 任务专用 embedding,区别是什么?
q_en: Pre-trained vs task-specific embeddings — what's the difference?
why: 预训练(Word2Vec/GloVe/通用 BERT)在公开语料上训好、开箱即用、无需领域训练;任务专用则在领域数据上微调或从头训(YouTube 检索的两塔、商品搜索的对比模型),更贴合领域语义但要训练成本。
why_en: Pre-trained (Word2Vec/GloVe/general BERT) is trained on public corpora and usable out of the box with no domain training, while task-specific is fine-tuned or trained from scratch on domain data for better fit at a training cost.
tradeoff: 预训练(开箱即用、无需领域训练、语义泛化) vs 任务专用(贴合领域、需训练成本)
options: 预训练在公开语料训好、开箱即用;任务专用在领域数据微调,更贴合但有训练成本
预训练一定更贵、任务专用免费开源,区别只在采购价格
预训练只能用于文本、任务专用只能用于图像,区别在于支持的模态而不是训练数据来源
两者完全一样,只是不同团队的叫法不同
options_en: Pre-trained is trained on public corpora and works out of the box; task-specific is fine-tuned on domain data for better fit at a training cost.
Pre-trained is always costlier and task-specific is free open source; the difference is purchase price.
Pre-trained is text-only and task-specific is image-only; the split is by supported modality, not by training data.
They're exactly the same thing, just named differently by different teams.
optionExplanations: 对;区别在训练来源与领域贴合度:预训练通用开箱即用,任务专用用领域数据换更好的领域表现。
价格不是划分标准——预训练常免费开源,任务专用才要投入训练成本,选项说反了。
两类都可跨模态(有文本也有图像的预训练/任务专用模型),按模态划分不成立。
两者在领域贴合度和训练成本上有本质不同,不是同物异名。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the difference is training source and domain fit: pre-trained is general and out-of-box, task-specific spends domain data for better domain performance.
Price isn't the criterion — pre-trained is often free/open, task-specific incurs training cost, so the option is backwards.
Both span modalities (there are text and image pre-trained/task-specific models), so a modality split fails.
They differ fundamentally in domain fit and training cost, not just naming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在通用公开语料上训好的 embedding 模型(Word2Vec/GloVe/通用 BERT),开箱即用无需领域训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A pre-trained embedding model is trained on general public corpora (Word2Vec/GloVe/general BERT), usable out of the box without domain training.

termDefinitions.term: task-specific embedding / 任务专用嵌入
termDefinitions.meaning: 在领域数据上微调或从头训练的 embedding(两塔、对比学习),更贴合特定任务语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A task-specific embedding is fine-tuned or trained from scratch on domain data (two-tower, contrastive) to fit the task's semantics.

scenario: 两种场景:(A)通用文本语义已够用、想快速上线;(B)检索质量直接影响营收、值得投入训练。
scenario_en: Two settings: (A) general text semantics suffice and you want a fast launch; (B) retrieval quality directly drives revenue, worth training investment.
q: 什么时候选预训练、什么时候选任务专用 embedding?
q_en: When do you pick pre-trained vs task-specific embeddings?
why: 看领域贴合的边际收益 vs 训练成本:通用语义够用、要快上线时用预训练;当领域语义差异大、检索质量直接换营收时,任务专用的更好表现值回训练与重建成本。
why_en: Weigh the marginal gain of domain fit against training cost: use pre-trained when general semantics suffice and speed matters, task-specific when domain gaps are large and retrieval quality converts to revenue.
tradeoff: 预训练(快、省、通用够用时) vs 任务专用(准、贵、领域差异大且质量换营收时)
options: 永远选任务专用:自己在领域数据上训出来的一定比公开预训练的好,成本不用考虑
随机选一个,反正各家 embedding 效果都差不多
永远选预训练:省事就行,领域语义差异对检索质量影响不大
看领域收益 vs 训练成本:通用够用就预训练,领域差异大且质量换营收就任务专用
options_en: Always go task-specific: training on your own domain data always beats public pre-training, cost aside.
Pick one at random; embeddings from any vendor perform about the same.
Always go pre-trained: convenience wins, and domain semantic gaps barely affect retrieval quality.
Weigh domain gain vs training cost: pre-trained when general semantics suffice, task-specific when the domain gap is large and quality converts to revenue.
whenOtherWins: 如果领域文本与通用语料差异极小(如标准英语描述),预训练已经足够,硬训任务专用只是白烧训练与重建成本。
whenOtherWins_en: If the domain text barely differs from general corpora (standard English descriptions), pre-trained already suffices and training a task-specific model just burns cost.
optionExplanations: 「永远任务专用」忽略了训练+重建成本,通用语义够用时它并不划算。
embedding 之间差异很大(上下文、模态、领域贴合),随机选是不负责任的。
「永远预训练」在领域语义差异大时会牺牲检索质量,进而丢营收,不能一概而论。
对;决策看领域贴合的边际收益能否盖过训练/重建成本,而非一刀切。
optionExplanations_en: 'Always task-specific' ignores training+rebuild cost and isn't worth it when general semantics suffice.
Embeddings differ a lot (context, modality, domain fit), so picking randomly is irresponsible.
'Always pre-trained' sacrifices retrieval quality when domain gaps are large, losing revenue, so it can't be blanket.
Correct — the decision weighs whether domain-fit gain exceeds training/rebuild cost, not a blanket rule.

termDefinitions.meaning: embedding 对特定领域语义的适配程度;领域差异越大,任务专用的边际收益越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain fit is how well an embedding matches a domain's semantics; larger domain gaps raise the marginal gain of task-specific.

scenario: 「bank」在「river bank」和「bank account」里意思完全不同,你在评估某个 embedding 模型能否区分。
scenario_en: 'bank' means different things in 'river bank' vs 'bank account'; you assess whether a given embedding model can tell them apart.
q: Word2Vec 的核心特性和局限是什么?
q_en: What's Word2Vec's core characteristic and limitation?
why: Word2Vec 给静态的词级向量,快但无上下文:不管在什么句子里,「bank」永远是同一个向量,分不清河岸和银行。适合当轻量特征输入,不适合需要上下文消歧的语义任务。
why_en: Word2Vec gives static word-level vectors — fast but context-free, so 'bank' has the same vector regardless of sentence, unable to disambiguate river bank from bank account.
options: Word2Vec 给静态词级向量,快但无上下文,bank 永远是同一个向量
Word2Vec 给上下文相关的词向量,能按句子区分 bank 的河岸/银行两种含义
Word2Vec 是多模态模型,能把文本和图像编码到同一个向量空间
Word2Vec 推理成本极高,不适合放在实时检索路径上
options_en: Word2Vec gives static word-level vectors — fast but context-free, so bank is always the same vector.
Word2Vec gives context-dependent word vectors and can tell the river-bank and money-bank senses apart per sentence.
Word2Vec is a multimodal model that encodes text and images into one shared vector space.
Word2Vec has extremely high inference cost and does not belong on a real-time retrieval path.
optionExplanations: 对;静态、词级、快是它的特点,无上下文是它的核心局限,bank 只有一个向量。
Word2Vec 恰恰不含上下文,同一个词只有一个静态向量,无法区分词义。
Word2Vec 是纯文本词级模型,不是多模态,编不了图像。
Word2Vec 极轻量、推理很快,「成本极高」说反了,它正因快而适合当特征输入。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — static, word-level, and fast are its traits, and context-free is its core limit, so bank has one vector.
Word2Vec is exactly context-free; one word has a single static vector and can't disambiguate senses.
Word2Vec is a text-only word-level model, not multimodal, and can't encode images.
Word2Vec is very lightweight and fast; 'extremely high cost' is backwards — its speed suits it as a feature input.

termDefinitions.meaning: 静态词级 embedding 模型,快但无上下文,同一词恒为同一向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Word2Vec is a static word-level embedding model, fast but context-free, giving one vector per word regardless of sentence.

termDefinitions.term: static vs contextual / 静态 vs 上下文
termDefinitions.meaning: 静态嵌入词义固定不随句子变,上下文嵌入同词随语境给不同向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Static embeddings fix a word's vector, while contextual embeddings give different vectors for the same word by context.

scenario: 要给一个上千万文档的大语料做实时编码检索,你在权衡 BERT 这类上下文模型的成本。
scenario_en: Encoding a corpus of tens of millions of docs in real time, you weigh the cost of contextual models like BERT.
q: BERT 类 embedding 的优势和主要代价是什么?
q_en: What's the strength and main cost of BERT-style embeddings?
why: BERT 靠全序列注意力给上下文相关的 token 级向量,语义更丰富(能区分 bank 词义);但推理成本高,对大语料做实时编码很贵。丰富语义 vs 推理开销是它的核心取舍。
why_en: BERT gives contextual token-level vectors via full-sequence attention, richer semantics but high inference cost, making real-time encoding of a large corpus expensive.
tradeoff: BERT(上下文语义丰富) vs 高推理成本(大语料实时编码很贵)
options: BERT 无上下文、速度极快,只是查表取静态词向量,语义太浅
BERT 只能编码单个词,不能处理整句,句子相似度要另找模型
BERT 靠全序列注意力给上下文 token 向量,语义丰富但推理成本高
BERT 推理几乎零成本,可以对上千万文档的整个语料做无限量的实时编码
options_en: BERT is context-free and blazing fast, just a lookup of static word vectors, so semantics stay shallow.
BERT can only encode single words, not full sentences, so sentence similarity needs another model.
BERT gives contextual token vectors via full-sequence attention — rich semantics but high inference cost.
BERT inference is near-zero cost, so you can encode the entire tens-of-millions-of-document corpus in real time without limit.
optionExplanations: BERT 恰恰有上下文且较重,「无上下文、极快」描述的是 Word2Vec 不是 BERT。
BERT 处理整个序列、给 token 级向量,能编码句子而非只编单词。
对;全序列注意力带来上下文语义,代价是高推理成本,大语料实时编码尤其贵。
BERT 推理成本高,「几乎零成本无限量」与它的重计算特性相悖。
optionExplanations_en: BERT is precisely contextual and heavy; 'context-free, extremely fast' describes Word2Vec, not BERT.
BERT processes the whole sequence and gives token-level vectors, encoding sentences, not just single words.
Correct — full-sequence attention yields contextual semantics at the cost of high inference, especially expensive for real-time large-corpus encoding.
BERT inference is costly; 'near-zero, unlimited' contradicts its heavy compute.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于全序列注意力的上下文 token 级 embedding 模型,语义丰富但推理成本高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BERT is a contextual token-level embedding model using full-sequence attention, rich in semantics but costly to infer.

termDefinitions.term: full-sequence attention / 全序列注意力
termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 token 都与序列里所有 token 交互算注意力,带来上下文但计算量大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Full-sequence attention has each token attend to all others in the sequence, giving context at high compute cost.

scenario: 产品需求:用户输入一段文字 query,要检索出相关的图像(文搜图)。
scenario_en: Product need: a user types a text query and retrieves relevant images (text-to-image search).
q: CLIP 有什么独特能力,靠什么实现?
q_en: What unique capability does CLIP have, and how?
why: CLIP 靠对比预训练把文本和图像对齐到同一个共享向量空间,从而支持跨模态检索:文字 query 的向量能直接和图像向量比相似度,实现文搜图。这是单模态模型做不到的。
why_en: CLIP uses contrastive pre-training to align text and image into a shared vector space, enabling cross-modal retrieval so a text query's vector can be compared directly with image vectors.
options: CLIP 只处理图像,靠卷积网络给图片分类打标签
CLIP 只能编码文本,和 BERT 的用途完全一样
CLIP 是更快的 Word2Vec,只是词向量维度更高、训练语料更大
CLIP 靠对比预训练把文本和图像对齐到共享空间,支持文搜图
options_en: CLIP only handles images, using a convolutional network to classify and label pictures.
CLIP can only encode text and serves exactly the same purpose as BERT.
CLIP is a faster Word2Vec, just with higher-dimensional word vectors and a bigger training corpus.
CLIP uses contrastive pre-training to align text and images into a shared space, enabling text-to-image search.
optionExplanations: CLIP 不是单纯图像分类器,它的关键是把文本和图像放进同一空间做跨模态匹配。
CLIP 同时编码文本和图像,与只做文本的 BERT 用途不同。
CLIP 与 Word2Vec 无关,它是多模态对比模型不是更快的词向量。
对;对比预训练对齐文图共享空间,是 CLIP 支持文搜图这类跨模态检索的根本。
optionExplanations_en: CLIP isn't a plain image classifier; its key is placing text and image in one space for cross-modal matching.
CLIP encodes both text and images, differing from text-only BERT.
CLIP is unrelated to Word2Vec; it's a multimodal contrastive model, not a faster word vector.
Correct — contrastive pre-training aligning a shared text-image space is what lets CLIP do cross-modal retrieval like text-to-image.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对比预训练把文本与图像对齐到共享向量空间的模型,支持跨模态检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) aligns text and image into a shared vector space via contrastive learning, enabling cross-modal retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一种模态的 query(文字)检索另一种模态的结果(图像),需共享向量空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cross-modal retrieval uses a query in one modality (text) to retrieve results in another (image), requiring a shared vector space.

scenario: 要做语义搜索:给一段自然语言 query,检索语义相近的句子/文档,还要兼顾质量和速度。
scenario_en: Building semantic search: given a natural-language query, retrieve semantically similar sentences/docs while balancing quality and speed.
q: 语义搜索的当前默认 embedding 选择是什么,为什么?
q_en: What's the current default embedding for semantic search, and why?
why: Sentence Transformers(孪生/Siamese BERT)给句子级向量,是语义搜索的当前默认——它在质量和速度间取得平衡:比原始 BERT 更适合直接比句子相似度,又不像逐 token 那么慢。
why_en: Sentence Transformers (Siamese BERT) give sentence-level vectors and are the current default for semantic search, balancing quality and speed better than raw BERT for comparing sentence similarity.
tradeoff: Sentence Transformers(句级、质量/速度平衡) vs 原始BERT(token级、直接比句子慢)
options: Word2Vec,因为它推理最快、最省资源,句子级上下文和语义精度对搜索来说根本无所谓
直接用原始 BERT 逐 token 编码,拿 token 向量平均后比句子相似度
Sentence Transformers(孪生 BERT)给句子级向量,质量/速度平衡
CLIP,因为语义搜索本质上是跨模态检索问题
options_en: Word2Vec, because it's fastest and lightest on compute, and sentence-level context and semantic precision don't matter for search at all.
Use raw BERT token by token and average the token vectors to compare sentence similarity.
Sentence Transformers (Siamese BERT) give sentence-level vectors with a quality/speed balance.
CLIP, because semantic search is fundamentally a cross-modal retrieval problem.
whenOtherWins: 如果 query 是跨模态的(文字搜图像),就该用 CLIP 而非 Sentence Transformers;后者是同模态句子语义搜索的默认。
whenOtherWins_en: If the query is cross-modal (text-to-image), use CLIP rather than Sentence Transformers, which is the default for same-modality sentence-semantic search.
optionExplanations: Word2Vec 只有静态词向量,一句话的词序和上下文全丢了,召回质量撑不住搜索。
把 token 向量平均是常见的临时做法,但每对句子都要跑一遍编码器,延迟撑不住线上检索。
对;孪生结构让两句话各编一次就能直接算余弦,离线可预编码入 ANN 索引。
CLIP 强在把文字和图像拉进同一空间;纯文本检索用它,等于付了跨模态的成本却没用上。
optionExplanations_en: Word2Vec only has static word vectors, losing word order and context, so recall quality cannot carry search.
Averaging token vectors is a common stopgap, but every sentence pair reruns the encoder, blowing the online latency budget.
Correct — the Siamese setup encodes each sentence once so cosine is direct, and vectors can be pre-encoded into the ANN index offline.
CLIP's strength is pulling text and images into one space; on pure text you pay the cross-modal cost without using it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 孪生(Siamese)BERT 结构,直接产出句子级 embedding,语义搜索的当前默认。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sentence Transformers are a Siamese BERT architecture producing sentence-level embeddings, the current default for semantic search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个共享权重的编码塔分别编码两段输入,便于直接比它们的向量相似度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Siamese network uses two weight-sharing towers to encode two inputs so their vector similarity is directly comparable.

scenario: 要在 Word2Vec / BERT / CLIP / Sentence Transformers 里按上下文能力、模态、推理成本做横向对比。
scenario_en: Comparing Word2Vec / BERT / CLIP / Sentence Transformers on context, modality, and inference cost.
q: 四类 embedding 模型的关键区分维度是什么?
q_en: What are the key distinguishing dimensions across the four embedding models?
why: 关键维度是粒度/上下文/模态/推理成本:Word2Vec 词级静态最省;BERT token 级上下文最贵;CLIP 多模态、成本中;Sentence Transf. 句级、语义搜索默认。选型按任务粒度和预算定。
why_en: Key axes: granularity, context, modality, inference cost — Word2Vec is word-level static and cheap, BERT is token-level contextual and costly, CLIP is multimodal and medium, Sentence Transformers is sentence-level and the semantic-search default.
tradeoff: 细粒度/强上下文(BERT/CLIP/Sentence Transf.) vs 轻量低成本(Word2Vec):按任务粒度和预算选型
options: 四维区分:粒度/上下文/模态/推理成本,而非只看一个维度
只看推理速度一个维度就够,粒度、上下文、模态的差异可以忽略不计
只看模型参数量一个维度,越大就选、不管任务匹不匹配
四者可以随便互换使用,反正效果都差不多、无需比较
options_en: Four axes — granularity/context/modality/inference cost — not just one dimension.
Looking only at inference speed is enough on its own — differences in granularity, context, and modality can be ignored.
Looking only at parameter count, picking the biggest regardless of task fit.
The four are interchangeable; performance is about the same, no need to compare.
optionExplanations: 对;粒度、上下文、模态、成本四维把四个模型分开,选型据任务与预算而定。
只看速度会忽略上下文能力和模态——语义搜索需要上下文,Word2Vec 再快也不够。
只看大小忽略了模态和上下文匹配,大模型未必适合跨模态或轻量场景。
四者在上下文、模态、成本上系统性不同,随便选会用错工具。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — granularity, context, modality, and cost separate the four; choose by task and budget.
Speed-only ignores context and modality — semantic search needs context, and fast Word2Vec still falls short.
Size-only ignores modality and context match; a big model may not fit cross-modal or lightweight needs.
The four differ systematically in context, modality, and cost, so picking any uses the wrong tool.

termDefinitions.meaning: 与 Word2Vec 类似的静态词向量模型,基于全局共现统计训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GloVe (Global Vectors) is a static word-vector model like Word2Vec, trained on global co-occurrence statistics.

scenario: 拿到一个预训练 embedding 模型上生产,要决定是冻结权重直接用,还是在领域数据上微调。
scenario_en: Taking a pre-trained embedding model to production, you decide whether to freeze weights or fine-tune on domain data.
q: 冻结(freeze) vs 微调(fine-tune) embedding 模型,核心区别是什么?
q_en: Freeze vs fine-tune an embedding model — what's the core difference?
why: 冻结=权重固定、更便宜、模型不变所以不用重建索引;微调=领域适配更好,但触发全量重编码 + ANN 索引重建 + 版本管理。
why_en: Freezing keeps weights fixed so it is cheaper and needs no index rebuild, while fine-tuning fits the domain better but triggers a full re-encode, an ANN index rebuild, and version management.
tradeoff: 冻结(便宜、无需重建索引) vs 微调(领域表现好、触发全量重编码+索引重建)
options: 冻结=权重固定、便宜、不用重建索引;微调=领域适配更好但触发全量重编码
冻结和微调都会触发全量重编码和索引重建,区别只在训练时长
微调更便宜因为它跳过了重编码这一步,冻结更贵因为每次上线都要重训基础模型
两者对下游 ANN 索引没有任何影响,只影响离线评测精度
options_en: Freeze = fixed weights, cheap, no index rebuild; fine-tune = better domain fit but triggers a full re-encode.
Both freeze and fine-tune trigger a full re-encode and index rebuild; only training time differs.
Fine-tune is cheaper because it skips the re-encoding step, and freeze is costlier because it retrains the base model every time you ship.
Neither affects the downstream ANN index; they only change offline evaluation accuracy.
optionExplanations: 对;冻结不改模型故无需重建索引,微调改了向量空间就要全量重编码+索引重建,这才是关键运维影响。
冻结不改模型、无需重建索引,「都要重建」把冻结的关键优势抹掉了。
说反了:微调才要重编码+重建更贵,冻结不训练不重建更便宜。
微调恰恰重塑向量空间、必须重建索引,「对索引无影响」忽略了核心运维代价。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — freeze doesn't change the model so needs no rebuild, while fine-tune shifts the vector space and forces full re-encoding + rebuild, the key ops impact.
Freeze doesn't change the model and needs no rebuild; 'both rebuild' erases freeze's key advantage.
Backwards: fine-tune is the costlier one needing re-encoding+rebuild, while freeze neither trains nor rebuilds.
Fine-tune precisely reshapes the vector space and must rebuild the index; 'no index impact' ignores the core ops cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保持预训练权重不变直接用,便宜且不改向量空间,故不触发索引重建。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Freeze keeps pre-trained weights fixed, cheap and unchanging to the vector space, so it triggers no index rebuild.

termDefinitions.meaning: 微调时模型在新数据上覆盖掉原先学到的通用知识,冻结可避免这一风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Catastrophic forgetting is fine-tuning overwriting previously learned general knowledge; freezing avoids this risk.

scenario: 团队决定季度性微调 embedding 模型,你要向面试官讲清这在运维上会连锁触发什么。
scenario_en: The team fine-tunes the embedding model quarterly, and you must explain the operational chain this triggers.
q: 微调 embedding 模型会连锁触发哪些运维动作?
q_en: What operational chain does fine-tuning an embedding model trigger?
why: 微调改变了向量空间,旧向量作废:必须用新模型全量重新编码整个语料 → 重建 ANN 索引 → 还要做 embedding 版本管理(保留新旧版本供切换)。资深回答会把微调直接连到「重编码+重建+版本管理」这条运维链,而不止说「精度更高」。
why_en: Fine-tuning shifts the vector space and invalidates old vectors, so you must re-encode the whole corpus with the new model, rebuild the ANN index, and manage embedding versions.
options: 什么都不用做,微调后旧的 ANN 索引照常能用,向量空间没变
只需把新模型部署上线,ANN 索引会自动跟着增量更新向量
全量重编码语料 → 重建 ANN 索引 → 做版本管理
只需清空索引再把原来的向量重新导入,不用重编码
options_en: Nothing at all — the old ANN index keeps working after fine-tuning because the vector space is unchanged.
Just deploy the new model; the ANN index incrementally updates its vectors along with it.
Re-encode the whole corpus → rebuild the ANN index → manage versions.
Just clear the index and re-import the original vectors; no re-encoding needed.
optionExplanations: 微调后向量空间变了,旧索引里的旧向量和新模型不兼容,「照常能用」会导致静默退化。
索引不会自动更新,新模型的向量要显式全量重编码并重建索引才生效。
对;重编码+重建索引+版本管理是微调的必然连锁,这条运维链正是资深信号。
清空不重编码等于没有可检索的向量,重编码是必须的一步不能省。
optionExplanations_en: Fine-tuning shifts the vector space, so old index vectors are incompatible with the new model; 'still works' causes silent degradation.
The index doesn't auto-update; the new model's vectors need explicit full re-encoding and a rebuild to take effect.
Correct — re-encoding + rebuild + version management is the inevitable chain of fine-tuning, and naming it is the senior signal.
Clearing without re-encoding leaves no vectors to search; re-encoding is a mandatory step.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用新的 embedding 模型把整个语料重新计算成新向量,微调后必须做。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Re-encoding recomputes the entire corpus into new vectors with the new embedding model, mandatory after fine-tuning.

termDefinitions.term: embedding versioning / 嵌入版本管理
termDefinitions.meaning: 同时保留每个实体的新旧向量版本,让服务在切换期路由到正确版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding versioning keeps old and new vectors per entity so serving routes to the right version during transitions.

scenario: 金融风控:在交易描述文本上做欺诈相关的语义理解,通用语义已经够用,且不想承担重建索引的运维负担。
scenario_en: Fintech risk: semantic understanding of transaction-description text where general semantics suffice and you'd rather avoid index-rebuild ops.
q: 金融风控对交易描述用 BERT,该冻结还是微调?
q_en: For fintech fraud on transaction descriptions, should you freeze or fine-tune BERT?
why: 冻结。交易描述的通用语义 BERT 已经够用,冻结省下重训与索引重建的成本、也避免灾难性遗忘。没有足够强的领域收益去抵消微调的重建代价时,冻结是更划算的选择。
why_en: Freeze — general BERT semantics already suffice for transaction descriptions, so freezing saves retraining and index-rebuild cost and avoids catastrophic forgetting.
tradeoff: 冻结(通用语义够、省重建) vs 微调(领域收益不足以抵消重建代价)
options: 微调,不管交易描述的通用语义够不够用,微调都更准,重建成本可以不用管
每天微调一次,保持模型最新
既不冻结也不微调,直接不用 embedding
冻结:通用语义够用,省下重训+索引重建成本、避免灾难性遗忘
options_en: Fine-tune — regardless of whether general semantics already suffice for transaction descriptions, fine-tuning is always more accurate and rebuild cost doesn't matter.
Fine-tune daily to keep the model current.
Neither freeze nor fine-tune; just drop embeddings entirely.
Freeze: general semantics suffice, saving retraining + index-rebuild cost and avoiding catastrophic forgetting.
whenOtherWins: 如果交易描述含大量领域黑话/行业缩写,通用 BERT 分不清,那微调的领域收益就可能盖过重建成本,值得微调。
whenOtherWins_en: If transaction descriptions are full of domain jargon general BERT can't parse, fine-tuning's domain gain may outweigh rebuild cost and become worthwhile.
optionExplanations: 微调不是无条件更好——通用语义够用时,它的重建成本没有对应领域收益,得不偿失。
每天微调=每天全量重编码+重建索引,运维代价极高且无必要。
不用 embedding 就做不了语义检索,这是回避问题不是选择。
对;通用够用+想省重建时冻结最划算,还顺带避免灾难性遗忘。
optionExplanations_en: Fine-tune isn't unconditionally better — when general semantics suffice, its rebuild cost has no matching domain gain, a net loss.
Daily fine-tuning means daily full re-encoding + rebuild, extremely costly and unnecessary.
Dropping embeddings makes semantic retrieval impossible; that's evasion, not a choice.
Correct — with general semantics sufficient and rebuild to avoid, freeze is most economical and dodges catastrophic forgetting.

termDefinitions.term: index-management impact / 索引管理影响
termDefinitions.meaning: 模型是否变会决定要不要重编码与重建索引,是 freeze/fine-tune 决策的关键代价维。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Index-management impact is whether a model change forces re-encoding and rebuild, a key cost dimension of the freeze/fine-tune decision.

scenario: 电商搜索:检索质量直接影响转化和营收,领域词汇(品牌/品类/属性)与通用语义差异大。
scenario_en: E-commerce search: retrieval quality directly drives conversion and revenue, with domain vocabulary (brands/categories/attributes) far from general semantics.
q: 电商搜索该冻结还是季度微调 Sentence Transformers,为什么?
q_en: Should e-commerce search freeze or fine-tune Sentence Transformers quarterly, and why?
why: 季度微调。检索质量直接换营收,领域语义差异大,微调带来的检索提升值回全量重编码+索引重建的成本。这里领域收益盖过了重建代价,和金融风控冻结正好相反。
why_en: Fine-tune quarterly — retrieval quality converts to revenue and domain gaps are large, so the retrieval gains justify the full re-encoding and index-rebuild cost.
tradeoff: 季度微调(领域检索提升换营收、接受重建) vs 冻结(省成本但领域检索质量受限)
options: 冻结:微调太麻烦,检索差一点对营收无所谓
季度微调:检索质量直接换营收,提升值回重编码+重建成本
每小时微调一次,更新越频繁检索质量越好
完全不用 embedding,改回关键词精确匹配就够了
options_en: Freeze — fine-tuning is a hassle and slightly worse retrieval barely dents revenue.
Fine-tune quarterly: retrieval quality converts to revenue, so the gain repays the re-encode and rebuild cost.
Fine-tune every hour — the more often you update, the better retrieval gets.
Drop embeddings entirely and go back to exact keyword matching.
whenOtherWins: 如果检索质量对营收边际影响很小,或重建成本极高(超大语料 + 紧预算),那冻结反而更划算,不必季度微调。
whenOtherWins_en: If retrieval quality barely moves revenue, or rebuild cost is prohibitive (huge corpus + tight budget), freezing is more economical and quarterly fine-tuning isn't worth it.
optionExplanations: 检索差直接掉转化掉营收,「无所谓」在电商里代价很大,冻结在此不划算。
对;领域差异大且质量换营收,季度微调的检索收益盖过重建成本,是合理取舍。
每小时微调=每小时重编码全量语料+重建索引,成本爆炸且收益边际递减,过度频繁。
关键词精确匹配丢掉语义泛化,搜不到同义/近义表达,检索质量反而更差。
optionExplanations_en: Poor retrieval directly cuts conversion and revenue; 'fine' is costly in e-commerce, so freezing isn't economical here.
Correct — large domain gaps and quality-to-revenue make quarterly fine-tuning's gains exceed rebuild cost, a sound tradeoff.
Hourly fine-tuning means hourly full re-encoding + rebuild, exploding cost with diminishing returns, far too frequent.
Exact keyword matching loses semantic generalization, missing synonyms/paraphrases and worsening retrieval quality.

termDefinitions.term: retrieval quality to revenue / 检索质量换营收
termDefinitions.meaning: 在电商/搜索里,更好的检索直接提升点击、转化与营收,故值得投入微调与重建。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In e-commerce/search, better retrieval directly lifts clicks, conversion, and revenue, justifying fine-tuning and rebuild investment.

scenario: 目录有 1 亿(100M)个物品,serving 时要为每个 query 找最相似的若干个物品向量。
scenario_en: The catalog has 100M items and at serving time you must find the most similar item vectors for each query.
q: 为什么 1 亿量级要用近似最近邻(ANN)而不是暴力精确检索?
q_en: Why use approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) instead of brute-force exact search at 100M scale?
why: 暴力检索要把 query 和每一个物品向量逐个算余弦相似度,1 亿次比对在 serving 延迟内根本跑不完。ANN 用索引结构把搜索降到次线性,牺牲一点召回换到亚毫秒级延迟,是海量向量检索的唯一可行解。
why_en: Brute-force cosine against every one of 100M item vectors can't finish within serving latency, so ANN uses an index structure to make search sublinear, trading a little recall for sub-millisecond latency.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Q["query 向量"] --> B{"1亿物品?"}
  B -->|暴力: 1亿次比对| X["超延迟预算✗"]
  B -->|ANN: 次线性| Y["亚毫秒✓ 略损召回"]
options: 暴力检索在 1 亿量级也能在几毫秒内跑完,用 ANN 只是工程习惯
ANN 只是省内存,对检索延迟没有任何影响
ANN 比暴力更精确,因为索引会过滤掉噪声向量
暴力要 1 亿次逐个比相似度、超延迟预算;ANN 次线性,略损召回
options_en: Brute force still finishes in a few milliseconds at 100M, so ANN is just engineering habit.
ANN only saves memory and has no effect at all on retrieval latency.
ANN is more accurate than brute force because the index filters out noisy vectors.
Brute force needs 100M pairwise comparisons and blows the latency budget; ANN is sublinear at a small recall cost.
optionExplanations: 1 亿次逐个余弦相似度在 serving 延迟内跑不完,「也很快」与规模事实相悖。
ANN 主要解决的是延迟(次线性搜索),省内存是部分索引家族的附带特性。
ANN 是「近似」,精度略低于暴力精确检索,「更精确」说反了。
对;暴力线性于目录大小、扛不住 1 亿,ANN 次线性搜索用略损召回换到可用延迟。
optionExplanations_en: 100M pairwise cosine can't finish within serving latency, so 'also fast' contradicts the scale reality.
ANN mainly solves latency (sublinear search); memory saving is an incidental trait of some index families.
ANN is 'approximate' with slightly lower accuracy than exact brute-force, so 'more accurate' is backwards.
Correct — brute-force is linear in catalog size and can't handle 100M, while ANN's sublinear search buys usable latency for slight recall loss.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用索引结构在海量向量里近似地找最相似向量,牺牲少量召回换大幅提速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) uses an index to approximately find the most similar vectors, trading slight recall for large speedups.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用两向量夹角余弦衡量语义相近程度,值越大越相似。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cosine similarity measures semantic closeness by the cosine of the angle between two vectors; higher means more similar.

scenario: 选 ANN 索引:有基于树的 Annoy、基于图的 HNSW、基于量化的 IVF-PQ(FAISS),要按召回/延迟/内存权衡。
scenario_en: Choosing an ANN index: tree-based Annoy, graph-based HNSW, quantization-based IVF-PQ (FAISS), weighing recall/latency/memory.
q: 三大 ANN 索引家族各自的特点是什么?
q_en: What characterizes the three ANN index families?
why: 树基(Annoy)简单但高维差;图基(HNSW)召回/延迟最佳,现代向量库最常用;量化基(IVF-PQ)内存高效。按召回、延迟、内存三者权衡选型。
why_en: Tree-based Annoy is simple but weak in high dimensions, graph-based HNSW gives the best recall-latency point and is what modern vector databases use, and quantization-based IVF-PQ is the memory-efficient choice for huge corpora.
options: 三者底层完全一样,只是不同库对同一个算法的不同命名
树基(Annoy)简单但高维差;图基(HNSW)召回/延迟最佳;量化基省内存
树基召回最高、图基最省内存、量化基延迟最低——三者在召回/内存/延迟上各占一个极值
只有 HNSW 还能用,树基和量化基都已经被淘汰了
options_en: All three are the same underneath, just different libraries naming one algorithm differently.
Tree-based (Annoy) is simple but weak in high dimensions; graph-based (HNSW) has the best recall/latency; quantization-based saves memory.
Tree-based has the best recall, graph-based saves the most memory, quantization-based has the lowest latency — one extreme each.
Only HNSW is still usable; tree-based and quantization-based are both obsolete.
optionExplanations: 三者在召回、延迟、内存上取舍不同,不是同物异名。
对;树简单但高维弱、图召回延迟最佳最主流、量化省内存扛超大语料,是标准三分。
属性张冠李戴:图基才是召回/延迟最佳,量化基才最省内存,树基才最简单。
Annoy/IVF-PQ 各有适用场景(高维小库、超大内存受限),并未淘汰。
optionExplanations_en: The three trade off differently on recall, latency, and memory; not the same thing renamed.
Correct — tree simple but weak in high-dim, graph best recall/latency and mainstream, quantization memory-efficient for huge corpora, the standard split.
Attributes mismatched: graph-based has best recall/latency, quantization-based saves most memory, tree-based is simplest.
Annoy/IVF-PQ each have niches (small high-dim, huge memory-bound), and aren't obsolete.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于图的 ANN 索引,召回/延迟表现最佳,Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector 等现代向量库主流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a graph-based ANN index with the best recall/latency, mainstream in modern vector DBs.

termDefinitions.meaning: FAISS 里的量化索引,用 Voronoi 分区+向量压缩,内存高效,适合超大语料。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF-PQ (Inverted File with Product Quantization) in FAISS uses Voronoi partitioning plus vector compression, memory-efficient for very large corpora.

termDefinitions.meaning: Spotify 开源的树基(随机投影树)ANN 索引,简单但在高维空间表现较弱。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Annoy is Spotify's tree-based (random-projection tree) ANN index, simple but weaker in high dimensions.

scenario: ANN 索引可调:搜索更多邻居/分区能提召回,但也拉高延迟。要在质量和速度间定档位。
scenario_en: An ANN index is tunable: searching more neighbors/partitions raises recall but also latency, and you set the quality-speed dial.
q: ANN 检索的核心可调旋钮是什么,怎么权衡?
q_en: What's the core tunable knob in ANN retrieval, and how do you trade it off?
why: 核心旋钮是召回 vs 延迟:搜索的邻居/分区越多,召回越高但延迟越高;越少则越快但漏得越多。按产品的延迟 SLA 和质量要求定档——比如要 sub-10ms 就把搜索范围压到刚好还能保住目标召回。
why_en: The core knob is recall vs latency: searching more neighbors/partitions raises recall but latency, while fewer is faster but misses more, so tune to the product's latency SLA and quality target.
tradeoff: 搜更多邻居/分区(召回高、延迟高) vs 搜更少(快、漏得多)
options: 核心旋钮是向量维度:把维度调得越高,召回就一定越好,对延迟完全没有影响
核心旋钮是模型大小:模型参数越大,ANN 检索就越快
核心旋钮是召回 vs 延迟:搜更多邻居召回高但更慢,按 SLA 定档
ANN 没有可调旋钮,召回和延迟由索引类型固定决定
options_en: The core knob is vector dimension: cranking dimension higher always means better recall, with absolutely no impact on latency.
The core knob is model size: the more parameters, the faster ANN retrieval runs.
The core knob is recall vs latency: probing more neighbors lifts recall but costs time, so tune to the SLA.
ANN has no tunable knob; recall and latency are fixed by the index type.
whenOtherWins: 如果场景对召回极其敏感(如安全/合规检索,漏一个都不行),就该往召回侧调、接受更高延迟,甚至退回精确检索。
whenOtherWins_en: If the use case is extremely recall-sensitive (safety/compliance retrieval where missing one is unacceptable), tune toward recall and accept higher latency, even reverting to exact search.
optionExplanations: 维度不是 ANN 的检索旋钮,且高维反而给树基索引带来困难,「一定更好」不成立。
模型大小影响编码不影响 ANN 检索速度,「越大越快」无关且错误。
对;召回/延迟是 ANN 的核心权衡旋钮,搜索范围决定二者,按 SLA 定档。
ANN 恰恰通过搜索范围(邻居/分区数)可调,召回延迟不是固定的。
optionExplanations_en: Dimension isn't ANN's retrieval knob, and high dimensions actually hurt tree-based indexes, so 'always better' fails.
Model size affects encoding, not ANN retrieval speed; 'bigger is faster' is irrelevant and wrong.
Correct — recall/latency is ANN's core trade knob, set by search breadth and tuned to the SLA.
ANN is precisely tunable via search breadth (neighbors/partitions), so recall/latency isn't fixed.

termDefinitions.term: recall vs latency knob / 召回-延迟旋钮
termDefinitions.meaning: ANN 中搜索的邻居/分区数量:搜得越多召回越高但越慢,是核心可调权衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The recall-vs-latency knob is how many neighbors/partitions ANN searches: more means higher recall but slower, the core tunable trade-off.

scenario: Spotify/Pinterest 用调好的 HNSW/FAISS 在生产里做到 >95% 召回 + sub-10ms p99 延迟。
scenario_en: Spotify/Pinterest hit >95% recall at sub-10ms p99 latency in production with tuned HNSW/FAISS.
q: 「>95% 召回 + sub-10ms p99」这组数字说明什么?
q_en: What does '>95% recall at sub-10ms p99' demonstrate?
why: 这组数字是行业调优后的经验标杆,不是理论上限:调好的 HNSW/FAISS 能同时拿到 >95% 召回和亚 10ms 尾延迟,略损召回压得很小,是定检索目标的参考锚点。
why_en: These are tuned empirical benchmarks, not theoretical limits: well-tuned HNSW/FAISS gets both >95% recall and sub-10ms tail latency, a reference anchor for retrieval targets.
options: 说明近似检索必然大幅牺牲召回,95% 已经逼近理论上限,再怎么调优也上不去了
说明调优后 HNSW/FAISS 能同时给出高召回与低尾延迟,可作检索目标锚点
说明只有暴力精确检索才能达到 95% 召回,ANN 天生做不到、必须放弃
说明 p99 延迟和召回二者互不相关,系统设计时可以随意设定目标
options_en: It shows approximate search must sacrifice a lot of recall; 95% is already near the theoretical ceiling, and no amount of further tuning will push it higher.
It shows tuned HNSW/FAISS gets high recall and low tail latency together, a reference anchor for retrieval targets.
It shows only exact brute-force reaches 95% recall; ANN inherently cannot and must be abandoned.
It shows p99 latency and recall are unrelated to each other, so a system can set targets arbitrarily.
optionExplanations: 近似检索确实有召回损失,但调优后能压到很小,95% 不是天花板而是当前经验水位,还能再抬。
对;这正是调优后 HNSW/FAISS 的经验水位——高召回配亚10ms延迟同时拿到,可当作定目标的锚点。
暴力精确检索能到 100% 召回但延迟扛不住百万级以上语料,ANN 的价值就在用可控召回损失换可用延迟。
召回和延迟其实互相牵制——调大搜索范围两者一起变,不是各自独立能随便设的两个旋钮。
optionExplanations_en: Approximate search does lose some recall, but tuning shrinks it a lot — 95% is today's benchmark, not a hard ceiling, and can still climb.
Correct — this is exactly the tuned benchmark: high recall together with sub-10ms latency, a level you can set as your retrieval SLA.
Brute-force can hit 100% recall but can't keep latency down past a million-scale corpus; ANN trades a bit of recall for usable latency.
Recall and latency actually move together — widen the search and both shift, they're not two knobs you can set independently.

termDefinitions.meaning: >95% 召回 + sub-10ms p99 是调优后的行业经验参考,不是理论上限,用来定检索质量/延迟目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The >95% recall at sub-10ms p99 is a tuned industry benchmark, not a theoretical limit, used to set retrieval quality/latency targets.

termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 请求的延迟低于该值,衡量尾部延迟;检索里常作为 SLA 目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p99 latency is the value 99% of requests finish under, measuring tail latency, often a retrieval SLA target.

scenario: embedding 模型是按余弦相似度训练的,但索引却配置成用 L2 欧氏距离检索。
scenario_en: The embedding model was trained with cosine similarity, but the index is configured to search with L2 Euclidean distance.
q: 索引的距离度量和模型训练目标不一致,会怎样?
q_en: What happens if the index's distance metric mismatches the model's training objective?
why: 会静默退化检索质量,不报任何错。距离度量(cosine/dot/L2)必须匹配 embedding 模型的训练目标——训练用余弦、检索却用 L2,相似度排序就系统性偏了,结果变差但系统不报错,很难发现。
why_en: It silently degrades retrieval with no error: the index distance metric (cosine/dot/L2) must match the model's training objective, or the similarity ranking is systematically wrong while nothing alarms.
options: 系统会立刻报错,启动时就校验度量和模型是否匹配
没影响,cosine/dot/L2 在向量归一化后结果完全一样
静默退化检索质量、不报错:度量必须匹配训练目标,否则排序偏
检索会变得更快更准,度量不匹配是常见的加速优化技巧
options_en: The system errors immediately, validating metric-model match at startup.
No impact — cosine, dot and L2 give identical results once vectors are normalized.
Retrieval silently degrades with no error: the metric must match the training objective or ranking skews.
Retrieval gets faster and more accurate; a mismatched metric is a common speed optimization.
optionExplanations: 度量不匹配不会触发错误,系统照常返回结果,只是结果悄悄变差,这正是它危险的地方。
不同度量给出不同的相似度排序,「结果都一样」与向量几何相悖。
对;训练目标决定该用哪种度量,配错会系统性打乱相似度排序、静默降质,难以察觉。
度量不匹配只会降质,不会更快更准,把它当优化技巧是错误理解。
optionExplanations_en: A metric mismatch triggers no error; the system returns results as usual, just quietly worse — precisely why it's dangerous.
Different metrics give different similarity rankings; 'same result' contradicts vector geometry.
Correct — the training objective dictates the metric, and a mismatch systematically scrambles similarity ranking, silently degrading, hard to detect.
A mismatch only degrades quality, never faster or more accurate; treating it as an optimization trick misunderstands it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量两向量相似/远近的方式(余弦、点积、L2 欧氏),必须与 embedding 训练目标一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distance metric (cosine, dot, L2) measures vector similarity and must match the embedding's training objective.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两向量对应维度差平方和的平方根,一种常见距离度量,与余弦度量在语义上不等价。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: L2 (Euclidean) distance is the root sum of squared per-dimension differences, a common metric not semantically equivalent to cosine.

scenario: 团队更新/微调了 embedding 模型,重新编码了 query,但没有重新编码物品、也没重建 ANN 索引。上线后没报任何错,可 CTR 悄悄往下掉。
scenario_en: The team updated/fine-tuned the embedding model and re-encoded queries but didn't re-encode items or rebuild the ANN index; nothing errors, yet CTR quietly drops.
q: 「陈旧索引(stale index)」问题是怎么发生的,后果是什么?
q_en: How does the 'stale index' problem arise, and what's the consequence?
why: 重训让新模型的向量落在不同空间(embedding drift),新 query 去比旧物品向量,相似度不可靠:不报错、CTR 却在掉。
why_en: Retraining puts the new model vectors in a different space, so a new query compared against old item vectors gives unreliable similarity — nothing errors out, but CTR quietly drops.
diagram:
flowchart LR U["更新模型
只重编码query"] --> D["embedding drift
向量空间变了"] D --> M["新query向量 vs 旧物品向量"] M --> S["相似度不可靠
静默退化, CTR↓"]
options: 更新模型后系统会立刻报错,检索直接返回空结果
新旧向量落在不同空间,相似度失真 → 检索静默退化、不报错
陈旧索引让检索命中更少、速度更快,是有意的优化
只要 query 侧重编码了就没事,物品向量留旧版本也不影响
options_en: After the model update the system errors immediately and retrieval returns empty results.
Old and new vectors land in different spaces, so similarity is distorted and retrieval silently degrades with no error.
A stale index returns fewer hits and runs faster, which is a deliberate optimization.
As long as the query side is re-encoded it's fine; leaving item vectors on the old version is harmless.
optionExplanations: 陈旧索引不报错——这正是它危险之处,系统照常返回结果,质量却悄悄崩。
对;向量空间漂移让新旧向量不可比,余弦排序失真,检索静默退化是这题的核心失败模式。
陈旧索引只会降质不会「有意优化」,把它当优化是完全误读。
只重编码 query 不重编码物品正是制造陈旧索引的原因,物品向量必须同步更新。
optionExplanations_en: A stale index doesn't error — that's the danger; the system returns results as usual while quality quietly collapses.
Correct — vector-space drift makes new and old vectors incomparable, distorting cosine ranking; silent retrieval degradation is the core failure here.
A stale index only degrades quality, not a 'deliberate optimization' — a total misread.
Re-encoding only queries and not items is exactly what creates the stale index; item vectors must be updated together.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型更新后未重编码物品/重建的 ANN 索引,新旧向量空间错位导致检索静默退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stale index is an ANN index not re-encoded/rebuilt after a model update, so misaligned vector spaces silently degrade retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型更新使向量空间本身移位,新旧向量不可直接比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding drift is the vector space itself shifting from a model update, making old and new vectors non-comparable.

scenario: 监控报告里同时提到「data drift」和「embedding drift」,面试官问你两者是不是一回事。
scenario_en: A monitoring report mentions both 'data drift' and 'embedding drift', and the interviewer asks if they're the same.
q: embedding drift 和 data drift 有什么区别?
q_en: What's the difference between embedding drift and data drift?
why: 两者不同:data drift 是输入数据分布变了(用户行为/内容变了);embedding drift 是向量空间本身因模型更新而移位——数据没变,但同样的内容被新模型编成了不同向量。前者来自世界变化,后者来自模型变化。
why_en: Data drift is the input distribution changing (user behavior/content shifts), while embedding drift is the vector space itself shifting from a model update, so the same content maps to different vectors even if data is unchanged.
tradeoff: data drift(输入分布变、来自世界) vs embedding drift(向量空间变、来自模型更新)
options: 两者完全一样,只是不同团队对同一现象的叫法
data drift=输入分布变了;embedding drift=模型更新让向量空间移位
embedding drift 指数据量变多、data drift 指数据量变少,都只是规模变化
两者都只是模型精度下降的别名,没有实质区别
options_en: They're the same thing, just what different teams call one phenomenon.
Data drift = the input distribution shifted; embedding drift = a model update moved the vector space.
Embedding drift means more data and data drift means less data; both are just volume changes.
Both are just aliases for accuracy dropping, with no real difference.
optionExplanations: 两者起因不同(世界变 vs 模型变),不是同物异名,混为一谈会误诊。
对;data drift 来自输入分布变化,embedding drift 来自模型更新导致向量空间移位,修法也不同。
drift 讲的是分布/空间移位,不是数据量多少,选项理解错了概念。
两者是不同起因的问题,精度下降只是可能症状,不能划等号。
optionExplanations_en: Their causes differ (world vs model change); not the same thing renamed, and conflating them misdiagnoses.
Correct — data drift comes from input distribution shift, embedding drift from a model update shifting the vector space, with different fixes.
Drift is about distribution/space shift, not data volume; the option misreads the concept.
They're different-cause problems; an accuracy drop is only a possible symptom, not an equivalence.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入数据的分布随时间变化(用户行为、内容变了),需重训或更新数据应对。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data drift is the input data distribution changing over time (user behavior, content), addressed by retraining or updating data.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏斜
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练与线上服务时数据/表示不一致导致的退化;陈旧索引是它在索引层的类比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is degradation from data/representation mismatch between training and serving; the stale index is its index-level analog.

scenario: 团队升级了 query 侧的 embedding 模型,但没重新编码物品、也没重建索引,想知道检索会怎样。
scenario_en: The team upgrades the query-side embedding model but doesn't re-encode items or rebuild the index, and wonders what happens to retrieval.
q: 只更新 query 模型、不重编码物品会导致什么?
q_en: Updating only the query model without re-encoding items leads to what?
why: 检索质量静默退化:新 query 向量和旧物品向量落在错位的向量空间里,余弦相似度失去意义,排序变差却不报错。正确做法是 query 和物品必须用同一版本模型编码,或走零停机重建把物品同步更新。
why_en: Retrieval quality silently degrades because new query vectors and old item vectors sit in misaligned embedding spaces, so cosine loses meaning and ranking worsens without error.
tradeoff: 同版本编码query+物品(空间对齐、检索可靠) vs 只更新一侧(空间错位、静默退化)
options: 静默退化:新 query 与旧物品向量错位,余弦失去意义
检索会更准,因为 query 模型更新之后表达能力更强了
系统会自动检测版本不一致,并把所有物品重新编码一遍
只影响新入库的物品,老物品的检索结果照常正确
options_en: Silent degradation: new queries and old item vectors are misaligned, so cosine loses meaning.
Retrieval gets more accurate, because the updated query model is now more expressive.
The system detects the version mismatch on its own and re-encodes every item for you.
Only newly ingested items are affected; old items still retrieve correctly.
whenOtherWins: 如果新旧两个模型恰好共享同一向量空间(如仅做了不改变几何的等价变换),query 单侧更新才不致命——但一般微调/重训都会改变空间。
whenOtherWins_en: Only if the new and old models happen to share the same vector space (e.g. a geometry-preserving equivalent transform) is a one-sided query update non-fatal — but fine-tuning/retraining usually shifts the space.
optionExplanations: 对;单侧更新造成空间错位,余弦排序失真,检索静默退化正是这题要点。
query 模型再强,若和物品向量不在同一空间,比出来的相似度也无意义,不会更准。
系统不会自动重编码,物品向量必须显式用新模型重编码才对齐。
错位影响的是所有物品的相似度比较,不只是新物品,老物品同样失真。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — one-sided update misaligns spaces, distorts cosine ranking, and silently degrades retrieval, the point here.
However strong the query model, if it's not in the same space as item vectors, the computed similarity is meaningless, not more accurate.
The system won't auto-re-encode; item vectors must be explicitly re-encoded with the new model to align.
Misalignment affects all items' similarity comparison, not just new ones; old items are distorted too.

termDefinitions.term: misaligned embedding spaces / 向量空间错位
termDefinitions.meaning: query 和物品用不同版本模型编码,向量落在不可比的空间,相似度失真。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Misaligned embedding spaces are query and item vectors encoded by different model versions, landing in non-comparable spaces that distort similarity.

scenario: 要在模型切换期保证零停机,又希望切换那一刻新索引就是完全最新的,不用等回填。
scenario_en: You need zero downtime during a model switch and want the new index fully current the instant you cut over, with no backfill wait.
q: 「双写(dual-write)」重建策略怎么做,代价是什么?
q_en: How does the dual-write rebuild strategy work, and what's its cost?
why: 每个新增/更新的物品同时用新旧两个模型编码,并行写进在线索引和影子索引;等影子索引填满并验证后切流量。好处是切换那刻影子索引已完全最新;代价是过渡期写吞吐和存储翻倍。
