optionExplanations_en: W&D is jointly trained with a shared loss and summed outputs, not two independent models trained separately like an ensemble and averaged.
Correct — wide memorizes frequent co-occurrences, deep generalizes to unseen combos, jointly trained and summed into a sigmoid for CTR, the original design.
Both branches process representations of the same tabular features (sparse crosses vs dense embeddings), not separate image/text modalities.
The roles are swapped: wide is the linear memorizer (frequent co-occurrences), deep is the generalizing net (unseen combos); they can't be exchanged.

termDefinitions.meaning: Google 2016 排序模型,线性 wide(记忆)与深度 deep(泛化)联合训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wide & Deep (W&D) is Google's 2016 ranking model jointly training a linear wide (memorization) and deep (generalization) part.

termDefinitions.meaning: 点击率,曝光被点击的概率,排序模型常见的预测目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR (Click-Through Rate) is the probability an impression is clicked, a common ranking prediction target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 利用历史高频共现(如已装×曝光)直接记住有效交叉,wide 部分负责。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Memorization exploits frequent historical co-occurrences to directly capture effective crosses, handled by the wide part.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对没见过的特征组合也能给出合理预测,deep 部分靠稠密 embedding 负责。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Generalization gives sensible predictions for unseen feature combinations, handled by the deep part via dense embeddings.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 解释 Wide & Deep 为什么两条支路都要,而不是只留一条。
scenario_en: Explaining why Wide & Deep needs both branches rather than just one.
q: wide 的「记忆」和 deep 的「泛化」在能力上如何互补？
q_en: How do wide's memorization and deep's generalization complement each other?
why: wide 靠人工交叉记住高频强共现(deep 会平滑掉),deep 靠稠密 embedding 泛化到未见组合。单用 wide 不会泛化、单用 deep 漏掉尖锐规则,合起来才互补、强于任一支。
why_en: Wide memorizes sharp high-frequency co-occurrences that deep would smooth over, while deep generalizes to sparse unseen combos, so together they beat either alone.
tradeoff: wide 记忆(高频共现精准但不泛化) vs deep 泛化(覆盖未见组合但平滑掉尖锐规则)
options: 两支能力完全重叠,留一支即可,另一支纯属冗余没有增益
wide 记忆高频共现(deep 会平滑掉)、deep 泛化未见组合,互补优于任一支
wide 负责泛化未见组合、deep 负责记忆高频共现,两者角色和实际正好相反
两支都只做记忆,区别仅在于 wide 用 CPU、deep 用 GPU,能力上没有分工
options_en: The two branches fully overlap; keep one, the other is pure redundancy with no gain.
Wide memorizes high-frequency co-occurrences that deep smooths away, deep generalizes to unseen combos.
Wide generalizes to unseen combos and deep memorizes high-frequency co-occurrences — roles exactly opposite to reality.
Both branches only memorize; the sole difference is wide uses CPU and deep uses GPU, with no capability split.
optionExplanations: 两支能力不重叠:一个记忆尖锐规则、一个泛化新组合,去掉任一支都掉能力。
对;记忆与泛化是互补的两种能力,合起来才既抓高频又覆盖长尾,优于单支。
角色说反了:wide 记忆、deep 泛化,不能互换。
分工不是硬件差异,而是记忆 vs 泛化两种建模能力的差异。
optionExplanations_en: The branches don't overlap: one memorizes sharp rules, the other generalizes new combos; dropping either loses capability.
Correct — memorization and generalization are complementary, together capturing both frequent and long-tail patterns, beating either alone.
Roles reversed: wide memorizes, deep generalizes; they can't be swapped.
The split isn't hardware but two modeling capabilities, memorization vs generalization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把两个特征组合成新特征(如已装 app×曝光 app),让线性模型捕捉共现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature cross combines two features (e.g. installed-app × impression-app) so a linear model can capture co-occurrence.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 排序模型现在是纯逻辑回归(LR),既有大量稀疏类别特征,又新增了不少稠密 embedding 特征,想升级但不想丢掉线性模型的记忆力。
scenario_en: The ranker is plain logistic regression with lots of sparse categoricals plus new dense embeddings, and you want to upgrade without losing linear memorization.
q: 从纯 LR 往上升级,最自然的下一步是什么？
q_en: Escalating from plain LR, what's the most natural next step?
why: 纯 LR 大致等于 W&D 的 wide 支路。既然同时有稀疏类别+稠密 embedding,自然升级就是加一条 deep 支路变 Wide & Deep:保住记忆力,再补未见组合的泛化。
why_en: Plain LR is roughly W&D's wide branch, so adding a deep branch to form Wide & Deep keeps the memorization and adds generalization for the new dense embeddings.
tradeoff: 升级为 W&D(保留 LR 记忆+加 deep 泛化,平滑过渡) vs 直接上更复杂结构(收益不确定、丢失渐进性)
options: 把 LR 直接换成一个纯深度前馈网,把稀疏类别也全部走 embedding,彻底丢掉线性支路
在 LR(≈wide 支路)上加一条 deep 支路,变成 Wide & Deep 补上泛化
退回到 GBDT,放弃新增的稠密 embedding 特征,只用手工交叉的树模型继续做排序
保持纯 LR 架构不变,只把新增的稠密 embedding 特征离散化后塞进稀疏交叉里
options_en: Replace LR outright with a pure deep feed-forward net, routing sparse categoricals through embeddings too, dropping the linear branch entirely.
Add a deep branch on top of LR (≈ the wide branch), forming Wide & Deep to add generalization.
Revert to GBDT, abandon the newly added dense embedding features, and keep ranking with a hand-crossed tree model only.
Keep the plain LR architecture but discretize the new dense embedding features and stuff them into sparse crosses instead.
whenOtherWins: 若手工特征交叉的维护成本已成主要痛点、想彻底自动化交叉,则该跳过 W&D 直接上 DCN(自动交叉)。
whenOtherWins_en: If manual feature-cross maintenance is the main pain and you want crosses fully automated, skip W&D and go straight to DCN.
optionExplanations: 把稀疏类别硬塞进 embedding 会丢掉 LR 的尖锐记忆力,对高频强共现反而变差,不是最平滑的升级。
对;LR≈wide,加 deep 支路即 W&D,保留记忆又补泛化,是最自然的下一步。
退回 GBDT 等于放弃刚拿到手的稠密 embedding 特征和泛化能力,和「升级」方向相反。
把稠密 embedding 硬离散化再塞进线性交叉,丢失了 embedding 本该带来的连续泛化能力,本质还是纯 LR,没有真正升级。
optionExplanations_en: Forcing sparse categoricals through embeddings drops LR's sharp memorization and does worse on frequent strong co-occurrences, not the smoothest upgrade.
Correct — LR ≈ wide, so adding a deep branch is W&D, keeping memorization and adding generalization, the natural next step.
Reverting to GBDT abandons the newly gained dense embedding features and their generalization power, opposite to upgrading.
Discretizing the dense embeddings and stuffing them into linear crosses throws away the continuous generalization embeddings were supposed to add — it's still plain LR underneath, not a real upgrade.

termDefinitions.term: sparse categorical feature / 稀疏类别特征
termDefinitions.meaning: 取值离散且高基数的特征(如 app ID),线性 wide 支路擅长记忆其交叉。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sparse categorical feature is a high-cardinality discrete feature (e.g. app ID) whose crosses the wide branch memorizes well.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: W&D 的 wide 支路要人工设计特征交叉,团队想让交叉自动化。
scenario_en: W&D's wide branch needs hand-designed feature crosses, and the team wants crosses automated.
q: DCN(Deep & Cross Network)相对 W&D 的关键改进是什么？
q_en: What is DCN's (Deep & Cross Network) key improvement over W&D?
why: DCN 用 cross-network 每层做显式特征交叉,每加一层多一阶交互,L 层自动捕捉 (L+1) 阶交叉,消除 wide 支路的人工交叉。deep 支路并行,cross+deep 拼接进最终预测层。
why_en: DCN's cross-network does explicit feature crossing per layer so L layers automatically capture up to (L+1)-order interactions, eliminating W&D's manual feature crossing.
options: DCN 把 deep 支路删掉,只保留一个更大的线性层来手工枚举所有可能的特征交叉
DCN 用 cross-network 每层显式自动交叉(L 层→(L+1)阶),消除人工交叉
DCN 只是把 W&D 换了个名字,内部结构和训练方式完全一样,没有任何机制改进
DCN 靠更大的 embedding 维度来隐式交叉,完全不引入任何专门的 cross 层结构
options_en: DCN removes the deep branch and keeps one larger linear layer that hand-enumerates all possible crosses.
DCN cross-network does explicit automatic crossing per layer (L layers → (L+1)-order), removing manual crosses.
DCN is just W&D renamed; the internal structure and training are identical with no mechanism change.
DCN relies on a larger embedding dimension for implicit crossing and introduces no dedicated cross-layer structure.
optionExplanations: DCN 保留 deep 支路;它替换的是 wide 的人工交叉,不是靠更大线性层手工枚举。
对;cross-network 逐层自动升阶交叉,把人工特征交叉自动化,这正是 DCN 的核心改进。
DCN 有实质机制改进(cross-network 自动交叉),不是改名。
更大 embedding 不等于显式交叉;DCN 的关键正是专门的 cross 层显式建交互。
optionExplanations_en: DCN keeps the deep branch; it replaces wide's manual crosses, not via a larger hand-enumerating linear layer.
Correct — the cross-network automatically raises interaction order per layer, automating manual crosses, DCN's core improvement.
DCN has a real mechanism change (automatic crossing), not a rename.
A bigger embedding isn't explicit crossing; DCN's point is a dedicated cross layer that models interactions explicitly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 W&D 上用 cross-network 自动做显式特征交叉,消除人工交叉工程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DCN (Deep & Cross Network) uses a cross-network for automatic explicit feature crossing, removing manual cross engineering.

termDefinitions.meaning: 逐层做显式特征交叉的网络,每层多一阶交互,L 层达 (L+1) 阶。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross-network performs explicit feature crossing per layer, each adding one interaction order, reaching (L+1)-order after L layers.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: DCN 的 cross 层数要定几层:每层成本 ∝ 层数 × 输入维度,高维稀疏输入下会成瓶颈。
scenario_en: Choosing DCN's cross-layer count: each layer costs ∝ #layers × input dim, and high-dim sparse inputs can bottleneck.
q: DCN 的 cross 层数为什么常取 2-3 层这个甜点区？
q_en: Why is DCN's cross-layer count commonly kept at the 2-3 sweet spot?
why: L 层 cross 能自动捕捉到 (L+1) 阶交互,前几阶交互带来的收益最大;但 cross 成本 ∝ 层数 × 输入维度,高维稀疏输入下层数一多就成算力瓶颈。2-3 层在「够高阶」与「不炸算力」之间取平衡,是常用甜点区。
why_en: L layers capture (L+1)-order interactions with the biggest gains from the first few orders, while cost scales with #layers × input dim, so 2-3 layers balance order against compute.
options: 因为 cross 层只能取奇数,2-3 层是唯一合法的层数配置
因为高阶交互收益递减,而 cross 成本∝层数×输入维度,2-3 层是平衡点
因为 2-3 层能把所有 (L+1) 阶以上的无穷阶交互一次性全部精确建出来
因为层数越多精度一定越高,取 2-3 层纯粹是因为训练框架的上限限制
options_en: Because cross layers must be odd, so 2-3 is the only legal configuration.
Because high-order gains diminish while cost scales with layers × input dim, so 2-3 is the balance point.
Because 2-3 layers exactly build all infinite-order interactions beyond (L+1) at once.
Because more layers always mean higher accuracy, and 2-3 is purely a training-framework upper limit.
optionExplanations: 层数没有奇偶限制;2-3 是收益与成本的平衡点,不是唯一合法值。
对;前几阶交互收益最大、再往上成本随维度飙升,2-3 层是够用又不炸算力的甜点区。
L 层只到 (L+1) 阶,不可能一次建出无穷阶交互,这句本身不成立。
层数越多不必然越准,还会增本增噪;取 2-3 层是收益/成本权衡而非框架上限。
optionExplanations_en: There's no odd/even rule; 2-3 is a gain-vs-cost balance, not the only legal value.
Correct — the first few orders give the most gain while cost climbs with dimension, so 2-3 layers is the enough-yet-affordable sweet spot.
L layers reach only (L+1)-order, so building infinite-order at once is false.
More layers don't guarantee accuracy and add cost and noise; 2-3 is a gain/cost tradeoff, not a framework cap.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时参与一次特征交叉的原始特征个数;DCN 的 L 层达到 (L+1) 阶。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Interaction order is how many raw features join one cross; DCN's L layers reach (L+1)-order.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: DCN-v2(2021)相对初代 DCN 在 cross 层的权重上做了改动。
scenario_en: DCN-v2 (2021) changes the weight in the cross layer relative to the original DCN.
q: DCN-v2 相比初代 DCN 的主要改动与代价是什么？
q_en: What does DCN-v2 change from the original DCN, and at what cost?
why: DCN-v2 把 cross 层里的向量权重 w_l 换成矩阵 W_l,让每层能表达更丰富的交叉,精度可比甚至优于 W&D,还免去人工交叉;代价是参数量更多、算力更大。它把加新特征的迭代从「天」缩短到「小时」。
why_en: DCN-v2 replaces the cross layer's vector weight w_l with a matrix W_l for richer crosses, matching or beating W&D without manual crosses, at the cost of more parameters.
tradeoff: DCN-v2 矩阵权重 W_l(交叉更丰富、精度更高) vs 初代向量权重 w_l(参数更少、表达力较弱)
options: DCN-v2 把 cross 层删掉只留 deep 支路,靠更深的前馈网代替显式交叉
DCN-v2 把 cross 层向量权重 w_l 换成矩阵 W_l,交叉更丰富但参数更多
DCN-v2 重新引入了人工特征交叉,放弃了初代的自动交叉能力
DCN-v2 只是把初代模型量化压缩,不改变 cross 层结构,纯粹为了省显存
options_en: DCN-v2 removes the cross layer, keeping only the deep branch, replacing explicit crosses with a deeper feed-forward net.
DCN-v2 swaps the cross layer vector weight w_l for a matrix W_l: richer crosses, more parameters.
DCN-v2 reintroduces manual feature crosses, abandoning the original's automatic crossing.
DCN-v2 just quantizes and compresses the original without changing the cross layer, purely to save VRAM.
optionExplanations: DCN-v2 保留并增强 cross 层,不是删掉它换更深 deep。
对;向量权重→矩阵权重是 v2 的核心改动,换来更丰富交叉与更高精度,代价是参数更多。
v2 恰恰继续自动交叉,并未回到人工交叉。
v2 是结构增强(矩阵权重)而非单纯量化压缩。
optionExplanations_en: DCN-v2 keeps and strengthens the cross layer, not removes it for a deeper deep branch.
Correct — vector-to-matrix weight is v2's core change, buying richer crosses and higher accuracy at more parameters.
v2 continues automatic crossing and doesn't return to manual crosses.
v2 is a structural upgrade (matrix weight), not mere quantization/compression.

termDefinitions.meaning: 2021 版 DCN,cross 层用矩阵权重 W_l 替代向量 w_l,交叉更丰富。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DCN-v2 (2021) replaces the cross layer's vector weight with a matrix W_l for richer feature crosses.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 排序团队每次加一个新特征,都要人工设计它和别的特征怎么交叉,迭代一次要好几天,想提速。
scenario_en: Every new feature requires hand-designing its crosses, taking days per iteration, and the team wants to speed up.
q: 为了摆脱人工特征交叉、加快迭代,该在 W&D 和 DCN 之间选谁？
q_en: To drop manual feature crossing and iterate faster, choose W&D or DCN?
why: DCN 更合适:cross-network 自动做显式交叉,不用人工设计每个特征怎么交叉,把加新特征的迭代从「天」压到「小时」,精度还可比/优于 W&D。W&D 的 wide 支路恰恰要人工交叉,正是团队想摆脱的负担。
why_en: DCN fits: its cross-network automates explicit crossing so you skip hand-designing crosses, cutting feature-add iteration from days to hours while matching or beating W&D.
tradeoff: DCN(自动交叉、迭代小时级、算力中等) vs W&D(人工交叉、迭代天级、但结构更简单成熟)
options: 选 W&D,因为人工按业务经验设计的交叉一定比自动交叉更准,多花几天也值得
选 DCN:cross-network 自动做显式交叉,迭代从天缩到小时
两者都不选,退回纯 LR,靠人工精简特征来减少要交叉的组合数,绕开自动化
选谁都行,W&D 和 DCN 在是否需要人工设计交叉这一点上其实没有实质区别
options_en: Choose W&D because crosses hand-designed from business experience are always more accurate than automatic ones, worth the extra days.
Choose DCN: the cross-network automates explicit crossing and cuts iteration from days to hours.
Choose neither; revert to plain LR and manually trim features to shrink the combinations that need crossing, sidestepping automation.
Either is fine — W&D and DCN don't actually differ substantively on whether manual cross design is needed.
whenOtherWins: 若少数几个关键交叉靠领域知识人工设计能显著提点、且特征集稳定不常变,W&D 的人工交叉反而更可控。
whenOtherWins_en: If a few key crosses hand-designed from domain knowledge boost metrics a lot and the feature set is stable, W&D's manual crosses can be more controllable.
optionExplanations: 人工交叉不必然更准,即使是业务经验驱动的交叉,DCN 自动交叉精度也可比/更优,还省掉几天迭代成本。
对;DCN 自动化交叉直击「人工设计慢」的痛点,迭代提速且精度不降,是对症之选。
退回纯 LR 靠人工精简特征依然要人工判断留哪些交叉,是砍能力换简单,解决不了「想保留交叉但要自动化」的诉求。
两者关键区别正是在此:W&D 需人工设计交叉,DCN 自动交叉,不能说没有实质区别。
optionExplanations_en: Manual crosses aren't necessarily more accurate — even business-experience-driven crosses are matched/beaten by DCN's automatic crosses, which also save days of iteration.
Correct — DCN's automation targets the 'manual design is slow' pain, speeding iteration without losing accuracy.
Reverting to LR and manually trimming features still requires manually judging which crosses to keep — trading capability for simplicity, and doesn't meet the 'keep crosses but automate' need.
This is exactly their key difference: W&D needs hand-designed crosses, DCN automates them, so they do differ substantively.

termDefinitions.term: feature engineering burden / 特征工程负担
termDefinitions.meaning: 人工设计与维护特征交叉的成本;DCN 自动化交叉以降低它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feature-engineering burden is the cost of hand-designing and maintaining crosses, which DCN reduces via automatic crossing.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 把两塔、Wide & Deep、DCN 放在一张决策矩阵上,准备在面试里说清各自定位。
scenario_en: Placing two-tower, Wide & Deep, and DCN on one decision matrix to state each one's role in an interview.
q: 两塔、W&D、DCN 分别处在级联的哪一阶段、各自的特征工程负担如何？
q_en: Which cascade stage do two-tower, W&D, and DCN serve, and what's each one's feature-engineering burden?
why: 两塔用于检索(用户/物品编码器+ANN,交互弱但快,sub-10ms);W&D 用于排序(记忆强,但要人工交叉,FE 负担高);DCN 用于排序(自动交叉,FE 负担低,算力中等)。定位不同:一个负责收窄规模,两个负责精打分。
why_en: Two-tower serves retrieval (encoders + ANN, fast, weak interaction), while W&D and DCN serve ranking, with W&D carrying high manual-cross burden and DCN automating crosses.
tradeoff: 两塔(检索、快、交互弱) vs W&D(排序、记忆强、人工交叉贵) vs DCN(排序、自动交叉、算力中等)
options: 三者都用于检索阶段,谁也不做排序,靠堆三个检索模型串联来提升召回
两塔=检索(快、交互弱);W&D、DCN=排序(前者人工交叉,后者自动)
三者都是排序模型,没有一个能做检索,检索只能靠关键词匹配
两塔用于排序,W&D 和 DCN 用于检索,三者的阶段定位正好和实际相反
options_en: All three serve retrieval, none does ranking, chaining three retrieval models to boost recall.
Two-tower = retrieval (fast, weak interaction); W&D and DCN = ranking, with manual vs automatic crossing.
All three are rankers, none can do retrieval, and retrieval must rely on keyword matching.
Two-tower does ranking while W&D and DCN do retrieval — the stage roles are exactly reversed.
optionExplanations: 两塔才用于检索,W&D/DCN 是排序;三者不是同阶段堆叠,而是级联分工。
对;两塔收窄规模、W&D/DCN 精打分,FE 负担 W&D 高、DCN 低,这就是三者定位。
两塔正是可做检索的架构,说三者都不能检索与事实不符。
阶段说反了:两塔检索、W&D/DCN 排序,不能互换。
optionExplanations_en: Only two-tower serves retrieval while W&D/DCN rank; they aren't stacked at one stage but split across the cascade.
Correct — two-tower narrows scale, W&D/DCN score precisely, with W&D high and DCN low on FE burden, their exact roles.
Two-tower is precisely the retrieval-capable architecture, so 'none can retrieve' is false.
Stages reversed: two-tower retrieves, W&D/DCN rank; they can't be swapped.

termDefinitions.meaning: 人工设计特征/交叉的工作量:W&D 高、DCN 低、两塔中等。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feature-engineering (FE) burden is the manual work of designing features/crosses: high for W&D, low for DCN, moderate for two-tower.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度神经网络,W&D 的 deep 支路与 DCN 的并行支路都是它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DNN (Deep Neural Network) is the deep branch in W&D and the parallel branch in DCN.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

q: 把两塔检索的线上服务流程排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the online serving flow of two-tower retrieval:
steps: 线上收到请求,只跑用户塔算出用户向量
离线用物品塔把全部物品预计算成向量
拿用户向量到 ANN 索引里做近邻检索,返回 top-K 候选
把物品向量灌进 ANN 索引(FAISS/ScaNN)
why: 离线两步先行:物品塔预算物品向量 → 灌进 ANN 索引;线上两步随请求:只跑用户塔得用户向量 → ANN 近邻检索 top-K。把重活(十亿物品编码)放离线、线上只算一个用户向量,是 sub-10ms 的关键。
why_en: Offline first precompute item vectors then index them in ANN; online run only the user tower then do an ANN top-K lookup, keeping the heavy item encoding offline.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["离线:物品塔预算物品向量"] --> B["灌进 ANN 索引"]
  B --> C["线上:用户塔算用户向量"]
  C --> D["ANN 近邻检索 top-K"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 对物品向量建的索引(FAISS/ScaNN),支持毫秒级 top-K 相似检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ANN index (FAISS/ScaNN) over item vectors supports millisecond top-K similarity retrieval.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

q: 填空:两塔检索的部署要点。
q_en: Fill in the two-tower retrieval deployment essentials.
text: 物品 embedding 在{{离线}}预计算并灌进 {{ANN}} 索引(FAISS/ScaNN);线上只跑{{用户塔}},用它的向量做近邻检索,top-K 在 {{sub-10ms}} 内返回。
text_en: Item embeddings are precomputed {{offline}} and indexed in an {{ANN}} system (FAISS/ScaNN); online only the {{user tower}} runs, and its vector retrieves top-K within {{sub-10ms}}.
why: 记住「物品离线 + 用户在线 + ANN 检索」这条部署主线:重活放离线固化,线上只算一个向量再近邻查,才能在 sub-10ms 里从十亿物品取回候选。
why_en: Remember offline items + online user + ANN lookup: freeze the heavy work offline so online computes one vector then a nearest-neighbor query within sub-10ms.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 ANN 索引里取与用户向量最相似的 K 个物品作为候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-K retrieval returns the K items most similar to the user vector from the ANN index as candidates.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 两塔里物品有十亿量级,每次用户请求都要在 sub-200ms 端到端内返回候选。
scenario_en: A two-tower with a billion items must return candidates within a sub-200ms end-to-end budget per request.
q: 为什么两塔一定要把物品 embedding 离线预计算,而不是请求时现算？
q_en: Why must a two-tower precompute item embeddings offline rather than at query time?
why: 请求时给十亿物品逐个跑物品塔算 embedding,计算量远超 sub-200ms 预算,直接顶破延迟约束。离线把物品向量算好灌进 ANN,线上只算一个用户向量再近邻检索,才能满足延迟。这正是两塔解耦设计的目的。
why_en: Computing embeddings for a billion items at query time far exceeds the latency budget, so items are precomputed offline into ANN while online only the user vector is computed.
tradeoff: 离线预算物品向量(满足延迟、但物品更新有滞后) vs 请求时现算(最新但十亿级违反延迟约束)
options: 因为请求时逐个算十亿物品 embedding 远超延迟预算,离线+ANN 才够快
因为物品 embedding 离线算出来精度更高、更稳定,和线上延迟预算没关系
因为物品塔太大装不进线上服务器内存,只能在离线机器上跑一次
因为请求时算 embedding 会泄露用户隐私,离线算是出于合规要求
options_en: Because computing a billion item embeddings at query time blows the latency budget; offline + ANN is fast enough.
Because offline item embeddings are more accurate and stable, unrelated to the online latency budget.
Because the item tower is too large to fit in online server memory and can only run once on offline machines.
Because computing embeddings at query time leaks user privacy, so offline is a compliance requirement.
whenOtherWins: 若物品只有几千条且频繁变化,请求时现算物品向量也能满足延迟,离线预算+ANN 的收益就不明显了。
whenOtherWins_en: If there are only a few thousand items that change often, computing item vectors at query time can meet latency and offline+ANN buys little.
optionExplanations: 对;十亿物品请求时逐个前向必然超预算,离线固化+ANN 才把延迟压回 sub-200ms 内。
离线算不必更准;真正原因是延迟约束,不是精度。
内存不是根因;即便装得下,逐个前向十亿物品的时间也过不了预算。
隐私不是这里的原因;物品 embedding 与用户隐私无关,预算约束才是主因。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — forward-passing a billion items per request must exceed budget; freezing offline + ANN brings latency back within sub-200ms.
Offline isn't inherently more accurate; the real reason is the latency constraint, not accuracy.
Memory isn't the cause; even if it fit, forward-passing a billion items per request exceeds the budget.
Privacy isn't the reason; item embeddings don't involve user privacy — the budget constraint is.

termDefinitions.meaning: 离线提前算好物品向量并索引,避免请求时重复对海量物品做前向。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precompute means computing and indexing item vectors offline to avoid re-running forward passes over many items per request.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 要给级联的两个阶段各选模型:一个面对十亿量级要极快,一个面对数百候选要尽量准。
scenario_en: Choosing a model for each cascade stage: one faces billions and must be very fast, one faces hundreds and must be accurate.
q: 检索阶段和排序阶段对模型的要求为什么正好相反？
q_en: Why are the model requirements for retrieval and ranking essentially opposite?
why: 检索面对十亿量级,必须轻量可预计算(两塔+ANN),牺牲交互建模换速度;排序只剩数百候选,可以上表达力强、算交互的重模型(W&D/DCN)换精度。同一个模型无法同时满足两端,所以按阶段分工选不同架构。
why_en: Retrieval faces billions and must be light and precomputable, trading interaction for speed, while ranking faces hundreds and can afford an expressive interaction-modeling model for accuracy.
tradeoff: 检索(轻量可预计算、交互弱、快) vs 排序(重、交互强、准,但只处理少量候选)
options: 因为检索和排序其实要求一样,都追求又快又准,用同一个模型跑两遍就行
检索面对十亿要轻量可预计算,排序只剩数百可上重模型算交互
因为检索要最准、排序要最快,所以检索用重模型、排序用轻模型
因为检索和排序的差别只是数据库不同,和模型架构选择完全无关
options_en: Because retrieval and ranking actually have the same requirements — both want fast and accurate — so one model run twice suffices.
Retrieval faces billions and must stay light and precomputable; ranking faces hundreds and can model interaction.
Because retrieval wants maximum accuracy and ranking wants maximum speed, so retrieval uses the heavy model and ranking the light one.
Because the difference is only the database used, unrelated to model architecture choice.
whenOtherWins: 若候选集本就很小(几千条),检索这一层几乎可省,直接用一个排序重模型给全部候选打分也能满足延迟。
whenOtherWins_en: If the candidate set is small (a few thousand), the retrieval layer is nearly unneeded and one heavy ranker over all candidates can meet latency.
optionExplanations: 两端要求相反:一个求快、一个求准,同一模型很难同时满足,所以才分阶段。
对;规模决定了检索必须轻、排序才付得起重,这正是级联按阶段选不同架构的原因。
分反了:检索面对十亿必须最快(轻模型),排序候选少才用重模型求准。
差别不在数据库而在规模/延迟对模型的要求,直接决定架构选择。
optionExplanations_en: The ends are opposite: one wants speed, one wants accuracy, and one model can't do both — hence two stages.
Correct — scale dictates retrieval be light and ranking afford heavy, the reason the cascade picks different architectures per stage.
Reversed: retrieval faces billions and must be fastest (light), ranking with few candidates uses the heavy model for accuracy.
The difference is scale/latency demands on the model, not the database, and it drives architecture choice.

termDefinitions.term: cascade division of labor / 级联分工
termDefinitions.meaning: 检索轻量收窄规模、排序重模型精打分,两阶段各司其职。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cascade division of labor has light retrieval narrow the scale and a heavy ranker score precisely, each stage playing its role.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 两塔把用户和物品分开编码,直到最后才用点积相遇。
scenario_en: A two-tower encodes user and item separately, meeting only at a final dot product.
q: 两塔为了速度牺牲了什么,这个代价怎么补？
q_en: What does two-tower sacrifice for speed, and how is that cost mitigated?
why: 两塔用户与物品直到末端点积才相遇,中间无法建模细粒度的用户-物品特征交互,交互建模弱——这是它换取「可预计算+ANN 快速检索」付出的代价。补法:让下游的排序阶段(W&D/DCN,或蒸自 cross-encoder)把交互建模补回来。
why_en: Two-tower can't model fine-grained user-item interaction since they meet only at the final dot product, trading interaction for precomputable speed, mitigated by the downstream ranker.
tradeoff: 两塔(可预计算、快检索) vs 牺牲用户-物品细粒度交互建模(靠下游排序补回)
options: 牺牲了训练速度,补法是买更多 GPU 让两塔训得更快
牺牲细粒度用户-物品交互(末端才点积),靠下游排序补回来
牺牲了 embedding 维度,补法是把向量维度扩到上万维
两塔没有牺牲任何东西,它在速度和交互建模上都是最优的
options_en: It sacrifices training speed; mitigate by buying more GPUs so the towers train faster.
It sacrifices fine-grained user-item interaction (they meet only at the dot product); the downstream ranker compensates.
It sacrifices embedding dimension; mitigate by expanding vectors to tens of thousands of dims.
Two-tower sacrifices nothing; it's optimal on both speed and interaction modeling.
optionExplanations: 牺牲的不是训练速度,而是推理时的交互建模;加 GPU 补不回结构上缺的交互。
对;分开编码换来了可预计算的快检索,代价是交互弱,靠下游排序阶段把交互补回来。
维度不是牺牲点;盲目扩维增本还未必补回交互,治标不治本。
两塔确有牺牲(交互建模),说它两端都最优不成立。
optionExplanations_en: It sacrifices interaction modeling at inference, not training speed; GPUs can't restore structurally missing interaction.
Correct — separate encoding buys precomputable fast retrieval at weak interaction, restored by the downstream ranker.
Dimension isn't the sacrifice; blindly expanding it adds cost without truly restoring interaction.
Two-tower does sacrifice interaction, so claiming it's optimal on both is false.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户与物品向量只在最后点积相遇,中途不交互,故交互建模弱。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Late interaction means user and item vectors meet only at a final dot product, so interaction modeling is weak.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 设计两塔时要决定每座塔喂什么特征。
scenario_en: Designing a two-tower, you decide what features feed each tower.
q: 以下哪些是两塔各自常见的输入特征?(多选)
q_en: Which are common inputs to each two-tower? (multiple)
why: 用户塔吃用户侧信号:观看历史、人口属性、上下文(如一天中的时段);物品塔吃物品侧信号:物品 ID、标题 embedding、类别、热度。两侧各自编码成同维向量,不能把物品的原始视频码率这类无语义的传输参数当建模特征。
why_en: The user tower takes watch history, demographics, and context, while the item tower takes item ID, title embedding, category, and popularity, each encoded into same-dim vectors.
options: 用户塔:观看历史、人口属性、上下文(如时段)
物品塔:物品 ID、标题 embedding、类别、热度
两塔都需要:各自把特征编码成同维稠密向量
物品塔:视频的原始网络传输码率与 CDN 节点 IP
options_en: User tower: watch history, demographics, context (e.g. time of day).
Item tower: item ID, title embedding, category, popularity.
Both towers: each encodes features into a same-dimension dense vector.
Item tower: the video's raw network bitrate and CDN node IP.
optionExplanations: 对;用户侧的历史/人口/上下文是刻画用户口味的核心信号。
对;物品侧的 ID/标题/类别/热度共同刻画物品,编码成物品向量。
对;两塔输出必须同维,才能做点积/余弦相似度检索。
错;码率和 CDN IP 是传输/分发参数,无推荐语义,不该当建模特征。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — user-side history/demographics/context are core signals of user taste.
Correct — item-side ID/title/category/popularity together characterize the item as a vector.
Correct — both towers must output the same dimension to do dot-product/cosine similarity.
Wrong — bitrate and CDN IP are delivery parameters with no rec semantics and shouldn't be modeling features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求时的情境信号(时段、设备等),喂进用户塔刻画当下场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Context features are request-time situational signals (time of day, device) fed to the user tower to capture the moment.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 面试白板上画两塔时,除了画两座塔和点积,还需要标注哪些信息才算讲清楚。
scenario_en: Sketching two-tower on the whiteboard, beyond the towers and dot product, what must you annotate to be clear?
q: 画两塔检索图时,最该标注的是哪一项？
q_en: When sketching two-tower retrieval, what is most important to annotate?
why: 关键是标出「离线 vs 在线」的边界:物品索引在 FAISS/ScaNN 里离线预算,用户塔在线跑,并标上 sub-10ms 延迟。这条边界解释了两塔为何能在十亿级做到低延迟,是面试官最想看到的成本/延迟意识,而不是画得好不好看。
why_en: Mark the offline vs online boundary — item index in FAISS/ScaNN offline, user tower online — and annotate the sub-10ms latency, which explains how two-tower scales.
tradeoff: 标注离线/在线边界+延迟(体现规模化推理) vs 只画结构框(看不出为何能低延迟)
options: 把每座塔画成几层、每层多少神经元,精确标注网络深度和宽度
标出离线物品索引(FAISS/ScaNN)与在线用户塔的边界
标注训练用的 GPU 型号和 batch size,让面试官知道算力配置
把用户和物品的全部原始特征名一个不漏地写满整块白板
options_en: Draw each tower's layer count and neurons per layer, annotating exact depth and width.
Mark the boundary between the offline item index (FAISS/ScaNN) and the online user tower.
Annotate the training GPU model and batch size so the interviewer knows the compute setup.
Write out every raw feature name for user and item, missing none, filling the whole board.
whenOtherWins: 若讨论已聚焦到「模型容量是否够」,那时标注塔的深度/宽度才有意义;但讲检索为何低延迟时,边界+延迟最关键。
whenOtherWins_en: If the discussion has narrowed to model capacity, annotating depth/width matters then; but to explain low-latency retrieval, the boundary and latency come first.
optionExplanations: 层数神经元数是次要实现细节,标了也解释不了两塔为何能规模化低延迟。
对;离线/在线边界 + 延迟标注直接讲清两塔的规模化推理逻辑,是面试最想看到的。
GPU 型号与 batch size 是训练配置,与「为何在线检索快」无关。
堆满原始特征名信息过载,反而盖住了边界这个关键点。
optionExplanations_en: Layer/neuron counts are minor implementation details and don't explain why two-tower scales at low latency.
Correct — the offline/online boundary plus latency directly explains two-tower's scalable inference, what interviewers most want.
GPU model and batch size are training config, unrelated to why online retrieval is fast.
Cramming raw feature names overloads the board and hides the key boundary point.

termDefinitions.term: offline/online boundary / 离线在线边界
termDefinitions.meaning: 图上区分哪部分离线预算(物品索引)哪部分在线实时(用户塔)的分界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The offline/online boundary marks which parts are precomputed offline (item index) vs run live online (user tower).

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

q: 填空:DCN cross 层的机制与阶数关系。
q_en: Fill in DCN's cross-layer mechanism and order relation.
text: DCN 的 cross 层公式 x_{l+1} = x_0·x_l^T·w_l + b_l + x_l,每层多加一{{阶}}交互;叠 L 层后自动捕捉到 {{(L+1)}} 阶交叉;实践常取 {{2-3}} 层,因成本∝层数×输入维度。
text_en: DCN's cross layer x_{l+1} = x_0·x_l^T·w_l + b_l + x_l adds one interaction {{order}} per layer; after L layers it captures {{(L+1)}}-order crosses; practice uses {{2-3}} layers since cost scales with #layers × input dim.
why: 记住 cross 层「每层+1 阶、L 层达 (L+1) 阶、成本随层数×维度」这条关系:它解释了为何 2-3 层是甜点区,也解释了 DCN 如何自动替代人工交叉。
why_en: Remember each cross layer adds one order, L layers reach (L+1)-order, and cost scales with layers × dim, explaining the 2-3-layer sweet spot.

termDefinitions.meaning: cross 公式里的 +x_l,把上一层输出加回,稳定深层训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The residual term (+x_l) in the cross formula adds back the previous layer's output to stabilize deep training.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: DCN 排序模型的输入是高维稀疏特征拼接后的向量,团队发现加 cross 层后延迟明显上升。
scenario_en: A DCN ranker's input is a high-dim sparse concatenated vector, and adding cross layers noticeably raises latency.
q: cross 层的计算成本大致随什么增长,这对高维稀疏输入意味着什么？
q_en: What does cross-layer cost scale with, and what does that mean for high-dim sparse inputs?
why: cross 成本大致 ∝ 层数 × 输入维度。高维稀疏输入拼接后维度很大,层数一多计算量线性放大,成为延迟瓶颈。设计含义:控制 cross 层数(常 2-3 层),必要时先降维,别让 cross 层把排序延迟预算吃光。
why_en: Cross cost scales roughly with #layers × input dim, so high-dim sparse inputs make layers bottleneck latency, meaning cap cross layers (often 2-3) and reduce dimension if needed.
options: cross 成本∝层数×输入维度;高维稀疏下层数一多就成延迟瓶颈
cross 成本与输入维度无关,只由 batch size 决定,和高维稀疏没关系
cross 成本随层数指数爆炸,所以哪怕 2 层也无法上线,必须彻底弃用 cross 层
cross 成本随层数下降,层数越多反而越省算力,应尽量多堆几十层
options_en: Cross cost scales with layers × input dim; with high-dim sparse inputs, more layers bottleneck latency.
Cross cost is independent of input dim and set only by batch size, unrelated to high-dim sparsity.
Cross cost explodes exponentially with layers, so even 2 layers can't ship and cross layers must be abandoned entirely.
Cross cost falls with more layers, so more layers save compute and you should stack dozens.
optionExplanations: 对;成本∝层数×维度,高维输入下多加层线性放大延迟,故限层数并考虑降维。
输入维度正是成本的关键因子,说它无关与机制矛盾。
成本随层数线性而非指数;2-3 层完全可上线,不必弃用 cross。
层数越多算力越大而非越省,堆几十层会顶破延迟预算。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — cost scales with layers × dim, so with high-dim inputs extra layers linearly inflate latency; cap layers and consider dim reduction.
Input dimension is the key cost factor, so calling it irrelevant contradicts the mechanism.
Cost scales linearly with layers, not exponentially; 2-3 layers ship fine, no need to abandon cross.
More layers cost more not less; stacking dozens would blow the latency budget.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征拼接后的向量长度,高维稀疏输入会放大 cross 层计算量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Input dimension is the length of the concatenated feature vector; high-dim sparse inputs inflate cross-layer compute.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 排序模型(W&D/DCN)预测 CTR,面试官问训练用什么目标函数。
scenario_en: A ranker (W&D/DCN) predicts CTR, and the interviewer asks what training objective is used.
q: CTR 排序模型通常用什么目标函数,输出层是什么？
q_en: What objective and output layer does a CTR ranker typically use?
why: CTR 是二分类(点/不点),输出层用 sigmoid 压成 0-1 概率,训练用二元交叉熵(BCE)。W&D/DCN 的分支输出相加过 sigmoid,再与点击标签算 BCE。
why_en: CTR is binary (click/no-click), so the output is a sigmoid giving a 0-1 probability trained with binary cross-entropy (BCE).
options: 用均方误差回归点击次数,输出层是线性层直接输出任意实数
用二元交叉熵(BCE),输出层 sigmoid 给出点击概率
用多分类 softmax 预测点击发生在一天中的哪个小时
不需要目标函数,CTR 排序靠规则阈值直接判定点或不点
options_en: Mean-squared error regressing click counts, with a linear output emitting any real number.
Binary cross-entropy (BCE), with a sigmoid output giving the click probability.
Multiclass softmax predicting which hour of the day the click happens.
No objective needed; CTR ranking decides click/no-click by a rule threshold.
optionExplanations: CTR 是概率不是计数,MSE 回归实数不匹配二分类,也不给概率输出。
对;二分类点/不点用 sigmoid+BCE,输出可解释为点击概率,是 CTR 排序标准配置。
点击小时是另一个问题,softmax 预测时段与 CTR 二分类目标无关。
排序要学习可比的概率分数,规则阈值给不出可优化梯度也无法个性化。
optionExplanations_en: CTR is a probability not a count; MSE regressing reals mismatches binary classification and gives no probability.
Correct — click/no-click uses sigmoid + BCE, output readable as click probability, the standard CTR ranking setup.
Click hour is a different problem; softmax over hours is unrelated to the binary CTR objective.
Ranking needs comparable probability scores; a rule threshold gives no optimizable gradient and can't personalize.

termDefinitions.meaning: 二元交叉熵,二分类(如点/不点)的标准损失函数,配 sigmoid 输出。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BCE (Binary Cross-Entropy) is the standard loss for binary classification like click/no-click, paired with a sigmoid output.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把任意实数压到 0-1 的激活函数,输出可当概率解释。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sigmoid squashes any real number into 0-1, so the output reads as a probability.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

q: 把排序架构从简单到自动化的演进链排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the ranking-architecture evolution from simple to automated:
steps: DCN 用 cross-network 自动做显式交叉,免去人工设计
纯逻辑回归(LR),只有线性、靠人工特征
DCN-v2 把 cross 向量权重换成矩阵,交叉更丰富
Wide & Deep 加一条 deep 支路,补上泛化能力
why: 演进主线是「逐步减少人工、增强交叉表达」:LR(纯人工线性)→ W&D(加 deep 泛化,但 wide 仍人工交叉)→ DCN(自动交叉)→ DCN-v2(矩阵权重更丰富交叉)。每一步要么补能力、要么自动化,迭代成本从天降到小时。
why_en: The line reduces manual work and enriches crosses: LR → W&D (adds deep generalization) → DCN (automates crosses) → DCN-v2 (matrix weights for richer crosses).
diagram:
flowchart LR
  LR["LR 纯线性"] --> WD["W&D +deep 泛化"]
  WD --> DCN["DCN 自动交叉"]
  DCN --> V2["DCN-v2 矩阵权重"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 排序模型从人工线性逐步走向自动交叉、更强交互表达的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Architecture evolution is the ranker's path from manual linear models toward automated crossing and richer interaction.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 有人把两塔设计成共享全部参数,并且只用随机负样本训练,结果 embedding 空间坍缩、召回骤降。
scenario_en: Someone builds a two-tower sharing all parameters and trains with only random negatives; the embedding space collapses and recall crashes.
q: 「共享全部参数 + 只用随机负样本」为什么会让两塔崩掉,怎么救？
q_en: Why does 'share all params + only random negatives' break a two-tower, and how do you fix it?
why: 两塔本该学不同表示;强行共享全部参数让两侧纠缠、区分度下降,再叠加随机负样本太易 → embedding 退化、recall 骤降。救法:两塔各自独立参数 + hard negative mining 提难度。
why_en: Sharing all parameters entangles the two towers' representations and, combined with only easy random negatives, degrades the embedding space; fix with separate params and hard-negative mining.
options: 因为可训练参数太少导致模型欠拟合,救法是把两座塔合并成一个更大的共享网络来增加容量
共享全部参数让两侧表示纠缠+随机负样本太易→recall 降;救法是独立参数
因为学习率设得太高,只要把学习率调低、再训练更久,共享参数加随机负样本就都没问题了
因为底层 ANN 索引精度不够才导致召回下降,与参数共享和负采样无关,换成精确检索即可
options_en: Because too few parameters underfit; fix by merging the towers into one larger shared network.
Sharing all parameters entangles both representations and easy random negatives drop recall; fix with separate parameters.
Because the learning rate is too high; just lower it and shared params with random negatives are fine.
Because the ANN index isn't precise enough, unrelated to param sharing or negative sampling; switch to exact search.
optionExplanations: 问题不是参数太少而是共享导致表示纠缠;合并成一个网络反而更纠缠,方向错了。
对;走完「共享+随机负太易→区分度退化→recall 降→独立参数+难负例修」整链,是标准诊断。
调学习率救不了结构性纠缠和负例太易带来的信息缺口,治标不治本。
recall 骤降可直接归因于参数共享+随机负样本,推给 ANN 精度是误诊。
optionExplanations_en: The issue isn't too few params but sharing entangling representations; merging into one net entangles more, wrong direction.
Correct — it walks the chain shared+easy-negatives → collapsed discrimination → recall drop → separate params + hard negatives, the standard diagnosis.
Tuning the learning rate can't fix structural entanglement and the information gap from easy negatives.
The recall crash traces to param sharing + random negatives; blaming ANN precision is a misdiagnosis.

termDefinitions.term: embedding space collapse / 向量空间坍缩
termDefinitions.meaning: embedding 区分度退化、样本挤成一团,导致近邻检索召回骤降。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding space collapse is when vectors lose discrimination and cluster together, crashing nearest-neighbor recall.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 训练两塔时在「随机负样本」和「难负样本(hard negatives)」之间配比。
scenario_en: Balancing random negatives and hard negatives when training a two-tower.
q: 随机负样本与难负样本在训练信号上有何区别？
q_en: How do random vs hard negatives differ as training signal?
why: 随机负样本大多明显无关,信号弱,只教模型区分「远处的东西」;难负样本是相似但不相关的物品,逼模型学出细粒度边界,信号强但挖掘有成本、过难还可能训不稳。实践常两者混合:随机负给覆盖,难负给区分度。
why_en: Random negatives are mostly obviously irrelevant and weak signal, while hard negatives are similar-but-irrelevant and force a fine boundary, at higher mining cost.
tradeoff: 随机负样本(便宜、覆盖广、信号弱) vs 难负样本(信号强、区分度高、挖掘贵且可能训不稳)
options: 随机负样本信号更强,因为它覆盖面广,难负样本反而没什么用
随机负样本信号弱只分明显无关,难负样本逼出细边界但挖掘贵
两者提供的训练信号完全一样,唯一区别在于难负样本的采样过程更快一些
难负样本是指和用户强相关的正确物品,应该当正样本用
options_en: Random negatives give stronger signal via broad coverage; hard negatives are useless.
Random negatives are weak signal separating only the obvious, while hard negatives force a fine boundary at higher mining cost.
The training signal is identical; the only difference is that hard negatives sample somewhat faster.
Hard negatives are strongly-relevant correct items for the user and should be used as positives.
optionExplanations: 覆盖广不等于信号强;随机负太易,难负才提供区分细边界的强信号。
对;随机负弱信号、难负强信号但挖掘贵,这条对比决定了两者的配比策略。
两者信号不同:随机负弱、难负强,不是只差训练速度。
难负是相似但不相关的负例,不是正确物品,当正样本会污染标签。
optionExplanations_en: Broad coverage isn't strong signal; random negatives are too easy, hard negatives give the strong fine-boundary signal.
Correct — random weak, hard strong but costly to mine; this contrast sets the mixing strategy.
Their signal differs: random weak, hard strong, not merely a training-speed gap.
Hard negatives are similar-but-irrelevant negatives, not correct items; using them as positives corrupts labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 与用户相似但实际不相关的物品,作负例逼模型学细粒度相关性边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hard negative is an item similar to the user yet actually irrelevant, forcing a fine relevance boundary.

category: Neural Architectures For Ranking And Retrieval

scenario: 面试官给一个非结构化输入(文本/图片)的系统，问你怎么选神经网络架构，别只报模型名。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a system with unstructured input (text/image) and asks how you pick a neural architecture, not just name models.
q: 选架构该按什么顺序推理？
q_en: In what order should you reason to pick an architecture?
why: 先看输入模态(文本/图片/多模态)缩小家族，再看任务类型(检索用 embedding 还是逐词生成)定形态，最后用服务约束(延迟/吞吐/端上还是服务器 GPU)拍板。三步顺序保证你是被约束推着选，而不是凭偏好报模型名。
why_en: Go input modality, then task type, then serving constraint, so the requirements drive the choice instead of naming a favorite model.
diagram:
flowchart TD A["1. 输入模态
文本/图片/多模态"] --> B["2. 任务类型
检索 embedding vs 逐词生成"] B --> C["3. 服务约束
延迟/吞吐/端上 or 服务器 GPU"] C --> D["落地到具体架构"]
options: 先按团队最熟的模型选，再倒推它能不能满足延迟，能就用、不能再换一个
先看输入模态缩小家族，再看任务类型定形态，最后用服务约束(延迟/吞吐/端上)拍板
先定训练用什么 GPU 集群和框架，架构等训练管线搭好了再套一个进去
先挑准确率榜单第一名的模型，不看延迟预算和内存占用，上线跑不动或超时才回头优化
options_en: Pick the model the team knows best, then check if it meets latency; if not, swap for another.
Narrow the family by input modality, fix the form by task type, then decide with serving constraints (latency/throughput/edge).
First choose the training GPU cluster and framework, then fit an architecture into the pipeline once it is built.
Pick whatever tops the accuracy leaderboard, ignoring the latency budget and memory footprint, and only fix it after launch when it can't keep up or times out.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务和延迟预算都还没定死(纯研究探索期)，可以先拿熟悉的 baseline 跑通再谈选型。
optionExplanations: 凭熟悉度选是把结论前置，很可能选中一个模态或延迟根本不匹配的模型，绕一大圈才发现。
对；模态先砍掉不相关家族、任务定 encoder/decoder 形态、服务约束做最终裁决，是被需求推着走。
GPU 和框架是实现细节，先定它等于先造车间再想造什么车，架构反而受工具牵制。
榜单第一往往参数多、延迟高，忽略服务约束选它，上线才发现端上或实时路径扛不住。
optionExplanations_en: Choosing by familiarity puts the conclusion first and often lands on a model whose modality or latency simply doesn't fit.
Correct — modality cuts irrelevant families, task fixes the encoder/decoder form, and serving constraints make the final call.
GPUs and frameworks are implementation details; fixing them first lets tooling dictate the architecture.
The leaderboard leader is usually param-heavy and high-latency, so ignoring serving constraints breaks edge or real-time paths.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入数据的类型：纯文本、纯图片还是文本+图片的多模态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Input modality is the kind of data fed in: text only, image only, or multimodal text-plus-image.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上线后的运行限制：延迟预算、吞吐、跑在端上还是服务器 GPU。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A serving constraint is a runtime limit such as latency budget, throughput, and whether it runs on-device or on a server GPU.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 把输入序列长度从 512 翻到 1024 后，transformer 的注意力计算成本暴涨。
scenario_en: Doubling the transformer input sequence from 512 to 1024 makes attention compute blow up.
q: 自注意力对序列长度的复杂度是多少，翻倍长度会怎样？
q_en: What is self-attention's complexity in sequence length, and what happens when you double it?
why: 自注意力要算每个 token 对其他所有 token 的相关性，是 O(n²)：序列长度翻倍，计算和显存约变 4 倍。所以它直接约束你能设多长的最大输入、怎么组 batch、要多少 GPU 显存。
why_en: Self-attention is O(n squared) because every token attends to every other, so doubling the sequence roughly quadruples compute and memory, capping max input length and batching.
options: O(n)，长度翻倍成本也只翻倍，最大输入长度基本不受注意力限制
O(n log n)，长度翻倍成本增加一倍多，显存压力基本可以忽略
O(n²)，长度翻倍成本约变 4 倍，卡住最大输入长度与显存
O(1)，注意力成本与序列长度无关，只由模型参数量和层数决定
options_en: O(n): doubling the length only doubles cost, so attention barely limits max input length.
O(n log n): doubling the length raises cost a bit over 2x, and memory pressure is negligible.
O(n squared): doubling the length roughly quadruples cost, capping max input length and memory.
O(1): attention cost is independent of sequence length, set only by parameter count and depth.
optionExplanations: 低估了：注意力是全对全比较，不是线性扫一遍，长序列的显存爆炸正来自平方项。
n log n 是排序类复杂度，注意力没有分治结构，实际是每对 token 都要算一次。
对；平方复杂度是 transformer 长文本受限的根因，长序列要么截断要么上稀疏/线性注意力变体。
参数量决定的是单步算力，序列长度通过 O(n²) 的注意力矩阵独立地放大成本。
optionExplanations_en: Underestimate: attention is all-pairs, not a linear scan, and the memory blowup on long sequences comes from the squared term.
n log n is sorting-style complexity; attention has no divide-and-conquer, so every token pair is computed once.
Correct — quadratic cost is why transformers struggle with long text, forcing truncation or sparse/linear-attention variants.
Parameter count sets per-step compute; sequence length independently scales cost through the O(n squared) attention matrix.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让序列里每个 token 关注其他所有 token 并加权聚合的机制，是 transformer 的核心。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Self-attention lets every token in a sequence attend to and weight all others, the core of a transformer.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 搜索系统要做查询意图分类，延迟预算 <5ms，QPS 很高，query 短。
scenario_en: A search system classifies query intent under a sub-5ms latency budget, high QPS, with short queries.
q: 该选哪种 transformer 形态？
q_en: Which transformer form should you pick?
why: 选 encoder-only(BERT)+蒸馏：双向编码一次前向出表示，短 query 蒸馏后 <10ms，还能离线预算 embedding。decoder 逐词生成塞不进 5ms。
why_en: Pick encoder-only BERT with distillation because bidirectional embeddings are precomputable and fast for short classification, whereas a decoder generates token by token and is the wrong form.
options: decoder-only(GPT)，用自然语言逐词生成意图标签更灵活，新增意图类别时改改 prompt 就行，不用重训分类头
encoder-decoder(T5)，把意图分类当 seq2seq 翻译任务来做，通用性最好
encoder-only(BERT)+蒸馏，双向 embedding 可离线预算+缓存，短序列 <10ms
直接上最大的通用 LLM，用 few-shot prompt 分类，省掉训练分类头的工作
options_en: Decoder-only (GPT): generate the intent label as natural-language text token by token — adding a new intent just means tweaking the prompt, no retrained head needed.
Encoder-decoder (T5): treat intent classification as a seq2seq translation task for generality.
Encoder-only (BERT) with distillation: bidirectional embeddings are precomputable and cacheable, sub-10ms on short input.
Just use the largest general LLM with few-shot prompting to classify, skipping a trained head.
whenOtherWins: 如果意图是开放式、无法枚举成固定标签集(要生成自然语言解释)，那才需要 decoder-only 的生成能力。
optionExplanations: 逐词生成引入 autoregressive 延迟，对固定标签的分类是杀鸡用牛刀，5ms 预算下扛不住。
seq2seq 同时背上编码+自回归解码两份成本，分类这种单标签任务用它纯属浪费。
对；BERT 双向表示天生适合分类，蒸馏压小后满足 5ms，embedding 还能预算缓存进特征库。
大 LLM 单次推理就几十上百毫秒，QPS 高时成本和延迟都爆，分类任务不需要这么重。
optionExplanations_en: Token-by-token generation adds autoregressive latency; it's overkill for fixed-label classification and won't fit 5ms.
Seq2seq carries both encode and autoregressive-decode costs, wasteful for a single-label classification task.
Correct — BERT's bidirectional representation suits classification, distillation fits 5ms, and embeddings can be precomputed into a feature store.
A large LLM costs tens to hundreds of ms per call, blowing latency and cost at high QPS for a task that doesn't need it.

termDefinitions.meaning: encoder-only 模型，双向编码文本，擅长分类、语义相似、检索的 embedding。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) is an encoder-only model whose bidirectional embeddings suit classification and retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用小学生模型模仿大教师模型，压小参数换更快推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a small student to mimic a large teacher, shrinking the model for faster inference.

tradeoff: 推理延迟 vs 任务通用性：encoder-only 蒸馏拿到 5ms 内的分类延迟，代价是丢掉生成能力和跨任务复用。
category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 面试官要你区分三种 transformer 形态在服务(serving)侧的关键差异。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to distinguish the three transformer forms by their key serving-side property.
q: encoder-only / decoder-only / encoder-decoder 各自的服务特性是什么？
q_en: What is each of encoder-only / decoder-only / encoder-decoder's serving property?
why: encoder-only 的 embedding 可离线预算+缓存,推理挪出实时路径;decoder-only 逐词生成,受显存带宽瓶颈;encoder-decoder 两份成本叠加(编码+自回归解码)。形态决定成本结构,不是准确率高低。
why_en: Encoder-only embeddings are precomputable, decoder-only is memory-bandwidth-bound autoregressive generation, and encoder-decoder stacks both costs.

rows: 逐词生成,显存带宽瓶颈
编码+自回归解码双份成本

options: 三种形态的服务成本基本一致,选哪个只看训练时的准确率高低,部署延迟、显存占用和批处理效率都不构成区分维度
encoder-only 可预算 embedding;decoder-only 生成受带宽限;encoder-decoder 双份成本
encoder-only 最慢因为双向编码要跑两遍前向,decoder-only 最快因为只单向自回归,encoder-decoder 居中
decoder-only 的 embedding 可离线缓存,encoder-only 必须实时逐词生成,两者角色刚好相反
options_en: All three cost about the same to serve; pick by training accuracy, since latency, memory, and batching efficiency do not separate them.
Encoder-only precomputes embeddings; decoder-only is memory-bandwidth-bound while generating; encoder-decoder pays both.
Encoder-only is slowest because bidirectional encoding runs two forward passes, decoder-only fastest because it's one-directional autoregression, encoder-decoder in between.
Decoder-only embeddings cache offline while encoder-only must generate token by token in real time — the roles are swapped.
optionExplanations: 服务成本差异巨大:预算 embedding 与逐词生成完全不同量级,忽略它会选错部署方案。
对;形态直接决定成本结构——预算缓存、显存带宽、还是两者叠加,这才是服务侧要说清的差异。
双向不等于跑两遍,encoder 一次前向就出全序列表示;真正慢的是 decoder 的逐词自回归。
角色说反了:能预算缓存 embedding 的是 encoder-only,逐词生成的是 decoder-only。
optionExplanations_en: Serving costs differ hugely: precomputed embeddings versus token-by-token generation are different orders of magnitude.
Correct — the form dictates the cost structure: precompute-and-cache, memory-bandwidth-bound, or both stacked.
Bidirectional isn't two passes; the encoder produces the full-sequence representation in one forward pass — the decoder's autoregression is the slow part.
The roles are reversed: encoder-only is the one that precomputes embeddings, and decoder-only does token-by-token generation.

termDefinitions.meaning: decoder-only 模型,自回归地一次生成一个 token。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) is a decoder-only model that autoregressively generates one token at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: encoder-decoder 模型,把各种 NLP 任务统一成文本到文本的 seq2seq。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) is an encoder-decoder model casting NLP tasks as text-to-text seq2seq.

termDefinitions.term: memory-bandwidth bottleneck / 显存带宽瓶颈
termDefinitions.meaning: 生成时反复从显存搬运权重,速度受带宽而非算力限制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A memory-bandwidth bottleneck is when generation is limited by moving weights from memory, not by compute.

tradeoff: 服务成本结构 vs 任务通用性：encoder-only 可缓存最便宜但只做理解，encoder-decoder 最通用但成本翻倍。
category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 线上部署一个 GPT 类生成模型,发现模型越大吞吐掉得越狠,GPU 算力却没跑满。
scenario_en: Serving a GPT-style generator, throughput drops sharply as the model grows while GPU compute sits underused.
q: decoder-only 生成的主要服务失败模式是什么,怎么缓解?
q_en: What is the main serving failure mode of decoder-only generation, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 瓶颈在显存带宽:自回归每步都要把全部权重从显存搬到计算单元,模型增大的速度快过带宽增长,所以算力空转、带宽先到顶。缓解靠量化/蒸馏减小权重体积、KV cache 复用、批处理摊薄搬运成本。
why_en: Decoder generation is memory-bandwidth-bound because each step reloads all weights, so growing the model outpaces bandwidth; mitigate with quantization, KV cache, and batching.
options: 瓶颈是显存带宽:每步搬全部权重,模型增速快过带宽;靠量化/蒸馏/KV cache/批处理缓解
瓶颈是网络 I/O:生成慢因为每个 token 都要往数据库写一次,加缓存即可解决
瓶颈是 CPU 单线程:decoder 逐层计算无法并行,换更多 CPU 核心就能线性提升吞吐
瓶颈是磁盘读取:模型每步从磁盘加载权重,换 SSD 就能消除延迟
options_en: It's memory bandwidth: each step moves all weights and the model outgrows bandwidth; mitigate with quantization/distillation/KV cache/batching.
It's network I/O: generation is slow because each token writes to a database, so adding a cache fixes it.
It's single-threaded CPU: the decoder's layer-by-layer compute can't parallelize, so more CPU cores scale throughput linearly.
It's disk reads: the model loads weights from disk each step, so switching to SSD removes the latency.
optionExplanations: 对;自回归的成本主要是权重搬运,不是算力,所以要压权重体积(量化/蒸馏)、复用 KV、批处理摊销。
生成慢与写数据库无关,token 是在 GPU 上算出来的,瓶颈在显存到计算单元的带宽。
推理跑在 GPU 上,不是 CPU 单线程问题;加 CPU 核心解决不了显存带宽限制。
权重推理时已在显存里,不是每步读磁盘;SSD 改善不了显存带宽这个真正的瓶颈。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — autoregressive cost is dominated by weight movement, so shrink weights (quantize/distill), reuse KV cache, and batch.
Slow generation isn't about database writes; tokens are computed on the GPU, and the bottleneck is memory-to-compute bandwidth.
Inference runs on the GPU, not single-threaded CPU; adding CPU cores can't relieve a memory-bandwidth limit.
Weights sit in GPU memory at inference, not read from disk each step; an SSD doesn't touch the real memory-bandwidth bottleneck.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存已生成 token 的注意力键值,避免每步重算历史,是生成加速的关键。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A KV (Key-Value) cache stores attention keys/values of past tokens so generation doesn't recompute history each step.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次生成一个 token,把已生成的接回输入再预测下一个。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Autoregressive generation emits one token at a time, feeding what's produced back in to predict the next.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 快速回忆三种 transformer 形态对应的代表模型和主用途。
scenario_en: Quickly recall the three transformer forms with their representative model and main use.
q: 补全三种 transformer 形态的代表与用途:
q_en: Fill in each transformer form's representative model and use:
text: 分类/embedding/检索用 {{encoder-only}}(BERT);逐词生成用 {{decoder-only}}(GPT);摘要/翻译等 seq2seq 用 {{encoder-decoder}}(T5)。
text_en: Classification/embedding/retrieval uses {{encoder-only}} (BERT); token-by-token generation uses {{decoder-only}} (GPT); summarization/translation seq2seq uses {{encoder-decoder}} (T5).
why: 记忆钩子:任务性质决定形态——要理解就 encoder,要生成就 decoder,要输入输出都是序列就 encoder-decoder。形态一定,服务成本结构随之确定。
why_en: Task shape fixes the form: understand with an encoder, generate with a decoder, sequence-to-sequence with encoder-decoder.
category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 面试里要给 NLP 架构标注量级锚点:BERT 短序列蒸馏后 <10ms,GPT 家族生成约 30–50 tokens/秒。
scenario_en: You annotate NLP latency anchors: distilled BERT under 10ms on short input, GPT-family generation about 30-50 tokens/sec.
q: 这两个延迟锚点对设计意味着什么?
q_en: What do these two latency anchors imply for design?
why: 这两个是经验量级(依模型/硬件而变),不是公式:BERT<10ms 说明分类/检索可放实时路径甚至预算缓存;GPT 30–50 tok/s 说明生成 200 token 要几秒,长输出必须靠流式返回、限长或加大批处理来遮蔽延迟。
why_en: These are empirical anchors: sub-10ms BERT can sit on the real-time path, while 30-50 tokens/sec means long generations take seconds and need streaming or length caps.
options: BERT<10ms 说明它比 GPT 更准,GPT 慢是因为准确率更低,所以永远优先选 BERT
两个数都是硬性 SLA,任何模型、任何硬件上都必须精确达到,达不到就是架构选错了
BERT<10ms 可放实时路径;GPT 30–50 tok/s 长输出要几秒,得靠流式/限长遮蔽
GPT 30–50 tok/s 说明它比 BERT 快很多,长文本生成可以放进 5ms 的实时预算里
options_en: Sub-10ms BERT means it's more accurate; GPT is slow because it's less accurate, so always prefer BERT.
Both numbers are hard SLAs that any model on any hardware must hit exactly, or the architecture is wrong.
Sub-10ms BERT fits the real-time path; 30-50 tokens/sec means long outputs take seconds, so you stream or cap length.
GPT at 30-50 tokens/sec is much faster than BERT, so long-text generation fits inside a 5ms real-time budget.
optionExplanations: 延迟不代表准确率;两者形态不同、任务不同,不能拿速度当质量的证据。
这是随模型和硬件浮动的经验锚点,不是必须精确命中的合同 SLA。
对;把速度锚点翻译成设计动作——快的放实时、慢的靠流式和限长遮蔽,才是有信号的答法。
算反了:30–50 tok/s 是慢的一侧,生成几十个 token 就要上秒,塞不进 5ms。
optionExplanations_en: Latency isn't accuracy; different forms and tasks mean you can't use speed as evidence of quality.
These are empirical anchors that float with model and hardware, not contract SLAs to hit exactly.
Correct — translating speed anchors into design moves (fast on real-time, slow behind streaming/caps) is the high-signal answer.
Backwards: 30-50 tokens/sec is the slow side; generating dozens of tokens takes over a second, not 5ms.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生成模型每秒吐出的 token 数,衡量自回归解码速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tokens per second is how many tokens a generator emits each second, measuring autoregressive decode speed.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 语义相似/检索系统用 BERT 出 embedding,担心每次查询都实时跑 BERT 会拖垮延迟。
scenario_en: A semantic-similarity/retrieval system uses BERT embeddings and worries that running BERT per query wrecks latency.
q: encoder-only 的哪个服务特性能把推理挪出实时路径?
q_en: Which encoder-only serving property moves inference off the real-time path?
why: BERT 的 embedding 对固定文档是稳定的,可以离线批量算好、缓存进特征库或 ANN 索引;线上只做向量查表/近邻检索,BERT 前向不在关键路径上。代价是新增/变更文档要重算并回填 embedding。
why_en: BERT embeddings for fixed items are stable, so precompute them offline into a feature store or ANN index and only look up at serving, keeping the forward pass off the hot path.
options: 把 BERT 换成参数更多的模型,准确率上去以后就不必再实时推理了
embedding 离线批量预算+缓存进特征库/ANN,线上只查表
给每个查询开一个新的 GPU 实例实时跑 BERT,靠水平扩容硬扛住延迟
把 BERT 下发到客户端浏览器里跑,服务器完全不参与 embedding 计算
options_en: Swap BERT for a model with more parameters; once accuracy is up you no longer need real-time inference.
Precompute embeddings offline into a feature store or ANN index and only look them up at serving time.
Spin up a fresh GPU instance per query to run BERT live, brute-forcing the latency with horizontal scaling.
Ship BERT down to the client browser so the server never computes any embedding at all.
optionExplanations: 换大模型只会更慢,和把推理挪出实时路径没关系,方向反了。
对;对固定文档 embedding 可复用,离线算好当特征查表,是把推理搬离关键路径的标准手法。
每查一次就实时跑 BERT 正是要避免的,水平扩容只是烧钱不改成本结构。
端上跑重模型受设备算力限制,且无法共享缓存,不是这里的服务特性。
optionExplanations_en: A bigger model is only slower and has nothing to do with moving inference off the hot path — wrong direction.
Correct — embeddings for fixed items are reusable, so precomputing them as lookup features is the standard way to leave the hot path.
Running BERT live per query is exactly what to avoid; horizontal scaling just burns money without changing the cost structure.
Running a heavy model on-device is capped by device compute and can't share a cache — not the serving property here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 离线算好、供线上低延迟查表的特征存储系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store holds precomputed features for low-latency online lookup.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索,在向量库里快速找相似向量,牺牲一点精度换速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) search quickly finds similar vectors, trading a little accuracy for speed.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 面试官让你在准确率-延迟-参数量三角上区分 CNN、ResNet、ViT。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to place CNN, ResNet, and ViT on the accuracy-latency-parameter triangle.
q: 三种视觉架构在三角上各占什么位置?
q_en: Where does each vision architecture sit on the triangle?
why: CNN(MobileNet)省参最快、适合端上但准确率有天花板;ResNet 靠残差做深、准确率-延迟平衡;ViT 大数据下 SOTA,代价是参数算力和预训练数据都最多。
why_en: CNNs are param-light and fastest for edge with an accuracy ceiling, ResNet balances accuracy and latency as the server backbone, and ViT is SOTA on big data but heaviest and needs large pretraining.
options: 三者在准确率、延迟、参数量上都差不多,选哪个只看团队熟悉度和框架支持
ViT 参数最少、速度最快适合端上,MobileNet 参数最多、适合服务器端追高准确率
CNN 省参最快适合端上;ResNet 平衡做服务器骨干;ViT 大数据 SOTA 但最重
ResNet 参数最多但准确率最低,CNN 参数最少却准确率最高,ViT 在两者之间居中
options_en: All three are similar on accuracy, latency, and params, so pick by team familiarity and framework support.
ViT has the fewest params and is fastest for edge, while MobileNet is the biggest and suits high-accuracy servers.
CNNs are param-light and fastest for edge, ResNet balances as the server backbone, ViT is SOTA on big data but heaviest.
ResNet has the most params but the lowest accuracy, CNN the fewest params yet the highest accuracy, ViT sits in between.
optionExplanations: 三者差异恰恰在这三个维度上,说都差不多等于放弃了选型依据。
位置全反了:MobileNet 才是省参端上的,ViT 是参数最多的服务器侧模型。
对;三角三个角各有定位——端上省参、服务器平衡、大数据高准确率,选型就是在这上面权衡。
关系搞反了:CNN 参数最少但准确率有天花板,ViT 参数最多、准确率最高。
optionExplanations_en: The differences are exactly along those three axes; calling them similar throws away the basis for choosing.
The positions are reversed: MobileNet is the param-light edge model and ViT is the param-heaviest server model.
Correct — each corner has a niche: param-light edge, balanced server, big-data accuracy, and selection weighs among them.
The relationship is inverted: CNNs have the fewest params but an accuracy ceiling, while ViT has the most params and highest accuracy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用卷积层利用图像空间局部性,参数高效,MobileNet/EfficientNet 属此类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) uses convolution to exploit spatial locality, parameter-efficient; MobileNet/EfficientNet belong here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用残差(跳跃)连接让网络加深到 50–152 层而不梯度消失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ResNet (Residual Network) uses residual skip connections to train 50-152 layers without vanishing gradients.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把图片切成固定块当 token,用自注意力处理,大数据上准确率 SOTA。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ViT (Vision Transformer) splits an image into fixed patches as tokens and applies self-attention, SOTA on large data.

tradeoff: 准确率上限 vs 延迟/参数量：CNN 省算力但撞天花板，ViT 换来准确率却要付算力和预训练数据。
category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 手机 App 要在设备上做实时图像分类,延迟预算 <5ms,不能依赖服务器 GPU。
scenario_en: A mobile app needs on-device real-time image classification under a 5ms budget with no server GPU.
q: 该选哪种视觉架构?
q_en: Which vision architecture fits?
why: 选 MobileNet/EfficientNet:卷积利用空间局部性、参数少、专为端上 <5ms 预算设计,直接跑在手机 NPU/CPU 上。ViT 参数上百 M、延迟几十毫秒,端上装不下也跑不动;ResNet 更适合服务器侧。
why_en: Pick MobileNet/EfficientNet: param-light convolutions built for a sub-5ms on-device budget, whereas ViT's hundreds of millions of params won't fit or run on a phone.
options: ViT-Large,准确率最高,端上用户体验自然也是三者里最好的
ResNet-152,深层残差网络放在端上一样能保证很高的准确率
先在服务器跑大模型,再把结果推回手机,反正设备本来就一直联网,网络往返延迟可以忽略不计
MobileNet/EfficientNet,参数省,跑在手机 NPU 上
options_en: ViT-Large — the highest accuracy, so the on-device user experience is naturally the best of the three.
ResNet-152 — a deep residual network that still guarantees very high accuracy when it runs on-device.
Run the big model on the server and push results back to the phone — the device is always online anyway, so the round-trip latency is negligible.
MobileNet/EfficientNet — param-light and running on the phone NPU.
whenOtherWins: 如果设备端能稳定联网、延迟预算宽松、且准确率是硬指标,把重模型放服务器返回结果才更划算。
optionExplanations: ViT-Large 上百 M 参数、几十毫秒延迟,手机既装不下也跑不进 5ms。
ResNet-152 太深太重,端上延迟远超 5ms,是服务器批量场景才用的。
题目要求端上实时,依赖网络往返会引入不可控延迟且离线不可用,不符合约束。
对;它的深度可分离卷积把每层乘加量降一个量级,才装得进手机 NPU 的算力和 5ms 预算。
optionExplanations_en: ViT-Large's hundreds of millions of params and tens of ms won't fit on a phone or hit 5ms.
ResNet-152 is too deep and heavy; on-device latency far exceeds 5ms, and it's for server batch use.
The task demands on-device real-time; a network round-trip adds uncontrolled latency and breaks offline, violating the constraint.
Correct — its depthwise-separable convolutions cut per-layer multiply-adds by an order of magnitude, which is what fits the phone NPU and the 5ms budget.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为移动/边缘设计的高效 CNN,参数少、延迟低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MobileNet/EfficientNet are efficient CNNs designed for mobile/edge with few params and low latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 手机上专门加速神经网络推理的处理单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An NPU (Neural Processing Unit) is on-device hardware that accelerates neural-network inference.

tradeoff: 端上延迟/内存 vs 模型准确率上限：MobileNet 换来 5ms 内可跑，代价是复杂任务的准确率天花板。
category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 服务器端图像任务准确率优先,但只有几万张有标注图片,预训练数据也有限。
scenario_en: A server-side image task prioritizes accuracy but has only tens of thousands of labeled images and limited pretraining data.
q: 该上 ViT 还是 ResNet?
q_en: Should you use ViT or ResNet here?
why: 选 ResNet + 迁移学习:ViT 缺少卷积的空间归纳偏置,必须靠大规模预训练数据才能超过 ResNet;标注数据有限时 ViT 容易欠拟合。ResNet 残差骨干在中小数据上更稳,准确率-延迟也平衡。
why_en: Pick ResNet with transfer learning: ViT lacks convolution's spatial inductive bias and needs large-scale pretraining to beat ResNet, so on limited data ResNet is more reliable.
options: ViT-Large,参数最多、自注意力表达力最强,所以在任何数据量下都比 ResNet 准
ResNet + 迁移学习,数据有限时比缺归纳偏置的 ViT 更稳、更易达标
从零训练一个 ViT,虽然数据少但从头训能避免负迁移
MobileNet,反正准确率差不多还更快
options_en: ViT-Large — the most params and the strongest self-attention expressiveness, so it beats ResNet at any data size.
ResNet with transfer learning — on limited data it's more reliable than a ViT that lacks inductive bias.
Train a ViT from scratch — with little data, training fresh avoids negative transfer.
MobileNet — accuracy is about the same and it's faster anyway.
whenOtherWins: 当有大规模预训练数据(或可用现成大预训练 ViT 权重)且延迟预算允许时,ViT 的准确率上限更高,值得上。
optionExplanations: 参数多不等于小数据上更准;ViT 缺归纳偏置,没有大预训练反而更容易过拟合/欠拟合。
对;ResNet 的卷积归纳偏置让它在中小数据上样本效率更高,迁移学习进一步省数据。
从零训 ViT 更吃数据,几万张远不够,大概率跑不过用预训练的 ResNet。
题目准确率优先,MobileNet 有准确率天花板,牺牲的正是这里最看重的指标。
optionExplanations_en: More params doesn't mean more accurate on small data; without big pretraining, ViT tends to overfit/underfit.
Correct — ResNet's convolutional inductive bias gives better sample efficiency on limited data, and transfer learning saves more.
Training ViT from scratch is even more data-hungry; tens of thousands of images won't beat a pretrained ResNet.
The task prioritizes accuracy, but MobileNet's accuracy ceiling sacrifices exactly the metric that matters here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型结构自带的先验假设,如 CNN 假设图像有空间局部性,减少所需数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Inductive bias is a structural prior, like a CNN assuming spatial locality, which reduces the data needed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 拿在大数据上预训练好的模型作起点,在目标任务上微调,省数据省算力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transfer learning starts from a model pretrained on large data and fine-tunes it on the target task, saving data and compute.

tradeoff: 标注数据需求 vs 准确率上限：ResNet 的卷积归纳偏置省数据，ViT 要大规模预训练才换得到更高上限。
category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 面试官问 ResNet 到底靠什么能训到 50–152 层这么深。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what lets ResNet train as deep as 50-152 layers.
q: ResNet 的残差连接解决了什么问题?
q_en: What problem do ResNet's residual connections solve?
why: 残差(跳跃)连接让每层学的是相对上一层的增量 F(x)+x,梯度能沿捷径直接回传,绕开深层网络的梯度消失,从而能堆到 50–152 层。ResNet-50 因此成为两阶段系统常用的特征提取骨干。
why_en: Residual skip connections let each layer learn an increment F(x)+x so gradients flow through the shortcut, avoiding vanishing gradients and enabling 50-152 layers.
options: 把注意力引入卷积,使模型能关注图像最重要的区域
自动搜索最优网络结构,省去人工设计层数
残差跳跃连接让梯度走捷径回传,绕开深层梯度消失,能堆到 50–152 层
把图像切成 patch 当 token,用 transformer 处理长程依赖
options_en: Introduces attention into convolution so the model focuses on the most important image regions.
Automatically searches the optimal architecture, removing manual layer-count design.
Residual skip connections route gradients through a shortcut, avoiding deep vanishing gradients and enabling 50-152 layers.
Splits the image into patch tokens and uses a transformer for long-range dependencies.
optionExplanations: 那是注意力机制(GAT/ViT)的思路,不是 ResNet 残差连接解决的问题。
自动搜结构是 NAS 的事,ResNet 的层数是人工设计的残差堆叠。
对;残差连接的核心就是给梯度一条捷径,让极深网络仍可训练。
patch+transformer 是 ViT 的做法,ResNet 是纯卷积+残差,不切 patch。
optionExplanations_en: That's the attention idea (GAT/ViT), not what ResNet's residual connections solve.
Auto-searching architectures is NAS; ResNet's depth is hand-designed residual stacking.
Correct — residual connections give gradients a shortcut so very deep networks stay trainable.
Patch-plus-transformer is ViT; ResNet is pure convolution with residuals and doesn't patch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深层网络反向传播时梯度逐层缩小趋近于零,前面的层学不动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Vanishing gradients occur when backprop shrinks gradients toward zero through many layers, stalling early-layer learning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把某层输入直接加到其输出上(F(x)+x),给梯度一条捷径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A residual connection adds a layer's input to its output (F(x)+x), giving gradients a shortcut.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 在 V100、batch=1 下:ResNet-50 约 25.6M 参数/4.1ms/76% top-1,ViT-Base 约 86M/11.4ms/85.5%。
scenario_en: On V100 batch=1: ResNet-50 is ~25.6M params/4.1ms/76% top-1, ViT-Base ~86M/11.4ms/85.5%.
q: 这组数字对选型意味着什么?
q_en: What does this set of numbers imply for selection?
why: 这是基准量级(随硬件浮动):ViT 用约 3.3 倍参数、约 2.8 倍延迟换约 +9 点 top-1。只有准确率增益值这份延迟且有大预训练数据时才上 ViT。
why_en: These are benchmark anchors: ViT trades roughly 3x params and 2.8x latency for about +9 points top-1, so use it only when the accuracy gain is worth the latency and you have pretraining data.
options: ViT 参数是 ResNet 的 3 倍多、延迟约 2.8 倍,换 +9 点准确率
ViT 延迟更低所以更适合端上,ResNet 太重只能放在服务器机房里跑
两者准确率只差几个点可以忽略,永远选参数更少、延迟更低、部署更省显存的 ResNet-50
参数越多准确率越高是铁律,所以任何业务场景下都应该直接选 ViT-Base
options_en: ViT takes over 3x the params and about 2.8x the latency for roughly +9 points of accuracy.
ViT has lower latency so it suits the edge, while ResNet is too heavy and only runs in a server room.
They differ by only a few points, which is negligible, so always take the lighter, faster, more memory-efficient ResNet-50.
More parameters always means more accuracy, so any business scenario should just take ViT-Base.
optionExplanations: 对;把数字翻译成"多花的延迟/显存换来的准确率增量值不值",这才是选型该回答的问题。
读反了:ViT-Base 11.4ms 比 ResNet 的 4.1ms 更慢,不是更适合端上。
9 个点在很多任务上是巨大差距,不能一概忽略,要看任务对准确率的敏感度。
参数多不必然更准且成本更高;是否值得要结合延迟预算和数据量判断,不是铁律。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — translating the numbers into 'is the accuracy gain worth the extra latency/memory' is the real selection question.
Backwards: ViT-Base at 11.4ms is slower than ResNet's 4.1ms, not better for edge.
About 9 points is a huge gap on many tasks; you can't dismiss it without checking accuracy sensitivity.
More params isn't always more accurate and costs more; worth-it depends on latency budget and data, not a law.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型最高概率的那个类别正好是正确类的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-1 accuracy is the fraction of cases where the model's highest-probability class is the correct one.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 面试官问 ViT 是怎么把 transformer 用到图像上的,以及它对数据的要求。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how ViT applies a transformer to images and what data it needs.
q: ViT 的输入处理方式和数据前提是什么?
q_en: How does ViT process input, and what is its data prerequisite?
why: ViT 把图片切成固定大小的 patch,每个 patch 线性投影成一个 token,再送自注意力,像处理词序列一样处理图像块。它缺卷积的空间归纳偏置,所以要大规模预训练数据才能超过 ResNet。
why_en: ViT splits the image into fixed-size patches, projects each into a token, and runs self-attention, but lacking convolution's inductive bias it needs large-scale pretraining to beat ResNet.
options: ViT 用卷积核滑窗提特征,和 CNN 一样,只是堆叠层数更深,所以对预训练数据的要求反而更低
ViT 把图片切成固定 patch 当 token 做自注意力,缺归纳偏置需大预训练
ViT 逐像素自回归生成图像,训练数据越少反而越好训、越容易收敛
ViT 用残差连接堆到几百层,靠深度而非注意力取胜,完全不需要预训练
options_en: ViT extracts features with sliding convolution kernels like a CNN, just with deeper stacked layers, so it actually needs less pretraining data.
ViT splits the image into fixed patches used as tokens for self-attention, and lacking inductive bias it needs large-scale pretraining.
ViT generates the image autoregressively pixel by pixel, and the less training data the easier it converges.
ViT stacks hundreds of layers with residual connections, winning by depth rather than attention, needing no pretraining at all.
optionExplanations: ViT 不用卷积滑窗,正因为丢了卷积的归纳偏置,它反而更吃数据,不是更省。
对;patch→token→自注意力是 ViT 的核心,而它的代价就是对大规模预训练数据的依赖。
ViT 是判别式编码器不是逐像素生成器,而且数据越少越难训,不是越好。
残差堆深是 ResNet;ViT 靠自注意力,而且恰恰需要大规模预训练。
optionExplanations_en: ViT doesn't use sliding convolutions; dropping that inductive bias makes it more data-hungry, not less.
Correct — patch to token to self-attention is ViT's core, and its cost is the dependence on large-scale pretraining.
ViT is a discriminative encoder, not a pixel-by-pixel generator, and less data makes it harder, not easier.
Residual-stacked depth is ResNet; ViT relies on self-attention and specifically needs large-scale pretraining.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把图片切成的固定大小小方块,ViT 里每个 patch 投影成一个 token。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A patch is a fixed-size square the image is cut into; ViT projects each patch into a token.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 做两阶段目标检测,第一阶段要一个成熟、准确率-延迟平衡的特征提取骨干供后续检测头使用。
scenario_en: In two-stage object detection, stage one needs a mature, accuracy-latency-balanced feature-extraction backbone for the detection head.
q: 服务器端默认骨干选什么最稳妥?
q_en: What is the safest default server-side backbone?
why: 选 ResNet-50:约 25M 参数/4ms/76% top-1,准确率-延迟平衡、预训练权重生态成熟。MobileNet 上限不够,ViT 太重且吃预训练数据。
why_en: Pick ResNet-50: ~25M params, ~4ms, ~76% top-1, a balanced and mature feature-extraction backbone widely used in two-stage detection.
options: MobileNetV3,参数最省、延迟最低,拿来做两阶段检测骨干准确率也完全够用了
ViT-Large,准确率最高,当骨干后续检测头的效果自然最好
ResNet-50,约 25M/4ms/76%,准确率-延迟平衡且生态成熟
每次请求都从零训练一个小网络当骨干,保证贴合当前这批数据
options_en: MobileNetV3 — the smallest and fastest, plenty accurate to serve as a two-stage detection backbone.
ViT-Large — the highest accuracy, so the downstream detection head will naturally work best.
ResNet-50 — about 25M params, 4ms, 76% top-1, balanced on accuracy-latency with a mature ecosystem.
Train a fresh small network from scratch per request as the backbone so it fits the current batch of data.
whenOtherWins: 若目标平台是移动端、延迟极紧,骨干可换成 MobileNet/EfficientNet;若有大预训练数据且延迟宽松,可换 ViT 提准确率。
optionExplanations: MobileNet 准确率有天花板,做检测骨干时上限拉低整条管线的召回/精度。
ViT-Large 太重、吃预训练数据,做通用检测骨干成本和延迟都不划算。
对;ResNet-50 在准确率、延迟、生态成熟度上都平衡,是服务器骨干的安全默认。
每请求从零训练不现实,骨干要的是稳定可复用的预训练特征,不是即时训练。
optionExplanations_en: MobileNet's accuracy ceiling caps the whole pipeline's recall/precision when used as a detection backbone.
ViT-Large is heavy and pretraining-hungry, making it costly and slow as a general detection backbone.
Correct — ResNet-50 balances accuracy, latency, and ecosystem maturity, the safe default server backbone.
Training from scratch per request is impractical; a backbone needs stable reusable pretrained features, not on-the-fly training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统里负责把原始输入编码成特征、供下游头复用的基础网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A backbone is the base network that encodes raw input into features reused by downstream heads.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先提区域候选再对候选分类/回归的目标检测范式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-stage detection first proposes regions, then classifies/regresses those candidates.

tradeoff: 准确率上限 vs 延迟与数据成本：ResNet-50 取中间点，MobileNet 换延迟丢上限，ViT 换上限吃预训练数据。
category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: Pinterest 式视觉搜索:要用文字查图片、也支持以图搜图,还想做零样本分类,规模上亿。
scenario_en: Pinterest-style visual search: query images by text or by image, plus zero-shot classification, at hundreds of millions of items.
q: 跨模态检索/零样本该选哪个多模态架构?
q_en: For cross-modal retrieval / zero-shot, which multimodal architecture?
why: 选 CLIP:图文双编码器经对比学习对齐进同一空间,两侧 embedding 都能离线预算灌进 ANN,线上只做 cosine 近邻查表。Flamingo 拆不成可预算的双塔。
why_en: Pick CLIP: contrastively aligned image and text encoders let you precompute both embeddings into an ANN index and serve cosine lookups, matching two-tower retrieval infra.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  I["图片"] --> IE["图像编码器"] --> S["共享 embedding 空间"]
  T["文本"] --> TE["文本编码器"] --> S
  S --> A["ANN 索引 + cosine 查表"]
options: Flamingo,它能做联合推理,顺便也能做检索,一套架构就全包了
CLIP,双编码器对齐共享空间,embedding 可离线预算+ANN 查表
T5,把"找相似图"当成 seq2seq 生成任务,让模型直接吐出图片 id
给每一对(查询,图片)实时跑一个大模型算相似度,精度最高最准确
options_en: Flamingo — it does joint reasoning and can retrieve on the side, so one architecture covers everything.
CLIP — dual encoders aligned in a shared space, embeddings precomputable into ANN lookups.
T5 — treat "find a similar image" as a seq2seq generation task and have the model emit image ids.
Run a big model live on every (query, image) pair to score similarity, which is the most precise option.
whenOtherWins: 当任务不是检索而是需要对图文联合推理(看图回答问题、生成描述)时,才该上 Flamingo 而非 CLIP。
optionExplanations: Flamingo 每次请求都要跑完整管线、无法预算双塔,拿它做上亿规模检索延迟和成本都不合适。
对;CLIP 的对比对齐让两模态可比,embedding 离线算好走 ANN,正好复用已有的双塔检索基建。
T5 是文本 seq2seq,不产出可检索的跨模态向量,套不到以图搜图上。
对每对实时跑大模型是 O(N) 全量打分,上亿规模根本跑不动,ANN 查表才是正解。
optionExplanations_en: Flamingo runs the full pipeline per request with no precomputable towers, wrong on latency and cost at hundreds of millions.
Correct — CLIP's contrastive alignment makes the modalities comparable, embeddings precompute into ANN, reusing two-tower retrieval infra.
T5 is text seq2seq and doesn't produce searchable cross-modal vectors, so it can't do image-to-image search.
Scoring every pair live is O(N) full scan, impossible at hundreds of millions; ANN lookup is the answer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用对比学习把图像编码器和文本编码器对齐到同一 embedding 空间的多模态模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining) aligns an image encoder and a text encoder into one shared embedding space via contrastive learning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 查询塔和物品塔各自编码成向量,靠向量近邻检索匹配的架构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-tower retrieval encodes query and item with separate towers and matches by vector nearest-neighbor search.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 面试官问 CLIP 为什么能做零样本分类,不用为新类别微调。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks why CLIP can do zero-shot classification without fine-tuning for new classes.
q: CLIP 靠什么实现零样本分类?
q_en: How does CLIP achieve zero-shot classification?
why: 对比学习把配对的图文拉近、不配对的推远,使图像和文本落进同一 embedding 空间且可比。分类时把待测图片 embedding 和各个类别文字描述的 embedding 算 cosine 相似度,取最高者,无需为新类别微调。
why_en: Contrastive training puts images and text in one comparable space, so zero-shot classification just compares an image embedding against text-label embeddings by cosine similarity.
options: 它为每个可能的类别都预训练了一个专门的分类头,推理时挑激活值最高的那个
它把图片和各类别描述的 embedding 算 cosine 取最高
它像 GPT 一样逐词生成类别的名称,直接把生成出来的文本标签当作分类结果
它靠海量人工标注覆盖了所有可能类别,本质上是有监督分类而不是零样本
options_en: It pretrains a dedicated classification head for every possible class and picks whichever head activates highest.
It scores cosine similarity between the image embedding and each class-description embedding and takes the max.
It generates the class name token by token like GPT and uses the emitted text label as the classification result.
It relies on massive human labeling covering every possible class, so it is supervised classification, not zero-shot.
optionExplanations: CLIP 没有固定类别的分类头,加新类别不需要新头,这正是它零样本的原因。
对;共享空间让图文向量可比,新类别只要写一句文字描述编码成向量即可参与比较。
生成类别名是 decoder 的活,CLIP 是双编码器做 embedding 比对,不生成文本。
零样本恰恰不需要为目标类别标注,靠的是预训练学到的通用图文对齐。
optionExplanations_en: CLIP has no fixed-class head; adding a class needs no new head, which is exactly why it's zero-shot.
Correct — the shared space makes image and text vectors comparable, so a new class just needs a text description encoded into a vector.
Generating class names is a decoder's job; CLIP is dual encoders comparing embeddings, not generating text.
Zero-shot specifically needs no labels for the target classes, relying on general image-text alignment learned in pretraining.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时拉近正样本对、推远负样本对,让配对的图文在向量空间靠近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contrastive learning pulls matched pairs together and pushes mismatched pairs apart in vector space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不为目标类别提供训练样本,直接用文字描述即可分类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zero-shot classification labels new classes from text descriptions without any training examples for them.

category: Neural Architectures For Nlp And Vision

scenario: 要做看图回答问题(VQA)和图片描述,需要图文的联合推理而不仅是检索。
scenario_en: You need visual question answering and captioning, requiring joint image-text reasoning, not just retrieval.
q: Flamingo 是怎么把视觉信息接进 LLM 的?
q_en: How does Flamingo feed visual information into an LLM?
why: 冻结的视觉编码器出特征,Perceiver Resampler 把变长视觉 token 压成定长,再经门控交叉注意力注入冻结的 LLM。代价:整条管线每请求要顺序跑完。
why_en: A frozen vision encoder feeds a Perceiver Resampler that compresses visual tokens to a fixed count, injected into a frozen LLM via gated cross-attention layers.
diagram:
flowchart LR V["冻结视觉编码器"] --> P["Perceiver Resampler
压成固定数量视觉 token"] P --> G["门控交叉注意力"] L["冻结 LLM 块"] --> G G --> O["文本输出"]
options: 把图片切成 patch 直接当文本 token 拼进 prompt 里,让 LLM 自己去消化对齐
冻结视觉编码器→Resampler 压成定长视觉 token→门控交叉注意力注入 LLM
重新端到端训练整个 LLM,让它学会看图,视觉和语言部分都不冻结
先用 CLIP 把图片转成一句文字描述,再把这句描述喂给纯文本 LLM 回答
options_en: Slice the image into patches, drop them straight into the prompt as text tokens, and let the LLM align them itself.
Frozen vision encoder, then a Resampler compressing to fixed-length visual tokens, then gated cross-attention into the LLM.
Retrain the entire LLM end to end so it learns to see, freezing neither the vision side nor the language side.
Use CLIP to turn the image into a text caption first, then feed that caption to a text-only LLM to answer.
optionExplanations: 直接拼 patch 当文本 token 无法对齐两种模态,也不是 Flamingo 的机制。
对;Resampler 定长压缩+门控交叉注意力注入,是 Flamingo 让冻结 LLM 获得视觉能力的核心。
Flamingo 特意冻结视觉编码器和 LLM,只训练桥接层,不是端到端重训整个 LLM。
