P(hide) is just a log field, not used in scoring.
Predicting P(hide) is there to push click-through even higher, unrelated to negative experience.
optionExplanations: P(hide) 是众多目标之一,不是唯一,点赞/评论/分享也都参与组合。
对;负权 P(hide) 让排序主动规避用户反感内容,是多目标平衡体验的关键。
P(hide) 明确进入加权组合分,不是纯日志字段。
预测 P(hide) 正是为了降负体验,方向说反了。
optionExplanations_en: P(hide) is one of many objectives, not the only one; likes/comments/shares also contribute.
Correct — a negative weight on P(hide) makes ranking actively avoid disliked content, key to balancing experience across objectives.
P(hide) explicitly enters the weighted combination score, not a mere log field.
Predicting P(hide) is exactly to reduce negative experience — the direction is reversed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户隐藏/不想看该内容的概率,负体验信号,打分时给负权。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: P(hide) is the probability a user hides the content, a negative-experience signal given negative weight in scoring.

category: Multi Task And Multi Objective Learning

scenario: 多头 MTL 把 P(click)、P(conversion)、watch time 组合成一个排序分,要定各头的组合权重(scalarization)。
scenario_en: A multi-head MTL combines P(click), P(conversion), watch time into one ranking score, needing scalarization weights.
q: scalarization 的组合权重该怎么定?
q_en: How should you tune the scalarization weights?
why: 靠线上 A/B 实验调,而不是离线指标:权重的微小改变会移动 UX 与营收的平衡,离线指标预测不了这种线上权衡。scalarization 本质是产品/政策决策,得在真实流量上看它对整体体验和收入的影响。
why_en: Tune scalarization weights via online A/B tests, not offline metrics, because small weight shifts move the UX-revenue balance that offline metrics can't capture.
options: 只用离线 AUC 做网格搜索调权重,离线最优的那组就直接上线
靠线上 A/B 实验调:权重会移动 UX 与营收的平衡
权重设成相等且固定,永远不调
让模型自己端到端学权重,不需要任何人工或实验
options_en: Grid-search the weights on offline AUC alone and ship whichever set is offline-optimal.
Tune it with online A/B tests, because the weights shift the balance between UX and revenue.
Set weights equal and fixed, never adjusting.
Let the model learn the weights end to end with no human or experiment.
whenOtherWins: 在早期离线迭代、还没上线流量时,离线指标可用于粗筛权重范围,但最终权重仍要线上 A/B 定。
optionExplanations: 离线 AUC 抓不住 UX 与营收的真实权衡,离线最优上线常常掉整体收益。
对;权重是商业杠杆,只有真实流量下的留存和收入曲线能告诉你这组权重调对了没有。
等权固定忽略各目标的商业价值差异,也无法随业务变化调整。
端到端学不出"营收 vs 体验"这种业务价值权衡,那是产品决策不是纯优化。
optionExplanations_en: Offline AUC misses the real UX-revenue trade-off, so offline-optimal often loses overall value in production.
Correct — the weights are a business lever, and only retention and revenue curves under real traffic tell you whether a given set is right.
Equal fixed weights ignore differing business value and can't adapt as the business changes.
End-to-end learning can't derive the revenue-vs-experience trade-off, which is a product decision, not pure optimization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多个目标的预测按权重合成一个可排序的单一分数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scalarization combines multiple objective predictions by weights into a single rankable score.

category: Multi Task And Multi Objective Learning

scenario: 团队在纠结把 MTL 系统设计精力主要投在哪一步。
scenario_en: The team debates where to invest most of the MTL system-design effort.
q: 多目标排序里最有影响力的设计决策是哪一步?
q_en: What is the most impactful design decision in multi-objective ranking?
why: 把各头输出组合成单一排序分的 scalarization 是最有影响力的决策:它直接决定 UX 与营收的平衡,权重微调就能改变用户体验和收入,所以要靠线上 A/B 谨慎调而非拍脑袋。
why_en: Scalarization — combining head outputs into one ranking score — is the most impactful decision because it directly sets the UX-revenue balance.
options: 选 optimizer(Adam vs SGD vs Adagrad)是最关键的决策
scalarization:把各头输出组合成单一排序分的那一步
共享主干用几层是最关键决策
batch size 的选择是最有影响力的决策
options_en: Choosing the optimizer (Adam vs SGD vs Adagrad) is the most critical decision.
Scalarization — the step that combines the head outputs into a single ranking score.
How many layers the shared trunk has is the key decision.
Batch size choice is the most impactful decision.
optionExplanations: optimizer 是训练细节,影响收敛不影响"最终怎么排序"这个业务杠杆。
对;scalarization 直接决定线上排序结果和商业权衡,是影响面最大的决策。
主干层数是模型容量细节,不如组合权重直接左右业务结果。
batch size 影响训练稳定性,不是决定 UX/营收平衡的杠杆。
optionExplanations_en: The optimizer is a training detail affecting convergence, not the business lever of final ranking.
Correct — scalarization directly determines online ranking and the business trade-off, the highest-impact decision.
Trunk depth is a capacity detail, less directly steering business outcomes than the combination weights.
Batch size affects training stability, not the UX/revenue balance lever.
category: Multi Task And Multi Objective Learning

scenario: MTL 里不同 head 任务性质不同:有的是二分类,有的要输出有序列表,有的下游依赖预测概率的准度。
scenario_en: Different MTL heads differ: some are binary classification, some output ordered lists, some feed downstream that relies on probability accuracy.
q: 各 head 的 loss 该怎么按任务性质选?
q_en: How should you pick each head's loss by task nature?
why: 分类 head 用交叉熵,要输出有序列表的用排序损失,下游依赖概率绝对准度(如 bid=P(click)×value)时要做校准。全用一种 loss 会让某些 head 学偏。
why_en: Use cross-entropy for classification heads, ranking losses for ordered lists, and calibration when downstream relies on predicted probabilities.
options: 所有 head 一律用 MSE,统一最省事
分类用交叉熵、有序列表用排序损失、依赖概率时做校准
所有 head 一律用排序损失,反正整个系统就是个排序系统
loss 随便选,反正共享主干才决定效果
options_en: Use MSE for all heads, uniform and simplest.
Cross-entropy for classification, ranking loss for ordered lists, calibration when downstream depends on probabilities.
Use ranking loss on every head, since the whole system is a ranking system anyway.
Pick any loss; only the shared trunk decides quality.
whenOtherWins: 若某个 head 的下游只需相对排序、不需概率绝对值,就用排序损失而非追求校准,省掉校准环节。
optionExplanations: MSE 对分类和排序都不合适,概率预测和有序度都会变差。
对;loss 匹配任务性质——分类交叉熵、列表排序损失、依赖概率就校准,才各得其所。
分类和概率校准任务用排序损失会丢掉概率语义,不是全场景通用。
loss 直接决定每个 head 学到什么,不是无关紧要的细节。
optionExplanations_en: MSE suits neither classification nor ranking, degrading both probability prediction and ordering.
Correct — matching loss to task nature (cross-entropy, ranking, calibration) serves each head properly.
Ranking loss on classification/calibration heads loses probability semantics; it isn't universal.
The loss directly determines what each head learns; it's not an irrelevant detail.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让预测概率与真实频率一致(说 0.3 就真有约 30% 发生),下游竞价/阈值依赖它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration makes predicted probabilities match real frequencies (0.3 means about 30% happen), relied on by downstream bidding/thresholds.

tradeoff: 统一 loss vs 逐 head 匹配:统一实现最省事但牺牲部分 head 的目标语义,逐 head 匹配效果更好、实现与调参更繁。
category: Multi Task And Multi Objective Learning

scenario: 从零设计一个多目标排序的 MTL 系统,要有条理地走一遍关键决策。
scenario_en: Designing a multi-objective ranking MTL system from scratch, walk the key decisions in order.
q: 把 MTL 设计流程排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the MTL design flow correctly:
steps: 监控梯度余弦相似度,发现任务干扰
按任务相关度选架构:相关用 shared-bottom,异构用 MMoE
上缓解手段:GradNorm/PCGrad 或手动 loss 加权
用线上 A/B 调 scalarization 权重组合最终排序分
why: 先按任务相关度选架构,再监控梯度余弦发现干扰,接着上缓解(手动加权/GradNorm/PCGrad),最后用线上 A/B 调 scalarization 定最终排序分。顺序保证"先定结构、再诊断、再治疗、最后定业务权衡"。
why_en: Choose architecture by task relatedness, monitor gradient cosine for interference, apply mitigation, then A/B-tune scalarization for the final score.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["选架构"] --> B["监控梯度余弦"]
  B --> C["上缓解手段"]
  C --> D["A/B 调 scalarization"]
category: Multi Task And Multi Objective Learning

scenario: YouTube 的参与度(观看时长)和满意度(问卷质量分)只弱相关。
scenario_en: YouTube's engagement (watch time) and satisfaction (survey quality) are only weakly correlated.
q: 为什么弱相关的目标让 YouTube 从 shared-bottom 转向 MMoE?
q_en: Why do weakly correlated objectives push YouTube from shared-bottom to MMoE?
why: 两个目标只弱相关,shared-bottom 强迫它们共享同一表示,会互相拖累(负迁移),不足以兼顾。MMoE 的每任务门控让参与度和满意度各自倚重不同专家家族,专业分工避免了被迫折中。
why_en: Weakly correlated objectives make a forced shared representation drag them down, so MMoE's per-task gating lets each lean on its own experts.
options: 因为 MMoE 参数更少所以更快,与相关性无关
两目标弱相关,共享表示会互相拖累;MMoE 门控让各自倚重不同专家
因为观看时长和满意度其实完全相同,合并即可
因为 shared-bottom 架构根本不支持两个以上的 head,只有 MMoE 支持
options_en: Because MMoE has fewer params and is faster, unrelated to correlation.
The two objectives are only weakly correlated, so a shared representation drags them down; MMoE gating lets each lean on different experts.
Because watch time and satisfaction are actually identical, so just merge them.
Because the shared-bottom architecture simply cannot support more than one head and only MMoE can.
optionExplanations: MMoE 参数通常更多不是更少,转向它的理由是异构性不是参数量。
对;弱相关=共享表示净收益低、冲突高,每任务门控的专业分工正好对症。
两目标弱相关不是相同,合并会丢掉满意度这个独立信号。
shared-bottom 完全支持多 head,转向 MMoE 是为处理异构,不是能力限制。
optionExplanations_en: MMoE usually has more params, not fewer; the reason to switch is heterogeneity, not param count.
Correct — weak correlation means low sharing benefit and high conflict, and per-task gating's specialization is the fix.
Weakly correlated isn't identical; merging drops satisfaction as an independent signal.
Shared-bottom fully supports multiple heads; switching to MMoE handles heterogeneity, not a capability limit.
category: Multi Task And Multi Objective Learning

scenario: 面试小测:训练中提升 CTR 一致地拉低了转化率,问根因。
scenario_en: Quiz: during training, improving CTR consistently degrades conversion; what's the root cause?
q: 这个现象的根因是什么?
q_en: What is the root cause of this phenomenon?
why: 根因是共享参数上的冲突梯度(负迁移):CTR 和转化在同一共享权重上要的特征方向相反,优化器一平均就把转化往下带。识别它才能对症上 PCGrad/门控/手动加权。
why_en: The cause is conflicting gradients on shared parameters (negative transfer): CTR and conversion demand opposite feature directions on shared weights.
options: 转化率的正样本太少,补充采样即可解决,与共享参数无关
共享参数上的冲突梯度(负迁移):两任务要的特征方向相反
学习率设置错误,与任务冲突无关
模型容量不够,把共享主干加宽加深就能自然消除
options_en: There are too few positive conversion samples; more sampling fixes it, unrelated to shared parameters.
Conflicting gradients on the shared parameters (negative transfer): the two tasks want opposite feature directions.
Wrong learning rate, unrelated to task conflict.
Model capacity is too small; widening and deepening the shared trunk makes it go away.
optionExplanations: 加数据缓解不了方向性冲突,负迁移是梯度方向相反造成的,不是数据量。
对;这正是负迁移/冲突梯度的定义,识别它才能选对缓解手段。
lr 改步长不改方向冲突,治不了两任务梯度相反。
加容量不改变共享权重上的方向冲突,负迁移照旧。
optionExplanations_en: More data can't relieve directional conflict; negative transfer comes from opposing gradient directions, not data volume.
Correct — this is the definition of negative transfer/conflicting gradients, and identifying it guides the mitigation.
LR changes step size, not directional conflict, so it won't fix opposing task gradients.
Adding capacity doesn't change the directional conflict on shared weights; negative transfer persists.
category: Multi Task And Multi Objective Learning

scenario: 一个 CTR 模型离线 AUC 很高,但输出的 P(click) 系统性偏高,广告竞价按 bid=P(click)×价值出价后开始悄悄超支。
scenario_en: A CTR model has high offline AUC but systematically overestimates P(click), and ad bidding at bid=P(click)×value quietly overspends.
q: 为什么损失函数选择要当成生产设计决策,而非纯理论?
q_en: Why treat loss-function choice as a production design decision, not pure theory?
why: 因为损失直接决定输出的性质:一个只最大化 AUC 但概率不校准的模型,会在二价拍卖里扭曲出价、悄悄流失营收。分类/排序/校准三类损失各服务不同下游需求,选错就算离线指标好看线上照样亏钱。
why_en: Loss shapes the output's usable property: an AUC-maximizing but miscalibrated model distorts second-price auction bids and silently loses revenue, so classification/ranking/calibration losses serve different downstream needs.
diagram:
flowchart TD L["损失函数选择"] --> C["分类损失
CE/Focal"] L --> R["排序损失
BPR/Lambda*"] L --> K["校准
Platt/Isotonic"]
options: 损失函数只影响训练收敛速度,不影响业务结果,随便选一个就行
损失决定输出性质:只追 AUC 而概率不校准会扭曲拍卖出价
只要模型够大,任何损失都收敛到同样结果,选择无关紧要
损失函数是学术概念,生产系统统一用 MSE 即可,下游自己适配
options_en: Loss only affects training convergence speed, not business outcomes, so just pick one.
Loss decides the output's property: chasing AUC without calibration distorts auction bids.
With a big enough model, any loss converges to the same result, so choice is irrelevant.
Loss is academic; production can use MSE everywhere and let downstream adapt.
whenOtherWins: 若下游只需相对排序、完全不用概率绝对值(如纯召回排序),那对概率校准的要求可以放松,选排序损失即可。
optionExplanations: 损失直接决定输出是否可当概率用,"只影响收敛"低估了它的业务影响。
对;AUC 高不等于概率可用,校准差会在竞价/阈值这些下游悄悄亏钱,这就是它是设计决策的原因。
不同损失优化不同目标(排序 vs 概率),再大模型也收敛到不同性质的输出。
MSE 对分类和排序都不合适,统一用它会牺牲概率语义和排序质量。
optionExplanations_en: Loss decides whether the output is usable as a probability; 'only affects convergence' underrates its business impact.
Correct — high AUC doesn't mean usable probabilities, and poor calibration silently loses money downstream, which is why it's a design decision.
Different losses optimize different goals (ranking vs probability), so even big models converge to differently-shaped outputs.
MSE suits neither classification nor ranking; using it uniformly sacrifices probability semantics and ranking quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量模型排序能力(正样本排在负样本前的概率),但不反映概率是否校准。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) measures ranking ability (probability a positive outranks a negative) but not whether probabilities are calibrated.

termDefinitions.meaning: 赢家按第二高出价付费的拍卖机制,广告竞价常用,出价依赖校准的 P(click)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A second-price auction charges the winner the second-highest bid, common in ad auctions, where bids rely on calibrated P(click).

tradeoff: 排序能力(AUC) vs 概率校准:优化前者不保证概率能直接拿去出价

scenario: CTR 预估 head 要一个默认分类损失,类别大致均衡,下游还想直接用输出概率。
scenario_en: A CTR head needs a default classification loss with roughly balanced classes, and downstream wants to use the output probability directly.
q: 二元交叉熵默认好在哪,什么条件下输出接近校准?
q_en: Why is binary cross-entropy the default, and when is its output near-calibrated?
why: 二元交叉熵 L=−[y·log(p)+(1−y)·log(1−p)],向真实标签方向给平滑梯度,是 CTR head 和二/多分类的工业标准。当类别大致均衡时,它的输出近似校准的后验概率,可直接用于下游竞价/阈值。
why_en: Binary cross-entropy gives smooth gradients toward the true label and, when classes are roughly balanced, yields approximately calibrated posterior probabilities.
options: 它专为极端类别不均衡设计,类别越偏输出越校准
给平滑梯度、是工业标准;类别均衡时输出近似校准概率
它只优化排序,不产出可以直接使用的概率值
它输出的分数没有概率意义,必须再套一层校准才能用
options_en: It is built for extreme imbalance — the more skewed the classes, the better calibrated it gets.
It gives smooth gradients and is the industry standard; with balanced classes outputs are near-calibrated.
It only optimizes ranking and never produces directly usable probability values.
Its scores carry no probabilistic meaning, so you always need a calibration layer on top.
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反:极端不均衡下简单 CE 会被易负样本主导,那时才需要 focal loss。
对;平滑梯度+均衡时近似校准,是它当 CTR 默认损失的原因。
CE 是分类概率损失不是排序损失,它就产出概率。
均衡数据上 CE 输出本就近似校准,不是必须再套校准层。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite: under extreme imbalance plain CE is dominated by easy negatives, which is when focal loss is needed.
Correct — smooth gradients plus near-calibration when balanced is why it's the default CTR loss.
CE is a classification probability loss, not a ranking loss; it does produce probabilities.
On balanced data CE output is already near-calibrated, so a calibration layer isn't always required.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分类默认损失 L=−[y·log(p)+(1−y)·log(1−p)],向真实标签给平滑梯度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Binary cross-entropy is the default classification loss, giving smooth gradients toward the true label.

termDefinitions.term: calibrated posterior / 校准后验概率
termDefinitions.meaning: 输出概率与真实发生频率一致(说 0.3 就约 30% 发生)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A calibrated posterior means predicted probabilities match real frequencies (0.3 means about 30% happen).

scenario: 欺诈检测正样本占比 <1/10,000,用普通交叉熵训练时海量易分负样本主导了梯度,模型学不到稀有正类。
scenario_en: Fraud positives are <1 in 10,000, and with plain cross-entropy the flood of easy negatives dominates the gradient so the model can't learn the rare positives.
q: 极端类别不均衡下该换什么损失?
q_en: Under extreme class imbalance, which loss should you switch to?
why: 用 focal loss:它加一个调制因子 (1−p_t)^γ,把已高置信分对的样本(p_t→1)的梯度压下去,让模型把注意力放到难分的稀有正类上。普通 CE 在 <1/10,000 这种不均衡下会被易负样本淹没。
why_en: Use focal loss: its modulating factor down-weights easy, high-confidence examples so the model focuses on hard rare positives, which plain CE drowns out under extreme imbalance.
options: 继续用普通 CE,把学习率调大、多训练几轮,稀有正类照样能学到
focal loss:加 (1−p_t)^γ 压低易分样本的梯度
改用 MSE 回归标签,把分类当回归做,对类别不均衡天然更鲁棒
把负样本随机删到与正样本一样多,丢掉的信息不重要
options_en: Stick with plain CE — raise the learning rate and train a few more epochs; rare positives will still be learned.
Focal loss: a (1−p_t)^γ factor damps the gradients of easy examples.
Switch to MSE regression on the labels — treat classification as regression, which is naturally more robust to imbalance.
Randomly drop negatives down to the positive count; the discarded information does not matter.
whenOtherWins: 当类别大致均衡、无需压易样本时,普通交叉熵反而更简单、开箱校准更好,不必上 focal loss。
optionExplanations: 调大 lr 不改变易负样本主导梯度的结构,稀有正类照样被淹没。
对;调制因子静默易分样本梯度,把学习信号集中到难分稀有正类,正是极端不均衡的解。
MSE 不是分类概率损失,对不均衡分类既不校准也不聚焦难例。
粗暴删负样本丢大量信息且不是损失层面的解,focal 才是在损失里重加权。
optionExplanations_en: Raising LR doesn't change easy negatives dominating the gradient; rare positives stay drowned out.
Correct — the modulating factor silences easy-example gradients and concentrates learning on hard rare positives, the fix for extreme imbalance.
MSE isn't a classification probability loss; it neither calibrates nor focuses on hard cases under imbalance.
Bluntly deleting negatives loses information and isn't a loss-level fix, whereas focal reweights within the loss.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在交叉熵上乘调制因子 (1−p_t)^γ,压低易分样本、聚焦难分样本,治极端不均衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Focal loss multiplies cross-entropy by (1-p_t)^gamma to down-weight easy examples and focus on hard ones, for extreme imbalance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型已高置信判为负的样本,在不均衡下数量巨大会主导梯度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Easy negatives are samples confidently classified as negative; under imbalance their sheer number dominates the gradient.

tradeoff: 稀有正类召回 vs 多数类精度与概率校准:focal 用校准换对难例的聚焦

scenario: 面试官问 focal loss 里 (1−p_t)^γ 这个调制因子具体在干什么。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what focal loss's modulating factor (1-p_t)^gamma actually does.
q: focal loss 的调制因子如何改变各样本的梯度?
q_en: How does focal loss's modulating factor change per-example gradients?
why: L_focal=−α_t·(1−p_t)^γ·log(p_t)。对已分对的高置信样本 p_t→1,(1−p_t)^γ→0,梯度被静默;对难分样本 p_t 小,因子接近 1,梯度基本保留。于是学习信号自动从易样本转移到难样本。
why_en: For confident correct examples (p_t to 1) the factor (1-p_t)^gamma goes to 0 and silences the gradient, while hard examples keep near-full gradient, shifting learning to hard cases.
options: 它同比例放大所有样本的梯度,让训练收敛更快、更早学会稀有类
对高置信分对样本静默梯度,对难分样本保留,信号转向难例
它只作用于负样本,对正样本的梯度完全没有任何压制效果
它把所有样本的梯度都置零,相当于直接停止训练
options_en: It scales up every sample's gradient equally, so training converges faster and learns rare classes sooner.
It silences gradients on confident correct samples and keeps them on hard ones, shifting the signal to hard examples.
It applies only to negative samples, leaving positive-sample gradients completely unsuppressed.
It zeroes out every gradient, which effectively stops training.
optionExplanations: 它不是放大所有梯度,而是选择性压低易样本梯度,方向相反。
对;(1−p_t)^γ 随置信度增大趋零,把梯度预算从易样本挪给难样本。
它对任何已高置信分对的样本(含正类)都压梯度,不只负样本。
只有 p_t→1 的样本梯度趋零,难样本梯度保留,训练照常进行。
optionExplanations_en: It doesn't amplify all gradients; it selectively down-weights easy examples — the opposite.
Correct — (1-p_t)^gamma goes to zero as confidence rises, reallocating gradient budget from easy to hard examples.
It down-weights any confidently correct example including positives, not just negatives.
Only p_t-to-1 examples have gradients near zero; hard examples keep theirs, so training continues.

termDefinitions.meaning: focal loss 里的 (1−p_t)^γ,随预测置信度升高而减小,压低易样本贡献。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The modulating factor (1-p_t)^gamma in focal loss shrinks as prediction confidence rises, down-weighting easy examples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型对真实类别赋予的概率,p_t→1 表示已高置信分对。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p_t is the probability the model assigns to the true class; p_t near 1 means a confident correct prediction.

scenario: RetinaNet 默认 γ=2;一个 p_t=0.9 的样本损失被压到约原来的 1/100;γ 一般在验证集上调在 1–5。
scenario_en: RetinaNet defaults to gamma=2; an example at p_t=0.9 has its loss cut ~100x; gamma is tuned in 1-5 on validation.
q: focal loss 的 γ 该怎么理解和调?
q_en: How should you understand and tune focal loss's gamma?
why: γ 控压制强度:γ=0 退化成普通 CE;γ=2(RetinaNet 默认)时 p_t=0.9 的样本损失约降 100 倍。在验证集上 1–5 之间调,权衡稀有正类召回 vs 多数类精度;太大会连易样本都欠拟合。这是经验超参不是公式常量。
why_en: Gamma sets suppression strength: gamma=0 is plain CE, gamma=2 cuts a p_t=0.9 example's loss ~100x, tuned in 1-5 to trade rare-positive recall against majority precision.
options: γ 就是学习率的另一种写法,数值越大训练收敛得越快
γ 控压制强度:0 退化成 CE,常用 2,验证集上调
γ 是类别数量,二分类里固定等于 2,永远不可以调
γ 越大一定越准,应尽量设到框架允许的最大值
options_en: Gamma is just another name for the learning rate — the bigger the value, the faster training converges.
Gamma controls how hard easy examples are damped: 0 is plain CE, 2 is typical, tune on validation.
Gamma is the number of classes, permanently fixed at 2 for binary tasks and never tunable.
Bigger gamma is always more accurate, so set it to the maximum the framework allows.
optionExplanations: γ 不是学习率,它只调易样本的压制强度,与步长无关。
对;γ 是压制旋钮,γ=0 退回 CE、γ=2 是常用默认,过大反而欠拟合易样本,得验证集上调。
γ 与类别数无关,它是控制调制因子陡峭度的连续超参。
γ 太大会把易样本梯度也压没导致欠拟合,不是越大越好。
optionExplanations_en: Gamma isn't the learning rate; it only sets easy-example suppression, unrelated to step size.
Correct — gamma is the suppression knob: gamma=0 reverts to CE, gamma=2 is a common default, and too high underfits easy examples, so tune on validation.
Gamma is unrelated to class count; it's a continuous hyperparameter controlling the modulating factor's steepness.
Too-high gamma suppresses easy-example gradients into underfitting, so bigger isn't always better.

termDefinitions.meaning: focal loss 里控制易样本压制强度的超参,γ=0 即普通 CE。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Gamma is focal loss's focusing hyperparameter controlling easy-example suppression; gamma=0 is plain cross-entropy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 提出 focal loss 的稠密目标检测模型,默认 γ=2。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RetinaNet is the dense object-detection model that introduced focal loss, defaulting to gamma=2.

scenario: 有人以为上了 focal loss 就不必再管数据采样了。
scenario_en: Someone assumes adopting focal loss removes any need for data sampling.
q: focal loss 能替代过采样/类别加权采样吗?
q_en: Does focal loss replace oversampling / class-weighted sampling?
why: 不能替代:focal 在损失层面重加权,过采样在数据层面平衡分布,两者互补。实践中把 focal loss 与分层小批(每个 batch 保证一定比例正样本)结合,效果最好;只靠 focal 而 batch 里几乎没有正样本,梯度依旧稀薄。
why_en: Focal loss reweights at the loss level while oversampling balances at the data level, so combine focal with stratified mini-batches rather than replacing sampling.
options: 能,focal loss 完全取代采样,数据侧不用再做任何处理了
不能,focal 在损失层重加权、采样在数据层平衡,两者互补
能,只要 γ 调得够大就完全不需要任何采样策略
两者冲突,用了 focal 之后就绝不能再做任何采样
options_en: Yes — focal loss fully replaces sampling, so nothing needs to change on the data side.
No — focal reweights at the loss layer while sampling rebalances at the data layer; they complement each other.
Yes — as long as gamma is large enough you need no sampling strategy at all.
They conflict: once you use focal you must never sample again.
optionExplanations: focal 不平衡 batch 里的样本构成,若一个 batch 几乎全是负样本,梯度仍稀薄。
对;损失重加权与数据采样互补,分层小批+ focal 才能同时保证正样本出现和难例聚焦。
γ 再大也解决不了 batch 里正样本极少的问题,采样管的是分布不是权重。
两者不冲突而是互补,实践中常一起用。
optionExplanations_en: Focal doesn't balance batch composition; if a batch is almost all negatives, gradients stay thin.
Correct — loss reweighting and data sampling are complementary, so stratified mini-batches plus focal ensure both positive presence and hard-case focus.
No gamma fixes batches with almost no positives; sampling controls distribution, not weights.
They don't conflict but complement, and are commonly used together.

termDefinitions.meaning: 构造每个训练 batch 时保证各类别有一定比例,防某类在 batch 中缺席。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stratified mini-batch is built to guarantee each class a share, preventing a class from being absent in the batch.

scenario: 小测:在 γ>0 的 focal loss 下,一个已经分得很好的样本(p_t→1)的梯度会怎样?
scenario_en: Quiz: under focal loss with gamma>0, what happens to the gradient of a well-classified example (p_t to 1)?
q: γ>0 时,已分好样本的梯度贡献如何变化?
q_en: With gamma>0, how does a well-classified example's gradient change?
why: 显著减小:(1−p_t)^γ 在 p_t→1 时趋近 0,把这些已学会样本的梯度几乎抹掉,好让优化器把力气花在还没学好的难样本上。这正是 focal loss 治不均衡的核心机制。
why_en: It is significantly reduced, because (1-p_t)^gamma approaches zero as p_t to 1, nearly erasing well-classified examples' gradients so the optimizer focuses on hard ones.
options: 显著增大,模型会花更多力气去学它已经会做对的那些样本
显著减小,(1−p_t)^γ→0 抹掉已学好样本的梯度
完全不变,梯度贡献和普通交叉熵一模一样
先增大后减小,梯度走向具体取决于当前 batch 的大小
options_en: It grows sharply, so the model spends even more effort on samples it already gets right.
It shrinks sharply — (1−p_t)^γ→0 wipes out gradients on already-learned samples.
It is unchanged; gradient contribution is identical to plain cross-entropy.
It first rises then falls, depending on the size of the current batch.
optionExplanations: 已学会的样本正是要压制的对象,不该增大它们的梯度。
对;调制因子在高置信处趋零,静默易样本、聚焦难样本,是 focal 的设计目的。
γ>0 时它明显不同于 CE,易样本梯度被压,不是不变。
变化只取决于 p_t 和 γ,和 batch 大小无关。
optionExplanations_en: Already-learned examples are exactly what to suppress; their gradients shouldn't grow.
Correct — the modulating factor nears zero at high confidence, silencing easy and focusing on hard examples, focal's design goal.
With gamma>0 it clearly differs from CE; easy-example gradients are suppressed, not unchanged.
The change depends only on p_t and gamma, not batch size.

scenario: 排序损失按"一次看多少数据"分成三类,面试官要你区分。
scenario_en: Ranking losses split by 'how much data at once' into three units; the interviewer asks you to distinguish them.
q: pointwise / pairwise / listwise 的区别是什么?
q_en: What distinguishes pointwise / pairwise / listwise?
why: pointwise 给单项绝对分;pairwise 只要求正样本排在负样本前;listwise 直接优化整表指标(如 NDCG)。粒度越靠后越贴近排序指标,但算力越贵。
why_en: Pointwise scores each item absolutely, pairwise enforces relevant-over-irrelevant order, and listwise optimizes a whole-list metric like NDCG.
options: 三者本质完全一样,底层都用同一个交叉熵公式,只是论文换了叫法
pointwise 单项分;pairwise 成对序;listwise 整表指标
pointwise 优化整列表、listwise 单项打分,和实际角色刚好反过来
三者都只看单个物品的绝对分,完全不考虑成对或整列表的排序结构
options_en: They are all the same thing under the hood — the same cross-entropy formula, just renamed by different papers.
Pointwise: one item score. Pairwise: order within a pair. Listwise: whole-list metric.
Pointwise optimizes the whole list and listwise scores single items — their roles are exactly swapped.
All three look only at a single item's absolute score and ignore pairwise or whole-list ordering structure entirely.
optionExplanations: 三者优化粒度不同(点/对/列),直接影响是否对齐最终排序指标,不是叫法差异。
对;从单点到成对到整列,粒度递增、越贴近 NDCG 但越贵,是排序损失的分类主轴。
角色说反了:pointwise 是单项打分,listwise 才优化整列表。
只有 pointwise 只看单项;pairwise 看成对、listwise 看整列表。
optionExplanations_en: They differ in granularity (point/pair/list), which affects alignment to the final ranking metric — not just naming.
Correct — from point to pair to list, granularity rises, closer to NDCG but costlier, the main axis of ranking losses.
Roles reversed: pointwise scores single items and listwise optimizes the whole list.
Only pointwise looks at a single item; pairwise looks at pairs and listwise at the whole list.

termDefinitions.meaning: 排序质量指标,越靠前的相关项贡献越大,越靠后折扣越多。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain) is a ranking-quality metric where relevant items higher up contribute more.

tradeoff: 指标对齐 vs 计算成本:粒度从单点到整列越贴近 NDCG,训练开销越大

scenario: 推荐里只有隐式反馈(用户点了什么),没有显式评分,想训一个学相对偏好的模型。
scenario_en: A recommender has only implicit feedback (what users clicked), no explicit ratings, and wants to learn relative preference.
q: BPR 的优化目标和适用信号是什么?
q_en: What is BPR's objective and the feedback it suits?
why: BPR 是 pairwise:最大化"正样本 i 分高于采样负样本 j"的概率,L=−log σ(x̂_ui−x̂_uj)。只要相对序,天然吃点击这类隐式反馈。
why_en: BPR is pairwise: it maximizes the probability a positive scores above a sampled negative, needing only correct ordering, so it suits implicit feedback and scales via negative sampling.
options: BPR 要求每个物品有精确的绝对评分,只能用显式反馈
pairwise 最大化正样本分高于采样负样本,只需相对序
BPR 直接优化 NDCG,属于 listwise 排序损失
BPR 输出校准的点击概率,专为广告竞价设计
options_en: BPR needs an exact absolute rating per item, so it only works with explicit feedback.
Pairwise: it maximizes the margin of a positive over a sampled negative, needing only relative order.
BPR directly optimizes NDCG, which makes it a listwise ranking loss.
BPR emits calibrated click probabilities and was designed for ad bidding.
optionExplanations: BPR 恰恰不需要绝对评分,它只比较正负两项的高低,专为无评分的隐式反馈设计。
对;负采样让它一轮只算少量对比,能扩到数十亿量级,所以成了候选生成的默认损失。
它不直接优化 NDCG——把梯度按 NDCG 加权的是 LambdaRank,不是这里的成对边际。
BPR 优化排序不保证概率校准,竞价需要校准的概率损失而非 BPR。
optionExplanations_en: BPR specifically needs no absolute ratings; it compares positive vs negative order, built for rating-free implicit feedback.
Correct — negative sampling keeps each step to a handful of comparisons, so it scales to billions of pairs and became the default for candidate generation.
It does not optimize NDCG directly — weighting gradients by NDCG is LambdaRank, not this pairwise margin.
BPR optimizes ranking without guaranteeing calibration; bidding needs a calibrated probability loss, not BPR.

termDefinitions.meaning: pairwise 排序损失,最大化正样本得分高于采样负样本,适配隐式反馈。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BPR (Bayesian Personalized Ranking) is a pairwise ranking loss maximizing a positive scoring above a sampled negative, for implicit feedback.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户行为(点击/购买)隐含的偏好信号,没有显式打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Implicit feedback is preference inferred from behavior (clicks/purchases) with no explicit ratings.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从海量未交互项里随机抽负样本与正样本配对,避免全量计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative sampling randomly draws negatives from the vast un-interacted items to pair with positives, avoiding full computation.

scenario: 召回(candidate generation)阶段要从数十亿物品里快速筛出几百个候选,只需近似排序、追求速度和规模。
scenario_en: The candidate-generation stage must quickly narrow billions of items to a few hundred, needing only approximate ordering at speed and scale.
q: 召回阶段的排序损失该选什么?
q_en: Which ranking loss fits candidate generation?
why: 选 BPR:候选生成只需近似正确的相对序、要快要能扩,BPR 的 pairwise+负采样正好又快又能到数十亿对。精细的、按位置加权的 listwise(LambdaRank)留给最终重排,那里指标对齐更值这份算力。
why_en: Pick BPR: candidate generation needs fast, scalable approximate ordering, which pairwise-plus-negative-sampling delivers, leaving metric-aligned listwise for final re-ranking.
options: LambdaRank,直接优化 NDCG 最精确,召回也该用最好的
BPR:pairwise+负采样又快又可扩,近似序够召回用
普通 MSE 回归打分,召回阶段只需要回归一个分数
focal loss,召回阶段最怕类别不均衡,先治不均衡
options_en: LambdaRank — it optimizes NDCG directly and is the most precise, so recall should use the best too.
BPR: pairwise plus negative sampling is fast and scalable, and approximate order is enough for recall.
Plain MSE regression on scores, since candidate generation only needs a regressed number.
Focal loss, because candidate generation suffers most from class imbalance.
whenOtherWins: 到最终重排阶段,候选只剩几百个、指标对齐比速度更重要时,才换成 LambdaRank/LambdaMART。
optionExplanations: LambdaRank 逐位置加权算得贵,数十亿候选上跑不动,精度换不回召回要的吞吐。
对;BPR 便宜可扩、近似排序够用,是召回阶段的默认选择。
MSE 回归不直接优化排序,召回要的是相对序不是绝对回归值。
focal 是分类不均衡损失,不解决召回的大规模排序问题。
optionExplanations_en: LambdaRank's per-position weighting is costly and can't run over billions of candidates; precision doesn't buy back recall's needed throughput.
Correct — BPR is cheap, scalable, and approximate ordering suffices, the default at the recall stage.
MSE regression doesn't directly optimize ranking; recall needs relative order, not absolute regressed values.
Focal is a classification-imbalance loss, not a fix for recall's large-scale ranking.
tradeoff: 排序精度 vs 吞吐与可扩展性:召回要扫百万候选,重排才买得起 listwise 算力

scenario: 用 BPR 训练排序,发现它对"交换发生在列表哪个位置"一视同仁。
scenario_en: Training ranking with BPR, you notice it treats a swap the same regardless of where in the list it happens.
q: BPR 相比 listwise 的关键局限是什么?
q_en: What is BPR's key limitation versus listwise?
why: BPR 不加权"交换发生在列表哪里":把第 1、2 名交换和第 98、99 名交换视为同等,但对用户/指标而言头部错序代价远大。listwise(LambdaRank)正是用 NDCG 变化给不同位置的交换赋不同权重来补上这点。
why_en: BPR doesn't weight where a swap occurs, treating top-of-list and bottom swaps equally, whereas listwise weights by NDCG change.
options: BPR 无法处理隐式反馈,只能用显式评分训练
不加权交换位置:头部错序和尾部错序被同等对待
BPR 计算代价太高,无法扩展到大规模候选集
BPR 会输出过度校准的概率,反而破坏排序质量
options_en: BPR cannot handle implicit feedback and needs explicit ratings to train.
It never weights where a swap happens: a top-of-list inversion counts the same as a tail one.
BPR is too expensive to compute and cannot scale to large candidate sets.
BPR emits over-calibrated probabilities that end up hurting ranking quality.
optionExplanations: BPR 正是为隐式反馈设计的,这说反了。
对;不区分交换位置是 BPR 的核心局限,头部排序质量因此得不到重点优化。
BPR 靠负采样恰恰便宜可扩,不是贵。
BPR 不优化概率校准,谈不上过度校准,和它的位置局限无关。
optionExplanations_en: BPR is designed for implicit feedback — this is reversed.
Correct — not distinguishing swap position is BPR's core limitation, so top-of-list quality isn't prioritized.
BPR is cheap and scalable via negative sampling, not expensive.
BPR doesn't optimize calibration, so over-calibration doesn't apply and is unrelated to its positional limitation.

scenario: 最终重排要让头部顺序尽量对,交换排名靠前的两个物品应该比交换靠后的更受重视。
scenario_en: Final re-ranking must get the head order right, so swapping two top items should matter more than swapping bottom ones.
q: LambdaRank 如何让排序对齐 NDCG?
q_en: How does LambdaRank align ranking with NDCG?
why: 给每对梯度乘上"交换这两位引起的 NDCG 变化":头部交换权重大、尾部小。于是不必对不可导的 NDCG 求导,也能把优化力度对齐指标。
why_en: LambdaRank weights each pairwise gradient by the NDCG change from swapping those two positions, so top swaps get larger gradients aligned to the metric.
options: 它对所有位置的交换赋予完全相同的权重,和 BPR 做法一样
每对梯度乘上交换这两位带来的 NDCG 变化,头部权重更大
它直接对不可导的 NDCG 求梯度来做反向传播优化排序
它放弃排序目标,改成逐项概率回归再排序
options_en: It gives every position's swap exactly the same weight, the same approach as BPR.
It multiplies each pair's gradient by the NDCG change from swapping those two positions, so top swaps weigh more.
It differentiates the non-differentiable NDCG directly to backprop and optimize the ranking.
It abandons ranking and regresses per-item probabilities instead.
optionExplanations: 等权正是 BPR 的做法,LambdaRank 的价值恰恰是按位置差异化加权。
对;用 NDCG 变化加权每对梯度,让优化重点落在头部,是它对齐指标的核心。
NDCG 不可导,LambdaRank 正是绕开求导、直接用指标变化当梯度权重。
它仍是排序损失,只是给 pairwise 梯度加了指标权重,不是回归。
optionExplanations_en: Equal weighting is BPR's approach; LambdaRank's value is exactly position-differentiated weighting.
Correct — weighting each pairwise gradient by NDCG change concentrates optimization on the head, its metric-alignment core.
NDCG is non-differentiable; LambdaRank specifically sidesteps differentiation by using metric change as the gradient weight.
It remains a ranking loss, just adding a metric weight to pairwise gradients, not regression.

termDefinitions.meaning: listwise 排序,用交换两位带来的 NDCG 变化加权每对 pairwise 梯度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LambdaRank is a listwise method weighting each pairwise gradient by the NDCG change from swapping two positions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 这些经指标加权的梯度,无需对不可导的 NDCG 求导即可得到。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The lambdas are these metric-weighted gradients, obtained without differentiating the non-differentiable NDCG.

scenario: 特征丰富的搜索排序场景,想要 listwise 的指标对齐,又想用树模型的表达力。
scenario_en: A feature-rich search-ranking setting wants listwise metric alignment with the expressiveness of tree models.
q: LambdaMART 是怎么构成的,擅长什么?
q_en: How is LambdaMART built, and what is it good at?
why: LambdaMART = 把 LambdaRank 的 λ 梯度放进 GBDT:每一轮 boosting 用一棵树去拟合这些指标加权的 lambda 梯度。它是 Bing 搜索排序的主力,在特征丰富的场景里与神经排序器不相上下。
why_en: LambdaMART puts LambdaRank's lambda gradients inside GBDT, fitting a tree to those metric-weighted gradients each boosting round, the backbone of Bing search ranking.
options: 把 LambdaRank 的 λ 梯度塞进神经网络的注意力层
λ 梯度放进 GBDT,每轮树拟合指标加权梯度
一种纯 pointwise 回归损失,和 NDCG 完全无关
只是 BPR 的另一个名字,底层机制完全相同
options_en: It stuffs LambdaRank's lambda gradients into a neural attention layer.
Lambda gradients go into GBDT: each boosting round fits a tree to those metric-weighted gradients.
A purely pointwise regression loss with no connection to NDCG.
Just another name for BPR with an identical underlying mechanism.
optionExplanations: LambdaMART 用的是梯度提升树 GBDT 不是神经注意力,载体说错了。
对;λ 梯度 + GBDT 的组合,让树模型也能对齐 NDCG,在特征丰富场景很强。
它是 listwise 指标对齐的,不是与 NDCG 无关的 pointwise 回归。
它是 GBDT 载体的 listwise 方法,和 pairwise 的 BPR 机制不同。
optionExplanations_en: LambdaMART uses gradient-boosted trees (GBDT), not neural attention — wrong carrier.
Correct — lambda gradients plus GBDT let trees align to NDCG, strong in feature-rich settings.
It's listwise metric-aligned, not an NDCG-agnostic pointwise regression.
It's a GBDT-based listwise method, mechanically different from pairwise BPR.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LambdaRank 的 λ 梯度用在 GBDT 上的 listwise 排序方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LambdaMART is a listwise ranking method applying LambdaRank's lambda gradients within GBDT.

termDefinitions.meaning: 逐轮加树、每棵拟合前一轮残差/梯度的树集成模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GBDT (Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees) is a tree ensemble adding trees round by round, each fitting the previous round's residual/gradient.

scenario: 最终重排阶段只剩几百个候选,要把头部顺序做到最精,直接对齐 NDCG 换取业务价值。
scenario_en: Final re-ranking has a few hundred candidates and must perfect the head order, aligning to NDCG for business value.
q: 最终重排该用哪类损失?
q_en: Which loss family for final re-ranking?
why: 用 LambdaMART/LambdaRank 这类 listwise:候选少、可承受更高算力,而它们按位置用 NDCG 加权梯度,把头部排序做精,指标对齐直接转成业务价值。BPR 只给近似序、不加权位置,精度不够。
why_en: Use listwise LambdaMART/LambdaRank: few candidates afford the compute, and NDCG-weighted gradients perfect the head order for business value.
options: BPR,pairwise 又快又能扩,重排阶段候选虽少也该优先考虑吞吐和算力成本
listwise:LambdaRank/LambdaMART,按位置加权 NDCG
focal loss,重排阶段最怕类别不均衡,应先压住易分样本
普通交叉熵逐项打分,忽略列表结构也不影响最终排序质量
options_en: BPR — pairwise is fast and scalable, and even with few candidates re-ranking should still prioritize throughput and compute cost.
Listwise LambdaRank/LambdaMART, weighting NDCG by position.
Focal loss, since re-ranking suffers most from imbalance and should damp easy samples first.
Plain cross-entropy per item; ignoring list structure does not hurt final ranking quality.
whenOtherWins: 在召回阶段、候选达数十亿、速度和规模压倒精度时,反而该用 BPR 而非 listwise。
optionExplanations: 重排阶段候选已很少,速度不再是瓶颈,BPR 的近似序换不来头部精度。
对;listwise 按位置加权对齐 NDCG,把头部做精,正是重排追求的价值。
focal 是分类不均衡损失,与重排的列表排序目标不符。
逐项 CE 忽略列表结构,得不到 listwise 的位置加权优势。
optionExplanations_en: At re-ranking candidates are already few and speed isn't the bottleneck, so BPR's approximate order doesn't buy head precision.
Correct — listwise weights by position to align with NDCG and perfect the head, exactly re-ranking's goal.
Focal is a classification-imbalance loss, mismatched to re-ranking's list-ordering objective.
Per-item CE ignores list structure and misses listwise's positional weighting advantage.
tradeoff: 指标对齐精度 vs 每次打分的算力:重排候选只剩几百条,买得起 listwise

scenario: 面试官要你横向比较 CE、BPR、LambdaRank、LambdaMART 的方法和最佳用途。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to compare CE, BPR, LambdaRank, and LambdaMART by approach and best use.
q: 这四个损失的方法与最佳用途分别是什么?
q_en: What are each loss's approach and best use?
why: 粒度决定战场:CE 是 pointwise 概率(CTR),BPR 是 pairwise 相对序(召回),Lambda 系是 listwise 指标加权(重排/搜索)。
why_en: CE is pointwise for CTR, BPR pairwise for candidate generation, LambdaRank listwise for re-ranking, and LambdaMART lambda-gradients-in-GBDT for search ranking.
options: 四者用途完全可互换,选哪个都不影响线上结果
CE→CTR;BPR→召回;LambdaRank→重排;LambdaMART→搜索
CE 拿来做重排、LambdaRank 拿来做 CTR 预估,和实际用途正好相反
四者都是 pointwise 损失,只是各自名字不同而已
options_en: All four are interchangeable and the choice changes nothing in production.
CE→CTR; BPR→candidate generation; LambdaRank→re-ranking; LambdaMART→search.
CE gets used for re-ranking and LambdaRank for CTR prediction — exactly the reverse of practice.
All four are pointwise losses that merely go by different names.
optionExplanations: 它们粒度和目标不同,用途不可互换,混用会牺牲各自优势。
对;选损失等于选阶段——先问这一步要绝对概率、相对序还是整表指标。
角色说反了:CE 做 CTR/pointwise,LambdaRank 做 listwise 重排。
只有 CE 逐项打分;BPR 比较成对高低,Lambda 家族看整张列表。
optionExplanations_en: They differ in granularity and goal, so uses aren't interchangeable and mixing sacrifices each one's strength.
Correct — picking a loss is picking a stage: ask whether this step needs an absolute probability, a relative order, or a whole-list metric.
Roles reversed: CE is for CTR/pointwise and LambdaRank for listwise re-ranking.
Only CE scores items one by one; BPR compares pairs and the Lambda family looks at the whole list.
tradeoff: pointwise/pairwise vs listwise:越贴近 NDCG 的粒度越准,单次训练也越贵

scenario: 面试官问"模型校准得好"到底是什么意思。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what 'the model is well-calibrated' actually means.
q: 校准良好的定义是什么?
q_en: What is the definition of well-calibrated?
why: 校准良好=在所有模型输出 P=0.3 的曝光里,约 30% 真的发生了点击;即预测概率与实际频率一致。它和排序能力(AUC)是两回事:模型可以排序很好但概率系统性偏高/偏低。
why_en: Well-calibrated means among all impressions where the model says P=0.3, about 30% actually click — predicted probabilities match observed frequencies.
options: 模型的 AUC 越高就越校准,两者其实是一回事
在预测 P=0.3 的样本里约 30% 真的发生了
校准指模型在测试集上的准确率超过 90%
校准指模型对每个样本都输出 0 或 1 的确定预测
options_en: The higher the AUC the better calibrated — the two are really the same thing.
Among all impressions predicted at P=0.3, about 30% actually happen.
Calibration means the model exceeds 90% accuracy on the test set.
Calibration means the model outputs a hard 0 or 1 for every sample.
optionExplanations: AUC 只看排序,不看概率绝对值,高 AUC 也可能概率系统偏差、不校准。
对;校准是"预测概率=实际频率",与排序能力独立,竞价/阈值依赖它。
校准不是准确率,一个高准确率模型概率也可能不校准。
输出确定 0/1 反而丢了概率信息,与校准无关。
optionExplanations_en: AUC only measures ranking, not absolute probability; high AUC can still be systematically biased and miscalibrated.
Correct — calibration is 'predicted probability equals observed frequency', independent of ranking, relied on by bidding/thresholds.
Calibration isn't accuracy; a high-accuracy model can still be miscalibrated.
Outputting hard 0/1 discards probability information and is unrelated to calibration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测概率与真实频率一致的程度,说 0.3 就约 30% 会发生。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration is how well predicted probabilities match true frequencies, so 0.3 means about 30% occur.

scenario: 广告竞价按 bid=P(click)×出价价值报价,模型的 P(click) 系统性偏高。
scenario_en: Ad bidding sets bid=P(click)×bid_value, and the model's P(click) is systematically inflated.
q: P(click) 校准偏差在二价拍卖里造成什么后果?
q_en: What does miscalibrated P(click) cause in a second-price auction?
why: 因为出价直接乘以 P(click):高估 P(click)→出价偏高→超支/多花钱;低估→出价偏低→丢掉本该赢的曝光、流失营收。所以竞价系统对校准的敏感度极高,光有高 AUC 不够。
why_en: Since bid multiplies by P(click), overestimation overbids and overspends while underestimation underbids and loses winnable impressions and revenue.
options: 没有后果,拍卖只看排序,不看概率的绝对值
高估→超支多花钱,低估→丢曝光,竞价对校准极敏感
只会拖慢训练速度,对最终的出价没有影响
会让离线 AUC 下降,但出价金额完全不受影响
options_en: No consequence — the auction only looks at ranking, not absolute probabilities.
Overestimate and you overspend; underestimate and you lose impressions — bidding is highly calibration-sensitive.
It only slows down training and has no effect on the final bid.
It lowers offline AUC, but the bid amount is completely unaffected.
optionExplanations: 出价直接乘 P(click),概率绝对值错就出价错,不只是排序问题。
对;高估超支、低估丢量,是校准差在竞价里的直接金钱后果。
校准偏差影响的是出价金额,不是训练速度。
校准与 AUC 独立,偏差主要害的是出价而非 AUC。
optionExplanations_en: The bid multiplies by P(click), so wrong absolute probability means wrong bids, not just ranking.
Correct — overestimation overspends and underestimation loses volume, the direct monetary cost of poor calibration in bidding.
Calibration error affects bid amounts, not training speed.
Calibration is independent of AUC; the error mainly harms bids, not AUC.

scenario: 欺诈/医疗分诊用固定阈值(如 0.5)决定是否告警,模型对真实概率 0.4 的样本却输出 0.8。
scenario_en: Fraud/medical triage uses a fixed threshold (e.g. 0.5) to alert, but the model outputs 0.8 for a case whose true probability is 0.4.
q: 校准偏差在阈值决策里造成什么问题?
q_en: What problem does miscalibration cause in threshold-based decisions?
why: 阈值决策直接把概率和临界值比:真实 0.4 却报 0.8,会越过 0.5 阈值触发大量本不该有的告警(过多误报),挤占人工复核、侵蚀对系统的信任。这类系统必须概率校准,阈值才有意义。
why_en: Threshold decisions compare probability to a cutoff, so reporting 0.8 when true is 0.4 crosses the threshold and triggers excessive false alarms that erode trust.
options: 没影响,阈值决策只看排序不依赖概率数值
真实 0.4 报 0.8 会越过阈值,误报激增
只会让模型变得更保守,告警数量因此明显减少而已
会同时提升召回率和精确率,而且完全没有任何副作用
options_en: No impact — threshold decisions look at ranking and never at the probability value.
A true 0.4 reported as 0.8 crosses the cutoff, so false alarms spike.
It would only make the model more conservative, noticeably cutting the number of alerts.
It improves both recall and precision at once, with absolutely no side effects.
optionExplanations: 阈值决策正是拿概率数值和临界值比,数值错决策就错。
对;高估越过阈值→误报暴增→人工复核过载、信任下降,这是阈值系统的校准代价。
高估是更激进而非保守,会增加而不是减少告警。
误报暴增有明显副作用(信任和人力),精确率也会因误报增多而下降,不是没有代价的双重提升。
optionExplanations_en: Threshold decisions compare the probability value to a cutoff, so a wrong value means a wrong decision.
Correct — overestimation crosses the threshold, spiking false alarms, overloading review and eroding trust, the calibration cost in threshold systems.
Overestimation is more aggressive, not conservative, increasing rather than reducing alerts.
A spike in false alarms has clear downsides (trust and labor), and precision also drops as alarms flood in — not a cost-free double gain.

scenario: 线上模型概率明显不校准,要排查常见成因。
scenario_en: A production model is clearly miscalibrated, and you must diagnose common causes.
q: 以下哪些是常见的概率不校准成因?(多选)
q_en: Which are common causes of miscalibration? (multiple)
why: 常见成因:重正则(把概率往中间压)、focal loss(重塑损失景观、牺牲校准换聚焦难例)、不均衡数据。CE 在均衡数据上开箱校准较好,但生产数据很少均衡。识别成因才能决定是否上后处理校准。
why_en: Common causes are heavy regularization, focal loss (reshapes the loss landscape), and imbalanced data.
options: 过重的正则化
focal loss(重塑损失景观,牺牲校准换聚焦难例)
类别不均衡的数据
使用了 GPU 而非 CPU 训练
options_en: Heavy regularization.
Focal loss (reshapes the loss landscape, trading calibration for hard-example focus).
Class-imbalanced data.
Training on GPU instead of CPU.
optionExplanations: 对;强正则把概率往中间压,削弱与真实频率的对应,导致不校准。
对;focal 为聚焦难例重塑损失,常以牺牲概率校准为代价。
对;不均衡数据让 CE 的开箱校准假设失效,概率系统性偏移。
错;GPU/CPU 只是硬件,不改变模型输出概率的校准性。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — heavy regularization squeezes probabilities toward the middle, weakening the match to true frequency.
Correct — focal reshapes the loss to focus on hard examples, often at the cost of calibration.
Correct — imbalanced data breaks CE's out-of-the-box calibration assumption, biasing probabilities.
Wrong — GPU vs CPU is just hardware and doesn't change output calibration.

scenario: 要量化模型校准程度,常见两个指标是 ECE 和 Brier score。
scenario_en: To quantify calibration, two common metrics are ECE and Brier score.
q: ECE 和 Brier score 各衡量什么?
q_en: What does each of ECE and Brier score measure?
why: ECE 把样本按预测概率分桶,取每桶 |预测−实际| 的加权平均,纯粹衡量校准误差;Brier score 是"概率 vs 0/1 结果"的均方误差,同时捕捉校准和区分度。ECE 专测校准,Brier 更综合。
why_en: ECE is the weighted average of per-bin |predicted-observed| measuring calibration only, while Brier score is the MSE of probability vs binary outcome capturing both calibration and discrimination.
options: 两者完全等价,在任何模型上数值总是相同
ECE 分桶测校准误差;Brier 是概率与 0/1 的均方误差
ECE 衡量的是区分度、Brier 只衡量校准误差,和实际角色正好相反
两者都只是 AUC 的变体,和概率校准无关
options_en: They are fully equivalent and always give the same number on any model.
ECE bins predictions to measure calibration error; Brier is the squared error of probability vs the 0/1 outcome.
ECE measures discrimination and Brier only measures calibration error — exactly the reverse of reality.
Both are just AUC variants and say nothing about calibration.
optionExplanations: 两者衡量的侧重不同(纯校准 vs 校准+区分),数值也不同,不等价。
对;ECE 分桶纯测校准,Brier 用 MSE 综合校准与区分度,分工清楚。
角色说反了:ECE 专测校准,Brier 才兼顾区分度。
两者都直接关乎校准,不是只测 AUC。
optionExplanations_en: They emphasize different things (calibration only vs calibration plus discrimination) and differ numerically — not equivalent.
Correct — ECE bins to measure calibration purely, Brier uses MSE to capture both calibration and discrimination, a clean split.
Roles reversed: ECE measures calibration and Brier also captures discrimination.
Both directly concern calibration, not just AUC.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按预测概率分桶,各桶 |预测−实际| 的加权平均,衡量整体校准误差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ECE (Expected Calibration Error) bins by predicted probability and takes the weighted average of per-bin |predicted-observed|.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测概率与 0/1 结果之间的均方误差,同时反映校准与区分度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Brier score is the mean squared error between predicted probability and the binary outcome, reflecting calibration and discrimination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 画预测概率 vs 实际频率,曲线在对角线下方=过度自信。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reliability diagram plots predicted vs observed probability; a curve below the diagonal means overconfidence.

tradeoff: 专测 vs 综合:ECE 只报校准误差,Brier 把校准与区分度混在一个数里

scenario: 模型不校准,验证数据有限,可靠性图大致呈 S 形(sigmoid 样),要选一个后处理校准方法。
scenario_en: The model is miscalibrated, validation data is limited, and the reliability diagram is roughly sigmoidal; pick a post-hoc calibration method.
q: 默认该用哪种后处理校准?
q_en: Which post-hoc calibration should be the default?
why: 验证数据有限时选 Platt scaling:只拟合两个参数 P=σ(a·z+b),假设可靠性曲线呈 sigmoid,不易过拟合。数据充足才轮到非参 isotonic。
why_en: Use Platt scaling: a 2-parameter logistic on the logit, which assumes a sigmoidal curve, resists overfitting on limited data, and is the default.
options: isotonic regression,非参数最灵活,验证数据少也无所谓
Platt scaling:在 logit 上拟合两参数 logistic
直接重训整个模型,不做任何后处理校准
把所有输出概率统一乘 0.5,简单粗暴地压低
options_en: Isotonic regression — non-parametric and most flexible, and scarce validation data is fine.
Platt scaling: fit a two-parameter logistic on the logit.
Retrain the whole model from scratch instead of any post-hoc calibration.
Multiply every output probability by 0.5 to bluntly push them down.
whenOtherWins: 当验证数据充足、且可靠性图明显非 sigmoid 时,才换非参的 isotonic regression 去拟合非 S 形模式。
optionExplanations: isotonic 非参更灵活但吃数据,验证数据有限时容易过拟合,不该做默认。
对;两参数、假设 sigmoid、抗过拟合,数据有限+曲线近 S 形时 Platt 是稳妥默认。
后处理校准就是为了不重训整模型,重训代价大且未必解决校准。
统一乘常数不是按可靠性曲线拟合,治不了系统性校准偏差。
optionExplanations_en: Isotonic is more flexible but data-hungry, prone to overfit on limited validation data — not the default.
Correct — two parameters, a sigmoidal assumption, and overfit resistance make Platt the safe default on limited, near-S-shaped data.
Post-hoc calibration exists to avoid retraining the whole model, which is costly and may not fix calibration.
Multiplying by a constant isn't fitting the reliability curve and won't fix systematic calibration bias.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后处理校准:在 logit 上拟合两参数 logistic P=σ(a·z+b),假设 sigmoid 曲线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Platt scaling is post-hoc calibration fitting a 2-parameter logistic P=sigmoid(a*z+b) on the logit, assuming a sigmoidal curve.

termDefinitions.meaning: 过 sigmoid 之前的原始分数 z,Platt scaling 直接在它上面做线性变换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The logit is the raw pre-sigmoid score z, on which Platt scaling applies a linear transform.

tradeoff: 少参稳健(Platt) vs 非参灵活(isotonic):按验证集数据量决定

scenario: 验证数据非常充足,可靠性图明显不是 S 形(有明显的非 sigmoid 弯折)。
scenario_en: Validation data is abundant, and the reliability diagram is clearly non-sigmoidal (with distinct non-sigmoid kinks).
q: 这种情况下该换哪种校准方法?
q_en: Which calibration method should you switch to here?
why: 换 isotonic regression:它是非参的单调阶梯函数,不假设分布,能拟合 Platt 的 sigmoid 假设抓不住的非 S 形模式。代价是需要大量验证数据才不过拟合——正好本场景数据充足,条件满足。
why_en: Switch to isotonic regression: a non-parametric monotonic step function that fits non-sigmoidal patterns Platt can't, given abundant validation data.
options: 坚持用 Platt scaling 就够了,sigmoid 假设放在哪里都成立
isotonic regression:非参单调阶梯,能拟合非 S 形曲线
不做校准,验证数据一多模型就会自动校准
把 γ 调大改用 focal loss,顺便把校准也做了
options_en: Stick with Platt scaling — that's enough, since the sigmoid assumption holds everywhere.
Isotonic regression: a non-parametric monotonic step function that fits non-sigmoidal curves.
Skip calibration; with enough validation data the model calibrates itself.
Raise gamma and switch to focal loss to get calibration as a side effect.
whenOtherWins: 若验证数据有限或曲线本就近 sigmoid,Platt scaling 更稳、不易过拟合,不该上 isotonic。
optionExplanations: 曲线明显非 S 形时,两参数 logistic 拟合不出这些弯折,校准反而更差。
对;阶梯只保证单调、不限形状,所以能贴住 Platt 抓不住的弯折。
数据多不会自动校准,不均衡/正则等成因仍在,需显式后处理。
focal 是训练损失不是校准方法,调 γ 反而可能更不校准。
optionExplanations_en: When the curve is clearly non-sigmoidal, a two-parameter logistic cannot bend to fit it and calibration gets worse.
Correct — the step function only enforces monotonicity, not a shape, so it hugs the kinks Platt misses.
More data does not auto-calibrate; causes like imbalance or regularization persist and need explicit post-hoc fixing.
Focal is a training loss, not a calibration method; raising gamma can worsen calibration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非参的单调阶梯校准函数,不假设分布,能拟合非 sigmoid 形状但吃数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Isotonic regression is a non-parametric monotonic step calibration function that fits non-sigmoidal shapes but needs much data.

tradeoff: 拟合灵活度 vs 过拟合风险:isotonic 更灵活但要大量验证数据兜底

scenario: 回忆 focal loss 的公式与各因子作用。
scenario_en: Recall the focal loss formula and each factor's role.
q: 补全 focal loss 公式:
q_en: Fill in the focal loss formula:
text: L_focal = −α_t · {{(1−p_t)^γ}} · log(p_t);其中调制因子在 p_t→1 时趋近 {{0}},静默{{易分}}样本的梯度。
text_en: L_focal = −α_t · {{(1−p_t)^γ}} · log(p_t); the modulating factor approaches {{0}} as p_t to 1, silencing {{easy}}-example gradients.
why: α_t 平衡正负类权重,(1−p_t)^γ 是聚焦难例的调制因子:置信越高压得越狠,把梯度让给难样本。γ=0 时退化回普通交叉熵。
why_en: Alpha balances class weights and (1-p_t)^gamma focuses on hard examples, silencing confident ones, reverting to cross-entropy at gamma=0.

scenario: 线上 CTR 模型概率不校准,要走一遍诊断到修复再监控的完整流程。
scenario_en: A production CTR model is miscalibrated; walk the full diagnose-fix-monitor flow.
q: 把生产环境校准处理流程排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the production calibration workflow correctly:
steps: 用可靠性图/ECE 诊断:曲线在对角线下方=过度自信
在留出验证集上拟合后处理校准(默认 Platt scaling)
上线后持续监控 ECE,数据漂移时重拟合
在留出验证集上选方法:近 sigmoid+数据有限用 Platt,非 sigmoid+数据充足用 isotonic
why: 先用可靠性图/ECE 诊断偏差方向,再据曲线形状和数据量选方法(Platt vs isotonic),在留出集上拟合,最后上线持续监控 ECE、随漂移重拟合。"在验证集上做 Platt scaling 并线上监控 ECE"是资深级信号。
why_en: Diagnose with a reliability diagram/ECE, choose the method by curve shape and data, fit on a held-out split, then monitor ECE in production and refit on drift.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  D["诊断 ECE/可靠性图"] --> S["选方法"]
  S --> F["验证集拟合"]
  F --> M["线上监控 ECE"]

scenario: 两个 CTR 模型 AUC 相同,但一个概率校准、一个系统性高估,都要接进二价广告竞价。
scenario_en: Two CTR models share AUC, but one is calibrated and one systematically overestimates, both feeding a second-price ad auction.
q: 为什么"最大化 AUC"不足以保证竞价系统赚钱?
q_en: Why is maximizing AUC insufficient to make a bidding system profitable?
why: AUC 只看排序(谁点击概率更高),不看概率绝对值。竞价 bid=P(click)×价值直接吃概率绝对值,校准差的模型即使 AUC 一样也会扭曲出价、悄悄超支或丢量。所以竞价系统要显式盯校准(ECE),不能只优化 AUC。
why_en: AUC only measures ordering, but bidding uses absolute P(click), so an equally-ranked but miscalibrated model distorts bids and loses money.
options: AUC 已经包含校准信息,最大化 AUC 就足够了
AUC 只看排序,竞价吃概率绝对值,校准差会扭曲出价
两个模型只要 AUC 相同,就一定同样赚钱
竞价只看排序,概率的绝对值完全无关紧要
options_en: AUC already contains calibration information, so maximizing AUC is enough.
AUC only ranks; bidding consumes the absolute probability, so poor calibration distorts bids.
Two models with the same AUC are guaranteed to make the same money.
Bidding only cares about ranking, so absolute probabilities are irrelevant.
optionExplanations: AUC 不含校准信息,排序一样但概率可系统偏移,AUC 看不出来。
对;所以竞价系统的上线门槛要额外挂一个 ECE 阈值,只看 AUC 会放行亏钱模型。
AUC 相同但校准不同,盈利能力可以差很多,不能只看 AUC。
出价是概率乘以转化价值,概率的绝对值恰恰是决定花多少钱的那一项。
optionExplanations_en: AUC carries no calibration info; equal ranking can hide a systematic probability shift AUC can't see.
Correct — so a bidding system needs an explicit ECE gate at launch, since an AUC-only gate would ship a money-losing model.
Equal AUC with different calibration can differ greatly in profitability, so AUC alone isn't enough.
The bid is the probability times conversion value, so the absolute probability is exactly what sets how much you spend.

scenario: 一个 300M 参数的 ViT 要跑在手机上,预算 <50MB 内存、<10ms 延迟,准确率还不能崩。
scenario_en: A 300M-param ViT must run on a phone under 50MB memory / 10ms latency without wrecking accuracy.
q: 把模型压到部署预算内,该按什么顺序试压缩手段?
q_en: To fit the deployment budget, in what order should you try compression techniques?
why: 按成本从低到高依次试:量化→剪枝→蒸馏→NAS,达到预算就停。先试最便宜的量化,不够再叠更贵的手段。这样用最小代价满足 <50MB/<10ms,而不是一上来就烧 NAS 的上千 GPU 小时。
why_en: Apply cheapest-to-most-expensive — quantization, pruning, distillation, NAS — stopping once the budget is met, rather than jumping to the costliest first.
diagram:
flowchart LR Q["量化
最便宜"] --> P["剪枝"] P --> D["蒸馏"] D --> N["NAS
最贵"]
options: 先上最贵的 NAS 从头搜一个新架构,图省事一步到位
按成本从低到高:量化→剪枝→蒸馏→NAS,达到预算就停
只申请加大手机内存配额来装下原模型,完全不压缩
随便挑一个手段(比如先上蒸馏)压到底,不排成本顺序
options_en: Start with the costliest NAS to search a new architecture from scratch, hoping to get there in one shot.
Go cheapest to most expensive: quantization, pruning, distillation, NAS, stopping once the budget is met.
Just request a bigger phone memory quota to fit the original model without compressing at all.
Pick any one technique at random (say, distillation first) and push it all the way, ignoring cost order.
whenOtherWins: 若便宜手段(量化/剪枝/蒸馏)都达不到预算,或本就要为该硬件长期投入,才值得上 NAS 从头搜架构。
optionExplanations: NAS 最贵(上千 GPU 小时),一上来就用是杀鸡用牛刀,多数预算靠更便宜手段就能满足。
对;成本递增地试、达标即停,是用最小代价满足部署约束的成熟做法。
改硬件不是模型压缩,手机内存/延迟预算通常是硬约束,改不了。
不按成本顺序可能既费力又过度,合理做法是先便宜后昂贵、够了就停。
optionExplanations_en: NAS is costliest (thousands of GPU-hours); leading with it is overkill when cheaper techniques usually meet the budget.
Correct — escalating cost and stopping when met is the mature way to satisfy deployment constraints at minimal cost.
Changing hardware isn't model compression, and phone memory/latency budgets are usually hard constraints.
Ignoring cost order risks both effort and over-engineering; the sound approach is cheap-first and stop when enough.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在尽量保住准确率的前提下缩小模型体积/延迟,以适配部署约束。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Model compression shrinks a model's size/latency while preserving accuracy, to meet deployment constraints.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自动搜索高效网络结构的方法,效果好但历史上算力开销极大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NAS (Neural Architecture Search) automatically searches efficient architectures, effective but historically very compute-heavy.

category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 面试官问决定"微调预训练模型还是从头训"要看哪两个维度。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks which two dimensions decide 'fine-tune a pretrained model vs train from scratch'.
q: 迁移学习的决策该沿哪两个轴判断?
q_en: Along which two axes should you make the transfer-learning decision?
why: 两个轴:任务与源任务的相似度、目标域有标注数据量。相似度高→可复用预训练特征;数据量大→敢多解冻/从头训。四象限各对应不同策略,别一律"直接微调预训练模型",要说清自己落在哪个象限。
why_en: Decide on task similarity to the source and target labeled-data volume; the four quadrants map to different strategies.
options: 只看模型参数量:参数越大就越该全量微调
任务相似度 + 目标域标注数据量,两轴四象限
只看 GPU 预算:算力够就全量微调,不够只训 head
看模型发表年份和作者名气,挑最新最有名的骨干
options_en: Only parameter count: the bigger the model, the more it should be fully fine-tuned.
Task similarity plus target labeled-data volume — two axes, four quadrants.
Only GPU budget: full fine-tune if compute allows, otherwise train just the head.
Publication year and author fame — pick the newest, most famous backbone.
optionExplanations: 参数量不决定该微调还是从头训,相似度和数据量才是判据。
对;相似度决定能否复用特征、数据量决定能解冻多少/敢不敢从头训,两轴四象限。
GPU 预算是约束不是决定迁移策略的核心两轴。
年份和名气与迁移决策无关,是无信息维度。
optionExplanations_en: Parameter count doesn't decide fine-tune vs from-scratch; similarity and data volume are the criteria.
Correct — similarity governs feature reuse and data volume governs how much to unfreeze or whether to train fresh, giving four quadrants.
GPU budget is a constraint, not the core two axes of transfer strategy.
Year and fame are irrelevant to the transfer decision, uninformative dimensions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 拿在大数据上预训练的模型作起点,在目标任务上微调,省数据省算力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transfer learning starts from a model pretrained on large data and fine-tunes it on the target task.

termDefinitions.meaning: 目标任务与预训练源任务在数据分布/特征上的接近程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Task similarity is how close the target task is to the pretraining source task in data distribution and features.

category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 医学影像分类,骨干用 ImageNet 预训练(任务相似),但只有几千张有标注医学图。
scenario_en: Medical-image classification on an ImageNet-pretrained backbone (similar task) with only a few thousand labeled images.
q: 高相似度+小数据该怎么微调?
q_en: High similarity plus small data — how do you fine-tune?
why: 冻结骨干、只微调 head:任务相似说明预训练特征可直接复用,数据少则解冻太多层会过拟合。只训 head 让可训练参数最少,用几千张也能稳。首要风险就是解冻层数过多导致过拟合。
why_en: Freeze the base and fine-tune only the head: similar tasks reuse pretrained features, and with little data unfreezing too many layers overfits.
options: 全量微调所有层,数据少也要让模型充分适应
冻结骨干,只微调 head(可训练参数最少)
从头训一个新模型,不复用 ImageNet 预训练权重
解冻一半层并随机初始化再训,兼顾复用与适应
options_en: Full fine-tune every layer; even with little data, let the model fully adapt.
Freeze the backbone and fine-tune only the head, keeping trainable params minimal.
Train a new model from scratch, not reusing the ImageNet pretrained weights.
Unfreeze half the layers, re-initialize them randomly, and train — reuse plus adaptation.
whenOtherWins: 当同样高相似但目标数据量很大时,可全量微调并配 layer-wise LR decay,以更充分适应目标域。
optionExplanations: 小数据全量微调会过拟合,解冻越多可训练参数越多,几千张撑不住。
对;冻骨干+训 head 把可训练参数压到最小,复用特征又不过拟合,是该象限标准解。
任务相似时从头训浪费了可复用的预训练特征,小数据更训不好。
随机初始化解冻层丢掉了预训练权重,等于半从头训,小数据下更容易崩。
optionExplanations_en: Full fine-tuning on small data overfits; more unfrozen layers means more trainable params that a few thousand images can't support.
Correct — freeze base plus train head minimizes trainable params, reusing features without overfitting, the standard quadrant solution.
From scratch on a similar task wastes reusable pretrained features and trains worse on small data.
Randomly re-initializing unfrozen layers discards pretrained weights, effectively half-from-scratch, more likely to collapse on small data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把某些层的权重固定不参与训练,只训未冻结部分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Freezing fixes certain layers' weights so only the unfrozen parts train.

termDefinitions.meaning: 接在骨干之上的任务专属输出层,微调时常只训它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The head is the task-specific output layer atop the backbone, often the only part fine-tuned.

tradeoff: 复用预训练特征 vs 解冻层数带来的过拟合风险
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 把 BERT 微调到搜索排序,任务相似度高,而且有大量标注数据。
scenario_en: Fine-tuning BERT for search ranking, a similar task, with a large amount of labeled data.
q: 高相似度+大数据该怎么训?
q_en: High similarity plus large data — how do you train?
why: 全量微调 + layer-wise 学习率衰减(浅层小 lr、深层大 lr):数据多足以调动全部参数,分层 lr 让接近输入的通用层小步微调、接近输出的任务层大步适应。主要风险是 lr 太大导致灾难性遗忘。
why_en: Full fine-tune with layer-wise LR decay (small LR for early layers, higher for late), since large data supports tuning all params while decay guards against catastrophic forgetting.
options: 只冻结骨干训 head,大数据下也不必动骨干
全量微调,配 layer-wise LR decay
从头随机初始化训练,丢掉 BERT 已学到的预训练权重
只训练最后一层的偏置项,其余参数全部冻结
options_en: Freeze the backbone and train only the head; even with big data, leave the base alone.
Full fine-tune with layer-wise LR decay.
Train from scratch with random init, discarding BERT's already-learned pretrained weights.
Train only the last layer bias terms and freeze everything else.
whenOtherWins: 若同样高相似但数据很少,应退回"冻骨干只训 head",因为全量微调在小数据上会过拟合。
optionExplanations: 数据充足时只训 head 没充分利用数据,骨干也能安全适应目标域,收益被浪费。
对;大数据支撑全量微调,layer-wise LR decay 兼顾通用层稳定与任务层适应,防遗忘。
任务相似时从头训浪费预训练,收敛更慢、效果通常更差。
只训偏置项可训练容量太小,大数据高相似场景发挥不出来。
optionExplanations_en: With ample data, head-only underuses it; the base can safely adapt too, so the gain is wasted.
Correct — large data supports full fine-tuning, and layer-wise LR decay balances stable general layers with adapting task layers, guarding against forgetting.
From scratch on a similar task wastes pretraining, converging slower and usually worse.
Training only biases has too little capacity to exploit large-data high-similarity settings.

termDefinitions.term: layer-wise LR decay / 分层学习率衰减
termDefinitions.meaning: 越靠近输入的层用越小学习率,越靠近输出的层用越大,防通用层被大步改坏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Layer-wise LR decay uses smaller learning rates for earlier layers and larger for later ones, protecting general layers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 微调时学习率过大,模型迅速覆盖掉预训练学到的通用知识。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Catastrophic forgetting is when a too-high fine-tuning LR quickly overwrites the general knowledge learned in pretraining.

tradeoff: 全参数适应能力 vs 灾难性遗忘的风险
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 用 NLP 骨干去做卫星影像任务(任务极不相似),而且只有很少标注数据——最危险的象限。
scenario_en: Using an NLP backbone for satellite imagery (very dissimilar) with little labeled data — the most dangerous quadrant.
q: 低相似度+小数据该怎么办?
q_en: Low similarity plus small data — what do you do?
why: 这是最危险的象限:直接全量微调不相关骨干会负迁移+遗忘。走 PEFT(少量新增参数试探性适配)或干脆从头训小模型;别硬套不相关的预训练权重。数据太少还要防过拟合。
why_en: This most dangerous quadrant risks negative transfer, so use PEFT or train a small model from scratch rather than forcing an unrelated backbone.
options: 全量微调这个不相关骨干,让它彻底适应新任务
走 PEFT 或从头训小模型,别硬套不相关骨干
冻结骨干只训 head,复用不相关特征也无妨
直接拿骨干做零样本推理,一个参数都不训练
options_en: Full fine-tune this unrelated backbone so it fully adapts to the new task.
Use PEFT or train a small model from scratch; do not force an unrelated backbone.
Freeze the backbone and train only the head; reusing unrelated features is fine.
Just run the backbone zero-shot and train nothing at all.
whenOtherWins: 若同样低相似但数据量很大,直接从头训练更稳妥,数据足以支撑不依赖任何迁移。
optionExplanations: 全量微调不相关骨干易负迁移,小数据还会过拟合,是这象限最典型的坑。
对;PEFT 试探性适配或从头训小模型,避开硬套不相关权重的负迁移,是该象限稳妥解。
骨干特征与卫星影像不相关,复用它等于给 head 灌无用甚至误导的特征。
任务极不相似,零样本推理几乎没有可迁移信号,不训练无从适配。
optionExplanations_en: Full fine-tuning an unrelated backbone invites negative transfer and small-data overfitting, the classic trap of this quadrant.
Correct — PEFT for tentative adaptation or a small from-scratch model avoids forcing unrelated weights, the safe quadrant solution.
The backbone's features are unrelated to satellite imagery, so reusing them feeds the head useless or misleading features.
With very low similarity, zero-shot has almost no transferable signal, and no training means no adaptation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 冻结大部分权重,只更新少量新增参数的微调范式,如 LoRA。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PEFT (Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning) freezes most weights and updates only a small added set, e.g. LoRA.

termDefinitions.meaning: 源任务与目标不相关时,迁移不但没帮助反而损害目标任务性能。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative transfer is when an unrelated source task hurts rather than helps the target task.

tradeoff: 迁移省数据 vs 负迁移与小数据过拟合
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 在专有特征上做欺诈模型,和任何公开预训练任务都不相似,但自有标注数据量很大。
scenario_en: A fraud model on proprietary features, dissimilar to any public pretraining, but with a large in-house labeled dataset.
q: 低相似度+大数据该怎么选?
q_en: Low similarity plus large data — which strategy?
why: 从头训练(或仅用预训练权重做初始化):数据量足以支撑从零学到专有特征的表示,而任务不相似意味着迁移可能是负的、白搭。主要风险是若强行迁移不相关模型只会浪费算力。
why_en: Train from scratch (or use pretrained weights only as init): ample data supports learning proprietary features, while dissimilarity makes transfer likely negative.
options: 冻结公开预训练骨干只训 head,省事又省算力
从头训练,或只把预训练权重当初始化
只做零样本推理,一个参数都不训练
用 LoRA 在不相关骨干上加适配器就够了
options_en: Freeze the public pretrained backbone and train only the head — easy and compute-cheap.
Train from scratch, or use pretrained weights merely as initialization.
Do zero-shot inference only and train no parameters at all.
Just add LoRA adapters on top of the unrelated backbone.
whenOtherWins: 若任务其实与某个预训练源相似,即使数据多也该优先全量微调复用特征,而非从头训。
optionExplanations: 不相关骨干的特征对专有欺诈特征没用,冻它训 head 等于用错的特征底座。
对;数据足以从头学专有表示,不相似让迁移收益存疑,从头训避免负迁移浪费。
零样本对专有特征没有可迁移信号,不训练无法建模。
LoRA 仍依赖骨干原有表示,骨干不相关时适配器也补不回缺失的相关特征。
optionExplanations_en: An unrelated backbone's features are useless for proprietary fraud features, so freezing it and training the head uses the wrong base.
Correct — ample data supports learning proprietary representations, and dissimilarity makes transfer dubious, so from-scratch avoids wasted negative transfer.
Zero-shot has no transferable signal for proprietary features, and no training means no modeling.
LoRA still relies on the backbone's representations, which an unrelated backbone lacks, so adapters can't recover the missing relevant features.
tradeoff: 迁移省算力 vs 任务不相似带来的负迁移
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 面试官要你用一张四象限表说清迁移策略,别一律"直接微调"。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to lay out the four-quadrant transfer strategy instead of defaulting to 'just fine-tune'.
q: 任务相似度×数据量的四象限分别对应什么策略?
q_en: What strategy does each quadrant of similarity x data volume map to?
why: 高相似小数据→冻骨干只训 head;高相似大数据→全量微调+分层 lr;低相似小数据→PEFT/从头训(最危险);低相似大数据→从头训。相似度决定复用多少,数据量决定能改多少,别默认"直接微调预训练模型"。
why_en: High-sim small-data freezes to head-only, high-sim big-data full fine-tunes with LR decay, low-sim small-data uses PEFT/from-scratch, low-sim big-data trains from scratch.
options: 不分象限,一律"直接微调预训练模型"就够用了
四象限各配一策:冻 head / 全量 / PEFT / 从头
数据越多就越该冻结骨干、数据越少就越该全量微调,和实际相反
四象限用的策略其实完全一样,只是叫法不同罢了
options_en: No quadrants needed — always just fine-tune the pretrained model.
Each quadrant gets its own strategy: freeze head, full fine-tune, PEFT, or from scratch.
More data means more freezing and less data means full fine-tuning — reversed from reality.
All four quadrants really use the same strategy under different names.
optionExplanations: 一律直接微调忽略象限差异,低相似时会负迁移、小数据时会过拟合。
对;四象限各有其解,相似度定复用、数据量定改动幅度,这才是成熟答法。
关系说反了:数据多才敢全量微调,数据少才要冻结防过拟合。
四象限策略实质不同,冻结/全量/PEFT/从头各异,不是名字差异。
optionExplanations_en: Uniformly fine-tuning ignores quadrant differences, risking negative transfer at low similarity and overfitting on small data.
Correct — each quadrant has its solution, with similarity setting reuse and data setting change magnitude, the mature answer.
The relationship is reversed: more data enables full fine-tuning, less data needs freezing to avoid overfitting.
The quadrant strategies differ substantively (freeze/full/PEFT/scratch), not just in name.
tradeoff: 复用预训练特征的多少 vs 目标数据量允许改动的幅度
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 全量微调 BERT 时学习率设得偏大,发现模型在新任务上过一会儿反而通用能力全丢了。
scenario_en: Full fine-tuning BERT with a high learning rate, the model soon loses its general ability on the new task.
q: 这是什么问题,layer-wise LR decay 如何缓解?
q_en: What is this, and how does layer-wise LR decay mitigate it?
why: 这是灾难性遗忘:lr 太大把预训练学到的通用表示迅速覆盖掉。分层 lr 衰减给靠近输入的通用层很小的 lr(几乎不动)、靠近输出的任务层较大的 lr,既保住底层通用知识又让上层适应新任务。
why_en: It's catastrophic forgetting from a too-high LR; layer-wise LR decay gives tiny LRs to general early layers and larger LRs to task-specific late layers.
options: 是欠拟合,把学习率再调大一点让它更快收敛
灾难性遗忘;分层 lr 保住浅层通用知识,深层大步适应
是数据泄漏,和学习率的大小完全没有关系
是梯度消失,给深层加残差连接或换个更平滑的激活函数就能修复
options_en: It is underfitting; raise the learning rate further so it converges faster.
Catastrophic forgetting; layer-wise LR protects the general early layers while late layers adapt fast.
It is data leakage, entirely unrelated to the learning rate.
It is vanishing gradients; adding residual connections deeper or swapping in a smoother activation would fix it.
optionExplanations: 调更大 lr 只会加剧遗忘,方向完全反了。
对;分层 lr 让通用层小步、任务层大步,是防灾难性遗忘的标准手段。
遗忘是学习率过大覆盖预训练知识,与数据泄漏无关。
梯度消失是深层训练难题,和"通用能力被覆盖"是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Raising LR worsens forgetting, exactly the wrong direction.
Correct — layer-wise LR moves general layers slowly and task layers faster, the standard guard against catastrophic forgetting.
Forgetting is a too-high LR overwriting pretrained knowledge, unrelated to data leakage.
Vanishing gradients is a deep-training issue, different from general ability being overwritten.
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 要为一个大模型维护 10 个微调变体,全量微调时每个变体都要存一份完整的梯度/优化器状态副本。
scenario_en: Maintaining 10 fine-tuned variants of a large model, full fine-tuning stores a full gradient/optimizer-state copy per variant.
q: 全量微调在多变体/多租户服务下的核心痛点是什么?
q_en: What is full fine-tuning's core pain in multi-variant / multi-tenant serving?
why: 每个任务都存一整份权重+梯度/优化器副本,10 个变体=10 份完整模型压在显存/存储里,多租户服务成本高到不可行。PEFT 正是为此:冻结共享底座,每任务只存少量新增参数。
why_en: Each task keeps a full weight-plus-optimizer copy, so 10 variants means 10 full models in memory — too costly for multi-tenant serving, which PEFT fixes.
options: 每个变体存一整份完整副本,10 份压满显存/存储
全量微调的准确率一定低于 PEFT,和存储开销无关
全量微调无法在 GPU 上训练,只能退回 CPU 慢跑
变体越多推理反而越快,根本不构成问题
options_en: Each variant stores a full copy — ten of them saturate GPU memory and storage.
Full fine-tuning always scores below PEFT on accuracy, unrelated to storage.
Full fine-tuning cannot train on GPU and must fall back to slow CPU.
More variants actually make inference faster, so it is not a problem.
optionExplanations: 对;痛点是存储/显存爆炸——N 个任务 N 份完整模型,多租户服务养不起,这是 PEFT 的动机。
全量微调准确率通常不低于 PEFT,痛点在存储成本不在准确率。
全量微调完全能在 GPU 上训,这与事实不符。
变体多不会让推理更快,反而增加维护和存储负担。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the pain is storage/memory blowup (N tasks, N full models) that multi-tenant serving can't afford, the motivation for PEFT.
Full fine-tuning usually isn't less accurate than PEFT; the pain is storage cost, not accuracy.
Full fine-tuning trains fine on GPU; this is false.
More variants don't speed inference; they add maintenance and storage burden.
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 面试官问 LoRA 具体怎么用很少的参数逼近全量微调。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how LoRA approximates full fine-tuning with very few parameters.
q: LoRA 的低秩分解是怎么做的?
q_en: How does LoRA's low-rank decomposition work?
why: LoRA 把权重更新 ΔW 分解成两个小矩阵 A×B:A∈R^{d×r}、B∈R^{r×d},秩 r≪d。前向时用冻结的 W 输出加上这条低秩旁路 A×B。只训 A、B,可训练参数从十亿级降到百万级,精度接近全量微调。
why_en: LoRA factorizes the weight update ΔW into two small matrices A×B with rank r much less than d, training only A and B as a low-rank bypass alongside frozen W.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  X["输入"] --> W["冻结 W"]
  X --> A["A (d×r)"] --> B["B (r×d)"]
  W --> S["相加"]
  B --> S
  S --> O["输出"]
options: 把整个 W 重新训练一遍,换个名字改叫 LoRA 而已
把 ΔW 分解成两个小矩阵 A×B(r≪d),只训 A、B
随机丢弃一半权重使其归零来减参,靠稀疏化省显存
把 W 量化成 8-bit 低精度来省下参数量
options_en: Retrain the whole W from scratch and just relabel it LoRA.
Factorize ΔW into two small matrices A×B with rank r far below d, training only A and B.
Randomly zero out half the weights to cut params, relying on sparsity to save memory.
Quantize W down to 8-bit low precision to save parameters.
optionExplanations: LoRA 恰恰不重训整个 W,W 冻结,只训低秩旁路,这说反了。
对;低秩分解 A×B 把可训练参数压到百万级,前向叠加旁路,是 LoRA 的核心。
随机丢权重是剪枝/稀疏化,不是 LoRA 的低秩更新机制。
量化是降精度省存储,和 LoRA 的低秩参数高效微调是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: LoRA specifically doesn't retrain W; W is frozen and only the low-rank bypass trains — this is reversed.
Correct — low-rank A×B compresses trainable params to millions, with the bypass added in the forward pass, LoRA's core.
Randomly dropping weights is pruning/sparsity, not LoRA's low-rank update.
Quantization lowers precision to save storage, different from LoRA's low-rank parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把权重更新分解为两个低秩小矩阵 A×B、只训它们的 PEFT 方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) factorizes the weight update into two low-rank matrices A×B and trains only those.

termDefinitions.meaning: 低秩旁路的中间维度,r≪d 使新增参数极少(如 r=16)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rank r is the bottleneck dimension of the low-rank bypass; r much less than d keeps added params tiny (e.g. r=16).

category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 一个数十亿参数的大模型,用 LoRA 在 r=16 下微调。
scenario_en: A multi-billion-parameter model is fine-tuned with LoRA at r=16.
q: r=16 的 LoRA 在参数量和精度上意味着什么?
q_en: What does LoRA at r=16 mean for parameters and accuracy?
why: 低秩 r=16 让每个被适配的权重矩阵只新增 r×(d行+d列) 量级的参数,总量从数十亿级(全量)降到百万级 LoRA 参数,却能达到接近全量微调的精度。适配器体积小(几 MB),可在注册表里存上百个共享一个底座。
why_en: At r=16, LoRA adds only millions of parameters versus billions for full fine-tuning while reaching near full-FT accuracy, and adapters are a few MB each.
options: 参数量和全量微调一样多,精度也完全一样
可训练参数从数十亿降到百万级,精度接近全量
参数比全量微调更多,精度反而更低,得不偿失
r=16 意味着整个模型总共只有 16 个参数
options_en: Same parameter count as full fine-tuning, and identical accuracy.
Trainable params drop from billions to millions, with accuracy near full fine-tuning.
More params than full fine-tuning yet lower accuracy — a bad trade.
r=16 means the whole model has only sixteen parameters.
optionExplanations: LoRA 可训练参数远少于全量微调,不是一样多。
对;百万级参数换来接近全量的精度、几 MB 适配器,是 LoRA 高效的量级证据。
LoRA 参数更少而非更多,精度接近全量,不是得不偿失。
r 是低秩旁路的秩,不是总参数数,模型仍有数十亿参数。
optionExplanations_en: LoRA's trainable params are far fewer than full fine-tuning, not equal.
Correct — millions of params for near-full accuracy and few-MB adapters is the quantitative evidence of LoRA's efficiency.
LoRA has fewer params, not more, at near-full accuracy — not a bad trade.
r is the low-rank bypass's rank, not total parameter count; the model still has billions of params.
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 关心 LoRA 上线后会不会给推理加延迟,以及能否一个底座服务多任务。
scenario_en: You worry whether LoRA adds inference latency and whether one base can serve many tasks.
q: LoRA 的两种服务方式各是什么?
q_en: What are LoRA's two serving options?
why: 两种:①推理前把旁路合并进权重 W'=W+AB,之后前向和原模型完全一样,零额外延迟;②动态换适配器,一个冻结底座按请求挂不同 LoRA,服务多任务。适配器几 MB,可在注册表里存上百个配一个底座。
why_en: Either merge at inference W'=W+AB for zero added latency, or dynamically swap adapters so one frozen base serves many tasks.
options: 只能每个任务部署一份完整模型,和全量微调一样重
合并 W'=W+AB 零延迟,或动态换适配器服务多任务
LoRA 推理必然比原模型慢很多,而且这个延迟无法消除
单个适配器动辄就有几 GB,注册表里根本放不下几个
options_en: You must deploy a full model per task, as heavy as full fine-tuning.
Merge W'=W+AB for zero added latency, or hot-swap adapters so one base serves many tasks.
LoRA inference is inevitably far slower than the base, and this latency cannot be eliminated.
A single adapter can easily run several GB, so a registry can barely hold a few.
optionExplanations: LoRA 共享一个底座、只挂小适配器,不需要每任务一份完整模型。
对;合并后零延迟、或动态换适配器多任务共享底座,正是 LoRA 服务的两种玩法。
合并 AB 进 W 后前向与原模型无异,零额外延迟,不是必然更慢。
适配器只有几 MB,注册表能存上百个配一个底座。
optionExplanations_en: LoRA shares one base with small adapters, needing no full model per task.
Correct — merge for zero latency or dynamically swap adapters over a shared base, LoRA's two serving modes.
After merging AB into W the forward pass matches the base with zero added latency, not inevitably slower.
Adapters are only a few MB, so a registry holds hundreds atop one base.

termDefinitions.meaning: LoRA 为某任务训练出的低秩权重增量(A、B),体积仅几 MB。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An adapter is LoRA's low-rank weight delta (A, B) trained for a task, only a few MB.

termDefinitions.meaning: 推理前把 AB 加回 W 得到 W'=W+AB,之后前向零额外开销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Merging adds AB back into W to get W'=W+AB before inference, so the forward pass has zero extra cost.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["合并模式"] --> W1["W'=W+AB"] --> Z["零额外延迟"]
  S["动态换模式"] --> B["冻结底座"] --> R["按请求挂 LoRA"] --> T["多任务共享"]
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 要为一个 7B LLM 维护 10 个针对不同客户/任务的微调变体,还得多租户同机服务,显存吃紧。
scenario_en: Maintaining 10 fine-tuned variants of a 7B LLM for different customers/tasks, served multi-tenant on one machine with tight memory.
q: 这种多变体多租户场景,LoRA 的关键优势是什么?
q_en: In this multi-variant multi-tenant setting, what's LoRA's key advantage?
why: 共享一个 7B 底座,每个任务只存一个几 MB 的轻量适配器,而不是 10 份完整 7B 副本。显存里驻留一个底座+按需挂适配器,多租户服务成本骤降;合并后还零额外延迟。
why_en: Share one 7B base and store only a lightweight few-MB adapter per task instead of ten full copies, slashing multi-tenant serving cost.
options: 每个变体都全量微调并各存一份 7B 副本,准确率最高
共享一个 7B 底座,每任务只存几 MB 适配器
把 10 个任务合并成一个模型,放弃任务间的区分
给每个租户单独一台机器各跑一份完整 7B
options_en: Full fine-tune each variant and keep a 7B copy each, since accuracy is highest.
Share one 7B base and store only a few-MB adapter per task.
Merge the ten tasks into one model and give up distinguishing them.
Give every tenant a dedicated machine running its own full 7B.
whenOtherWins: 若只有单一任务、无需多变体,且追求极致精度,直接全量微调一个模型反而更简单,不必引入适配器管理。
optionExplanations: 10 份完整 7B 副本显存/存储爆炸,多租户同机根本放不下。
对;一个底座+多个几 MB 适配器,是 LoRA 在多变体多租户下省显存的核心优势。
合并任务会丢掉各客户/任务的差异化,不满足需求。
每租户一台机成本极高,LoRA 的意义正是一机多租户共享底座。
optionExplanations_en: Ten full 7B copies blow up memory/storage and can't fit multi-tenant on one machine.
Correct — one base plus many few-MB adapters is LoRA's core advantage for saving memory under multi-variant multi-tenant serving.
Merging tasks loses per-customer differentiation and fails the requirement.
A machine per tenant is very costly; LoRA's point is one machine serving many tenants over a shared base.
category: Transfer Learning Fine Tuning And Model Compression

scenario: 面试官让你列举 PEFT 家族里的具体方法。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to list concrete methods in the PEFT family.
q: 以下哪些是 PEFT(参数高效微调)方法?(多选)
