diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["偏模型"] --> P["给女性展示更少"]
  P --> C["观测点击更少"]
  C --> L["预测 CTR 更低"]
  L --> D["投放更少"]
  D --> M
options: 偏见会随每次重训自动被稀释，环最终收敛到公平
偏预测→偏采集数据→更偏的模型，差距逐轮放大
反馈环只影响整体准确率，不影响群体公平
只要模型准确率足够高，反馈环就不会出现
options_en: The bias auto-dilutes each retraining and the loop converges to fairness.
Biased predictions → biased collected data → a more biased model; the gap widens each round.
Feedback loops only hurt overall accuracy, not group fairness.
As long as accuracy is high enough, no feedback loop appears.
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反，这是正反馈——不干预会越训越偏，不会自动收敛到公平。
对；展示少导致观测点击少，模型误以为女性 CTR 低，投放进一步减少，差距逐轮放大。
反馈环放大的正是群体间的 demographic-parity 差距，直接是公平问题。
高准确率也可能困在有偏数据的自我强化里，准确率高不等于无反馈环偏差。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite — it's positive feedback: without intervention it worsens each cycle, not converging to fairness.
Correct — fewer impressions cause fewer observed clicks, the model infers low female CTR, delivery shrinks further, and the gap widens each cycle.
The loop amplifies exactly the inter-group demographic-parity gap — a fairness problem directly.
High accuracy can still be trapped in self-reinforcing biased data; high accuracy doesn't preclude feedback-loop bias.

termDefinitions.term: feedback loop bias / 反馈环偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 偏模型影响下一批采集数据，形成越训越偏的正反馈，放大群体差异。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feedback-loop bias is when a biased model shapes the next data it collects, a positive feedback that worsens group disparities each retraining.

scenario: 怀疑广告投放系统存在反馈环偏差，想在它把差距拉得过大之前发现它。
scenario_en: You suspect feedback-loop bias in an ad system and want to catch it before the gap grows too large.
q: 怎么检测反馈环是否在起作用？
q_en: How do you detect whether the feedback loop is active?
why: 跨连续重训周期监控公平指标：如果 demographic-parity 差距随每次重训单调变大，说明反馈环在放大差异。单看一次快照看不出来，趋势才是信号。
why_en: Monitor fairness metrics across successive retraining cycles — a monotonically widening demographic-parity gap signals an active loop.
tradeoff: 跨周期监控趋势（能捕捉放大动态）vs 单次快照（只看一个版本，漏掉反馈环）
whenOtherWins: 如果系统不重训、或不用自身产出的数据再训练（无闭环），就不存在这种放大动态，跨周期监控意义不大。
options: 看单次评估的 aggregate 准确率是否达标
跨重训周期看公平差距是否单调变大
只在用户投诉后做一次性审计
看模型参数量有没有增长
options_en: Check whether a single evaluation's aggregate accuracy passes.
Track whether the fairness gap grows monotonically across retraining cycles.
Only run a one-off audit after user complaints.
Check whether the model's parameter count grew.
optionExplanations: 单次 aggregate 准确率看不出跨周期的放大趋势，反馈环恰恰藏在时间维度里。
对；反馈环是时间动态，只有跨重训周期追踪公平差距的趋势才抓得住。
事后一次性审计太晚，等投诉时差距已被放大多轮。
参数量和反馈环偏差无关，抓错了信号。
optionExplanations_en: A single aggregate accuracy can't reveal cross-cycle amplification; the loop hides in the time dimension.
Correct — the loop is a temporal dynamic, caught only by tracking the fairness gap's trend across retraining cycles.
A post-hoc one-off audit is too late; by complaint time the gap has amplified over many cycles.
Parameter count is unrelated to feedback-loop bias — wrong signal.

scenario: 确认广告系统存在反馈环偏差，要选缓解手段。
scenario_en: Having confirmed feedback-loop bias in the ad system, you select mitigations.
q: 缓解广告系统的反馈环偏差，有哪些手段？(多选)
q_en: Which techniques mitigate feedback-loop bias in an ad system? (select all)
why: 三招：① 探索策略保证各群体最低曝光，打破『没展示就没数据』；② 反事实日志离线评估公平策略；③ 去偏重训用重加权/重采样抵消已累积偏斜。
why_en: Exploration policies for minimum exposure, counterfactual logging for off-policy evaluation, and debiased retraining that reweights/resamples to counteract accumulated skew.
options: 探索策略（epsilon-greedy/Thompson sampling）保证各群体最低曝光
反事实日志：记录公平策略本会怎么做，用于离策略评估而不真正上线伤害
去偏重训：重加权/重采样抵消已累积的偏斜
直接删掉少数群体的样本，让数据更干净
options_en: Exploration policies (epsilon-greedy/Thompson sampling) to guarantee minimum exposure across groups.
Counterfactual logging: record what a fair policy would do, for off-policy evaluation without deploying harm.
Debiased retraining: reweight/resample to counteract accumulated skew.
Just delete the minority group's samples to make the data cleaner.
optionExplanations: 对；探索策略强制给每个群体最低曝光，打破『没展示→没数据→更不展示』的环。
对；反事实日志离线记录公平策略的动作，能评估而不真的部署有害策略。
对；去偏重训在训练侧重加权/重采样，抵消历史数据里累积的偏斜。
错；删掉少数群体样本会加剧代表性不足，让反馈环更严重，方向完全相反。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — exploration forces minimum exposure per group, breaking the 'no impression to no data to even less' loop.
Correct — counterfactual logging records a fair policy's actions offline, enabling evaluation without deploying a harmful policy.
Correct — debiased retraining reweights/resamples on the training side to counteract accumulated skew.
Incorrect — deleting minority samples worsens under-representation and the loop — the exact opposite direction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录一个假想的公平策略本会采取的动作，用于离策略评估而不真正部署。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Counterfactual logging records the actions a hypothetical fair policy would take, enabling off-policy evaluation without deploying it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用已有日志数据评估一个未真正上线的新策略的表现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Off-policy evaluation estimates how a new, not-yet-deployed policy would perform using existing logged data.

scenario: 反馈环的根子在『没给某群体展示→就没有它的点击数据→模型更不给它展示』。
scenario_en: The loop's root is 'don't show a group to get no click data to show it even less'.
q: 哪种缓解手段直接打破这个『没数据』的死循环？
q_en: Which mitigation directly breaks the 'no data' vicious cycle?
why: 用探索策略（epsilon-greedy 或 Thompson sampling）保证每个群体都有最低曝光量，从而持续采集到各群体的反馈数据，打破『没展示就没数据』。它以少量短期收益换长期数据均衡与公平。
why_en: Exploration policies (epsilon-greedy/Thompson sampling) guarantee minimum exposure per group so data keeps flowing, breaking the no-data cycle.
tradeoff: 探索保证最低曝光（打破死循环，代价是牺牲少量短期指标）vs 纯利用（短期指标最优，但固化反馈环）
whenOtherWins: 如果各群体已有充足且均衡的反馈数据、不存在采集缺口，纯利用（exploit）短期收益更高，不必额外探索。
options: 把模型准确率再调高，数据分布自然会均衡
用探索策略保证各群体的最低曝光量
冻结模型不再重训，反馈环就停下来了
把所有群体合并成一个整体，差异就消除了
options_en: Push accuracy higher and the data distribution will balance itself.
Use an exploration policy to guarantee every group a floor of impressions.
Freeze the model and stop retraining; the loop halts.
Merge all groups into one and the disparity disappears.
optionExplanations: 调准确率不解决采集缺口，有偏数据下准确率高反而固化偏见。
对；探索强制给每个群体最低曝光，重新引入其反馈数据，直接打断『没展示→没数据』。
冻结模型只是停在当前偏见上，不修正已有差距，也没恢复缺失群体的数据。
合并群体是掩盖差异不是消除，反而让公平监控失去分辨率。
optionExplanations_en: Tuning accuracy doesn't fix the data gap; on biased data, high accuracy entrenches the bias.
Correct — exploration forces minimum exposure per group, reintroducing their feedback data and directly breaking 'no impression to no data'.
Freezing the model just locks in current bias, neither correcting the gap nor restoring missing-group data.
Merging groups hides the disparity rather than removing it and destroys fairness-monitoring resolution.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以概率 ε 随机探索、其余时间选当前最优的策略，用来保证探索量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Epsilon-greedy explores randomly with probability ε and exploits the current best otherwise, ensuring some exploration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按各选项『可能最优』的后验概率抽样来平衡探索与利用的策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Thompson sampling picks actions in proportion to their posterior probability of being optimal, balancing exploration and exploitation.

scenario: 面试里被问『为什么公平性要在设计阶段就当硬需求，而不是上线后再说』。
scenario_en: In an interview you're asked why fairness must be a hard requirement at design time, not after launch.
q: 哪些监管在推动把公平当设计需求？
q_en: Which regulators push fairness as a design requirement?
why: EEOC（就业机会均等）、ECOA（信贷机会均等）、EU AI Act 等越来越要求提供非歧视性影响的证据。这意味着公平不是上线后可选项，而是要在设计阶段就留下可审计的证明。
why_en: EEOC, ECOA, and the EU AI Act increasingly require evidence of non-discriminatory impact, making fairness a design-time, auditable requirement.
options: 只有内部伦理委员会关心，没有外部法律约束
EEOC、ECOA、EU AI Act 要求非歧视证据
GDPR 只管数据隐私，和公平完全无关，无监管推动
监管只针对模型的整体准确率，不涉及群体层面的公平
options_en: Only internal ethics boards care; there's no external legal pressure.
EEOC, ECOA, and the EU AI Act require evidence of non-discriminatory impact.
GDPR only covers data privacy and is unrelated to fairness — no regulatory pressure.
Regulators only care about a model overall accuracy, not group-level fairness.
optionExplanations: 外部法律约束确实存在，EEOC/ECOA/EU AI Act 都在施压，不只是内部伦理。
对；这些监管要求非歧视影响的证据，逼公平前置为设计阶段的可审计需求。
就业/信贷/AI 专门法规都直接触及公平，说『无监管推动』不成立。
监管关注的正是群体公平与非歧视影响，不止准确率。
optionExplanations_en: External legal pressure does exist — EEOC/ECOA/EU AI Act all apply, not just internal ethics.
Correct — these regulators demand evidence of non-discriminatory impact, forcing fairness to be a design-time auditable requirement.
Employment/credit/AI-specific laws directly touch fairness, so 'no regulatory pressure' is false.
Regulators focus precisely on group fairness and non-discriminatory impact, not only accuracy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 美国就业机会均等委员会，监管招聘等场景的歧视问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The EEOC (Equal Employment Opportunity Commission) is the US agency regulating employment discrimination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 美国信贷机会均等法，禁止信贷决策中的歧视。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ECOA (Equal Credit Opportunity Act) is the US law prohibiting discrimination in credit decisions.

scenario: 面试做广告/推荐系统的评估设计，想给出 senior/staff 级的公平性洞察。
scenario_en: Designing evaluation for an ads/rec system in an interview, you want senior/staff-level fairness insight.
q: 提哪两点最能体现资深级的公平性思维？
q_en: Which two points best show senior-level fairness thinking?
why: 两个 staff 级信号：① calibration 与 equalized odds 的不可能定理（base rate 不同时必须取舍）；② 反馈环监控 + 探索缓解，体现长期动态意识。
why_en: Cite the calibration-versus-equalized-odds impossibility result and propose feedback-loop monitoring plus exploration mitigation, showing awareness of tradeoffs and long-term dynamics.
options: 承诺同时满足所有公平指标，并把准确率也做到最高
点明不可能定理，并提反馈环监控与探索缓解
只报告一个 demographic-parity 数字就结束
强调只要删掉受保护属性特征就万事大吉
options_en: Promise to satisfy all fairness metrics at once and also maximize accuracy.
Name the impossibility theorem, and raise feedback-loop monitoring plus exploration.
Report a single demographic-parity number and stop.
Insist that dropping the protected-attribute feature solves everything.
optionExplanations: 承诺全都满足恰恰暴露不懂不可能定理，是反信号。
对；不可能定理体现取舍意识、反馈环监控体现长期动态意识，都是资深级洞察。
只报一个数字停在最浅层，没有取舍也没有动态视角。
只删属性是 unawareness 谬误，代理会泄漏，反而暴露理解不足。
optionExplanations_en: Promising to satisfy all at once exposes ignorance of the impossibility result — a negative signal.
Correct — the impossibility result shows tradeoff awareness and feedback-loop monitoring shows long-term-dynamics awareness, both senior insights.
Reporting one number stops at the shallowest level, with no tradeoff or dynamics lens.
Dropping the attribute alone is the unawareness fallacy — proxies leak, exposing a shallow grasp.

scenario: 做一个 RAG 客服助手，回答听起来很流畅，但你要证明它是对的、还要说清错在哪。
scenario_en: Building a RAG support assistant, the answers sound fluent but you must prove correctness and pinpoint where it went wrong.
q: 评估生成式系统时，面试最看重的核心信号是什么？
q_en: What's the core interview signal when evaluating a generative system?
why: 核心信号是把失败做诊断性分离：一个坏答案到底来自检索（没找到对的文档）还是生成（找到了却编造/没依据）。分清了才能提针对性修复，而不是笼统地说『改进模型』。
why_en: The core signal is diagnostic separation of retrieval failures from generation failures, so you propose targeted fixes instead of a vague 'improve the model'.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Q["query"] --> R["retriever"]
  R -->|context relevance| C["retrieved passages"]
  C --> G["generator"]
  G -->|faithfulness/groundedness| A["answer"]
options: 让最终答案的 ROUGE 分数尽量高，用单一指标当验收门槛
把失败诊断分离：坏答案来自检索还是生成，据此定向修复
只看答案是否流畅通顺，读起来自然就判定它合格
先把生成模型换成参数量更大的版本，再谈评估口径
options_en: Push the final answer's ROUGE score as high as possible and gate on that single metric.
Separate failures diagnostically: retrieval or generation, then fix that side.
Only check fluency — if it reads naturally, call it a pass.
Swap in a larger-parameter generator first, then worry about evaluation.
optionExplanations: ROUGE 只看 n-gram 重叠，编造的答案也能刷高分，不解决『错在哪』。
对；分清检索 vs 生成失败，才能定向修（改检索器 or 改生成约束），是 gen AI 评估的核心。
流畅是生成式系统的默认属性，流畅≠正确，正是它最危险的地方。
不诊断就换大模型可能白花钱——如果是检索没找到文档，再大的生成器也救不了。
optionExplanations_en: ROUGE only counts n-gram overlap; a fabricated answer can score high and it doesn't answer 'where it went wrong'.
Correct — separating retrieval vs generation failures enables targeted fixes (fix the retriever or the generation constraints), the core of gen-AI eval.
Fluency is a default property of generative systems; fluent ≠ correct, which is exactly the danger.
Swapping to a bigger model without diagnosis may waste money — if retrieval didn't find the doc, no bigger generator helps.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索增强生成：先检索相关文档，再让生成模型基于这些文档作答。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) retrieves relevant documents first, then has the generator answer grounded in them.

scenario: 有人想直接用 BLEU/ROUGE 评估开放式问答的答案质量。
scenario_en: Someone wants to use BLEU/ROUGE directly to evaluate open-ended QA answer quality.
q: 为什么 BLEU/ROUGE 这类词汇重叠指标评不了开放式生成？
q_en: Why do lexical-overlap metrics like BLEU/ROUGE fail for open-ended generation?
why: 它们假设只有一个正确参考答案、把词汇重叠当质量。但开放式任务有很多合法输出：一个幻觉答案可能因共享 n-gram 而 ROUGE 高分，一个准确的改写却因用词不同而低分。重叠 ≠ 正确。
why_en: They assume one correct reference and equate lexical overlap with quality, so a hallucination can score high on shared n-grams while an accurate paraphrase scores low.
options: 它们计算太慢，每次全量评估要跑几十分钟，跟不上模型每周迭代的节奏
假设唯一参考答案、把 n-gram 重叠当质量：幻觉也能高分
它们只支持中文语料，评不了英文语料上的开放式生成
它们每条测试样本都要人工先写好参考答案，标注成本随语料规模线性增长到用不起
options_en: They're too slow — a full evaluation run takes tens of minutes, which can't keep pace with a weekly model-iteration cycle.
They assume one reference and treat n-gram overlap as quality, so a hallucination can score high.
They only support Chinese corpora and can't evaluate open-ended generation in English.
Every test sample needs a human-written reference first, and labeling cost scales linearly with corpus size until it's unaffordable.
optionExplanations: 速度不是问题，问题在指标的假设与开放式生成不符。
对；单参考+重叠=质量的假设，让幻觉刷高分、改写被误伤，根本上不适配多正确答案的任务。
BLEU/ROUGE 与语言无关，中英文都可算，语言不是失效原因。
BLEU/ROUGE 是自动指标，不需人工标注；成本不是它们失效的原因。
optionExplanations_en: Speed isn't the issue; the metric's assumptions mismatch open-ended generation.
Correct — the single-reference-plus-overlap-equals-quality assumption lets hallucinations score high and paraphrases get penalized, unfit for many-valid-answer tasks.
BLEU/ROUGE are language-agnostic and work for both Chinese and English; language isn't the failure cause.
BLEU/ROUGE are automatic and need no human labels; cost isn't why they fail.

termDefinitions.meaning: 机器翻译指标，衡量输出与参考的 n-gram 精确率，惩罚正确的改写。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy) is an MT metric measuring n-gram precision against a reference, penalizing valid paraphrases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 摘要指标，衡量输出覆盖参考 n-gram 的召回，可能奖励重叠的幻觉文本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ROUGE (Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation) measures recall of a reference's n-grams, and can reward hallucinated overlapping text.

termDefinitions.meaning: 连续 n 个词的片段，词汇重叠指标以此为比较单位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An n-gram is a contiguous sequence of n tokens, the comparison unit for lexical-overlap metrics.

scenario: 要区分 BLEU 和 ROUGE 各自量什么、各自还在哪些任务有用。
scenario_en: Distinguish what BLEU and ROUGE each measure and where each is still useful.
q: BLEU 和 ROUGE 的侧重与残余用途分别是什么？
q_en: What do BLEU and ROUGE emphasize, and where is each still useful?
why: BLEU 侧重 n-gram 精确率（输出的词有多少在参考里），适合 MT 等约束输出；ROUGE 侧重召回（参考的词有多少被覆盖），适合抽取式摘要。前者惩罚有效改写，后者会奖励重叠的幻觉文本。
why_en: BLEU emphasizes n-gram precision (fit for MT/constrained outputs) while ROUGE emphasizes recall of the reference (fit for extractive summarization).
tradeoff: BLEU（精确率、约束输出/MT）vs ROUGE（召回、抽取式摘要）
options: BLEU 量的是召回、用于摘要；ROUGE 量精确率、用于机器翻译
BLEU 量 n-gram 精确率、宜 MT；ROUGE 量参考召回、宜摘要
两者都量语义相似度，用途完全相同，指标可以互相替换
BLEU 和 ROUGE 都专为开放式对话设计，能直接评出幻觉与事实错误
options_en: BLEU measures recall and is used for summarization; ROUGE measures precision and is used for machine translation.
BLEU is n-gram precision, fit for MT; ROUGE is recall of the reference, fit for summarization.
Both measure semantic similarity, serve identical purposes, and are interchangeable.
Both BLEU and ROUGE are built for open-ended dialogue and catch hallucinations and factual errors directly.
optionExplanations: 说反了：BLEU 是精确率、ROUGE 是召回，用途也对调错了。
对；BLEU 精确率适合翻译/受限输出，ROUGE 召回适合抽取式摘要，各有残余价值。
两者都是词汇重叠而非语义相似度，用途也不同。
两者都做不了幻觉检测，恰恰是它们对开放式生成失效的原因。
optionExplanations_en: Reversed: BLEU is precision, ROUGE is recall, and the uses are swapped too.
Correct — BLEU's precision fits translation/constrained outputs, ROUGE's recall fits extractive summarization, each with residual value.
Both are lexical overlap, not semantic similarity, and their uses differ.
Neither detects hallucination — that's exactly why they fail for open-ended generation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 机器翻译，输出较受约束、有相对明确的参考答案，BLEU 在此仍有用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MT (Machine Translation) has constrained outputs with a relatively clear reference, where BLEU remains useful.

scenario: 有人提议用 BERTScore 替代 BLEU/ROUGE，因为它用嵌入算语义相似度。
scenario_en: Someone proposes BERTScore over BLEU/ROUGE because it uses embeddings for semantic similarity.
q: BERTScore 相比 BLEU/ROUGE 好在哪、又漏了什么？
q_en: How is BERTScore better than BLEU/ROUGE, and what does it still miss?
why: BERTScore 用嵌入算语义相似度，比纯 n-gram 更懂改写。但当语义相近时它会漏掉事实错误——一句话措辞和参考很像、意思也接近，但把 30 天说成 90 天，BERTScore 照样给高分。适合一遍粗筛相似度，不适合判事实对错。
why_en: BERTScore uses embeddings so it recognizes paraphrases, but it misses factual errors when the semantics stay similar, making it a first-pass similarity screen only.
tradeoff: BERTScore（懂语义改写，但漏事实错误）vs 事实核验（能抓事实错，但需 claim 级验证）
options: BERTScore 能直接判断事实真假，可完全取代人工事实核验
用嵌入更懂改写，但语义相近时漏事实错误（30 天说成 90 天仍高分）
它比 BLEU/ROUGE 更差，因为算嵌入要多跑一次模型推理，拖慢线上评估节奏
它专门检测幻觉，是 RAG 场景里首选的事实性指标，可以直接替代人工审核
options_en: BERTScore judges factual truth directly and fully replaces human fact-checking.
Embeddings catch paraphrases, but it misses factual errors when semantics stay close (30 days stated as 90 still scores high).
It's worse than BLEU/ROUGE because computing embeddings needs an extra inference pass that slows down online evaluation.
It detects hallucination specifically and is the go-to factuality metric for RAG, so it can directly replace human review.
optionExplanations: 语义相似不等于事实正确，BERTScore 判不了真假，替代不了核验。
对；它懂改写胜过 n-gram，但对『语义近但事实错』盲区，适合首轮相似度粗筛。
它多花的是评估阶段的计算时间，不是判断质量变差——工程成本和效果好坏是两回事。
它不检测幻觉，也替代不了人工审核——RAG 事实性要靠 faithfulness/RAGAS 这类 claim 级验证。
optionExplanations_en: Semantic similarity isn't factual correctness; BERTScore can't judge truth and can't replace verification.
Correct — it beats n-grams at paraphrase but is blind to 'semantically close yet factually wrong', fit for first-pass similarity screening.
The extra cost is evaluation-time compute, not worse judgment — engineering cost and output quality are different things.
It doesn't detect hallucination and can't replace human review — RAG factuality needs claim-level checks like faithfulness/RAGAS.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 BERT 嵌入算输出与参考的语义相似度，比 n-gram 更懂改写但漏事实错误。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BERTScore computes semantic similarity between output and reference using BERT embeddings, recognizing paraphrases but missing factual errors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种预训练语言模型，其嵌入用于衡量文本语义相似度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) is a pretrained language model whose embeddings measure text semantic similarity.

scenario: RAG 答案里每一句听起来都对，但你要确认它没编造检索文档里没有的内容。
scenario_en: Every sentence of a RAG answer sounds right, but you must confirm it didn't fabricate anything absent from the retrieved docs.
q: RAG 三元组里的 faithfulness（忠实度）度量什么，属于哪个组件？
q_en: In the RAG triad, what does faithfulness measure, and which component does it target?
why: faithfulness 属于生成器：答案里每条主张都必须被检索到的段落支持。做法是把答案拆成原子主张、逐条核验；只要一条无依据就拉低分数（如答案说『90 天退货』而政策写 30 天，就是幻觉）。
why_en: Faithfulness targets the generator: every claim in the answer must be supported by retrieved passages, verified by decomposing into atomic claims.
options: 检索器有没有把与查询语义匹配的所有文档都找回来，比如漏掉退货政策那一段
生成器：答案每条原子主张都被检索段落支持，无依据即降分
答案读起来是否流畅通顺，有没有病句或生硬的机器翻译腔用词
答案末尾是否按顺序标注了它引用的检索段落编号，格式对不对
options_en: Whether the retriever brought back every document semantically matching the query — say, missing the return-policy passage.
The generator: every atomic claim is supported by retrieved passages; any unsupported one drops the score.
Whether the answer reads fluently, without awkward phrasing or stiff machine-translation-sounding word choices.
Whether the answer lists the passage numbers it cites at the end, in order and correctly formatted.
optionExplanations: 『有没有找到文档』是 context relevance（检索器），不是 faithfulness。
对；faithfulness 盯生成器：逐条原子主张必须有检索依据，无依据即幻觉。
流畅是表面属性，faithfulness 管的是每条主张是否有依据，与流畅无关。
『引用段落编号』更接近 groundedness 的可追溯性，faithfulness 关注是否被支持。
optionExplanations_en: 'Whether docs were found' is context relevance (retriever), not faithfulness.
Correct — faithfulness targets the generator: each atomic claim must be grounded in retrieval; unsupported means hallucination.
Fluency is surface; faithfulness is about whether each claim is supported, unrelated to fluency.
'Citing passage numbers' is closer to groundedness's traceability; faithfulness is about being supported.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生成答案的每条主张都能被检索到的上下文支持，无编造。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Faithfulness means every claim in the generated answer is supported by the retrieved context, with no fabrication.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把答案拆成的最小可独立核验的事实陈述，逐条对照上下文验证。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic claim is a minimal independently-verifiable factual statement the answer is decomposed into for checking against context.

scenario: 要给 RAG 答案自动打一个忠实度分数，答案往往一段话里含好几个事实点。
scenario_en: You want to auto-score a RAG answer's faithfulness; answers often pack several facts into one paragraph.
q: 该怎么给一段含多个事实点的答案算 faithfulness？
q_en: How to compute faithfulness for an answer packed with multiple facts?
why: 把答案分解成原子主张，逐条对照检索上下文核验，任一条无支持就整体降分。整段一起判会让一个隐藏的幻觉被其他正确内容稀释掉，拆成原子才抓得住。
why_en: Decompose the answer into atomic claims and verify each against the retrieved context, dropping the score if any one is unsupported.
tradeoff: 拆原子主张逐条核验（抓得住单点幻觉）vs 整段一次打分（幻觉被正确内容稀释、漏检）
whenOtherWins: 如果答案本身就是单一简短事实（一句一点），不必拆分，直接核验那一条即可。
options: 整段答案和上下文算一次语义相似度得分，分数高于阈值就判定为忠实
把答案拆成原子主张，逐条对照上下文核验，任一条无支持就降分
数答案里有多少词出现在上下文里，占比高就忠实
让答案越长越好，覆盖面广、提到的细节多，出错概率反而被稀释掉
options_en: Compute one semantic-similarity score for the whole answer against the context; above a threshold counts as faithful.
Decompose the answer into atomic claims and verify each against the context, dropping the score if any is unsupported.
Count how many answer words appear in the context; a high ratio means faithful.
Make the answer as long as possible — broad coverage and more detail dilute the odds of getting caught being wrong.
optionExplanations: 整段相似度会让一个隐藏幻觉被大量正确内容稀释，抓不住单点错误。
对；原子主张逐条核验才能定位到具体哪句无依据，这正是 RAGAS 的做法。
词重叠占比就是 ROUGE 式思路，编造内容也可能高重叠，判不了忠实。
错觉——『稀释』的是平均分不是错误本身，一条无依据主张照样让该句被判幻觉。
optionExplanations_en: Whole-answer similarity lets a hidden hallucination be diluted by lots of correct content, missing single-point errors.
Correct — atomic-claim verification localizes exactly which sentence is unsupported, which is what RAGAS does.
Word-overlap ratio is ROUGE-style; fabricated content can still overlap heavily and can't judge faithfulness.
A mistaken instinct — 'dilution' only lowers the average score, not the underlying error; one unsupported claim still gets flagged.

scenario: 怀疑 RAG 答案跑题，想先确认检索这一步有没有把对的文档捞上来。
scenario_en: Suspecting an off-topic RAG answer, you first check whether retrieval surfaced the right documents.
q: context relevance（上下文相关性）度量什么，怎么进一步拆分？
q_en: What does context relevance measure, and how is it further split?
why: 它只看检索这一端：捞回的文档和查询对不对得上。precision 管捞回的有多少相关，recall 管该捞的有没有捞全。
why_en: Context relevance grades only the retrieval side — whether the docs you pulled match the query — and it splits into precision, how much of what you pulled is relevant, and recall, whether you pulled everything you needed.
options: 生成答案里每条主张是否都有检索依据、有没有编造内容，即 faithfulness
检索器：捞回文档是否匹配查询，分 precision 与 recall
答案是否引用具体段落编号，即 groundedness
答案与人工参考答案之间的 n-gram 词汇重叠率
options_en: Whether every claim in the answer is grounded in retrieval and free of fabrication — that is faithfulness.
The retriever: whether retrieved docs match the query, split into precision and recall.
Whether the answer cites specific passage numbers — that is groundedness.
The n-gram lexical overlap between the answer and a human reference.
optionExplanations: 主张有没有依据是 faithfulness（生成器），不是 context relevance（检索器）。
对；先量这一端，才能把答偏归因到检索，而不是冤枉生成器。
引用段落是 groundedness 的可追溯性，不是检索相关性。
n-gram 重叠是词汇指标，评不了检索是否相关。
optionExplanations_en: Whether claims are supported is faithfulness (generator), not context relevance (retriever).
Correct — grading this side first is what lets you blame an off-topic answer on retrieval instead of the generator.
Citing passages is groundedness's traceability, not retrieval relevance.
N-gram overlap is a lexical metric and can't judge retrieval relevance.

termDefinitions.term: context relevance / 上下文相关性
termDefinitions.meaning: 检索器捞回的文档是否与查询相关，独立于生成器评估。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Context relevance is whether the retriever's returned documents match the query, evaluated independently of the generator.

termDefinitions.meaning: precision=捞回的相关比例；recall=需要的信息是否都被捞到。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Context precision is the fraction of retrieved passages that are relevant; context recall is whether all needed info was retrieved.

scenario: RAG 答案漏掉了政策里一个关键条款，怀疑检索没把需要的信息全捞回来。
scenario_en: A RAG answer omits a key policy clause; you suspect retrieval didn't return all needed info.
q: 『需要的信息有没有都被检索到』该用哪个指标？
q_en: 'Was all the needed info retrieved' maps to which metric?
why: 用 context recall：它衡量回答所需的信息是否都被检索覆盖到。漏关键条款正是 recall 不足（该捞的没捞全）。context precision 管的是另一端——捞回的里有多少是相关的，用来抓噪声文档。
why_en: Use context recall — whether all information needed to answer was retrieved; a missing clause is a recall gap, not precision.
tradeoff: context recall（该捞的全不全，抓遗漏）vs context precision（捞回的准不准，抓噪声）
whenOtherWins: 如果问题是检索回来一堆无关文档把生成器带偏，那看 context precision（相关比例）更对症。
options: context precision，衡量捞回的文档里有多少是相关的
context recall，衡量回答所需信息是否都被检索到
faithfulness，衡量答案的每条主张是否有上下文依据
groundedness，衡量答案有没有引用具体的检索段落
options_en: Context precision, how many of the retrieved documents are relevant.
Context recall, whether all the information needed to answer was retrieved.
Faithfulness, whether each claim in the answer is supported by the context.
Groundedness, whether the answer cites specific retrieved passages.
optionExplanations: precision 管『捞回的准不准』，抓的是噪声文档，不是『漏了该捞的』。
对；漏关键条款=该检索的没检索全=context recall 不足，正是这个指标。
faithfulness 是生成器侧，答案没依据才降它，这里是检索漏了信息。
groundedness 管引用可追溯，不衡量检索完整性。
optionExplanations_en: Precision governs 'is what's retrieved accurate', catching noise docs, not 'missed what should be retrieved'.
Correct — a missing key clause is under-retrieval, i.e. a context recall gap, exactly this metric.
Faithfulness is generator-side, dropped when the answer is unsupported; here retrieval missed info.
Groundedness governs citation traceability, not retrieval completeness.

scenario: 医疗/金融等高风险 RAG 场景，答案不仅要对，还要能指出每句话来自哪段依据。
scenario_en: In high-stakes RAG (healthcare/finance), the answer must be right and traceable to a specific source passage.
q: groundedness（可依据性）额外要求什么，为什么在高风险场景关键？
q_en: What does groundedness additionally require, and why is it critical in high-stakes domains?
why: groundedness 要求可追溯：每条主张都能映射到某个具体的检索段落并引用它（『根据退货政策一节…』）。在医疗/金融，答对还不够，必须能指出依据出处以便审计和追责，所以它比单纯忠实更进一步。
why_en: Groundedness requires traceability — each claim maps to and cites a specific retrieved passage — which matters in high-stakes domains for auditability.
options: 答案越长越好，尽量覆盖更多可能相关的信息
可追溯：每条主张映射到具体检索段落并引用出处
答案的语气要正式专业，避免口语化的表达
检索的文档数量要尽量多，召回越多越可靠
options_en: The longer the answer the better, covering as much possibly-relevant information as it can.
Traceability: every claim maps to and cites a specific retrieved passage.
The tone should be formal and professional, avoiding colloquial phrasing.
Retrieve as many documents as possible — more recall is more reliable.
optionExplanations: 长度和可追溯无关，冗长反而更难逐句对上依据。
对；groundedness 是『每句能指到出处并引用』，在医疗/金融用于审计追责，比忠实更进一步。
语气正式是风格问题，与能否追溯到依据无关。
文档多不等于每句有引用，可追溯性看的是主张到段落的映射。
optionExplanations_en: Length is unrelated to traceability; verbosity makes per-sentence sourcing harder.
Correct — groundedness is 'each sentence points to and cites a source', used for auditability in healthcare/finance, one step beyond faithfulness.
Formal tone is style, unrelated to traceability to sources.
More documents doesn't mean each sentence is cited; traceability is the claim-to-passage mapping.

termDefinitions.meaning: 答案每条主张都能追溯并引用到某个具体检索段落，支持审计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Groundedness means each claim in the answer can be traced and cited to a specific retrieved passage, supporting audit.

scenario: 一个 RAG 答案事实上是对的，但检查发现检索回来的文档全跑题——模型是靠自身参数知识答对的。
scenario_en: A RAG answer is factually correct, but the retrieved docs are all off-topic — the model answered from its parametric knowledge.
q: 这种情况最该判哪个维度失败？
q_en: Which dimension should you flag as failing here?
why: 判 context relevance 失败：检索没捞到相关文档，答案不是基于检索上下文得来的（是靠模型参数知识）。虽然这次碰巧答对，但检索环节坏了，靠参数知识不可靠也不可控，属于检索失败而非生成失败。
why_en: Flag context relevance: retrieval surfaced off-topic docs, so the answer wasn't grounded in retrieved context but came from parametric knowledge — a retrieval failure.
tradeoff: 判 context relevance 失败（检索坏了，虽偶然答对但不可靠）vs 判合格（被偶然正确骗过、放过检索缺陷）
whenOtherWins: 如果检索文档确实相关、但答案编造了文档里没有的内容，那失败在 faithfulness（生成），不是 context relevance。
options: faithfulness 失败，因为答案的主张没有检索上下文里的依据支持
context relevance 失败：检索文档跑题，答案靠参数知识
没有失败，答案最终是对的就算合格，不用深究检索这步兜没兜住
groundedness 成功，因为答案的事实内容是正确的
options_en: Faithfulness fails, because the answer's claims lack support from the retrieved context.
Context relevance fails: retrieval was off-topic and the answer came from parametric knowledge.
No failure — the final answer is correct so it passes, no need to dig into whether retrieval actually held up.
Groundedness succeeds, because the factual content of the answer is right.
optionExplanations: faithfulness 是拿答案对照检索上下文判有无编造；这里根子在捞错文档。
对；根因在检索这一步，修检索器才治本；这次答对只是模型背过这条政策。
答对是偶然——同类查询下次很可能就错，不能判合格。
groundedness 也不成立：没有相关段落可供追溯。
optionExplanations_en: Faithfulness checks the answer against retrieved context for fabrication; here the root cause is pulling the wrong docs.
Correct — the root cause sits in retrieval, so fixing the retriever is the real fix; getting it right this time just means the model memorized the policy.
Correctness is coincidental — a similar query will likely fail next time, so it cannot pass.
Groundedness doesn't hold either: there is no relevant passage to trace back to.

scenario: RAG 客服答案说『支持 90 天退货』，但检索到的政策文档明确写的是 30 天。
scenario_en: A RAG support answer says '90-day return', but the retrieved policy doc clearly states 30 days.
q: 这是哪个维度、哪个组件的失败？
q_en: Which dimension and component failed here?
why: 这是 faithfulness 失败（生成器幻觉）：检索文档写的是 30 天（检索没问题），但生成器编出了文档里没有的 90 天。修复方向是加强生成约束/引用而非改检索，这正是诊断分离的价值。
why_en: Faithfulness fails (generator hallucination): retrieval had the 30-day doc but the generator invented 90 days not in the context.
tradeoff: 判 faithfulness 失败（生成幻觉，修生成约束）vs 误判为检索问题（去改检索，方向全错）
whenOtherWins: 如果检索根本没捞到那份退货政策文档，那才是 context relevance 失败，该去修检索器。
options: context relevance 失败，检索器没能把退货政策文档捞回来
faithfulness 失败：文档写 30 天，生成器却编出 90 天
BLEU 分数不够高导致的整体质量下降，需要提升生成流畅度
groundedness 成功，因为答案给出了一个具体数字
options_en: Context relevance fails — the retriever never surfaced the return-policy document.
Faithfulness fails: the doc says 30 days but the generator invented 90.
An overall quality drop caused by a low BLEU score, so generation fluency needs work.
Groundedness succeeds, because the answer gave a concrete number.
optionExplanations: 检索明明捞到了正确的 30 天文档，检索没问题，去改检索是错方向。
对；文档在、生成器却编造 90 天，是典型 faithfulness 幻觉，修生成约束/强制引用。
BLEU 与此无关，问题是事实幻觉不是词汇重叠。
groundedness 失败——90 天这个数字无法追溯到任何检索段落，给了数字不等于有依据。
optionExplanations_en: Retrieval did surface the correct 30-day doc, so retrieval is fine and fixing it is the wrong direction.
Correct — the doc is present yet the generator fabricated 90 days, a classic faithfulness hallucination; fix generation constraints/forced citation.
BLEU is irrelevant; the issue is factual hallucination, not lexical overlap.
Groundedness fails — the 90-day number traces to no retrieved passage; giving a number isn't the same as being supported.

scenario: 人工评估太慢太贵、n-gram 指标又不可信，想找个中间档的自动评估办法。
scenario_en: Human eval is slow/costly and n-gram metrics untrustworthy; you want a middle-ground automated evaluator.
q: LLM-as-judge 是什么，定位在什么档位？
q_en: What is LLM-as-judge, and where does it sit?
why: 用一个强 LLM 按 rubric 给输出在忠实/连贯/有用等维度打分。它比人工更快更便宜、又比 n-gram 更可靠，定位是『开发期快速迭代』的中间档，但有系统性偏差，需交叉验证。
why_en: LLM-as-judge uses a capable LLM to score outputs on dimensions like faithfulness/coherence/helpfulness, cheaper/faster than humans and more reliable than n-grams.
options: 让被评模型给自己打分，省掉找外部裁判和写 rubric 的功夫
用强 LLM 按 rubric 在忠实/连贯/有用等维度打分
用 BLEU/ROUGE 自动打分换了个新名字，本质还是算词汇重叠分数
纯靠人工众包一条条打分，只是把流程包装成新名字
options_en: Have the evaluated model score itself, skipping the work of finding an external judge and writing a rubric.
A capable LLM scores outputs by rubric on faithfulness/coherence/helpfulness.
Just a rebrand of BLEU/ROUGE auto-scoring — still lexical-overlap counting underneath.
Plain human crowdsourced scoring, item by item, just repackaged under a trendier name.
optionExplanations: 自评是既当选手又当裁判，会系统性高估，不是 LLM-as-judge 的做法。
对；裁判必须是独立模型，rubric 把口径固定下来，分数才可复现、可比较。
它不是 BLEU/ROUGE——恰恰是为了绕开 n-gram 的语义盲区。
它是自动的（LLM 打分），不是人工众包，速度成本正是其优势。
optionExplanations_en: Self-scoring makes the model player and referee, systematically overrating — not what LLM-as-judge is.
Correct — the judge must be a separate model, and the rubric pins the criteria so scores are reproducible and comparable.
It's not BLEU/ROUGE — it exists precisely to bypass n-grams' semantic blind spots.
It's automatic (LLM scoring), not human crowdsourcing; speed and cost are its advantages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个能力强的大语言模型按评分标准给其他模型的输出打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LLM-as-judge uses a capable large language model to score other models' outputs against a rubric.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  O["model output"] --> J["judge LLM + rubric"]
  C["retrieved context"] --> J
  J --> S["scores: faithful / coherent / helpful"]
  S --> H["human spot-check"]

scenario: 要用 LLM-as-judge，纠结是给每个输出单独打分，还是两两比谁更好。
scenario_en: Using LLM-as-judge, you weigh scoring each output alone versus comparing two head-to-head.
q: pointwise 打分和 pairwise 比较各适合什么？
q_en: What is pointwise scoring good for versus pairwise comparison?
why: pointwise=给单个输出配 rubric 打绝对分（如 1-5），适合在一个测试集上看绝对质量水平。pairwise=在某维度上二选一挑更好的，适合做模型选型或和基线对比。选型看相对胜负更稳，绝对水平看 pointwise。
why_en: Pointwise scores one output against a rubric for absolute quality across a test set, while pairwise picks the better of two for model selection or vs a baseline.
tradeoff: pointwise（绝对分、看整体质量水平）vs pairwise（相对胜负、做模型选型/对比基线）
options: pointwise 用于模型选型；pairwise 用于测绝对质量水平
pointwise 给单输出打绝对分；pairwise 二选一做模型选型
两者完全等价，输出的分数可以互换着用
pointwise 只能人工来做，pairwise 只能由 LLM 做
options_en: Pointwise for model selection; pairwise for measuring absolute quality level.
Pointwise gives one output an absolute score; pairwise picks the better of two for model selection.
They are fully equivalent and their scores can be used interchangeably.
Pointwise can only be done by humans, pairwise only by an LLM.
optionExplanations: 说反了：pointwise 测绝对质量，pairwise 才适合选型。
对；要整体质量水平用 pointwise 绝对分，要选哪个模型更好用 pairwise 相对胜负。
两者产出不同（绝对分 vs 相对胜负），用途也不同，不可互换。
两者都可由 LLM 或人做，不存在这种限制。
optionExplanations_en: Reversed: pointwise measures absolute quality, pairwise fits selection.
Correct — use pointwise absolute scores for overall level, pairwise win/loss for which model is better.
They produce different things (absolute vs relative) with different uses, not interchangeable.
Both can be done by an LLM or humans; no such restriction exists.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给单个输出按 rubric 打一个绝对分（如 1-5），衡量绝对质量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pointwise scoring rates a single output against a rubric with an absolute score (e.g. 1-5) for absolute quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在某维度上比较两个输出、挑更好的一个，适合模型选型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pairwise comparison picks the better of two outputs on a dimension, fit for model selection.

scenario: 想让 faithfulness 评分自动化，不必每条主张都人工核对上下文。
scenario_en: You want faithfulness scoring automated without manually checking every claim against context.
q: RAGAS 是怎么自动算 faithfulness 的？
q_en: How does RAGAS automatically compute faithfulness?
why: RAGAS 把答案分解成原子主张，再提示一个 LLM 逐条核验每条主张是否被检索上下文支持，从而得到一个自动的 faithfulness 分数。本质是把『拆原子主张+逐条核验』这套人工流程用 LLM 自动化。
why_en: RAGAS decomposes answers into atomic claims and prompts an LLM to verify each against the context, yielding an automatic faithfulness score.
options: 计算答案与人工参考答案之间的 BLEU 重叠分数
拆成原子主张，提示 LLM 逐条核验是否被上下文支持
让答案越长越好，用覆盖度来提高忠实度
只看答案里是否包含检索文档的标题关键词
options_en: Compute a BLEU overlap score between the answer and a human reference.
Decompose into atomic claims and prompt an LLM to verify each against the context.
Make answers longer and use coverage to raise faithfulness.
Just check whether the answer contains the retrieved doc's title keywords.
optionExplanations: BLEU 是词汇重叠，判不了主张是否被上下文支持，不是 RAGAS 的机制。
对；粒度落到单条主张，才能指出是哪一句没依据，而不是给整段一个模糊分。
长度不提升忠实度，反而更易引入无依据主张。
含标题不代表主张有依据，核验的是每条主张与上下文的支持关系。
optionExplanations_en: BLEU is lexical overlap and can't judge whether claims are context-supported — not RAGAS's mechanism.
Correct — grading at the single-claim level tells you which sentence is unsupported instead of one fuzzy score for the whole passage.
Length does not improve faithfulness and tends to add unsupported claims.
Containing the title doesn't mean claims are supported; what's checked is each claim's support in the context.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自动评估 RAG 的框架，用 LLM 把答案拆原子主张并逐条核验以算 faithfulness。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RAGAS (Retrieval-Augmented Generation Assessment) automates RAG evaluation by using an LLM to decompose answers into atomic claims and verify each for a faithfulness score.

scenario: 用 LLM-as-judge 打分前，要先知道它有哪些系统性偏差以便防范。
scenario_en: Before trusting LLM-as-judge scores, you list its systematic biases to guard against.
q: LLM-as-judge 有哪些系统性偏差？(多选)
q_en: Which systematic biases does LLM-as-judge have? (multiple)
why: 三种真实偏差：position（pairwise 里靠前的占便宜）、verbosity（答案越长分越高）、self-enhancement（偏袒同族模型）。temperature bias 是杜撰的。
why_en: The real ones are position bias, verbosity bias, and self-enhancement bias — favoring whichever option comes first, longer answers, and the judge's own model family; temperature bias is made up.
options: position bias：pairwise 中偏向排在前面的那个
verbosity bias：不管准确度，更长的答案打更高分
self-enhancement bias：偏袒自己同族模型（GPT-4 评 GPT-4 抬分）
temperature bias：只有温度设为 0 时才会打分
options_en: Position bias: prefers whichever option appears first in pairwise.
Verbosity bias: rates longer answers higher regardless of accuracy.
Self-enhancement bias: favors its own model family (GPT-4 judging GPT-4 inflates scores).
Temperature bias: only scores when temperature is set to 0.
optionExplanations: 对；顺序会左右胜负，把 A/B 交换再测一次就能抵消掉。
对；打分时要控长度或对啰嗦扣分，否则冗长答案白占便宜。
对；同族抬分要靠换一个模型家族或人工对照才能暴露出来。
错；这是杜撰的名词，温度只影响输出随机性，不决定能否打分。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — order can decide the winner, so swap A/B and re-run to cancel it out.
Correct — control length or penalize verbosity when scoring, otherwise long answers get a free ride.
Correct — same-family inflation only shows up if you switch model family or compare against humans.
Incorrect — this term is invented; temperature affects output randomness, not whether scoring happens.

termDefinitions.meaning: 评审 LLM 倾向给更长的答案更高分，与准确度无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Verbosity bias is a judge LLM's tendency to rate longer answers higher regardless of accuracy.

termDefinitions.term: self-enhancement bias / 自我增强偏好
termDefinitions.meaning: 评审 LLM 偏袒与自己同族的模型输出，抬高其分数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Self-enhancement bias is a judge LLM favoring outputs from its own model family, inflating their scores.

scenario: 你用 GPT-4 当评审来给包括 GPT-4 自家输出在内的多个模型打分。
scenario_en: You use GPT-4 as the judge to score several models, including GPT-4's own outputs.
q: 怎么防止 self-enhancement bias 污染评审结果？
q_en: How do you prevent self-enhancement bias from tainting the judging?
why: 用不同模型家族做交叉验证，或引入人工标注对照。GPT-4 评 GPT-4 会系统性抬分，换一个不同 family 的评审（或人工）能暴露这种偏袒，别让『裁判和选手同队』。
why_en: Cross-validate with a different model family or human annotators, since a judge inflates scores for its own family.
tradeoff: 换不同 family/人工交叉验证（暴露偏袒，成本增加）vs 单一同族评审（便宜但系统性抬自家分）
whenOtherWins: 如果被评模型里根本不含评审同族的模型，self-enhancement 风险低，可以直接用单一评审省成本。
options: 让 GPT-4 对同一批答案多打几轮取平均分，就能把偏袒抵消掉
用不同模型家族做交叉验证，或引入人工标注对照，暴露同族抬分
让被评模型自己也参与打分，用互相制衡的方式抵消掉偏向
只评非 GPT-4 家族的模型，把自家模型排除在评审范围外
options_en: Have GPT-4 score the same batch several rounds and average — that cancels out the favoritism.
Cross-validate with a different model family or human annotators to expose same-family inflation.
Let the evaluated models also score and use mutual checks to cancel out the bias.
Only evaluate models outside the GPT-4 family, excluding its own outputs from the review scope.
optionExplanations: 同一个评审多次平均，系统性偏袒还在，均值消不掉方向性偏差。
对；换不同 family 或人工交叉验证，才能把『裁判偏袒同队选手』这种系统偏差揪出来。
让选手自评引入更多自利偏差，问题更糟不是更好。
跳过自家输出等于回避评估，产品里还是要比 GPT-4，问题没解决。
optionExplanations_en: Averaging the same judge keeps the systematic favoritism; a mean can't cancel a directional bias.
Correct — a different family or human cross-validation is what exposes the judge favoring its own team.
Letting contestants self-score adds more self-interest bias — worse, not better.
Skipping its own outputs dodges evaluation; you still need to compare GPT-4 in production, so it's unsolved.

scenario: 团队想全程只用 LLM-as-judge 的分数来决定模型能否上生产。
scenario_en: The team wants to gate production purely on LLM-as-judge scores.
q: LLM-judge 分数能直接当上生产的验收标准吗？
q_en: Can LLM-judge scores directly gate production?
why: 不行：LLM-judge 适合开发期快速迭代，但因有系统性偏差，上生产前必须在留出集上用人工评估验证过它和人类判断一致。用它迭代、用人工把关，是安全的分工。
why_en: No — use LLM-judge for rapid iteration, but validate it against human eval on a held-out set before production because of its systematic biases.
options: 可以，LLM-judge 比人更准，直接拿它的分数上线即可
不行：先用它迭代，上生产前用人工在留出集上验证一致
可以，只要多用几个 prompt 打分求平均就绝对可靠
不行，LLM-judge 毫无用处，全流程都应该只用人工
options_en: Yes — LLM-judge is more accurate than humans, so gate releases on its score.
No: iterate with it, but validate agreement with humans on a held-out set before production.
Yes — just average several scoring prompts and it becomes fully reliable.
No — LLM-judge is useless; use humans for the entire process.
optionExplanations: LLM-judge 有 position/verbosity/self-enhancement 等偏差，未经人工校验直接上线有风险。
对；分工是 LLM-judge 迭代、人工在留出集验收，验证一致后才敢用于生产决策。
多 prompt 缓解 prompt sensitivity，但消不掉其它系统偏差，仍需人工校验。
全程人工太慢太贵，LLM-judge 在开发期极有价值，不该全盘否定。
optionExplanations_en: LLM-judge carries position/verbosity/self-enhancement biases; gating without human validation is risky.
Correct — the division is LLM-judge for iteration and humans for held-out validation before it gates production.
More prompts ease prompt sensitivity but not other systematic biases; human validation is still needed.
All-human is too slow and costly; LLM-judge is highly valuable in development and shouldn't be dismissed.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  D["dev loop: LLM-judge"] --> V{"agrees with human on held-out set?"}
  V -->|yes| P["gate production"]
  V -->|no| R["fix rubric or prompt"]
  R --> D

scenario: 要设计人工评估任务，有人打算直接问标注员『这个答案好不好？』。
scenario_en: Designing a human-eval task, someone plans to just ask annotators 'is this answer good?'
q: 人工评估的任务该怎么设计？
q_en: How should the human-evaluation task be constructed?
why: 别问笼统的『好不好』。要分解成原子、无歧义的问题，每个映射到一个维度：『是否回应了问题？』(相关性)、『有没有上下文里没有的主张？』(忠实度)、『是否通顺？』(流畅度)，用二元/序数信号各自独立分析。
why_en: Don't ask 'is it good?' — decompose into atomic, unambiguous questions each mapping to one dimension, analyzed with binary/ordinal signals.
tradeoff: 拆原子问题逐维度问（信号清晰、可独立分析）vs 笼统问『好不好』（口径不一、无法定位维度）
whenOtherWins: 如果只是想快速拿一个整体偏好排序（哪个更好）、不需要定位维度，pairwise 的整体偏好判断可以更快。
options: 直接问『这个答案好不好？』，让标注员打一个总分
拆成原子无歧义问题，每个映射一个维度独立分析
让标注员写一段自由评论，事后再人工归纳成结论
只问答案长度够不够，答得长的就判为质量更好
options_en: Just ask 'is this answer good?' and have annotators give one overall score.
Decompose into atomic, unambiguous questions, each mapped to one dimension and analyzed independently.
Have annotators write free-form comments and summarize them into conclusions later.
Only ask whether the answer is long enough — longer is judged better.
optionExplanations: 笼统的『好不好』每个标注员理解不同，口径乱、也定位不到是哪个维度出问题。
对；拆成映射维度的原子问题，信号清晰、可独立分析，还能对齐 RAG 三元组诊断。
自由评论难以量化和聚合，一致性差，不如结构化的原子问题。
以长度判好坏正是要避免的 verbosity 陷阱，长≠好。
optionExplanations_en: A vague 'is it good' means each annotator interprets differently — inconsistent and can't localize which dimension failed.
Correct — atomic questions mapped to dimensions give clean, independently-analyzable signals aligned with the RAG-triad diagnosis.
Free-form comments are hard to quantify and aggregate, with poor consistency, worse than structured atomic questions.
Judging by length is the verbosity trap to avoid; longer ≠ better.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["answer"] --> Q1["回应了问题吗 = 相关性"]
  A --> Q2["有上下文外的主张吗 = 忠实度"]
  A --> Q3["读起来通顺吗 = 流畅度"]

scenario: 人工评估里给 faithfulness 打 1-5 分，但不同标注员对『3 分』理解不一致，数据很飘。
scenario_en: In human eval, faithfulness is scored 1-5 but annotators disagree on what '3' means, so data is noisy.
q: 怎么让不同标注员的打分口径一致？
q_en: How do you make different annotators score consistently?
why: 给 rubric 配分数锚点：每个分值配具体例子，如 faithfulness 1=全是幻觉、3=部分有依据+至少一条无依据、5=每条主张都有依据。没有锚点，标注员的口径会随时间漂移，一致性下降。
why_en: Give the rubric concrete score anchors with an example per score, because without anchors annotator consistency drifts.
options: 把量表从 1-5 改成 1-100，刻度越细口径越一致
给 rubric 每个分值配锚点例子，统一打分参照
只留一个标注员打分，从源头上避免分歧出现
让标注员各自打完再互相商量，改到彼此一致
options_en: Change the scale from 1-5 to 1-100 — finer granularity means more consistent calibration.
Give every rubric score an anchor example so annotators share one reference.
Keep only one annotator so disagreement never arises.
Let annotators score independently, then discuss and revise until they agree.
optionExplanations: 刻度更细只会让口径更难对齐，1-100 比 1-5 更飘不是更稳。
对；每个分值配具体锚点例子，标注员有统一参照，一致性才稳得住。
只用一个标注员没法算一致性、也无法发现 rubric 歧义，掩盖问题而非解决。
事后商量会引入从众偏差，污染独立信号；应先用锚点让独立打分就一致。
optionExplanations_en: Finer granularity makes calibration harder; 1-100 drifts more than 1-5, not less.
Correct — a concrete anchor example per score gives annotators a shared reference, stabilizing consistency.
One annotator can't measure agreement or reveal rubric ambiguity — hiding the problem, not solving it.
Post-hoc discussion introduces conformity bias tainting independent signal; anchors should make independent scores agree first.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为量表每个分值给出的具体示例，统一标注员对该分值的理解。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A score anchor is a concrete example for each scale value that unifies annotators' understanding of that score.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  R["faithfulness rubric"] --> A1["1 = 全是幻觉"]
  R --> A3["3 = 部分有依据"]
  R --> A5["5 = 每条主张都有依据"]

scenario: 两名标注员按 rubric 打完分，你算出标注一致性（IAA）的 kappa 只有 0.3。
scenario_en: Two annotators finish scoring by rubric, and you compute an inter-annotator agreement (IAA) kappa of just 0.3.
q: IAA kappa = 0.3 意味着什么，该怎么做？
q_en: What does an IAA kappa of 0.3 mean, and what should you do?
why: IAA<0.4 是经验阈值，说明 rubric 有歧义、标注员理解不一，此时数据不可信。应先修 rubric（补锚点、澄清定义）再重新标注，而不是拿这批飘的数据去训练或下结论。
why_en: IAA below 0.4 is a rule-of-thumb signal that the rubric is ambiguous, so revise the rubric before trusting the data.
options: 0.3 已经够好，可以直接拿这批打好的标注数据去训练
IAA<0.4 说明 rubric 有歧义，先修再重标
说明是生成模型本身太差，应该立刻拿去重新训练一版
kappa 越低越好，说明标注员各自有独立判断不盲从
options_en: 0.3 is already good enough — take this labeled batch straight into training.
IAA below 0.4 means the rubric is ambiguous; fix it and relabel first.
It means the generator itself is bad and should be retrained right away.
Lower kappa is better — it shows annotators each judge independently instead of just following along.
optionExplanations: 0.3 低于 0.4 的经验线，数据一致性不足、不可信，直接用会把噪声当结论。
对；IAA<0.4 指向 rubric 歧义，先补锚点/澄清定义再重标，才拿得到可信信号。
低 IAA 是标注/评估口径问题，不是模型问题，重训模型是错方向。
kappa 低代表分歧大、信号不可信，不是好事，别把噪声美化成『独立见解』。
optionExplanations_en: 0.3 is below the 0.4 rule-of-thumb line; agreement is too low to trust, and using it treats noise as conclusion.
Correct — IAA below 0.4 points to rubric ambiguity; add anchors/clarify definitions and relabel to get trustworthy signal.
Low IAA is a labeling/rubric issue, not a model issue; retraining the model is the wrong direction.
Low kappa means high disagreement and untrustworthy signal — not good; don't romanticize noise as 'independent views'.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标注一致性：不同标注员对同一样本给出一致标签的程度，衡量数据可信度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IAA (Inter-Annotator Agreement) measures how consistently different annotators label the same items, gauging data reliability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 经过随机一致性修正的一致性度量，比原始一致率更严格，<0.4 视为偏低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kappa is a chance-corrected agreement measure stricter than raw agreement, with values below 0.4 considered low.

scenario: 算标注一致性时，有的任务是 2 个标注员，有的是 5 个标注员。
scenario_en: Computing IAA, some tasks have 2 annotators and some have 5.
q: Cohen's kappa 和 Fleiss' kappa 分别用在什么情形？
q_en: When do you use Cohen's kappa versus Fleiss' kappa?
why: Cohen's kappa 用于两名标注员之间；Fleiss' kappa 推广到多名标注员。两者都做了随机一致性修正，区别只在标注员数量：2 人用 Cohen、3 人及以上用 Fleiss。
why_en: Cohen's kappa is for two annotators; Fleiss' kappa generalizes to multiple annotators, both chance-corrected.
tradeoff: Cohen's kappa（恰好 2 名标注员）vs Fleiss' kappa（3 名及以上多标注员）
options: Cohen 用于多名标注员，Fleiss 用于两名标注员
Cohen 用于两名标注员，Fleiss 推广到多名标注员
两者都只能用于两名标注员之间，没有实质区别
Cohen 用于分类标注，Fleiss 用于回归数值标注
options_en: Cohen for multiple annotators, Fleiss for two annotators.
Cohen is for two annotators; Fleiss generalizes to multiple annotators.
Both work only between two annotators, with no real difference.
Cohen for categorical labels, Fleiss for regression-valued labels.
optionExplanations: 说反了：Cohen 是两人、Fleiss 才是多人。
对；人数决定用哪条公式，报告 IAA 时要写明是哪一个，否则数值没法比。
Fleiss 恰恰是为多标注员设计的，说『都只能两人』错误。
两者都用于分类标注的一致性，不是分类 vs 回归的区别。
optionExplanations_en: Reversed: Cohen is for two, Fleiss is for multiple.
Correct — the annotator count picks the formula, so state which kappa you're reporting or the numbers aren't comparable.
Fleiss is designed precisely for multiple annotators; 'both only two' is wrong.
Both measure agreement for categorical labeling, not a classification-vs-regression distinction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量两名标注员之间、经随机一致性修正的一致度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cohen's kappa measures chance-corrected agreement between two annotators.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 kappa 一致性度量推广到多名（≥3）标注员的版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fleiss' kappa generalizes the kappa agreement measure to multiple (3+) annotators.

q: 把生成式系统评估的分层策略按『从快到准』排序：
q_en: Order the layered gen-AI evaluation strategy from fastest to most trustworthy:
steps: 人工评估：上生产前的最终验证（gold standard）
自动指标（BLEU/BERTScore 等）：快速迭代时的粗筛信号
LLM-as-judge：开发期按 rubric 打分，比人快、比 n-gram 准
why: 分层：自动指标做快速迭代粗筛 → LLM-as-judge 做开发期评分 → 人工评估做上生产前的最终验证。越往后越准越贵，用便宜的筛掉大部分、把人工留给最后把关。
why_en: Automated metrics for rapid iteration, then LLM-as-judge for development, then human evaluation for final validation before production.
diagram:
flowchart LR A["自动指标
快速迭代"] --> J["LLM-as-judge
开发期评分"] J --> H["人工评估
上线前验证"]

scenario: 面试给一个 RAG 系统设计评估方案，想给出 staff 级的完整答案。
scenario_en: Designing an evaluation plan for a RAG system in an interview, you want a staff-level complete answer.
q: 评估方案里体现 staff 级水准的关键是什么？
q_en: What's the key to a staff-level evaluation plan here?
why: 关键是能把坏答案定位成检索失败还是生成失败，并给出针对性修复，再套一层『自动指标→LLM-judge→人工』的分层策略。只说『用 BLEU』或『用大模型』都停在表面，诊断分离+分层才是资深信号。
why_en: Pinpoint whether a bad answer is a retrieval or generation failure and propose targeted fixes, wrapped in an automated-to-LLM-judge-to-human layered strategy.
options: 承诺把 BLEU 分数做到全行业最高水平
定位坏答案是检索还是生成失败，并配分层评估策略
只用一个 LLM-judge 打个总分就交付方案
强调换最大的生成模型来一次性解决所有问题
options_en: Promise the industry's highest BLEU score.
Localize a bad answer to retrieval or generation, plus a layered eval strategy.
Just deliver one overall LLM-judge score.
Emphasize swapping in the biggest generator to solve everything at once.
optionExplanations: BLEU 分数高对开放式生成无意义，幻觉也能高分，是反信号。
对；诊断分离（检索 vs 生成）+ 针对性修复 + 分层评估，正是 gen AI 评估的资深答法。
只给一个总分既不诊断也不分层，且受 LLM-judge 偏差影响，停在浅层。
不诊断就换大模型可能白费——若是检索失败，换生成器解决不了。
optionExplanations_en: High BLEU is meaningless for open-ended generation and hallucinations score high too — a negative signal.
Correct — diagnostic separation (retrieval vs generation) plus targeted fixes plus layered evaluation is the senior gen-AI answer.
One overall score neither diagnoses nor layers and is subject to LLM-judge bias — shallow.
Swapping to a bigger model without diagnosis may waste effort — if it's a retrieval failure, a new generator won't fix it.

scenario: 面试官让你先讲清 ML 服务的三种范式，以及每种主要在优化什么。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to lay out the three ML serving paradigms and what each mainly optimizes.
q: ML 服务的三种范式是什么，各自的定位是什么？
q_en: What are the three ML serving paradigms and what does each optimize?
why: 同步在请求路径上一次往返出结果（低延迟）、异步按计划预算好存起来（低成本）、流式秒级更新（新鲜度）。服务架构同时决定延迟、成本和新鲜度，大规模系统常混用。
why_en: Synchronous (real-time, one HTTP round-trip, low latency), asynchronous (batch, pre-computed on a schedule, low cost), and streaming (near-real-time, seconds, freshness) — and large systems usually mix them.
diagram:
flowchart LR S["同步/实时
毫秒级 主打延迟"] A["异步/批处理
小时级 主打成本"] T["流式/近实时
秒级 主打新鲜度"]
options: 同步主打低延迟、异步主打低成本、流式主打新鲜度
只有同步和异步两种，流式只是异步的别名，没有第三种
三种范式优化的是同一目标（延迟），只是实现语言不同
三种范式指训练、验证、测试三个阶段，与线上服务无关
options_en: Synchronous optimizes low latency, asynchronous optimizes cost, streaming optimizes freshness.
Only synchronous and asynchronous exist; streaming is just another name for asynchronous, no third type.
All three optimize the same goal (latency) and differ only in implementation language.
The three paradigms are the train/validation/test stages, unrelated to online serving.
optionExplanations: 对；三种范式各有主打维度，服务架构是同时权衡延迟、成本、新鲜度的核心选择，常混用。
流式是独立的第三种（近实时、秒级），不是异步别名，异步是小时级批处理。
三者优化目标不同：同步保延迟、异步压成本、流式抢新鲜度，不是同一目标。
这是把服务范式和训练数据划分搞混了，三范式说的是线上出预测的方式。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — each paradigm has a lead dimension, and serving is the core tradeoff among latency, cost, and freshness, often mixed.
Streaming is a distinct third type (near-real-time, seconds), not an alias for async, which is hourly batch.
Their goals differ: sync guards latency, async cuts cost, streaming chases freshness — not one goal.
This confuses serving paradigms with training-data splits; the three describe how predictions are produced online.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把训练好的模型接入线上、产出预测的方式；同时决定用户延迟、基础设施成本和数据新鲜度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A serving architecture is how a trained model produces predictions online, jointly shaping user latency, infrastructure cost, and data freshness.

termDefinitions.meaning: 指 Meta、Amazon、Apple、Netflix、Google 这类超大规模互联网公司的统称。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MAANG refers to hyperscale internet companies like Meta, Amazon, Apple, Netflix, and Google.

scenario: 面试官要你在一张表里对比同步、异步、流式的延迟、成本和训练-服务偏斜风险。
scenario_en: The interviewer wants a table contrasting sync, async, and streaming on latency, cost, and training-serving skew risk.
q: 同步、异步、流式在延迟/成本/偏斜风险上怎么对比？
q_en: How do sync, async, and streaming contrast on latency, cost, and skew risk?
why: 同步：毫秒级延迟、成本最高、偏斜风险高（在线特征逻辑易与离线训练管线分叉）；异步：小时级、成本最低、偏斜风险低（复用同一套离线特征管线）；流式：秒到分钟级、成本居中、偏斜风险中等。这条对比是选范式的地图。
why_en: Sync is ms latency, highest cost, high skew risk; async is hours, cheapest, low skew; streaming is seconds-to-minutes, moderate cost and moderate skew.
tradeoff: 同步（低延迟但贵+高偏斜）vs 异步（便宜+低偏斜但陈旧）vs 流式（新鲜但运维复杂、居中）
options: 三种范式的延迟、成本、偏斜风险都相同，选哪种都一样
同步毫秒/最贵/高偏斜；异步小时/最省/低偏斜；流式居中
异步延迟最低、成本最高，同步延迟最高、成本最低，正好相反
偏斜风险只由模型大小决定，与服务范式和特征计算路径无关
options_en: All three have identical latency, cost, and skew risk, so it doesn't matter which you pick.
Sync: ms, priciest, high skew; async: hours, cheapest, low skew; streaming sits in between.
Async has the lowest latency and highest cost, sync the highest latency and lowest cost — reversed.
Skew risk is decided only by model size, unrelated to the paradigm or the feature path.
optionExplanations: 三者在三条维度上系统性不同，正是这些差异决定了按约束选范式。
对；这张对比表是选范式的中立地图，本题答案由具体延迟/成本/新鲜度约束在图上选行。
彻底说反了：同步才是最低延迟最高成本，异步才是最高延迟最低成本。
偏斜来自在线特征逻辑与离线训练管线是否一致，服务范式直接影响它——同步最高、异步最低。
optionExplanations_en: The three differ systematically on all three axes, and those differences drive constraint-based choice.
Correct — this table is the neutral map; the answer for a case is chosen by the actual latency/cost/freshness constraints.
Fully reversed: sync is lowest latency and highest cost, async is highest latency and lowest cost.
Skew comes from whether online feature logic matches the offline training pipeline; the paradigm strongly affects it — highest for sync, lowest for batch.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏斜
termDefinitions.meaning: 线上服务时的特征/逻辑与离线训练时不一致，导致模型线上表现劣于离线，是三种范式共有的首要风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is a mismatch between features/logic at serving time and at training time, degrading online performance — the shared first-order risk.

scenario: 模型离线评估很好，上线后指标明显掉，你怀疑训练和服务时算特征的方式不一致。
scenario_en: A model evaluates well offline but drops in production; you suspect features are computed differently at training vs serving time.
q: 训练-服务偏斜是什么，为什么是所有服务范式的首要风险？
q_en: What is training-serving skew, and why is it the first-order risk across all paradigms?
why: 偏斜=服务时的特征计算或分布与训练时不一致：同一个「近 7 天点击数」线上现算、离线批算，一分叉模型就吃到陌生输入而掉点。三种范式都有，同步最危险。
why_en: Skew is when serving-time feature computation diverges from training, so the model sees different inputs than it learned on and degrades; it spans all paradigms, worst in sync, mitigated by mirroring the training pipeline.
options: 偏斜指模型太大装不进显存，与特征计算无关，扩显存或换卡即可
服务时特征计算/分布与训练时不一致，模型吃到不同输入而掉点
偏斜只在异步批处理里出现，同步和流式天然免疫
偏斜是网络延迟抖动，加 CDN 就能消除
options_en: Skew means the model no longer fits in GPU memory; unrelated to features, just add memory or swap cards.
Serving-time feature computation or distribution diverges from training, so the model sees different inputs and degrades.
Skew only appears in async batch; sync and streaming are naturally immune.
Skew is network latency jitter, removable with a CDN.
optionExplanations: 偏斜是特征/分布不一致的问题，不是显存问题，扩显存无关。
对；训练与服务的特征逻辑一分叉，模型输入就变了、线上掉点；同步在线现算特征最容易分叉。
恰恰相反：异步复用离线管线偏斜最低，同步现算特征偏斜最高，没有范式天然免疫。
偏斜是数据/特征一致性问题，不是网络抖动，CDN 解决不了。
optionExplanations_en: Skew is a feature/distribution mismatch, not a memory issue; adding GPU memory is irrelevant.
Correct — once training and serving feature logic diverge, the model's inputs change and it degrades; sync computing features live diverges most easily.
The opposite: async reusing offline pipelines has the lowest skew, sync computing features live the highest; no paradigm is immune.
Skew is a data/feature consistency problem, not network jitter, so a CDN can't fix it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一存放特征、并让训练与在线服务读同一份特征定义的系统，是抑制训练-服务偏斜的关键层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store centrally holds features so training and online serving read the same definitions, a key layer for suppressing training-serving skew.

scenario: Stripe 要在一笔支付「完成之前」判定是否欺诈并放行/拒绝，预测就卡在关键路径上，用户在等结果。
scenario_en: Stripe must decide fraud approve/decline before a payment completes, so the prediction sits on the critical path with the user waiting.
q: 预测卡在同步关键路径上，该用哪种服务范式？
q_en: When prediction is on the synchronous critical path, which paradigm?
why: 用同步实时推理：请求→模型服务器→响应一次 HTTP 往返内出结果，因为放行/拒绝必须在支付完成前给出，等不了预计算或批处理。代价是成本最高、要按峰值常备算力，还常需量化/蒸馏压到延迟预算内。
why_en: Use synchronous real-time inference — request to model server to response in one HTTP round-trip — because the decision must return before the payment completes, at the cost of highest, peak-provisioned compute.
tradeoff: 同步（关键路径必须即时出结果，但成本最高）vs 批处理（便宜，但结果不在请求路径上、来不及）
whenOtherWins: 如果预测不在用户等待的关键路径上、可容忍小时级陈旧（如离线批量算推荐再存起来），就该用异步批处理省成本。
options: 异步批处理：每晚预算好所有交易的欺诈分，白天查表返回
同步实时推理：一次往返内出结果，支付完成前给出放行/拒绝
流式近实时：把交易打进 Kafka，几秒内算完再回写
先不决策，交易照常放行，事后每晚批量复核可疑交易再追回
options_en: Async batch: pre-compute fraud scores for all transactions overnight and look them up during the day.
Synchronous real-time inference: one round-trip decides approve or decline before the payment completes.
Streaming near-real-time: push transactions into Kafka and score within a few seconds before writing back.
Don't decide up front — approve everything and batch-review suspicious transactions nightly to claw back.
optionExplanations: 批处理预算的是过去的交易，新交易还没发生就没有分，无法在支付完成前给出放行/拒绝。
对；决策卡在支付完成前的关键路径上，只有同步一次往返能满足，代价是成本最高。
秒级对支付授权还是太慢，用户和商户在同步等一个即时的批准/拒绝，流式追不上。
先放行再事后复核意味着欺诈交易已经成功，违背「完成前决策」的硬约束。
optionExplanations_en: Batch pre-computes past transactions; a brand-new one has no score yet, so it can't approve/decline before completion.
Correct — the decision is on the critical path before payment completes, and only a synchronous round-trip meets it, at highest cost.
Seconds is still too slow for payment authorization; the user and merchant wait synchronously for an instant approve/decline.
Approve-then-review means the fraudulent transaction already succeeded, breaking the decide-before-completion constraint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户请求必须等待其完成才能继续的处理链路；卡在关键路径上的预测必须同步、即时返回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The critical path is the processing chain a user request must wait on to proceed; a prediction on it must return synchronously and instantly.

scenario: 要给一个同步实时推理服务画基础设施：如何在个位数毫秒内组装特征并出预测。
scenario_en: Sketch the infra for a synchronous real-time inference service: how to assemble features and predict in single-digit ms.
q: 同步实时推理的典型基础设施长什么样？
q_en: What does typical synchronous real-time inference infra look like?
why: API 网关→负载均衡→模型服务器（TensorFlow Serving、Triton）按 QPS 扩缩，特征在请求时从 Redis/DynamoDB 个位数毫秒取出。整条链路都为一次往返内出结果服务。
why_en: API gateway to model servers (TensorFlow Serving, Triton) behind load balancers autoscaled on QPS, with features assembled at request time from a low-latency store (Redis, DynamoDB) in single-digit ms.
diagram:
flowchart LR U["请求"] --> G["API 网关"] --> LB["负载均衡"] --> M["模型服务器
TF Serving/Triton"] FS["低延迟特征存储
Redis/DynamoDB"] --> M M --> R["响应"]
options: 每晚 Spark 批量打分写进 KV，白天只查表，不做在线推理
API 网关→LB→模型服务器按 QPS 扩缩，请求时从 Redis 取特征
事件进 Kafka 由 Flink 窗口聚合后再异步回写特征库
把模型整个嵌进客户端 App，完全不需要任何服务器端推理设施
options_en: Nightly Spark batch scores into a KV store; daytime is lookup-only with no online inference.
API gateway to a load balancer to model servers autoscaled on QPS, with features fetched from Redis at request time.
Events go into Kafka, Flink aggregates windows, then asynchronously writes back to the feature store.
Embed the whole model inside the client app so no server-side inference infrastructure exists.
optionExplanations: 这是异步批处理的架构（Spark 打分、查表），不是同步在线推理。
对；网关+模型服务器+按 QPS 扩缩+请求时低延迟取特征，正是同步实时的标配，全为延迟预算服务。
Kafka+Flink 窗口聚合是流式管线，不是一次 HTTP 往返内出结果的同步推理。
端上推理是另一类方案，题问的是服务器端同步实时推理的典型基础设施。
optionExplanations_en: That's async batch (Spark scoring, lookup), not synchronous online inference.
Correct — gateway plus model servers plus QPS autoscaling plus request-time low-latency features is the sync real-time standard, all for the latency budget.
Kafka plus Flink windowing is a streaming pipeline, not one-round-trip synchronous inference.
On-device inference is a different approach; the question is server-side synchronous real-time infra.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒查询数，衡量请求负载；同步服务按 QPS 自动扩缩模型服务器数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS (Queries Per Second) measures request load; synchronous services autoscale model-server count on QPS.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生产级模型推理服务器：把训练好的模型包成高吞吐、低延迟的在线服务端点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TensorFlow Serving and Triton are production model-inference servers that expose a trained model as a high-throughput, low-latency online endpoint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 低延迟键值存储：Redis 是内存 KV，DynamoDB 是托管 KV，用于请求时个位数毫秒取特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis (in-memory KV) and DynamoDB (managed KV) are low-latency key-value stores used to fetch features in single-digit ms at request time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式消息队列，把事件按主题持久化排队，供下游流处理消费。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed message queue that durably buffers events by topic for downstream stream processors to consume.

termDefinitions.meaning: 流处理引擎，对事件流做有状态的窗口聚合与实时计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Flink is a stream processing engine that runs stateful windowed aggregations over event streams in real time.

scenario: 财务问：为什么同步实时推理是三种范式里最烧钱的？
scenario_en: Finance asks: why is synchronous real-time inference the most expensive of the three paradigms?
q: 为什么同步实时服务成本最高？
q_en: Why is synchronous real-time serving the most expensive?
why: 因为它要为峰值和尾延迟常备算力：GPU/CPU 得一直在线待命、按最高 QPS 和 p99 尾延迟做容量规划，空闲时段也在烧钱。相比之下批处理能把机器用完即走、跑 spot 抢占实例，所以同步最贵。
why_en: It must keep GPU/CPU always-on and provisioned for peak QPS and p99 tail latency, burning money even when idle, whereas batch spins up ephemerally on spot instances.
options: 为峰值和 p99 尾延迟常备在线算力，空闲时段也在烧钱
因为它每次请求都要重新训练一遍模型，训练开销随流量线性增长
因为它必须把全部历史数据常驻内存才能响应，内存账单最贵
其实它最便宜，只是模型服务器的许可证和监控费用偏高
options_en: It keeps always-on compute provisioned for peak and p99 tail latency, burning money even when idle.
Because it retrains the model on every request, so training cost grows linearly with traffic.
Because it must keep all historical data resident in memory to respond, making RAM the top bill.
Actually it's the cheapest; only the model server's license and monitoring fees run high.
optionExplanations: 对；常备算力+按峰值和 p99 尾延迟规划容量是同步成本高的根因，空闲时段也停不下来。
同步推理只做前向推理，不在请求时重训模型，这不是成本来源。
推理只需模型权重和请求特征，不需要把全部历史数据装进内存。
同步恰恰是三者里最贵的，不是最便宜，成本来自常备算力而非许可证。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — always-on compute sized for peak and p99 tail latency is why sync costs most; you can't spin it down when idle.
Sync inference only does a forward pass, not retraining per request — not the cost source.
Inference needs only model weights and request features, not all historical data in memory.
Sync is the most expensive of the three, not the cheapest, and the cost is always-on compute, not licensing.

termDefinitions.term: p99 tail latency / p99 尾延迟
termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 请求快于该延迟、最慢 1% 的延迟上界；同步服务要按尾延迟而非平均值做容量规划。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p99 tail latency is the bound below which 99% of requests fall; sync services must be sized by the tail, not the average.

termDefinitions.meaning: 云厂商可随时回收的廉价临时算力，适合可中断的批处理任务，同步在线服务不能用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Spot/preemptible instances are cheap, reclaimable compute suited to interruptible batch jobs, not always-on synchronous serving.

scenario: 同步服务的模型太大、跑不进个位数到几十毫秒的延迟预算，你要压小它。
scenario_en: A synchronous service's model is too big for the single-to-tens-of-ms latency budget; you must shrink it.
q: 哪些技术常用来把同步模型压进延迟预算？(多选)
q_en: Which techniques are commonly used to fit a sync model into the latency budget? (multiple)
why: 量化（用低精度如 int8 表示权重，减小体积、加速推理）、蒸馏（用大模型教出一个更小更快的学生模型）、ONNX（跨框架的优化推理运行时/格式）都能压延迟。加更多历史训练数据不改变推理延迟，跑题。
why_en: Quantization, distillation, and ONNX all cut inference latency, while adding more training data doesn't change serving latency.
options: 量化：用 int8 等低精度表示权重，减小体积、加速推理
蒸馏：用大模型教出一个更小更快的学生模型顶替上线
ONNX：跨框架的优化推理运行时/格式，提速推理
加更多历史训练数据，让模型见得更多
options_en: Quantization: represent weights in low precision like int8 to shrink size and speed inference.
Distillation: train a smaller, faster student model from a large teacher to serve instead.
ONNX: a cross-framework optimized inference runtime/format that speeds inference.
Add more historical training data so the model sees more examples.
optionExplanations: 对；量化把权重降到 int8 等低精度，模型更小、算得更快，直接砍推理延迟。
对；蒸馏出的小学生模型延迟更低，用它上线换取延迟预算，代价是略损精度。
对；ONNX 运行时对算子做图优化、跨框架加速，是压推理延迟的常用手段。
错；加训练数据影响的是模型质量和训练时长，不改变线上单次推理延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — quantization drops weights to int8-like precision, shrinking the model and speeding compute, directly cutting inference latency.
Correct — a distilled student model has lower latency; serving it buys the latency budget at slight accuracy cost.
Correct — the ONNX runtime graph-optimizes operators and accelerates across frameworks, a common latency-cutting tool.
Wrong — more training data affects model quality and training time, not per-request serving latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型权重从高精度（fp32）降到低精度（int8）表示，减小体积、加速推理，略损精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization lowers model weights from high precision (fp32) to low precision (int8) to shrink size and speed inference at slight accuracy cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用大模型（teacher）的输出训练一个更小的学生模型，逼近其能力但延迟更低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a smaller student model from a large teacher's outputs to approximate it at lower latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跨框架的模型交换格式与优化推理运行时，用于加速线上推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange) is a cross-framework model format and optimized inference runtime used to accelerate serving.

scenario: 同步服务在请求时用一套在线代码现算特征，而训练时特征是另一套离线管线算的。
scenario_en: A sync service computes features live with online code at request time, while training used a separate offline pipeline.
q: 为什么训练-服务偏斜在同步范式里最危险，怎么防？
q_en: Why is training-serving skew most dangerous in the synchronous paradigm, and how to guard?
why: 同步要在请求时用在线代码现算特征，这套逻辑最容易和离线训练管线分叉（单位、缺失值、时间窗口口径不同），模型吃到与训练时不同的输入而线上掉点。防法是校验在线特征逻辑严格镜像训练管线，最好共用同一个特征存储/定义。
why_en: Sync computes features live with online code that most easily diverges from the offline training pipeline, so validate that online logic exactly mirrors training, ideally via a shared feature store.
options: 因为同步不需要特征，全靠模型参数直接出结果，偏斜无从谈起
同步在请求时用在线代码现算特征，最易与离线训练管线分叉
因为同步的偏斜来自 GPU 温度过高，加散热即可
同步其实偏斜最低，因为它跑得最快、数据来不及漂移
options_en: Because sync needs no features at all and answers from model weights alone, so skew cannot arise.
Sync computes features live with online code, which most easily diverges from the offline training pipeline.
Because sync's skew comes from GPU overheating, fixable with more cooling.
Sync actually has the least skew because it runs fastest and data has no time to drift.
optionExplanations: 同步当然需要特征，还得在请求时现算，正因此最容易分叉。
对；在线现算与离线管线一分叉，模型输入就变了；镜像训练逻辑、共用特征存储是标准防法。
偏斜是特征一致性问题，与 GPU 温度无关，散热解决不了。
同步偏斜最高不是最低，速度快和偏斜低是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Sync does need features, computed live at request time, which is exactly why it diverges most.
Correct — once live computation diverges from the offline pipeline the inputs change; mirroring training logic and sharing a feature store is the standard guard.
Skew is feature consistency, unrelated to GPU temperature, so cooling won't help.
Sync has the highest skew, not lowest; being fast is unrelated to skew.

termDefinitions.term: online feature logic / 在线特征逻辑
termDefinitions.meaning: 同步服务在请求时实时计算特征的代码；若与离线训练管线口径不一致就产生偏斜。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Online feature logic is the code a sync service runs to compute features live at request time; if it doesn't match the offline training pipeline, skew results.

scenario: Netflix 每晚给每个用户 × 候选集算推荐，几十亿条，白天用户打开首页要求个位毫秒返回，且当天新鲜度可以放宽。
scenario_en: Netflix scores every user × candidate set nightly (billions of rows); the daytime homepage needs sub-ms return and same-day freshness is relaxed.
q: 这种「预测集有界、新鲜度可放宽、量极大」的场景该用哪种范式？
q_en: Which paradigm fits a bounded prediction set, relaxed freshness, and huge volume?
why: 用异步批处理：每晚 Spark 大批量给所有用户×候选打分写进 KV 存储，白天 App 做亚毫秒查表而非在线推理。大 batch 把 GPU 利用率拉满、还能跑 spot 抢占实例，成本最低；代价是结果陈旧到下一批才更新。
why_en: Use async batch — nightly Spark scores all users x candidates into a KV store and the app does sub-ms lookups instead of inference — maximizing GPU utilization cheaply, at the cost of staleness.
tradeoff: 异步批处理（成本最低、亚毫秒查表，但结果陈旧）vs 同步（永远新鲜，但按峰值常备算力、最贵）
whenOtherWins: 如果需要基于用户此刻行为的即时预测（如刚搜完就要更新的结果）、或预测集无法预先枚举，就得上同步或流式，批处理的陈旧无法接受。
options: 同步实时：每次用户打开首页都现场跑一次模型算全部候选
异步批处理：每晚 Spark 批量打分写 KV，白天亚毫秒查表
流式近实时：每个用户行为事件都进 Kafka 触发重算
把所有推荐硬编码成全站统一的固定热门榜单，完全不用模型
options_en: Synchronous real-time: run the model over every candidate each time a user opens the homepage.
Async batch: nightly Spark scoring written into a KV store, with sub-millisecond lookups during the day.
Streaming near-real-time: every user behavior event enters Kafka and triggers a re-score.
Hard-code every recommendation into one site-wide fixed popularity chart with no model at all.
optionExplanations: 预测集有界、新鲜度可放宽时，每次现算推理是浪费——同步最贵，这里没必要。
对；大 batch 预算好写 KV、白天查表，GPU 利用率高、可用 spot、成本最低，正好匹配可放宽新鲜度。
为每个事件实时重算是流式，成本和运维都更高，这里新鲜度可放宽用不着。
硬编码榜单丢掉了个性化，不是「用模型给每个用户×候选打分」的推荐系统。
optionExplanations_en: With a bounded set and relaxed freshness, re-inferring each time is wasteful — sync is priciest and unnecessary here.
Correct — large batches into KV plus daytime lookups give high GPU utilization, spot usage, and lowest cost, matching relaxed freshness.
Re-scoring per event is streaming, costlier to run and operate, and unneeded when freshness is relaxed.
A hard-coded chart drops personalization; it's not a model scoring every user x candidate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按计划（小时/天/周）离线大批量预算预测并存起来，服务时查表而非推理的范式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Asynchronous batch pre-computes predictions offline on a schedule (hourly/daily/weekly) and stores them, serving via lookup instead of inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式大数据批处理引擎，常用来给海量用户×候选批量打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Spark is a distributed big-data batch engine commonly used to score massive user x candidate sets.

scenario: 面试官问：为什么异步批处理是三种范式里最便宜的？
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: why is async batch the cheapest of the three paradigms?
q: 为什么异步批处理成本最低？
q_en: Why is async batch the cheapest paradigm?
why: 因为它按计划跑、用完即走：大 batch 把 GPU 利用率拉满（一次处理海量样本，摊薄启动开销），机器是临时起的、可跑便宜的 spot/抢占实例，由 Airflow 编排。不像同步要按峰值常备在线算力，所以最省。
why_en: It runs on a schedule and spins down: large batches max GPU utilization and it uses cheap ephemeral spot/preemptible instances orchestrated by Airflow, versus sync's always-on peak provisioning.
options: 因为它每次只算一个样本，显存占用小、可以用最便宜的机器
按计划跑、用完即走，大 batch 拉满 GPU 利用率
因为它根本不需要模型，直接从数据库查历史平均值返回
因为它把推理都放到用户手机上跑，服务端几乎零算力成本
options_en: Because it scores one sample at a time, using little memory so the cheapest machines suffice.
It runs on a schedule and spins down, with big batches maxing GPU utilization.
Because it needs no model at all and just returns a historical average from the database.
Because it pushes inference onto users phones, leaving nearly zero server-side compute cost.
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反：批处理一次算海量样本（大 batch），高利用率正是它便宜的原因，不是逐样本。
对；计划性、可中断、大 batch 高利用率、spot 便宜，这些叠加让异步成本最低。
批处理当然要用模型打分，只是把打分结果存起来供查，不是纯查数据库。
端上推理是另一类方案；异步批处理是服务端定时大批量打分，不是手机推理。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite: batch processes huge sample sets at once (large batches), and high utilization is why it's cheap, not per-sample.
Correct — scheduled, interruptible, high-utilization large batches on cheap spot instances make async the lowest cost.
Batch still runs the model to score; it just stores results for lookup, not pure DB queries.
On-device inference is different; async batch is scheduled server-side bulk scoring, not phone inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 工作流编排工具，用有向无环图调度定时批处理任务（如每晚打分作业）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Airflow is a workflow orchestrator that schedules batch jobs as DAGs, e.g. nightly scoring runs.

termDefinitions.meaning: GPU 计算资源被有效使用的比例；大 batch 一次喂满 GPU，利用率高、单条成本低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GPU utilization is the fraction of GPU compute effectively used; large batches keep it high, lowering per-item cost.

scenario: 用户中午搜了徒步靴，但推荐首页到晚上还在给他看昨天那批推荐，没反映今天的兴趣。
scenario_en: A user searched hiking boots at noon, but the rec homepage still shows yesterday's batch until night, not today's interest.
q: 异步批处理的核心局限是什么，为什么？
q_en: What is async batch's core limitation, and why?
why: 核心局限是陈旧（staleness）：预测在上一批算好后就冻结，直到下一批才更新，所以用户当天的新行为在下次跑批前不会反映到推荐里。这是「按计划预算、服务时查表」这一设计的必然代价，用新鲜度换成本。
why_en: The core limitation is staleness — predictions freeze from the last batch until the next run, so today's new behavior isn't reflected until the next job, the inherent cost of trading freshness for cost.
options: 核心局限是延迟太高，即使是查一次表也要好几秒才返回
陈旧：预测冻结到下一批才更新，当天新行为不被反映
核心局限是成本太高，因为它同样要常备 GPU 在线待命
核心局限是偏斜最严重，因为它在请求时用在线代码现算特征
options_en: The core limit is latency: even a single lookup takes several seconds to return.
Staleness: predictions freeze until the next batch, so the day’s new behavior is not reflected.
The core limit is cost, because it also keeps GPUs provisioned and idling online.
The core limit is worst-case skew, because it computes features live with online code.
optionExplanations: 查表本身是亚毫秒的，延迟不是批处理的问题；它的痛点是新鲜度。
对；预测按批冻结、下一批才更新，是批处理用新鲜度换成本的必然代价。
批处理恰恰成本最低、用完即走，不常备 GPU，成本不是它的局限。
批处理复用离线管线，偏斜最低不是最高；在线现算特征是同步的特征。
optionExplanations_en: The lookup itself is sub-ms; latency isn't batch's problem — freshness is its pain point.
Correct — predictions freeze per batch and update only next run, the inherent freshness-for-cost tradeoff.
Batch is the cheapest and spins down, no always-on GPUs, so cost isn't its limitation.
Batch reuses offline pipelines and has the lowest skew, not the highest; live feature computation is sync's trait.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测反映的是上一次批处理时的状态，不含此后的新数据/新行为，直到下一批才更新。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Staleness means predictions reflect the last batch's state and miss newer data/behavior until the next run.

scenario: 面试官问：为什么异步批处理天然最不容易出训练-服务偏斜？
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: why is async batch naturally least prone to training-serving skew?
q: 为什么异步批处理的偏斜风险最低？
q_en: Why does async batch have the lowest skew risk?
why: 因为打分时复用的就是训练时那套离线特征管线——同一份代码、同一套特征定义算特征，服务侧和训练侧不分叉，自然没有在线/离线口径不一致的偏斜。这与同步在请求时另写一套在线特征逻辑正好相反。
why_en: Because scoring reuses the very same offline feature pipeline as training — same code, same definitions — so serving and training don't diverge, unlike sync's separate online feature logic.
options: 因为批处理复用训练时同一套离线特征管线打分，服务与训练不分叉，天然无偏斜
因为批处理根本不用特征，直接输出随机结果
因为批处理每次都重新训练模型，所以永远最新
因为批处理跑在 GPU 上而训练跑在 CPU 上，硬件不同就没偏斜
options_en: Because batch reuses the same offline feature pipeline as training to score, so serving and training don't diverge — naturally skew-free.
Because batch uses no features and just outputs random results.
Because batch retrains the model each run, so it's always up to date.
Because batch runs on GPU while training runs on CPU, and different hardware means no skew.
optionExplanations: 对；复用同一套离线特征管线是批处理低偏斜的根因——服务和训练算特征的代码一致就不分叉。
批处理当然用特征打分，输出的是模型预测不是随机数。
批处理是打分不是重训模型，低偏斜来自特征管线复用而非重训。
偏斜是特征逻辑一致性问题，与 GPU/CPU 硬件无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — reusing the same offline feature pipeline is why batch has low skew; identical feature code in serving and training doesn't diverge.
Batch does use features to score, outputting model predictions, not random numbers.
Batch scores rather than retrains; low skew comes from pipeline reuse, not retraining.
Skew is feature-logic consistency, unrelated to GPU vs CPU hardware.

termDefinitions.term: offline feature pipeline / 离线特征管线
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时批量计算特征的代码/流程；批处理服务复用它来打分，从而避免训练-服务偏斜。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The offline feature pipeline is the batch feature-computation code used at training; batch serving reuses it to score, avoiding skew.

scenario: Uber 的到达时间预估（ETA）要随路况持续更新，但不需要亚 100ms 的即时响应，几秒内刷新就够、且要贴近当前状态。
scenario_en: Uber ETA must continuously update with traffic but needs no sub-100ms response — refreshing within seconds while staying close to current state is enough.
q: 「要新鲜但不卡死延迟、要持续更新」的场景该用哪种范式？
q_en: Which paradigm fits fresh-but-not-ultra-low-latency continuous updates?
why: 用流式近实时：事件进 Kafka、Flink 算窗口特征并打分，秒到分钟级更新，填补同步太严和批处理太陈旧之间的空档。代价是运维复杂（精确一次、背压、检查点）。
why_en: Use streaming near-real-time — events into Kafka, Flink computes windowed features and scores in seconds — filling the gap between sync's strict latency and batch's staleness, at the cost of operational complexity.
tradeoff: 流式（秒级新鲜、可跑更重模型，但运维复杂）vs 批处理（更便宜，但陈旧追不上路况）
whenOtherWins: 如果预测卡在用户等待的亚 100ms 关键路径上（支付授权、广告竞价），流式的秒级还是太慢，必须同步；若新鲜度可放宽到小时级则用更省的批处理。
options: 同步实时：每次 ETA 都在用户等待的关键路径上做一次往返推理
流式近实时：事件进 Kafka，Flink 算窗口特征打分，秒级更新
异步批处理：每晚算一次全城 ETA，白天所有请求都直接查表
把 ETA 写死成按距离折算的固定值，不随实时路况变化
options_en: Synchronous real-time: each ETA runs a round-trip inference on the user's waiting critical path.
Streaming near-real-time: events into Kafka, Flink computes windowed features and scores, updating in seconds.
