Correct — this self-reinforcing loop is online learning's signature gaming risk; retraining alone cannot fix it, you need anomaly detection and filtering at the signal intake.
Adding machines does not fix polluted signal; this is a data-trust problem, not a compute bottleneck.
Training-serving skew is inconsistent feature computation, which is a different problem from malicious injected clicks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 外部行为者注入伪造信号，让模型放大他们想推的内容，形成自我强化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feedback-loop gaming is when actors inject fake signals so the model amplifies the content they want, in a self-reinforcing loop.

scenario: 团队想给某任务上在线学习，先评估这个任务到底适不适合。
scenario_en: A team wants online learning for a task and first assesses whether the task is even suitable.
q: 满足哪些条件时在线学习才可行？(多选)
q_en: Which conditions make online learning viable? (multiple)
why: 在线学习可行的三条：标签回流快(点击而非 90 天违约)、特征空间稳定(无 schema 频繁变动)、单次坏更新影响面有界。三者缺一，即时更新的风险就压过收益。
why_en: Online learning is viable when labels arrive fast (clicks, not 90-day defaults), the feature space is stable (no schema churn), and a single bad update is bounded; miss any one and the risk of instant updates outweighs the benefit.
options: 标签回流快(如点击，而非 90 天后才确认的贷款违约)
特征空间稳定，没有频繁的 schema 变动
单次坏更新的影响面有界，能限制爆炸半径
有大量离线历史数据可供一次性预训练
options_en: Labels arrive fast (clicks, not loan defaults confirmed after 90 days).
The feature space is stable with no frequent schema churn.
A single bad update's blast radius is bounded and can be contained.
There is lots of offline historical data available for a one-time pretrain.
optionExplanations: 对；标签越快回流，在线学习越能即时纠偏；90 天才确认的标签没法支撑即时更新。
对；schema 频繁变动会让在线更新学到不一致的特征，稳定特征空间是前提。
对；影响面有界才敢即时上线，坏更新不至于波及全量用户。
错；有离线历史数据只支持批量预训练，不是在线学习是否可行的判据。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the faster labels return, the sooner online learning can self-correct; labels confirmed after 90 days cannot support instant updates.
Correct — frequent schema churn makes online updates learn inconsistent features, so a stable feature space is a precondition.
Correct — a bounded blast radius is what makes instant deployment safe, so a bad update cannot reach all users.
Wrong — having offline history only supports batch pretraining and is not a criterion for online-learning viability.

termDefinitions.term: schema churn / schema 频繁变动
termDefinitions.meaning: 特征的字段/格式经常增删改，会破坏训练与服务的一致性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Schema churn is frequent changes to feature fields or formats, which breaks consistency between training and serving.

tradeoff: 即时新鲜度 vs 更新安全性：标签快/特征稳/影响面有界才敢换新鲜度，否则宁可批量再训练
tradeoff_en: Instant freshness vs update safety: only fast labels, stable features, and a bounded blast radius justify trading safety for freshness.

scenario: 一家 MAANG 公司既想要在线学习的即时性，又怕一次坏更新拖垮整个推荐系统。
scenario_en: A MAANG company wants online learning's immediacy but fears one bad update taking down the whole recommender.
q: 他们通常怎么在系统里放置在线学习，以限制爆炸半径？
q_en: How do they typically place online learning in the system to bound the blast radius?
why: 选择性使用：只让最终排序层做在线学习(改动局部、易回滚)，上游候选生成等重模块走周期性再训练，这样一次坏更新只影响排序而不波及整条管线。
why_en: Use it selectively: put online learning only on the final ranking layer (local, easy to roll back) while upstream candidate generation stays on periodic retraining, so a bad update touches only ranking, not the whole pipeline.
tradeoff: 只在线最终排序层(即时且影响面有界) vs 全链路在线(更即时但坏更新波及全系统)
options: 整条管线（候选生成+排序）全部改成在线学习，追求最大即时性，不做任何隔离
上游候选生成在线、最终排序层走批量，把稳定性放在最后一层，反而更省心
全部保持离线批量训练，彻底放弃在线学习，靠更频繁的批量周期兜底风险
只让最终排序层在线学习、上游走周期性再训练，把爆炸半径圈在排序层
options_en: Convert the entire pipeline (candidate generation plus ranking) to online learning for maximum immediacy, with no isolation at all.
Make upstream candidate generation online and the final ranking layer batch, putting stability in the last layer — supposedly simpler.
Keep everything offline batch training, abandoning online learning entirely, relying on a more frequent batch cadence to cover the risk.
Make only the final ranking layer online and keep upstream on periodic retraining, boxing the blast radius into ranking.
whenOtherWins: 若上游候选生成本身也要秒级追热点(如突发新闻检索)，可给它加一个受控的实时侧路，但仍需与主索引隔离以限风险。
optionExplanations: 全链路在线把爆炸半径拉到最大，一次坏更新能同时污染检索和排序，与他们的目标相反。
顺序搞反：候选生成是重、影响面大的上游，最不该做在线，并不会更省心；即时性应放在末端排序。
全离线放弃了即时性——批量周期再频繁也是小时/天级，追不上分钟级趋势，与「既要在线又要限风险」的目标不符。
对；末端排序改动局部、易回滚，在线放这里既得即时性又把风险圈住，是 MAANG 常见做法。
optionExplanations_en: Whole-pipeline online maximizes the blast radius; one bad update can poison both retrieval and ranking, the opposite of their goal.
Order reversed: candidate generation is the heavy, wide-impact upstream that should least be online, and it is not actually simpler; immediacy belongs at the ranking tail.
Fully offline abandons immediacy — even a more frequent batch cadence is still hours-to-days, too slow for minute-level trends, contradicting the goal of wanting online plus bounded risk.
Correct — the tail ranker is local and easy to roll back, so putting online there gains immediacy while boxing the risk, a common MAANG pattern.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两阶段推荐的第一阶段，从海量目录快速筛出几百个候选交给排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Candidate generation is the first stage of a two-stage recommender, quickly narrowing a huge catalog to a few hundred candidates for ranking.

termDefinitions.meaning: Meta/Apple/Amazon/Netflix/Google 等大型科技公司的统称。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MAANG refers to large tech companies like Meta, Apple, Amazon, Netflix, and Google.

scenario: 要真正把在线学习跑起来，评估它对基础设施的额外要求。
scenario_en: To actually run online learning, assess the extra infrastructure it demands.
q: 在线学习需要哪些基础设施能力？(多选)
q_en: Which infrastructure capabilities does online learning require? (multiple)
why: 在线学习是重基建活：需要低延迟特征管线、把预测与真实结果实时对齐的流式标签拼接器(streaming label joiner)、以及能热切换的服务权重。这些复杂度正是它「基础设施复杂」风险的来源。
why_en: Online learning is infrastructure-heavy: it needs a low-latency feature pipeline, a streaming label joiner that matches predictions to outcomes in real time, and hot-swappable serving weights.
options: 低延迟的实时特征管线
流式标签拼接器：实时把预测和它对应的真实结果对齐
可热切换(hot-swap)的服务端权重
一个季度一次的离线批处理调度器就足够
options_en: A low-latency real-time feature pipeline.
A streaming label joiner that matches predictions to their real outcomes in real time.
Hot-swappable serving weights.
A once-per-quarter offline batch scheduler is enough.
optionExplanations: 对；即时更新要求特征也能低延迟供给，否则更新拿不到最新输入。
对；只有把预测与其真实结果实时配对，才能马上算出这次预测对不对来更新。
对；权重要能不停机热切换，才能把学到的即时反映到线上服务。
错；季度批处理正是在线学习要替代的东西，无法支撑即时更新。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — instant updates require features supplied with low latency, or the update lacks the latest inputs.
Correct — only by pairing each prediction with its real outcome in real time can you immediately score it and update.
Correct — weights must hot-swap without downtime so learned changes reach live serving immediately.
Wrong — quarterly batch is exactly what online learning replaces and cannot support instant updates.

termDefinitions.term: streaming label joiner / 流式标签拼接器
termDefinitions.meaning: 把每次预测和它随后到来的真实结果(点击/购买)实时配对成训练样本的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A streaming label joiner pairs each prediction with its later real outcome (click/purchase) in real time to form a training example.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不停机就把线上模型权重替换成新版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hot-swap replaces the live model's weights with a new version without downtime.

scenario: 两种周期性再训练策略：一种按固定节奏跑，一种盯着漂移信号、越阈值才跑。
scenario_en: Two periodic retraining policies: one runs on a fixed cadence, the other watches a drift signal and only retrains when it breaches a threshold.
q: 在「响应实际退化」这一维度上，调度式(scheduled)与触发式(trigger-based)再训练的核心差别是什么？
q_en: On responsiveness to actual degradation, what is the core difference between scheduled and trigger-based retraining?
why: 调度式按固定节奏跑、不看信号，稳定漂移下够用但对突变反应慢；触发式监控漂移信号、越阈值才训，能对真实退化即时响应并在平稳期省算力，代价是需要一套可靠的监控栈。
why_en: Scheduled runs on a fixed cadence blind to signals — fine for gradual drift but slow to sudden shifts — while trigger-based watches a drift signal and retrains on breach, responding to real degradation and saving compute when stable, at the cost of a robust monitoring stack.
tradeoff: 调度式(简单可预测但过训/滞后) vs 触发式(响应真实退化、省算力但依赖监控栈)
options: 调度式能对突变即时响应，触发式反而要等监控攒够样本才动手
调度式按节奏跑、不看信号；触发式越漂移阈值才训，快但要监控栈
两者都需要一整套漂移监控栈，区别只在于跑得多频繁、成本多高
触发式的算力成本永远低于调度式，且不需要额外投入监控基建
options_en: Scheduled responds instantly to sudden shifts while trigger-based waits until monitoring gathers enough samples to act.
Scheduled runs on a cadence blind to signals; trigger-based retrains on a drift-threshold breach, fast but needing a monitoring stack.
Both need a full drift-monitoring stack; the only difference is how often they run and at what cost.
Trigger-based always costs less compute than scheduled and needs no extra investment in monitoring infrastructure.
optionExplanations: 说反了：调度式不看信号，对突变最迟钝；即时响应突变正是触发式的强项。
对；这条差别决定选型——稳定渐进漂移用调度式够，突变高风险场景要触发式即时响应。
调度式并不需要监控栈，这正是它简单的原因；触发式才依赖监控。
触发式省算力但有代价：需要维护一套可靠监控，误报浪费、漏报退化。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: scheduled ignores signals and is slowest to sudden shifts; instant response is trigger-based's strength.
Correct — this difference drives the choice: gradual drift is fine with scheduled, while sudden high-stakes shifts need trigger-based's instant response.
Scheduled does not need a monitoring stack, which is why it is simple; only trigger-based depends on monitoring.
Trigger-based saves compute but has a cost: maintaining a robust monitor, where false alarms waste and missed triggers let degradation slip.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量线上数据或指标偏离训练分布程度的监控量，越阈值即触发再训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A drift signal is a monitored measure of how far live data or metrics deviate from the training distribution, triggering retraining on breach.

scenario: 一个网页搜索排序模型，领域相对稳定、漂移是缓慢渐进的，团队想要可预测的算力开销和编排。
scenario_en: A web-search ranker in a relatively stable domain with slow gradual drift; the team wants predictable compute and orchestration.
q: 该选哪种再训练策略？
q_en: Which retraining policy should you pick?
why: 稳定域+渐进漂移下，调度式(如每日/每周固定再训练)最省心：算力和编排可预测，渐进漂移用固定节奏就能追上，不必为它维护一整套触发监控。
why_en: For a stable domain with gradual drift, scheduled retraining (e.g. daily/weekly) is simplest: compute and orchestration are predictable and a fixed cadence keeps up with slow drift without maintaining trigger monitoring.
tradeoff: 调度式(可预测、够追渐进漂移) vs 触发式(应对突变但要养监控栈)
options: 调度式：固定节奏再训练，算力可预测，渐进漂移够追上
触发式：为渐进漂移专门养一套漂移监控，越阈值才训练
在线学习：逐条即时更新排序权重，追最快的信号
永不再训练，靠人工每周手改排序规则
options_en: Scheduled: retrain on a fixed cadence with predictable compute, enough to keep up with gradual drift.
Trigger-based: maintain a whole drift-monitoring stack just for gradual drift and retrain on breach.
Online learning: update ranking weights instantly example by example to chase the fastest signal.
Never retrain, hand-editing ranking rules every week.
whenOtherWins: 若领域会突发剧变(欺诈手法一夜改变)，固定节奏来不及，改用触发式在漂移越阈值时即时再训练。
optionExplanations: 对；稳定+渐进漂移正是调度式的甜区，固定节奏够用、成本可预测、无需养监控。
为渐进漂移养触发监控是过度工程，稳定域几乎不会突破阈值，白白增加复杂度。
搜索排序无需秒级即时，在线学习的抗噪与基建代价在这里不划算。
不再训练会让渐进漂移持续累积，排序质量悄悄下滑。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — stable plus gradual drift is scheduled's sweet spot: a fixed cadence suffices, cost is predictable, and no monitoring is needed.
Maintaining trigger monitoring for gradual drift is over-engineering; a stable domain rarely breaches the threshold, adding complexity for nothing.
Search ranking needs no second-level immediacy, so online learning's noise and infrastructure costs are not worth it here.
Not retraining lets gradual drift accumulate and quietly erodes ranking quality.

termDefinitions.term: scheduled retraining / 调度式再训练
termDefinitions.meaning: 按固定节奏(每日/每周)再训练，不看信号，成本和编排可预测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scheduled retraining runs on a fixed cadence (daily/weekly) regardless of signals, with predictable cost and orchestration.

scenario: 一个欺诈检测模型，欺诈手法可能一夜之间突变，平时又长期平稳，团队想省算力但绝不能漏掉突发退化。
scenario_en: A fraud model where tactics can shift overnight but are otherwise stable for long stretches; the team wants to save compute but must not miss sudden degradation.
q: 该选哪种再训练策略？
q_en: Which retraining policy fits?
why: 触发式最贴合：平稳时不训省算力，一旦漂移信号越阈值就即时再训练，对突发欺诈手法即时响应。代价是必须养一套可靠监控，防误报浪费/漏报退化。
why_en: Trigger-based fits best: skip retraining when stable to save compute, but retrain immediately when the drift signal breaches, responding to sudden fraud shifts — at the cost of a robust monitor that avoids false alarms and missed triggers.
tradeoff: 触发式(省算力+即时响应突变) vs 调度式(简单但对突变滞后)
options: 调度式：固定每周再训练一次，不管欺诈手法是否已经突变
触发式：盯漂移信号，越阈值即时再训练，平稳时省算力
永不再训练，靠人工事后复盘每一起漏检的欺诈案例
全离线季度再训练，攒够一整季度的数据才更新一次模型
options_en: Scheduled: retrain once a week on a fixed cadence regardless of whether fraud tactics have already shifted.
Trigger-based: watch the drift signal, retrain immediately on breach, save compute when stable.
Never retrain, relying on humans to manually review every missed fraud case after the fact.
Fully offline quarterly retraining, updating the model only once a full quarter of data accumulates.
whenOtherWins: 若领域稳定、漂移只是缓慢渐进(如搜索)，触发式的监控栈是过度投入，固定节奏的调度式更省心。
optionExplanations: 固定每周对突发欺诈太慢：手法一夜变了得等到下周才训，中间损失巨大。
对；高风险+突变正是触发式的甜区，平稳省算力、突变即时响应，恰好满足两个诉求。
人工复盘只能事后发现漏检案例，模型本身并不会因此更新，欺诈手法一旦变化，退化仍会持续放大。
季度再训练比每周还慢，突发欺诈场景完全不可接受。
optionExplanations_en: Weekly is too slow for sudden fraud: if tactics change overnight you wait until next week, losing heavily in between.
Correct — high-stakes plus sudden shifts is trigger-based's sweet spot: save compute when calm, respond instantly on a shift, meeting both needs.
Manual review only surfaces missed cases after the fact; the model itself never updates, so once tactics shift, degradation keeps amplifying.
Quarterly is even slower than weekly and completely unacceptable for sudden fraud.

termDefinitions.term: trigger-based retraining / 触发式再训练
termDefinitions.meaning: 监控漂移信号，越过阈值才自动再训练；平稳期省算力，突变即时响应。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Trigger-based retraining monitors a drift signal and retrains only on threshold breach, saving compute when stable and responding instantly to shifts.

scenario: 一个大规模生产推荐系统，既要保证基线新鲜度，又要在突发分布变化时兜底，还要控制算力。
scenario_en: A large-scale production recommender that needs a freshness baseline, a safety net for sudden shifts, and compute control.
q: 多数大团队实际怎么组合再训练策略？
q_en: How do most large teams actually combine retraining policies?
why: 混合式：调度式提供固定新鲜度基线，触发式当突发漂移的紧急安全网。这样平时可预测、突变有兜底，代价是最复杂——要同时维护节奏和监控两套机制。
why_en: Hybrid: scheduled provides a freshness baseline and trigger-based acts as an emergency safety net for sudden drift, giving predictability plus a fallback at the cost of being the most complex to maintain.
tradeoff: 混合式(可预测+突变兜底) vs 单一策略(要么慢要么无基线)
options: 只用调度式，突变时靠运气熬到下一个固定周期才更新，风险自担
只用触发式，完全不设固定节奏的新鲜度基线兜底，全靠监控信号驱动
调度式做新鲜度基线 + 触发式兜突发漂移，代价是最复杂
两套都不要，改用在线学习替代所有周期性再训练机制，简化运维
options_en: Scheduled only, riding out sudden shifts by luck until the next fixed cycle updates — risk left unmanaged.
Trigger-based only, with no fixed-cadence freshness baseline at all, driven entirely by monitoring signals.
Scheduled for the freshness baseline plus trigger-based to catch sudden drift, at the cost of most complexity.
Neither, replacing all periodic retraining with online learning to simplify operations.
whenOtherWins: 若团队小、系统简单或算力紧，维护两套机制不划算，退回单一调度式(稳定域)或单一触发式(突变域)即可。
optionExplanations: 只用调度式缺突变兜底，一旦分布剧变得硬等下个周期，生产系统承受不起。
只用触发式没有固定基线——虽全靠监控信号驱动，但平稳期若出现监控盲区，新鲜度仍会悄悄滑落。
对；大规模生产用混合式兼顾可预测新鲜度与突变响应，代价是同时养节奏+监控两套。
在线学习并不能替代所有再训练——很多上游重模块仍需周期性批量，也谈不上真的简化运维。
optionExplanations_en: Scheduled alone lacks a sudden-shift fallback; a distribution jump forces waiting for the next cycle, which production cannot afford.
Trigger alone has no fixed baseline — though driven entirely by monitoring signals, a blind spot during calm periods can still quietly erode freshness.
Correct — large-scale production uses hybrid to balance predictable freshness with sudden-shift response, at the cost of maintaining both cadence and monitoring.
Online learning cannot replace all retraining — many heavy upstream modules still need periodic batch, so it doesn't actually simplify operations either.

termDefinitions.term: hybrid retraining / 混合式再训练
termDefinitions.meaning: 调度式固定节奏做基线 + 触发式做突发漂移的紧急兜底，两者结合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hybrid retraining combines a scheduled fixed-cadence baseline with trigger-based emergency retraining for sudden drift.

scenario: 用户看到的推荐来自多个模型版本混合，你要把每次用户行为归因到「真正导致这次展示的那次预测」。
scenario_en: Recommendations come from a mix of model versions, and you must attribute each user action to the exact prediction that caused that impression.
q: 为什么需要一个「信号路由层 (signal routing layer)」，它防的是什么？
q_en: Why do you need a signal routing layer, and what does it prevent?
why: 信号路由层把用户行为准确对齐到「引发它的那次预测」，否则把行为归错模型会引入选择偏差(selection bias)，让再训练学到失真的因果，指标看着动其实归因错了。
why_en: A signal routing layer aligns each user action to the prediction that caused it, otherwise mis-attributing actions introduces selection bias and retraining learns a distorted cause-effect.
options: 它是负载均衡器，只负责把请求平均分到各模型副本
它把用户行为对齐到引发它的那次预测，防止归因错误
它是缓存层，只为降低特征查询延迟和读放大
它是限流器，防止突发流量打垮训练与特征管线
options_en: A load balancer that just spreads requests evenly across model replicas.
It aligns each user action to the prediction that caused it, preventing mis-attribution.
A cache layer that only lowers feature-lookup latency and read amplification.
A rate limiter that stops traffic spikes from overwhelming the training and feature pipelines.
optionExplanations: 负载均衡处理的是请求分发，跟把行为归因到正确预测这个数据正确性问题无关。
对；正确归因是干净训练数据的前提，错配会把别的模型的功过算到当前模型头上，引入选择偏差。
缓存降的是延迟，不解决行为-预测的归因对齐。
限流保护的是稳定性，不是训练标签的因果正确性。
optionExplanations_en: Load balancing handles request distribution and is unrelated to the data-correctness problem of attributing actions to the right prediction.
Correct — correct attribution is a precondition for clean training data; mis-matching credits another model's outcome to this one, introducing selection bias.
A cache lowers latency and does not solve action-to-prediction attribution.
Rate limiting protects stability, not the causal correctness of training labels.

termDefinitions.term: signal routing layer / 信号路由层
termDefinitions.meaning: 把每次用户行为对齐回引发它的那次预测，保证再训练标签归因正确。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A signal routing layer maps each user action back to the prediction that caused it, keeping retraining labels correctly attributed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练数据的采集/归因不代表真实分布，让模型学到失真的因果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Selection bias is when how training data is collected or attributed misrepresents the true distribution, teaching the model a distorted cause-effect.

q: 把 champion/challenger 让新模型上线前「跑关卡」的顺序排好：
q_en: Order the champion/challenger gauntlet a new model must pass before full rollout:
steps: 数据验证：检查 schema 与分布是否正常
模型验证：检查是否收敛、参数是否合理
性能验证：离线指标 vs 留出集(holdout)
流量切分：路由把 ~5% 流量给 challenger、95% 给 champion
指标比较与晋升：统计显著窗口内业务指标达标才晋升，否则丢弃
why: 顺序是先便宜后昂贵、先离线后在线：数据→模型→性能三道离线门把明显坏的挡掉，再用小流量切分做在线活体评估，最后按统计显著的业务指标决定晋升还是丢弃。
why_en: The order is cheap-before-expensive and offline-before-live: data, model, and performance gates screen out obvious failures, then a small traffic split does live evaluation, and finally statistically significant business metrics decide promotion or discard.
diagram:
flowchart TB D["数据验证"] --> M["模型验证"] M --> P["性能验证
离线 vs holdout"] P --> S["流量切分 ~5%"] S --> C["指标比较"] C -->|达标| Promote["晋升为 champion"] C -->|不达标| Discard["丢弃"]

termDefinitions.meaning: champion 是当前服务用户的模型，challenger 是待验证的新模型，需跑完验证关卡才可能晋升。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The champion is the model currently serving users; the challenger is a new model that must pass validation gates before it can be promoted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时留出、不参与训练的一部分数据，用来无偏评估模型离线性能。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A holdout is data set aside from training, used to evaluate the model's offline performance without bias.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先把小比例流量导给新版本观察，安全后再全量，这里用于模型版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A canary release routes a small fraction of traffic to a new version to observe safely before full rollout, here applied to model versions.

scenario: 刚再训练出一个新模型，有人主张直接推给全量用户。
scenario_en: A freshly retrained model is ready, and someone argues for pushing it to all users at once.
q: 在 champion/challenger 框架里，champion 和 challenger 各扮演什么角色，为什么不能直接全量？
q_en: In champion/challenger, what roles do champion and challenger play, and why not push to all users?
why: champion 是当前服务全量用户的现役模型，challenger 是待验证的新模型，只吃一小片流量跑关卡。直接全量上新模型太鲁莽——万一训练数据有 bug，会一次性伤到所有用户。
why_en: The champion serves all users now while the challenger is the new model that only takes a small traffic slice to prove itself, because pushing a new model to everyone at once is reckless if its training data has a bug.
options: champion 现役服务全量，challenger 只吃小流量待验证；直接全量太鲁莽
champion 和 challenger 都服务全量流量，只是分别跑在不同硬件上
challenger 服务全量、champion 只做离线基线对照，直接全量没有风险
两者随机轮流服务同一批用户，不设任何数据/模型/性能验证关卡
options_en: The champion serves all traffic today; the challenger takes a small slice to prove itself, so full rollout is reckless.
Both champion and challenger serve full traffic, just running separately on different hardware.
The challenger serves full traffic while the champion is only an offline baseline comparison, so full rollout has no risk.
They randomly alternate serving the same users with no data/model/performance validation gates at all.
optionExplanations: 对；这个角色分工把未验证代码的爆炸半径钉在一小片流量上，而不是全站。
两者不同时服务全量：challenger 只吃约 5%，这是控制风险的核心。
说反了：吃小流量的那个才是新模型，全量服务的是已被验证过的现役。
不是随机轮流，challenger 要先过数据/模型/性能关卡再小流量评估。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — this split pins an unproven model's blast radius to one small slice of traffic instead of the whole site.
They do not both serve full traffic: the challenger takes only about 5%, which is the core of risk control.
Backwards: the small-slice model is the new one, while the incumbent already proven in production serves everyone.
It is not random alternation; the challenger must pass data/model/performance gates before small-traffic evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 当前正在服务全量用户的现役模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The champion is the incumbent model currently serving all users.

termDefinitions.meaning: 待验证的新模型，先跑验证关卡再吃小流量活体评估。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The challenger is a new model that passes validation gates then takes a small traffic slice for live evaluation.

scenario: challenger 模型上线活体评估，路由把大约 5% 流量给它、95% 给 champion。
scenario_en: A challenger goes to live evaluation with the router sending about 5% of traffic to it and 95% to the champion.
q: 这个 5% 的切分比例对评估设计意味着什么？
q_en: What does this 5% split imply for the evaluation design?
why: 5% 是金丝雀发布式的经验比例、不是公式推导：小到坏模型也只伤 5% 用户(限爆炸半径)，又要足够大和足够长的窗口才能凑够统计显著的业务指标；太小则样本不足、迟迟判不出胜负。
why_en: The 5% is an empirical canary fraction, not a formula: small enough that a bad model hurts only 5% of users, yet the window must be large and long enough to reach statistically significant business metrics.
options: 5% 是硬性数学最优比例，任何系统都必须精确用 5%，不能调整
5% 说明 challenger 已经证明更好，可以直接省掉指标比较环节
5% 越小越好，哪怕只给 0.01% 流量也能立刻判出胜负
5% 是金丝雀经验比例：坏模型只伤 5% 用户，又要够大够久才统计显著
options_en: 5% is a hard mathematically optimal ratio every system must use exactly and cannot tune.
5% means the challenger is already proven better, so the metric-comparison step can be skipped entirely.
The smaller the better; even giving just 0.01% of traffic instantly decides the winner.
5% is an empirical canary fraction: a bad model hurts only 5% of users, yet the slice must be big and long enough to reach significance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 路由把一小比例流量导给新模型做活体对照评估，其余仍走现役模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Traffic splitting routes a small fraction of traffic to the new model for a live controlled comparison, with the rest on the incumbent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 指标差异大到不太可能只是随机波动，需要足够样本量和观察窗口才能判定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Statistical significance means a metric difference is unlikely to be random noise, requiring enough sample size and observation window.

scenario: 评估 challenger 时，有人建议给 champion 用工作日流量、给 challenger 用周末流量以省事。
scenario_en: During evaluation, someone suggests measuring the champion on weekday traffic and the challenger on weekend traffic for convenience.
q: 为什么 champion 和 challenger 必须看「同一片流量切分」？
q_en: Why must champion and challenger see the same traffic slice?
why: 只有同一片流量(同时段、同人群)对照，指标差异才归因于模型本身；工作日 vs 周末的人群/行为不同，会把流量差异误当成模型差异，引入选择偏差让结论作废。
why_en: Only comparing on the same slice (same time, same population) attributes metric differences to the model itself, since weekday-versus-weekend populations differ and would inject selection bias that invalidates the conclusion.
tradeoff: 同一片流量对照(干净归因) vs 不同时段/人群(混入选择偏差)
options: 为了省算力，让两个模型分别在不同时段跑评估
同一片流量对照才能把差异归因到模型，否则人群差异会混入选择偏差
无所谓看哪片流量，只要两边样本量一样大就行
必须让 challenger 看更难的流量，才算真正的压力测试
options_en: To save compute, run the two models in different time windows.
Only the same slice attributes the difference to the model; otherwise population differences inject selection bias.
It doesn't matter which slice, as long as both sides have equal sample sizes.
The challenger must see harder traffic to count as a real stress test.
whenOtherWins: 只有当你专门想测某个特定分段(如仅新用户)时，才刻意固定到那一段，但两模型仍须在同一段上对照。
optionExplanations: 省算力换来的是脏对照：不同时段人群不同，指标差异分不清是模型还是流量造成的。
对；同片流量把外部变量对齐，剩下的差异才是模型本身，这是避免选择偏差的关键。
样本量相等还不够——若两片流量人群不同，偏差仍在，必须是同一片。
让 challenger 单独看更难流量会人为拉低它，评估不公平也不干净。
optionExplanations_en: Saving compute buys a dirty comparison: different time windows have different populations, so the metric gap cannot be told apart from a traffic effect.
Correct — the same slice aligns external variables so the remaining difference is the model itself, the key to avoiding selection bias.
Equal sample size is not enough — if the two slices have different populations the bias remains; it must be the same slice.
Giving the challenger harder traffic artificially penalizes it, making the evaluation unfair and dirty.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一时段、同一人群的一批请求，用于给两个模型做同条件对照。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A traffic slice is a batch of requests from the same time and population, used to compare two models under identical conditions.

scenario: Uber 的 ETA challenger 在 5% 的行程上跑，结果发现它的训练数据被一个管线 bug 污染了。
scenario_en: Uber's ETA challenger runs on 5% of rides, and it turns out its training data was corrupted by a pipeline bug.
q: champion/challenger 的小流量评估在这里带来了什么价值？
q_en: What value did the small-traffic champion/challenger evaluation provide here?
why: 小流量金丝雀把坏模型的影响圈在 5% 内并及早暴露：污染训练数据的 challenger 直接被丢弃、champion 继续服务，全量用户几乎无感。若直接全量上线，这个 bug 会波及所有行程。
why_en: The small-traffic canary contained the bad model to 5% and surfaced it early: the corrupted challenger was discarded and the champion kept serving with no user impact, whereas a full rollout would have hit every ride.
options: 它证明所有 challenger 都会失败，不该再训练新模型
它把坏模型圈在 5% 并及早暴露，坏的丢弃、现役继续服务
它加快了 challenger 的训练速度，与风险控制无关
它自动修复了被污染的训练数据，无需人工介入排查
options_en: It proves all challengers fail and new models should not be retrained.
It contained the bad model to 5% and surfaced it early: drop the bad one, keep the incumbent serving.
It sped up the challenger's training and is unrelated to risk control.
It automatically repaired the corrupted training data with no human investigation.
optionExplanations: 过度推论：challenger 失败不代表不该再训练，正是这套机制让失败变得安全、可继续迭代。
对；金丝雀的价值就是限爆炸半径+早发现，坏 challenger 只伤 5% 就被拦下，champion 兜底。
小流量评估不是为了加速训练，而是控风险、做在线活体验证。
它只是暴露并丢弃坏模型，不会自动修复被污染的数据，那仍需人工排查。
optionExplanations_en: Over-reach: a failed challenger does not mean stop retraining; this very mechanism makes failure safe so you can keep iterating.
Correct — the canary's value is bounding blast radius plus early detection: the bad challenger hurt only 5% before being stopped, with the champion as fallback.
Small-traffic evaluation is not for speeding training but for risk control and live validation.
It only exposes and discards the bad model; it does not auto-fix corrupted data, which still needs manual investigation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预计到达时间，Uber 等用模型预测行程耗时。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) is the predicted trip duration that companies like Uber model.

scenario: 面试官问：「你的模型上线后为什么会随时间退化？先说最常见的那个原因。」
scenario_en: Interviewer: 'Why does your model degrade over time in production? Lead with the most common cause.'
q: 生产模型退化最常见的根因是什么，它常常比架构选择的影响更大？
q_en: What is the most common root cause of production model degradation, often bigger than architecture choices?
why: 训练-服务偏差(training-serving skew)：训练时的分布/特征计算和服务时模型实际看到的不一致，是退化的头号原因，往往比模型架构选得好不好影响更大。面试先讲它再讲缓解手段。
why_en: Training-serving skew — a divergence between the training distribution/feature computation and what the model actually sees at serving — is the top cause of degradation, often outweighing architecture choices.
options: 训练-服务偏差：训练与服务的特征计算不一致，是头号根因
GPU 显存不足导致推理精度下降，是模型退化的首要根因
模型参数量太小，只要加大模型规模就能根治线上退化
网络延迟抖动频繁，是模型质量随时间退化的最主要原因
options_en: Training-serving skew: feature computation differs between training and serving, the number-one root cause.
Insufficient GPU memory lowering inference precision, as the primary root cause of model degradation.
Too few parameters; simply scaling up the model size cures production degradation.
Frequent network latency jitter, the main reason model quality degrades over time.
optionExplanations: 对；训练时与服务时的分布/特征不一致是退化头号原因，面试应先点它再讲缓解。
显存不足是工程故障，不是模型随时间退化的分布性根因。
加大模型改善的是容量，压不住世界变化带来的分布漂移。
网络抖动影响延迟不影响模型学到的分布，与退化根因无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a train-vs-serve mismatch in distribution/features is the top cause of degradation; lead with it, then mitigations.
GPU memory shortage is an engineering fault, not the distributional root cause of degradation over time.
Enlarging the model boosts capacity but cannot hold back distribution drift from a changing world.
Network jitter affects latency, not the learned distribution, and is unrelated to the degradation root cause.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时的数据分布或特征计算方式与线上服务时不一致，是模型退化最常见根因。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is a divergence between the training distribution or feature computation and what the model sees at serving, the most common cause of degradation.

scenario: 训练时某特征是「7 天滚动平均」，离线批算；线上服务时同名特征却是「当前时点查一次」，两边计算逻辑不同。
scenario_en: In training a feature is a 7-day rolling average computed in batch, but at serving the same-named feature is a single point-in-time lookup — two different computations.
q: 这属于哪种训练-服务偏差，最直接的缓解是什么？
q_en: Which kind of training-serving skew is this, and what is the most direct mitigation?
why: 这是数据管线偏差(pipeline skew)：同一特征两边算法不同。最直接的解法是统一特征仓库(feature store)，让训练和服务共用同一套计算逻辑，从源头消除不一致。
why_en: This is data-pipeline skew — the same feature computed differently on each side — and the most direct fix is a unified feature store so training and serving share one computation logic.
tradeoff: 统一特征仓库(消除双端不一致但要建平台) vs 两端各自实现(快但持续漂移)
options: 标签反馈延迟：真标签迟到，用更快到达的代理标签顶上缓解
数据管线偏差：同一特征两端算法不同，用统一特征仓库对齐
概念漂移：映射关系变了，用漂移监控加触发式再训练缓解
数据漂移：输入分布变了，靠加大模型容量与参数量缓解
options_en: Label feedback delay: true labels arrive late, mitigated with faster-arriving proxy labels standing in.
Data-pipeline skew: the same feature computed differently on each side, aligned with a unified feature store.
Concept drift: the mapping relationship changed, mitigated with drift monitoring plus trigger-based retraining.
Data drift: the input distribution changed, mitigated by increasing model capacity and parameter count.
whenOtherWins: 若两端算法一致、只是标签迟到才失准，那是标签延迟问题，该上代理标签+缩短再训练周期，而非特征仓库。
optionExplanations: 标签延迟是标签迟到，本题问题在特征两端算法不同，不是标签时效。
对；同名特征两端算法不一致是典型管线偏差，统一特征仓库对齐两端计算正是对症。
概念漂移是 P(Y|X) 变了，本题是特征计算不一致，不是映射关系变化。
数据漂移是输入分布随时间变，本题是同一时刻两端算法不同，加大模型无关。
optionExplanations_en: Label delay is labels arriving late; here the problem is two different feature computations, not label timeliness.
Correct — the same feature computed differently on each side is classic pipeline skew, and aligning both sides' computation via a unified feature store is the direct fix.
Concept drift is P(Y|X) changing; here it is inconsistent feature computation, not a changed mapping.
Data drift is inputs shifting over time; here the two sides differ at the same instant, and model size is irrelevant.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一管理特征定义与计算的平台，让训练与服务共用同一套逻辑，消除双端偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store centralizes feature definitions and computation so training and serving share one logic, eliminating skew.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取某一时刻的特征值，须避免用到未来信息造成泄漏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A point-in-time lookup fetches a feature value as of a specific moment, avoiding leakage from future information.

scenario: 欺诈标签要等确认，常常 +30 天才到；等真标签再训练，模型早已落后于最新欺诈手法。
scenario_en: Fraud labels take about +30 days to confirm; waiting for true labels to retrain leaves the model behind the latest tactics.
q: 这属于哪种训练-服务偏差，怎么缓解？
q_en: Which kind of training-serving skew is this, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 这是标签反馈延迟(label feedback delay)：真标签数天/数周才到。缓解用代理标签(proxy label)——找更快到达的替身信号顶上，再配合缩短再训练周期，让模型不必干等真标签。
why_en: This is label feedback delay — true labels arrive days or weeks late — mitigated with proxy labels (faster-arriving stand-ins) plus a shorter retraining cadence so the model does not wait idle.
tradeoff: 代理标签(快但可能偏) vs 只等真标签(准但严重滞后)
options: 数据管线偏差；用统一特征仓库对齐两端计算
标签反馈延迟；用更快到达的代理标签顶上并缩短周期
数据漂移；用 PSI 持续监控输入分布来缓解
概念漂移；靠加大 batch size 和学习率缓解
options_en: Data-pipeline skew; align both sides with a unified feature store.
Label feedback delay; stand in with faster proxy labels and shorten the retraining cycle.
Data drift; mitigate by continuously monitoring the input distribution with PSI.
Concept drift; mitigate by raising batch size and learning rate.
whenOtherWins: 若真标签其实很快就到、只是两端特征算法不同才失准，那是管线偏差，该上统一特征仓库而非代理标签。
optionExplanations: 管线偏差是特征两端算法不同，本题瓶颈是标签迟到，不是特征计算。
对；标签迟到就用代理标签当快速替身，再缩短周期，让模型不必等 30 天真标签。
PSI 查的是输入分布漂移，解决不了「标签迟到没法训练」这个时效问题。
加大 batch size 与标签何时到达无关，救不了标签延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Pipeline skew is different feature computation on each side; here the bottleneck is late labels, not feature computation.
Correct — for late labels use proxy labels as fast stand-ins plus a shorter cadence so the model need not wait 30 days for true labels.
PSI checks input-distribution drift and cannot solve the timing problem of labels arriving too late to train on.
Increasing batch size is unrelated to when labels arrive and does not fix label delay.

termDefinitions.meaning: 比真标签更快到达的替身信号，用来在真标签到位前支撑训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A proxy label is a faster-arriving stand-in signal used to support training before the true label is available.

termDefinitions.term: label feedback delay / 标签反馈延迟
termDefinitions.meaning: 真实标签要数天/数周后才确认到达，拖慢再训练时效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Label feedback delay is when true labels only confirm days or weeks later, slowing retraining.

scenario: 面试官特意问你区分：一种是输入分布变了，另一种是同样的输入现在对应不同的意图/结果。
scenario_en: The interviewer specifically asks you to distinguish: one is inputs shifting, the other is the same input now mapping to a different intent/outcome.
q: 数据漂移 (data drift) 和概念漂移 (concept drift) 的区别是什么？
q_en: What is the difference between data drift and concept drift?
why: 数据漂移是输入分布 P(X) 变了、但输入→输出映射未必变(夏转秋的流量)；概念漂移是特征看着一样、但映射 P(Y|X) 变了(同样的用户/广告在 UI 改版后 CTR 骤降)。很多候选人把两者混为一谈。
why_en: Data drift is the input distribution P(X) shifting while the input-to-output mapping may stay put, whereas concept drift is the mapping P(Y|X) changing even though features look the same.
tradeoff: 数据漂移(输入变、映射未必变) vs 概念漂移(输入同、映射变)

rows: UI 改版后同用户 CTR 骤降

options: 数据漂移是模型权重随训练轮次变化，概念漂移是数据库 schema 变了
两者是同义词，只是不同论文和团队里的叫法习惯不同而已
数据漂移是输入分布 P(X) 变；概念漂移是映射 P(Y|X) 变
数据漂移只发生在训练阶段，概念漂移只发生在推理阶段，二者不共存
options_en: Data drift means model weights change across training rounds; concept drift means the database schema changed.
They are synonyms, just named differently by convention across papers and teams.
Data drift is the input distribution P(X) shifting; concept drift is the mapping P(Y|X) changing.
Data drift only happens during training and concept drift only during inference, and the two never coexist.
optionExplanations: 全错：漂移讲的是数据/映射随时间变，不是权重变或 schema 变。
不是同义词——一个是输入变、一个是映射变，检测手段也不同，混淆正是常见失分点。
对；P(X) 变 vs P(Y|X) 变是本质区别，前者查输入分布、后者查预测误差/校准。
两者都发生在生产分布随时间变，且完全可以同时发生，不受训练/推理阶段限制。
optionExplanations_en: All wrong: drift is about data/mapping changing over time, not weights or schema changing.
Not synonyms — one is inputs shifting, the other is the mapping shifting, detected differently, and conflating them is a common way to lose points.
Correct — P(X) shifting versus P(Y|X) shifting is the essential difference: check input distribution for one, prediction error/calibration for the other.
Both occur as the production distribution changes over time and can happen simultaneously, not confined to training or inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入分布 P(X) 随时间变化，输入到输出的映射未必变。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data drift is the input distribution P(X) changing over time, while the input-to-output mapping may stay the same.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征看着一样，但输入到标签的映射 P(Y|X) 变了，同样行为现在含义不同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concept drift is when features look the same but the input-to-label mapping P(Y|X) changed, so the same behavior now means something different.

scenario: 线上输入分布随时间持续变化(用户构成、内容类型都在漂),模型准确率缓慢下滑但没有明确故障。
scenario_en: The live input distribution keeps shifting over time (user mix, content types drift) and accuracy slowly slides with no hard failure.
q: 针对这种分布漂移，最合适的缓解组合是什么？
q_en: What is the most fitting mitigation for this distribution shift?
why: 分布漂移的对策是漂移监控 + 触发式再训练：持续监控输入(数据漂移)和映射(概念漂移)信号，一旦越阈值就自动再训练，把模型拉回当前分布，而不是干等固定周期。
why_en: The remedy for distribution shift is drift monitoring plus trigger-based retraining: continuously watch input and mapping signals and auto-retrain on breach to pull the model back to the current distribution.
tradeoff: 漂移监控+触发再训练(对症、及时) vs 只加大模型(治不了分布变化)
options: 加大模型容量与参数量，让它记住更多历史模式
统一特征仓库，消除训练/服务两端的特征计算差异
漂移监控 + 触发式再训练：越阈值自动再训，拉回分布
换更快的推理硬件并加大 batch，降低服务延迟
options_en: Increase model capacity and parameter count so it memorizes more historical patterns.
A unified feature store to remove feature-computation differences between training and serving.
Drift monitoring plus trigger-based retraining: breach the threshold and auto-retrain back to the live distribution.
Switch to faster inference hardware and larger batches to cut serving latency.
whenOtherWins: 若失准其实来自训练/服务特征算法不一致(而非世界变化)，那是管线偏差，该上统一特征仓库而不是再训练。
optionExplanations: 加大模型提升的是容量，抵不过世界持续变化带来的分布漂移，治标不治本。
特征仓库治的是两端计算不一致，不是输入分布随时间真实变化。
对；漂移监控发现变化、触发再训练把模型对齐到当前分布，是分布漂移的对症组合。
换硬件只降延迟，与输入分布是否变化毫无关系。
optionExplanations_en: More capacity cannot outrun a continuously changing world's distribution drift, treating symptoms not cause.
A feature store fixes inconsistent computation on the two sides, not a genuine input-distribution change over time.
Correct — monitoring detects the change and trigger-based retraining realigns the model to the current distribution, the on-target combo for drift.
New hardware only lowers latency and has nothing to do with whether the input distribution shifts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上输入随时间变化，涵盖数据漂移(输入变)与概念漂移(映射变)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distribution shift is live inputs changing over time, covering both data drift (inputs) and concept drift (mapping).

scenario: 复习训练-服务偏差的三大来源及各自缓解手段。
scenario_en: Review the three sources of training-serving skew and each mitigation.
q: 补全训练-服务偏差的三个来源与对应缓解：
q_en: Fill in the three sources of training-serving skew and their mitigations:
text: 训练-服务偏差三来源：①{{数据管线}}偏差(特征两端算法不同)→统一{{特征仓库}}；②{{标签}}反馈延迟(真标签数周才到)→{{代理}}标签+缩短周期；③{{分布}}漂移(输入或映射随时间变)→漂移监控+{{触发式}}再训练。
text_en: Three sources of training-serving skew: (1) {{data-pipeline}} skew (feature computed differently) → unified {{feature store}}; (2) {{label}} feedback delay (true labels weeks late) → {{proxy}} labels + shorter cadence; (3) {{distribution}} shift (inputs or mapping change over time) → drift monitoring + {{trigger-based}} retraining.
why: 三来源各有对症解法：管线偏差→特征仓库统一计算；标签延迟→代理标签补位；分布漂移→监控+触发再训练。面试答退化时按这个结构走一遍最稳。
why_en: Each source has its own fix: pipeline skew to a feature store, label delay to proxy labels, distribution shift to monitoring plus trigger-based retraining.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练与服务在特征/分布/标签时效上的不一致，退化的头号根因，有三大来源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is train-vs-serve inconsistency in features, distribution, or label timing — the top cause of degradation, with three sources.

q: 面试被问「你的模型如何随时间退化」，把最稳的作答结构排好：
q_en: Asked 'how does your model degrade over time,' order the strongest answer structure:
steps: 先点名头号根因：训练-服务偏差
拆成三来源：管线偏差、标签延迟、分布漂移(数据/概念)
给每个来源配缓解：特征仓库、代理标签、漂移监控
落到再训练策略：调度/触发/混合把模型持续拉回当前分布
why: 先亮最重要的根因(训练-服务偏差)抓住重点，再拆三来源展示全面，接着落到再训练策略和逐项缓解，体现从诊断到治理的闭环——这是 Staff+ 想听的结构。
why_en: Lead with the top root cause (training-serving skew) to anchor, decompose the three sources to show breadth, then land on retraining policy and per-source mitigations, showing a diagnose-to-remedy loop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在退化或故障时退回可用的次优路径(如兜底启发式)，而非彻底崩溃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Graceful degradation is falling back to a usable suboptimal path (e.g. a fallback heuristic) when degrading or failing, instead of collapsing.

scenario: Google 广告排序若对一次爆红的新品慢 24 小时才适应，就等于错过了一整天的优化投放。
scenario_en: If Google ad ranking adapts to a viral product launch 24 hours late, that equals a full day of lost optimized placements.
q: 「24 小时滞后 = 损失一天优化投放」这个说法在设计上意味着什么？
q_en: What does '24h lag equals a lost day of optimized placements' imply for design?
why: 陈旧代价不是抽象损失、而是直接折成收入：模型每晚 T 小时适应，就少赚 T 小时的最优投放。它把「新鲜度」量化成收入基数，用来论证在广告这类场景值得付出在线学习的基建复杂度。
why_en: Staleness cost converts directly into revenue: every hour late is an hour of suboptimal placement lost, which quantifies freshness as a revenue base justifying online learning's infra complexity here.
options: 说明广告排序本身无需实时响应，慢一整天完全可以接受，不影响收入
说明只要多买服务器就能消除滞后，跟学习方式选型完全无关
24 小时是行业硬性 SLA，任何模型都必须在此窗口内更新完，否则违规
陈旧代价折成收入：滞后1小时=少赚1小时投放，证明值得上在线学习基建
options_en: It shows ad ranking itself needs no real-time response and a full day's delay is fine, with no revenue impact.
It shows buying more servers eliminates the lag, entirely unrelated to the choice of learning method.
24h is a hard industry SLA every model must update within, or it is a violation.
Staleness cost prices out as revenue: an hour of lag loses an hour of optimal placement, justifying online-learning infra.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型落后于当前分布每单位时间造成的业务损失(此处是广告收入)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Staleness cost is the business loss (here ad revenue) per unit time the model lags behind the current distribution.

optionExplanations: 说反了：这个换算恰恰证明滞后有实打实的收入代价，不是可以随意接受的延迟。
堆机器降的是计算延迟，救不了模型认知世界变化要多久这件事，二者是两回事。
过度绝对：具体时限该按每小时损失多少收入来定，不是放之四海皆准的硬 SLA。
对；把每小时滞后直接折成损失的投放收入，用这笔账证明新鲜度值多少钱、值不值得上在线学习。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: this math is exactly why the lag has a real revenue cost, not a delay to shrug off.
More servers cut compute latency, not how long the model takes to notice the world changed.
Overstated: the right cutoff should track hourly revenue lost, not a fixed one-size SLA.
Correct — pricing each lag hour as lost placement revenue is how you justify online-learning infra.

scenario: 面试官问你在持续学习里到底在权衡什么，想听一句能收住全场的核心取舍。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what you are fundamentally trading off in continual learning and wants one closing axis.
q: 持续学习(在线/周期再训练/champion-challenger/偏差治理)背后统一的核心取舍轴是什么？
q_en: What single core tradeoff axis unifies continual learning (online / retraining / champion-challenger / skew control)?
why: 核心轴是新鲜度 vs 稳定性：在线学习和频繁再训练买新鲜度(快速适应变化)，批量、champion/challenger 验证和 KL 式约束买稳定性(防噪声/操纵/坏更新)。所有具体机制都是在这条轴上找平衡点。
why_en: The core axis is freshness versus stability: online learning and frequent retraining buy freshness while batch, champion/challenger validation, and constraints buy stability, and every mechanism balances on this axis.
tradeoff: 新鲜度(快速适应变化) vs 稳定性(防噪声/操纵/坏更新)
options: 新鲜度 vs 稳定性：快速适应变化 vs 防噪声与坏更新
精度 vs 召回：只是分类阈值挪动带来的单模型评估取舍
内存 vs 磁盘：纯粹是存储成本与容量规划层面的取舍
读性能 vs 写性能：数据库索引选型层面的工程权衡取舍
options_en: Freshness vs stability: adapting fast to change versus guarding against noise and bad updates.
Precision vs recall: just a single-model evaluation tradeoff from moving the classification threshold.
Memory vs disk: purely a tradeoff at the storage-cost-and-capacity-planning level.
Read vs write performance: an engineering tradeoff at the database-index-selection level.
whenOtherWins: 当任务标签慢、易被操纵或坏更新代价高时，天平压向稳定性(批量+严格验证)；标签快、变化剧烈且影响面有界时压向新鲜度(在线学习)。
optionExplanations: 对；它把在线学习、再训练节奏、小流量对照验证收成一句可背走的话。
精度/召回是单模型评估的取舍，不是持续学习的系统级主轴。
内存/磁盘是存储成本问题，与持续学习要不要快速适应变化无关。
读写性能是数据库层取舍，答不到持续学习的核心矛盾。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — it compresses online learning, retraining cadence, and small-slice comparison into one takeaway sentence.
Precision/recall is a single-model evaluation tradeoff, not the system-level axis of continual learning.
Memory/disk is a storage-cost question, unrelated to whether continual learning should adapt fast.
Read/write performance is a database-layer tradeoff and misses continual learning's core tension.

termDefinitions.term: freshness vs stability / 新鲜度 vs 稳定性
termDefinitions.meaning: 持续学习的核心取舍：快速适应变化(新鲜)对抗防噪声/操纵/坏更新(稳定)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Freshness versus stability is continual learning's core tradeoff: adapting quickly to change versus guarding against noise, gaming, and bad updates.

scenario: Uber ETA 在新路修好后悄悄失准、欺诈模型在骗子换招后照旧,离线指标却一切正常、没有告警响起。
scenario_en: Uber ETA quietly drifts after new roads open and a fraud model rots as fraudsters shift tactics, yet offline metrics look fine and no alarm fires.
q: ML 生产监控为什么是持续学习的前提，它由哪四层组成？
q_en: Why is production monitoring a precondition for continual learning, and what four layers make it up?
why: 所有再训练策略都假设你能先「检测到退化」；检测不到，模型就悄悄腐烂。监控由四层互相支撑：数据漂移、概念漂移、预测监控、告警。
why_en: Every retraining strategy assumes you can first detect degradation, or the model silently rots, so monitoring stacks four interdependent layers: data drift, concept drift, prediction monitoring, and alerting.
diagram:
flowchart TB DD["数据漂移
P(X) 变"] --> AL["告警"] CD["概念漂移
P(Y·X) 变"] --> AL PM["预测监控
输出分布"] --> AL AL --> R["再训练/回滚/降级"]
options: 监控只是上线后的可选装饰,模型质量在训练阶段就已经定好了
再训练都假设先能检测退化;四层:数据漂移、概念漂移、预测监控、告警
监控就是记录日志,唯一目的是出事之后追责和还原时间线
四层其实是数据/模型/服务/网络这类基础设施监控,盯的是 CPU、内存等硬件资源
options_en: Monitoring is optional post-launch decoration; model quality is already fixed at training time.
Retraining assumes you can detect degradation first; the four layers are data drift, concept drift, prediction monitoring, and alerting.
Monitoring is just logging, whose only purpose is post-incident blame and timeline reconstruction.
The four layers are actually data/model/service/network infrastructure monitoring, watching CPU, memory and other hardware resources.
optionExplanations: 监控不是装饰，是持续学习的前提：没有检测就无从触发再训练，模型只会悄悄退化。
对；四层从数据到概念到预测再到告警层层兜住退化信号，是本课的核心心智模型。
日志追责只是副产品，监控真正要做的是实时发现分布/映射/输出的退化。
这四层是数据科学层面的漂移与告警，不是硬件监控层。
optionExplanations_en: Monitoring is not decoration but a precondition for continual learning: without detection you cannot trigger retraining and the model just degrades silently.
Correct — the four layers catch degradation signals from data to concept to prediction to alerting, the lesson's core mental model.
Log-based blame is a byproduct; monitoring's real job is real-time detection of distribution/mapping/output degradation.
These four are data-science drift and alerting layers, not hardware monitoring tiers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入特征的分布；数据漂移就是它随时间变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: P(X) is the distribution of input features; data drift is P(X) changing over time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给定输入时标签的条件分布，即输入到输出的映射；概念漂移是它变了。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: P(Y|X) is the conditional distribution of the label given inputs — the input-to-output mapping; concept drift is P(Y|X) changing.

scenario: 夏天到秋天,交通流量的输入特征分布明显变了,但「给定这些输入、路况预测该是多少」的映射关系并没有变。
scenario_en: From summer to autumn, the input traffic-feature distribution clearly shifts, but the mapping from those inputs to the predicted outcome has not changed.
q: 这属于哪种漂移，用什么来检测最合适？
q_en: Which kind of drift is this, and what detects it best?
why: 这是数据漂移(data drift)：输入分布 P(X) 变了、映射 P(Y|X) 未必变。检测靠逐特征比对参考(训练)窗口 vs 滚动服务窗口的分布,主力方法是 PSI 和 KS 检验。
why_en: This is data drift — P(X) shifts while P(Y|X) may not — detected by comparing each feature's reference (training) window against a rolling serving window, mainly via PSI and the KS test.
tradeoff: 查数据漂移(逐特征比分布) vs 查概念漂移(需标签看映射)
options: 概念漂移;映射变了,得靠在线精度/召回下降来检测,不是比输入分布
数据漂移;用 PSI/KS 比参考窗口与滚动服务窗口的分布
预测漂移;只看输出分布随时间的变化,不比对输入特征
标签延迟;真标签没回来,只能用代理标签近似检测
options_en: Concept drift; the mapping changed, so you catch it from a drop in online precision or recall, not by comparing input distributions.
Data drift; use PSI or KS to compare the reference window against the rolling serving window.
Prediction drift; you only watch how the output distribution moves, never comparing input features.
Label delay; true labels have not come back, so you approximate with proxy labels.
whenOtherWins: 若输入分布没变、但同样输入现在对应不同结果(如 UI 改版后 CTR 骤降),那才是概念漂移,要靠标签驱动的指标来抓。
whenOtherWins_en: If inputs are unchanged but the same input now yields a different outcome (CTR collapses after a UI redesign), that is concept drift, caught by label-driven metrics.
optionExplanations: 概念漂移是映射 P(Y|X) 变,本题明说映射未变、只有输入分布变,不符。
对；输入分布 P(X) 变正是数据漂移,逐特征比参考 vs 服务窗口的分布是标准打法。
预测漂移只看输出,而本题证据在输入特征分布上,应直接查输入。
标签延迟是标签时效问题,与本题「输入分布变了」的检测对象无关。
optionExplanations_en: Concept drift is the mapping P(Y|X) changing; here the mapping is stated unchanged with only inputs shifting, so it does not fit.
Correct — a shifting input distribution P(X) is exactly data drift, and comparing each feature's reference vs serving window is the standard approach.
Prediction drift looks only at outputs, but the evidence here is in the input feature distribution, so check inputs directly.
Label delay is a timing issue, unrelated to detecting the shifted input distribution in this case.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时的数据分布快照,作为对照基线去比对当前服务窗口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reference window is a snapshot of the training-time distribution used as a baseline to compare against the current serving window.

termDefinitions.term: rolling serving window / 滚动服务窗口
termDefinitions.meaning: 线上最近一段时间的输入分布,随时间滑动,用来和参考窗口比漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rolling serving window is the recent live input distribution that slides over time, compared to the reference window to detect drift.

scenario: 用 PSI 逐特征监控数据漂移,某特征算出 PSI = 0.3。
scenario_en: Monitoring per-feature data drift with PSI, one feature comes out at PSI = 0.3.
q: PSI 怎么算、阈值怎么读、这个 0.3 意味着要做什么？
q_en: How is PSI computed, how are its thresholds read, and what does 0.3 mean to do?
why: PSI 按分箱累加 Σ(实际比例−期望比例)·ln(实际/期望),衡量服务分布偏离训练分布多远。经验阈值 <0.1 无、0.1–0.25 中度、>0.25 显著,所以 0.3 要排查或再训练。
why_en: PSI (Population Stability Index) is the sum over bins of (actual minus expected) times ln(actual/expected), symmetric; empirically under 0.1 is no shift, 0.1 to 0.25 moderate, and above 0.25 significant, so 0.3 means this feature drifted significantly and needs action.
options: PSI 是模型精度指标,0.3 就是准确率 30%,低于基线才需要行动
按分箱累加 Σ(实际−期望)·ln(实际/期望);0.3 超过 0.25 阈值=显著漂移
PSI 越大代表分布越稳定,0.3 属于高分,说明这个特征很健康
PSI 只对连续特征有效,类别特征必须换成卡方检验;而且分箱越少结果越准,建议只分 3 箱
options_en: PSI is a model-accuracy metric, so 0.3 means 30% accuracy and you act only below baseline.
Sum over bins of (actual minus expected) times ln(actual/expected); 0.3 clears the 0.25 line, so it is significant drift.
A bigger PSI means a more stable distribution, so 0.3 is a high score and this feature is healthy.
PSI only works on continuous features and categorical ones must switch to a chi-square test, and fewer bins are more accurate so three bins is best.

termDefinitions.meaning: 总体稳定性指数:按分箱累加 (实际比例−期望比例)·ln(实际/期望),衡量分布漂移,对称。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PSI (Population Stability Index) sums (actual minus expected) times ln(actual/expected) over bins to measure distribution drift, and is symmetric.

optionExplanations: 把 PSI 当成准确率是常见误解——它是分布漂移的统计量，跟模型精度无关，0.3 不对应任何准确率数字。
对；公式和三档阈值都对上了，0.3 落在显著区，该去排查或考虑再训练。
说反了——PSI 越大代表分布离参考窗口越远，0.3 是明显漂移的信号，不是稳定。
分箱不是越少越准，关键是分箱要固定一致；而且 PSI 类别、连续特征都能用，不是只对连续有效。
optionExplanations_en: PSI is not an accuracy metric — it measures distribution shift, so 0.3 has nothing to do with a 30% accuracy figure.
Right — the formula and threshold bands line up, and 0.3 lands in the action zone, so investigate or retrain.
Backwards — a higher PSI means the distribution has drifted further from the reference, so 0.3 signals real drift, not stability.
Fewer bins isn't more accurate — what matters is keeping binning consistent, and PSI works on categorical features too, not just continuous.

scenario: 要给不同类型特征选漂移检测方法:一批是分箱后的类别/离散特征,一批是纯连续特征。
scenario_en: Choosing a drift test per feature type: some are binned categorical/discrete, others are purely continuous.
q: PSI 和 KS 检验各更适合哪类特征，输出和阈值有何不同？
q_en: Which feature types suit PSI vs the KS test, and how do their outputs and thresholds differ?
why: PSI 靠分箱,对类别与离散特征友好但对分箱敏感;KS 不用分箱,直接比两条 CDF 的最大距离,更适合连续特征。选型看特征类型:类别用 PSI,连续用 KS。
why_en: PSI relies on binning, suits categorical and binned continuous features, outputs a PSI score with 0.1/0.25 thresholds, and is cheap but bin-sensitive; the KS test needs no binning, compares two CDFs' max distance, suits continuous features, outputs a D-statistic plus p-value (p<0.05 significant), but is weak on high-dim/categorical.
tradeoff: PSI(分箱、类别友好、对分箱敏感) vs KS(无分箱、连续友好、类别差)
options: PSI 适合连续特征、KS 适合类别特征,两者输出都是 p 值,共用同一套阈值判断
两者完全等价,任何特征类型都能随意互换,输出含义与阈值也一样
PSI:分箱、类别友好、对分箱敏感;KS:无分箱、连续友好、输出 D 统计+p 值
KS 检验必须有真值标签才能跑,PSI 不需要,所以 KS 只能离线事后用
options_en: PSI suits continuous features and KS suits categorical ones, and both output p-values judged against one shared threshold.
They are fully equivalent, interchangeable on any feature type, with the same outputs and thresholds.
PSI is binned, categorical-friendly and bin-sensitive; KS is binning-free, continuous-friendly and outputs a D-stat plus p-value.
The KS test needs ground-truth labels to run while PSI does not, so KS is only usable offline after the fact.
optionExplanations: 说反了:PSI 靠分箱、对类别更友好,KS 无分箱、对连续更友好;且 PSI 输出的是分数不是 p 值。
不等价:适用特征类型、输出、对分箱的敏感度都不同,不能随意互换。
对;分箱与否决定了各自的适用特征和输出形态,这是选型的核心判据。
两者都是无标签的输入分布检测,KS 并不需要标签。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: PSI relies on binning and is categorical-friendly while KS is binning-free and continuous-friendly, and PSI outputs a score, not a p-value.
Not equivalent: applicable feature types, outputs, and bin sensitivity all differ, so they are not interchangeable.
Correct — whether or not you bin determines each one's suitable features and output form, the core selection criterion.
Both are label-free input-distribution tests; KS does not need labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非参数检验,取两条累积分布函数(CDF)的最大距离为 D 统计量,配 p 值判显著。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The KS (Kolmogorov-Smirnov) test is nonparametric, taking the max distance between two CDFs as the D-statistic with a p-value for significance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 累积分布函数:某值以下的累计概率,KS 检验比较两条 CDF。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDF (Cumulative Distribution Function) gives the cumulative probability up to a value; the KS test compares two CDFs.

scenario: 两个团队用 PSI 监控同一个连续特征,一个分 5 箱、一个分 50 箱,算出的 PSI 差异很大。
scenario_en: Two teams monitor the same continuous feature with PSI, one with 5 bins and one with 50 bins, and get very different PSI values.
q: 这暴露了 PSI 的什么局限，怎么应对？
q_en: What PSI limitation does this expose, and how do you handle it?
why: PSI 对分箱选择敏感:箱数/边界变了,同一分布能算出不同 PSI,阈值判断随之飘。应对是固定分箱方案、对连续特征改用无需分箱的 KS 检验,并跨时间保持分箱一致以便可比。
why_en: PSI is sensitive to bin choice: changing bin count or edges yields different PSI for the same distribution, so fix the binning scheme, prefer the binning-free KS test for continuous features, and keep bins consistent over time for comparability.
options: PSI 对分箱敏感:箱数/边界一变,同分布算出不同 PSI;应固定分箱或改用 KS
说明 PSI 在任何场景下都不可用,应彻底弃用漂移检测,只靠在线精度掉了再回头查
说明箱越多一定越准,两队统一都分成 50 箱就能消掉这个差异
PSI 与分箱方案无关,两队结果不同只可能是取数或口径上的 bug
options_en: PSI is bin-sensitive: change bin count or edges and the same distribution yields a different PSI, so pin the binning or switch to KS.
It shows PSI is unusable in every setting, so drop drift detection entirely and just investigate after online accuracy falls.
It shows more bins are always more accurate, so having both teams use 50 bins removes the gap.
PSI does not depend on binning, so the gap can only come from a data-pull or definition bug.
optionExplanations: 对;分箱敏感是 PSI 的已知局限,固定分箱+对连续特征用 KS 是标准应对。
PSI 仍是低成本的类别/分箱漂移利器,只需固定分箱,不必彻底弃用。
箱越多不必然越准,反而更易受采样噪声影响,关键是跨时间一致。
差异恰恰来自分箱不同,不是数据 bug,这正是分箱敏感的表现。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — bin sensitivity is a known PSI limitation, and fixing bins plus using KS for continuous features is the standard remedy.
PSI is still a cheap tool for categorical/binned drift; just fix the binning rather than abandoning it.
More bins are not necessarily more accurate and can amplify sampling noise; consistency over time is what matters.
The difference comes precisely from different binning, not a data bug — that is the bin-sensitivity showing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把连续值切成若干区间统计频率;PSI 依赖分箱,箱的选择会影响结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Binning slices continuous values into intervals to count frequencies; PSI depends on binning and the bin choice affects the result.

scenario: 模型有上千个特征,对每个特征都跑昂贵的漂移检验、还高频跑,监控成本快赶上服务成本了。
scenario_en: The model has thousands of features, and running an expensive drift test on every one at high frequency makes monitoring cost rival serving cost.
q: 怎么在不留盲区的前提下压低监控成本？
q_en: How do you cut monitoring cost without leaving blind spots?
why: 只重点监控一小撮高重要度特征(按 SHAP/特征重要度选 top),并先用轻量汇总统计(mean/var/min/max)做粗筛,再对可疑特征上昂贵的逐特征检验。这样把算力花在最可能影响输出的特征上。
why_en: Monitor a curated set of high-importance features (top by SHAP/importance) and use lightweight summary stats (mean/var/min/max) as a first pass before expensive per-feature tests, spending compute on the features most likely to move the output.
tradeoff: 重点监控高重要度特征+轻量粗筛(省算力但可能漏低重要度特征) vs 全特征高频检验(无盲区但贵)
options: 对全部上千特征都跑最贵的逐特征检验,覆盖越全盲区就越少
只监控高重要度特征(SHAP top),先用轻量汇总统计粗筛再上贵检验
干脆不监控特征,等用户投诉或在线指标掉下来了再回头排查
随机抽 10 个特征监控,完全不看重要度,只求抽样成本可控、覆盖面看似公平
options_en: Run the most expensive per-feature test on all thousand-plus features, since fuller coverage means fewer blind spots.
Monitor only high-importance features by SHAP, screen with lightweight summary stats first, then run expensive tests on suspects.
Skip feature monitoring altogether and investigate once users complain or online metrics drop.
Randomly sample ten features with no regard to importance at all, just to keep cost bounded and coverage looking fair.
whenOtherWins: 若某个低重要度特征其实是已知易坏的上游管线来源,也该单独纳入监控,重要度不是唯一筛选维度。
whenOtherWins_en: If a low-importance feature comes from a known-fragile upstream pipeline, monitor it too — importance is not the only screening dimension.
optionExplanations: 全特征最贵检验成本失控,且大量低重要度特征漂了也不影响输出,性价比极低。
对;按重要度聚焦+轻量粗筛把算力花在刀刃上,兼顾覆盖与成本。
不监控等投诉是把退化外包给用户,发现时已造成损害。
随机抽样忽略重要度,可能全抽到无关特征、漏掉真正影响输出的那些。
optionExplanations_en: The most expensive test on all features blows up cost, and many low-importance features drifting does not move the output, so the ROI is terrible.
Correct — focus by importance plus a lightweight first pass spends compute where it counts, balancing coverage and cost.
Waiting for complaints outsources degradation detection to users, by which point damage is done.
Random sampling ignores importance and may pick all irrelevant features, missing the ones that actually move the output.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于博弈论 Shapley 值的特征重要度归因,用来挑出对预测影响最大的特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) attributes feature importance via game-theoretic Shapley values, used to pick the features most influencing predictions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 均值/方差/最小/最大等轻量指标,作漂移的第一道粗筛。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Summary stats like mean/variance/min/max are lightweight measures used as a first-pass drift screen.

scenario: UI 改版后,同一批用户看同一个广告,特征分布几乎没变,但 CTR 却明显掉了。
scenario_en: After a UI redesign, the same users see the same ad with almost unchanged feature distributions, yet CTR clearly drops.
q: 这属于哪种漂移，为什么数据漂移检测抓不到它？
q_en: Which drift is this, and why do data-drift detectors miss it?
why: 这是概念漂移:特征看着一样,但输入→标签的映射 P(Y|X) 变了(改版后同样的展示不再引来点击)。PSI/KS 只比输入分布,输入没变它们无感,得靠标签驱动的信号(在线指标下降、残差/校准变化)才能抓。
why_en: This is concept drift: features look the same but the input-to-label mapping P(Y|X) changed (the same impression no longer draws a click), and since PSI/KS only compare inputs they miss it — you need label-driven signals.
tradeoff: 概念漂移(映射变、需标签抓) vs 数据漂移(输入变、比分布抓)
options: 数据漂移;输入分布确实变了,PSI 逐特征比对就能直接抓到
概念漂移;映射 P(Y|X) 变而输入未变,PSI/KS 只比输入故无感
预测漂移;这只是模型输出分布本身在随时间抖动,跟输入到标签的映射变化没有关系
标签延迟;映射其实没变,只是真标签迟到导致指标看起来滞后
options_en: Data drift; the input distribution really did move, so per-feature PSI catches it directly.
Concept drift; P(Y|X) changed while inputs did not, and PSI or KS only compare inputs so they stay blind.
Prediction drift; the output distribution is just jittering over time on its own, with nothing to do with a change in the input-to-label mapping.
Label delay; the mapping is unchanged and metrics only look stale because true labels arrive late.
whenOtherWins: 若是输入特征分布本身变了(如流量季节性),那才是数据漂移,PSI/KS 逐特征比分布就能抓到。
whenOtherWins_en: If the input feature distribution itself changed (seasonal traffic), that is data drift, caught by per-feature PSI/KS.
optionExplanations: PSI 只比输入分布,本题输入没变,它必然抓不到,判成数据漂移是典型误区。
对;映射变而输入不变正是概念漂移,只能靠标签相关信号发现。
预测漂移看输出分布,而本题根因是映射关系变,概念漂移更准确。
标签延迟是标签迟到的时效问题,与本题「映射变了」不是一回事。
optionExplanations_en: PSI only compares inputs; with inputs unchanged it necessarily misses this, so calling it data drift is a classic mistake.
Correct — a changed mapping with unchanged inputs is exactly concept drift, detectable only via label-related signals.
Prediction drift watches output distribution, but the root cause here is a changed mapping, so concept drift is more precise.
Label delay is a timing issue of late labels, different from the mapping changing here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征不变但输入到标签的映射 P(Y|X) 变了,同样输入现在对应不同结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concept drift is when features stay but the input-to-label mapping P(Y|X) changes, so the same input now yields a different outcome.

scenario: 你想直接确认概念漂移,手上有一部分已打标的生产数据。
scenario_en: You want to directly confirm concept drift and have some labeled production data on hand.
q: 检测概念漂移最直接的信号是什么，主要瓶颈是什么？
q_en: What is the most direct signal for concept drift, and what is the main bottleneck?
why: 最直接信号是在已打标生产数据上的在线指标(precision/recall/AUC)下降——映射真变了准确率就掉。瓶颈是标签延迟:欺诈标签要数周才确认,等真标签到手模型早已退化,所以常需代理信号顶上。
why_en: The most direct signal is a drop in online metrics (precision/recall/AUC) on labeled production data, but the bottleneck is label delay — fraud labels take weeks — so proxy signals often fill the gap.
options: 在已打标生产数据上的在线指标(precision/recall/AUC)下降;瓶颈是标签延迟
输入 PSI 上升信号最直接;它完全不依赖任何标签,所以概念漂移检测理论上也不存在延迟瓶颈这回事
GPU 利用率下降最直接;与标签完全无关,瓶颈在算力监控的采样率
模型文件体积变化最直接;不依赖任何标签,因此这条路径没有瓶颈
options_en: A drop in online metrics like precision, recall or AUC on labeled production data; the bottleneck is label delay.
A rising input PSI signal is the most direct one, and since it needs no labels at all, concept-drift detection in theory has no delay bottleneck at all.
Falling GPU utilization is the most direct signal, unrelated to labels, bottlenecked by the compute sampling rate.
A change in model file size is the most direct signal, needs no labels at all, so this path has no bottleneck.
optionExplanations: 对;标签驱动的在线指标下降最能证实映射变了,但真标签迟到是它的天然瓶颈。
输入 PSI 抓的是数据漂移;概念漂移里输入没变,PSI 无感,且这不是最直接的映射信号。
GPU 利用率是资源指标,跟映射 P(Y·X) 是否变化毫无关系。
模型体积不变,更与概念漂移无关,属无意义选项。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a label-driven drop in online metrics best confirms a changed mapping, but late true labels are its inherent bottleneck.
Input PSI catches data drift; in concept drift inputs are unchanged so PSI is blind, and it is not the most direct mapping signal.
GPU utilization is a resource metric with nothing to do with whether P(Y|X) changed.
Model size does not change and is unrelated to concept drift, a meaningless option.

termDefinitions.meaning: ROC 曲线下面积,衡量分类器排序好坏,常用作在线监控指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) measures a classifier's ranking quality and is a common online monitoring metric.

scenario: 标签要数周才到,你没法等真标签算在线精度,但又想尽早发现概念漂移。
scenario_en: Labels take weeks to arrive so you cannot wait for online accuracy, yet you want early warning of concept drift.
q: 标签滞后时，可以用哪些代理信号提示概念漂移？(多选)
q_en: When labels lag, which proxy signals hint at concept drift? (multiple)
why: 标签没到齐时用三类代理:残差分布监控(预测误差系统性偏移)、校准曲线分析(预测 30% 实测漂到 15%)、预测 vs 实际标签分布随真值陆续到来的分歧增长。它们比真标签更早给出映射变了的线索。
why_en: While labels lag, use residual-distribution monitoring (systematic error shift), calibration-curve analysis (predicts 30% but observed drifts to 15%), and growing divergence between predicted and actual label distributions as ground truth trickles in.
options: 残差分布监控:预测误差随时间系统性偏移
校准曲线分析:预测 30% 但实测漂到 15%
预测 vs 实际标签分布的分歧随真值陆续到来而增长
监控 GPU 温度是否升高
options_en: Residual-distribution monitoring: prediction errors systematically shift over time.
Calibration-curve analysis: predicts 30% but observed drifts to 15%.
Growing divergence between predicted and actual label distributions as ground truth arrives.
Monitoring whether GPU temperature rises.
optionExplanations: 对;残差系统性偏移(如持续高估)说明映射断了,不必等全部真标签。
对;校准漂移(预测概率与实测频率脱节)是概念漂移的早期信号。
对;随真值陆续到来两分布分歧变大,是强指示信号。
错;GPU 温度是硬件指标,与映射 P(Y·X) 是否变化无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a systematic residual shift (e.g. consistent over-prediction) signals a broken mapping without waiting for all true labels.
Correct — calibration drift (predicted probabilities detaching from observed frequency) is an early concept-drift signal.
Correct — widening divergence between the two distributions as ground truth arrives is a strong indicator.
Wrong — GPU temperature is a hardware metric, unrelated to whether P(Y|X) changed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测值与真实值之差;其分布系统性偏移提示映射变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A residual is the gap between prediction and actual; a systematic shift in its distribution hints at a changed mapping.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测概率 vs 实际发生频率的关系曲线;两者脱节即校准退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A calibration curve plots predicted probability against actual observed frequency; a gap between them means degraded calibration.

scenario: 一个分类模型对某类样本一直预测「30% 概率」,但随时间推移这类样本的实际发生率跌到了 15%。
scenario_en: A classifier keeps predicting '30% probability' for a class, but over time the actual rate for that class drifts to 15%.
q: 这说明模型出了什么问题，属于哪种监控信号？
q_en: What does this indicate about the model, and which monitoring signal is it?
why: 预测概率(30%)与实测频率(15%)持续脱节 = 校准退化,是概念漂移的代理信号:映射变了,模型的概率不再可信。后果是依赖该概率做阈值决策(如风控放行线)会系统性偏,需重训或重新校准。
why_en: A persistent gap between predicted probability (30%) and observed frequency (15%) is degraded calibration — a concept-drift proxy — meaning the mapping changed and the model's probabilities are no longer trustworthy.
options: 模型延迟变高了,属于服务性能监控,与预测概率准不准没有关系
校准退化:预测概率与实测频率脱节,是概念漂移代理信号,阈值决策会偏
输入分布变了,属于数据漂移,用 PSI 逐特征比对就能定位并修好
只是随机噪声,预测概率与实际频率本来就不必一致,不需要处理
options_en: Model latency went up, a service-performance issue with nothing to do with how accurate the predicted probability is.
Calibration decay: predicted probability has detached from observed frequency, a concept-drift proxy that skews threshold decisions.
The input distribution changed, so it is data drift and per-feature PSI will locate and fix it.
It is just random noise; predicted probability never has to match observed frequency, so no action is needed.
optionExplanations: 延迟是服务性能,与预测概率和实测频率脱节这个校准问题无关。
对;概率与频率脱节就是校准退化,作为概念漂移代理,会让所有基于该概率的阈值决策偏移。
PSI 查输入分布;这里问题在输出概率与真实频率的一致性,不是输入漂移。
持续单向脱节不是随机噪声,而是校准系统性退化,必须处理。
optionExplanations_en: Latency is serving performance, unrelated to the calibration gap between predicted probability and observed frequency.
Correct — probability detaching from frequency is degraded calibration, a concept-drift proxy that skews every threshold decision built on that probability.
PSI checks input distribution; here the issue is output-probability vs actual-frequency consistency, not input drift.
A persistent one-directional gap is not random noise but systematic calibration decay that must be addressed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型输出的概率与真实发生频率是否一致;预测 30% 就应约 30% 发生。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration is whether the model's output probabilities match real frequencies; a predicted 30% should occur about 30% of the time.

scenario: 标签要数周才回来,你想要一条尽可能快、不依赖真值的退化「跳闸线」。
scenario_en: Labels return weeks later and you want the fastest possible degradation tripwire that needs no ground truth.
q: 哪种监控能不等标签就最快报警，代价是什么？
q_en: Which monitoring alerts fastest without labels, and at what cost?
why: 预测监控:只看模型输出分布随时间的变化,不需要任何真值标签,所以是最快的跳闸线。代价是它只报症状不报根因——输出突变可能来自数据漂移、概念漂移、管线 bug 或特征陈旧,还得进一步定位。
why_en: Prediction monitoring watches the output distribution over time with no ground-truth labels, making it the fastest tripwire, at the cost of flagging symptoms not root cause — an output shift could be data drift, concept drift, a pipeline bug, or stale features.
tradeoff: 预测监控(无标签、最快但只报症状) vs 在线指标(需标签、慢但直指映射)
options: 在线精度监控;它最快而且能直接定位根因,不受标签延迟影响
概念漂移检测;它不需要任何标签,靠输入分布就能确认映射变了
预测监控:只看输出分布、无需真值,最快;代价是只报症状
数据漂移 PSI;它可以替代真值标签,直接拿来评估模型的精度
options_en: Online accuracy monitoring; it is the fastest and pinpoints root cause, and label delay does not affect it.
Concept-drift detection; it needs no labels and confirms a mapping change from the input distribution alone.
Prediction monitoring: output distribution only, no ground truth, the fastest tripwire, but it reports symptoms only.
Data-drift PSI; it can stand in for ground-truth labels and directly measure model accuracy.
whenOtherWins: 当真标签能快速到手时,直接看在线精度/召回下降更能定位根因,不必只依赖预测分布这种症状信号。
whenOtherWins_en: When true labels arrive fast, a drop in online precision/recall pinpoints root cause better, so you need not rely only on the symptom-level prediction distribution.
optionExplanations: 在线精度要等真标签,恰恰不快;它准但慢,不满足「不等标签最快报警」。
概念漂移的最直接信号仍是标签驱动的在线指标,不是无标签就最快的那条。
对;输出分布监控无需标签、反应最快,但只能报症状,根因还得进一步查。
PSI 查的是输入漂移,不能替代真值评估模型精度。
optionExplanations_en: Online accuracy waits for true labels and is precisely not fast; it is accurate but slow, failing the label-free fastest-alert goal.
Concept drift's most direct signal is still label-driven online metrics, not the label-free fastest one.
Correct — output-distribution monitoring needs no labels and reacts fastest, but flags only symptoms with root cause needing further investigation.
PSI checks input drift and cannot replace ground truth for evaluating model accuracy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跟踪模型输出分布随时间的变化并在偏离时报警,无需真值标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prediction monitoring tracks the model's output distribution over time and alerts on divergence, needing no ground-truth labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一触即发的快速报警阈值,用于第一时间发现异常。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tripwire is a fast trigger threshold that fires immediately to surface anomalies first.

scenario: 欺诈模型预测的欺诈率一夜之间从 3% 跳到 18%,但监控中的那些特征都没有数据漂移。
scenario_en: A fraud model's predicted fraud rate jumps from 3% to 18% overnight, yet none of the monitored features show data drift.
q: 预测分布突变但监控特征无漂移，最可能的根因是什么？
q_en: Prediction distribution shifted but monitored features show no drift — what is the most likely root cause?
why: 输出分布突变+被监控特征无漂移,强烈指向未被监控特征上的管线 bug:某个没在监控里的特征被喂了错误值,污染了预测。要去查特征管线健康度,而不是急着再训练。
why_en: An output shift with no drift in monitored features strongly points to a pipeline bug in an unmonitored feature serving wrong values, so investigate feature-pipeline health rather than rushing to retrain.
tradeoff: 先查未监控特征的管线 bug(常见根因) vs 直接再训练(可能白训还留着 bug)
options: 立刻全量再训练模型,不必查特征;重训会自动覆盖掉那些坏输入
某个未监控特征的管线 bug 喂了错值污染预测;先查特征管线健康度
一定是概念漂移,映射变了,而输入没变所以被监控特征才没反应
一定是数据漂移,只是 PSI 的分箱没算对,才漏掉了真正变化的特征
options_en: Retrain the whole model right away without checking features, since retraining will absorb the bad inputs.
A pipeline bug on an unmonitored feature is serving wrong values and polluting predictions; check feature-pipeline health first.
It must be concept drift: the mapping moved while inputs did not, which is why monitored features look calm.
It must be data drift, and PSI simply used the wrong bins, so it missed the features that actually moved.
whenOtherWins: 若排查后发现被监控特征确实也漂了,才转向数据漂移/概念漂移路线;先验证管线再谈重训。
whenOtherWins_en: Only if investigation shows monitored features did drift do you switch to a data/concept-drift track; verify the pipeline before retraining.
optionExplanations: 急着重训会在带 bug 的脏特征上训练,既浪费又治标不治本,根因还在。
对;监控特征无漂移却输出突变,典型是未监控特征的管线故障,先查管线最省事。
概念漂移一般不会一夜从 3% 跳到 18% 且监控特征全无漂移,更像管线突发故障。
监控特征无漂移不支持数据漂移结论;把它归为 PSI 算错缺乏依据。
optionExplanations_en: Rushing to retrain trains on buggy dirty features, wasteful and treating symptoms while the root cause remains.
Correct — no drift in monitored features but a sudden output shift is classically an unmonitored-feature pipeline fault, so check the pipeline first.
Concept drift rarely jumps 3% to 18% overnight with zero drift in monitored features; a sudden pipeline fault is likelier.
No drift in monitored features does not support a data-drift conclusion, and blaming a PSI miscalculation lacks basis.

termDefinitions.term: feature pipeline bug / 特征管线 bug
termDefinitions.meaning: 计算或传输某特征的管线出错,给模型喂了错误值,常在未监控特征上。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature-pipeline bug is a fault in computing or delivering a feature that feeds the model wrong values, often on unmonitored features.

scenario: 对比「预测监控」和「概念漂移检测」在是否需要标签、速度、能否定位根因上的差别。
scenario_en: Compare prediction monitoring and concept-drift detection on label need, speed, and root-cause localization.
q: 预测监控与概念漂移检测最关键的两点差别是什么？
q_en: What are the two key differences between prediction monitoring and concept-drift detection?
why: 预测监控无需标签、最快,但只报症状(输出变了)不指根因;概念漂移检测(靠在线指标/残差/校准)需要标签或代理,慢一些,但直指映射真的变了。两者互补:预测监控先跳闸,概念漂移检测再定性。
why_en: Prediction monitoring needs no labels and is fastest but flags only symptoms, while concept-drift detection (via online metrics/residuals/calibration) needs labels or proxies and is slower but points at a real mapping change — they are complementary.
tradeoff: 预测监控(无标签、快、只报症状) vs 概念漂移检测(需标签、慢、指根因)
options: 两者都需要标签,速度也差不多,区别只在于用的统计算法名字不同
预测监控慢但准而且能定根因,概念漂移检测快但结论不太可靠
预测监控无标签、最快但只报症状;概念漂移检测需标签、慢但指根因
预测监控只能用在分类模型上,概念漂移检测只能用在回归模型上
options_en: Both need labels and run at similar speed; the only difference is the name of the statistic used.
Prediction monitoring is slow but accurate and pinpoints root cause, while concept-drift detection is fast but unreliable.
Prediction monitoring is label-free and fastest but symptoms-only; concept-drift detection needs labels, is slower, but names the cause.
Prediction monitoring only applies to classification models and concept-drift detection only to regression models.
optionExplanations: 预测监控恰恰不需要标签,这正是它快的原因,说两者都需标签是错的。
说反了:预测监控快但只报症状,概念漂移检测慢但更能定性根因。
对;是否需标签+能否定位根因是两者互补的核心分工。
两者都能用于分类和回归,只是统计量不同,不受任务类型限制。
optionExplanations_en: Prediction monitoring precisely needs no labels, which is why it is fast, so saying both need labels is wrong.
Backwards: prediction monitoring is fast but symptoms-only, while concept-drift detection is slower but better at root cause.
Correct — label need plus root-cause capability is the complementary division of labor between them.
Both apply to classification and regression with different statistics, not restricted by task type.

termDefinitions.term: symptom vs root cause / 症状 vs 根因
termDefinitions.meaning: 症状是可观测的异常(输出变了),根因是背后原因(漂移/bug/陈旧);监控要从症状追到根因。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A symptom is an observable anomaly (output shifted) while the root cause is the underlying reason (drift/bug/staleness); monitoring traces from symptom to root cause.

scenario: 值班工程师每天被上百条告警淹没,慢慢开始忽略它们,结果真出事那次也被划过去了。
scenario_en: On-call engineers are flooded with hundreds of alerts daily, start ignoring them, and swipe past the one time it really mattered.
q: 告警设计的首要失败模式是什么，怎么防？
q_en: What is alerting's primary failure mode, and how do you guard against it?
why: 首要失败模式是告警疲劳(alert fatigue),而非漏报:告警太多、太吵,人就麻木、把真信号一起忽略。防法是分严重度分级(page/小时级/日报),让每条告警的动作明确、噪声可控。
why_en: The primary failure mode is alert fatigue, not missed signals: too many noisy alerts numb people into ignoring real ones, guarded against with severity tiers (page/within-hours/daily digest) so each alert has a clear action.
options: 漏报;应该把所有阈值都调到最敏感,宁可多报也绝不能放过真信号
告警延迟;只要加快推送通道、缩短采集间隔,值班人自然就能第一时间及时响应
告警疲劳(太吵致麻木);用严重度分级(page/小时级/日报)让动作明确
告警存储成本;把历史告警日志压缩归档,成本降下来问题自然就没了
options_en: Missed detections; set every threshold to maximum sensitivity so no real signal ever slips through.
Alert latency; just speed up the push channel and shorten the collection interval and on-call will naturally respond in time.
Alert fatigue from too much noise; tier alerts by severity (page / within hours / daily digest) so each has a clear action.
Alert storage cost; compress and archive historical alert logs and the problem goes away once cost drops.
optionExplanations: 把阈值全调最敏感恰恰制造告警疲劳,真信号会被海量误报淹没,适得其反。
推送再快,若量大而杂,人依旧麻木,速度不是根本问题。
对;告警疲劳是首要敌人,分级让高危立即 page、低危进日报,噪声可控。
存储成本是次要工程问题,与人会不会忽略告警的可用性无关。
optionExplanations_en: Making all thresholds most sensitive precisely creates alert fatigue, drowning real signals in false alarms — counterproductive.
Faster pushing does not help if volume is high and noisy; people still go numb, and speed is not the core issue.
Correct — alert fatigue is the primary enemy, and tiering pages high-severity immediately while sending low-severity to a digest keeps noise controlled.
Storage cost is a minor engineering issue, unrelated to whether people ignore alerts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 告警过多过吵导致值班人麻木、忽略,连真信号也被划过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alert fatigue is when too many noisy alerts numb on-call staff into ignoring them, including real signals.

scenario: 线上突然出现:模型对所有请求都吐同一个常数输出(预测分布塌缩),用户正在受影响。
scenario_en: In production the model suddenly emits a constant output for every request (prediction distribution collapse) and users are affected right now.
q: 这该归到哪个告警严重度层，为什么？
q_en: Which severity tier does this belong to, and why?
why: 预测分布塌缩(常数输出)=系统实质已坏、正在伤用户,属 Tier 1「立即 page」,和服务报错、延迟 SLA 违约同级。这类要人马上响应,不能等日报。
why_en: Prediction distribution collapse (constant output) means the system is effectively broken and hurting users now, so it is Tier 1 'page immediately,' alongside serving errors and latency SLA breaches.
tradeoff: Tier 1 立即 page(系统正在坏) vs Tier 2/3(退化但仍可用)
options: Tier 3 日报:属于信息性观察,汇总进日报、留到周会复盘就够了
Tier 2 小时级:功能其实还在只是退化,几个小时内处理来得及
Tier 1 立即 page:预测塌缩=系统实质已坏、正在伤用户
根本不用告警:常数输出多半会随着流量变化自己恢复正常
options_en: Tier 3 daily digest: this is informational, roll it into the daily report and review it at the weekly meeting.
Tier 2 within hours: the feature still works and is merely degrading, so handling it within a few hours is fine.
Tier 1 page immediately: a collapsed prediction distribution means the system is effectively broken and hurting users.
No alert at all: a constant output usually recovers on its own as traffic patterns shift.
whenOtherWins: 若只是高重要度特征出现显著漂移但输出仍正常、用户暂未受影响,那降到 Tier 2 小时级告警即可。
whenOtherWins_en: If only a high-importance feature shows significant drift while outputs stay normal and users are not yet affected, drop to a Tier 2 within-hours alert.
optionExplanations: 常数输出正在伤用户,放日报等于故障持续几天,严重误判等级。
系统已实质失效不是「仍在只是退化」,Tier 2 低估了严重性。
对;塌缩=正在坏、正在伤用户,和服务报错/延迟违约同属立即 page。
模型不会自愈常数输出这种故障,不告警会让事故无人处理。
optionExplanations_en: Constant output is hurting users now; a daily digest means the outage lasts days — a severe misgrading.
The system is effectively down, not 'still functional just degrading,' so Tier 2 underrates the severity.
Correct — collapse means actively broken and harming users, so it is page-immediately alongside serving errors and latency breaches.
The model will not self-heal a constant-output fault; not alerting leaves the incident unhandled.

termDefinitions.term: prediction distribution collapse / 预测分布塌缩
termDefinitions.meaning: 模型对所有输入输出几乎相同的常数,输出多样性消失,常是严重故障。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prediction distribution collapse is when the model emits nearly the same constant for all inputs, losing output diversity — usually a severe fault.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务水平协议:承诺的延迟/可用性等指标上限,违约即触发高优告警。
