whenOtherWins_en: If signals are few and highly aligned in semantics, a well-tuned weighted-sum scalar is simpler and sufficient, without multi-task complexity.
optionExplanations: 只训观看时长丢了跳过/分享等互补信号,欠拟合真实满意度。
对;多任务是 YouTube/TikTok 标准,共享表征+保语义,兼顾稳健与效果。
各训独立模型无法共享表征,还要维护多套,serving 投票也更贵。
if-else 规则学不到细粒度偏好,扛不住规模,是倒退。
optionExplanations_en: Training only watch time drops complementary skip/share signals, underfitting real satisfaction.
Correct — multi-task is the YouTube/TikTok standard, sharing representations and keeping semantics for both robustness and quality.
Independent models cannot share representations, need multiple pipelines, and voting at serving is costlier.
If-else rules cannot learn fine-grained preference and do not scale, a regression.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多任务模型中被各预测头共用的底层网络,学通用表征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A backbone is the shared lower network used by all heads in a multi-task model, learning general representations.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 你要为模型设计「用户特征」——刻画这个用户是谁、长期偏好如何。
scenario_en: You design user features — who the user is and their long-term preferences.
q: 哪些属于用户特征，它们的时间尺度是怎样的？
q_en: Which are user features, and what is their time scale?
why: 用户特征刻画长期、稳定的画像:近 30 天的品类分布、平均会话时长、时段活跃曲线、人口属性(年龄段/语言/国家)、7 天累计观看/跳过/分享率。它们变化慢,可批量更新。
why_en: User features capture a long-term, stable profile: 30-day genre distribution, average session length, time-of-day activity curves, demographics (age bucket/language/country), and 7-day cumulative watch/skip/share rates — slow-changing, batch-updatable.
tradeoff: 用户特征(长期稳定、可批量更新) vs 上下文特征(短期意图、需近实时)
options: 当前设备类型和此刻时段,属短期意图,手机通勤和客厅电视会让同一用户在同一天看到完全不同的候选集和排序结果
近 30 天品类分布、平均会话时长、人口属性、7 天累计观看/跳过/分享率,长期稳定可批量更新
视频的标题和时长,这些描述的是被打分的物品本身,不是用户是谁
当前会话最近看的 N 个视频,这类信号刻画的是即时上下文而不是长期画像
options_en: Current device type and current time-of-day, a short-term intent — phone-commute versus living-room TV can give the same user an entirely different candidate set and ranking on the same day.
30-day genre distribution, average session length, demographics, 7-day cumulative watch/skip/share rates — long-term stable, batch-updatable.
The video's title and duration — these describe the item being scored, not who the user is.
The last N videos in the current session — this kind of signal captures immediate context, not a long-term profile.
whenOtherWins: 若要捕捉「这一刻想看什么」的临时意图,那是上下文特征(设备/时段/本会话最近视频),而非长期用户画像。
whenOtherWins_en: To capture right-now intent, use contextual features (device/time/last videos this session), not the long-term user profile.
optionExplanations: 设备/此刻时段是上下文特征、刻画短期意图,不是长期用户画像。
对;这些都是慢变、长期稳定的用户画像特征,可批量更新。
标题和时长是视频特征,描述被打分的物品,不是用户。
本会话最近视频是上下文特征,刻画即时意图,不是长期画像。
optionExplanations_en: Device/current time are contextual features capturing short-term intent, not a long-term user profile.
Correct — these are slow-changing, long-term stable user-profile features, batch-updatable.
Title and duration are video features describing the scored item, not the user.
Last videos this session are contextual features for immediate intent, not a long-term profile.

termDefinitions.meaning: 刻画用户长期身份与偏好的特征(历史品类分布、人口属性等),变化慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: User features capture a user's long-term identity and preferences (historical genre distribution, demographics), changing slowly.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 同一个用户,早上 8 点在手机上通勤,和晚上 9 点在客厅智能电视上,看到的推荐很不一样。
scenario_en: The same user at 8AM on a phone commuting versus 9PM on a living-room smart TV gets very different recommendations.
q: 是什么类型的特征造成了同一用户不同时刻的推荐差异？
q_en: Which feature type causes the same user to get different recs at different moments?
why: 上下文特征:当前设备(手机通勤→偏短视频;智能电视晚间→偏长视频)、时段、星期几、本会话最近看的 N 个视频。它们刻画「此刻的即时意图」,是同一用户在不同情境拿到不同推荐的原因。面试官特别看重这一区分。
why_en: Contextual features: current device (phone commute favors short-form, evening smart-TV favors long-form), time of day, day of week, and the last N videos this session — they capture right-now intent and are why the same user gets different recs across contexts.
tradeoff: 上下文特征(即时意图、需近实时更新) vs 用户特征(长期画像、批量更新)
options: 用户长期人口属性,如年龄段、语言和国家,这些跨情境几乎不变,不会随时段或设备切换
上下文特征:当前设备/时段/星期几/本会话最近视频,刻画此刻即时意图
视频的创作者 ID 和上传时间
视频的内容嵌入向量
options_en: Long-term demographics like age bucket, language, and country, which stay nearly constant across time of day or device.
Contextual features: current device/time/day-of-week/last videos this session, capturing right-now intent.
The video's creator ID and upload date.
The video's content embedding vector.
whenOtherWins: 若要解释这个用户「一贯」的口味(跨情境稳定的偏好),那看长期用户特征而非上下文特征。
whenOtherWins_en: To explain the user's habitual taste (stable across contexts), look at long-term user features rather than contextual ones.
optionExplanations: 人口属性是长期用户特征、跨情境稳定,解释不了同一用户不同时刻的差异。
对;设备/时段/本会话视频等上下文特征刻画即时意图,正是差异来源。
创作者 ID/上传时间是视频特征,描述物品不描述情境。
内容嵌入是视频特征,刻画视频语义,不刻画用户此刻情境。
optionExplanations_en: Demographics are long-term user features stable across contexts and cannot explain moment-to-moment differences.
Correct — contextual features like device/time/session videos capture immediate intent, the source of the difference.
Creator ID/upload date are video features describing the item, not the context.
Content embeddings are video features capturing video semantics, not the user's current context.

termDefinitions.meaning: 当前请求的即时情境(设备、时段、星期、本会话最近视频),刻画短期意图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contextual features are the current request's immediate context (device, time, day, recent session videos), capturing short-term intent.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 模型吃的是一个结构化特征向量,而不是原始行为流;这些特征沿三个维度组织。
scenario_en: The model consumes a structured feature vector, not raw behavior; features organize along three dimensions.
q: 视频推荐的特征工程通常沿哪三个维度组织？
q_en: Along which three dimensions is video-recommendation feature engineering organized?
why: 三维:用户特征(用户是谁+长期历史)、视频特征(被打分的物品:元数据+人气+内容嵌入)、上下文特征(当前请求的即时情境)。三者分别贡献长期画像、物品属性、短期意图,缺一面推荐就偏。
why_en: Three dimensions: user features (who + long-term history), video features (the scored item: metadata + popularity + content embeddings), and contextual features (the current request's immediate context) — contributing long-term profile, item attributes, and short-term intent.
options: 训练集/验证集/测试集三维,这是划分数据评估模型泛化能力的维度,不是特征本身
用户特征、视频特征、上下文特征:长期画像+物品属性+短期意图
CPU/内存/磁盘三维
召回/排序/重排三维
options_en: Train/validation/test three splits — that's how you partition data to evaluate generalization, not a feature dimension.
User features, video features, contextual features: long-term profile + item attributes + short-term intent.
CPU/memory/disk three dimensions.
Retrieval/ranking/re-ranking three stages.
optionExplanations: 训练/验证/测试是数据划分,不是特征工程的维度。
对;用户/视频/上下文三维分别覆盖长期画像、物品属性、即时意图。
CPU/内存/磁盘是硬件资源,不是特征维度。
召回/排序/重排是流程阶段,不是特征组织维度。
optionExplanations_en: Train/validation/test are data splits, not feature-engineering dimensions.
Correct — user/video/context cover long-term profile, item attributes, and immediate intent.
CPU/memory/disk are hardware resources, not feature dimensions.
Retrieval/ranking/re-ranking are pipeline stages, not feature-organization dimensions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被打分物品的属性:标题/类别/时长/创作者、人气统计、内容嵌入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Video features are the scored item's attributes: title/category/duration/creator, popularity stats, and content embeddings.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 两类特征更新节奏差别很大:本会话最近看了什么(几秒前发生),和某视频的总播放量/人气(慢慢累积)。
scenario_en: Two feature classes differ in update cadence: what the user watched this session (seconds ago) and a video's total views/popularity (slowly accruing).
q: 特征的「新鲜度谱系」该怎么塑造特征存储的选型？
q_en: How should the feature freshness spectrum shape the feature-store choice?
why: 按新鲜度分层存储:本会话/即时信号需近实时更新,放内存型存储(如 Redis)秒级可读;人气统计变化慢,可由离线管线每几小时批量更新。用一套统一存储硬扛两端,要么太贵要么不够新鲜。
why_en: Tier storage by freshness: current-session/immediate signals need near-real-time updates in an in-memory store (Redis) readable in seconds, while slow popularity stats can batch-update every few hours from offline pipelines — one uniform store for both is either too costly or too stale.
tradeoff: 内存近实时(会话信号、快但贵) vs 批量每几小时(人气统计、省但滞后)
options: 所有特征都塞进同一张每天批量刷新一次的离线表,不区分会话即时信号和慢变的人气统计
按新鲜度分层:会话即时信号用内存(Redis)近实时,人气统计用离线管线每几小时批量
所有特征无论新鲜度如何都放进内存做毫秒级更新,人气统计这类慢变数据也跟着烧机器成本
全部特征只在模型训练时计算一次,serving 阶段长期复用陈旧特征快照不再更新
options_en: Put all features into one offline table batch-refreshed once a day, without distinguishing session-immediate signals from slow-changing popularity stats.
Tier by freshness: session/immediate signals in memory (Redis) near-real-time, popularity stats batch-updated every few hours from offline pipelines.
Put every feature in memory with millisecond-level updates regardless of freshness need, burning machine cost even on slow-changing popularity data.
Compute all features only once at training time and keep reusing that stale snapshot at serving without ever refreshing it.
whenOtherWins: 若某个人气类特征其实需要秒级新鲜(如实时热榜),就把它也提升到内存近实时层,新鲜度需求而非默认分层决定归属。
whenOtherWins_en: If a popularity feature actually needs second-level freshness (a live trending chart), promote it to the in-memory near-real-time tier — the freshness need, not the default tier, decides.
optionExplanations: 统一每天批量刷新会让会话即时信号严重过期,推荐跟不上当下意图。
对;按新鲜度分层把即时信号放内存、人气放批量,兼顾新鲜与成本。
全部内存毫秒更新对慢变人气是浪费,成本失控且无必要。
serving 阶段不再更新等于永远用训练时的陈旧快照,即时意图完全捕捉不到。
optionExplanations_en: One daily batch refresh leaves session-immediate signals badly stale, so recs cannot track current intent.
Correct — tiering by freshness puts immediate signals in memory and popularity in batch, balancing freshness and cost.
All-in-memory millisecond updates waste resources on slow popularity, blowing cost with no need.
Never refreshing at serving means permanently reusing the training-time snapshot, missing immediate intent entirely.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不同特征对更新时效的要求不同,从秒级(会话)到几小时(人气),决定存储分层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The freshness spectrum is how different features need different update timeliness, from seconds (session) to hours (popularity), driving storage tiering.

termDefinitions.meaning: 内存键值存储,读延迟约毫秒级,用于近实时的会话/即时特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory key-value store with millisecond read latency, used for near-real-time session/immediate features.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 一个刚上传 5 分钟的新视频:0 观看时长、0 重看、0 分享,没有任何用户互动历史。
scenario_en: A brand-new video uploaded 5 minutes ago: zero watch time, zero replays, zero shares, no interaction history.
q: 新视频为什么会陷入冷启动的「先有鸡还是先有蛋」死锁？
q_en: Why does a new video hit the cold-start chicken-and-egg deadlock?
why: 协同过滤靠「看过 X 的人也看 Y」的互动共现,新视频零互动就没有共现数据→无法被 CF 推荐→没曝光→更收不到互动,形成先有鸡先有蛋的死锁。必须用不依赖互动历史的信号(内容嵌入)破局。
why_en: Collaborative filtering relies on interaction co-occurrence (people who watched X also watched Y), but a zero-interaction new video has no co-occurrence, so CF cannot recommend it, it gets no exposure, receives no interactions, and deadlocks — broken only by an interaction-free signal like content embeddings.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  N["新视频 0 互动"] --> NC["无共现数据"]
  NC --> NR["CF 无法推荐"]
  NR --> NE["无曝光"]
  NE --> N
options: 因为新视频文件太大,存储不下,系统要先压缩转码、生成多种清晰度版本才能进入候选集,这个过程本身就很慢
CF 靠互动共现,新视频零互动→无共现→CF 推不了→无曝光→更无互动,先有鸡先有蛋死锁
因为新视频还没被转码完成
因为新视频缺少标题,无法索引
options_en: Because the new video file is too large to store, so it must finish compressing, transcoding, and generating multiple resolutions before it can even enter the candidate set.
CF relies on interaction co-occurrence; zero interactions means no co-occurrence, so CF cannot recommend it, no exposure, no interactions — a chicken-and-egg deadlock.
Because the new video is not finished transcoding.
Because the new video lacks a title and cannot be indexed.
optionExplanations: 冷启动是数据(零互动)问题,不是文件大小或存储问题。
对;零互动→无共现→CF 无从下手→无曝光→仍无互动,正是冷启动死锁的机制。
转码是工程步骤,与 CF 需要互动共现的死锁无关。
标题缺失可补,冷启动的根本是缺互动共现数据,不是缺标题。
optionExplanations_en: Cold start is a data (zero-interaction) problem, not a file-size or storage issue.
Correct — zero interactions means no co-occurrence, so CF has nothing to work with, no exposure, still no interactions — the cold-start deadlock mechanism.
Transcoding is an engineering step, unrelated to the CF-needs-co-occurrence deadlock.
A missing title can be added; cold start's root is missing interaction co-occurrence, not a missing title.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新视频/新用户零互动历史,协同过滤无从推荐,形成先有鸡先有蛋死锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is a new video/user with no interaction history, so collaborative filtering cannot recommend it, forming a chicken-and-egg deadlock.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 一个上线才 5 分钟、零互动的新视频,你要让它有机会进入某些用户的候选检索集。
scenario_en: A 5-minute-old, zero-engagement new video needs a chance to enter some users' candidate retrieval set.
q: 怎么把这个新视频 bootstrap 进检索集，最合适？
q_en: How do you best bootstrap this new video into the retrieval set?
why: 用内容嵌入:预训练模型从视觉帧/音频/标题描述提出一个语义向量,新烹饪教程即使零互动也会落在已有烹饪视频附近。用它和用户偏好嵌入做 ANN 相似度检索,超过阈值就进候选集,绕开对互动历史的依赖。
why_en: Use a content embedding: a pretrained model turns visual frames/audio/title-description into a semantic vector, so a new cooking tutorial lands near existing cooking videos despite zero interactions, and ANN similarity against user-preference embeddings admits it to the set above a threshold.
tradeoff: 内容嵌入 bootstrap(零互动也可推、但个性化弱) vs 只等 CF(需先攒互动、新视频永远起不来)
options: 等它自然攒够互动再让 CF 推荐,期间完全不给它任何曝光,直到某天它自己突然攒够了足够的互动
用内容嵌入(视觉/音频/文本)把它放到语义相近视频附近,再用 ANN 相似度进候选集
随机把它插进所有用户的候选集
只按上传时间新旧强行置顶
options_en: Wait until it naturally accrues enough interactions for CF, giving it zero exposure the whole time, until it somehow accrues enough interactions entirely on its own.
Use a content embedding (visual/audio/text) to place it near semantically similar videos, then ANN similarity to enter the candidate set.
Randomly insert it into every user's candidate set.
Force it to the top purely by upload recency.
whenOtherWins: 若视频已积累了足够互动,协同过滤嵌入通常比内容嵌入更个性化、更准,这时应逐步转向 CF。
whenOtherWins_en: Once a video has accrued enough interactions, collaborative-filtering embeddings are usually more personalized and accurate, so shift toward CF.
optionExplanations: 干等互动正是死锁本身:不推就永远收不到互动,新视频永远起不来。
对;内容嵌入不依赖互动历史,用语义相似度破解冷启动死锁,是标准解法。
随机插入无关内容会伤体验,也不是基于语义相关的 bootstrap。
只按新旧置顶不考虑相关性,会把不相关新视频塞给所有人。
optionExplanations_en: Waiting for interactions is the deadlock itself: no exposure means no interactions ever, so the video never takes off.
Correct — content embeddings need no interaction history and use semantic similarity to break the cold-start deadlock, the standard fix.
Randomly inserting irrelevant content hurts experience and is not semantically relevant bootstrapping.
Top-pinning by recency ignores relevance and forces irrelevant new videos on everyone.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从视频的视觉/音频/文本内容提取的语义向量,不依赖互动历史,用于冷启动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A content embedding is a semantic vector from a video's visual/audio/text content, independent of interaction history, used for cold start.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 要给新视频生成一个不依赖任何观看历史的语义向量。
scenario_en: You need a semantic vector for a new video that depends on no watch history.
q: 内容嵌入通常从视频的哪些模态、用什么模型生成？
q_en: From which modalities and models is a content embedding typically generated?
why: 多模态提取:视觉 transformer 编码画面帧、音频编码器编码原声、文本编码器编码标题/描述,融合成一个稠密语义向量。它捕捉「视频讲的是什么」,靠内容而非互动定位,让新视频一上线就能落到语义邻域。
why_en: Multimodal extraction: a vision transformer encodes frames, an audio encoder the soundtrack, and a text encoder the title/description, fused into a dense semantic vector capturing what the video is about, positioning it by content rather than interaction.
options: 只从观看时长和分享数生成,属互动信号,新视频零互动时向量全是缺省值,推荐定位不到内容语义
视觉 transformer 编码帧 + 音频编码器编码原声 + 文本编码器编码标题/描述,融合成语义向量
从视频文件的字节流直接哈希生成,哈希值不携带任何语义信息,内容相似的视频在向量空间里彼此靠不拢也分不开
从上传者的粉丝数换算得到向量,这只反映创作者本身的人气高低,完全不刻画这条视频自己的内容
options_en: Only from watch time and share count, an interaction signal that stays at default/empty values for a brand-new video with zero interactions, so recs can't locate its content semantics.
A vision transformer encodes frames + an audio encoder the soundtrack + a text encoder the title/description, fused into a semantic vector.
Directly hashed from the video file's byte stream — such a hash carries no semantic information at all, so content-similar videos land nowhere near each other in the vector space.
Derived from the uploader's follower count — this only reflects the creator's own popularity, not anything about this particular video's content.
optionExplanations: 观看时长/分享是互动信号,新视频恰恰没有,这不是内容嵌入的来源。
对;视觉/音频/文本三模态编码融合,是不依赖互动的内容嵌入标准做法。
字节流哈希不含任何语义信息,内容相似的视频在向量空间里不会靠近,无法用于语义检索。
粉丝数是创作者人气,不刻画这条视频自己的内容语义。
optionExplanations_en: Watch time/shares are interaction signals a new video lacks, not the source of a content embedding.
Correct — fusing vision/audio/text encoders is the standard interaction-free content-embedding approach.
A byte-stream hash carries no semantic information, so content-similar videos would not be nearby and it cannot serve semantic retrieval.
Follower count is creator popularity, not this video's own content semantics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把图像帧切块后用自注意力编码成向量的模型,用于提取视频画面语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A vision transformer splits image frames into patches and encodes them with self-attention into vectors, extracting visual semantics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时利用视觉、音频、文本多种模态生成统一的内容表征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multimodal means combining vision, audio, and text modalities into one unified content representation.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 新视频靠内容嵌入进了候选集,但内容嵌入比协同过滤嵌入个性化更弱;随着它慢慢积累观看/分享,你想让推荐越来越个性化。
scenario_en: A new video entered via content embeddings, but those are less personalized than CF embeddings; as it accrues watches/shares you want recs to grow more personalized.
q: 该怎么随互动积累调整内容 vs 协同信号的权重？
q_en: How should you shift weight between content and collaborative signals as interactions accrue?
why: 做嵌入 warm-up:互动少时以内容嵌入为主(能推但个性化弱),随互动累积逐步把权重从内容转向协同过滤嵌入(更个性化)。混合比例可设成总曝光次数的函数——低于阈值内容主导,越过阈值协同接管。
why_en: Do embedding warm-up: with few interactions lean on content embeddings (recommendable but weakly personalized), then gradually shift weight from content to collaborative embeddings (more personalized) as interactions accrue, with the blend ratio a function of total impression count.
tradeoff: 内容嵌入(冷启段可推、个性化弱) vs 协同嵌入(需互动、个性化强);按曝光量渐变混合
options: 永远只用内容嵌入,即使积累了大量互动,也完全不给协同过滤嵌入任何权重,个性化永远停在弱状态
嵌入 warm-up:少互动时内容主导,随互动积累按曝光量渐变把权重转向协同过滤嵌入
一有第一条互动就立刻 100% 切到协同过滤
两种嵌入永远各占 50%,不随互动变化
options_en: Use only content embeddings forever, even after many interactions accrue, giving zero weight to the collaborative signal so personalization stays weak forever.
Embedding warm-up: content dominates with few interactions, then shift weight toward CF embeddings by impression count as interactions accrue.
Switch 100% to collaborative filtering the instant the first interaction arrives.
Keep the two embeddings at a fixed 50/50 regardless of interactions.
whenOtherWins: 若视频始终没什么互动(长尾冷门),内容嵌入应长期主导,因为协同信号一直不足以支撑个性化。
whenOtherWins_en: If a video never accrues much interaction (long-tail obscure), content embeddings should keep dominating, since collaborative signal stays too sparse to personalize.
optionExplanations: 积累了互动还只用内容嵌入,白白浪费更个性化的协同信号,推荐停在弱个性化。
对;按曝光量从内容渐变到协同,是嵌入 warm-up 的标准做法,平滑接管。
第一条互动就全切协同,信号太少会极不稳定、噪声大。
固定 50/50 忽略互动多少,冷启段和成熟段都不最优。
optionExplanations_en: Sticking to content embeddings after interactions accrue wastes the more personalized collaborative signal, leaving recs weakly personalized.
Correct — shifting from content to collaborative by impression count is the standard embedding warm-up, a smooth handover.
Switching fully to collaborative on the first interaction is highly unstable and noisy with too little signal.
A fixed 50/50 ignores interaction volume and is optimal neither in cold start nor at maturity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 随互动积累把推荐权重从内容嵌入逐步转向协同过滤嵌入的渐变策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding warm-up gradually shifts recommendation weight from content to collaborative-filtering embeddings as interactions accrue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 视频被展示给用户一次;累计曝光量常作混合比例的自变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An impression is one showing of a video to a user; cumulative impression count often drives the blend ratio.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 把整个目录嵌入:每个向量 256 维、每维 4 字节 float,目录约 10 亿视频。
scenario_en: Embedding the whole catalog: each vector is 256-dim, 4 bytes per float, catalog about 1 billion videos.
q: 这个规模的原始嵌入占用多大存储空间，这对系统设计意味着什么？
q_en: How much storage space do these raw embeddings occupy, and what does that imply for system design?
why: 算法:256 维 × 4 字节 = 1KB/向量,× 10 亿视频 ≈ 1TB。单机内存装不下,ANN 索引必须分片+副本,检索层要跨数十台机器,并考虑 PQ 压缩降内存。
why_en: Compute: 256 dims x 4 bytes = 1KB per vector, times 1 billion videos is about 1TB, which no single machine can hold, so the ANN index must be sharded plus replicated across dozens of machines, motivating PQ compression.
options: 约 1GB,单机内存轻松装下,完全不需要考虑分片或副本
约 1TB(256×4B×10 亿):单机内存装不下,ANN 索引必须分片+副本,并考虑压缩降内存
约 1PB,只能存磁盘、无法做内存检索,读取延迟会从毫秒级暴涨到秒级甚至分钟级,检索系统完全不可用
约 1MB,可忽略不计,不用做任何存储规划
options_en: About 1GB, easily fits one machine's memory with no need to consider sharding or replication.
About 1TB (256x4B x 1B): one machine cannot hold it, so the ANN index must be sharded + replicated and consider compression.
About 1PB, storable only on disk with no in-memory retrieval, so read latency jumps from milliseconds to seconds or minutes and the retrieval system becomes unusable.
About 1MB, negligible, requiring no storage planning at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 向量的维数,视频推荐常用 128-256 维;维度×字节×数量 = 存储量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding dimension is the vector's length, commonly 128-256 for video recsys; dims x bytes x count gives storage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 乘积量化:把向量切段并各自量化压缩,大幅降低内存,牺牲少量精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PQ (Product Quantization) splits a vector into segments and quantizes each to shrink memory greatly at slight accuracy cost.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 要给整个 10 亿视频目录批量算内容嵌入,这个作业会跑很久、还可能中途失败。
scenario_en: You batch-compute content embeddings for the whole 1-billion-video catalog, a long job that may fail midway.
q: 这个 catalog 嵌入管线该怎么设计？
q_en: How should the catalog-embedding pipeline be designed?
why: 用分布式 GPU 集群批量跑内容模型(或训练好的双塔编码器),并配编排来处理失败/重试(否则跑一半挂了要从头)。产出的向量装入 HNSW/IVF 等 ANN 索引,分片+副本存储。这是离线重活,不在 serving 关键路径上。
why_en: Run the content model (or a trained two-tower encoder) in batch on a distributed GPU cluster with orchestration for failures/retries (or a mid-run crash restarts from scratch), then load the vectors into HNSW/IVF ANN indexes, sharded and replicated — an offline heavy job off the serving critical path.
tradeoff: 离线分布式批量+编排重试(可扩展、抗失败) vs 单机一次性跑(慢、一挂全废)
options: 在 serving 请求时对每个视频实时算嵌入,把大模型推理塞进读路径的延迟预算里
分布式 GPU 集群批量跑内容模型,配失败重试编排,产出向量装入分片+副本的 ANN 索引
用单台服务器的 CPU 顺序逐个跑完 10 亿视频,吞吐远跟不上目录更新速度,中途崩溃还要从头重来
让用户设备各自为自己看到的视频算嵌入,算力和显存都不够跑大模型,向量也没法汇总进统一索引
options_en: Compute each video's embedding in real time at serving request, stuffing a large model's inference into the read-path latency budget.
Batch-run the content model on a distributed GPU cluster with failure-retry orchestration, loading vectors into a sharded + replicated ANN index.
Run all 1 billion videos sequentially on a single server's CPU — throughput falls far behind the catalog's update rate, and a mid-run crash means starting over.
Have each user device compute embeddings for the videos it sees — devices lack the compute and memory to run a large model, and the vectors couldn't be pooled into one shared index anyway.
whenOtherWins: 若只是少量新上传视频要嵌入(增量),可用一个轻量近实时管线单独处理,不必每次都全量批跑。
whenOtherWins_en: For just a few newly uploaded videos (incremental), a lightweight near-real-time pipeline can handle them, without a full batch run each time.
optionExplanations: serving 时实时算 10 亿级嵌入会击穿延迟预算,嵌入本就该离线预计算。
对;分布式 GPU 批量+编排重试是全目录嵌入的标准工程,抗失败可扩展。
单机 CPU 顺序跑 10 亿视频吞吐太低、追不上更新速度,且一挂全废,不可行。
用户设备既没算力也没显存跑大模型,产出的向量也无法汇总共享同一个索引。
optionExplanations_en: Computing billion-scale embeddings at serving blows the latency budget; embeddings should be precomputed offline.
Correct — distributed GPU batch with retry orchestration is the standard engineering for whole-catalog embedding, failure-resistant and scalable.
A single-server CPU over 1 billion videos has far too little throughput to keep up, and loses everything on a mid-run crash — infeasible.
User devices have neither the compute nor the memory to run a large model, and the resulting vectors couldn't be pooled into one shared index.

termDefinitions.meaning: 调度分布式作业、处理失败与重试、跟踪进度的控制层,保证长作业能跑完。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Orchestration is the control layer scheduling distributed jobs, handling failures and retries, and tracking progress so long jobs finish.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 要把 10 亿视频向量装进 ANN 索引做毫秒级检索,在 HNSW 和 IVF+PQ 之间选。
scenario_en: Loading 1 billion video vectors into an ANN index for millisecond retrieval, choosing between HNSW and IVF+PQ.
q: HNSW 和 IVF+PQ 在内存与召回上的核心取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the core memory-vs-recall tradeoff between HNSW and IVF+PQ?
why: HNSW 是多层近邻图,召回强,但要在内存里存全精度向量、内存开销大;IVF+PQ 用 Voronoi 分桶+乘积量化压缩向量,内存大幅下降,代价是可调的召回损失。海量+内存紧就偏 IVF+PQ,召回优先就偏 HNSW。
why_en: HNSW is a multi-layer proximity graph with strong recall but stores full-precision vectors in memory (heavy), while IVF+PQ uses Voronoi bucketing plus product quantization to shrink memory dramatically at a tunable recall loss — favor IVF+PQ when memory-bound, HNSW when recall-first.
tradeoff: HNSW(召回强但内存大,存全精度) vs IVF+PQ(内存省但召回可调损失)
options: 两者内存和召回完全一样,只是名字不同,选哪个纯粹是团队习惯问题,和数据规模、召回要求都没关系
HNSW 召回强但内存大(存全精度);IVF+PQ 用分桶+量化大幅省内存,代价是可调召回损失
IVF+PQ 内存更大、召回也更高,全面优于 HNSW
HNSW 不占内存,IVF+PQ 只能存磁盘
options_en: Both have identical memory and recall, just different names — picking one is purely a matter of team habit, unrelated to data scale or recall requirements.
HNSW has strong recall but heavy memory (full-precision); IVF+PQ uses bucketing + quantization to save memory at a tunable recall loss.
IVF+PQ uses more memory and higher recall, strictly better than HNSW.
HNSW uses no memory and IVF+PQ can only be disk-stored.
optionExplanations: 两者取舍不同:HNSW 吃内存换召回,IVF+PQ 压内存牺牲一点召回,不是一样。
对;全精度内存 vs 压缩省内存+可调召回损失,正是二者的核心取舍。
IVF+PQ 是压缩省内存的,不是更大内存更高召回,描述反了。
HNSW 恰恰内存开销大;IVF+PQ 也常驻内存检索,不是只能磁盘。
optionExplanations_en: Their tradeoffs differ: HNSW spends memory for recall, IVF+PQ compresses memory sacrificing some recall — not the same.
Correct — full-precision memory vs compressed memory with tunable recall loss is exactly the core tradeoff.
IVF+PQ compresses to save memory, not more memory and higher recall — reversed.
HNSW is memory-heavy, and IVF+PQ also retrieves in memory, not disk-only.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多层可导航近邻图 ANN 索引,召回强但内存里存全精度向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a multi-layer proximity-graph ANN index with strong recall but full-precision in-memory vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 倒排文件索引:先把向量分到 Voronoi 桶,查询只搜相近桶,常配 PQ 压缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF (Inverted File index) buckets vectors into Voronoi cells and searches only nearby cells, often paired with PQ compression.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 你重新训练了内容/双塔嵌入模型,准备上线新版嵌入。
scenario_en: You retrained the content/two-tower embedding model and are about to ship new embeddings.
q: 重训嵌入模型为什么会引出「整索引重建」这个 Staff+ 难题？
q_en: Why does retraining the embedding model raise the Staff+ whole-index-rebuild problem?
why: 嵌入模型一变,所有向量的坐标系都变了→每个视频的嵌入都得重算→整个 ANN 索引必须重建并原子切换。天真做法会出现「新旧嵌入混用/陈旧嵌入」的窗口:查询向量是新模型的、索引里还是旧向量,相似度就失真。
why_en: Change the embedding model and the whole vector space changes, so every video's embedding must be recomputed and the entire ANN index rebuilt and swapped atomically; a naive swap creates a mixed/stale-embedding window where the query is new-model but the index is old vectors, distorting similarity.
options: 只需更新变动过的少数视频嵌入,其余不受影响
模型变→向量坐标系全变→每个嵌入都要重算→整索引重建+原子切换;天真做法有新旧混用/陈旧窗口
重训模型不影响已有嵌入,索引无需动,新模型和旧索引可以一直混用下去,查询结果也不会受影响
只要把学习率调小,嵌入就不会变
options_en: Only the few changed videos' embeddings need updating; the rest are unaffected.
A model change shifts the whole vector space, so every embedding is recomputed, the whole index rebuilt and atomically swapped; a naive swap has a mixed/stale window.
Retraining does not affect existing embeddings, so the index needs no change, and the old index can keep mixing with the new model forever with no impact on query results.
Just lower the learning rate and embeddings won't change.
optionExplanations: 模型变会改变所有向量的坐标系,不是只影响少数视频,全都得重算。
对;新模型让整个嵌入空间改变,必须整索引重建并原子切换,否则出现失真窗口。
重训恰恰改变所有嵌入,索引不动会让新查询对旧向量,相似度失真。
调学习率改变的是训练动态,只要模型更新了嵌入就会变,不能靠它避免。
optionExplanations_en: A model change shifts every vector's coordinate system, not just a few videos — all must be recomputed.
Correct — a new model changes the whole embedding space, requiring a full rebuild and atomic swap or a distorting window appears.
Retraining precisely changes all embeddings; leaving the index untouched makes new queries hit old vectors, distorting similarity.
Learning rate changes training dynamics; once the model updates, embeddings change, so it cannot avoid this.

termDefinitions.meaning: 嵌入模型更新后重算全部向量并重建 ANN 索引,需原子切换避免新旧混用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An index rebuild recomputes all vectors after an embedding-model update and rebuilds the ANN index, swapped atomically to avoid mixing versions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次性把流量从旧索引切到新索引,不出现半新半旧的中间态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic swap flips traffic from the old index to the new one at once, with no half-new-half-old intermediate state.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 整个 ANN 索引要换新版嵌入,但换的过程中不能让线上检索出现失真或宕机。
scenario_en: The whole ANN index must switch to new embeddings, but online retrieval must not distort or go down during the switch.
q: 怎么安全地完成整索引切换？
q_en: How do you safely complete the whole-index switch?
why: 用蓝绿部署:在旁边并行构建新索引(green),先验证 recall@K 与延迟 SLA 达标,再原子切换流量路由;旧索引(blue)保留可即时回滚。这样切换是瞬时且已验证的,避免陈旧嵌入窗口。
why_en: Use blue-green deployment: build the new index (green) in parallel, validate recall@K and latency SLA, then atomically switch the traffic router while keeping the old index (blue) for instant rollback, making the switch instant and validated with no stale-embedding window.
tradeoff: 蓝绿部署(并行构建+验证后原子切,安全但要双份资源) vs 原地更新(省资源但有失真/宕机窗口)
options: 直接在旧索引上原地覆盖写入新向量,边写边对外服务查询,写到一半时同一次查询可能命中新旧混合结果
蓝绿部署:并行构建新索引,验证 recall@K/延迟达标后原子切流量,旧索引留作回滚
停机几小时,离线重建后再开服务,billion 级重建可能要停一整天甚至更久
让新旧两套索引长期各服务一半用户,永久并存不做切换,同一用户在不同请求里会撞到不同坐标系的相似度
options_en: Overwrite new vectors in place on the old index while it keeps serving queries — mid-write, the same query could hit a mix of new and old results.
Blue-green deployment: build the new index in parallel, validate recall@K/latency, atomically switch traffic, keep the old index for rollback.
Take hours of downtime, rebuild offline, then reopen — a billion-scale rebuild might take a full day or longer.
Keep old and new indexes each permanently serving half the users with no switch — the same user could hit incomparable similarity scores across different coordinate systems on different requests.
whenOtherWins: 若索引小、重建极快且能容忍短暂窗口,增量插入或原地更新更省资源,不必开双份蓝绿。
whenOtherWins_en: If the index is small, rebuilds fast, and a brief window is tolerable, incremental insertion or in-place update saves resources without doubling for blue-green.
optionExplanations: 原地边写边服务会出现半新半旧的失真窗口,查询相似度不可靠。
对;并行构建+验证达标+原子切+可回滚,是零窗口安全切换的标准做法。
停机几小时违背可用性,billion 级重建可能长达数小时到数天,不可接受。
新旧永久共存会让同一用户命中不同坐标系,相似度不可比,是错的。
optionExplanations_en: In-place overwrite while serving creates a half-new-half-old distortion window with unreliable similarity.
Correct — parallel build, validate, atomic swap, and rollback is the standard zero-window safe switch.
Hours of downtime violates availability, and billion-scale rebuilds can take hours to days — unacceptable.
Permanent coexistence makes one user hit different coordinate systems with incomparable similarity — wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 并行维护旧(blue)新(green)两套,新套验证后原子切流量,旧套留作即时回滚。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blue-green deployment keeps old (blue) and new (green) in parallel, atomically switching traffic after validating green, with blue kept for instant rollback.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 全目录重嵌入需要巨量 GPU,峰值算力吃不消;但高流量视频的新鲜嵌入最要紧。
scenario_en: Re-embedding the whole catalog needs enormous GPU and the peak is unaffordable, but high-traffic videos' fresh embeddings matter most.
q: 怎么在不打满 GPU 峰值的前提下推进重嵌入？
q_en: How do you progress re-embedding without maxing GPU peak?
why: 增量重嵌入:先重算高流量视频(它们影响最大用户量),长尾在更长窗口里慢慢回填。这样把 GPU 需求摊平、削峰,同时最快让最要紧的嵌入更新到位。
why_en: Incremental re-embedding: recompute high-traffic videos first (they affect the most users) and backfill the long tail over a longer window, flattening peak GPU demand while updating the most important embeddings fastest.
tradeoff: 增量重嵌入(削峰、先高流量) vs 一次性全量重嵌入(峰值 GPU 打满、快但贵)
options: 一次性把全目录 10 亿视频同时重嵌入,GPU 需求瞬间拉满峰值,配额扛不住还可能拖垮其他线上服务
增量重嵌入:先重算高流量视频,长尾在更长窗口回填,削平 GPU 峰值
干脆不重嵌入,一直用旧向量,哪怕新模型效果明显更好也不换
只重嵌入长尾冷门视频,高流量、影响用户最多的头部视频反而保持旧向量不更新,优先级正好搞反
options_en: Re-embed all 1 billion catalog videos at once, spiking GPU demand to its peak instantly — the quota can't absorb it and it risks starving other online services.
Incremental re-embedding: recompute high-traffic videos first, backfill the long tail over a longer window, flattening peak GPU.
Skip re-embedding and keep old vectors forever, even if the new model is clearly much better.
Re-embed only the obscure long-tail videos, leaving the high-traffic, most-impactful videos on old vectors — priorities exactly backwards.
whenOtherWins: 若有充足 GPU 且要求全目录同版本一致(如配合一次原子蓝绿切换),一次性全量重嵌入反而更简单、无版本混杂。
whenOtherWins_en: With ample GPU and a need for whole-catalog version consistency (paired with one atomic blue-green swap), a one-shot full re-embed is simpler with no version mixing.
optionExplanations: 一次性全量会把 GPU 峰值打满,资源吃不消,还可能连累其他线上服务,正是要规避的。
对;先高流量后长尾的增量策略削平峰值,又优先更新影响最大的嵌入。
不重嵌入就享受不到新模型的提升,嵌入越来越陈旧。
只重长尾把最影响用户的高流量视频晾在旧向量上,优先级搞反了。
optionExplanations_en: A one-shot full re-embed maxes peak GPU beyond capacity and risks starving other services — exactly what to avoid.
Correct — high-traffic-first, long-tail-later incremental flattens the peak while prioritizing the most impactful embeddings.
Not re-embedding forgoes the new model's gains and lets embeddings grow stale.
Re-embedding only the long tail leaves the most user-impactful high-traffic videos on old vectors — priorities reversed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按流量优先级分批重算嵌入(先高流量后长尾),削平峰值 GPU 需求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Incremental re-embedding recomputes embeddings in traffic-priority batches (high-traffic first, long tail later) to flatten peak GPU demand.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 重嵌入过渡期里,一部分视频已是新版嵌入、一部分还是旧版,查询要能对上正确的版本。
scenario_en: During the re-embed transition, some videos are on new embeddings and some on old, and queries must match the correct version.
q: 过渡期怎么保证查询用对嵌入版本？
q_en: How do you ensure queries use the right embedding version during transition?
why: 嵌入版本化:同时存多个版本,给每条查询按当前过渡策略路由到对应版本的向量比对,避免拿新模型的查询向量去比旧模型的库向量(坐标系不同、相似度失真)。过渡完成后再收敛到单一版本。
why_en: Embedding versioning: store multiple versions and route each query to the matching version's vectors during transition, avoiding comparing a new-model query vector against old-model index vectors (different spaces, distorted similarity), then converge to one version afterward.
tradeoff: 嵌入版本化(过渡期不失真但要多存/路由) vs 单版本硬切(简单但过渡期易混坐标系)
options: 过渡期随便用哪版都行,反正差不多,新模型的查询向量拿旧索引比一比也没什么大问题
嵌入版本化:存多版本,按过渡策略把查询路由到对应版本的向量比对,避免跨坐标系失真
过渡期直接停服务,等全切完再开
把新旧向量直接平均成一个中间向量
options_en: Any version is fine during transition; they're roughly the same, so comparing a new-model query against the old index is no big deal.
Embedding versioning: store multiple versions and route each query to the matching version's vectors, avoiding cross-space distortion.
Shut down service during transition until fully switched.
Average old and new vectors into one intermediate vector.
whenOtherWins: 若能用蓝绿一次性原子切换、过渡窗口趋近于零,就无需长期维护多版本路由的复杂度。
whenOtherWins_en: If a blue-green atomic swap makes the transition window near-zero, you avoid the complexity of maintaining multi-version routing.
optionExplanations: 新旧版本坐标系不同,混用会让相似度失真,不是差不多。
对;版本化+按版本路由保证查询与库向量同坐标系,过渡期不失真。
停服务违背可用性,billion 级过渡可能很长,不可接受。
平均新旧向量得到的是无意义的混合坐标,相似度更乱,是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Old and new versions live in different spaces, so mixing distorts similarity — not roughly the same.
Correct — versioning plus version-aware routing keeps query and index vectors in the same space, undistorted during transition.
Shutting down violates availability, and a billion-scale transition can be long — unacceptable.
Averaging old and new gives a meaningless mixed space with worse similarity — wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时保存多个嵌入模型版本的向量,过渡期按版本路由查询,避免跨坐标系比对。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding versioning stores vectors from multiple embedding-model versions and routes queries by version during transition to avoid cross-space comparison.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 在 billion 级目录上做一次完整索引重建,大约要跑数小时到数天。
scenario_en: A full index rebuild on a billion-scale catalog takes roughly hours to days.
q: 「重建要数小时到数天」这个事实直接约束了什么设计决策？
q_en: What design decision does 'rebuild takes hours to days' directly constrain?
why: 它直接约束嵌入模型的更新频率:重建这么慢,你就不可能每小时换一版嵌入模型,更新节奏被重建耗时框死。所以要么接受较低的模型迭代频率,要么上增量重嵌入/蓝绿等手段来摊平这个成本。
why_en: It directly constrains how often you can update the embedding model: with rebuilds this slow you cannot swap the model hourly, so cadence is bounded by rebuild time — accept a lower iteration frequency or use incremental re-embedding/blue-green to amortize it.
options: 约束了视频的清晰度设置,重建慢就该把上传视频统一转码成更低分辨率来节省存储空间
约束嵌入模型的更新频率:重建太慢→不能高频换模型;需增量/蓝绿摊平成本
约束了用户界面的刷新率和动画帧率,和后端索引重建速度完全无关
约束了数据库主键该用自增整数还是 UUID,这是建表时就定好的
options_en: Constrains the video resolution setting — if rebuilds are slow, just transcode every upload to a lower resolution to save storage.
Constrains embedding-model update frequency: slow rebuilds mean you cannot swap the model often; use incremental/blue-green to amortize.
Constrains the UI refresh rate and animation frame rate, entirely unrelated to backend index rebuild speed.
Constrains whether the database primary key is an auto-increment integer or a UUID, a schema choice fixed at table-creation time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 整索引重建耗时(数小时到数天)决定嵌入模型能多频繁更新的上限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rebuild cadence — hours to days for a full rebuild — caps how frequently the embedding model can be updated.

termDefinitions.meaning: 128 位的全局唯一标识符,常用作数据库主键的一种选择,与自增整数是两种不同的主键设计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) is a 128-bit globally unique ID, one common choice for a database primary key as an alternative to an auto-increment integer.

optionExplanations: 视频清晰度是编码/转码环节决定的,和索引重建要跑多久没有关系。
对;重建这么慢,模型换版的节奏就被它框住了,只能接受更低迭代频率或用增量/蓝绿摊平。
UI 刷新率是前端渲染节奏,跟后端索引重建耗时是两回事。
主键类型是建表时定好的结构决策,不会被索引重建速度左右。
optionExplanations_en: Video resolution is set at encoding/transcoding time and has nothing to do with how long an index rebuild takes.
Correct — such slow rebuilds mean a new embedding version can't ship often, so teams lean on staged re-embedding or a blue-green swap to spread out the cost.
UI refresh rate is a frontend rendering cadence, unrelated to backend index rebuild time.
Primary-key type is decided at table design time and stays fixed no matter how long a catalog-wide index refresh takes.
category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

q: 把新视频从上传到进入检索、再逐步个性化的流程排好:
q_en: Order the flow of a new video from upload to retrieval to gradual personalization:
steps: 对新视频跑内容模型(视觉/音频/文本)生成内容嵌入
用内容嵌入与用户偏好嵌入做 ANN 相似度,超阈值进候选集
视频获得真实观看/分享,积累互动信号
按曝光量做 embedding warm-up,权重从内容渐移到协同过滤
why: 冷启动闭环:先用内容模型给零互动新视频造语义嵌入→ANN 相似度把它 bootstrap 进候选集→拿到曝光后积累真实互动→再按曝光量 warm-up 把权重从内容转向更个性化的协同过滤嵌入。每一步解锁下一步。
why_en: Cold-start loop: content model makes a semantic embedding for the zero-interaction video, ANN similarity bootstraps it into the set, exposure accrues real interactions, then impression-count warm-up shifts weight from content to more personalized collaborative embeddings.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  E["生成内容嵌入"] --> A["ANN 相似度进候选集"]
  A --> I["积累真实互动"]
  I --> W["warm-up 内容→协同"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 用不依赖互动的信号(内容嵌入)让新物品先获得曝光,从而开始积累互动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bootstrap uses interaction-free signals (content embeddings) to get a new item initial exposure so it can start accruing interactions.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 同一个视频既能算内容嵌入(从画面/音频/文本),也能在积累互动后算协同过滤嵌入(从共现行为)。
scenario_en: The same video can have a content embedding (from frames/audio/text) and, once interactions accrue, a collaborative-filtering embedding (from co-occurrence behavior).
q: 内容嵌入和协同过滤嵌入的关键差别，决定了它们各自的用武之地？
q_en: What key difference between content and collaborative embeddings decides where each shines?
why: 内容嵌入来自视频本身内容、零互动就能算,但个性化弱(只知道内容像不像);协同过滤嵌入来自用户互动共现、更个性化(知道什么样的人爱看),但需要足够互动才准。所以冷启用内容、成熟后转协同。
why_en: Content embeddings come from the video's own content and exist at zero interactions but are weakly personalized (only content similarity), while CF embeddings come from interaction co-occurrence and are more personalized (who likes it) but need enough interactions — so cold start uses content, maturity uses CF.
tradeoff: 内容嵌入(零互动可用、个性化弱) vs 协同过滤嵌入(需互动、个性化强)
options: 内容嵌入需要大量互动,协同过滤嵌入零互动就能算
两者完全一样,可任意替换,不管视频是不是新上传的、有没有互动历史,用哪个嵌入效果都完全一样
内容嵌入零互动可用但个性化弱;协同过滤嵌入需互动但更个性化,故冷启用内容、成熟转协同
协同过滤嵌入只从视频画面生成,与用户行为无关
options_en: Content embeddings need lots of interactions; CF embeddings exist at zero interactions.
They are identical and interchangeable, regardless of whether the video is brand-new or has years of interaction history — either embedding performs exactly the same.
Content embeddings exist at zero interactions but are weakly personalized; CF embeddings need interactions but are more personalized, so cold start uses content and maturity uses CF.
CF embeddings come only from video frames, unrelated to user behavior.
optionExplanations: 说反了:内容嵌入零互动可算,协同过滤才需要互动共现。
两者来源和个性化强弱都不同,不能任意替换。
对;是否需要互动+个性化强弱,正好决定冷启用内容、成熟转协同的分工。
协同过滤嵌入正是从用户互动共现学来的,不是从画面生成。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: content embeddings exist at zero interactions while CF needs interaction co-occurrence.
They differ in source and personalization strength and are not interchangeable.
Correct — interaction need plus personalization strength decides the cold-start-content, maturity-CF division of labor.
CF embeddings are learned from user interaction co-occurrence, not from frames.

termDefinitions.term: collaborative-filtering embedding / 协同过滤嵌入
termDefinitions.meaning: 从用户互动共现学到的物品向量,更个性化,但需足够互动才可靠。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A collaborative-filtering embedding is an item vector learned from user interaction co-occurrence, more personalized but reliable only with enough interactions.

category: Video Recommendation Data Strategy Feature Engineering

scenario: 设计 YouTube 类推荐的第一道漏斗：要从 >10 亿视频里，在 <10ms 内挑出几百个候选交给排序。
scenario_en: The first funnel of a YouTube-like recommender: pick a few hundred candidates from >1B videos in <10ms for ranking.
q: 候选检索阶段的职责和硬约束是什么？
q_en: What is the candidate-retrieval stage's job and hard constraint?
why: 候选检索是最宽的第一道漏斗：把 >10 亿视频在 <10ms 内收窄到几百个候选。主流做法是双塔（two-tower）解耦编码，因为把用户和视频分开编码，才能靠预计算+ANN 在这个延迟内检索十亿级目录。
why_en: Candidate retrieval is the widest first funnel — narrow >1B videos to a few hundred in <10ms — and the standard is a two-tower decoupled encoder, since separating user and video encoding enables precompute-plus-ANN retrieval within that budget.
diagram:
flowchart LR C[">10 亿视频"] --> R["候选检索
双塔+ANN, <10ms"] R --> H["几百候选"] H --> RK["排序阶段"]
options: 逐个给全部十亿视频跑重排序模型精打分，约束是让最终排序准确率最高
把 >10 亿收窄到几百候选、<10ms 完成，靠双塔+ANN
渲染前端推荐列表，约束是首屏配色与排版好看
存储视频元数据与封面，约束是磁盘容量足够大
options_en: Run a heavy ranking model to fine-score all billion videos one by one; the constraint is maximizing final ranking accuracy.
Narrow >1B to a few hundred candidates in <10ms, via two-tower plus ANN.
Render the frontend recommendation list; the constraint is nice colors and layout.
Store video metadata and thumbnails; the constraint is enough disk capacity.
optionExplanations: 逐个精打分是排序阶段的活，十亿量级在 <10ms 内根本打不完。
对；宽漏斗要的是快速收窄，双塔+ANN 是在延迟预算内检索十亿目录的标准解。
前端渲染与检索职责无关，答不到这一阶段的目标。
存储是基建，不回答候选检索「快速收窄」的核心职责。
optionExplanations_en: Per-item fine scoring is the ranking stage's job; billions can't be scored within <10ms.
Correct — the wide funnel needs fast narrowing, and two-tower plus ANN is the standard way to retrieve a billion-scale catalog in budget.
Frontend rendering is unrelated to retrieval's job.
Storage is infrastructure, not the fast-narrowing job of candidate retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两阶段推荐的第一/最宽漏斗，从海量目录快速收窄到几百候选交给排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Candidate retrieval is the first, widest funnel of a two-stage recommender, quickly narrowing a huge catalog to a few hundred candidates for ranking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：牺牲少许精度换取在海量向量里毫秒级找到相近项。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) search trades a little exactness for millisecond retrieval of nearby items among massive vectors.

scenario: 面试官让你讲双塔（dual encoder）到底长什么样、相关性怎么算。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what the two-tower (dual encoder) actually looks like and how relevance is computed.
q: 双塔模型的结构和打分方式是什么？
q_en: What is the two-tower model's structure and scoring?
why: 双塔把打分拆成两条独立编码路径：user tower 和 video tower，各自输出一个固定 128–256 维、落在同一共享空间的 embedding；相关性 ≈ 两个向量的点积。两塔训练后相互独立，这正是能预计算视频侧的前提。
why_en: Two-tower splits scoring into two independent encoders (user tower, video tower), each emitting a fixed 128-256-dim embedding in a shared space, with relevance approximated by their dot product.
diagram:
flowchart TB
  U["用户特征"] --> UT["user tower"] --> UE["用户 embedding"]
  V["视频特征"] --> VT["video tower"] --> VE["视频 embedding"]
  UE --> D["点积 = 相关性"]
  VE --> D
options: 单塔把用户和视频特征拼在一起编码，端到端直接输出一个点击概率分数
两条独立编码路径各出一个共享空间 embedding，相关性≈点积
两塔共享同一份权重，必须实时一起前向才能算出分数
只有视频塔，用户信息不参与编码，靠热度排序兜底
options_en: A single tower concatenates user and video features and outputs one click-probability score end to end.
Two independent encoders each emit a shared-space embedding, and relevance is their dot product.
The towers share one set of weights and must run forward together in real time to score.
There is only a video tower; user info isn't encoded, and popularity ordering fills in.
optionExplanations: 拼一起编码就无法分开预计算，失去双塔的核心优势。
对；两塔独立出同空间向量、点积算相关，独立性正是能离线预计算视频侧的关键。
双塔的意义就是训练后独立、可分开算，不需要实时一起前向。
用户塔不可或缺，缺了它就没法做个性化检索。
optionExplanations_en: Encoding them together prevents separate precompute, losing two-tower's core advantage.
Correct — two independent encoders emit same-space vectors and dot-product relevance, and that independence is what enables offline precompute of the video side.
The whole point is post-training independence and separate scoring, not a joint real-time forward.
The user tower is essential; without it there's no personalized retrieval.

termDefinitions.term: two-tower model / 双塔模型 (dual encoder)
termDefinitions.meaning: 用两条独立编码路径分别把用户和物品映射到同一向量空间，用点积/相似度打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-tower model (dual encoder) maps user and item through two independent encoders into one vector space, scoring by dot product/similarity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户或视频压成的定长稠密向量，落在共享空间里可比较相似度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a fixed-length dense vector representing a user or video in a shared space for similarity comparison.

scenario: 十亿级目录、每次请求要 <10ms 出候选。你要解释双塔到底靠什么在这个预算内检索。
scenario_en: A billion-scale catalog with a <10ms per-request budget — explain what actually makes two-tower retrieval fit.
q: 双塔在服务时的关键「不对称」是什么，为什么它是延迟优势的根源？
q_en: What is two-tower's key serving asymmetry, and why is it the latency advantage?
why: 关键不对称：两塔训练后独立，所以整个目录的视频 embedding 可离线预计算好存起来，服务时只需为当前请求算一次用户 embedding，再做 ANN 检索。video tower 在服务时永不运行——这正是十亿级亚毫秒检索可行的根源。
why_en: The asymmetry: since towers are independent after training, all video embeddings are precomputed offline, so serving only computes the user embedding per request then runs ANN — the video tower never runs at serving time.
tradeoff: 预计算视频侧（服务时只算用户塔、亚毫秒） vs 实时双塔全算（灵活但扛不住十亿量级）
options: 服务时把用户塔和视频塔都实时各跑一遍前向计算，保证两侧 embedding 每次都刷成最新的
视频 embedding 离线预计算好，服务时只算用户 embedding + ANN
用户和视频 embedding 都离线预计算，服务时不做任何前向计算
服务时只跑视频塔，用户信息在检索阶段完全忽略不用
options_en: At serving, run a live forward pass through both the user and video towers each request so both embeddings stay perfectly fresh.
Video embeddings are precomputed offline; serving only computes the user embedding plus ANN.
Both user and video embeddings are precomputed offline, so serving does no forward pass at all.
At serving, only the video tower runs and user info is ignored during retrieval.
whenOtherWins: 如果视频侧特征高度实时（如刚上传几秒的直播弹幕状态），无法离线预计算，那才需要在服务时对这部分做实时编码，牺牲一点延迟换新鲜度。
whenOtherWins_en: If video-side features are highly real-time (a livestream's second-old state) and can't be precomputed, you must encode that part online, trading latency for freshness.
optionExplanations: 十亿视频实时跑视频塔在 <10ms 内不可能，失去双塔预计算的意义。
对；视频侧离线算好、在线只算用户塔+ANN，这个不对称让亚毫秒检索十亿目录可行。
用户 embedding 依赖当前请求上下文，必须在线算，不能全预计算。
缺了用户 embedding 就无法个性化，检索会退化成非个性化热门。
optionExplanations_en: Running the video tower over billions in <10ms is impossible, defeating precompute.
Correct — precompute the video side, compute only the user tower + ANN online, and that asymmetry makes sub-ms billion-scale retrieval feasible.
The user embedding depends on request context and must be computed online, not fully precomputed.
Without a user embedding there's no personalization; retrieval degrades to non-personalized popularity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练后两塔独立，视频侧可离线预计算，服务时只算用户侧，是双塔延迟优势的根源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Serving asymmetry: towers are independent post-training, so the video side is precomputed offline and only the user side runs at serving — the latency advantage.

scenario: 你要设计 user tower 的输入特征——它负责把「这个用户此刻想看什么」编码成一个向量。
scenario_en: You're designing the user tower's input features — it encodes 'what this user wants now' into a vector.
q: user tower 通常吃哪些输入特征？（多选）
q_en: Which inputs typically feed the user tower? (multiple)
why: 用户塔只吃用户侧信号：历史行为、身份画像、当前上下文，合成「此刻想看什么」。视频侧属性属于另一座塔，混进来会破坏两塔解耦。
why_en: The user tower only ingests user-side signals — past behavior, profile, and current context — fused into 'what this person wants now'; video-side attributes belong to the other tower, and mixing them breaks the decoupling.
options: 观看历史 embedding（mean pooling / 轻 attention 聚合）
人口统计：年龄段、国家、语言
上下文信号：设备、时段、星期几
视频类别、时长桶、创作者 ID
options_en: Watch-history embeddings (mean pooling / light attention).
Demographics: age bucket, country, language.
Context signals: device, time of day, day of week.
Video category, duration bucket, creator ID.
optionExplanations: 对；观看历史是最强的个性化信号，聚合成向量喂用户塔。
对；人口统计给冷启动/粗粒度偏好兜底。
对；上下文让同一用户在不同设备/时段得到不同检索。
错；类别/时长/创作者是视频侧属性，属于 video tower 的输入。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — watch history is the strongest personalization signal, aggregated into the user tower.
Correct — demographics backstop cold-start and coarse preferences.
Correct — context lets the same user get different retrieval by device/time.
Wrong — category/duration/creator are video-side attributes for the video tower.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一串向量按元素取平均聚合成一个向量，这里把观看历史压成单个用户表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Mean pooling averages a sequence of vectors element-wise into one, here compressing watch history into a single user representation.

scenario: 你要设计 video tower 的输入特征——它把每个视频编码成可离线预计算的向量。
scenario_en: You're designing the video tower's inputs — it encodes each video into a precomputable vector.
q: video tower 通常吃哪些输入特征？（多选）
q_en: Which inputs typically feed the video tower? (multiple)
why: video tower 吃：内容 embedding（预训练视觉/多模态提取）、元数据（类别、时长桶、创作者 ID）、热度统计（播放量、点赞率、新鲜度）。观看历史、设备时段是用户侧信号，不进视频塔。
why_en: The video tower takes content embeddings (from pretrained vision/multimodal models), metadata (category, duration bucket, creator ID), and popularity stats (views, like ratio, recency).
options: 内容 embedding：预训练视觉/多模态模型提取
元数据：类别、时长桶、创作者 ID
热度统计：播放量、点赞率、新鲜度
用户的观看历史与当前设备
options_en: Content embeddings from pretrained vision/multimodal models.
Metadata: category, duration bucket, creator ID.
Popularity stats: views, like ratio, recency.
The user's watch history and current device.
optionExplanations: 对；内容 embedding 让新视频没有交互也能被编码，缓解冷启动。
对；元数据是稳定的视频属性，适合离线预计算进向量。
对；热度统计让视频塔带上流行度信号，注意可能引入热度偏置。
错；观看历史和设备是用户侧信号，属于 user tower。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — content embeddings let a new video be encoded without interactions, easing cold start.
Correct — metadata are stable video attributes, good for offline precompute.
Correct — popularity stats give the video tower a popularity signal, though they can introduce popularity bias.
Wrong — watch history and device are user-side signals for the user tower.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用预训练视觉/多模态模型从视频画面音频提取的向量，让新视频无需交互即可表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A content embedding is a vector extracted from a video's pixels/audio by a pretrained vision/multimodal model, representing new videos without interactions.

scenario: 生产里给两塔 embedding 打相似度，你在点积和余弦相似度之间选。
scenario_en: Scoring two-tower embeddings, you choose between dot product and cosine similarity in production.
q: 为什么生产双塔检索里点积常优于余弦相似度？
q_en: Why is dot product often preferred over cosine similarity in production two-tower retrieval?
why: 余弦相似度先归一化、只看方向；点积保留向量模长（magnitude），让模型学到基于模长的相关性——比如把热门/高置信视频的向量拉长，检索时天然占优。所以点积能表达方向之外的强度信息。
why_en: Cosine normalizes and keeps only direction, while dot product retains magnitude, letting the model learn magnitude-based relevance (e.g. longer vectors for high-confidence videos), expressing strength beyond direction.
tradeoff: 点积（保留模长、能学强度相关性） vs 余弦（归一化、只看方向）
options: 点积保留模长，能学基于强度的相关性；余弦只剩方向
余弦相似度在任何场景都更准，点积只是算得快的近似
两者数学上完全等价，训练和检索表现没有任何差别
点积只能用于文本 embedding，视频 embedding 必须用余弦
options_en: Dot product keeps magnitude so the model can learn strength-based relevance; cosine leaves only direction.
Cosine similarity is more accurate in every setting; dot product is just a fast approximation.
The two are mathematically equivalent, with no difference in training or retrieval behavior.
Dot product only works for text embeddings; video embeddings must use cosine.
optionExplanations: 对；模长承载了强度/置信信息，点积保留它，余弦归一化会抹掉。
余弦不总更准：抹掉模长会丢掉模型想利用的强度信号。
归一化与否不等价：余弦丢模长，点积保留，结果不同。
点积/余弦与模态无关，视频同样可用点积。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — magnitude carries strength/confidence, which dot product keeps and cosine normalizes away.
Cosine isn't always better: normalizing away magnitude discards a signal the model may want.
Normalizing is not equivalent: cosine drops magnitude, dot product keeps it.
Dot vs cosine is modality-agnostic; video can use dot product too.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两向量对应元素乘积之和，同时反映方向一致性和模长，不做归一化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The dot product sums element-wise products, reflecting both directional agreement and magnitude without normalization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 归一化后的点积，只衡量两向量夹角（方向），丢弃模长信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cosine similarity is the normalized dot product, measuring only the angle (direction) and discarding magnitude.

scenario: 训练双塔时，你有一批 (用户, 真看过的视频) 正样本对，要让模型学会检索。
scenario_en: Training two-tower with a batch of (user, engaged-video) positive pairs, you want it to learn retrieval.
q: 对比损失（contrastive loss）怎么训练双塔，训练信号质量主要由什么决定？
q_en: How does contrastive loss train two-tower, and what mainly determines signal quality?
why: 对比损失把 (用户, 看过的视频) 正样本的 embedding 拉近，把 (用户, 没看的视频) 负样本推远。训练信号质量几乎完全由负样本决定：负样本太「容易」学不到细粒度边界，好负样本才逼出有区分度的向量。
why_en: Contrastive loss pulls positive (user, engaged-video) embeddings together and pushes negatives apart, and signal quality comes almost entirely from the negatives.
options: 拉近正样本、推远负样本；信号质量几乎完全由负样本决定
只拉近正样本，不需要任何负样本
把所有 embedding 无差别地都推远，越分散越好、不分正负
信号质量只由正样本数量决定，与负样本无关
options_en: Pull positives together, push negatives apart; signal quality comes almost entirely from the negatives.
Only pull positives together, needing no negatives.
Push all embeddings apart indiscriminately, positives and negatives alike; the more spread, the better.
Signal quality depends only on the number of positives, not negatives.
optionExplanations: 对；对比学习的判别力来自「和什么对比」，负样本的难度直接决定学到的边界。
没有负样本，模型可以把所有向量塌到一点也满足「拉近正样本」，会坍缩。
无差别推远会破坏正样本的相近关系，学不到相关性。
正样本给「该近」的信号，但没有负样本就没有「该远」的对比，信号不完整。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — contrastive discriminative power comes from what you contrast against, so negative difficulty sets the learned boundary.
With no negatives the model can collapse all vectors to one point and still 'pull positives together'.
Pushing everything apart breaks positive closeness and learns no relevance.
Positives give the 'should be near' signal, but without negatives there's no 'should be far' contrast.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把正样本对的向量拉近、负样本对推远的损失，训练信号质量取决于负样本难度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contrastive loss pulls positive pairs' vectors together and pushes negatives apart; signal quality depends on negative difficulty.

scenario: 你想在不额外加载数据的情况下，给一个 batch 里的每个正样本对配上负样本。
scenario_en: You want negatives for each positive pair in a batch without loading extra data.
q: in-batch negatives 是怎么零成本造出负样本的？
q_en: How do in-batch negatives create negatives at zero cost?
why: 在一个含 B 个正样本对的 batch 里，某用户的正样本视频，对其他每个用户都算负样本 → 每个用户白得 B−1 个负样本，零额外数据加载成本。代价是它近似均匀采样，多是「容易」负样本。
why_en: In a batch of B positive pairs, one user's positive video serves as a negative for every other user, giving B-1 negatives at zero data-loading cost.
tradeoff: in-batch（零成本 B−1 负样本但偏易） vs 硬负样本（贵但判别力强）
options: 训练时额外从视频库里随机采样 B 个视频，再单独加载进来当负样本
batch 里某用户的正样本对其他用户都是负样本，白得 B−1 个
把正样本向量复制一份加高斯噪声，当作负样本喂进去
让标注员逐条标注哪些视频算这个用户的负样本
options_en: During training, sample B extra random videos from the video DB and load them in separately as negatives.
In a batch, one user's positive is a negative for every other user, giving B-1 free negatives.
Copy the positive vector, add Gaussian noise, and feed that in as a negative.
Have annotators label one by one which videos count as negatives for this user.
whenOtherWins: 当模型已能轻松分开粗类、需要学习「同类里哪个更相关」的细粒度边界时，就该补硬负样本，光靠 in-batch 的易负样本不够。
whenOtherWins_en: Once the model easily separates coarse classes and needs fine-grained 'which within a genre' boundaries, add hard negatives — easy in-batch negatives no longer suffice.
optionExplanations: 额外采样要多加载数据，正是 in-batch 想省掉的成本。
对；复用 batch 内其他正样本当负样本，B−1 个负样本零额外成本，是标准做法。
加噪副本不是真实负样本，学不到有意义的对比。
人工标注负样本昂贵且不可规模化，与「零成本」相悖。
optionExplanations_en: Extra sampling loads more data — exactly the cost in-batch avoids.
Correct — reusing other positives in the batch as negatives gives B-1 free negatives, the standard trick.
Noised copies aren't real negatives and teach no meaningful contrast.
Human-labeled negatives are costly and unscalable, against 'zero cost'.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把同一 batch 里其他用户的正样本视频当作当前用户的负样本，零额外数据成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In-batch negatives treat other users' positive videos in the same batch as negatives for the current user, at zero extra data cost.

scenario: 只用 in-batch negatives 训练，随机 batch 里同一用户对应的负样本大多是完全无关的视频（做饭 vs 游戏）。
scenario_en: Training with only in-batch negatives, a user's negatives are mostly totally unrelated videos (cooking vs gaming).
q: 只用 in-batch negatives 会导致什么问题？
q_en: What problem arises from using only in-batch negatives?
why: in-batch 近似均匀采样，负样本大多是「容易」的（做饭 vs 游戏一眼可分）。模型只学会分开粗类，学不到细粒度区分——两个相似的游戏视频它分不开，检索精度上不去。修法是掺硬负样本。
why_en: In-batch approximates uniform sampling, so negatives are mostly 'easy' (cooking vs gaming), teaching only coarse separation and failing to distinguish two similar gaming videos — fixed by mixing in hard negatives.
options: 负样本太容易，只学会分粗类，分不开两个相似游戏视频
毫无问题，随机负样本已经足够学到全部细粒度区分
会让每步训练变慢，是纯粹的吞吐问题，与检索精度无关
负样本数量太多导致显存爆炸，必须把 batch size 缩小
options_en: Negatives are too easy, so the model only separates coarse classes and can't tell two similar gaming videos apart.
No problem at all — random negatives already teach every fine-grained distinction.
It just slows each training step; it's a pure throughput issue, unrelated to retrieval precision.
Too many negatives blow up GPU memory, so you have to shrink the batch size.
optionExplanations: 对；易负样本让边界只到粗类级，相似项分不开，必须补硬负样本逼出细边界。
随机负样本几乎都是易的，学不到相似项之间的细粒度边界。
这不是速度问题，是学到的判别粒度太粗。
in-batch 恰恰省显存（复用 batch），不是显存爆炸。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — easy negatives leave the boundary at coarse-class level, so similar items don't separate; hard negatives are needed.
Random negatives are almost all easy and teach no fine boundary between similar items.
It's not a speed issue but a too-coarse learned granularity.
In-batch actually saves memory (reuse), not blows it up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 与正样本明显不同、一眼可分的负样本，只能训出粗粒度区分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An easy negative is obviously different from the positive and only trains coarse-grained distinctions.

scenario: 你要让双塔学会区分「同一创作者/同一题材、但用户跳过了」的相似视频。
scenario_en: You want two-tower to distinguish similar videos from the same creator/genre that the user skipped.
q: 该用什么样的负样本，为什么？
q_en: What kind of negatives should you use, and why?
why: 用硬负样本（hard negatives）：语义上相似但用户没交互的视频（同创作者/同题材、被跳过）。它们逼模型在相近区域画细粒度边界，正是易负样本给不了的判别力。代价是难挖、且比例过高会不稳。
why_en: Use hard negatives — semantically similar videos the user did not engage (same creator/genre, skipped) — forcing fine-grained boundaries that easy negatives can't provide.
tradeoff: 硬负样本（细边界、判别力强） vs 易负样本（便宜但只分粗类）
options: 更多完全无关的随机视频，只要数量堆够就能提升判别力
语义相似但用户没交互的视频（同创作者、被跳过）
把正样本本身再用一次当负样本，等于给模型加正则
只用平台上最热门的视频当负样本，覆盖面最大
options_en: More totally unrelated random videos — just pile up enough of them to improve discrimination.
Semantically similar videos the user didn't engage with (same creator, skipped).
Reuse the positives themselves as negatives, which acts as regularization.
Use only the platform's most popular videos as negatives for the widest coverage.
whenOtherWins: 如果模型还处于早期、连粗类都分不清，先用便宜的 in-batch 易负样本打基础更合适，等粗边界稳了再上硬负样本。
whenOtherWins_en: If the model is early and can't even separate coarse classes, cheap in-batch easy negatives fit better first, adding hard negatives once coarse boundaries stabilize.
optionExplanations: 堆无关随机视频还是易负样本，学不到相似项之间的细边界。
对；相似但没交互的视频是真正的近失手负例，逼出细粒度判别力。
把正样本当负样本是自相矛盾的错误监督信号。
只用热门当负样本会引入热度偏置，且不一定语义相似。
optionExplanations_en: Piling unrelated randoms are still easy negatives and teach no fine boundary between similar items.
Correct — similar-but-not-engaged videos are true near-miss negatives that force fine-grained discrimination.
Using positives as negatives is contradictory, wrong supervision.
Only-popular negatives introduce popularity bias and aren't necessarily semantically similar.

termDefinitions.meaning: 语义相似但用户没交互的负样本，逼模型在相近区域学出细粒度边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hard negative is a semantically similar but non-engaged item that forces the model to learn fine-grained boundaries.

scenario: 你要挖硬负样本，有两条来源：ANN 索引里检索出的近失手视频，和展示日志里「展示了但没点」的视频。
scenario_en: Two hard-negative sources: near-misses retrieved from the ANN index, and impression-log 'shown-but-not-clicked' videos.
q: ANN-mined 和 impression-log 两种硬负样本来源，各自特点是什么？
q_en: What characterizes the ANN-mined vs impression-log hard-negative sources?
why: ANN-mined：用用户 embedding 查索引取 top-K 里没交互的近失手，代价是周期性 ANN 查询。impression-log：展示了却没点，是真实的拒绝信号、成本低（日志里现成），但带上一个模型策略造成的选择偏置。
why_en: ANN-mined pulls top-K non-engaged near-misses by querying the index (cost: periodic ANN queries), while impression-log uses shown-but-not-clicked as a real rejection signal at low cost but with selection bias from the prior model's policy.
tradeoff: ANN-mined（近失手、需周期查询） vs impression-log（真实拒绝、便宜但有选择偏置）

rows: 上个模型策略的选择偏置

options: ANN-mined 挖索引 top-K 近失手但要周期查询；impression-log 便宜但有偏置
两者完全一样，只是不同团队对同一种采样法的两种叫法
ANN-mined 靠人工逐条标注近似样本，impression-log 则是纯随机采样出来的负例
两者都零成本、零偏置，任选一种即可，不需要混合使用
options_en: ANN-mined digs top-K near-misses from the index but needs periodic queries; impression-log is cheap but biased.
They are exactly the same thing, just two names different teams use for one sampling method.
ANN-mined relies on humans labeling near-misses one by one, while impression-log is purely random negative sampling.
Both are zero-cost and zero-bias, so pick either one and never bother mixing them.
optionExplanations: 对；一个靠检索近失手（成本在查询），一个靠日志的真实拒绝（成本低但有偏置），各有取舍。
两者信号来源和偏置都不同，不是叫法差异。
ANN-mined 是检索出来的、不是人工标注；impression-log 是真实展示拒绝、不是随机。
impression-log 带上个模型策略的选择偏置，并非零偏置。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — one retrieves near-misses (cost in queries), the other uses logged real rejection (cheap but biased); each trades off.
Their signal source and bias differ; it's not just naming.
ANN-mined is retrieved, not human-labeled; impression-log is real shown-rejection, not random.
Impression-log carries the prior model's selection bias — not zero-bias.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录哪些内容被展示给用户的日志；展示了却没点=真实拒绝信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An impression log records what was shown to users; shown-but-not-clicked is a real rejection signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日志里的负样本受上个推荐模型策略影响，不代表用户对全库的真实偏好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Selection bias means logged negatives are shaped by the prior model's policy, not the user's true preference over the whole catalog.

scenario: 你要给双塔训练配负样本比例，团队问「硬负样本掺多少合适」。
scenario_en: Setting the negatives mix for two-tower training, the team asks how many hard negatives to include.
q: 「~70% in-batch + 30% 硬负样本」这个配比在设计上意味着什么？
q_en: What does the '~70% in-batch + 30% hard negatives' recipe imply for design?
why: 这是经验配比不是公式：多数用便宜的 in-batch 打粗边界底子，掺约 30% 硬负样本逼出细粒度判别。硬负样本比例过高会让训练不稳——梯度尖峰、embedding 坍缩。所以 30% 是「判别力 vs 稳定性」的经验平衡点。
why_en: It's an empirical mix, not a formula: mostly cheap in-batch for coarse boundaries plus ~30% hard negatives for fine discrimination, since too many hard negatives destabilize training (gradient spikes, embedding collapse).
options: 70/30 是必须一字不差精确背诵、套到任何模型规模都不能变的硬性铁律
经验配比：in-batch 打底，硬负样本逼细粒度边界，比例过高会不稳
硬负样本越多越好，训练时应该直接冲到 100%
这个配比只关系到训练速度快慢，是否稳定完全跟它无关
options_en: 70/30 is a hard rule to recite word-for-word, fixed regardless of model scale or data.
Empirical mix: in-batch lays the base, hard negatives sharpen fine-grained boundaries, and too high a ratio destabilizes training.
The more hard negatives the better; training should push straight to 100%.
The mix only affects training speed; stability has nothing to do with it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练不稳时向量塌到很小区域、彼此难区分，检索质量崩溃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding collapse is when unstable training squeezes vectors into a tiny region, making them indistinguishable and wrecking retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 硬负样本比例过高时梯度突然变得极大，破坏训练稳定性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A gradient spike is a sudden very large gradient, here from too high a hard-negative ratio, destabilizing training.

optionExplanations: 把 70/30 当成必须一字不差背下的公式会翻车——它是经验值，换模型规模就该重新调。
对；便宜的 in-batch 先带出粗略分类，硬负样本再补上细粒度的判别力，两头都不偏废。
冲到 100% 硬负样本会丢掉粗边界的训练基础，还容易把梯度冲到不稳定。
配比其实直接决定训练稳不稳——硬负样本比例一高，梯度就容易冲高。
optionExplanations_en: Treating 70/30 as a formula to memorize word-for-word backfires — it's empirical and should be retuned for a different model scale.
Correct — cheap in-batch lays the coarse base first, then hard negatives add the fine-grained discrimination, balancing both.
Pushing to 100% hard negatives loses the coarse-boundary base and risks destabilizing gradients.
The mix directly governs training stability — a higher hard-negative share risks gradient spikes.

scenario: 训练双塔时你想及早发现 embedding 是不是在坍缩，需要一个监控指标。
scenario_en: Training two-tower, you want an early signal that embeddings are collapsing.
q: 监控 embedding 的 alignment + uniformity 有什么用？
q_en: What do monitoring embedding alignment + uniformity tell you?
why: alignment 看正样本对是否靠得够近，uniformity 看整体向量是否均匀铺满空间。uniformity 掉了 = 向量正塌进一小片区域，是 embedding 坍缩的早期信号，提示硬负样本比例太高或训练不稳。
why_en: Alignment checks whether positives sit close and uniformity whether vectors spread evenly across the space, so dropping uniformity is an early sign of embedding collapse.
options: alignment 看正样本够不够近，uniformity 看向量铺不铺得开
两者只衡量训练的收敛快慢，与 embedding 是否发生坍缩没有任何关系
两者衡量的是模型参数量和 embedding 维度是否够大
两者只在模型上线后看线上指标时才有意义，训练期无用
options_en: Alignment checks whether positive pairs sit close; uniformity checks whether vectors spread across the space.
They only measure how fast training converges and have nothing to do with whether embeddings collapse.
They measure whether the model's parameter count and embedding dimension are large enough.
They only matter for online metrics after launch and are useless during training.
optionExplanations: 对；uniformity 下降说明向量在往一小片塌，提前预警坍缩，好及时调负样本比例。
它们是 embedding 分布质量指标，不是速度，正是用来抓坍缩。
与参数量无关，衡量的是向量在空间的分布。
训练中就该监控，坍缩发生在训练阶段，等上线太晚。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — falling uniformity shows vectors collapsing into a small region, an early warning to adjust the negative ratio.
They're embedding-distribution quality metrics, not speed, and exactly catch collapse.
Unrelated to parameter count; they measure vector spread in space.
You monitor them during training, since collapse happens then; after launch is too late.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对比学习指标，衡量正样本对的 embedding 是否足够接近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alignment is a contrastive metric measuring whether positive pairs' embeddings are close enough.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量 embedding 是否均匀分布在向量空间，下降预示坍缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Uniformity measures whether embeddings spread evenly across the space; a drop foreshadows collapse.

scenario: 十亿级向量要建 ANN 索引，你在 HNSW 和 IVF+PQ 之间权衡召回和内存。
scenario_en: Building an ANN index over billions of vectors, you weigh recall vs memory between HNSW and IVF+PQ.
q: HNSW 和 IVF+PQ 在召回和内存上怎么对比？
q_en: How do HNSW and IVF+PQ contrast on recall and memory?
why: HNSW 是多层邻近图，召回强，但要在内存里存全精度向量、内存大。IVF+PQ 用 Voronoi 分桶+向量压缩，内存大幅下降，代价是可调的召回损失。取舍轴是「召回/内存」。
why_en: HNSW is a multi-layer proximity graph with strong recall but stores full-precision vectors in memory, while IVF+PQ uses Voronoi cells plus compression for far less memory at a tunable recall loss.
tradeoff: HNSW（召回强、内存大） vs IVF+PQ（内存小、召回可调地损失）
options: HNSW 图召回强但存全精度向量、内存大；IVF+PQ 压缩省内存、损召回
两者的内存占用和召回率完全一样，选哪个都没有实际区别
HNSW 内存最省几乎不占空间，IVF+PQ 因为要建倒排桶所以内存占用反而最大
IVF+PQ 召回一定高于 HNSW，同时内存占用也一定更大
options_en: HNSW's graph gives strong recall but stores full-precision vectors (big memory); IVF+PQ compresses to save memory at some recall loss.
Their memory footprint and recall are identical, so the choice makes no practical difference.
HNSW uses the least memory and barely any space, while IVF+PQ uses the most because it builds inverted lists.
IVF+PQ always has higher recall than HNSW and always uses more memory too.
optionExplanations: 对；一个用图换召回吃内存，一个用压缩省内存损召回，正是这条取舍轴。
两者在内存/召回上差别明显，不能随意选。
说反了：HNSW 存全精度内存大，IVF+PQ 压缩内存小。
IVF+PQ 用压缩换内存，召回通常略低而非更高。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — one trades memory for recall via a graph, the other compresses to save memory at recall cost.
Their memory/recall differ clearly; you can't pick blindly.
Backwards: HNSW stores full precision (big memory), IVF+PQ compresses (small memory).
IVF+PQ trades compression for memory, usually slightly lower recall, not higher.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多层邻近图 ANN 索引，召回强，但在内存里保存全精度向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a multi-layer proximity-graph ANN index with strong recall that stores full-precision vectors in memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 Voronoi 分桶（IVF）加向量压缩（PQ）的 ANN 索引，内存小、召回可调。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF+PQ (Inverted File + Product Quantization) is an ANN index using Voronoi cells plus vector compression for low memory at tunable recall.

scenario: 向量规模让全精度 HNSW 的内存开销撑爆预算，但你还能接受一点点召回下降。
scenario_en: Vector scale blows the memory budget for full-precision HNSW, but you can tolerate a small recall drop.
q: 这种内存受限的场景该选哪个 ANN 索引？
q_en: For this memory-constrained case, which ANN index fits?
why: 选 IVF+PQ：Voronoi 分桶缩小搜索范围、PQ 压缩把向量从几十字节压到几字节，内存大幅下降，用可调的召回损失换回预算。内存不是瓶颈、只求最高召回时才反过来选 HNSW。
why_en: Choose IVF+PQ: Voronoi cells prune the search and PQ compresses vectors to a few bytes, cutting memory sharply at a tunable recall loss that fits the budget.
tradeoff: IVF+PQ（省内存、损一点召回） vs HNSW（召回最高但吃满内存）
options: 选 HNSW，图索引召回率最高，内存占用再大一点点也完全无所谓
选 IVF+PQ：分桶+压缩把内存压下来，换可调的召回损失
两个都不选，直接暴力扫全部十亿向量保证百分百召回
随便选一个，ANN 索引的内存占用和召回率互不相关
options_en: Choose HNSW — the graph index has the best recall, and an even bigger memory footprint doesn't matter at all.
Choose IVF+PQ: cells plus compression cut memory, trading a tunable recall loss.
Choose neither and brute-force scan all billion vectors to guarantee 100% recall.
Pick either one — an ANN index's memory footprint and recall are unrelated.
whenOtherWins: 如果内存充足、且业务对召回极敏感（哪怕 1% 召回损失都不能接受），就该选 HNSW 全精度，用内存换最高召回。
whenOtherWins_en: If memory is ample and the business is highly recall-sensitive (even 1% loss unacceptable), choose full-precision HNSW, spending memory for top recall.
optionExplanations: HNSW 全精度正是内存瓶颈的来源，撑爆预算的场景不该选它。
对；IVF+PQ 用压缩把内存降下来，可调召回损失匹配「能容忍一点下降」的前提。
十亿量级暴力扫在 <10ms 内不可能，不是选项。
内存与召回强相关，PQ 压得越狠内存越省、召回越损。
optionExplanations_en: HNSW full precision is the memory bottleneck; don't pick it when it blows the budget.
Correct — IVF+PQ compresses to cut memory, and the tunable recall loss matches 'can tolerate a small drop'.
Brute-force over billions can't finish in <10ms — not an option.
Memory and recall are strongly linked; harder PQ saves memory but loses recall.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把向量切成子段、各用码本量化成小码字，大幅压缩存储，代价是精度损失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Product quantization (PQ) splits a vector into sub-segments each quantized to a codebook codeword, sharply compressing storage at a precision cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：牺牲少许精确度，换在海量向量里毫秒级找到相近项。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) search gives up a little exactness to find nearby items among massive vectors in milliseconds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种多层邻近图 ANN 索引，召回高，但要在内存里存全精度向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a multi-layer proximity-graph ANN index with high recall that keeps full-precision vectors in memory.

scenario: 面试官问：ANN 索引在 Staff+ 层面有哪三个互相拉扯的量要一起权衡。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks which three tensioned quantities you balance in an ANN index at Staff+ level.
q: ANN 索引的三方取舍是哪三个量？
q_en: What are the three quantities in the ANN index's three-way tradeoff?
why: 三方：索引刷新频率（越快内容越新但成本高、还可能服务到半成品索引）、服务延迟（p99 通常 <10ms，越紧就更激进量化/更少探针→召回降）、召回 recall@K（越高越吃算力）。三者互相拉扯，不能同时拉满。
why_en: The three are index refresh frequency (fresher but costlier), serving latency (usually <10ms p99, tighter means more quantization/fewer probes and lower recall), and retrieval recall@K (higher costs more compute).
options: 索引刷新频率、服务延迟 p99、召回 recall@K，三者互相拉扯
模型参数量、学习率、batch size 三个训练超参之间的平衡
前端配色、日志保留时长、机房地理位置三者之间的平衡
只有召回率一个维度需要权衡，延迟和刷新频率都不受影响
options_en: Index refresh frequency, p99 serving latency, and recall@K — three quantities in tension.
The balance among three training hyperparameters: parameter count, learning rate, and batch size.
The balance among frontend colors, log retention period, and datacenter geography.
Only recall needs balancing; latency and refresh frequency are unaffected by it.
optionExplanations: 对；刷新/延迟/召回是索引设计互相牵制的三方，这是 Staff+ 要点出的取舍。
这些是训练超参，不是索引服务侧的三方取舍。
全是无关的运维/前端项，答不到索引取舍。
召回不能孤立看，延迟和刷新频率会直接压它。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — refresh/latency/recall are the three mutually-constraining index dimensions to name at Staff+.
Those are training hyperparameters, not the serving-side three-way tradeoff.
All unrelated ops/frontend items, missing the index tradeoff.
Recall can't be viewed alone; latency and refresh directly squeeze it.

termDefinitions.meaning: ANN 返回的 top-K 里覆盖了多少真正最近邻，衡量近似检索的召回质量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall@K measures how many true nearest neighbors appear in the ANN's top-K, gauging approximate-retrieval quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 重建或更新 ANN 索引以纳入新内容，越频繁越新鲜但成本越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Index refresh rebuilds or updates the ANN index to include new content; more frequent means fresher but costlier.

scenario: 全库 ANN 索引一次全量重建要几个小时，但你不能在重建期间让检索停摆或读到半成品索引。
scenario_en: A full ANN index rebuild takes hours, but retrieval can't stall or read a half-built index during it.
q: 该用什么部署方式安全地刷新索引？
q_en: How should you safely refresh the index?
why: 用蓝绿部署：在旁边并行构建新索引，构建期旧索引继续服务，验证 recall@K 通过后原子切换到新索引。这样避免服务停摆和读到部分索引的风险。
why_en: Use blue-green: build the new index in parallel while the old one keeps serving, then atomically swap after validating recall@K, avoiding downtime and partial-index reads.
tradeoff: 蓝绿并行构建+原子切换（无停摆、可验证） vs 原地重建（简单但期间读到半成品/停摆）
options: 原地把旧索引删掉直接重建，重建的几个小时里检索服务先停一停
蓝绿：旁边并行建新索引，验证 recall@K 后原子切换
查询过程中边查边随机改索引结构，不做任何离线验证
干脆不刷新索引，永远用第一版建好的索引对外服务
options_en: Delete the old index in place and rebuild it, pausing retrieval service for the hours-long rebuild.
Blue-green: build the new index in parallel, validate recall@K, then swap atomically.
Mutate the index structure randomly while queries run, with no offline validation.
Never refresh at all and keep serving from the very first index you built.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是往索引里加极少量新向量、且能容忍短暂质量波动，直接增量插入比整套蓝绿重建更省——但增量久了要定期全量重建。
whenOtherWins_en: If only a tiny number of vectors are added and brief quality wobble is acceptable, incremental insertion is cheaper than full blue-green — but periodic full rebuilds are still needed.
optionExplanations: 原地重建期间检索停摆或读到半成品，几小时的窗口不可接受。
对；并行构建+验证后原子切换，既不停摆也不读部分索引，是标准安全刷新。
不验证就切换正是索引迁移出事的根源，召回可能悄悄崩。
永不刷新会让新视频永远进不了候选，内容严重过时。
optionExplanations_en: In-place rebuild stalls retrieval or reads a partial index; an hours-long window is unacceptable.
Correct — parallel build plus validated atomic swap avoids downtime and partial reads, the standard safe refresh.
Swapping without validation is exactly how index migrations break, silently tanking recall.
Never refreshing keeps new videos out of candidates forever, badly stale.

termDefinitions.term: blue-green index swap / 蓝绿索引切换
termDefinitions.meaning: 并行构建新索引，验证后把查询流量原子切到新索引，旧索引作回退。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blue-green index swap builds a new index in parallel, validates it, then atomically routes queries to it with the old one as fallback.

scenario: 为了省事，团队只往 HNSW 索引里不断增量插入新视频，从不做全量重建。
scenario_en: To save effort, the team only incrementally inserts new videos into HNSW and never fully rebuilds.
q: 长期只做增量插入、不全量重建会怎样？
q_en: What happens if you only incrementally insert and never fully rebuild?
why: HNSW 支持增量插入，但图的邻近结构会随插入逐渐劣化——新点连不到最优邻居，召回慢慢下滑。所以要周期性全量重建把图重新整理好。增量图快但会累积质量债。
why_en: HNSW allows incremental insertion, but the graph's proximity structure degrades over time so recall slowly drops, which is why periodic full rebuilds are needed to restore quality.
options: 毫无影响，增量插入维护的图质量永远和定期全量重建的一样好
图邻近结构随插入劣化→召回慢慢下滑，需周期性全量重建整理
会让索引内存无限膨胀但召回反而更高
只影响写入速度，不影响检索召回
options_en: No effect; incrementally maintained graph quality always equals a periodic full rebuild.
The graph's proximity structure degrades with insertions, so recall slowly drops, needing periodic full rebuilds.
It inflates index memory infinitely but raises recall.
It only affects write speed, not retrieval recall.
optionExplanations: 增量图不会保持最优结构，长期质量必然低于全量重建。
对；增量插入让图逐渐劣化、召回下滑，定期全量重建是必要的维护。
召回是下降不是上升，内存也不是无限膨胀的核心问题。
劣化直接体现在检索召回，不只是写入速度。
optionExplanations_en: An incremental graph won't keep optimal structure; long-term quality falls below a full rebuild.
Correct — incremental insertion degrades the graph and drops recall, so periodic full rebuilds are needed maintenance.
Recall falls, not rises, and infinite memory isn't the core issue.
Degradation shows up in retrieval recall, not just write speed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不重建整个索引，只把新向量插进现有图/桶结构，快但长期质量会劣化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Incremental insertion adds new vectors into the existing graph/cells without a full rebuild — fast but degrading quality over time.
