why: PSI>0.2 是业界经验阈值(rule of thumb)，代表分数分布相对参考发生了显著偏移，不是精确公式。0.24 越线说明模型输出分布已明显漂移，应触发 champion-challenger 重训管线，别等标签。
why_en: PSI > 0.2 is an industry rule-of-thumb threshold marking significant distribution shift from the reference, not an exact formula, so 0.24 crossing it means the output distribution has clearly drifted and should trigger the champion-challenger retraining pipeline rather than waiting for labels.
options: PSI>0.2 只是个好看的整数阈值，本身没有统计含义
PSI>0.2 是经验阈值：分布显著漂移，0.24 应触发重训
PSI 越高说明模型越准确，0.24 是个好消息
必须等 PSI 涨到 1.0 才算真的漂移，0.24 完全无需理会重训
options_en: PSI > 0.2 is just a round number with no statistical meaning of its own.
PSI > 0.2 is a rule-of-thumb line for significant drift, so 0.24 should trigger retraining.
A higher PSI means a more accurate model, so 0.24 is good news.
It only counts as drift once PSI reaches 1.0; at 0.24 you don't need to think about retraining.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用经验界：<0.1 稳定、0.1–0.2 需关注、>0.2 显著漂移，非精确公式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A common PSI rule of thumb: <0.1 stable, 0.1–0.2 watch, >0.2 significant drift, not an exact formula.

termDefinitions.term: rule of thumb / 经验法则
termDefinitions.meaning: 行业惯用的粗略阈值/估算，供参考而非严格数学结论。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rule of thumb is a rough industry threshold or estimate for guidance, not a strict mathematical result.

optionExplanations: 这条界线不是随手挑的整数，0.2 是经验观察到的显著偏移分界点。
对，0.2 只是行业惯用的粗略界线，本例已经压过它，该立刻拉重训流程而不是干等标签回流。
PSI 走高说明分布偏得更远，不代表模型更准，0.24 该拉警报而非当好消息。
漂移判定不需要等到 PSI=1.0 那种极端值，0.24 已经过线，早该有动作。
optionExplanations_en: That cutoff isn't a picked round number — 0.2 is the empirically observed boundary for meaningful shift.
Correct — 0.2 is just a common early-warning line, and this reading already passed it, so kick off retraining now rather than sit on it.
A rising PSI signals the model's outputs have moved further from the baseline, not that it's more accurate — 0.24 should raise an alarm, not celebration.
Drift doesn't require waiting for an extreme value like PSI=1.0; 0.24 has already crossed the line and warrants action.

scenario: PSI 报了分数漂移，但你想知道到底是哪个输入特征(交易额?设备指纹?地理?)变了，好做针对性特征工程。
scenario_en: PSI flagged score drift, but you want to know which input feature (amount? device fingerprint? geo?) shifted, to do targeted feature engineering.
q: 该用什么检验来定位漂移的特征？
q_en: Which test pinpoints the drifted feature?
why: 用 KS 检验(Kolmogorov-Smirnov)逐特征比较当前 vs 参考分布，它能指出具体哪个特征分布变了，从而定向做特征工程。PSI 看整体分数、KS 看单特征，二者分工不同。
why_en: Use the KS test (Kolmogorov-Smirnov) per feature to compare current vs reference distributions, pinpointing which feature shifted for targeted feature engineering; PSI covers the overall score while KS covers individual features.
tradeoff: KS 逐特征(定位到具体特征、指导特征工程) vs PSI(只看整体分数、不知道是哪个特征)
whenOtherWins: 若只需知道模型输出整体是否偏移、不关心具体特征，PSI 更省事；要抓行为量的突变点则用 ADWIN。
options: PSI，它能把分数漂移精确定位到每一个输入特征上
KS 检验：逐特征比对当前 vs 参考分布，定位漂移特征
把线上 accuracy 按特征分桶拆解，看哪个桶掉得最多
ADWIN，它专门做逐特征的分布一致性检验与告警
options_en: PSI, which pinpoints score drift down to each individual input feature.
The KS test: compare current vs reference distributions feature by feature to locate the drifting one.
Bucket live accuracy by feature and see which bucket drops the most.
ADWIN, which is built for per-feature distribution consistency tests and alerts.
optionExplanations: PSI 衡量的是整体分数分布偏移，定位不到是哪个具体特征变了。
对；KS 逐特征比较分布，能指出交易额/设备/地理里究竟哪个漂移，指导定向特征工程。
accuracy 需要标签且滞后，也不是分特征漂移检测工具。
ADWIN 是在流数据上检测行为量的突变点，不是逐特征分布检验。
optionExplanations_en: PSI measures overall score-distribution shift and can't pinpoint which specific feature changed.
Correct — KS compares distributions per feature, pinpointing whether amount/device/geo drifted, guiding targeted feature engineering.
Accuracy needs labels and lags, and isn't a per-feature drift detector.
ADWIN detects change points in streaming behavior volume, not per-feature distribution testing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 比较两个分布最大累积差异的统计检验，逐特征用可定位哪个特征漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The KS (Kolmogorov-Smirnov) test compares the maximum cumulative difference between two distributions, used per feature to pinpoint which one drifted.

scenario: 你想在流式数据上无需固定窗口地捕捉「拦截率/复核率突然跳变」这种预测行为异常，几小时内就报警。
scenario_en: On streaming data, without a fixed window, you want to catch prediction-behavior anomalies like a sudden jump in block/review rate and alert within hours.
q: 该用哪种检测器？
q_en: Which detector should you use?
why: 用 ADWIN(自适应窗口)监控 block/review 率，它在流数据上自动伸缩窗口、检测变化点，无需预设固定窗口，能在几小时内抓到突变。block 率骤降常是欺诈者找到了绕过路径。
why_en: Use ADWIN (Adaptive Windowing) on the block/review rate; it auto-resizes its window on streaming data to detect change points without a preset fixed window, catching sudden shifts within hours — a sudden block-rate drop often signals an evasion path.
tradeoff: ADWIN(自适应窗口抓突变点、无需固定窗口) vs 固定窗口统计(要预设窗口、对突变反应慢)
whenOtherWins: 若要比较分布形状(分数或特征)而非行为量的突变点，PSI/KS 更合适；ADWIN 强在流式变化点检测。
options: PSI，它专门用于检测流式数据里的突变点与跳变，不需要窗口
KS 检验，对每一笔交易的特征做实时逐条比对
ADWIN(自适应窗口)：监控 block/review 率的变化点
先用固定 7 天滑动窗口算均值，再看是否超过一倍标准差，超了就报警
options_en: PSI, which specializes in detecting change points and jumps in streaming data without any window.
The KS test, comparing each transaction feature in real time, row by row.
ADWIN (Adaptive Windowing): watch the block/review rate for change points.
First compute a mean over a fixed 7-day sliding window, then alert whenever it exceeds one standard deviation.
optionExplanations: PSI 比的是分布偏移、用固定参考窗口，不是流式变化点检测器。
KS 是逐特征分布检验，不是监控行为量突跳的在线变化点方法。
对；ADWIN 会自适应收缩/放大窗口去抓这个比率的跳变，不用先定死窗口大小，几小时内就能报警。
固定窗口要预设长度，对不同尺度的突变反应慢，正是 ADWIN 自适应要解决的痛点。
optionExplanations_en: PSI compares distribution shift against a fixed reference window, not a streaming change-point detector.
KS is a per-feature distribution test, not an online change-point method for behavior-volume jumps.
Correct — ADWIN auto-resizes its window and detects change points in block/review rate on the stream without a preset window, alerting within hours.
A fixed window needs a preset length and reacts slowly to shifts of different scales — exactly the pain ADWIN's adaptivity solves.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自适应窗口算法，在流数据上自动伸缩窗口以检测统计量的变化点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ADWIN (Adaptive Windowing) auto-resizes its window on streaming data to detect change points in a statistic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据流中统计特性发生突变的时刻，ADWIN 用来定位突发漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A change point is the moment a stream's statistical property jumps, which ADWIN locates to flag sudden drift.

scenario: 只靠 KS 逐特征检验监控漂移，欺诈者故意让每个特征的边际分布看起来和合法交易一样。
scenario_en: Relying only on KS per-feature tests, fraudsters deliberately make each feature's marginal distribution look like legit traffic.
q: 为什么单靠 KS 特征检验不够，会漏掉什么？
q_en: Why is KS feature testing alone insufficient, and what does it miss?
why: 欺诈者可以模仿合法的边际特征分布，让 KS 检测不出任何特征变化，但特征↔欺诈的关系(概念)已经变了——这是概念漂移。所以必须把特征监控和分数(PSI)+行为(ADWIN)监控配对，才抓得到这种隐蔽漂移。
why_en: Fraudsters can mimic legit marginal feature distributions so KS sees no feature change, yet the feature-to-fraud relationship (the concept) has shifted — concept drift — so feature monitoring must be paired with score (PSI) and behavior (ADWIN) monitoring to catch it.
options: KS 已经足够，特征分布不变就说明模型完全没有漂移
欺诈者模仿合法边际分布，KS 看不出，但概念已漂移
KS 太敏感，会把正常的季节性波动大量误报成漂移
KS 只在离线训练阶段有用，线上监控根本不该使用它
options_en: KS is enough; if feature distributions are unchanged, the model has not drifted at all.
Fraudsters mimic legitimate marginal distributions so KS sees nothing, yet the concept has drifted.
KS is too sensitive and floods you with false drift alarms from normal seasonal swings.
KS is only useful during offline training and should never run in production monitoring.
optionExplanations: 特征边际分布不变不代表关系不变——欺诈者正是钻这个空子让 KS 失明。
对；KS 只看边际分布，抓不到关系变化；分数漂移(PSI)和行为突变(ADWIN)才能补上这盲区。
问题不是误报而是漏报：KS 在这种对抗下会安静地什么都测不出。
KS 线上逐特征监控是有用的，只是不能单用，要和其它信号配对。
optionExplanations_en: Unchanged marginal feature distributions don't mean the relationship is unchanged — fraudsters exploit exactly this to blind KS.
Correct — KS only sees marginals and misses relationship change; score drift (PSI) and behavior jumps (ADWIN) cover that blind spot.
The problem is false negatives, not false positives: under this adversary KS silently detects nothing.
KS per-feature monitoring is useful in production; it just can't be used alone and must be paired with other signals.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单个特征自身的分布，欺诈者可模仿它使 KS 看不出变化，却已改变特征与欺诈的关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A marginal distribution is a single feature's own distribution; mimicking it fools KS even as the feature-to-fraud relationship changes.

scenario: 标签滞后 30–90 天，你要用一组无标签信号组成「监控金字塔」及时发现模型退化。
scenario_en: With labels 30–90 days late, you need a set of label-free signals forming a 'monitoring pyramid' to catch degradation in time.
q: 无标签监控金字塔应包含哪些信号？(多选)
q_en: Which signals belong in the label-free monitoring pyramid? (multiple)
why: 三层互补：PSI 看分数分布整体漂移(几天)、KS 逐特征定位是哪个特征变了、ADWIN 看 block/review 率的行为突变点(几小时)。三者配对才能既抓渐变又抓突变、既知道漂了又知道漂在哪。
why_en: Three complementary layers: PSI for overall score-distribution drift (days), KS per-feature to localize which feature moved, and ADWIN for behavior change points in block/review rate (hours) — paired, they catch both gradual and sudden drift and tell you both that and where it drifted.
options: 分数分布漂移 → PSI(总体稳定性指数)
特征分布漂移 → KS 检验(逐特征定位)
预测行为异常 → ADWIN(block/review 率突变点)
GPU 温度 → 散热监控
options_en: Score-distribution drift → PSI (Population Stability Index).
Feature-distribution drift → KS test (per-feature localization).
Prediction-behavior anomalies → ADWIN (block/review-rate change points).
GPU temperature → thermal monitoring.
optionExplanations: 对；PSI 监控分数分布整体偏移，是金字塔第一层，几天内抓渐变。
对；KS 逐特征定位漂移来源，指导针对性特征工程。
对；ADWIN 在流上抓 block/review 率突变点，几小时内发现突发绕过。
错；GPU 温度是硬件运维，跟模型概念漂移无关，不属于监控金字塔。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — PSI monitors overall score-distribution shift, the pyramid's first layer, catching gradual drift within days.
Correct — KS localizes drift per feature, guiding targeted feature engineering.
Correct — ADWIN catches block/review-rate change points on the stream, spotting sudden evasion within hours.
Wrong — GPU temperature is hardware ops, unrelated to model concept drift, not part of the monitoring pyramid.

termDefinitions.meaning: PSI(分数)+KS(特征)+ADWIN(行为)三层互补的无标签漂移监控体系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The monitoring pyramid is a three-layer label-free drift system: PSI (score) + KS (feature) + ADWIN (behavior).

scenario: 三种无标签监控信号 PSI、KS、ADWIN 各盯不同层面的漂移。
scenario_en: The three label-free signals PSI, KS, and ADWIN each watch a different layer of drift.
q: PSI / KS / ADWIN 各监控什么、时效如何？
q_en: What does each of PSI/KS/ADWIN monitor, and how fast?
why: PSI 盯分数分布整体漂移、几天见效；KS 逐特征定位是哪个特征变了；ADWIN 盯 block/review 率的行为突变点、几小时报警。分数层、特征层、行为层，三层互补缺一不可。
why_en: PSI watches overall score-distribution drift (days); KS localizes which feature moved; ADWIN watches behavior change points in block/review rate (hours) — score layer, feature layer, behavior layer, three complementary and indispensable views.
tradeoff: PSI(整体分数、几天) vs KS(定位特征) vs ADWIN(行为突变、几小时)
options: 三者完全等价，用哪一个监控都是一样的效果
PSI 盯分数(天)、KS 盯特征、ADWIN 盯行为突变(小时)
PSI 看特征分布、KS 看拦截行为、ADWIN 看分数，各管一层
三者都必须拿到真实欺诈标签之后才能计算
options_en: The three are fully equivalent; any one of them gives the same result.
PSI watches the score (days), KS watches features, ADWIN watches behavior jumps (hours).
PSI watches feature distributions, KS watches blocking behavior, ADWIN watches scores.
All three can only be computed once true fraud labels arrive.
optionExplanations: 三者盯不同层面、时效不同，绝非等价，单用任何一个都有盲区。
对；分数(PSI)、特征(KS)、行为(ADWIN)三层各司其职、时效互补，合起来才无死角。
对应关系全错：PSI 是分数、KS 是特征、ADWIN 是行为。
三者恰恰都是无标签信号，不依赖真实标签，这正是它们的价值。
optionExplanations_en: They watch different layers with different latencies — far from equivalent, and any one alone has blind spots.
Correct — score (PSI), feature (KS), behavior (ADWIN), each with its role and complementary latency, together leaving no gap.
The mapping is all wrong: PSI is score, KS is feature, ADWIN is behavior.
All three are precisely label-free signals independent of true labels — that's their value.

termDefinitions.term: drift monitoring layers / 漂移监控分层
termDefinitions.meaning: 分数层(PSI)、特征层(KS)、行为层(ADWIN)三层无标签监控，覆盖不同漂移与时效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Drift monitoring layers are score (PSI), feature (KS), and behavior (ADWIN), three label-free views covering different drifts and latencies.

scenario: 监控信号越线后，系统要自动闭合「监控→重训→安全上线」的回路。
scenario_en: Once a monitoring signal crosses threshold, the system closes the monitoring→retrain→safe-deploy loop.
q: 把「监控→重训→安全上线」闭环排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the monitoring→retraining→safe-deploy loop correctly:
steps: 任一信号(PSI/KS/ADWIN)越过阈值报警
触发 champion-challenger 重训管线，用强标签训 challenger
challenger 影子模式在真实流量上验证，指标更优才晋升
晋升为新 champion，回到持续监控
why: 闭环是：监控报警→触发重训→影子验证→择优晋升→继续监控。任一环缺失都会让漂移无人响应或让未验证模型直接上线，这正是 Staff+ 强调的「监控→重训→安全上线」自动化。
why_en: The loop runs alert, trigger retraining, shadow-validate, promote if better, keep monitoring; missing any link leaves drift unanswered or ships an unvalidated model, exactly the Staff+ monitoring-to-safe-deploy automation.
diagram:
flowchart LR A["信号越阈值报警"] --> B["触发重训
训 challenger"] B --> C["影子验证
指标更优?"] C --> D["晋升新 champion"] D --> A

termDefinitions.term: monitoring→retraining loop / 监控-重训闭环
termDefinitions.meaning: 监控报警触发重训、影子验证后安全上线、再回到监控的自动化循环。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The monitoring-to-retraining loop is the automation where an alert triggers retraining, shadow validation enables safe deploy, and it returns to monitoring.

scenario: 两周内 auto-block 率从 1.2% 缓慢跌到 0.4%，但 KS 逐特征检验显示所有特征分布都没变。
scenario_en: Over two weeks the auto-block rate slides from 1.2% to 0.4%, yet KS per-feature tests show no feature-distribution change.
q: 最可能发生了什么？
q_en: What most likely happened?
why: 特征分布没变但拦截率骤降，说明欺诈者学会把特征值伪装进模型认为「安全」的分布区间——特征值看着正常，但特征↔欺诈的关系变了，是概念漂移。KS 只看边际分布抓不到，这正是要配 ADWIN(行为)+PSI(分数)的原因。
why_en: Unchanged features but a plunging block rate mean fraudsters learned to place feature values inside the model's learned 'safe' region — values look normal but the feature-to-fraud relationship changed, i.e. concept drift that KS's marginal view misses, which is why ADWIN (behavior) and PSI (score) are paired in.
options: 模型确实变好了、欺诈总量在减少，所以拦截率自然下降
打分服务间歇故障导致大量交易漏打分，与欺诈行为无关
欺诈者把特征值伪装进模型认为安全的区间(概念漂移)
只是随机波动而已，两周窗口太短，说明不了任何问题
options_en: The model genuinely improved and total fraud is falling, so the block rate drops.
Intermittent scoring outages let many transactions skip scoring, unrelated to fraud.
Fraudsters moved feature values into the region the model learned as safe — concept drift.
It is just random noise; a two-week window is far too short to mean anything.
optionExplanations: 拦截率骤降+损失通常随后上升，不是欺诈减少，而是欺诈绕过了检测。
服务器故障会体现在打分量/错误率上，且不解释「特征没变但拦得少」的模式。
对；特征边际不变而关系变，是典型概念漂移，KS 看不见，须靠行为(ADWIN)与分数(PSI)监控补上。
两周持续单调下滑不是随机波动，是明确的行为漂移信号。
optionExplanations_en: A plunging block rate usually precedes rising losses — not less fraud, but fraud evading detection.
A server outage would show in scoring volume/error rate and doesn't explain the 'features unchanged but fewer blocks' pattern.
Correct — unchanged marginals with a changed relationship is classic concept drift, invisible to KS and caught only by behavior (ADWIN) and score (PSI) monitoring.
Two weeks of steady monotonic decline isn't random noise; it's a clear behavior-drift signal.

termDefinitions.term: safe distribution region / 「安全」分布区间
termDefinitions.meaning: 模型学到的低风险特征取值范围；欺诈者把特征伪装进此区间以绕过检测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The 'safe' distribution region is the low-risk feature-value range the model learned; fraudsters disguise features into it to evade detection.

scenario: 打分服务突然挂了，但交易仍在源源不断进来、必须立刻给出 block/pass。
scenario_en: The scoring service suddenly goes down, yet txns keep arriving and must get block/pass immediately.
q: 服务层故障时该怎么办？
q_en: What should happen when the serving layer fails?
why: 做优雅降级：打分不可用时回退到确定性业务规则(金额上限、地理-速度、黑名单)兜底，先保证交易不中断、明显欺诈仍被拦，再修复模型。全停会阻断合法交易、全放会门户大开，都不可接受。
why_en: Graceful degradation: when scoring is unavailable, fall back to deterministic business rules (amount caps, geo-velocity, blocklists) to keep txns flowing and still block obvious fraud, then repair the model, since halting all blocks legit txns and passing all opens the floodgates.
tradeoff: 回退规则兜底(不中断交易、拦明显欺诈但精度降) vs 全停/全放(要么阻断营收要么门户大开)
whenOtherWins: 对极高风险交易类别，宁可在打分不可用时保守拒绝或走人工，也不放行——此时‘全走人工’胜过规则兜底。
options: 打分挂了就全部放行，优先保证交易链路不中断，但故障窗口内欺诈会大量涌入
打分挂了就全部拒绝，宁可错杀也不放过欺诈，合法交易也被一起挡下
优雅降级：回退确定性业务规则，拦明显欺诈不中断交易
直接停服等模型恢复，期间不处理任何交易请求，业务整体中断
options_en: If scoring is down, approve everything to keep the payment path unbroken, but fraud floods in during the outage window.
If scoring is down, decline everything — better to over-block than let fraud through, at the cost of blocking legit transactions too.
Graceful degradation: fall back to deterministic rules that block obvious fraud without halting traffic.
Take the service fully offline until the model recovers, processing no transactions and stalling the whole business meanwhile.
optionExplanations: 全放会让欺诈门户大开，故障窗口内损失激增。
全拒会阻断大量合法交易、直接砸营收和用户体验。
对；规则兜底在模型缺席时维持基本防护、不中断业务，是 Staff+ 强调的故障模式设计。
停服等恢复等于业务中断，对支付系统不可接受。
optionExplanations_en: Passing everything opens the floodgates, and losses spike during the outage.
Declining everything blocks many legit txns, hammering revenue and user experience.
Correct — rule fallback maintains baseline protection without halting business while the model is absent, the Staff+ failure-mode design.
Going offline until recovery is a business outage, unacceptable for a payment system.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关键组件失效时退到较简能力(如规则兜底)维持基本服务，而非整体宕机。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Graceful degradation falls back to a simpler capability (e.g. rule fallback) to keep basic service when a key component fails, rather than a full outage.

scenario: 面试官说：你已经把组件都列全了，怎样把答案从 L5 抬到 Staff+？
scenario_en: The interviewer says your component list is complete; how do you lift the answer from L5 to Staff+?
q: Staff+ 的关键区分点是什么？
q_en: What is the key Staff+ differentiator?
why: 不是堆更多组件，而是说清每个决策「为什么存在」和「拿掉它会坏什么」，并花时间在故障模式与优雅降级(如打分层宕机)而非只讲 happy path。深度体现在权衡与失效推理，不在组件数量。
why_en: Not more components but articulating why each decision exists and what breaks if removed, and spending time on failure modes and graceful degradation (e.g. serving layer down) rather than only the happy path; depth is in tradeoff and failure reasoning, not component count.
options: 堆更多组件、把架构图画得更大更复杂、覆盖更多模块
说清每个决策为何存在、拿掉会坏什么，重点讲失效路径
把所有阈值都调到最优的具体数字并在白板上背出来
换更大的深度模型，方案越复杂越显得资深
options_en: Add more components and draw a bigger, more complex diagram covering more modules.
Explain why each decision exists and what breaks without it, focusing on failure paths.
Tune every threshold to an optimal number and recite them on the whiteboard.
Swap in a bigger deep model, since a more complex design looks more senior.
optionExplanations: 组件更多不等于更深，面试官恰恰说组件已全，堆料反而稀释信号。
对；Staff+ 深度在于权衡与失效推理——为什么、拿掉会坏什么、故障怎么降级。
背具体阈值数字是 trivia，讲不清背后取舍反而显浅。
换大模型与延迟预算冲突，且复杂度本身不是资深信号，讲清取舍才是。
optionExplanations_en: More components isn't more depth; the interviewer just said the list is complete, so piling on dilutes signal.
Correct — Staff+ depth is tradeoff and failure reasoning: why, what breaks if removed, how it degrades under failure.
Reciting specific threshold numbers is trivia; failing to explain the underlying tradeoff reads as shallow.
A bigger model conflicts with the latency budget, and complexity itself isn't a seniority signal — explaining tradeoffs is.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统组件失效的具体方式及其后果，Staff+ 要主动分析并给出降级方案。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A failure mode is a specific way a component fails and its consequences, which Staff+ answers proactively analyze with degradation plans.

scenario: 支付欺诈系统要服务全球用户：既要低延迟(<50ms)，又要满足各地数据驻留/合规要求。
scenario_en: A global payment fraud system must serve worldwide with low latency (<50ms) and meet regional data-residency/compliance rules.
q: 架构上该怎么应对全球延迟与合规？
q_en: How should the architecture handle global latency and compliance?
why: 做多区域部署：把打分与特征就近放到用户所在区，物理上缩短 RTT 保住 <50ms；同时把数据留在合规辖区内满足数据驻留。跨洲同步调用的 RTT 物理下限就有几十毫秒，靠优化代码消不掉，只能靠就近部署。
why_en: Multi-region deployment: place scoring and features near users to physically shorten RTT and hold <50ms, while keeping data within compliant jurisdictions for residency, since a cross-continent synchronous call's RTT has a tens-of-ms physical floor that code tuning can't remove.
tradeoff: 多区域就近部署(低延迟+合规驻留但运维/一致性更复杂) vs 单区域(简单但跨洲延迟高、难满足驻留)
whenOtherWins: 若用户集中在单一地区、且无跨境数据驻留要求，单区域部署更简单、成本更低也够用。
options: 单区域集中部署，靠优化代码把跨洲延迟压下去，但物理 RTT 下限压不掉
多区域部署：打分/特征就近放用户区降 RTT，数据留在合规辖区满足驻留
全球所有请求都打到同一个数据中心，最一致，但远端用户 RTT 会爆表
把延迟预算从 50ms 放宽到 500ms 就不用多区域了，但这违反授权前的产品 SLO
options_en: A single centralized region, tuning code to squeeze out cross-continent latency — but the physical RTT floor won't budge.
Multi-region: place scoring/features near users to cut RTT, keep data in compliant jurisdictions for residency.
Route all global requests to one data center for maximum consistency, but RTT balloons for distant users.
Just relax the budget from 50ms to 500ms and skip multi-region — but that violates the pre-authorization product SLO.
optionExplanations: 跨洲 RTT 有几十毫秒物理下限，优化代码消不掉，单区域满足不了全球 <50ms。
对；就近部署物理上缩短 RTT 达标延迟，数据驻留在辖区内满足合规，一箭双雕。
全球打一个中心会让远端用户 RTT 爆表，且违反数据驻留要求。
放宽到 500ms 违反授权前 <50ms 的产品 SLO，不是合规/延迟的正解。
optionExplanations_en: Cross-continent RTT has a tens-of-ms physical floor that code tuning can't remove, so one region can't meet global <50ms.
Correct — near-user deployment physically shortens RTT to meet latency, and in-jurisdiction data residency meets compliance, solving both.
One global center blows up RTT for distant users and violates data-residency rules.
Relaxing to 500ms violates the <50ms pre-authorization SLO and doesn't address compliance/latency properly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 法规要求某类数据必须存储/处理在特定辖区内，推动多区域部署。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data residency is a legal requirement that certain data be stored/processed within a jurisdiction, driving multi-region deployment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求到响应往返一次的时间；跨洲同步调用有几十毫秒物理下限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RTT (Round-Trip Time) is one request-response round trip, with a tens-of-ms physical floor across continents.

scenario: 把实时打分管线的三段延迟预算背成一句。
scenario_en: Memorize the three-stage scoring pipeline budgets in one line.
q: 补全 <50ms 实时打分管线的阶段与预算：
q_en: Fill in the sub-50ms scoring pipeline stages and budgets:
text: 实时打分 <50ms：{{特征检索}}(~15ms，预计算+实时双路径) → {{模型打分}}(~10ms，GBM 1–3ms) → {{决策引擎}}(~5ms，规则增强)，另留 ~{{20}}ms 给网络/序列化/余量。
text_en: Real-time scoring <50ms: {{feature retrieval}} (~15ms, precomputed+real-time dual path) → {{model scoring}} (~10ms, GBM 1–3ms) → {{decision engine}} (~5ms, rule-augmented), with ~{{20}}ms reserved for network/serialization/margin.
why: 记住三段+预留，就能现场把 50ms 拆给各组件、并解释为何 GBM 而非深度集成、为何决策要规则增强。这条预算线是整课的骨架。
why_en: Remembering the three stages plus reserve lets you split 50ms across components live and justify GBM over a deep ensemble and rule augmentation, the backbone of the lesson.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征检索→模型打分→决策引擎的三段实时链路，端到端预算 <50ms。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The scoring pipeline is the three serial stages feature retrieval → model scoring → decision engine, budgeted end-to-end under 50ms.

scenario: 把无标签监控金字塔的三层背成一组「信号→方法→抓什么」。
scenario_en: Memorize the label-free monitoring pyramid as three 'signal→method→what it catches'.
q: 补全无标签监控金字塔三层：
q_en: Fill in the three layers of the label-free monitoring pyramid:
text: 监控金字塔：分数分布漂移→{{PSI}}(>{{0.2}} 显著，几天抓渐变)；特征分布漂移→{{KS}} 检验(逐特征定位)；预测行为异常→{{ADWIN}}(block/review 率突变点，几小时)。
text_en: Monitoring pyramid: score-distribution drift→{{PSI}} (>{{0.2}} significant, days for gradual); feature-distribution drift→{{KS}} test (per-feature localization); prediction-behavior anomalies→{{ADWIN}} (block/review-rate change points, hours).
why: 三层缺一不可：单靠 KS 会被模仿边际分布骗过，配上 PSI(分数)与 ADWIN(行为)才抓得到隐蔽概念漂移。记住这三件套就能答满监控题。
why_en: The three layers are indispensable: KS alone is fooled by mimicked marginals, so pairing PSI (score) and ADWIN (behavior) catches hidden concept drift — this trio answers monitoring questions fully.

termDefinitions.meaning: PSI+KS+ADWIN 三层无标签漂移监控，覆盖分数、特征、行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The monitoring pyramid is three label-free drift layers, PSI+KS+ADWIN, covering score, feature, and behavior.

scenario: 同一道欺诈 serving+monitoring 题，L4、L5、Staff+ 的答案深度不同。
scenario_en: On the same fraud serving+monitoring question, L4, L5, and Staff+ answers differ in depth.
q: L4 / L5 / Staff+ 的答案边界大致在哪？
q_en: Where roughly are the L4/L5/Staff+ answer boundaries?
why: L4 只有基础管线(特征查+推理+单阈值)加准确率监控；L5 补上延迟预算、分层路由、PSI 与 champion-challenger；Staff+ 再加 ADWIN、自动重训、优雅降级与多区域。
why_en: L4 is a basic pipeline (lookup+inference+single threshold) with basic accuracy monitoring, missing label delay and drift strategy; L5 adds the full 3-stage pipeline, latency budgets, tiered dynamic routing, PSI, champion-challenger, missing ADWIN and the feedback loop; Staff+ adds the full monitoring pyramid, auto alert/retrain, graceful degradation, multi-region.
tradeoff: L4(基础单阈值) vs L5(三段管线+PSI+分层) vs Staff+(监控金字塔+自动化+降级+多区域)
options: 三级答案没有本质区别，只看表达是否流畅、结构是否完整，跟深度无关
L4 单阈值管线；L5 三段+PSI；Staff+ 监控金字塔+降级
L4 的答案最全面、Staff+ 反而最简单，级别越高讲得越少
只有 Staff+ 需要讲模型内部机制，L4/L5 只讲工程组件不涉及模型
options_en: The three levels differ only in how fluent and well-structured the delivery is, unrelated to depth.
L4: single-threshold pipeline; L5: three stages plus PSI; Staff+: monitoring pyramid plus degradation.
L4 answers are the most complete and Staff+ is actually the simplest; higher levels say less.
Only Staff+ needs to discuss internal model mechanics; L4 and L5 cover engineering components only, no model.
optionExplanations: 级别差异恰恰在覆盖的深度与失效推理，不是表达流畅度。
对；从单阈值到三段管线再到监控金字塔+自动化+降级+多区域，逐级加深，是标准分级。
说反了：Staff+ 覆盖最广最深，L4 最基础。
各级都要讲模型与工程，区别在深度而非是否涉及模型。
optionExplanations_en: The level difference is precisely coverage depth and failure reasoning, not delivery fluency.
Correct — from single threshold to full pipeline to monitoring pyramid + automation + degradation + multi-region, deepening by level, the standard scoping.
Backwards: Staff+ is the broadest and deepest, L4 the most basic.
Every level covers model and engineering; the difference is depth, not whether the model is involved.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同题按 L4/L5/Staff+ 逐级扩展覆盖面与失效推理深度的作答框架。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Seniority scoping is answering the same question with progressively broader coverage and deeper failure reasoning from L4 to L5 to Staff+.

scenario: 三档路由中 auto-pass ~94%、manual review ~5%、auto-block ~1%，1M 交易/天。
scenario_en: Tier routing: auto-pass ~94%, manual review ~5%, auto-block ~1%, on 1M txns/day.
q: 这 5% 复核占比对分析师产能意味着什么？
q_en: What does the 5% review share imply for analyst capacity?
why: 5% × 1M/天 = 5 万笔/天要人工复核，这是倒推分析师人数的基数；band 每加宽 1 个百分点就多 1 万笔/天，直接压产能。
why_en: 5% × 1M/day = 50,000/day to review — not trivia but the base sizing the analyst team: divide by per-analyst daily throughput to get headcount, and widening the band 1 point adds 10,000/day, so band width is the key knob under capacity.
options: 5% 只是个统计数字，和分析师产能没有关系
5%×1M = 5 万笔/天人工复核，是审核团队规模的基数
auto-block 的 1% 才是真正的产能瓶颈，人工复核不占人力
复核量是固定的，无论 band 调多宽都还是 5 万笔/天
options_en: The 5% is just a statistic with no bearing on analyst capacity.
5% × 1M = 50k transactions a day to review, the base for sizing the analyst team.
The 1% auto-block tier is the real capacity bottleneck; manual review costs no headcount.
Review volume is fixed at 50k a day no matter how wide the band is set.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分析师团队每天能处理的复核量；决定 manual review band 能设多宽。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Review capacity is how many cases analysts can handle per day, which caps how wide the manual-review band can be.

optionExplanations: 5% 换算成人天就是产能规划的直接输入，说和产能无关等于没做这道换算。
对，换算成 5 万笔/天就是复核团队要扛的日工作量，band 每宽一点这个数就跟着涨。
block 的 1% 交易早已自动处理，真正吃人力的是要人工过一遍的那 5%。
band 一变，落进复核区间的交易量跟着变，5 万笔只是当前 band 下的一个快照。
optionExplanations_en: Converting 5% into a daily headcount input is exactly the capacity-planning step; calling it unrelated skips that math.
Correct — converting to 50k/day is the workload the review team must absorb, and it climbs with every point the band widens.
The 1% auto-blocked txns are already handled automatically; the headcount actually goes to the 5% that needs a human look.
Widening or narrowing the band changes how many txns fall into review; 50k is just a snapshot at the current band.

scenario: 打分的预计算特征要在 ~15ms 特征检索预算里被高并发读取，键是用户/设备/商户 ID。
scenario_en: Precomputed features must be read at high concurrency within the ~15ms retrieval budget, keyed by user/device/merchant ID.
q: 预计算特征该放在什么存储里？
q_en: What storage should hold the precomputed features?
why: 用低延迟键值存储(Redis/DynamoDB)：按 ID 做点查、毫秒级读、能扛高并发，正好落在 15ms 检索预算内。用关系库做推理时多表 join 延迟高、抖动大，撑不住 50ms 端到端。
why_en: Use a low-latency key-value store (Redis/DynamoDB): point lookups by ID, millisecond reads, high concurrency, fitting the 15ms budget, whereas a relational DB doing inference-time multi-table joins is high-latency and jittery and can't hold the 50ms end-to-end.
tradeoff: 低延迟 KV 库(点查毫秒级、抗并发但需物化管线) vs 关系库 join(灵活但推理时延迟高、抖动大)
whenOtherWins: 若特征需在查询时做复杂关系聚合、且延迟预算宽松(离线/批打分)，关系库或数仓反而更合适。
options: 关系型数据库，推理时现场 join 多张明细表实时算特征，最灵活
键值存储(Redis/DynamoDB)：按 ID 点查、毫秒级读
对象存储(S3)，容量大、单位存储成本最省钱
全文搜索引擎，方便按关键词模糊检索特征值
options_en: A relational database, joining several detail tables live at inference time for maximum flexibility.
A key-value store (Redis/DynamoDB): point lookups by ID with millisecond reads.
Object storage (S3), with huge capacity and the cheapest cost per byte.
A full-text search engine, convenient for fuzzy keyword lookups of feature values.
optionExplanations: 关系库擅长复杂查询，但每次推理都要现场跨表拼数据，随并发量抖动，压不进这道题的紧预算。
对；KV 点查毫秒级、抗并发，正是特征库要的低延迟读，预计算好直接取。
S3 是高吞吐但高延迟的批量存储，点查毫秒级读做不到，不适合在线特征。
搜索引擎为全文检索优化，不是低延迟键值点查的最优解。
optionExplanations_en: Inference-time multi-table joins are high-latency and jittery, blowing the 15ms retrieval budget and 50ms end-to-end.
Correct — KV point lookups are millisecond and high-concurrency, exactly the low-latency reads a feature store needs, precomputed and fetched directly.
S3 is high-throughput but high-latency batch storage and can't do millisecond point reads, unfit for online features.
A search engine is optimized for full-text retrieval, not the best fit for low-latency key-value point lookups.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按键点查、毫秒级读、抗高并发的存储(Redis/DynamoDB)，用作在线特征库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A key-value store (Redis/DynamoDB) does point lookups by key with millisecond reads and high concurrency, used as the online feature store.

scenario: 一位老客户做了一笔金额远超其历史的合法大额采购，模型仅凭「金额异常」就打出高欺诈分。
scenario_en: A loyal customer makes a legitimate large purchase far above their history; the model scores high fraud on 'amount anomaly' alone.
q: 决策引擎的业务规则在这里起什么作用？
q_en: What role do the decision engine's business rules play here?
why: 规则层作为护栏纠正模型的单特征误判：结合商户类目、设备信任、地理-速度等上下文，给「已知可信设备+匹配类目的高额采购」做 override 或降级到人工，而不是仅凭金额自动拦，避免误伤合法大额交易。
why_en: The rules layer acts as a guardrail correcting the model's single-feature misjudgment: combining merchant category, device trust, and geo-velocity context, it overrides or downgrades to review a high-value purchase from a known trusted device and matching category rather than auto-blocking on amount alone, sparing legit large txns.
options: 规则层在这里没有作用，应完全信任模型高分直接拦截
规则层是护栏，结合设备信任/类目/地理纠正金额误判
规则层会把所有高额交易一律放行，直接绕过模型打分
规则层只在模型宕机时启用，正常时不参与决策
options_en: The rules layer does nothing here; trust the high model score and block outright.
The rules layer is a guardrail using device trust, category and geo context to correct amount-only misjudgment.
The rules layer waves through every high-value transaction, bypassing model scoring.
The rules layer only kicks in when the model is down and stays idle otherwise.
optionExplanations: 盲信单特征高分会误拦合法大额采购，砸掉老客户体验，正是规则层要防的。
对；规则层用上下文给边界样本 override 或转人工，是模型概率之上的业务护栏。
规则层不是无脑放行高额，而是结合上下文判断，仍会拦真正可疑的大额欺诈。
规则层在正常流程里就与概率协同工作，不是只在宕机时的兜底(那是优雅降级)。
optionExplanations_en: Blindly trusting a single-feature high score falsely blocks a legit large purchase and wrecks a loyal customer's experience — exactly what the rules layer prevents.
Correct — the rules layer uses context to override or route borderline cases to review, a business guardrail atop the model probability.
The rules layer doesn't blindly pass high amounts; it judges with context and still blocks genuinely suspicious large fraud.
The rules layer works alongside the probability in the normal flow, not only as an outage fallback (that's graceful degradation).

termDefinitions.term: business rule override / 业务规则覆盖
termDefinitions.meaning: 在模型概率之上，用上下文规则纠正单特征误判(如合法高额被误拦)的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A business rule override uses context rules atop the model probability to correct single-feature misjudgments, like a legit high-value txn wrongly blocked.

scenario: 要为员工做一个知识助手，回答关于公司内部文档的问题(类似 Microsoft Copilot、Notion AI)。
scenario_en: You're building an employee knowledge assistant that answers questions over internal docs (like Microsoft Copilot, Notion AI).
q: 企业级 RAG 的核心工作方式是什么？
q_en: How does enterprise RAG fundamentally work?
why: RAG(检索增强生成)=先从内部文档里检索相关段落，再把这些段落喂给 LLM，让它合成一个带引用的回答。答案必须 grounded 在检索到的文档上、并注明来源，而不是让 LLM 凭记忆生成。
why_en: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) first retrieves relevant passages from internal docs, then feeds them to an LLM that synthesizes a cited answer grounded in those passages rather than generated from the model's memory.
diagram:
flowchart LR Q["员工提问"] --> R["检索相关段落
内部文档"] --> L["LLM 合成"] --> A["带引用的回答"]
options: 把整个文档库一次塞进 LLM 上下文，让它读完再答
先检索相关段落，再喂给 LLM 合成带引用的回答
用关键词搜索直接返回文档链接，由用户自己去读
先让 LLM 凭记忆答，再事后去文档里找证据补引用
options_en: Stuff the whole doc corpus into the LLM context and let it read everything before answering.
Retrieve the relevant passages first, then feed them to an LLM to synthesize a cited answer.
Return document links from keyword search and let the user read them.
Let the LLM answer from memory, then hunt for evidence afterward to attach citations.
optionExplanations: 百万级文档远超任何上下文窗口，全塞进去既不可能也昂贵，检索正是为了只取相关部分。
对；检索缩小到相关段落、LLM 在其上合成并引用来源，这是 RAG 的本质：先检索后生成。
纯关键词搜索返回链接不合成答案，缺了 RAG 的「生成」这一半。
先凭记忆再补引用会 grounding 不牢、易幻觉，RAG 是先给证据再生成，顺序相反。
optionExplanations_en: Millions of docs far exceed any context window; stuffing them all is impossible and costly — retrieval exists to take only the relevant part.
Correct — retrieval narrows to relevant passages and the LLM synthesizes over them with citations, the essence of RAG: retrieve then generate.
Pure keyword search returns links without synthesizing an answer, missing RAG's 'generate' half.
Answering from memory then attaching citations grounds weakly and hallucinates; RAG gives evidence first then generates, the opposite order.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索增强生成：先检索相关文档段落，再让 LLM 基于这些段落生成带引用的回答。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) retrieves relevant passages first, then has an LLM generate a cited answer grounded in them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 大语言模型，RAG 里负责把检索到的段落合成成自然语言回答。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An LLM (Large Language Model) synthesizes the retrieved passages into a natural-language answer in RAG.

termDefinitions.meaning: 回答的每个论断都能对应到检索出的源文档，而非凭空生成。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Grounded means every claim in the answer maps to a retrieved source document rather than being invented.

scenario: 同样是 RAG，ChatGPT 联网搜索(消费级)和企业内部知识助手在约束上根本不同。
scenario_en: Both are RAG, but ChatGPT web search (consumer) and an internal enterprise assistant differ fundamentally in constraints.
q: 企业级 RAG 相比消费级 RAG，最根本的新增约束是什么？
q_en: What's the most fundamental added constraint of enterprise vs consumer RAG?
why: 消费级 RAG 的数据都是公开网页，人人可见；企业级面对带访问控制的内部文档，必须做到「按用户、文档级」的权限执行——绝不给用户看他无权看的文档。加上高准确率要求和强制引用、以及 SOC 2/GDPR/HIPAA 合规。
why_en: Consumer RAG uses public web content anyone can see, while enterprise faces access-controlled internal docs and must enforce per-user, document-level permissions — never surfacing docs a user can't view — plus higher accuracy, mandatory citation, and SOC 2/GDPR/HIPAA compliance.
tradeoff: 企业级(逐用户文档级权限+强制引用+合规) vs 消费级(内容全公开、引用可选、宽松)
options: 企业级只是要求响应排版更花哨、更贴合品牌规范
必须做逐用户、文档级的权限执行，绝不泄露无权文档
企业级只是文档更多，检索与安全约束和消费级一样
企业级不需要引用，因为内部文档天然可信可靠
options_en: Enterprise just wants fancier formatting that matches brand guidelines.
You must enforce per-user, document-level permissions and never leak an unauthorized doc.
Enterprise just has more documents; retrieval and security constraints match consumer.
Enterprise needs no citations because internal docs are inherently trustworthy.
optionExplanations: 排版是表层，跟企业级的核心权限/合规约束不在一个量级。
对；逐用户文档级权限是企业级的根本新增约束，直接塑造从摄取到上下文组装的每个组件。
不只是量的差别——权限、合规、引用是消费级根本没有的质变约束。
恰恰相反，企业级引用是合规强制项，审计和法务都依赖它。
optionExplanations_en: Formatting is surface-level, nowhere near enterprise's core permission/compliance constraints.
Correct — per-user document-level permission is the fundamental added constraint, shaping every component from ingestion to context assembly.
It's not just a volume difference — permissions, compliance, and citation are qualitative constraints consumer RAG lacks.
The opposite — enterprise citation is a compliance mandate that auditors and legal depend on.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以单个文档为粒度控制哪个用户能否看到，企业 RAG 必须逐用户执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Document-level permission controls visibility per individual document, enforced per user in enterprise RAG.

scenario: 面试官要你先框定企业 RAG 的「不可妥协」需求，再谈架构。
scenario_en: The interviewer wants you to frame the non-negotiable requirements of enterprise RAG before architecture.
q: 企业级 RAG 的三条不可妥协需求是哪些？(多选)
q_en: Which are the three non-negotiable requirements of enterprise RAG? (multiple)
why: 三条：答案准确(grounded 不幻觉)、答案可追溯(每条回答引用具体源文档/段落)、严格数据隐私(绝不呈现用户无权查看的文档)。三者共同支撑企业用户对关键工作流的信任与合规。
why_en: Three: answer accuracy (grounded, not hallucinated), answer traceability (every response cites specific source docs/passages), and strict data privacy (never surface docs the user can't view), together underpinning trust and compliance for critical workflows.
options: 答案准确：grounded 在检索文档上、不幻觉
答案可追溯：每条回答引用具体源文档/段落供核验
严格数据隐私：绝不呈现查询用户无权查看的文档
回答字数越多越好，显得内容详实
options_en: Answer accuracy: grounded in retrieved docs, not hallucinated.
Answer traceability: every response cites specific source docs/passages for verification.
Strict data privacy: never surface docs the querying user can't view.
The longer the answer the better, to look thorough.
optionExplanations: 对；员工会据答案做财务/法律决策，幻觉一条不存在的条款代价极高，准确是底线。
对；引用让用户能核验、也满足审计/法务的合规要求，是信任的支柱。
对；逐用户文档级隐私是企业级的核心，泄露=合规违规与数据暴露。
错；冗长不是需求，反而稀释信噪比，与三条不可妥协需求无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — employees act on answers for financial/legal decisions, so hallucinating a nonexistent clause is very costly; accuracy is the floor.
Correct — citations let users verify and satisfy audit/legal compliance, a pillar of trust.
Correct — per-user document-level privacy is core to enterprise; a leak equals a compliance violation and data exposure.
Wrong — verbosity isn't a requirement and dilutes signal, unrelated to the three non-negotiables.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每条回答都标注它依据的具体源文档/段落，供用户核验、满足合规。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Answer traceability means every response cites the specific source docs/passages it relies on, for user verification and compliance.

scenario: 企业 RAG 里若答案不 grounded、出现幻觉，员工可能据此做财务或法律决策。
scenario_en: If an enterprise RAG answer isn't grounded and hallucinates, employees may act on it for financial or legal decisions.
q: 为什么企业场景下「答案准确」的风险被放大？
q_en: Why is the 'answer accuracy' risk amplified in the enterprise?
why: 消费级答错顶多误导个人；企业里员工会拿一条幻觉的法律条款或凭空发明的指标去做真实业务决策，后果是合规、财务、工程层面的连锁损失。所以准确不是加分项而是底线，必须 grounded 在源文档。
why_en: A wrong consumer answer merely misleads one person, but in the enterprise employees act on a hallucinated legal clause or invented metric in real decisions, cascading into compliance, financial, and engineering losses, so accuracy is a floor not a bonus and must be grounded in source docs.
options: 企业文档普遍更长，超出上下文窗口被截断的部分模型完全看不到
员工会据幻觉的法条或指标做真实决策，引发合规与财务损失
因为企业审批链更长，出错后要多花时间走内部申诉流程
风险其实更小：企业文档经过审核，模型不会产生幻觉
options_en: Enterprise docs tend to be longer, and whatever falls outside the context window gets truncated and the model never sees it.
Employees act on a hallucinated clause or metric in real decisions, causing compliance and financial losses.
Because enterprise approval chains are longer, so a mistake just takes more time to escalate internally.
The risk is lower — enterprise docs are reviewed, so the model won't hallucinate.
optionExplanations: 被截断确实会丢信息，但风险被放大的根源是员工把结果当真去做决策，不是截断本身。
对；企业里错误答案被直接用于决策，放大成真实的合规/财务/工程损失，所以准确是底线。
审批链长短是流程效率问题，不是准确性风险被放大的根源。
文档可信不代表模型不会幻觉——幻觉恰恰是无中生有，与源文档是否可信无关。
optionExplanations_en: Truncation does lose information, but the amplified risk comes from employees acting on the output, not the truncation itself.
Correct — in the enterprise wrong answers feed decisions directly, amplifying into real compliance/financial/engineering losses, so accuracy is the floor.
Approval-chain length is a process-efficiency issue, not the root of amplified accuracy risk.
Trusted docs don't stop hallucination — hallucination is invention, independent of whether sources are trusted.

termDefinitions.meaning: LLM 生成源文档中并不存在的内容，企业里会被误当事实用于决策。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hallucination is an LLM generating content not present in the source docs, mistaken as fact in enterprise decisions.

scenario: 企业 RAG 里如果不精确控制放进上下文的内容，LLM 可能把用户无权查看的文档也纳入它的推理链。
scenario_en: In enterprise RAG, without precise control of context contents the LLM may pull unauthorized docs into its reasoning chain.
q: 为什么「上下文窗口管理」是一个易被忽视的生产失败模式？
q_en: Why is 'context window management' an easily overlooked production failure mode?
why: 即使检索阶段过滤了权限，若上下文组装不严谨，无权文档仍可能混进 prompt，被 LLM 用于推理——既泄露隐私又污染答案、损害信任。所以权限执行要贯穿到上下文组装这一步，不能只在检索处做。
why_en: Even if retrieval filters permissions, sloppy context assembly can let unauthorized docs into the prompt where the LLM reasons over them — leaking privacy and degrading answers and trust — so permission enforcement must extend through context assembly, not only at retrieval.
options: 上下文塞太大只会拖慢生成、抬高成本，跟隐私和权限没关系
无权文档混进上下文会被 LLM 用于推理，既泄露又污染答案
上下文管理只是个 token 预算问题，靠加大窗口就能解决
只要检索那一步过滤了权限，上下文阶段就绝对安全
options_en: A bloated context only slows generation and raises cost — no privacy or permission angle.
Unauthorized docs that slip into context get reasoned over by the LLM, leaking data and polluting the answer.
Context management is just a token-budget problem you can fix by enlarging the window.
Once retrieval filters permissions, the context stage is completely safe.
optionExplanations: 不只是变慢：无权内容进入推理链是隐私泄露和答案污染，属于安全失败。
对；上下文组装是权限执行的最后一道关，漏了它检索处的过滤也白搭。
加大窗口解决的是容量而非权限问题；窗口越大反而给无权内容更多混入空间。
检索过滤和上下文组装是两步，后者疏忽仍可能让无权内容混入，不能只靠前者。
optionExplanations_en: Not just slower — unauthorized content entering the reasoning chain is privacy leakage and answer pollution, a security failure.
Correct — context assembly is the last gate for permission enforcement; skip it and retrieval-side filtering is wasted.
A bigger window fixes capacity, not permissions — it just gives unauthorized content more room to slip in.
Retrieval filtering and context assembly are two steps; negligence in the latter can still leak unauthorized content, so the former alone isn't enough.

termDefinitions.term: context window management / 上下文窗口管理
termDefinitions.meaning: 精确控制哪些文档段落进入 LLM 的输入上下文，是权限执行的最后一关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Context window management precisely controls which passages enter the LLM's input context, the last gate for permission enforcement.

scenario: 企业 RAG 运行在 SOC 2、GDPR、HIPAA 等合规框架下。
scenario_en: Enterprise RAG operates under SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA compliance frameworks.
q: 这些合规框架把「访问控制」定位成什么？
q_en: How do these frameworks position 'access control'?
why: SOC 2/GDPR/HIPAA 让访问控制成为核心架构需求，而非事后加的功能。它塑造从文档摄取、索引设计、检索预算到延迟的每个组件——把它当「最后加个过滤器」是 Staff+ 面试的负面信号。
why_en: SOC 2/GDPR/HIPAA make access control a core architectural requirement, not a bolt-on feature, shaping every component from ingestion and index design to retrieval budget and latency — treating it as 'add a filter at the end' is a negative Staff+ signal.
options: 一个可选的加分功能，等主链路做完有空再补上
核心架构需求，塑造从摄取、索引到检索预算的每个组件
只是前端登录页与 SSO 的事，与检索管线无关
运维层的审计日志需求，不影响系统架构设计
options_en: An optional nice-to-have to add once the main pipeline is done.
A core architectural requirement shaping every component from ingestion and index to retrieval budget.
Just a front-end login and SSO concern, unrelated to the retrieval pipeline.
An ops-layer audit-logging need that doesn't shape the architecture.
optionExplanations: 把它当可选加分正是负面信号——合规下访问控制是硬需求，不能可有可无。
对；它是贯穿全链路的核心约束，从索引里存不存 ACL 到检索预算怎么花都受它决定。
登录只是身份认证；文档级授权要深入索引和检索，远不止前端。
它不只是日志，而是决定哪些文档能进候选集的架构级执行点。
optionExplanations_en: Treating it as optional bonus is precisely the negative signal — under compliance access control is a hard requirement, not nice-to-have.
Correct — it's a whole-pipeline core constraint, deciding from whether ACLs live in the index to how the retrieval budget is spent.
Login is just authentication; document-level authorization must reach into index and retrieval, far beyond the front end.
It's not just logging but an architecture-level enforcement point deciding which docs enter the candidate set.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关于安全、可用性、机密性等的审计合规标准，要求严格访问控制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SOC 2 (System and Organization Controls 2) is an audit standard for security, availability, and confidentiality requiring strict access control.

termDefinitions.meaning: 欧盟通用数据保护条例，规范个人数据处理与用户权利。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) is the EU regulation governing personal data processing and user rights.

termDefinitions.fullName: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
termDefinitions.meaning: 美国医疗数据隐私法，要求对受保护健康信息严格管控。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) is the US health-data privacy law mandating strict control of protected health information.

scenario: 面试官要你为企业 RAG 定义端到端业务指标，用来衡量系统好坏。
scenario_en: The interviewer wants end-to-end business metrics to gauge the enterprise RAG system.
q: 企业 RAG 的四个业务指标是哪些？(多选)
q_en: Which are the four business metrics for enterprise RAG? (multiple)
why: 四指标：答案准确率(事实正确+grounded)、引用质量(precision+recall 两轴)、用户采纳率(多少合格员工每周用)、答复时延(query→完整响应，期望 <5 秒)。它们把「好」拆成可度量的准确、可信、被用、够快。
why_en: Four metrics: answer accuracy (factually correct + grounded), citation quality (precision + recall), user adoption rate (share of eligible employees using it weekly), and time-to-answer (query→full response, expected <5s), decomposing 'good' into accurate, trustworthy, adopted, and fast.
options: 答案准确率(事实正确且 grounded)
引用质量(precision + recall 两轴)
用户采纳率(多少合格员工每周使用)
答复时延(query→完整响应，期望 <5 秒)
GPU 集群的月度电费
options_en: Answer accuracy (factually correct and grounded).
Citation quality (precision + recall).
User adoption rate (share of eligible employees using it weekly).
Time-to-answer (query→full response, expected <5s).
Monthly electricity bill of the GPU cluster.
optionExplanations: 对；准确率衡量答案是否事实正确且有据，是最基本的质量。
对；引用质量分 precision(引对没)和 recall(引全没)两轴，缺关键来源即使答对也损信任。
对；采纳率反映它是否真的改变了员工原有的手动搜索/问 Slack 的工作方式。
对；时延是体验硬指标，企业用户期望 <5 秒拿到完整回答。
错；电费是基础设施成本，不是衡量 RAG 产品好坏的业务指标。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — accuracy measures whether the answer is factually correct and grounded, the most basic quality.
Correct — citation quality splits into precision (cited docs relevant) and recall (relevant docs cited); missing a key source undermines trust even if the answer is right.
Correct — adoption reflects whether it truly changed employees' prior manual-search/Slack-asking workflow.
Correct — latency is a hard experience metric; enterprise users expect a full answer in under 5 seconds.
Wrong — electricity is infrastructure cost, not a business metric of RAG product quality.

termDefinitions.term: user adoption rate / 用户采纳率
termDefinitions.meaning: 多少合格员工每周使用该系统，反映它是否改变原有工作流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: User adoption rate is the share of eligible employees using the system weekly, reflecting whether it changed existing workflows.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从提问到拿到完整响应的延迟，企业用户期望 <5 秒。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Time-to-answer is the latency from query to full response, with enterprise users expecting under 5 seconds.

scenario: 有人只用「引用的文档里有多少真的相关」来衡量引用质量。
scenario_en: Someone measures citation quality only by 'how many cited docs are actually relevant'.
q: 引用质量为什么需要 precision 和 recall 两个轴？
q_en: Why does citation quality need both precision and recall?
why: 引用 precision = 引用的文档里真正相关的比例(引对没)；引用 recall = 相关文档里被引用到的比例(引全没)。只看 precision 会漏掉「答案对但漏引了关键来源」——即使答对，缺关键引用也会损害用户信任。
why_en: Citation precision = fraction of cited docs actually relevant (did you cite right); citation recall = fraction of relevant docs actually cited (did you cite all). Precision alone misses 'answer right but a key source uncited', which undermines trust even when the answer is correct.
tradeoff: precision(引对没、防引无关) vs recall(引全没、防漏关键来源)
options: 只要 precision，引对了就行，漏没漏关键来源无所谓
precision 看引对没、recall 看引全没，两轴都要
只要 recall，引得越多越好，相不相关都不重要
两轴衡量的是同一件事，测其中一个就足够代表质量
options_en: Precision only — as long as the cites are right, missing key sources is fine.
Precision asks 'cited right', recall asks 'cited all' — you need both axes.
Recall only — cite as many sources as possible, relevance aside.
The two axes measure the same thing, so one of them is enough.
optionExplanations: 光盯着引对不引错，会放过整段没被引到的关键文档，审计核不出依据。
对；precision 防引无关、recall 防漏关键，两轴互补才完整刻画引用质量。
只看 recall 会引入大量无关来源，precision 崩塌，用户被噪声淹没。
两者衡量的是不同错误(引错 vs 漏引)，绝非同一件事。
optionExplanations_en: Watching only for wrong cites lets an entirely uncited key document slip through, so audit can't verify the basis.
Correct — precision guards against irrelevant cites, recall against missing key ones; both together fully characterize citation quality.
Recall alone pulls in many irrelevant sources, collapsing precision and burying users in noise.
They measure different errors (wrong cite vs missing cite), far from the same thing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 引用的文档中真正相关的比例，防止引入无关来源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Citation precision is the fraction of cited docs that are actually relevant, guarding against irrelevant sources.

termDefinitions.meaning: 相关文档中被实际引用的比例，防止漏掉关键来源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Citation recall is the fraction of relevant docs actually cited, guarding against missing key sources.

scenario: 为提高引用 recall，你把检索从 top-10 扩到 top-20，重排更多文档。
scenario_en: To raise citation recall, you expand retrieval from top-10 to top-20, re-ranking more docs.
q: 这个改动对时延意味着什么，怎么表述这个取舍？
q_en: What does this do to latency, and how do you state the tradeoff?
why: 多检索/重排文档会增加时延——例如 top-10→top-20 提升引用 recall 但约加 200ms 到答复时延。这不是精确公式而是量级示例；关键是把「引用 recall ↑ 换 时延 ↑」这个取舍明说出来，因为企业期望 <5 秒。
why_en: Retrieving/re-ranking more docs adds latency — e.g. top-10→top-20 raises citation recall but adds ~200ms to time-to-answer; not an exact formula but an order-of-magnitude example, and the point is to state the 'citation recall up for latency up' tradeoff explicitly given the <5s expectation.
options: 没有代价，检索更多总是更好，不用考虑任何权衡
会降低时延，因为候选文档一多，向量索引的近似检索反而命中更快
recall↑但时延↑(+200ms)，需在 <5秒预期下说清取舍
只增加计算成本，不影响用户感知的响应时延，因为重排是后台异步完成
options_en: No cost — retrieving more is always better, with no tradeoff to weigh.
It lowers latency, since a larger candidate set makes the vector index's approximate search hit faster.
Recall goes up but so does latency (+200ms); state that tradeoff under the <5s expectation.
It only adds compute cost, not latency, because reranking runs asynchronously in the background.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索并保留相似度最高的 k 个候选段落；k 越大 recall 越高但时延越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-k retrieval keeps the k highest-similarity candidate passages; larger k raises recall but latency.

optionExplanations: 检索和重排都要花时间，候选集变大只会推高算力和时延，天下没有零代价的扩检索。
命中容易不等于算得快，ANN 索引的查找耗时随候选规模上升，候选变多只会拖慢检索和重排，不会让时延下降。
对；扩大检索范围本质是用时延换 recall，面试时把这笔账摊开讲才够专业。
重排是生成回答前的同步阻塞步骤，不是后台异步任务，用户会直接感知到这段延迟，尤其在企业 <5 秒预期下。
optionExplanations_en: Retrieval and reranking both cost time, so a bigger candidate set only drives up compute and latency — there is no free scaling.
Easier hits do not mean faster computation; ANN search cost grows with candidate-set size, so more candidates only slow retrieval and reranking, it never cuts latency.
Correct — widening retrieval trades latency for recall, and naming that tradeoff out loud is exactly the senior move here.
Reranking is a synchronous step before the answer is generated, not a background async task, so users directly feel that latency, especially against the enterprise <5s expectation.

scenario: 5 万员工、文档级访问控制，要在「最小化未授权暴露」和「保住许可范围内的检索 recall」之间选权限执行方式。
scenario_en: 50K employees, document-level access control; choose an enforcement strategy that minimizes unauthorized exposure while preserving recall within the permitted set.
q: 该用预检索过滤(pre-retrieval)还是后检索过滤(post-retrieval)？
q_en: Pre-retrieval or post-retrieval filtering?
why: 用预检索 ACL 过滤：向量库查询时就带上 ACL 过滤条件，无权文档根本不进候选集，整个检索预算都花在授权内容上、不浪费槽位。后检索是先按相似度取回再过滤，会把 top-k 槽位浪费在无权文档上，挤掉授权内容、降低许可集内 recall。
why_en: Use pre-retrieval ACL filtering: the vector DB query carries an ACL filter so unauthorized docs never enter the candidate set and the whole retrieval budget goes to authorized content; post-retrieval fetches by similarity then filters, wasting top-k slots on unauthorized docs and crowding out authorized ones, degrading recall within the permitted set.
tradeoff: 预检索过滤(不浪费槽位、防泄露强，但需索引 ACL 元数据+快速传播) vs 后检索过滤(实现简单但浪费槽位、降许可集 recall)
whenOtherWins: 当权限极少变、文档集很小、且不便把 ACL 元数据索引进向量库时，后检索过滤实现更简单也够用。
diagram:
flowchart LR Q["用户查询 + 身份"] --> V["向量库检索
带 ACL 过滤"] --> C["仅授权候选"] --> L["LLM 生成"]
options: 后检索过滤：先按相似度取回 top-k，再按权限过滤掉无权文档
预检索 ACL 过滤：查询即带 ACL 条件，无权文档不进候选集
不做权限过滤，靠 LLM 在 prompt 里被提醒别引用敏感内容
把所有文档都设为对全员可见，用简化设计换取实现速度
options_en: Post-retrieval filtering: fetch top-k by similarity, then drop unauthorized docs by permission.
Pre-retrieval ACL filtering: the query carries an ACL condition so unauthorized docs never enter the candidate set.
No permission filtering — just remind the LLM in the prompt not to cite sensitive content.
Make every document visible to everyone, trading privacy for implementation speed.
optionExplanations: 后检索先取回再过滤，无权文档白占 top-k 槽位，把授权文档挤出候选，泄露面也更大。
对；预检索让无权文档根本进不了候选集，防泄露最强、检索预算不浪费，正是 50K 文档级场景的答案。
靠 prompt 提醒不是权限执行，无权内容一旦进上下文就已泄露，属于负面信号。
全公开直接违反文档级隐私和合规，是最糟的选择。
optionExplanations_en: Post-retrieval fetches then filters, so unauthorized docs waste top-k slots and push authorized ones out of the candidate set.
Correct — pre-retrieval keeps unauthorized docs out of the candidate set entirely, strongest against leakage and no wasted budget, the answer for the 50K document-level case.
Relying on prompt reminders isn't enforcement; once unauthorized content enters context it's already exposed — a negative signal.
Making everything public directly violates document-level privacy and compliance, the worst choice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 访问控制列表，规定哪些用户/角色可访问某文档，企业 RAG 里作为检索过滤条件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ACL (Access Control List) specifies which users/roles may access a document, used as a retrieval filter in enterprise RAG.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在向量库查询阶段就加 ACL 过滤，无权文档不进候选集。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pre-retrieval filtering applies the ACL filter at the vector-DB query stage so unauthorized docs never enter the candidate set.

scenario: 预检索 vs 后检索 ACL 过滤在效率、实现复杂度和 recall 上各有取舍。
scenario_en: Pre- vs post-retrieval ACL filtering trade off efficiency, implementation complexity, and recall.
q: 两种过滤策略的核心取舍是什么？
q_en: What's the core tradeoff between the two filtering strategies?
why: 预检索：效率高(检索预算全用在授权内容)、防泄露强，但要求 ACL 元数据随 embedding 一起建索引、且 ACL 变更能快速传播。后检索：实现简单(索引里不放权限元数据)，但浪费检索槽位、降低许可集内 recall。
why_en: Pre-retrieval is efficient (whole budget on authorized content) and leak-resistant but requires ACL metadata indexed with embeddings and fast ACL-change propagation; post-retrieval is simpler (no permission metadata in the index) but wastes retrieval slots and lowers recall within the permitted set.
tradeoff: 预检索(高效防泄露但需索引 ACL+快速传播) vs 后检索(简单但浪费槽位、降 recall)

rows: 需索引 ACL 元数据

options: 预检索实现更简单、后检索效率更高，所以应该一律选后检索
预检索高效防泄露但要索引 ACL 元数据;后检索简单但浪费槽位
两者最终返回的结果集完全一样，只是叫法和实现顺序不同
后检索防泄露更强，因为过滤发生在送进 prompt 前的最后一步
options_en: Pre-retrieval is simpler and post-retrieval faster, so always pick post-retrieval.
Pre-retrieval is efficient and leak-resistant but needs ACL metadata indexed; post is simple but wastes slots.
Both return exactly the same result set; only the name and the order of steps differ.
Post-retrieval resists leaks better because filtering is the last step before the prompt.
optionExplanations: 说反了：预检索更高效(不浪费槽位)，后检索实现更简单，选择取决于约束。
对；预检索用索引复杂度换效率与安全，后检索用 recall/安全换实现简单，取舍清晰。
两者在 recall 与泄露风险上差别明显，绝非仅叫法不同。
后检索恰恰更易泄露：无权文档先被取回进入候选，泄露窗口更大。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: pre-retrieval is more efficient (no wasted slots), post is simpler to implement; the choice depends on constraints.
Correct — pre trades index complexity for efficiency and safety, post trades recall/safety for simplicity, a clear tradeoff.
They differ clearly in recall and leak risk, far from just naming.
Post-retrieval is actually more leak-prone: unauthorized docs are fetched into candidates first, widening the leak window.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先按相似度检索再按权限过滤，实现简单但无权文档会占掉检索槽位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Post-retrieval filtering retrieves by similarity then filters by permission — simpler but unauthorized docs occupy retrieval slots.

scenario: 后检索过滤：检索 top-20，结果里 12 个是当前用户无权查看的文档。
scenario_en: Post-retrieval filtering: retrieve top-20, and 12 of them are docs the current user can't view.
q: 过滤后还剩多少可用授权段落，这说明什么问题？
q_en: How many authorized passages remain after filtering, and what problem does this show?
why: 20 − 12 = 只剩 8 个授权段落进入上下文——检索槽位被无权文档白白占掉，等于用户实际只享受到 top-8 的 recall。这就是后检索「浪费检索槽位、降低许可集内 recall」的直接体现。预检索则一开始就只取授权文档。
why_en: 20 − 12 = only 8 authorized passages remain for context — retrieval slots wasted on unauthorized docs mean the user effectively gets only top-8 recall, the direct manifestation of post-retrieval 'wasting slots and lowering permitted-set recall', whereas pre-retrieval fetches only authorized docs from the start.
options: 还剩 20 个，因为权限过滤不会改变检索到的数量
还剩 8 个授权段落，12 个槽位被无权文档占用
还剩 12 个，因为无权限的文档反而是有用的内容
剩几个都不影响答案质量，数量多少无所谓
options_en: 20 remain, because permission filtering doesn’t change the retrieved count.
8 authorized passages remain — 12 slots were occupied by unauthorized docs.
12 remain, because the unauthorized ones are actually the useful content.
However many remain doesn’t affect answer quality, so the count is irrelevant.

termDefinitions.term: wasted retrieval slots / 浪费的检索槽位
termDefinitions.meaning: 后检索里无权文档占据 top-k 名额，挤走授权文档，降低许可集内 recall。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wasted retrieval slots are top-k spots taken by unauthorized docs in post-retrieval, crowding out authorized ones and lowering permitted-set recall.

optionExplanations: 过滤会把无权文档摘掉，候选数量必然跟着减少，不可能还停在原来的 20 个。
对；数一遍到底有多少槽位被无权文档占掉，就看清后检索白白扔掉了多少许可集内的 recall。
无权文档本来就没资格进上下文，谈不上「有用」，过滤正是要把它们剔除。
槽位数量直接决定进上下文的段落数、进而决定答案能覆盖到的证据，绝非无所谓。
optionExplanations_en: Filtering strips out unauthorized docs, so the candidate count necessarily shrinks — it cannot stay at 20.
Correct — tally how many slots unauthorized docs ate up and you see exactly how much permitted-set recall post-retrieval throws away.
Unauthorized docs have no business entering context at all, so calling them ‘useful’ misses the point of filtering.
The slot count directly caps how many passages reach context and thus how much evidence the answer can cover — far from irrelevant.

scenario: 你选了预检索 ACL 过滤，但用户的权限会随入职/转岗/项目变更频繁调整。
scenario_en: You chose pre-retrieval ACL filtering, but user permissions change frequently with onboarding, transfers, and project changes.
q: 预检索方案为此必须付出什么工程代价？
q_en: What engineering cost must the pre-retrieval approach pay for this?
why: 预检索要求 ACL 元数据在摄取时就随 embedding 一起建索引，且权限变更要能快速传播到索引——否则转岗后仍能检索到旧权限文档，造成暴露。代价是索引/摄取更复杂、要维护 ACL 更新管线，换来的是不浪费槽位与强防泄露。
why_en: Pre-retrieval requires ACL metadata indexed with embeddings at ingestion and fast propagation of permission changes into the index — otherwise a transferred user still retrieves stale-permission docs, causing exposure — at the cost of more complex indexing/ingestion and an ACL-update pipeline, in exchange for no wasted slots and strong leak resistance.
options: 不需要任何额外代价，源系统的权限变更会自动实时同步进入向量索引
摄取时把 ACL 元数据随 embedding 建索引，变更要快传播
只要每季度重建一次全量索引，就足以保证索引里的权限元数据始终最新
把全量权限表缓存到客户端本地、交给前端过滤，服务端完全不用再参与
options_en: No extra cost at all — permission changes in the source system sync into the vector index automatically in real time.
Index ACL metadata with embeddings at ingestion and propagate changes fast.
Rebuilding the whole index once a quarter is enough to keep the permission metadata always fresh.
Cache the full permission table locally on the client and hand filtering to the front end; the server stays completely out of it.
optionExplanations: 权限不会凭空自动生效——索引里的 ACL 元数据必须被主动更新，否则就是旧权限。
对；ACL 随 embedding 入索引 + 快速传播是预检索的前提，否则转岗用户仍能命中旧文档，造成暴露。
每季度重建也不够快，转岗当天旧权限文档仍可能被检索到，暴露窗口依然过长。
权限执行必须在服务端/索引侧，客户端缓存可被绕过，等于没有强制。
optionExplanations_en: Permissions don't take effect out of thin air — the index's ACL metadata must be actively updated, else it's stale.
Correct — ACL indexed with embeddings plus fast propagation is pre-retrieval's prerequisite, or a transferred user still hits old docs, causing exposure.
Quarterly rebuilds still aren't fast enough; a transferred user can still hit stale-permission docs the same day, an overlong exposure window.
Permission enforcement must be server/index-side; a client cache can be bypassed and isn't real enforcement.

termDefinitions.meaning: 权限变更后及时同步到检索索引，避免检索到用户已无权的文档。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ACL propagation is timely syncing of permission changes into the retrieval index so users can't retrieve docs they no longer may access.

scenario: 候选人把访问控制描述为「在检索结果最后加一个过滤器」。
scenario_en: A candidate describes access control as 'add a filter at the end of the retrieval results'.
q: 为什么这在 Staff+ 面试里是负面信号？
q_en: Why is this a negative Staff+ signal?
why: 把访问控制当事后过滤器，忽略了它其实影响摄取(是否抽取 ACL 元数据)、索引设计(权限能否作为过滤维度)、检索预算(槽位是否被无权文档占用)和延迟。它是贯穿全链路的架构约束，只在末端加过滤既低效又易泄露。
why_en: Treating access control as an end filter ignores that it actually affects ingestion (whether ACL metadata is extracted), index design (whether permission is a filter dimension), retrieval budget (whether slots go to unauthorized docs), and latency — it's a whole-pipeline architectural constraint, and a filter tacked on only at the end is both inefficient and leak-prone.
options: 因为末端过滤器写起来慢、运行时性能差，拖累 P99 时延
访问控制影响摄取、索引与检索预算，是全链路约束
因为 Staff+ 应该只谈架构，访问控制属于实现细节
这不是负面信号，在最后一步加过滤本来就是业界最佳实践
options_en: Because an end-stage filter is slow to write and slow at runtime, hurting P99 latency.
Access control shapes ingestion, indexing, and retrieval budget — it's a whole-pipeline constraint.
Because Staff+ should discuss architecture only; access control is an implementation detail.
It's not a negative signal — filtering at the last step is the industry best practice.
optionExplanations: 问题不是过滤器慢，而是它放错了位置、忽略了对全链路的塑造。
对；访问控制贯穿摄取到上下文组装，末端加过滤既浪费检索预算又留泄露窗口，暴露架构理解不足。
恰恰相反，Staff+ 正应把访问控制作为核心架构约束深入讨论。
末端过滤正是负面信号：它低效且不安全，不是最佳实践。
optionExplanations_en: The issue isn't a slow filter but its wrong placement, ignoring how it shapes the whole pipeline.
Correct — access control spans ingestion to context assembly; an end filter wastes retrieval budget and leaves a leak window, exposing weak architectural understanding.
On the contrary, Staff+ should discuss access control as a core architectural constraint in depth.
An end filter is precisely the negative signal: inefficient and unsafe, not best practice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把访问控制当末端附加步骤而非架构约束，导致低效与泄露风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An afterthought filter treats access control as a tacked-on final step rather than an architectural constraint, causing inefficiency and leak risk.

scenario: 公司已有成熟的文档权限系统，你不想在向量库里再复制一份权限、又怕两边不同步导致「权限漂移」。
scenario_en: The company already has a mature doc-permission system; you don't want to duplicate permissions in the vector DB and risk 'permission drift' from the two getting out of sync.
q: 现代做法怎么避免权限重复与漂移？
q_en: How do modern designs avoid duplicating permissions and permission drift?
why: 用基于 agent 的架构：运行时让 agent 直接查询源系统，复用源系统既有的访问控制，而不是把权限复制进向量索引。这样权限只有一份真相源，避免了索引侧权限与源系统不同步导致的 permission drift。
why_en: Use an agent-based architecture where at runtime the agent queries source systems directly and reuses their existing access controls rather than duplicating permissions into the vector index, keeping a single source of truth and avoiding permission drift from the index falling out of sync.
tradeoff: agent 直查源系统(复用既有权限、无漂移但运行时更慢/更复杂) vs 索引内复制 ACL(检索快但要维护同步、有漂移风险)
whenOtherWins: 当源系统查询太慢或不可用、且权限变更极少时，把 ACL 预索引进向量库、接受同步维护反而检索更快。
options: 把权限快照复制进向量索引，再定期跑批手动同步
agent 运行时直查源系统、复用其既有访问控制
干脆不做权限过滤，默认信任所有内部员工都可看
每次查询都让文档管理员人工审批一次再返回结果
options_en: Copy a permission snapshot into the vector index and sync it manually on a batch schedule.
Have the agent query source systems at runtime and reuse their existing access controls.
Skip permission filtering entirely and assume every internal employee may see everything.
Route every single query through a document admin for manual approval before returning.
optionExplanations: 复制快照+定期同步正是权限漂移的来源：源系统改了、索引没跟上就会泄露。
对；agent 运行时直查源系统，权限只有一份真相源，天然避免复制与漂移。
不做权限直接违反文档级隐私和合规，是最糟选择。
每次人工审批无法规模化，5 万员工的查询量会瞬间压垮管理员。
optionExplanations_en: A copied snapshot plus periodic sync is exactly where drift comes from: the source changes, the index lags, and data leaks.
Correct — the agent queries source systems at runtime, keeping a single source of truth and inherently avoiding duplication and drift.
Skipping permissions directly violates document-level privacy and compliance, the worst choice.
Manual per-query approval doesn't scale; 50K employees' query volume would instantly overwhelm admins.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让 agent 在运行时直接查询各源系统，复用源系统的访问控制，而非在索引里复制权限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Agent-based (agentic) RAG has an agent query source systems directly at runtime, reusing their access controls instead of duplicating permissions in the index.

termDefinitions.meaning: 索引里复制的权限与源系统真实权限随时间失步，造成越权访问。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Permission drift is when permissions copied into the index fall out of sync with the source system over time, enabling unauthorized access.

scenario: 面试官问：企业 RAG 最主要的生产失败模式是什么？
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: what is enterprise RAG's primary production failure mode?
q: 首要失败模式是什么，哪种过滤更能缓解？
q_en: What's the primary failure mode, and which filtering mitigates it better?
why: 首要失败模式是缺乏健壮访问控制→未授权数据暴露/合规违规。预检索过滤更能防对抗性数据外泄，因为无权文档从一开始就不进候选集，不给攻击者通过精心构造查询把敏感内容捞进上下文的机会。
why_en: The primary failure mode is lack of robust access control → unauthorized data exposure/compliance violations, and pre-retrieval filtering better mitigates adversarial exfiltration because unauthorized docs never enter the candidate set, denying attackers the chance to pull sensitive content into context via crafted queries.
options: 首要失败是端到端延迟过高，靠加一层结果缓存就能解决
首要失败是缺访问控制→未授权暴露;预检索过滤更防对抗外泄
首要失败是 GPU 推理容量不够，靠加机器扩容就能解决
首要失败是 UI 不够好看，靠前端改版来提升采纳率
options_en: The main failure is end-to-end latency, solved by adding a result cache.
The main failure is missing access control → unauthorized exposure; pre-retrieval filtering better blocks adversarial exfiltration.
The main failure is not enough GPU inference capacity, solved by adding machines.
The main failure is an unattractive UI, solved by a front-end redesign to lift adoption.
optionExplanations: 延迟是体验问题，不是最严重的、会造成合规违规的失败模式。
对；数据暴露是企业 RAG 最致命的失败，预检索让无权文档进不了候选集，从源头堵住外泄。
算力是容量问题，跟未授权暴露这个首要失败模式无关。
UI 是表层，跟数据安全的首要失败模式不在一个层级。
optionExplanations_en: Latency is an experience issue, not the most severe, compliance-violating failure mode.
Correct — data exposure is enterprise RAG's most fatal failure, and pre-retrieval keeps unauthorized docs out of candidates, blocking exfiltration at the source.
Compute is a capacity issue, unrelated to the primary unauthorized-exposure failure mode.
UI is surface-level, not on the same plane as the primary data-security failure mode.

termDefinitions.meaning: 攻击者诱导系统把无权内容取回并暴露；预检索过滤从候选集源头阻断。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exfiltration is coaxing the system to retrieve and expose unauthorized content; pre-retrieval filtering blocks it at the candidate-set source.

scenario: 某回答事实完全正确，但漏引了一份关键的源文档。
scenario_en: An answer is factually correct but fails to cite one key source document.
q: 为什么即使答案正确，漏引关键来源仍是问题？
q_en: Why is a missing key citation still a problem even when the answer is correct?
why: 企业用户和审计/法务靠引用来核验答案依据；漏引关键来源(引用 recall 低)让人无法确认答案的完整出处，即使内容对也削弱信任与合规。可追溯是硬需求，正确但不可核验仍不合格。
why_en: Enterprise users and audit/legal rely on citations to verify the basis; a missing key source (low citation recall) prevents confirming the answer's full provenance, undermining trust and compliance even when the content is right — traceability is a hard requirement, so correct-but-unverifiable still fails.
options: 不是问题，只要答案内容正确，有没有引用都无所谓
漏引关键来源让用户与审计无法核验依据，损信任与合规
只是排版上的小瑕疵，不影响用户对答案的信任
漏引反而更好，回答更简洁、用户读起来更快
options_en: Not a problem — as long as the content is right, citations don't matter.
A missing key source stops users and auditors from verifying the basis, hurting trust and compliance.
It's a minor formatting flaw that doesn't affect users' trust in the answer.
Missing citations is better — the answer reads shorter and faster.
optionExplanations: 答对不等于可核验；企业要能追溯依据，缺关键引用就无法信任地采用。
对；引用 recall 低=依据不完整，审计/法务无法验证，正确性不能替代可追溯性。
漏引不是排版问题，而是可追溯这一硬需求的缺失。
简洁不能以牺牲可核验为代价，缺关键引用是实质缺陷不是优点。
optionExplanations_en: Correct isn't verifiable; enterprises need traceable basis, and a missing key citation blocks trusted adoption.
Correct — low citation recall means incomplete basis that audit/legal can't verify; correctness can't substitute for traceability.
A missing citation isn't formatting but a failure of the hard traceability requirement.
Conciseness can't come at the cost of verifiability; a missing key citation is a substantive defect, not a merit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 答案每个论断的来源文档链路，可追溯性要求它对用户可见可核验。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Provenance is the source-document trail behind each claim; traceability requires it be visible and verifiable to users.

scenario: 同一道企业 RAG 题，L4、L5、Staff+ 期望的作答范围不同。
scenario_en: On the same enterprise RAG question, L4, L5, and Staff+ are expected to scope differently.
q: L4 / L5 / Staff+ 的作答边界大致在哪？
q_en: Where roughly are the L4/L5/Staff+ scoping boundaries?
why: L4 做完整基础管线并定义指标;L5 加混合检索、多阶段重排与预/后检索 ACL 取舍;Staff+ 谈零停机重建、版本迁移、对抗防御与成本。
why_en: L4 builds the end-to-end basic pipeline and defines metrics; L5 adds hybrid retrieval, multi-stage reranking and pre/post ACL tradeoffs; Staff+ covers zero-downtime rebuilds, version migration, adversarial defense and cost.
tradeoff: L4(基础单阶段管线) vs L5(混合检索+多阶段重排+ACL 细节) vs Staff+(零停机重建+版本迁移+漂移监控+成本)
options: 三级考察内容完全相同，区别只在谁讲得更多、时间铺得更满
L4 基础单阶段管线;L5 混合检索+重排;Staff+ 零停机重建+对抗防御
L4 最深最全，L5 次之，Staff+ 最浅，级别越高越可省略细节
只有 Staff+ 谈检索与索引重建，L4/L5 只需谈产品与 UI 交互
options_en: All three levels cover the same content; the only difference is who talks longer.
L4 a basic single-stage pipeline; L5 hybrid retrieval plus reranking; Staff+ zero-downtime rebuilds and adversarial defense.
L4 is the deepest and broadest, L5 next, Staff+ the shallowest — higher levels skip more detail.
Only Staff+ discusses retrieval and index rebuilds; L4 and L5 just cover product and UI.
optionExplanations: 级别差异在覆盖深度与运维/对抗维度，不是话多话少。
对；从单阶段基础管线到混合检索+重排，再到零停机重建+对抗防御+漂移监控，逐级加深。
说反了：Staff+ 覆盖最广最深，L4 最基础。
各级都要谈检索，UI 从来不是这道题的重点。
optionExplanations_en: The level difference is coverage depth and ops/adversarial dimensions, not verbosity.
Correct — from a single-stage basic pipeline to hybrid retrieval + reranking to zero-downtime rebuilds + adversarial defense + drift monitoring, deepening by level.
Backwards: Staff+ is the broadest and deepest, L4 the most basic.
Every level discusses retrieval; UI was never the point of this question.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结合 dense 向量检索与 BM25 关键词检索，用学习到的权重融合两者结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hybrid retrieval combines dense vector search with BM25 keyword search, fusing results via learned weights.

scenario: 很多候选人把精力都花在背检索机制细节上。
scenario_en: Many candidates spend all their prep memorizing retrieval-mechanism details.
q: 这道题上候选人最常见的准备偏差是什么？
q_en: What's the most common prep imbalance on this question?
why: 多数人过度准备检索机制、却准备不足「分级作答(scoping)」本身——即按 L4/L5/Staff+ 分层给出对应深度、并解释业务指标如何映射到架构。面试更看重你能不能把范围框对，而不是背更多算法。
why_en: Most overprepare retrieval mechanics and underprepare the scoping discussion itself — giving the right depth per L4/L5/Staff+ and mapping business metrics to architecture — since interviews value framing the scope correctly over memorizing more algorithms.
options: 过度准备业务指标与产品叙事，反而忽视了检索机制
过度准备检索机制、准备不足分级作答与业务指标映射
过度准备前端 UI 与交互，忽视了后端检索与索引设计
准备得刚刚好，这道题上候选人普遍不存在偏差
options_en: Overprepare business metrics and product narrative while neglecting retrieval mechanics.
Overprepare retrieval mechanics and underprepare scoping and the business-metric mapping.
Overprepare front-end UI and interaction while neglecting backend retrieval and indexing.
Prep is well balanced; candidates generally have no skew on this question.
optionExplanations: 偏差方向反了：多数人恰恰是检索机制准备过头、指标与 scoping 不足。
对；检索机制背得多但框不对范围，面试更看重按级别给对深度、把指标映射到架构。
UI 从来不是这道题重点，不是常见偏差。
普遍存在明显偏差，说没有偏差不符合观察。
optionExplanations_en: The direction is reversed: most actually overprepare retrieval mechanics and underprepare metrics and scoping.
Correct — heavy on retrieval mechanics but wrong on scope; interviews value giving the right depth per level and mapping metrics to architecture.
UI was never the point of this question, not a common imbalance.
A clear imbalance is common, so claiming none contradicts observation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按目标级别(L4/L5/Staff+)决定作答的广度与深度，并解释取舍。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A scoping discussion decides the breadth and depth of an answer per target level (L4/L5/Staff+) and explains the tradeoffs.

scenario: 把企业 RAG「安全地回答一个员工问题」的请求链路排序。
scenario_en: Order the request flow for enterprise RAG to safely answer one employee question.
q: 把带权限的企业 RAG 请求链路排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the permission-aware enterprise RAG request flow correctly:
steps: 接收员工查询 + 其身份/权限
向量库检索时带 ACL 过滤，只取授权段落
把授权段落组装进上下文窗口(不混入无权内容)
LLM 基于上下文生成 grounded 且带引用的回答
why: 链路是:拿到查询+身份→预检索 ACL 过滤只取授权段落→上下文组装守住权限→LLM 生成带引用回答。权限执行贯穿检索与上下文两步，任一处漏权限都可能把无权内容送进 LLM 推理。
why_en: The flow: take query+identity, pre-retrieval ACL filter to fetch only authorized passages, assemble context guarding permissions, then the LLM generates a cited answer — enforcement spans retrieval and context, and a gap in either can feed unauthorized content into LLM reasoning.
diagram:
flowchart LR A["查询+身份"] --> B["ACL 过滤检索
仅授权段落"] --> C["上下文组装
守住权限"] --> D["LLM 生成
带引用回答"]

termDefinitions.term: permission-aware retrieval / 权限感知检索
termDefinitions.meaning: 检索时结合用户身份的 ACL 过滤，确保候选段落都在用户权限内。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Permission-aware retrieval applies an ACL filter tied to the user's identity so all candidate passages are within their permissions.

scenario: 把企业 RAG 的三条不可妥协需求背成一句。
scenario_en: Memorize the three non-negotiable enterprise RAG requirements in one line.
q: 补全企业 RAG 三条不可妥协需求：
q_en: Fill in the three non-negotiable enterprise RAG requirements:
text: 企业 RAG 三不可妥协：答案{{准确}}(grounded 不幻觉)、答案{{可追溯}}(强制引用源文档)、严格数据{{隐私}}(逐用户文档级，绝不呈现无权文档)。合规底座：{{SOC 2}}/GDPR/HIPAA。
text_en: Three non-negotiables: answer {{accuracy}} (grounded, no hallucination), answer {{traceability}} (mandatory source citation), strict data {{privacy}} (per-user document-level, never surface unauthorized docs). Compliance base: {{SOC 2}}/GDPR/HIPAA.
why: 这三条是框定整道题的锚:准确保证能用、可追溯保证可信、隐私保证合规。记住它们+合规底座，就能在开场把企业 RAG 的需求和消费级区分开。
why_en: These three anchor the whole question: accuracy makes it usable, traceability trustworthy, privacy compliant; remembering them plus the compliance base lets you distinguish enterprise from consumer RAG up front.

termDefinitions.term: non-negotiable requirement / 不可妥协需求
termDefinitions.meaning: 系统必须满足、不能为其他目标牺牲的硬约束，企业 RAG 有准确/可追溯/隐私三条。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A non-negotiable requirement is a hard constraint the system must meet and can't trade away, here accuracy, traceability, and privacy.

scenario: 把企业 RAG 的四个业务指标背成一组。
scenario_en: Memorize the four enterprise RAG business metrics as a set.
q: 补全企业 RAG 四个业务指标：
q_en: Fill in the four enterprise RAG business metrics:
text: 四指标:答案{{准确率}}、引用质量({{precision}} + {{recall}} 两轴)、用户{{采纳率}}(每周活跃合格员工%)、答复时延(期望 <{{5}} 秒)。
text_en: Four metrics: answer {{accuracy}}, citation quality ({{precision}} + {{recall}}), user {{adoption}} rate (weekly-active eligible %), time-to-answer (expect <{{5}}s).
why: 四指标把「好」拆成准确、可信、被用、够快。记住引用要分 precision/recall 两轴、时延目标 <5 秒，就能在指标环节答满并引出 recall↔时延的取舍。
why_en: The four decompose 'good' into accurate, trustworthy, adopted, and fast; remembering citation's precision/recall axes and the <5s target lets you fully answer the metrics section and surface the recall↔latency tradeoff.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从产品价值角度衡量系统的指标(准确/引用/采纳/时延)，区别于纯模型指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A business metric gauges the system from product value (accuracy/citation/adoption/latency), distinct from pure model metrics.

scenario: 系统答案准确、引用也齐全，但只有很少员工每周使用它，多数人还是手动搜索或在 Slack 上问。
scenario_en: The system is accurate and well-cited, yet few employees use it weekly; most still search manually or ask on Slack.
q: 用哪个指标能捕捉「它是否真的改变了工作方式」？
q_en: Which metric captures 'did it actually change how people work'?
why: 用用户采纳率(每周使用的合格员工占比)。准确/引用衡量单次回答质量，但采纳率才反映系统是否真的取代了原有的手动搜索/问 Slack 的工作流——低采纳说明再准也没被真正用起来。
why_en: Use user adoption rate (share of eligible employees using it weekly); accuracy/citation measure single-answer quality, but adoption reflects whether the system actually replaced the manual-search/Slack-asking workflow — low adoption means even an accurate system isn't truly used.
tradeoff: 用户采纳率(反映工作流是否被改变) vs 单次准确/引用(只反映回答质量、不代表被使用)
whenOtherWins: 当系统刚上线、还在验证单次回答是否可信时,先盯准确率/引用质量比盯采纳率更有意义。
options: 答案准确率，只要每次答得准，员工自然会持续依赖它
用户采纳率：每周使用的合格员工占比，看工作流真被替代
端到端答复时延，只要响应够快就说明系统已经被广泛采纳
GPU 利用率，算力用得越多说明员工问得越多
options_en: Answer accuracy — if it's accurate every time, employees will naturally keep depending on it.
User adoption rate: share of eligible employees using it weekly, showing the workflow really changed.
End-to-end time-to-answer — fast responses alone mean the system has been broadly adopted.
GPU utilization — more compute used means employees ask more.
optionExplanations: 准确是必要不充分:答案再准，若没融入工作流、员工不用，价值也没兑现。
对;采纳率直接衡量员工是否用它替代了手动搜索/问 Slack，捕捉工作流是否被改变。
时延快只是体验好的一环，不等于被采纳，快而无人用照样是低采纳。
GPU 利用率反映的是负载/成本，可能来自后台任务，不等于用户采纳。
optionExplanations_en: Accuracy is necessary but not sufficient: even a very accurate answer delivers no value if it isn't woven into workflows and people don't use it.
Correct — adoption rate directly measures whether employees use it to replace manual search/Slack, capturing whether the workflow changed.
Fast latency is one facet of good experience, not adoption; fast-but-unused is still low adoption.
GPU utilization reflects load/cost, possibly from background jobs, and doesn't equal user adoption.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统是否真的取代了员工原有的手动搜索、问同事等做法，由采纳率反映。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Workflow change is whether the system actually replaced employees' prior manual search or asking colleagues, reflected by adoption rate.

scenario: 企业 RAG 是 MAANG 高频题，一道题同时考多个能力维度。
scenario_en: Enterprise RAG is a frequent MAANG question that tests several dimensions at once.
q: 这道题同时考察哪三个能力维度？
q_en: Which three capability dimensions does this question test at once?
why: 它同时考:检索管线设计(分块/embedding/混合检索/重排)、数据隐私推理(逐用户文档级访问控制)、端到端指标定义(准确/引用/采纳/时延)。正因为一题三考，框架比堆细节更重要。
why_en: It simultaneously tests retrieval-pipeline design (chunking/embedding/hybrid/reranking), data-privacy reasoning (per-user document-level access control), and end-to-end metric definition (accuracy/citation/adoption/latency) — so framing beats piling on detail.
options: 检索管线设计、Prompt 工程技巧、模型选型对比
检索管线设计、数据隐私推理、端到端指标定义
检索管线设计、上线成本优化、灰度发布回滚策略
只考检索，其它都不重要
