addStock throws and stops the call outright; it isn't silently skipped.
This reverses it: the code throws in addStock and returns false in removeStock.
why: addStock 对无效 warehouseId 直接 throw，removeStock 却和库存不足一样返回 false，两种失败信号并不对称。
why_en: addStock throws on an invalid warehouseId, while removeStock returns false just like it does for insufficient stock — the two failure signals aren't symmetric.
tradeoff: throw 让调用方无法忽略错误 vs return false 能把所有失败原因合并成一次判断
whenOtherWins: 如果团队约定所有失败都用返回值表达，应把 addStock 也改成返回 boolean，保持两者一致。

scenario: 团队要在 naive、defensive、atomic 三版 transfer 里选一个上生产。
scenario_en: The team must pick one of the naive, defensive, and atomic transfer versions for production.
q: 哪一版必须排除，另外两版又是什么取舍？
q_en: Which version must be excluded, and what tradeoff separates the other two?
options: naive 排除（正确性 bug）；defensive、atomic 都可接受
naive 和 defensive 都必须排除，只有 atomic 版本能被允许上生产
三版性能有差异但逻辑都正确，选哪个纯粹看团队喜好
atomic 必须排除，因为它会同时锁住两个仓库拖累吞吐
options_en: naive is out (a correctness bug); defensive and atomic are both acceptable.
Both naive and defensive must be excluded; only the atomic version is allowed in production.
All three are logically correct with only performance differences; pick by team taste.
atomic must be excluded because locking two warehouses at once drags down throughput.
optionExplanations: 只有一版有真正的正确性缺陷，另外两版只是并发度和一致性程度之间的选择。
defensive 已经用 removeStock 返回值堵住了 TOCTOU，没有正确性 bug，不必一并排除。
naive 那版会真的丢库存或产生幻影库存，不是三版都正确、只看喜好。
锁两个仓库换来的是外部可观察的真原子性，是可接受的代价，不是必须排除的缺陷。
optionExplanations_en: Only one version has a genuine correctness defect; the other two are a choice between concurrency and consistency level.
defensive already closes the TOCTOU race via removeStock's return value, so it has no correctness bug to exclude.
naive genuinely loses or duplicates stock — it isn't a case of all three being correct.
Locking two warehouses buys externally visible true atomicity, an acceptable cost, not a defect to rule out.
why: naive 是正确性 bug（幻影库存），生产不可接受；defensive 和 atomic 都正确，只在中间态可见性和并发度间取舍。
why_en: naive has a real correctness bug and is never production-acceptable; defensive and atomic are both correct, differing only in intermediate-state visibility and concurrency cost.
tradeoff: defensive 并发更高、允许短暂中间态 vs atomic 强一致但锁两仓库
whenOtherWins: 只要没人做跨仓总量聚合查询，defensive 换来的并发提升通常更划算。

scenario: 结账 reservation 超时可以设 30 秒，也可以设 10 分钟。
scenario_en: The checkout reservation timeout could be set to 30 seconds or to 10 minutes.
q: 该怎么在这两个极端之间选超时长度？
q_en: How should the timeout length be chosen between these two extremes?
options: 太短挤掉正在填单的用户，太长占用库存，多数落在 5-15 分钟
只要系统吞吐扛得住，超时长短对用户体验来说完全没有任何影响
越短越好，能让库存最快归还给下一个排队买家
越长越好，能保证每个点击购买的用户都能付完款
options_en: Too short cancels users mid-checkout, too long locks stock — most settle around 5-15 minutes.
As long as throughput holds up, the timeout length has zero effect on user experience.
Shorter is always better since it returns stock to the next buyer in line fastest.
Longer is always better since it guarantees every buyer who clicks can finish paying.
optionExplanations: 30 秒可能挤掉正在填支付信息的用户，10 分钟又让别人白等库存；多数电商落在 5-15 分钟。
超时太短会把还在操作的正常用户挤出结账流程，这是体验问题，不只是吞吐问题。
一味求短会误伤正在正常结账的用户，不是归还越快就一定更好。
一味求长会让热门商品长时间显示缺货，伤的是没抢到占用的那批用户。
optionExplanations_en: 30 seconds may bump users still typing payment info; 10 minutes leaves others waiting on stock — most sites land on 5-15 minutes.
A too-short timeout ejects normal users mid-checkout — a UX problem, not just a throughput one.
Chasing the shortest timeout punishes users who are checking out normally.
Chasing the longest timeout keeps hot items looking out of stock for longer, hurting everyone else.
why: 超时太短误伤正在结账的用户，太长让库存被无意义占用；这是业务权衡，多数电商落在 5-15 分钟。
why_en: Too short cancels legitimate in-progress checkouts; too long locks stock pointlessly — a business tradeoff most sites settle around 5-15 minutes.
tradeoff: 短超时保周转 vs 长超时保正常结账体验
whenOtherWins: 如果结账本身很快（一键支付），可以用更短的超时而不误伤用户。

scenario: 库存服务目录有 2000 万个 SKU，每个 SKU 一把 per-product 锁，单把锁对象约 48 字节。
scenario_en: The catalog has 20 million SKUs, one per-product lock each, and each lock object is about 48 bytes.
q: 全量锁大约占多少内存，这个数字用来判断什么？
q_en: Roughly how much memory do all the locks cost, and what does that number decide?
options: 约 2000 万×48B≈960MB，远小于服务器内存，代价可接受
约 2000 万×48B≈960GB，超过单机内存，per-product 锁不可行
锁对象大小取决于线程数，跟 SKU 数量无关，这个乘法算不出有意义的数字
只要用了 ConcurrentHashMap，内存占用就是常数，不随 SKU 数增长
options_en: About 20M × 48B ≈ 960MB, a small slice of server RAM — the cost is acceptable.
About 20M × 48B ≈ 960GB, more than a single machine has — per-product locking is infeasible.
Lock size depends on thread count, not SKU count, so this multiplication is meaningless.
Once you use ConcurrentHashMap, memory use becomes constant regardless of SKU count.
optionExplanations: 2000万×48字节≈9.6亿字节≈960MB，对比几十上百 GB 的服务器内存只占一小部分。
把字节数错当成了千倍单位，2000万×48B 算不到 GB 级别，数量级本身算错了。
锁数组大小随 key（productId）数量线性增长，跟并发线程数是两回事。
ConcurrentHashMap 管的是桶结构效率，每多存一把锁对象内存依然线性增长。
optionExplanations_en: 20M × 48 bytes ≈ 960 million bytes ≈ 960MB, a small fraction of the tens-to-hundreds of GB a server typically has.
This mistakes the unit by a thousandfold; 20M × 48B never reaches GB scale — the order of magnitude is simply wrong.
The lock array grows linearly with the number of keys (productId), which is unrelated to thread count.
ConcurrentHashMap manages bucket efficiency; storing one more lock object still costs memory linearly.
why: 总内存=SKU数×单锁字节数，2000万×48B≈960MB；这个数字用来判断 per-product 锁是否内存安全，结果是安全。
why_en: Formula: total memory = SKU count × bytes per lock, 20M × 48B ≈ 960MB — the number that answers whether per-product locking is memory-safe here, and it is.

termDefinitions.meaning: 能唯一标识一种可售商品规格的库存编码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) is a code that uniquely identifies one sellable product variant.

tradeoff: per-product 锁换来跨产品并发 vs 锁对象本身也要占内存

scenario: 面试里把 AlertListener 写成一个显式 interface；换成要上线的 JS/Python 代码。
scenario_en: The interview models AlertListener as an explicit interface; imagine this were production JS/Python code.
q: 生产代码通常会怎么表达同样的通知回调？
q_en: How would production code typically express the same notification callback?
options: 直接传函数回调，跳过专门声明接口
同样必须先定义接口类型，这门语言不支持把函数当参数传递
把回调换成同步阻塞调用，不再需要接口或函数
取消通知机制，让调用方自己轮询库存
options_en: Pass a plain function callback directly, skipping a dedicated interface.
Still must define an interface first — this language can't pass a function as a parameter.
Replace the callback with a synchronous blocking call, dropping both interface and function.
Drop notifications entirely and have the caller poll inventory instead.
optionExplanations: JS 用函数回调，Python 用 lambda，Go 用函数类型；生产代码通常直接传函数即可。
现代语言普遍把函数当一等公民，能直接传函数引用，不需要先声明接口。
换成阻塞调用没有回避通知这件事，也丢了非阻塞回调的初衷，答非所问。
轮询会让调用方持续发起无意义查询，没有解决通知问题。
optionExplanations_en: JS uses function callbacks, Python uses lambdas, Go uses function types — production code usually just passes a function.
Modern languages treat functions as first-class values and can pass a reference directly without declaring an interface.
Switching to a blocking call doesn't avoid notification and loses the point of a non-blocking callback — off target.
Polling makes the caller fire pointless repeated queries and never actually solves notification.
why: interface 在面试里更明确、跨语言通用；生产 JS/Python/Go 代码通常直接传函数回调，效果等价但样板代码更少。
why_en: An interface is clearer and language-agnostic for interview explanation, but production JS/Python/Go code usually just passes a function callback with less boilerplate for the same effect.
tradeoff: interface 显式结构 vs 函数回调更少样板代码
whenOtherWins: 如果通知逻辑本身有多个方法或要携带状态，interface/class 仍然比单个函数更合适。

q: 按顺序排列 confirmReservation 成功路径的三步操作：
q_en: Put the three mutations of a successful confirmReservation in order:
steps: 从 inventory[productId] 里真正扣减这笔数量
从 reserved[productId] 里减去同样的数量，释放占用
把这条 reservation 记录从 reservations 里删除
why: 先让 inventory 反映真实扣减，再释放 reserved 里的占用，最后清掉已履行的记录，保证两个字段都对上。
why_en: Inventory is debited first, then the matching reserved count is freed, then the fulfilled record is removed, keeping both fields consistent.

scenario: releaseReservation 只对 reserved[productId] 做减法，从不碰 inventory[productId]。
scenario_en: releaseReservation only decrements reserved[productId] and never touches inventory[productId].
q: 为什么 release 不需要改动 inventory？
q_en: Why doesn't release need to touch inventory at all?
options: reserveStock 没减过 inventory，release 把 reserved 减回去就够
inventory 在 reserveStock 阶段已被扣减，release 需要把这部分补回来
release 需要把 inventory 和 reserved 都清零，避免统计出错
inventory 由后台任务定期重算，release 不必关心它
options_en: reserveStock never touched inventory, so release just needs to undo the reserved increment.
inventory was already debited during reserveStock, and release needs to restore that amount.
release should zero out both inventory and reserved to avoid bad counts.
inventory is recomputed periodically by a background job, so release doesn't need to touch it.
optionExplanations: 占用阶段只挪动了一个计数器，物理库存表从头到尾都没被写过一次。
把 reserve 和 confirm 搞反了：真正扣减 inventory 的是 confirmReservation，不是 reserveStock。
清零会凭空销毁真实库存，release 只是取消一次占用，不该动物理数量。
inventory 是被 add/removeStock 直接写入的权威数据，不是派生出来的定期重算值。
optionExplanations_en: The hold step only moves a counter; the physical stock table is never written the whole time.
This swaps reserve and confirm — inventory is actually debited by confirmReservation, not reserveStock.
Zeroing would destroy real stock out of nowhere; release only cancels one hold, not the physical count.
inventory is authoritative data written directly by add/removeStock, not a derived value recomputed on a schedule.
why: reserveStock 只增加 reserved 计数、不碰物理库存，所以 release 撤销占用时只需把 reserved 减回去。
why_en: reserveStock only bumps the reserved count and never touches physical inventory, so releasing a hold just undoes that reserved increment.

scenario: Warehouse 每次操作的临界区只是几次 map 读写，量级在几微秒；每秒几百次操作。
scenario_en: Each Warehouse operation's critical section is a couple of map lookups, on the order of microseconds, at a few hundred ops per second.
q: 这个量级下，粗粒度 warehouse 锁真的会成为瓶颈吗？
q_en: At this scale, does the coarse warehouse lock actually become a bottleneck?
options: 不会：几百次×几微秒远小于 1 秒，混入慢 I/O 才会真变瓶颈
会：任何加了锁的临界区，不管多快，锁本身就是瓶颈
不会：synchronized 关键字在任何负载下都是零开销
会：几百次操作已经超过单核每秒能完成的锁获取上限
options_en: No: hundreds of ops × microseconds is far under a second; slow I/O inside the lock is the real risk.
Yes: any locked critical section is a bottleneck no matter how fast it runs.
No: the synchronized keyword has zero overhead at any load.
Yes: a few hundred operations already exceed what one core can lock-acquire per second.
optionExplanations: 几百次×几微秒总占用远不到 1 秒，争用概率很低；真正拖成瓶颈的是锁内混入网络调用这类慢操作。
锁开销很小，是否成瓶颈取决于临界区时长和调用频率，不是有锁就是瓶颈。
synchronized 有获取释放的固定开销，只是在这个量级下小到可忽略，不是零开销。
现代 CPU 每秒可完成的锁获取是百万级，几百次离这个上限还差好几个数量级。
optionExplanations_en: Hundreds × microseconds totals far under a second, so contention stays low; slow work like network calls inside the lock is what actually creates a bottleneck.
Lock overhead is tiny; whether it bottlenecks depends on hold time and call rate, not merely the presence of a lock.
synchronized has real acquire/release overhead, just small enough to ignore at this scale — not zero.
Modern CPUs handle millions of lock acquisitions per second, orders of magnitude above a few hundred.
why: 公式：锁争用≈操作频率×临界区时长，几百次/秒×几微秒≈毫秒级总占用，远低于 1 秒；这个数字说明现在不必上 per-product 锁。
why_en: Formula: contention ≈ op rate × critical-section duration, hundreds/sec × microseconds ≈ single-digit milliseconds — well under a second, telling you per-product locking isn't needed yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持锁执行的那段代码，同一时刻只能被一个线程执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is code that runs while holding a lock, executable by only one thread at a time.

tradeoff: 现在就上 per-product 锁的复杂度 vs 当前争用低、粗粒度锁已经够用

scenario: 同一产品配置了两条告警：20 件预警、5 件紧急；库存从 25 一次跌到 3。
scenario_en: One product has two alert configs — a warning at 20 and an urgent alert at 5 — and stock drops from 25 straight to 3.
q: getAlertsToFire 这次该收集几条告警？
q_en: How many alerts should getAlertsToFire collect for this drop?
options: 两条都收集：25→3 同时跨过 20 和 5 这两条线
只收集 5 件那条：只有最接近当前库存的阈值才算穿越
只收集 20 件那条：先穿越的阈值优先，后面直接跳过
一条都不收集：库存变化要逐次相邻发生才算穿越
options_en: Both: the drop from 25 to 3 crosses both the 20 and 5 line.
Only the 5-unit one: only the threshold nearest the new quantity counts as crossed.
Only the 20-unit one: whichever threshold crosses first wins, the rest are skipped.
Neither: crossing only counts if stock moves one adjacent step at a time.
optionExplanations: 两条阈值线各自单独比较这一趟涨跌，都符合从上方掉到下方，所以都该进列表。
判断是对每条 config 独立检查，没有离得最近才算数的规则。
遍历全部 configs 逐条判断，没有先穿越优先、后面短路跳过的逻辑。
prev/new 就是操作前后的值，不要求库存必须逐步挪动，一次性大跌同样满足条件。
optionExplanations_en: Each threshold line is compared to this one move independently, and both qualify as a downward crossing.
Each config is checked independently; there's no rule favoring whichever threshold sits closest to the new value.
The loop checks every config in turn; there's no short-circuit that lets an earlier crossing skip the rest.
prev/new are just the before/after values — nothing requires stock to move one step at a time for a crossing to count.
why: getAlertsToFire 对每条 config 独立判断 prev>=threshold&&new<threshold；一次大跌可以同时满足多条阈值，全部收集。
why_en: getAlertsToFire checks prev>=threshold && new<threshold independently per config, so one big drop can satisfy multiple thresholds and all of them get collected.

scenario: 双锁 atomic transfer 有两种失败：removeStock 因库存不足直接返回 false；或者 removeStock 成功后 addStock 抛异常。
scenario_en: The double-locked atomic transfer can fail two ways: removeStock returns false for insufficient stock, or removeStock succeeds and addStock then throws.
q: 这两种失败哪个需要讨论回滚，哪个不需要？
q_en: Which failure needs a rollback discussion, and which doesn't?
options: removeStock 失败无需回滚；addStock 失败才需要，源仓已扣
两种都不需要，持有双锁时任何失败都会自动撤销之前的写入
两种都需要，一旦进入 synchronized 块，所有写入都必须成对撤销
removeStock 失败才需要回滚，因为它已修改库存
options_en: removeStock failing needs no rollback; addStock failing does, since the source is already debited.
Neither needs one — holding both locks automatically undoes any prior write on failure.
Both need one — once inside a synchronized block, every write must be paired with an undo.
Only removeStock failing needs a rollback, since it already modified inventory.
optionExplanations: removeStock 校验完直接拒绝，没碰任何 map；addStock 抛异常时源仓的扣减已提交，这才缺回滚路径。
synchronized 只保证互斥访问，不是事务，不会自动撤销已提交的写入。
removeStock 失败那条路径根本没有写入发生，谈不上撤销。
顺序说反了：removeStock 校验不通过时不修改任何值，是 addStock 失败后源仓才处于已扣未加的状态。
optionExplanations_en: removeStock rejects right after validation, touching no map; addStock throwing leaves the source's debit already committed — that's the real gap.
synchronized only guarantees mutual exclusion, not transactions — it never auto-undoes a committed write.
The removeStock-failure path never writes anything, so there's nothing to undo there.
This has it backwards: removeStock rejecting changes nothing, while it's the addStock-failure path that leaves the source debited but the destination uncredited.
why: removeStock 因库存不足失败时两个仓库都还没被写入，不需要回滚；真正缺回滚路径的是 removeStock 成功后 addStock 才失败的窗口。
why_en: When removeStock fails on insufficient stock, neither warehouse has been written yet, so no rollback is needed; the real gap is the window after removeStock succeeds and addStock then fails.
tradeoff: 提前校验失败零成本 vs 两阶段之间失败需要额外补偿机制

scenario: checkAvailability 收到 quantity=0 时返回 false；addStock 收到同样的 0 却直接 throw。
scenario_en: checkAvailability returns false when quantity=0; addStock throws on that same invalid 0.
q: 为什么只读查询对非法输入更宽容？
q_en: Why is the read-only query more lenient with invalid input?
options: 只读查询用 false 更省事；写操作会真改库存，必须硬拒绝
两者其实同样严格，都会对非法输入直接抛错中断调用
checkAvailability 应该抛错，这是原设计遗漏的一个 bug
读操作永远不需要对参数做任何校验，天生更宽松
options_en: A read query can just return false; a write would actually mutate state, so it must reject outright.
They're actually equally strict — both throw directly on invalid input.
checkAvailability should throw too; this is a bug the original design missed.
Read operations never need to validate parameters at all, by nature.
optionExplanations: 这类查询本身不会改任何数据，告诉调用方一句问不出结果就够了。
源码里这个方法对非法数量选择的分支是返回布尔值，不是抛异常。
文章原本的写法就是这样处理，不属于需要修的遗漏。
它仍旧会判断数量是否合法，只是失败时选了更轻的信号方式。
optionExplanations_en: A query like this changes nothing, so telling the caller there's simply nothing to report is enough.
The branch this method takes for an invalid quantity returns a boolean, not an exception.
This is exactly how the article's own implementation handles it, not a flagged oversight.
It still checks whether the quantity is valid — it just signals failure more lightly than a throw.
why: checkAvailability 只读、无副作用，用 return false 更轻量；addStock 会真的改库存，非法输入必须硬拒绝防止误写。
why_en: checkAvailability is read-only with no side effects, so a lightweight false suffices; addStock actually mutates state, so invalid input must be rejected outright.
tradeoff: 读操作宽容处理 vs 写操作严格拒绝
whenOtherWins: 如果调用方把 false 和库存不足混为一谈，也可以把 checkAvailability 改成对非法输入抛错，统一错误处理路径。

scenario: 有人提议把 alertConfigs 从 Map<string, List<AlertConfig>> 换成 Map<string, Map<int, AlertListener>>，直接用阈值当 key。
scenario_en: Someone proposes replacing alertConfigs with a nested Map<string, Map<int, AlertListener>> keyed directly by threshold.
q: 该不该接受这个提议？
q_en: Should this proposal be accepted?
options: 不该：具名类型让多条告警规则一眼可读，裸 map 会丢失这层意图
该：两种写法性能完全一样，裸 map 代码量更少，没理由不换
不该：因为这门语言里 Map 类型根本不能嵌套使用
该：因为阈值天生唯一，用它当 key 更贴近数据本身
options_en: No: the named type makes multiple alert rules readable at a glance; a bare map loses that intent.
Yes: performance is identical either way, and the bare map is less code, so there's no reason not to.
No: this language simply can't nest map types.
Yes: thresholds are inherently unique, so keying on them fits the data more naturally.
optionExplanations: 把两个字段包成一个类型，字段名就在类型定义里写死了，读代码时不用再去猜。
省下的那点代码量，换来的是以后每个人都要重新确认这个字段到底存的是什么。
多数主流语言都能嵌套 map，这个限制并不存在。
同一产品的阈值确实不会重复，但这不是选具名类型而不是裸 map 的理由所在。
optionExplanations_en: Bundling the two fields into a type pins their names in the type definition, so readers never have to guess.
The little bit of code saved costs everyone else time re-confirming what that field actually stores.
Most mainstream languages support nested maps just fine; that restriction doesn't exist.
Thresholds not repeating for one product is true, but it isn't the reason to prefer a named type over a bare map.
why: AlertConfig 把 threshold 和 listener 打包成一个具名类型，让 List<AlertConfig> 的意图一读就懂；换成裸 Map 会让 key 到底是什么变得不明确。
why_en: AlertConfig bundles threshold and listener into a named type so List<AlertConfig> reads as intent; a bare Map obscures what the key actually represents.
tradeoff: 具名类型更清晰 vs 裸 map 代码量略少
whenOtherWins: 如果这门语言的 tuple/record 语法足够轻量，也可以不建 class，只要保持 threshold 和 listener 成对出现。

scenario: 有人提议给 Warehouse 加一个字段，直接持有其他所有 Warehouse 的引用，方便跨仓查询。
scenario_en: Someone proposes giving Warehouse a field that directly holds references to every other Warehouse, for convenient cross-warehouse lookups.
q: 这个提议会带来什么问题？
q_en: What problem would this proposal create?
options: 职责被打乱：跨仓协调本归 Manager，这里被重复实现一遍
完全没问题，反而减少了一层 Manager 的中间调用环节
会导致 Warehouse 之间产生循环引用，直接编译失败
只会让内存占用略微上升，架构上没有实质影响
options_en: It muddles responsibility: cross-warehouse coordination belongs to Manager, and this duplicates it.
No problem at all — it even removes a layer of indirection through Manager.
Warehouses would end up with circular references and fail to compile.
It only bumps memory use slightly; no real architectural impact.
optionExplanations: 路由和跨仓查询这件事已经有一个专门的入口在做了，没必要在别处再写一份。
少了这层入口，反而让每一个存储节点都得各自维护一套原本该集中管理的查找逻辑。
循环引用在大多数语言里是允许的，不会导致编译失败，这不是它的问题所在。
内存增长只是次要影响，真正的问题是职责边界被打乱，两个类都要处理跨仓逻辑。
optionExplanations_en: Routing and cross-warehouse lookups already have one dedicated entry point; there's no need to rebuild it elsewhere.
Removing that entry point just forces every storage node to maintain its own copy of logic that should be centralized.
Circular references compile fine in most languages; that's not where the real problem lies.
Extra memory is a minor side effect — the real issue is that responsibility boundaries get blurred across two classes.
why: 跨仓协调是 InventoryManager 的职责；让 Warehouse 也持有其他仓库引用会把这份职责拆成两份，各自维护一套路由逻辑。
why_en: Cross-warehouse coordination belongs to InventoryManager; letting Warehouse also hold sibling references splits that responsibility into two places maintaining their own routing logic.

scenario: 库存长期卡在阈值以下，每次 remove 操作都重新判定一次是否低于阈值；仓库每小时处理几百次 remove。
scenario_en: Stock stays stuck below the threshold, and every remove operation re-checks whether stock is low; the warehouse handles a few hundred removes per hour.
q: 如果告警逻辑是只要库存低于阈值就触发，这一小时大约会收到多少条重复告警？
q_en: If the alert logic fires whenever stock is below the threshold, roughly how many duplicate alerts land in that hour?
options: 几百条，跟操作次数同一量级，每次操作都重新判定并触发
最多 1 条，系统会自动记住已经报过一次，不会重复
0 条，库存已经低于阈值之后就不会再触发新的告警
几百条，但每条都是不同的错误原因，不属于重复告警
options_en: A few hundred, matching the operation count, since each operation re-fires the check.
At most 1 — the system remembers it already alerted once.
0 — once stock is already below the threshold, no new alert fires.
A few hundred, but each one is a distinct root cause, so it isn't really duplication.
optionExplanations: 每次 remove 后都判定当前值<阈值，跟前一次是否已经报过无关，几百次操作就是几百条同一件事的告警。
这一版逻辑本身就没有任何去重状态，不会自动记住已经报过。
跌破阈值之后库存依然低于阈值，判定条件持续成立，反而会一直触发。
几百条告警的内容完全相同——同一个产品、同一个仓库、同一句库存低，不是几百种不同原因。
optionExplanations_en: Every remove re-evaluates current < threshold regardless of whether it already fired before, so hundreds of operations mean hundreds of alerts about the same fact.
This version of the logic carries no dedup state at all, so it can't remember a prior alert.
Stock stays below the threshold after crossing it, so the condition keeps holding and keeps firing.
All those alerts carry the exact same content — same product, same warehouse, same low-stock fact — not distinct causes.
why: 公式：告警条数≈操作次数×1（每次操作都判定一次），几百次操作就产生几百条内容相同的告警；这个数字说明必须换成阈值穿越去重。
why_en: Formula: alerts ≈ operation count × 1 (every operation re-evaluates), so a few hundred operations produce a few hundred identical alerts — this number is why the design needs crossing-based dedup instead of re-checking the current value each time.
tradeoff: 每次都判定简单但会刷屏 vs 阈值穿越去重需要多记一个 previousQty

q: Logging Service 基础需求包含哪些点？（多选）
q_en: Which base requirements does the Logging Service need? (Select all)
options: 五个级别 DEBUG < INFO < WARN < ERROR < FATAL
每条记录包含 timestamp、level、message、threadName
每个 destination 有自己的 minLevel 和 formatter
并发写同一 destination 时字节不能交错
why: 题目重点是同步日志库的核心模型和并发写安全。异步、热更新、远程目的地和层级 logger 是后续扩展。
why_en: The base logger has ordered levels, immutable records, per-destination thresholds and formats, and non-interleaved concurrent writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 五值有序枚举 DEBUG<INFO<WARN<ERROR<FATAL，用于记录严重度和 destination 的阈值比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LogLevel is the five-value ordered enum from DEBUG to FATAL used for severity and threshold comparisons.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 destination 自己配置的最低级别阈值，记录级别低于它就被静默丢弃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: minLevel is the per-destination threshold below which a record is silently dropped.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 产生这条日志的线程名，在 Logger.log 顶部随 timestamp 一起只捕获一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: threadName is the emitting thread's name, captured once at the top of Logger.log alongside the timestamp.

options_en: Five ordered levels: DEBUG below INFO below WARN below ERROR below FATAL.
Every record carries a timestamp, level, message, and thread name.
Each destination has its own minimum level and formatter.
Concurrent writes to the same destination must never interleave bytes.
optionExplanations: 有序级别防止候选人漏掉阈值比较的基础——没有顺序就无法判断哪些消息该被过滤掉。
固定字段集合避免每次调用都临时拼装不同结构的日志，保证下游解析一致。
独立配置让同一条记录能在 console 详细、在 file 只留警戒线以上，互不牵连。
防止两个线程同时写导致同一行文件里混进另一条消息的字节，日志变成乱码。
optionExplanations_en: An ordered level enum is what makes per-destination threshold filtering possible in the first place.
A fixed field set keeps every log line parseable the same way instead of ad hoc per-call shapes.
Per-destination settings let the same record show up verbosely on console but sparsely in the file.
It stops two threads' writes from splicing together mid-line into unreadable garbled output.
scenario: 45 分钟 LLD 面试：设计进程内日志库，多线程调用、多个输出目标，先只做同步版。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute LLD round you design an in-process logging library: many threads calling it, several output destinations, synchronous only for now.

q: 补全日志级别顺序：
q_en: Fill in the log level order:
text: LogLevel 的自然顺序是 {{DEBUG < INFO < WARN < ERROR < FATAL}}，destination 用它与 {{minLevel}} 比较来过滤。
why: 级别是固定枚举，不需要为每个级别建类。顺序比较直接支持阈值过滤。
why_en: Log levels are an ordered enum used for per-destination threshold filtering.

termDefinitions.meaning: 五值有序枚举 DEBUG<INFO<WARN<ERROR<FATAL，用于记录严重度和 destination 的阈值比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LogLevel is the five-value ordered enum from DEBUG to FATAL used for severity and threshold comparisons.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 destination 自己配置的最低级别阈值，记录级别低于它就被静默丢弃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: minLevel is the per-destination threshold below which a record is silently dropped.

scenario: 每次 logger.info('x') 都要把 timestamp、level、message、threadName 一起传给多个 destination。
scenario_en: Each logger.info('x') call must pass timestamp, level, message, and threadName to multiple destinations.
q: 最合适的建模是什么？
q_en: What is the best model for this data?
options: 不可变 LogRecord 值对象
四个参数到处传
Destination 内部临时拼接全局变量
每个字段单独一个类
why: 这些字段总是一起出现、一起格式化，建成不可变记录能稳定方法签名。未来加 requestId 也只改记录结构。
why_en: LogRecord groups per-call data into one immutable value object that all destinations consume.
whenOtherWins: 非常小的脚本可直接传参数，但库设计中记录对象更稳。
tradeoff: 不可变值对象 vs 到处传递散装参数

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

options_en: An immutable LogRecord value object.
Pass the four fields around as loose parameters everywhere.
Have Destination stitch together global variables on the fly.
Give every field its own dedicated class.
optionExplanations: LogRecord 把四个字段打包成一份不可变快照，所有 destination 读同一份数据，未来加字段也只改这一个类。
把四个参数散着传，方法签名会随字段增长不断变化，调用点到处要改。
让 Destination 现拼字段等于把状态创建逻辑复制到每个目的地，容易各写各的、字段不一致。
每个字段单独建类只会增加对象数量，字段本就一起出现、一起格式化，没必要拆开。
optionExplanations_en: LogRecord bundles the four fields into one immutable snapshot that every destination reads, so adding a field later only touches this class.
Passing four loose parameters means every signature grows and every call site breaks whenever a field is added.
Having each Destination assemble its own state duplicates record-building logic and risks inconsistent fields across destinations.
Giving every field its own class just multiplies objects — the fields always travel and format together, so splitting them adds nothing.

q: LogRecord 字段为什么应只读？
q_en: Why should LogRecord fields be read-only?
options: 只读字段能让 CPU 缓存命中率更高，因此被误当作写入更快的必要条件
一条日志代表某时刻事实，destination/formatter 不应互相竞态修改它
Formatter 序列化时经常需要就地改写 message 字段以适配不同格式
threadName 应该在写入不同 destination 时重新捕获一次，才算准确
why: 不可变记录可安全地被多个 destination 和 formatter 读取。它也让格式化可以在锁外并行执行。
why_en: Immutable log records can be safely shared across destinations and formatted concurrently.
tradeoff: 不可变字段换并发安全 vs 可变字段换原地修改的灵活性

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 产生这条日志的线程名，在 Logger.log 顶部随 timestamp 一起只捕获一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: threadName is the emitting thread's name, captured once at the top of Logger.log alongside the timestamp.

options_en: Read-only fields improve CPU cache hits, so they're mistaken for a write-speed requirement.
A log record represents a fact at one moment, and destinations/formatters must not race to mutate it.
A formatter needs to rewrite the message field in place to match different output formats.
ThreadName should be recaptured each time the record reaches a different destination.
optionExplanations: 缓存命中率是真实存在的次要好处，但把它当成不可变的理由本末倒置——真正原因是并发安全，不是性能。
抓住了要点——同一条记录本该是固定事实，谁都不该在旁路上改写它。
Formatter 不该就地改 message；它只应该读取字段生成一份新的格式化字符串。
重新捕获 threadName 会让同一次调用在不同 destination 看到不一致的线程名，破坏“同一事实”的前提。
optionExplanations_en: Cache locality is a real side effect, but citing it as the reason mistakes a minor perk for the actual concurrency motive.
Correctly names the reason: a record is a fixed fact, and no destination should be racing to rewrite it.

q: timestamp 和 threadName 应在哪里捕获？

q: 最终模型包含哪些核心类型？（多选）

LogRecord
Formatter
Destination
Sink

q: 为什么 Formatter 应独立于 Destination？

q: 一次 Logger.log 的正确高层流程是什么？

顺序遍历 immutable destinations。
每个 destination 独立过滤、格式化、加锁写入。
why: Logger 不做 destination 阈值过滤，也不持有全局写锁。每个 destination 自己决定是否写。
why_en: Logger creates one record and fans it out, while each destination independently filters, formats, and writes.

participant D as Destination

scenario: 实现同步 Destination.write，要求并发写同一目标时字节不交错。
scenario_en: Implement synchronous Destination.write, requiring concurrent writes to the same target not to interleave bytes.
q: 这段伪代码的关键设计是什么？
q_en: What is the key design in this pseudocode?
codeSample:
write(record)
    if record.level < minLevel return      // filtered before lock
    formatted = formatter.format(record)    // pure fn, safe outside lock
    lock.acquire()
    try
        sink.write(formatted)                // only line under lock
    catch e
        stderr.write('logger: sink write failed')
    finally
        lock.release()
options: 把整个 Logger.log 方法整体加一把全局锁，让所有 destination 串行执行
阈值过滤和格式化在锁外，sink.write 在 destination 锁内，失败不抛给调用方
格式化阶段涉及共享状态，因此也必须放进 destination 的锁临界区内执行
一旦某个 sink 写入失败就应该立即终止对其余 destination 的遍历
why: 锁只保护共享输出资源，临界区保持最小。单个 sink 失败被隔离，调用方和其他目的地不受影响。
why_en: Destination.write filters and formats outside the lock, protects sink writes with a per-destination lock, and isolates sink failures.
whenOtherWins: 如果 formatter 有共享可变状态，也必须同步或改成无状态；本文假设 formatter 是纯函数。

B -- yes --> D["format outside lock"]
D --> E["lock destination"]
E --> F["sink.write(formatted)"]
F --> G["unlock in finally"]
F --> H["on failure: stderr diagnostic"]
tradeoff: 过滤格式化搬出临界区 vs 把整个方法都锁住换取实现简单

scenario: 两个线程同时写同一个 file destination，但另一个 console destination 很快。

q: 锁应放在哪里？
q_en: Where should the lock be placed?
options: 在 Logger.log 顶部包一把全局锁，让所有 destination 排队执行
给每个 LogRecord 实例单独分配一把锁，写入前先申请这把记录锁
每个 Destination 一个锁，只保护它自己的 sink.write
给每个 Formatter 实例分配一把锁，序列化时必须先持有它
why: 共享资源是具体 destination 的输出目标。全局锁会让慢文件写阻塞无关 console 写。
why_en: The lock belongs per destination because each destination protects its own output resource.
whenOtherWins: 如果多个 Destination 共享同一底层 stream，需要把锁下沉到共享 sink 或 stream。

T3["thread C"] --> C["console destination lock"]

C --> CW["console sink"]

options_en: One global lock wrapped around Logger.log, serializing every destination.
Each LogRecord instance gets its own lock acquired before writing.
One lock per Destination, protecting only that destination's sink.write.
Each Formatter instance needs its own lock before serializing.
optionExplanations: 全局锁只有在写入极少或都很快时才划算，一旦某个目标慢下来，会连累所有其他 destination 排队等它。
LogRecord 本身不是共享可变资源，给它加锁保护不了任何东西，只是白白多一次加锁开销。
锁跟着共享资源走——每个 destination 保护自己的输出目标，慢文件写不会拖慢无关的 console 写。
Formatter 被设计成无共享状态的纯函数，给它加锁是在保护一个本来就不需要同步的东西。
optionExplanations_en: A global lock only pays off when writes are rare or fast — once one target slows down, it queues up every other destination behind it.
LogRecord isn't shared mutable state, so locking it protects nothing — it's just extra locking overhead for no benefit.
The lock follows the shared resource — each destination protects only its own output, so a slow file write never stalls an unrelated console write.
Formatter is meant to be a stateless pure function, so locking it protects something that never needed synchronization.

q: 同步整个 Logger.log 的主要缺点是什么？
q_en: What is the main downside of synchronizing the entire Logger.log method?
options: 全局锁反而无法保证同一文件的字节不发生交错
使用全局锁之后 LogRecord 的字段会被迫变成可变的
全局锁会让每个 destination 都无法再按自己的 minLevel 过滤
一个慢 destination 会阻塞所有日志调用和其他 destination
why: 全局锁虽然正确，但粒度太粗。每个输出资源独立锁才能让无关目的地并行。
why_en: A global logger lock is correct but too coarse because one slow destination blocks everything.
tradeoff: 实现简单的一把全局锁 vs 精确到资源的每目标锁

q: Destination.write 应如何处理？
q_en: How should Destination.write handle it?
options: 捕获异常，写 stderr 诊断并返回，不让异常逃到业务代码
让 sink.write 抛出的异常一路冒泡到调用 logger.error 的业务代码
一旦某个 destination 写入失败就立刻中止对其余 destination 的遍历
把这个 sink 出错之后所有已配置的 destination 永久关闭，不再接受写入
why: 日志库不应让业务因为写日志失败而崩溃，也不能静默失败。stderr 诊断能暴露 sink 故障。
why_en: A sink failure should not crash the caller or stop other destinations, but should emit a diagnostic.
whenOtherWins: 极简实现可吞掉异常，但生产上最好有 stderr 或内部 status logger，并做限流。
tradeoff: 捕获+诊断保证隔离与可观测 vs 直接冒泡保证实现最简单

    ...
    lock.acquire()
    try
        sink.write(formatted)
    catch IOException e
        stderr.write('logger: sink write failed: ' + e.message)

        lock.release()

Letting the exception bubble up means a full disk can crash the entire business call chain — a logging library shouldn't have that power.
Aborting the loop means a healthy destination like console also misses records it should have received.

why_en: Swallowing sink failures silently can hide broken logging for a long time.

q: 文件句柄应如何管理？
q_en: How should the file handle be managed?
options: 每写一条日志就重新 open 一次文件，写完立刻 close
让 Formatter 在 format() 方法内部负责打开目标文件
构造时打开并复用 append writer
把目标文件的全部历史内容缓存进每一个 LogRecord 对象里
why: 每次 open syscall 成本高且没有必要。FileSink 拥有文件 writer，Destination 负责同步调用。
why_en: FileSink should open the file once and append through a reused writer.
whenOtherWins: 如果写入目标是短生命周期临时文件，可以每次打开，但普通 logger 不应这样做。
tradeoff: 构造时打开一次复用 vs 每次调用都 open/close

termDefinitions.meaning: Sink 的一个实现，构造时打开并复用一个文件句柄，把格式化字符串追加写入文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSink is a Sink implementation that opens a file handle once and appends formatted strings to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

options_en: Every log call should reopen and close the file.
Formatter.format should be the one opening the target file.
Open the file once in the constructor and reuse an append writer.
The file's entire history should be cached inside every LogRecord.
optionExplanations: 每条日志都 open/close 一次意味着每次写日志都多付一次系统调用成本，写得越频繁越贵。
打开文件是资源生命周期管理，属于 Sink 该做的事；Formatter 只管把记录变成字符串。
构造时开一次文件、之后一直复用同一个 writer 追加写入，省掉重复 open 的系统调用开销。
把整个文件历史塞进每个 LogRecord 会让每条记录都携带越来越大的历史包袱，完全偏离了它的职责。
optionExplanations_en: Reopening and closing per log line means paying a syscall cost on every single write — the more you log, the more it costs.
Opening a file is a resource-management job that belongs to Sink — Formatter's job is only turning a record into a string.
Open the file once in the constructor and keep reusing the same append writer, avoiding repeated open syscalls.
Caching the whole file history inside every LogRecord makes each record drag along a growing history blob — nowhere near its job.

scenario: 进程崩溃前最后几条日志可能仍在缓冲区。
scenario_en: The last few log lines may still be buffered when the process crashes.
q: 真实 FileSink 通常还要考虑什么？
q_en: What else should a real FileSink consider?
options: 每写一条日志之前先把整个文件删除重建
文件句柄打开后永远不主动关闭，交给操作系统兜底
把 flush() 调用放进 Formatter.format 方法里执行
按每条或有界间隔 flush
why: 只在 close 时 flush 对 logger 不理想，因为崩溃时可能看不到最近日志。flush 策略是可靠性和性能的权衡。
why_en: A real file sink needs a flush strategy so recent logs are visible before a crash.
whenOtherWins: 高吞吐系统可能批量 flush，降低 I/O 成本但接受小窗口数据丢失。
tradeoff: 更及时的 flush 换崩溃前可见 vs 只在 close 时 flush 换更少 I/O

termDefinitions.meaning: Sink 的一个实现，构造时打开并复用一个文件句柄，把格式化字符串追加写入文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSink is a Sink implementation that opens a file handle once and appends formatted strings to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

options_en: The file should be deleted and recreated before every write.
The file handle should never be explicitly closed and left to the OS.
Flush() belongs inside Formatter.format instead of the sink.
Flush after every record, or after a bounded interval.
optionExplanations: 每次写入前删除重建文件会直接抹掉之前所有日志，这是数据丢失，不是 flush 策略。
从不主动关闭句柄会让缓冲区里的最后几条日志在进程崩溃时永远留在内存里，看不到。
flush 是针对已写入的字节做落盘，Formatter 那一步字符串还没写进 sink，放错了阶段。
按每条或每隔一定条数 flush，是在“崩溃前能看到多少日志”和“I/O 开销多大”之间选一个平衡点。
optionExplanations_en: Deleting and recreating the file before every write erases all prior logs — that's data loss, not a flush policy.
Never closing the handle leaves whatever's still buffered stuck in memory forever if the process crashes.
Flush operates on bytes already handed to the sink — Formatter runs before that, so it's the wrong stage entirely.
Flushing per record or at a bounded interval trades off how much you'd lose on a crash against how much I/O overhead you accept.

q: 为什么 Logger 不在全局层面按 level 过滤？
q_en: Why should Logger not filter by level globally?
options: 每个 destination 有自己的 minLevel，同一 record 可能写 console 但不写 file
把过滤放在 Logger 全局这一层统一执行，让所有 destination 共用同一套判断反而更加安全更省事更可靠
因为 Logger.log 这个方法本身完全没有设计 level 参数可供全局过滤使用
因为 Destination 内部其实无法对 LogLevel 这个枚举值做大小比较判断的缘故
why: 阈值是 destination 的配置。全局过滤会错误丢掉某些目的地本应接收的记录。
why_en: Threshold filtering belongs to Destination because each destination has its own minimum level.
tradeoff: 阈值下放到每个 destination vs 阈值收在 Logger 全局层

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 destination 自己配置的最低级别阈值，记录级别低于它就被静默丢弃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: minLevel is the per-destination threshold below which a record is silently dropped.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日志库的唯一入口类，持有不可变 destinations 列表，把每次调用打包成 LogRecord 并 fan-out 给每个 destination。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logger is the single entry point that builds one LogRecord per call and fans it out to every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 五值有序枚举 DEBUG<INFO<WARN<ERROR<FATAL，用于记录严重度和 destination 的阈值比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LogLevel is the five-value ordered enum from DEBUG to FATAL used for severity and threshold comparisons.

options_en: Each destination keeps its own minLevel, so the same record can reach console but get dropped at file.
Filtering globally in one place on Logger, with every destination sharing the same check, is actually safer and simpler.
Logger.log's method signature was never designed with a level parameter for global filtering.
Destination is internally unable to compare LogLevel enum values against each other at all.
optionExplanations: 抓住关键——阈值是每个 destination 自己的配置，同一条记录完全可能一个目的地收、另一个目的地丢。
全局过滤反而更危险——它会在 Logger 层就先丢掉记录，某些本该收到低级别日志的 destination 永远看不到。
Logger.log 明明是接收 level 参数的，问题不在缺参数，而在过滤逻辑该放哪一层。
LogLevel 是有序枚举，Destination 完全可以直接比较大小，这不是限制所在。
optionExplanations_en: Gets the key point: threshold is per-destination config, so the same record can land at one destination and get dropped at another.
Global filtering is actually riskier — it drops records at the Logger level before some destinations that wanted them ever see them.
Logger.log does take a level parameter — the issue isn't a missing argument, it's which layer should filter.
LogLevel is an ordered enum that Destination can compare directly — that's not the constraint here.
scenario: 一条 DEBUG 记录要进 console（minLevel=DEBUG），但不该进 file（minLevel=WARN）。
scenario_en: One DEBUG record should reach the console, whose threshold is DEBUG, but not the file, whose threshold is WARN.

q: 以下每项 v1 排除的功能，为什么之后能在不改核心模型的情况下加上？（多选）
q_en: Why can each excluded v1 feature be added later without changing the core model? (Select all)
options: 异步/缓冲写
运行时热加载配置
远程/网络目的地
层级命名 logger
why: 这四项都被设计成能在不触碰 Logger 核心 API 的前提下叠加：异步和远程都落在已有的 Sink/queue 接口上，热更新只需换存储方式，层级只需加一层注册表。
why_en: Each excluded feature slots into an existing extension point — a Sink implementation, a swappable reference, or a factory registry — without rewriting Logger's core API.
scenario: Logger 的 v1 只实现同步、单机、静态配置的核心模型，把异步写、热更新配置、远程目的地、层级 logger 都排在范围外。
scenario_en: Logger v1 implements only the synchronous, single-machine, static-configuration core; async writes, hot config reload, remote destinations, and hierarchical loggers are out of scope.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日志库的唯一入口类，持有不可变 destinations 列表，把每次调用打包成 LogRecord 并 fan-out 给每个 destination。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logger is the single entry point that builds one LogRecord per call and fans it out to every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已经格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 假想中的未来 Sink 实现，把格式化字符串通过网络写到远程日志端点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RemoteSink is a hypothetical future Sink implementation that writes formatted strings to a remote endpoint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 层级 logger 的全局注册表，按 dotted-name 返回同一个 Logger 实例并挂上 parent 指针。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LoggerFactory is the global registry for hierarchical loggers that returns the same instance per dotted name and links it to its parent.

options_en: Async writes — add a bounded queue and worker to Destination, Logger stays untouched.
Hot-reload config — swap destinations for an atomically replaceable reference, the caller API stays the same.
Remote destinations — add a new RemoteSink implementing Sink, the interface doesn't change.
Hierarchical loggers — add name/parent fields to Logger and a LoggerFactory registry.
optionExplanations: 落在给 Destination 加 queue+worker 上，Logger 的 API 完全不用动。
只需把 destinations 换成可原子替换的引用，调用方接口不变。
只是新增一个实现 Sink 接口的 RemoteSink，接口本身不改。
需要给 Logger 加 name/parent 字段和一个工厂注册表，是唯一会新增字段的一项。
optionExplanations_en: Slots into adding a queue and worker to Destination — Logger's API doesn't move at all.
Only needs destinations swapped for an atomically replaceable reference — the caller-facing API stays the same.
Just means adding a new RemoteSink that implements the existing Sink interface — the interface itself doesn't change.
Needs name/parent fields on Logger plus a factory registry — the one extension that actually adds fields.

scenario: log() 不能被慢文件或网络写阻塞。
scenario_en: log() must not be blocked by a slow file or network write.
q: 最自然的非阻塞扩展是什么？
q_en: What is the most natural non-blocking extension?
options: 每次调用 log() 都新建一个专属的独立线程，负责把这条记录写到所有已经配置好的目的地上
每个 Destination 一个 bounded BlockingQueue 和 worker thread
直接去掉 destination 自己持有的那把锁，让多个线程并发调用 sink.write 写入同一个目标
把 Formatter.format 这个方法本身也改造成异步非阻塞的具体实现方式
why: 调用方只入队，单 consumer worker 串行写 sink，天然保持 destination 内顺序并可去掉该 sink 锁。bounded queue 还能定义背压策略。
why_en: A bounded queue and worker per destination make log calls mostly enqueue operations while one consumer writes the sink.
whenOtherWins: 同步 v1 更简单；只有调用延迟成为要求时才引入队列和 worker 生命周期。
diagram:
flowchart TD
A["caller log()"] --> B["Destination filter"]
B --> C["bounded queue"]
C --> D["worker thread"]
D --> E["format record"]
E --> F["sink.write"]
G["shutdown"] --> H["drain queue and join worker"]
tradeoff: 每目标一条 bounded queue + 单 worker vs 每次调用都开线程

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程安全的有界队列，满时可以阻塞、丢弃或拒绝生产者，常用于单消费者 worker 场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A BlockingQueue is a thread-safe bounded queue that can block, drop, or reject producers when full, often paired with a single consumer worker.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已经格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

options_en: Spawning a brand-new dedicated thread per log call to write to every configured destination.
A bounded BlockingQueue and a dedicated worker thread per Destination.
Removing the lock a destination holds and letting multiple threads call sink.write concurrently on the same target.
Making Formatter.format itself into an asynchronous, non-blocking implementation.
optionExplanations: 每次调用都开新线程，日志量一高线程数量会失控增长，反而拖垮系统。
每个目的地配一条有界队列和单独 worker，调用方只管入队立刻返回，写入交给后台线程串行处理。
去掉锁又让多个线程并发写同一个 sink，字节交错的问题会原样重现。
Formatter 本身是纯函数，不涉及 I/O，把它改造成异步没有实际收益，真正的阻塞点在 sink 写入。
optionExplanations_en: Spawning a thread per call means thread count explodes under load — the "fix" becomes the new bottleneck.
One bounded queue and worker per destination means the caller just enqueues and returns while a background thread handles the write serially.
Removing the lock while letting multiple threads write the same sink concurrently just brings back the interleaved-bytes problem.
Formatter is already a pure function with no I/O — making it async buys nothing, since the real blocking happens at the sink write.

q: 异步 Destination 需要额外考虑哪些问题？（多选）
q_en: What extra issues does an async Destination need to handle? (Select all)
options: worker 生命周期和 shutdown drain
queue 满时的 overflow policy
写失败在 worker 线程上的诊断
是否批量写和 flush
why: 异步不是只加一个队列。它把写入时机移到后台，带来关闭、丢弃、背压和可观测性问题。
why_en: Async logging adds worker lifecycle, overflow, diagnostics, batching, and flushing decisions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程安全的有界队列，满时可以阻塞、丢弃或拒绝生产者，常用于单消费者 worker 场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A BlockingQueue is a thread-safe bounded queue that can block, drop, or reject producers when full, often paired with a single consumer worker.

options_en: Worker lifecycle and shutdown drain.
The queue's overflow policy when it's full.
Diagnosing write failures that happen on the worker thread.
Whether to batch writes and how to flush them.
optionExplanations: 没处理好 shutdown 会让缓冲区里还没写出的日志在进程退出时直接丢失。
queue 满时不定策略，调用方要么被无限阻塞，要么记录被悄悄丢弃，两种都得明确选。
写失败现在发生在 worker 线程上，调用方彻底看不到，必须单独安排诊断出口。
批量和 flush 决定了崩溃时最多丢多少条日志，是可靠性和吞吐之间的又一个旋钮。
optionExplanations_en: Mishandling shutdown means whatever's still buffered gets lost the instant the process exits.
Without an explicit overflow policy, callers either block indefinitely or records vanish silently — one has to be chosen deliberately.
Write failures now happen on the worker thread where the caller can't see them at all, so diagnostics need their own path.
Batching and flush timing decide how many records a crash can cost — another dial between reliability and throughput.
scenario: 日志库要把写入挪到后台线程，业务线程调完 log 立即返回，而进程随时可能被 kill。
scenario_en: You move writing onto a background thread so callers return immediately, knowing the process can be killed at any moment.

q: bounded queue 满时为什么必须有明确策略？
q_en: Why must a full bounded queue have an explicit policy?
options: 只要把队列设置得足够大，实际上就永远不会真正被填满
队列满了之后底层会自动帮你无限扩容，完全不需要显式处理这件事
block、drop-new、drop-old、throw 都有不同业务代价
队列满了之后 worker 线程会自动帮你暂停整个业务逻辑，直到队列腾出空间为止
why: 异步日志在压力下必须在“不阻塞调用方”和“不丢日志”之间取舍。策略不能含糊。
why_en: A full async logging queue forces an explicit tradeoff between blocking callers and dropping records.
tradeoff: 阻塞调用方保数据 vs 丢记录保延迟，四选一没有免费选项

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程安全的有界队列，满时可以阻塞、丢弃或拒绝生产者，常用于单消费者 worker 场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A BlockingQueue is a thread-safe bounded queue that can block, drop, or reject producers when full, often paired with a single consumer worker.

options_en: As long as the queue is sized generously enough, it will never actually fill up.
Once full, the queue silently and automatically grows without bound, needing no explicit handling.
Block, drop-new, drop-old, and throw each carry a different business cost.
Once the queue fills, the worker thread automatically pauses the caller's entire business logic until space frees up.
optionExplanations: 队列设多大都是有界的，持续的高写入速率总能把任意大小的队列填满。
bounded queue 就是被设计成固定容量，满了不会自动扩容，这正是需要策略的原因。
说中了本质——block、drop-new、drop-old、throw 四条路各自让调用方或数据付出不同代价，没有免费选项。
队列满了只会拒绝或阻塞新的入队请求，不会主动去暂停调用方的其他业务逻辑。
optionExplanations_en: However large you size it, a bounded queue is still bounded — sustained high write rates can fill any size eventually.
A bounded queue is deliberately fixed-capacity — it never auto-grows, which is exactly why a policy is needed.
Nails it: block, drop-new, drop-old, and throw each make either the caller or the data pay a different price — none is free.
A full queue only rejects or blocks the enqueue call itself — it never reaches out to pause the caller's other business logic.
scenario: 异步日志的 bounded queue 只有 1 万容量，高峰期生产速度持续超过磁盘写入速度。
scenario_en: The async logger's bounded queue holds only ten thousand records, and at peak the producers outrun the disk.

scenario: 生产框架支持 getLogger('com.app.service.payments') 并继承父级配置。
scenario_en: A production framework supports getLogger('com.app.service.payments') and inherits parent configuration.
q: 应如何扩展？
q_en: How should the logger be extended?
options: 每次调用 getLogger(name) 都直接 new 一个全新且互不共享的 Logger 实例
把 logger 的 dotted-name 字符串保存在 Sink 实现里，由 Sink 负责继承逻辑
让 Formatter 接口负责判断某个 logger 是否应该继承父级配置
给 Logger 加 name/parent，并用 LoggerFactory 注册表按名称返回同一实例
why: 层级 logger 需要 dotted-name 树和共享注册表。Factory 是少数合理的全局状态，因为相同名字应返回同一 logger。
why_en: Hierarchical named loggers use a factory registry with parent links for inherited configuration.
whenOtherWins: 单一应用全局 logger 不需要该复杂度。
tradeoff: 共享注册表按名字返回同一实例 vs 每次都新建互不关联的实例

termDefinitions.meaning: 日志库的唯一入口类，持有不可变 destinations 列表，把每次调用打包成 LogRecord 并 fan-out 给每个 destination。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logger is the single entry point that builds one LogRecord per call and fans it out to every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 层级 logger 的全局注册表，按 dotted-name 返回同一个 Logger 实例并挂上 parent 指针。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LoggerFactory is the global registry for hierarchical loggers that returns the same instance per dotted name and links it to its parent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已经格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

options_en: Every getLogger(name) call should construct a brand-new, unrelated Logger.
The dotted logger name belongs on Sink, which then owns inheritance logic.
Formatter should decide whether a logger inherits its parent's configuration.
Add name and parent to Logger, and use a LoggerFactory registry that returns the same instance per name.
optionExplanations: 每次都 new 一个新实例意味着同名 logger 互不相识，配置继承和“同名返回同一个”的需求根本无法实现。
dotted-name 和继承是 Logger 的身份问题，Sink 只管写字节，不该反过来管理 logger 树结构。
Formatter 只序列化记录，判断谁是谁的父级完全不是它该关心的事。

q: 异步 destination 的正确高层流程是什么？

steps: write(record) 先按 minLevel 过滤。
通过 bounded queue 入队 LogRecord 并尽快返回。
worker 线程从 queue.take() 取记录。

tradeoff: 单 worker 顺序处理换目标内顺序 vs 多线程直接写换更低入队延迟

q_en: What can a synchronous per-destination lock guarantee, and what can it not guarantee?

why: 谁先拿到锁谁先写，同一文件不会字节交错。不同 destination 或全局时间顺序不是基础需求。
why_en: The per-destination lock prevents interleaved bytes but does not promise global ordering across threads.
tradeoff: 字节级原子写入 vs 跨线程严格调用顺序

options: 传输层整块：队列、schema 版本管理、跨服务分发都不用设计
五个严重级别的枚举可以省掉，进程内不需要区分严重度
线程安全可以不做，因为进程内的调用天然就是单线程的
格式化必须和目的地类型绑成同一个类，因为进程内不会出现远程目的地这种情况
options_en: The whole transport layer: queues, schema versioning, and cross-service delivery all disappear.
The five-level severity enum can be dropped; an in-process library needs no severity.
Thread safety can be skipped, because in-process calls are single-threaded by nature.
Formatting must be fused into the destination class, since a remote target can never appear in-process.
optionExplanations: 交付物缩成一个跑在单进程里的对象模型，写本地目标，摄取管线归别人。
级别和进程边界无关，需求明确要五级并有大小顺序。
恰恰相反：同进程多线程会同时调 log，锁是设计的一部分。
需求说格式与目的地类型各自独立变化，绑一起会退回 N×M 类爆炸。
optionExplanations_en: The deliverable shrinks to an object model inside one process writing to local targets; ingestion is someone else's problem.
Severity has nothing to do with the process boundary; five ordered levels are required.
The opposite: many threads in the same process call log concurrently, so locking is part of the design.
The requirements say format and target vary independently; fusing them brings back the N×M class explosion.
why: 进程内意味着共享状态只剩本进程的文件句柄和 stdout，传输与聚合整块消失；代价是这套库天生不具备跨服务汇总能力。
why_en: In-process means the only shared state is this process's file handle and stdout, so the whole transport and aggregation layer drops out of scope.
tradeoff: 进程内库的对象模型 vs 网络聚合服务的管线设计
whenOtherWins: 若回答是网络聚合服务，队列、摄取 schema、背压才是主设计，进程内的对象模型反而是次要话题。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次调用把同一条数据分发给多个下游接收者，这里指一次 log 调用写进所有已配置的 destination。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fan-out means one call delivers the same item to multiple downstream receivers — here, one log call reaching every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 集中约定日志或消息的字段结构与版本，让生产方和消费方对同一份结构达成一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Schema versioning centrally pins the field structure of messages so producers and consumers agree on one shape.

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程的标准输出流，控制台日志默认写到这里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stdout is a process's standard output stream, where console logs are written by default.

scenario: 为了让 log() 不阻塞调用方，你给每个 destination 配一个有界队列和一个专属 worker 线程；worker 是唯一取记录并写 sink 的线程。
scenario_en: To keep log() non-blocking you put a bounded queue in front of each destination plus one dedicated worker thread; that worker is the only thread that drains the queue and writes to the sink.
q: sink 上那把 per-destination 锁还需要留着吗？
q_en: Do you still need the per-destination lock around the sink?
options: 还需要，队列本身并不能阻止字节交错
可以去掉；单消费者独占 sink，但两个 destination 共享同一底层 stream 时要加回来
可以永久去掉；一旦引入队列，无论多少个 destination 指向同一个文件都不会再出现并发写问题
锁和队列解决的是同一个问题，二选一即可，选哪个只取决于团队代码风格
options_en: Keep it — a queue by itself does not stop bytes from interleaving.
Drop it; a single consumer owns the sink — but add it back when two destinations share one underlying stream.
Drop it permanently; once there is a queue, no number of destinations pointing at the same file can race.
Locks and queues solve the same problem, so pick either one based on team style.
optionExplanations: 在单消费者结构下没有第二个线程碰 sink，交错的前提已经不存在了。
只有 worker 线程碰 sink，互斥自动成立；共享底层 stream 时两个 worker 又会撞上。
两个 destination 各有一个 worker，它们写同一个文件时仍是两个线程在竞争。
锁管的是字节不交错的正确性，队列管的是调用方不被阻塞的协调，不可互换。
optionExplanations_en: With a single consumer no second thread touches the sink, so the premise for interleaving is already gone.
Only the worker touches the sink, so mutual exclusion is free — until two workers share one stream.
Each destination has its own worker; pointed at the same file, that is still two threads racing.
The lock is about bytes not interleaving; the queue is about not blocking the caller — not interchangeable.
why: 锁解决正确性、队列解决协调，是两个问题：单消费者让互斥变多余，但共享底层 stream 会把正确性问题原样带回来。
why_en: The lock is about correctness and the queue is about coordination; a single consumer makes the lock redundant until two destinations share one underlying stream.
tradeoff: 锁保证字节不交错 vs 队列保证调用方不阻塞
whenOtherWins: 两个 destination 写同一个底层 stream 时，各自的 worker 仍会互相交错，必须把锁加回来。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 容量有上限的队列，满了以后必须明确选择阻塞、丢新、丢旧还是抛异常。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounded queue has a fixed capacity, so when it fills you must choose explicitly between blocking, dropping, or throwing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只有一个线程从队列取数据并写下游资源，因此下游资源不会被并发访问。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Single consumer means exactly one thread drains the queue and writes the downstream resource, so that resource is never touched concurrently.

scenario: Destination 做成抽象基类，ConsoleDestination / FileDestination 只覆写 doWrite。现在要给文件输出加一层缓冲，之后还要再加一层失败重试。
scenario_en: Destination is an abstract base class and ConsoleDestination / FileDestination only override doWrite. Now you need to add buffering to the file output, and later retry on top of that.
q: 这个继承结构在加包装时具体怎么坏掉？
q_en: How exactly does the inheritance hierarchy break when you start wrapping?
options: 缓冲版只能再 subclass 并重抄文件逻辑，叠第二层包装就变成三层继承
抽象基类会让子类绕过 minLevel 过滤，过滤不变量守不住
父类和子类共享大量数据，改一个字段就得同步改每个子类的构造函数和序列化逻辑，重构成本随子类数量线性上升
继承会迫使 Formatter 和 Sink 合并成一个接口，格式与目的地重新耦合
options_en: The buffered version must subclass again and re-copy the file logic; a second wrapper makes it three levels of inheritance.
The abstract base lets subclasses bypass the minLevel filter, so the invariant is not held.
Parent and children share so much data that changing one field forces edits to every subclass constructor and serializer, and the cost grows with subclass count.
Inheritance forces Formatter and Sink to merge into one interface, re-coupling format and target.
optionExplanations: 包装是组合操作，用继承表达就只能层层叠，两个包装要三层类。
恰恰相反：模板方法把过滤和格式化钉在基类，子类只写 doWrite，反而不会漏。
真实情况相反——两个子类和基类不共享任何数据，只继承了一个方法，这才是继承理由薄的地方。
Formatter 与 Sink 的拆分与继承无关，继承版一样可以组合它们。
optionExplanations_en: Wrapping is a composition operation; expressed as inheritance it can only stack, so two wrappers need three levels.
The opposite: template method pins filter and format in the base class, so a subclass author cannot forget them.
Reality is the reverse — the subclasses share no data with the parent, they only inherit one method, which is the thin part.
Splitting Formatter from Sink is orthogonal to inheritance; the inheritance variant composes them too.
why: 继承在这里只买到一个方法的复用、不共享任何数据；而缓冲、重试、多路分发这类包装本质是组合，用继承表达只能层层 subclass。
why_en: Here inheritance only buys the reuse of one method and shares no data, while wrappers like buffering or retry are composition and can only be expressed as more subclassing.
tradeoff: 继承复用一个方法 vs 组合可自由叠加包装
whenOtherWins: 只有两个输出目标、且确定永不需要包装时，模板方法版少一个接口，在面试里同样站得住。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的纯函数接口，现有 PlainText 和 Json 两个实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Formatter is a pure-function interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string; plain text and JSON are the two implementations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基类写死流程骨架、把变化的一步留成抽象方法给子类填的模式，这里 write 是骨架、doWrite 是那一步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Template method means the base class fixes the workflow skeleton and leaves one abstract step for subclasses; here write is the skeleton and doWrite is the step.

scenario: 需求里的名词有：application、thread、severity level、timestamp、message、还有每次调用产生的那组数据。你要决定谁配拥有一个类。
scenario_en: The nouns in the requirements are: application, thread, severity level, timestamp, message, and the bundle of data produced per call. You must decide which of them deserves a class.
q: 该用哪条法则做这次筛选？
q_en: Which rule should drive that filtering?
options: 名词只要在需求里出现过就建类，宁多勿漏
拥有状态、强制某条规则、或有独立生命周期，占一条才建类
凡是被多个类读到的名词就建类，比如 timestamp 被每个 formatter 读到，所以它该是类
按需求文档的条目切分，一条需求对应一个类，这样类和需求能一一对上便于评审
options_en: Any noun that appears in the requirements becomes a class; better too many than too few.
Owns state, enforces a rule, or has its own lifecycle — one of those, or it stays a field.
Any noun read by more than one class becomes a class; timestamp is read by every formatter, so it is one.
Split by requirement bullet, one class per requirement, so classes map onto the doc and review is easy.
optionExplanations: 会造出 Application、Thread 这类没有状态也不归我们管的空壳类。
level 是五个固定值、timestamp 和 message 是原始值，三者都不占，所以是字段不是类。
被读到不代表拥有行为；按这条法则每个原始字段都会升格成类。
需求条目和类边界不是同一个维度，一条需求常常只落在某个类的一个方法上。
optionExplanations_en: That mints empty classes like Application and Thread, which own nothing and are outside our system anyway.
Level is five fixed values, timestamp and message are primitives — none qualifies, so all three stay fields.
Being read is not owning behaviour; by that rule every primitive field would become a class.
Requirement bullets and class boundaries are different axes; one bullet often lands on a single method.
why: application 和 thread 的生命周期归操作系统、不进模型；四个字段总是同行同生共死，才让那组数据升格成不可变值对象。
why_en: The application and threads are owned by the OS so we never model them, while the four per-call fields always travel together, which is what earns them one immutable value object.
tradeoff: 建类换封装 vs 保留字段换更小的模型
whenOtherWins: 某个名词现在只是字段，但日后长出自己的规则或独立生命周期时，那时再把它升格成类也不迟。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只承载数据、构造后不再变化的对象，可以在多线程间自由共享而不需要同步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A value object only carries data and never changes after construction, so it can be shared across threads without synchronization.

scenario: Formatter 是只有 format(record) -> String 一个方法的接口，现有 PlainText 和 Json 两个实现，Destination 在构造时收下其中一个。
scenario_en: Formatter is a one-method interface, format(record) -> String, with plain-text and JSON implementations, and a Destination takes one of them as a constructor argument.
q: 这对应哪个模式，扩展轴是什么？
q_en: Which pattern is this, and what is the axis of extension?
options: Strategy：序列化算法藏在接口后，加 CSV 格式只是新增一个实现类
Template Method：基类定好流程骨架，子类只填格式化那一步
Factory：由工厂读配置决定该 new 出哪一个 destination
Decorator：一个 formatter 包住另一个 formatter，一层层叠加装饰，直到拼出最终输出字符串
options_en: Strategy: the serialization algorithm sits behind an interface, so a CSV format is just one new class.
Template Method: the base class fixes the workflow and subclasses fill in the formatting step.
Factory: a factory reads config and decides which destination to instantiate.
Decorator: one formatter wraps another, stacking layer on layer until the final output string is assembled.
optionExplanations: 格式是可替换的算法、在构造时注入，扩展轴就是「再多一种格式」。
那是把 format 做成子类要覆写的钩子，正好是这里被拒绝的耦合方向。
工厂管的是对象怎么造出来，跟一次调用里用哪种序列化算法不是同一件事。
装饰要求包装者和被包装者同接口且能叠加，格式化在这里只用一次，不做叠加。
optionExplanations_en: Format is a swappable algorithm injected at construction; the axis of extension is simply "one more format".
That would make formatting a hook subclasses override — exactly the coupling this design rejects.
A factory governs how objects get built, which is a different question from which serializer runs per call.
Decoration needs wrapper and wrapped to share an interface and stack; formatting runs once here, no stacking.
why: 格式与目的地是两条独立变化的轴，Strategy 把格式那条轴变成一个构造参数；代价是多一个接口和一次间接调用。
why_en: Format and target vary along independent axes, and Strategy turns the format axis into a constructor argument at the cost of one extra interface.
tradeoff: Strategy 多一层间接 vs 硬编码格式少一个接口
whenOtherWins: 如果输出格式永远只有一种，直接在 Destination 里拼字符串更省，此时接口是纯开销。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的纯函数接口，现有 PlainText 和 Json 两个实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Formatter is a pure-function interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string; plain text and JSON are the two implementations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一族可互换的算法各自封装成实现同一接口的类，运行期由调用方选一个注入进来。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Strategy wraps a family of interchangeable algorithms behind one interface so the caller injects whichever one it wants.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基类固定流程骨架、把变化的一步留成抽象方法交给子类实现的继承型模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Template method fixes the workflow in a base class and leaves one varying step for subclasses to implement.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把对象的创建逻辑集中到一个专门的类或方法里，调用方不直接 new 具体实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A factory centralizes object creation so callers never instantiate concrete classes directly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 包装者与被包装者实现同一接口，通过层层包裹在不改原类的前提下叠加行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A decorator implements the same interface as the object it wraps, stacking extra behaviour without changing the original class.

scenario: Destination 只有一种形状：过滤 → 格式化 → 加锁 → 委托给 Sink，变化点全在 Sink 和 Formatter 后面。有人提议再抽一个 IDestination 接口。
scenario_en: Destination has exactly one shape — filter, format, lock, delegate to a Sink — and all variation lives behind Sink and Formatter. A teammate proposes extracting an IDestination interface as well.
q: 该不该为 Destination 再加接口？
q_en: Should Destination get an interface of its own?
options: 该加，所有类都面向接口编程才算符合依赖倒置
不加；只有一个实现的接口是为抽象而抽象，依赖倒置已落在 Sink 和 Formatter 上
该加，接口能让 Logger 遍历 destinations 时避开运行时类型判断带来的性能损失
该加，否则将来接入远程输出时必须回头修改 Destination 这个类的内部实现逻辑
options_en: Add it — programming to interfaces everywhere is what dependency inversion means.
No; a one-implementation interface is abstraction for its own sake, and inversion already sits at Sink and Formatter.
Add it so Logger can iterate destinations without paying for runtime type checks.
Add it, otherwise adding a remote output later forces you to edit Destination's internals.
optionExplanations: 依赖倒置是让高层依赖变化点的抽象，不是给每个类配一个接口。
Destination 只有一种合法流程，接口买不到第二个实现，只买到一层间接。
遍历一个同类型列表本来就没有类型判断，这个性能理由不存在。
恰恰相反：远程输出是新增一个 Sink 实现，Destination 一行都不用改。
optionExplanations_en: Dependency inversion means high-level code depends on abstractions at the axes of variation, not one interface per class.
There is only one legal Destination workflow, so the interface buys no second implementation, only indirection.
Iterating a homogeneous list involves no type checks, so that performance argument does not exist.
The opposite: a remote target is a new Sink implementation and Destination stays untouched.
why: 抽象要靠变化点挣来：这里的变化在 Sink 和 Formatter 后面，给 Destination 加接口只多一层间接，还多一个要维护的类型。
why_en: An abstraction has to be earned by a real axis of variation, and here that axis lives behind Sink and Formatter, so an IDestination would only add indirection.
tradeoff: 接口换可替换性 vs 具体类换更少间接层
whenOtherWins: 真出现第二种与「过滤-格式化-加锁-写入」不同流程的 destination 实现时，接口才开始有东西可支撑。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的纯函数接口，现有 PlainText 和 Json 两个实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Formatter is a pure-function interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string; plain text and JSON are the two implementations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 高层流程类依赖抽象接口而不是具体实现，这里 Destination 依赖 Sink 和 Formatter，而非 ConsoleSink 或 JsonFormatter。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dependency inversion means the high-level workflow class depends on abstractions like Sink and Formatter rather than on ConsoleSink or JsonFormatter.

scenario: 库里有 Logger、LogRecord、LogLevel、Formatter、Sink、Destination 六个类型；配置在启动时装配一次，之后成千上万个业务调用点只想打一行日志。
scenario_en: The library exposes Logger, LogRecord, LogLevel, Formatter, Sink, and Destination. Configuration is assembled once at startup, and after that tens of thousands of call sites just want to emit a line.
q: 运行期业务代码应该接触其中哪些类型？
q_en: Which of these should application code touch at runtime?
options: 只有 Logger（加上调用时传的 LogLevel），其余全部藏在它后面
Logger 和 Destination，这样业务代码能按场景临时切换输出目标
Logger 和 Formatter，业务代码最清楚自己该用文本还是 JSON 输出
Sink，跳过 Logger 直接写字节，省掉过滤和格式化这两步的开销以缩短热路径
options_en: Only Logger, plus the LogLevel passed at the call site; everything else hides behind it.
Logger and Destination, so business code can switch output targets per situation.
Logger and Formatter, since business code knows best whether it wants text or JSON.
Sink — write bytes directly, skipping filter and format to shorten the hot path.
optionExplanations: 门面只暴露 log 和五个便捷方法，调用点不需要知道背后有几层。
配置是启动时钉死的，运行期切目的地会把并发遍历和不可变性一起破坏。
格式是每个 destination 自己的配置，让调用点决定会让同一条记录在不同目标上不一致。
绕过 Destination 就绕过了过滤和锁，字节会和别的记录交错在一起。
optionExplanations_en: The facade exposes log plus five convenience methods; call sites never need to know what is behind it.
Configuration is fixed at startup; swapping targets at runtime breaks both immutability and lock-free iteration.
Format is per-destination configuration; letting call sites choose makes one record inconsistent across targets.
Bypassing Destination bypasses the filter and the lock, so bytes interleave with other records.
why: Logger 是应用唯一接触的公共门面，调用点数量决定了暴露面的改动成本；灵活性只保留在启动装配处，那里才 new 出 Sink 和 Formatter。
why_en: Logger is the only public face the application touches, so keeping the surface narrow keeps future changes off tens of thousands of call sites.
tradeoff: 窄门面换低改动成本 vs 宽 API 换调用点灵活性
whenOtherWins: 启动装配代码当然要直接 new 出 Sink、Formatter 和 Destination——那是配置代码，不是运行期调用点。

termDefinitions.meaning: 日志库的唯一入口类，持有不可变 destinations 列表，把每次调用打包成 LogRecord 并分发给每个 destination。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logger is the single entry point that builds one LogRecord per call and hands it to every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的纯函数接口，现有 PlainText 和 Json 两个实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Formatter is a pure-function interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string; plain text and JSON are the two implementations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对外只暴露一个入口类、把内部协作类全部挡在后面的做法，调用方只学一个 API。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A facade exposes a single entry class and hides the collaborating classes behind it, so callers learn only one API.

scenario: 现在 formatter.format() 在锁外执行，临界区只包 sink.write()。同事想把 format 也挪进锁里，理由是 try/finally 只写一段、更好读。
scenario_en: Right now formatter.format() runs outside the lock and the critical section holds only sink.write(). A teammate wants to move format inside so there is a single try/finally and the code reads better.
q: 把格式化放进锁内的代价什么时候才真正显现？
q_en: When does moving formatting inside the lock actually cost you?
options: 任何情况下都不可接受，格式化进锁会直接导致死锁
只有格式化昂贵（大对象 JSON 序列化）且竞争高时，吞吐才明显下滑
只要有两个线程就会显现，因为不可变记录进入锁内会被迫复制一份副本
只有单线程时才显现；多线程下锁会把格式化调度到别的核心上并行执行，反而更快
options_en: It is never acceptable — formatting inside the lock deadlocks.
Only when formatting itself is expensive (JSON-encoding a large object) and contention is high does throughput visibly drop.
Any two threads show it, because an immutable record entering the lock has to be copied.
Only single-threaded runs show it; with threads the lock schedules formatting onto another core, so it is faster.
optionExplanations: 格式化不获取任何别的锁，没有形成环的条件，死锁说法不成立。
临界区变长会把纯 CPU 时间压成串行段，量小的时候完全测不出来。
不可变对象从来不需要复制，这正是它能被多线程共享的原因。
锁只做互斥、不做调度，锁内的工作永远是串行的。
optionExplanations_en: Formatting acquires no other lock, so there is no cycle and no deadlock.
A longer critical section serializes pure CPU work, which is invisible until the work is large and contention high.
Immutable objects are never copied — that is exactly why they can be shared across threads.
A lock provides mutual exclusion, not scheduling; work inside it is always serial.
why: record 不可变、formatter 是纯函数，所以放锁外只为把临界区缩到最小；放锁内换来更简单的代码，代价是把 CPU 时间压进串行段。
why_en: The record is immutable and the formatter is pure, so keeping format outside the lock only shrinks the critical section; moving it in buys simpler code and pays in serialized CPU time.
tradeoff: 小临界区换吞吐 vs 大临界区换代码更简单
whenOtherWins: 格式化便宜、并发不高时，锁内格式化少一处推理负担，在面试里是同样可辩护的答案。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的纯函数接口，现有 PlainText 和 Json 两个实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Formatter is a pure-function interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string; plain text and JSON are the two implementations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一时刻只允许一个线程执行的代码段，越短并发吞吐越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is the code only one thread may execute at a time; the shorter it is, the higher the concurrent throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只依赖入参、不读写共享状态的函数，因此多线程同时调用天然安全。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A pure function depends only on its arguments and touches no shared state, so concurrent calls are safe by construction.

scenario: 磁盘写满，FileSink.write 每一次都抛 IOException。Destination 捕获后往 stderr 写一行诊断以免静默失败。服务每秒产生几千条 WARN 记录。
scenario_en: The disk is full, so FileSink.write throws IOException on every call. Destination catches it and writes one diagnostic line to stderr so the failure is not silent. The service emits thousands of WARN records per second.
q: 这个诊断通道接下来会怎样，该怎么收口？
q_en: What happens to that diagnostic channel next, and how do you contain it?
options: 每次失败一行，stderr 被刷爆、真正的报错被淹没；要限流、只报首次或按次数退避
不会出问题，stderr 无缓冲，写入代价可以忽略不计
诊断行会被同一个 destination 的锁自动节流到每秒一条
应该把诊断交回 logger 自己打，这样就能复用已有的 destination 过滤链路来限流，实现上也不必新增任何代码
options_en: One line per failure floods stderr and buries real errors; rate-limit, log only the first, or back off.
No problem — stderr is unbuffered, so the write cost is negligible.
The destination's own lock throttles the diagnostics down to one line per second.
Hand diagnostics back to the logger so the existing destination filter chain rate-limits them, needing no new code at all.
optionExplanations: 故障是持续性的，每条记录都会触发一次诊断，量级和日志量一样大。
问题不在单次成本，而在几千行每秒把运维真正要看的信息冲掉。
锁只保证互斥、不限速，几千个线程排队后照样每条都写出去。
把诊断交回正在失败的那条链路，等于让失败自己记录自己，可能无限递归。
optionExplanations_en: The failure is persistent, so every record triggers one diagnostic — the same volume as the logs themselves.
The issue is not per-write cost but thousands of lines per second washing out what operators need to see.
A lock gives mutual exclusion, not rate limiting; queued threads still each emit their line.
Routing diagnostics back through the failing path makes the failure log itself, risking unbounded recursion.
why: 正常写 → 每次失败都产一行诊断 → stderr 被同一条错误刷满、真实报错被淹没 → 限流/只报首次/退避把可见性救回来，代价是后续不同的失败可能被压掉。
why_en: A persistent sink failure emits one diagnostic per record until stderr is flooded, so you rate-limit or report only the first failure — at the cost of possibly suppressing later, different failures.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程的标准错误流，作为已知可用的兜底通道用来报告 sink 自己写不出去这件事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stderr is the process's standard error stream, used here as the known-good fallback channel for reporting that a sink itself failed to write.

termDefinitions.meaning: 连续失败时逐步拉长下一次上报或重试的间隔，避免故障期间把通道打满。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backoff means progressively lengthening the interval between reports or retries so a persistent failure cannot saturate the channel.

termDefinitions.meaning: 底层 I/O 操作失败时抛出的异常，磁盘满、句柄失效都会触发。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An IOException is thrown when an underlying input/output operation fails, for example when the disk is full or a handle is invalid.

scenario: 多个线程同时写同一个 FileDestination，磁盘 I/O 慢，per-destination 锁被持有几十毫秒。需求里异步写明确列在范围之外。
scenario_en: Several threads write to the same file destination, disk I/O is slow, and the per-destination lock is held for tens of milliseconds. Async writes are explicitly out of scope.
q: 拿不到锁的线程在 v1 里该怎么处理？
q_en: In v1, what should a thread do when it cannot get the lock?
options: 用 tryLock，拿不到就丢掉这条记录，保证调用方永不阻塞
就阻塞调用线程直到锁释放，v1 不做超时也不做 tryLock
加超时，超时后把这条记录转投到另一个 destination 上以免丢失
为每次 log 调用起一个线程去等锁，调用方立刻返回，等待被推到后台线程上承担
options_en: Use tryLock and drop the record when it fails, so callers never block.
Just block the calling thread until the lock is free; v1 adds no timeout and no tryLock.
Add a timeout and reroute the record to another destination so it is not lost.
Spawn a thread per log call to wait on the lock, returning immediately and pushing the wait to the background.
optionExplanations: 丢记录恰恰发生在系统压力最大、最需要日志的时刻。
契约是「写到了或没写」，阻塞语义最简单且不丢记录。
目的地是运维配置的输出位置，把记录换个地方写会让日志文件对不上。
每次调用一个线程，成本远超它省下的等待，且顺序更难推理。
optionExplanations_en: Dropping records happens exactly when the system is under most stress and the logs matter most.
The contract is "written or not written", and blocking is the simplest semantics that loses nothing.
A destination is an operator-configured output location; rerouting records makes the files disagree.
A thread per call costs far more than the wait it saves, and ordering becomes harder to reason about.
why: 阻塞是唯一既不丢记录又不引入新机制的选择；代价是慢磁盘的延迟会原样传导给调用线程，这正是异步扩展要解决的问题。
why_en: Blocking is the only option that neither loses records nor introduces new machinery, and it pays by passing slow-disk latency straight to the calling thread.
tradeoff: 阻塞换不丢记录 vs 超时或丢弃换调用方延迟
