scenario: 你刚开始准备系统设计面试,时间有限,在“深挖 Count-Min Sketch 的实现细节”和“打牢缓存、负载均衡、分区等核心概念”之间做取舍。
scenario_en: You are starting system design interview prep with limited time, choosing between deep Count-Min Sketch internals and core ideas like caching, load balancing, and partitioning.
q: 系统设计备考时间有限时,应该优先投入哪个方向?
q_en: With limited system design prep time, what should you prioritize?
options: 先掌握核心概念,再回头看这些专用结构
先背熟 Count-Min Sketch 的实现细节
两者各花一半准备时间
全部跳过,只刷面试真题
options_en: Master the core concepts first, then circle back to these specialized structures.
Memorize the implementation details of Count-Min Sketch first.
Split preparation time evenly between the two.
Skip both and only drill real interview questions.
why: 能完美实现 Count-Min Sketch 但没内化缓存、负载均衡、分区的候选人,照样设计不出高性能架构。核心概念的 ROI 远高于这些细节。
why_en: Master core concepts like caching, load balancing, and partitioning first, because nailing Count-Min Sketch without them still leads to a weak architecture.
whenOtherWins: 如果核心概念已经扎实、目标是资深/Infra 方向的深度轮,这些专用结构才是展示深度的差异化武器。
tradeoff: 核心概念先行,通用打底 vs 专用结构见长,但受众窄、见效慢

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用二维计数器数组估计元素出现次数上界的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Count-Min Sketch is a probabilistic structure that uses a two-dimensional counter array to estimate an upper bound on how often an item appeared.

optionExplanations: 核心概念覆盖几乎每场面试都会考的场景,时间有限时先打牢它回报率最高。
死记实现细节只在少数资深深度轮才用得上,基础不稳时投入产出比很低。
时间本就紧张,两头平分反而让核心概念和专用结构都学不透。
跳过基础只刷题,遇到基础架构问题会直接卡壳,不能替代扎实理解。
optionExplanations_en: Core concepts show up in nearly every interview, so nailing them first gives the best return on limited time.
Memorizing implementation details only pays off in rare deep-dive rounds, a poor bet before fundamentals are solid.
Splitting time evenly under a tight schedule leaves neither fundamentals nor specialized structures truly solid.
Skipping fundamentals to only drill questions leaves you stuck the moment a basic architecture question comes up.

scenario: 爬虫 URL 去重只需判断“这条 URL 见过没有”,不需要取回原始值。
scenario_en: For crawler URL dedup you only need to ask whether a URL was seen before; you never need to read the value back.
q: 布隆过滤器在抽象上最接近哪种数据结构的概率版?
q_en: Conceptually, a Bloom filter is a probabilistic version of which data structure?
options: 队列(插入和弹出)
图(节点和边)
有序列表(排序遍历)
集合(插入+成员查询)
options_en: A queue (push and pop).
A graph (nodes and edges).
A sorted list (ordered traversal).
A set (insert, check membership).
why: 布隆过滤器是集合(set)的概率类比:支持插入和成员查询,但用概率答案换取远小于哈希表的内存。
why_en: A bloom filter is a probabilistic analog of a set, supporting inserts and membership checks with far less memory than a hash table.
optionExplanations: 队列关心顺序进出,不支持“是否存在”这种成员查询语义
图建模的是节点间的关系,不是元素的成员关系
有序列表关心顺序遍历,不是概率化的成员测试
正确:集合语义(插入+成员查询)正是布隆过滤器概率化的对象
optionExplanations_en: A queue is about ordered push/pop, not an is-it-present query.
A graph models relationships between nodes, not set membership.
An ordered list is about traversal order, not probabilistic membership testing.
Correct: set semantics — insert plus membership check — is exactly what a Bloom filter makes probabilistic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型集合结构,用位数组和多个哈希函数判断元素是否可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that uses a bit array and multiple hash functions to test whether an element is possibly present.

scenario: 全网爬虫要记住已抓过的数万亿条 URL,单机内存只有 64GB。
scenario_en: A web-scale crawler must remember trillions of already-fetched URLs, but each node only has sixty-four gigabytes of RAM.
q: 要跟踪数万亿个元素 ID 的成员关系,为什么直接用哈希表实现集合不可行?
q_en: Why is a hash-table-backed set infeasible for membership over trillions of element IDs?
options: 每个元素都要占内存,超大集合下扛不住
哈希表的插入是 O(n)
哈希表不支持成员查询
哈希表必须整个存到磁盘上才装得下
options_en: Every element needs memory, unaffordable at huge scale.
A hash table's insert is O(n).
A hash table does not support membership queries.
A hash table must be stored entirely on disk to fit.
why: 哈希表插入和查询都是 O(1),但每个元素都要占内存,万亿级元素时内存不可行——这正是布隆过滤器做妥协的出发点。
why_en: A hash table gives O(1) inserts and lookups but needs memory for every element, which becomes infeasible at trillions of items.
optionExplanations: 正确:哈希表按元素数线性占内存,万亿级时不可行
哈希表插入是均摊 O(1),不是 O(n)
哈希表恰恰支持成员查询,这不是它的短板
哈希表可以完全放在内存里,不要求必须落盘
optionExplanations_en: Correct: a hash table's memory grows linearly with element count, infeasible at trillions of items.
Hash table inserts are amortized O(1), not O(n).
Membership queries are exactly what a hash table supports well; that is not its weakness.
A hash table can live entirely in memory; it is not required to be on disk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用哈希函数把 key 映射到桶位置的精确键值结构,插入和查询平均 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash table maps keys to bucket positions with a hash function, giving average O(1) inserts and lookups with exact answers.

scenario: 用布隆过滤器给数万亿 URL 去重,调用方要知道它的回答能信到什么程度。
scenario_en: You dedup trillions of URLs with a Bloom filter, and callers need to know exactly which of its answers they can trust.
q: 布隆过滤器能可靠给出哪些回答?(多选)
q_en: Which answers can a Bloom filter give reliably? (multi-select)
options: 元素“可能”在集合中(概率可配置)
元素“一定不”在集合中
元素“一定”在集合中
元素出现了多少次
options_en: The element is probably in the set (configurable probability).
The element is definitely not in the set.
The element is definitely in the set.
How many times the element occurred.
why: 布隆过滤器只有两种回答:可能在(有可配置的假阳性率)和一定不在。它永远无法证明元素一定在,也不提供计数。
why_en: A bloom filter can only say an element is probably in the set or definitely not in it, never that it is certainly present.
optionExplanations: 正确:能给出配置好的假阳性率下的“可能在”
正确:位缺失时的“一定不在”是绝对可靠的结论
布隆过滤器永远无法证明“一定在”,这正是它的代价
结构里没有计数信息,回答不了出现次数
optionExplanations_en: Correct: it can say an element is probably present at a configurable false-positive rate.
Correct: a missing bit gives an absolutely reliable definitely-not-present answer.
A Bloom filter can never prove definite presence; that certainty is exactly what it gives up.
The structure carries no count information, so it cannot answer how many times.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型集合结构,用位数组和多个哈希函数判断元素是否可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that uses a bit array and multiple hash functions to test whether an element is possibly present.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构判定元素“可能存在”,但实际上并不存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive is when the structure reports an element as present even though it is not.

q: 补全布隆过滤器的读写机制:
q_en: Fill in the Bloom filter read/write mechanism:
text: 插入元素时,用 {{k}} 个不同的哈希函数各哈希一次,把对应比特位都置为 {{1}}(相当于按位 OR 盖章);查询时若任意一位是 {{0}},该元素一定不在集合中。
why: k 个哈希函数生成元素的“印章”位图;插入是置位,查询是检查所有对应位。任何一位缺失就能斩钉截铁地说“不在”。
why_en: Each element is hashed k times to set k bits, and on lookup any unset bit proves the element was never inserted.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["item"] --> B["hash1 hash2 hash3"]
  B --> C["set bits"]
  D["query item"] --> E["check bits"]
  E --> F["no or maybe"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型集合结构,用位数组和多个哈希函数判断元素是否可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that uses a bit array and multiple hash functions to test whether an element is possibly present.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由一串二进制位组成的数组,布隆过滤器用它记录元素的“印章”。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bit array is a sequence of binary bits, and a Bloom filter uses it to record each element's hashed 'stamp'.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把任意输入映射为固定长度输出的函数,输出分布应尽量均匀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash function maps arbitrary input to a fixed-length output that should be uniformly distributed.

scenario: 爬虫查布隆过滤器判断某 URL 是否抓过,过滤器里已插入上亿条 URL。
scenario_en: A crawler probes a Bloom filter that already holds hundreds of millions of URLs to decide whether one was fetched.
q: 查询布隆过滤器时,发现元素对应的所有位都是 1,正确的结论是?
q_en: If all Bloom filter bits for an element are 1, what conclusion is correct?
options: 元素一定在集合中
元素一定不在集合中
可能在(位可能被覆盖)
无法得出任何结论
options_en: The element is definitely in the set.
The element is definitely not in the set.
Possibly present (bits may overlap).
No conclusion can be drawn at all.
why: 所有位为 1 只能说“可能在”:这些位可能是其他元素叠加置上的(就像别人的印章恰好覆盖了你的形状),这就是假阳性的来源。
why_en: If all bits are set the element is only probably present, because other elements' hashes may have set those same bits.
optionExplanations: 所有位为 1 只是“可能”,不能断言一定在集合中
位全为 1 时恰恰无法说“一定不在”,那是位缺失时才有的结论
正确:位可能被其他元素的哈希叠加置上,这就是假阳性的来源
至少能得出“可能在”这个概率结论,并非毫无信息
optionExplanations_en: All bits being set only means probably present, never a guarantee of presence.
When all bits are set you specifically cannot conclude definitely-absent; that needs a missing bit.
Correct: those bits may have been set by other elements' hashes overlapping, the source of false positives.
There is at least a probabilistic probably-in conclusion; it is not zero information.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构判定元素“可能存在”,但实际上并不存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive is when the structure reports an element as present even though it is not.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由一串二进制位组成的数组,布隆过滤器用它记录元素的“印章”。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bit array is a sequence of binary bits, and a Bloom filter uses it to record each element's hashed 'stamp'.

scenario: 布隆过滤器按 1 亿 URL 规模定容,爬虫实际跑到 10 亿条还在插入。
scenario_en: The Bloom filter was sized for a hundred million URLs, but the crawler has pushed past a billion and keeps inserting.
q: 随着插入越来越多、越来越多的位被置为 1,布隆过滤器会发生什么?
q_en: What happens as more inserts set more bits to 1 in a Bloom filter?
options: 单次查询延迟变慢
假阳性率持续升高,最终彻底失效
触发自动扩容机制
开始漏报一部分真正存在的元素
options_en: Each query gets slower.
The false-positive rate keeps climbing until it fails entirely.
It triggers automatic resizing.
It starts failing to report some elements that are actually present.
why: 位图越饱和,任意元素的位都全为 1 的概率越高,过滤器越没信息量;全部置 1 就像被墨水浸透的印章纸,什么都说明不了。
why_en: As more bits get set the filter saturates and its false-positive rate climbs, until a fully-set filter can say nothing at all.
optionExplanations: 查询始终是固定 k 次位检查,不会因位图变满而变慢
正确:位越满,任意查询命中全 1 的概率越高,假阳性率随之升高
布隆过滤器容量固定,不支持自动扩容
它只会误报“在”,不会漏报真正存在的元素(不存在假阴性)
optionExplanations_en: Lookup stays O(k), a fixed number of hash checks, regardless of how full the bit array gets.
Correct: as more bits fill, any query is more likely to see all-ones by chance, so false positives climb.
The filter's capacity is fixed; it has no auto-resizing.
It can only over-report presence; it never under-reports an element that is actually there.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构判定元素“可能存在”,但实际上并不存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive is when the structure reports an element as present even though it is not.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由一串二进制位组成的数组,布隆过滤器用它记录元素的“印章”。

scenario: 在 64GB 内存的爬虫节点上给布隆过滤器定容,目标假阳性率 1%。
scenario_en: You size a Bloom filter on a crawler node with sixty-four gigabytes of RAM, targeting a one percent false positive rate.
q: 既然位越多越不容易饱和,为什么不能无脑加大布隆过滤器的位数组?
q_en: If more bits reduce saturation, why not make the Bloom filter bit array huge by default?
options: 位数组太大会导致哈希冲突增加
加位会让查询变成 O(n)
位太多会产生假阴性
加位即加内存,违背省空间的初衷
options_en: A bigger bit array causes more hash collisions.
Adding bits turns lookup into O(n).
Too many bits causes false negatives.
More bits means more memory, defeating the whole point of using it.
why: 布隆过滤器必须按元素规模和目标假阳性率仔细选位数 m 和哈希数 k;盲目加位就丧失了省空间这个使用它的初衷。
why_en: You must size the bit array and hash count carefully, because adding bits grows the filter and saving space is the whole reason to use it.
optionExplanations: 位数组大小和哈希冲突率无关,冲突由哈希函数质量决定
查询固定是 k 次位检查,和位数组大小无关,不会退化成 O(n)
多加位只会让假阳性更少,不会产生假阴性
正确:加位就是加内存,省空间才是用它的理由,必须按需精确调参
optionExplanations_en: Bit-array size is unrelated to collision rate, which depends on hash-function quality.
Lookup is always k bit checks regardless of array size; it never degrades to O(n).
More bits only reduces false positives; it cannot cause false negatives.
Correct: more bits means more memory, and saving memory is the whole point, so size must be tuned deliberately.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型集合结构,用位数组和多个哈希函数判断元素是否可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that uses a bit array and multiple hash functions to test whether an element is possibly present.

scenario: 面试官给出一个已知量级:10 亿个 4 字节元素、1% 假阳性率下,布隆过滤器约需 1GB;同样元素数用优化过的哈希表约需 5GB。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives this scale: for one billion 4-byte elements at a 1% false-positive rate, a Bloom filter is about 1 GB; an optimized hash table for the same elements is about 5 GB.
q: 这组量级对布隆过滤器的部署方式意味着什么?
q_en: What does this scale imply for deploying a Bloom filter?
options: 1GB 已是不小的常驻内存,该做容量规划,不能每实例各存一份
可以完全忽略它的内存占用,像日志文件一样对待
既然比哈希表省了 80%,就不用再监控它的内存增长
1GB 还不够小,应该继续加哈希函数数量把它压到几 MB
options_en: One gigabyte is already substantial memory that needs real capacity planning, not casual per-instance copies.
Its memory footprint can be ignored entirely, treated like a log file.
Since it saves eighty percent over a hash table, its memory growth no longer needs monitoring.
One gigabyte is still not small enough; keep adding hash functions to shrink it to a few megabytes.
why: 10 亿元素、1% 假阳性率的布隆过滤器约 1GB——比很多人想象的大得多,必须像其他大内存组件一样规划部署和监控,而不是随手在每个实例里复制。
why_en: A billion-element Bloom filter at a one percent false-positive rate takes about a gigabyte, large enough that it needs real capacity planning rather than casual per-instance duplication.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型集合结构,用位数组和多个哈希函数判断元素是否可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that uses a bit array and multiple hash functions to test whether an element is possibly present.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用哈希函数把 key 映射到桶位置的精确键值结构,插入和查询平均 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash table maps keys to bucket positions with a hash function, giving average O(1) inserts and lookups with exact answers.

optionExplanations: 把 1GB 内存当独立组件规划,才配得上它的实际体量。
日志文件可弃可轮转,而常驻的 1GB 过滤器要供全程查询用。
省了 80% 不等于零增长,过滤器仍会随集合扩大而变大,要继续盯着。
哈希函数数量不影响位数组大小,想再省内存只能接受更高的假阳性率。
optionExplanations_en: Treat a one-gigabyte filter as real capacity to plan for, not a rounding error to wave away.
A log file can be discarded or rotated; a resident one-gigabyte filter must stay in memory for every lookup.
Eighty percent saved is not zero growth — the filter still grows as the tracked set grows.
More hash functions tune accuracy, not array size — shrinking further means accepting more false positives.

scenario: 同样存 10 亿元素,优化好的哈希表约需 5GB,布隆过滤器约需 1GB。
scenario_en: For the same one billion elements, an optimized hash table is about 5 GB and a Bloom filter is about 1 GB.
q: 这组节省幅度该怎么向面试官描述?
q_en: How should you describe this memory saving in an interview?
options: 省约 50%
省约 80%——可观,但不是好几个数量级
省约 99.9%,足足小了好几个数量级
几乎不省
options_en: It saves about fifty percent.
It saves about eighty percent — substantial, but not several orders of magnitude.
It saves about 99.9 percent, a full several orders of magnitude smaller.
It barely saves anything.
why: 1GB 对 5GB 是约 80% 的节省,很可观;但别夸张成“小好几个数量级”——布隆过滤器不是一个微型结构。
why_en: The bloom filter saves about eighty percent versus a hash table, a large win but not several orders of magnitude.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型集合结构,用位数组和多个哈希函数判断元素是否可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that uses a bit array and multiple hash functions to test whether an element is possibly present.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用哈希函数把 key 映射到桶位置的精确键值结构,插入和查询平均 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash table maps keys to bucket positions with a hash function, giving average O(1) inserts and lookups with exact answers.

optionExplanations: 把差距压低到腰斩,低估了两者相差 5 倍这件事。
1GB 对 5GB 正好是五分之一,口径不夸大也不缩水。
5 倍差距远够不上好几个数量级,这个说法夸大了节省。

why_en: Count-Min Sketch estimates how many times an item has appeared in a stream, more precisely an upper bound on that count.

q: 在 Count-Min Sketch 里查询某元素的计数时,取的是什么值?
q_en: When querying an item in Count-Min Sketch, which value do you return?
options: 该元素对应的所有计数器中的最小值
所有计数器的平均值
该元素对应的所有计数器中的最大值
对应计数器之和
options_en: The minimum across the element's counters.
The average of all counters.
The maximum across all of the element's counters.
The sum of the element's counters.
why: 取最小值(“count-min”名字的由来):任何一个对应计数器都 ≥ 真实次数(可能被碰撞抬高),所以最小的那个就是最紧的上界。
why_en: You take the minimum across the item's counters, because every counter is inflated by collisions and the smallest gives the tightest upper bound.
optionExplanations: 正确:取最小值给出最紧的上界,这正是“count-min”名字的由来
平均值会被碰撞抬高的计数器拖累,不是紧的上界
取最大值只会得到更松的上界,没有意义
求和会重复叠加碰撞误差,偏差比取最小值大得多
optionExplanations_en: Correct: taking the minimum gives the tightest upper bound, exactly why it is called count-min.
An average is dragged up by collision-inflated counters and is not a tight bound.
Taking the maximum only gives a looser upper bound, which is not useful.
Summing compounds collision error across counters, worse than taking the minimum.

一个跳表

A balanced tree.
A skip list.
A 2D counter array with multiple hashes.

why_en: A Count-Min Sketch is a two-dimensional array of counters with one hash function per row, incrementing on insert and taking the row-wise minimum on query.

q: 补全 Count-Min Sketch 的两个尺寸参数的作用:
q_en: Fill in what the two Count-Min Sketch size parameters control:
text: 宽度 w 控制{{碰撞}}概率——越宽碰撞越少、越准;深度 d 控制估计的{{置信度}}——越深越有把握;误差有由 w 和 d 决定的数学{{上界}}。
why: w(每行格子数)和 d(行数/哈希数)就是空间-精度旋钮;CMS 的误差不是玄学,而是有由这两个参数决定的可证明边界。
why_en: Width controls collision probability and depth controls confidence, and together they give mathematically bounded error.

scenario: 为千万唯一 videoId 的播放计数挑计数器数量,内存预算是固定的。

q: 两个极端:只用 1 个计数器,或给 N 个元素配 N 个专属计数器,分别会怎样?
q_en: What happens at the two extremes: one counter, or one dedicated counter per item?
options: 都能得到有用的近似
1 个坑毫无信息,N 个坑精确却不省空间
1 个计数器最省也最准;N 个计数器最浪费
两种都会导致假阴性
options_en: Both give a useful approximation.
One bucket gives no information, N buckets are exact but save nothing.
One counter is both cheapest and most accurate; N counters are the most wasteful.
Both extremes cause false negatives.
why: 1 个坑=所有人共享一个总数,上界毫无区分度;每人一个坑=精确计数但空间没省。CMS 的价值区间在中间:计数器数远小于唯一元素数仍能给有效上界。
why_en: One shared counter gives a useless bound and one counter per item is exact but saves nothing, so the sketch lives in between with far fewer counters than unique items.
optionExplanations: 1 个计数器时人人共享同一个数,给不出任何区分度
正确:1 个坑=毫无信息的共享上界;N 个坑=精确但不省空间
1 个计数器最省空间但完全没有区分度,谈不上“最准”
两种极端都不产生假阴性问题,CMS 本身也不会漏报
optionExplanations_en: With one counter everyone shares the same number, giving zero ability to distinguish people.
Correct: one bucket gives an uninformative shared bound; N buckets are exact but save nothing.
One counter saves the most space but has zero discrimination, so it is not 'most accurate'.
Neither extreme causes a false-negative issue; Count-Min Sketch itself never under-reports.

Correct: bounded space in exchange for approximate upper-bound counts; exact counts need space proportional to unique items.

q: 近似 Top-K 热播视频榜最合适的结构组合是?
q_en: For approximate YouTube Top-K videos, what structure combination fits best?
options: 为每个视频维护精确计数器的巨型哈希表
CMS 统计播放数,配有序 Top-K 列表
HyperLogLog 配合优先队列做排序

options_en: A giant hash table with an exact counter per video.
CMS for view counts, paired with a sorted top-K list.
HyperLogLog paired with a priority queue for ranking.

why: 每次播放在 CMS 里递增,再查该视频的估计计数;若它已在榜上或超过榜内最小值,就更新 Top-K 列表——空间远小于全量哈希表。

tradeoff: 近似计数、空间可控 vs 精确排行但空间随视频数线性增长

scenario: 面试官给出 HyperLogLog 的量级参考:约 1.5KB 内存 ≈ 2% 误差,3KB ≈ 1.6%,6KB ≈ 1.2%(误差与寄存器数 m 的平方根成反比)。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives HLL scale anchors: about 1.5 KB memory gives around 2% error, 3 KB gives around 1.6%, and 6 KB gives around 1.2%; error is inversely proportional to the square root of register count m.
q: 这组数字对“要不要为了更高精度加内存”的决定意味着什么?
q_en: What do these numbers imply about adding memory for more HLL accuracy?
options: 内存翻倍只把误差压到约 1/√2,收益递减——2% 已够用就不必再堆内存
内存翻倍误差也减半,应该不断加内存直到误差趋近于 0
这组数字说明 HLL 根本不适合十亿级数据,应换用精确 HashSet
只要给够内存,HyperLogLog 最终能做到零误差
options_en: Doubling memory only cuts error to about one over root two — diminishing returns, so stop once two percent is good enough.
Doubling memory halves the error too, so keep adding memory until error approaches zero.
These numbers mean HyperLogLog simply does not fit billion-scale data, so switch to an exact HashSet.
Given enough memory, HyperLogLog can eventually reach zero error.
why: HLL 误差 ∝ 1/√m,内存翻倍只把误差除以约 1.4——收益递减很快,与其无脑加内存,不如先确认业务能接受的误差下限。
why_en: Because HyperLogLog error scales as one over the square root of the register count, doubling memory only cuts error by about thirty percent, so it pays off to size for the error your business actually needs rather than over-provisioning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

optionExplanations: 1.5KB 到 3KB 到 6KB 每次翻倍,误差只从 2% 降到 1.6% 再到 1.2%,涨幅一次比一次小。
误差跟 1/√m 走,不是跟 1/m 走,翻倍内存换不来减半的误差。
HLL 恰恰是为十亿级设计的近似结构,该调对误差目标,不是换掉它。
只要还在用哈希与寄存器做估计,统计误差就不会消失,加内存也逼近不到零。
optionExplanations_en: Doubling from 1.5KB to 3KB to 6KB drops error from 2% to 1.6% to 1.2% — smaller gains each time.
Error tracks one over the square root of m, not one over m, so doubling memory never halves it.
HyperLogLog is built exactly for billion-scale data; the fix is tuning the error target, not swapping structures.
As long as it estimates from hashes and registers, statistical error never fully disappears.

scenario: 给 DAU 统计的 HLL 定内存:寄存器数 m 翻倍能换回多少精度决定值不值。
scenario_en: You're sizing a HyperLogLog for daily actives, and whether doubling the register count m is worth it depends on how much accuracy it buys.
q: HyperLogLog 的误差随寄存器数量 m 如何变化?
q_en: How does HyperLogLog error change with the number of registers m?
options: 按 1/m 线性下降
按 log m 下降
按 1/√m 下降
与 m 无关
options_en: It drops linearly as one over m.
It drops as the log of m.
It drops as one over the square root of m.
It is independent of m.
why: 误差 ∝ 1/√m:内存翻倍只把误差除以 √2,收益递减,所以够用就好,不必堆内存。
why_en: Error scales as one over the square root of the register count, so doubling memory only modestly improves accuracy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

optionExplanations: 1/m 下降太乐观了,实际误差降得没这么快。
log m 下降太慢,不符合 HLL 实际的统计特性。
这是 HLL 的真实规律,内存翻倍只把误差除以约 √2,收益递减。
寄存器数量 m 直接决定统计的方差,说无关忽略了它的全部作用。
optionExplanations_en: One over m would be overly optimistic; real error does not fall that fast.
Log m falls too slowly to match HyperLogLog’s actual statistical behavior.
That is the real rule — doubling memory divides error by roughly the square root of two, a shrinking gain.
The register count m directly sets the estimate’s variance; calling it unrelated ignores its whole role.

scenario: 内存受限的指标系统要统计超大数据集里的唯一元素个数。
scenario_en: A memory-constrained metrics system needs the number of unique elements in a very large dataset.
q: HyperLogLog 是好选择的前提条件有哪些?(多选)
q_en: What prerequisites make HyperLogLog a good choice? (multi-select)
options: 要统计超大数据集中的唯一元素个数
可用内存有限
能容忍小幅估计误差
需要能列出所有唯一元素
options_en: You need to count unique elements in a huge dataset.
Available memory is limited.
Small estimation error is tolerable.
You need to list every unique element.
why: HLL 的铁三角:去重计数 + 内存有限 + 容忍小误差。它只给数字,永远列不出具体有哪些元素。
why_en: HyperLogLog fits when you count unique items in huge data with limited memory and can tolerate small estimation errors.
optionExplanations: 正确:去重计数正是 HLL 存在的理由
正确:内存受限是选择近似结构而非精确 HashSet 的前提
正确:HLL 的估计天生带误差,必须能接受小幅偏差
HLL 只给数字,永远列不出具体是哪些元素
optionExplanations_en: Correct: counting unique items is exactly why HyperLogLog exists.
Correct: limited memory is the precondition for choosing an approximate structure over an exact HashSet.
Correct: HyperLogLog's estimate inherently carries error, so small deviations must be acceptable.
HyperLogLog only returns a number; it can never list which elements were seen.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用哈希函数把 key 映射到桶位置的精确键值结构,插入和查询平均 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash table maps keys to bucket positions with a hash function, giving average O(1) inserts and lookups with exact answers.

scenario: 有人想用 HLL 统计几千个元素的小集合,另一个人想用它出精确账单数字。
scenario_en: One team wants HyperLogLog for a set of a few thousand items, another wants it to produce exact billing numbers.
q: HyperLogLog 的两个主要反模式是什么?
q_en: What are the two main HyperLogLog anti-patterns?
options: 数据是字符串;或者数据是数字
数据有序;数据无序
需要精确计数,或基数本来就很小
内存太大;内存太小
options_en: The data is strings; or the data is numbers.
The data is ordered; the data is unordered.
You need exact counts, or the cardinality is naturally tiny.
Memory is too large; memory is too small.
why: 要精确就别用 HLL;基数很小也别用——几千个元素的 hash set 又准又便宜,套 HLL 只添误差和复杂度。
why_en: Avoid HyperLogLog when you need exact counts or when the unique set is small enough that a plain hash set is cheaper and exact.
optionExplanations: 数据类型不是 HLL 的反模式,它对字符串和数字都能哈希处理
有序无序也不是反模式,HLL 只关心哈希后的分布
正确:需要精确计数,或基数本来就很小,都不该用 HLL
内存大小本身不是反模式,是权衡的输入而非错误用法
optionExplanations_en: Data type is not the anti-pattern; HyperLogLog hashes strings and numbers alike.
Ordering is not the anti-pattern either; HyperLogLog only cares about the hashed distribution.
Correct: needing exact counts, or having a naturally tiny cardinality, are both poor fits for HyperLogLog.
Memory size itself is not the anti-pattern; it is an input to the tradeoff, not a misuse.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

scenario: 面试里要给 DAU 去重计数选落地方案,希望用现成组件而不是自研。
scenario_en: In the interview you need a concrete landing spot for deduplicated DAU counting, preferably off-the-shelf rather than hand-rolled.
q: 以下哪组常用系统对 HyperLogLog 提供开箱即用的支持?
q_en: Which common systems provide HyperLogLog support out of the box?
options: Redis 和 PostgreSQL
只有专用分析数据库
只有 Hadoop 生态
没有任何现成实现,必须自己从零写
options_en: Redis and PostgreSQL.
Only specialized analytics databases.
Only the Hadoop ecosystem.
No off-the-shelf implementation exists at all; you must write it from scratch yourself.
why: HLL 有几十种实现,Redis(PFADD/PFCOUNT)和 PostgreSQL 都原生支持,面试里可以直接点名。
why_en: Both Redis and PostgreSQL support HyperLogLog out of the box among dozens of implementations.
optionExplanations: 正确:Redis 用 PFADD/PFCOUNT 原生内置,PostgreSQL 则通过成熟的 hll 扩展提供,都能直接用
支持并不局限于专用分析数据库,通用数据库和缓存也原生支持
Hadoop 生态之外的通用系统同样原生支持 HLL
有几十种现成实现,不需要从零自己写
optionExplanations_en: Correct: Redis has PFADD/PFCOUNT built in, and PostgreSQL offers it through the mature hll extension.
Support is not limited to specialized analytics databases; general-purpose databases and caches support it too.
Native support exists well outside the Hadoop ecosystem too.
Dozens of ready-made implementations exist; you do not need to write one from scratch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的内存型 key-value 存储,常被用作缓存,原生支持 HyperLogLog。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory key-value store commonly used as a cache, with native HyperLogLog support.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用关系型数据库,也支持 HyperLogLog 等扩展。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PostgreSQL is a relational database that also supports extensions like HyperLogLog.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 内置 HyperLogLog 命令:PFADD 添加元素,PFCOUNT 估计基数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PFADD and PFCOUNT are Redis's built-in HyperLogLog commands for adding elements and estimating cardinality.

numberAnchors.risk: 单主写瓶颈、索引/事务变重

scenario: 为分析平台挑选哪些指标可以用 HLL 的几 KB 估计来算,哪些不能。
scenario_en: You decide which metrics on an analytics platform can ride on a few kilobytes of HyperLogLog estimate and which cannot.
q: 现代分析/指标系统里,哪些指标是 HyperLogLog 的典型用武之地?(多选)
q_en: Which modern analytics metrics are good fits for HyperLogLog? (multi-select)
options: 日活/月活用户数(DAU/MAU)
每个页面的独立访客数
去重搜索词数、独立 IP 数
账单的精确总金额
options_en: Daily/monthly active users (DAU/MAU).
Unique visitors per page.
Distinct search terms and unique IP counts.
The exact total amount on a bill.
why: 凡是“有多少个不同的 X”都是 HLL 的地盘:DAU/MAU、独立访客、去重搜索词、独立 IP。钱这类必须精确的指标绝不能用估计。
why_en: HyperLogLog powers distinct-count metrics like daily active users, unique visitors, distinct search terms, and unique IPs.
optionExplanations: 正确:DAU/MAU 本质就是“有多少个不同用户”,典型基数问题
正确:独立访客数同样是去重计数,HLL 的强项
正确:去重搜索词、独立 IP 数都是“有多少个不同的 X”
账单金额必须精确到分,绝不能用近似估计的结构
optionExplanations_en: Correct: DAU/MAU is fundamentally 'how many distinct users', a classic cardinality problem.
Correct: unique visitor counts are also a distinct-count problem, HyperLogLog's strength.
Correct: distinct search terms and unique IPs are both 'how many distinct X' questions.
A billing total must be exact to the cent and should never use an approximating structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日活跃用户数/月活跃用户数,衡量产品活跃度的核心指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DAU and MAU are daily and monthly active user counts, core metrics for product engagement.

scenario: 反爬系统要找出偷数据的 IP。只按请求总量封禁会误伤有大量真实用户的企业代理。已知真实用户会反复访问热门页面,而爬虫几乎只访问没见过的新页面。
scenario_en: An anti-scraping system needs to find IPs stealing data. Blocking by raw request count would hurt enterprise proxies; real users revisit popular pages, while scrapers mostly request never-seen pages.
q: 反爬系统该用什么信号区分爬虫?
q_en: What signal best separates scrapers from real users?
options: 每个 IP 的请求总数
去重 URL 占比(HLL 估计)
每个 IP 请求的平均响应时间
User-Agent 字符串
options_en: Total request count per IP.
Share of distinct URLs (HLL estimate).
Average response time of each IP's requests.
The User-Agent string.
why: 爬虫的特征是输入的“熵”高:访问的 URL 几乎全是新的。HLL 能低成本估计每个 IP 的去重 URL 比例,避免为每个 IP 存巨型 URL 集合。
why_en: HyperLogLog cheaply estimates the share of distinct URLs each IP requests, exposing scrapers that mostly hit never-seen pages.
whenOtherWins: 若 IP 数量小或需要精确证据链(封禁申诉),直接存每 IP 的精确 URL 集合;没有代理干扰时,简单的请求量阈值也够用。
tradeoff: 低成本估计去重 URL 占比 vs 为每个 IP 存精确 URL 集合的开销

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量数据随机性/多样性的指标,这里指一个 IP 访问了多少不同 URL。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Entropy here measures how varied an IP's requests are, based on how many distinct URLs it visits.

optionExplanations: 请求总量高的可能只是正常的企业代理,单看总数会误伤真实用户。
HLL 低成本估计每个 IP 访问的去重 URL 占比,精准捕捉几乎全访问新页面这个爬虫特征。
响应时间反映的是后端负载,跟一个 IP 是不是爬虫没有直接因果关系。
User-Agent 是客户端自己声明的字符串,伪造成本极低,不能当可靠信号。
optionExplanations_en: High total requests can just be a legitimate high-traffic corporate proxy, so raw count alone misfires.
HLL cheaply tracks each IP's ratio of never-before-seen URLs, catching the almost-all-new-pages scraper pattern.
Response time mostly reflects backend load, with no direct causal link to whether an IP is scraping.
The User-Agent is a client-declared string, trivially spoofed, so it is not a reliable signal alone.

scenario: 在规划缓存容量与分区策略,需要了解工作集:实际被访问的唯一 key 有多少、唯一条目的周转率如何,但不想为此付出巨大内存开销。
scenario_en: You are planning cache capacity and partitioning, and need to understand the working set: how many unique keys are accessed and how fast unique entries churn, without huge memory cost.
q: 缓存工作集规模该怎么低成本估计?
q_en: How can you estimate cache working-set size cheaply?
options: 记录全部访问日志再离线排序去重
只抽样 1% 的请求
用 Count-Min Sketch
HLL 估计被访问 key 的基数与周转
options_en: Log every access and deduplicate offline by sorting.
Sample just one percent of requests.
Use Count-Min Sketch.
Use HLL for the cardinality and turnover of accessed keys.
why: 缓存容量设计的核心输入是“工作集里有多少唯一 key”——典型的基数问题,HLL 用 KB 级内存就能回答,顺带支撑分区决策。
why_en: HyperLogLog answers working-set questions like how many unique keys are accessed without the memory overhead of exact tracking.
whenOtherWins: 如果还需要每个 key 的访问频次(不只是去重数),该用 Count-Min Sketch 或精确计数;key 空间很小则直接精确统计。
tradeoff: KB 级内存估计工作集基数 vs 精确统计但内存随唯一 key 数增长

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用二维计数器数组估计元素出现次数上界的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Count-Min Sketch is a probabilistic structure that uses a two-dimensional counter array to estimate an upper bound on how often an item appeared.

optionExplanations: 全量日志加离线排序去重能做到精确,但存储和处理成本高、还不是实时的。
抽样能省资源,但会给唯一 key 估计再叠一层误差,精度更难把握。
CMS 估计的是每个 key 的命中频次,答不出一共有多少个不同 key 这个基数问题。
HLL 用 KB 级内存直接给出唯一 key 数和周转速度,正对上容量规划要的那个数字。
optionExplanations_en: A full log with offline dedup can be exact, but storage and processing cost is high and not real time.
Sampling saves resources but adds another layer of error onto the unique-key estimate itself.
CMS estimates per-key hit frequency, not how many distinct keys total — a cardinality question it cannot answer.
HLL gives unique key count and turnover directly in kilobytes, exactly the number capacity planning needs.

scenario: 指标系统一边要“每个搜索词被搜了多少次”,一边要“一共多少个不同搜索词”。
scenario_en: One side of the metrics system asks how many times each search term was queried, the other asks how many distinct terms there were.
q: Count-Min Sketch 和 HyperLogLog 回答的问题有何本质不同?
q_en: What is the fundamental difference between Count-Min Sketch and HyperLogLog?
options: CMS 答频次上界,HLL 答去重总数
CMS 数去重数,HLL 数出现次数
两者都数去重数,只是精度不同
两者都回答成员存在性
options_en: CMS answers a frequency upper bound, HLL answers total distinct count.
CMS counts distinct items, HyperLogLog counts occurrences.
Both count distinct items, differing only in precision.
Both answer whether a member exists.
why: 记忆锚点:CMS = 每个已知元素的频次上界;HLL = 整个集合的去重规模。一个面向单个元素,一个面向全集。
why_en: Count-Min Sketch bounds how often a known item appeared, while HyperLogLog estimates how many distinct items exist overall.
tradeoff: 已知元素的频次上界(CMS) vs 全集的去重规模(HLL)

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用二维计数器数组估计元素出现次数上界的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Count-Min Sketch is a probabilistic structure that uses a two-dimensional counter array to estimate an upper bound on how often an item appeared.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型集合结构,用位数组和多个哈希函数判断元素是否可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that uses a bit array and multiple hash functions to test whether an element is possibly present.

optionExplanations: 记忆锚点就是这个:CMS 盯着单个已知元素的频次,HLL 盯着整个集合的去重规模。
角色对调了,CMS 从不做去重,它数的是频次,不是有多少种。
CMS 压根不回答有多少种不同的,不是精度差异,是问题类型完全不同。
成员是否存在是布隆过滤器的地盘,CMS 和 HLL 都不回答这个问题。
optionExplanations_en: That is the anchor: CMS focuses on one known item’s frequency, HLL on the whole set’s distinct count.
That swaps the roles — CMS never deduplicates, it counts frequency, not how many distinct.
CMS does not answer how many distinct at all; this is a different question, not a precision gap.
Membership is a Bloom filter’s job; neither CMS nor HyperLogLog answers that question.

scenario: 每天上亿条请求延迟记录要出 P95,内存和排序开销都受限。
scenario_en: You need P95 over hundreds of millions of request latencies a day, with both memory and sort cost constrained.
q: 为什么在海量数据流上无法精确计算 P95 延迟这类分位数?
q_en: Why can't we compute exact P95 latency over a massive stream?
options: 分位数在数学上无定义
要存储并排序全部样本才行
分位数只能离线计算
浮点误差会累积
options_en: Percentiles are mathematically undefined.
Every sample must be stored and sorted.
Percentiles can only be computed offline.
Floating-point error accumulates.
why: 精确 P95 需要保留全部样本并排序;每天上亿条延迟记录时既存不起也排不动,所以必须用有界内存的近似方法。
why_en: Exact quantiles require storing and sorting every value, which is impossible for massive datasets.
optionExplanations: 分位数在数学上是良定义的统计量,问题出在工程上存不下、排不动
正确:精确分位数要存下并排序全部样本,海量数据下既存不起也排不动
近似分位数结构完全可以做实时流式计算,不局限于离线
浮点误差不是这里的瓶颈,存储与排序的规模才是
optionExplanations_en: Percentiles are a well-defined statistic mathematically; the problem is engineering — storing and sorting at scale.
Correct: exact percentiles require storing and sorting every sample, infeasible at massive data volumes.
Approximate quantile structures can absolutely run in real time streaming, not just offline.
Floating-point error is not the bottleneck here; storage and sorting scale is.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量数据分布中某个百分比位置的值,如 P95 表示 95% 的数据小于等于它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A percentile marks the value below which a given percentage of the data falls, so P95 means ninety-five percent of values are at or below it.

scenario: 每天上亿条延迟样本上求分位数,内存必须固定、不随样本数增长。
scenario_en: You compute quantiles over hundreds of millions of latency samples a day, and memory must stay fixed regardless of sample count.
q: 基于直方图(bucket)的近似分位数方案,本质是什么?
q_en: What is the essence of a bucket-based approximate quantile scheme?
options: 对数据做随机抽样
存储最近 N 个值的一个滑动窗口
值域切成桶,每桶一个计数,内存有界
用机器学习模型预测分位数
options_en: Randomly sampling the data.
Keeping a single sliding window of the last N values.
Split the range into buckets, one counter each, bounded memory.
Using a machine-learning model to predict percentiles.
why: 每条数据只让所属桶的计数器 +1;无论流过多少数据,内存都固定为桶的数量,用桶宽的精度损失换无限的可扩展性。
why_en: Histogram-based quantiles group values into fixed buckets with counts, giving bounded memory no matter how much data flows through.
optionExplanations: 随机抽样会丢失部分数据点,不是直方图桶算法的做法
滑动窗口只看最近 N 个值,和固定桶计数是两种不同的近似方式
正确:把值域切成桶,每桶一个计数器,内存固定且与数据总量无关
不需要机器学习模型,桶计数是纯粹的确定性算法
optionExplanations_en: Random sampling discards data points; that is not how histogram bucketing works.
A sliding window only looks at the last N values, a different approximation from fixed bucket counts.
Correct: values are grouped into buckets, each with one counter, giving fixed memory independent of data volume.
No machine learning model is needed; bucket counting is a purely deterministic algorithm.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把值域切成若干区间(桶),只记录每个区间的计数,用有界内存近似分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram divides the value range into buckets and tracks only per-bucket counts, approximating the distribution in bounded memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量数据分布中某个百分比位置的值,如 P95 表示 95% 的数据小于等于它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A percentile marks the value below which a given percentage of the data falls, so P95 means ninety-five percent of values are at or below it.

scenario_en: Latency buckets: 0-10 ms has 1,000 requests, 10-50 ms has 8,000, 50-100 ms has 800, 100-500 ms has 180, and 500 ms+ has 20, for 10,000 total requests.
q: 这些延迟桶计数能读出什么?
q_en: What can you read from these latency bucket counts?
options: P95 落在 50-100ms 这一桶
P95 恰好是 95ms
中位数落在 50-100ms 这一桶
无法从桶计数推断分位数
options_en: P95 falls in the 50-100ms bucket.
P95 is exactly ninety-five milliseconds.
The median falls in the 50-100ms bucket.
Percentiles cannot be inferred from bucket counts at all.
why: 从小到大累加：≤50ms 覆盖 90%、≤100ms 覆盖 98%，第 95 百分位（第 9500 个）落在 50-100ms 桶；累加到 50% 在 10-50ms 桶，即中位数。
why_en: Summing buckets in order, 90% finish under 50ms and 98% under 100ms, so the 95th percentile lands in the 50-100ms bucket; the median sits in the 10-50ms bucket.
optionExplanations: 对——累加到 90% 是 50ms、98% 是 100ms，第 95 百分位就落在 50-100ms 桶。
95ms 只是猜了个具体数值,桶算法给不出这么精确的单点。
中位数（累加到 50%）落在 10-50ms 桶，不是这一段。
只要桶做了排序累加,就能大致定位分位数所在区间,并非完全无法推断。
optionExplanations_en: Right — cumulative reaches 90% at 50ms and 98% at 100ms, so P95 is in the 50-100ms bucket.
Ninety-five milliseconds is just a guessed exact value; a bucket algorithm cannot pin that down.
The median (running sum crossing 50%) is in the 10-50ms bucket, not this one.
Ordered cumulative bucket counts can roughly locate a percentile; it is not impossible to infer.

q: 补全桶算法的读写流程:
q_en: Fill in the bucket algorithm's write and read flow:
text: 新值到达:确定它属于哪个{{桶}},把该桶计数器{{+1}};估计分位数:从最小的桶开始{{累加}}计数,直到达到目标百分比为止。
why: 写路径是一次定位加一次递增,O(1);读路径是对桶计数做前缀求和,直到累计占比跨过目标分位。
why_en: Each value increments its bucket's counter, and a quantile is estimated by summing counters until the target percentage is reached.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["Latency"] --> B["Bucket"]
  B --> C["Count"]
  C --> D["Approx percentile"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把值域切成若干区间(桶),只记录每个区间的计数,用有界内存近似分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram divides the value range into buckets and tracks only per-bucket counts, approximating the distribution in bounded memory.

scenario: 延迟直方图的读 QPS 很高(dashboard 不停刷),写入是每条请求一次。
scenario_en: The latency histogram is read constantly by dashboards, while writes happen once per request.
q: 有些系统给每个桶存“累积计数”(如 10-50ms 桶存的是所有 <50ms 的总数),这个变体的取舍是?
q_en: What tradeoff does cumulative bucket counting make?
options: 读写都更快
读写都更慢
读更贵但写更便宜
写贵读快(省去求和)
options_en: Both reads and writes get faster.
Both reads and writes get slower.
Reads get pricier while writes get cheaper.
Writes cost more, reads skip summing.
why: 累积桶把前缀求和搬到写路径:值落在最大桶时要更新每个桶;换来的是读分位数时直接查,不必累加。
why_en: Cumulative buckets cost more writes, in the worst case touching every bucket, but make quantile reads cheap with no summing.
optionExplanations: 累积桶的写路径反而更贵,不是“都更快”
读路径因为不用再累加求和,反而变快,不是“都更慢”
说反了,是写更贵、读更便宜,不是读更贵
正确:最坏情况一次写要更新所有桶,但换来查询时无需再求和
optionExplanations_en: Cumulative buckets make writes more expensive, not 'both faster'.
Reads get cheaper because no summing is needed, not 'both slower'.
That is backwards — writes get pricier, reads get cheaper, not the reverse.
Correct: in the worst case one write touches every bucket, but queries no longer need to sum.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把值域切成若干区间(桶),只记录每个区间的计数,用有界内存近似分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram divides the value range into buckets and tracks only per-bucket counts, approximating the distribution in bounded memory.

scenario: 要跟踪一个值域已知、分布大致均匀的指标(比如 0-100 的 CPU 使用率百分比)的分位数。
scenario_en: You need percentiles for a metric with a known, roughly uniform range, such as CPU utilization from 0 to 100 percent.
q: 均匀值域指标的直方图桶边界怎么选?
q_en: For a known uniform metric, how should you choose histogram bucket boundaries?
options: 指数桶(每桶翻倍)
固定宽度桶(等宽区间)
动态调整边界的直方图
不分桶,存原始值
options_en: Exponential buckets, each doubling the previous.
Fixed-width buckets (equal-width ranges).
A dynamic histogram that adjusts boundaries.
No bucketing, store raw values.
why: 固定宽度桶最简单,当值域已知且分布均匀时精度也够;不引入不必要的复杂度是加分项。
why_en: Equal-width buckets are the simplest choice and work well when the value range is known and roughly uniform.
whenOtherWins: 延迟这类跨多个数量级、幂律分布的数据,固定宽度会在常见小值区间丢失精度,应改用指数桶。
tradeoff: 实现简单直接 vs 值域分布不均匀时精度打折

termDefinitions.meaning: 把值域切成若干区间(桶),只记录每个区间的计数,用有界内存近似分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram divides the value range into buckets and tracks only per-bucket counts, approximating the distribution in bounded memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量数据分布中某个百分比位置的值,如 P95 表示 95% 的数据小于等于它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A percentile marks the value below which a given percentage of the data falls, so P95 means ninety-five percent of values are at or below it.

optionExplanations: 指数桶是为跨数量级的长尾分布准备的,均匀值域用不上它的优势。
值域已知且均匀时,等宽桶实现最简单,精度也刚好够用。
动态直方图要周期性重算边界,这份复杂度在稳定均匀分布下换不回收益。
存原始值等于放弃了有界内存这个用桶算法的初衷。
optionExplanations_en: Exponential buckets exist for long-tail, cross-magnitude distributions, an edge this uniform range does not need.
For a known, uniform range, fixed-width buckets are the easiest to build and already precise enough here.
A dynamic histogram needs periodic boundary recomputation, complexity a stable distribution does not repay.
Storing raw values gives up the bounded-memory point of using buckets in the first place.

scenario: 要跟踪服务延迟的分位数:值从 1ms 到 10 秒跨四个数量级,呈幂律分布,而且要求在整个范围内都有合理精度。
scenario_en: You need service latency percentiles where values range from 1 ms to 10 seconds, span four orders of magnitude, follow a power-law distribution, and need reasonable precision across the range.
q: 宽值域延迟指标的桶边界怎么选?
q_en: For wide-range power-law latency, how should you choose bucket boundaries?
options: 固定 100ms 宽的桶
指数桶(每桶是前一桶的倍数)
只记录平均值
options_en: Fixed 100ms-wide buckets.
Three buckets: 0-1s, 1-10s, 10s+.
Exponential buckets, each a multiple of the previous.
Just record the average.
why: 指数桶让每个数量级都有相近的相对精度,是延迟这类宽值域、幂律分布数据的标准选择。
why_en: Exponential buckets, each a multiple of the previous, keep good relative accuracy across the wide power-law range typical of latency data.
whenOtherWins: 值域窄且分布均匀时,固定宽度桶更简单直接;若必须精确重放个体事件,则要另存原始数据。
tradeoff: 跨数量级的相对精度 vs 比固定宽度桶稍高的实现复杂度

termDefinitions.meaning: 把值域切成若干区间(桶),只记录每个区间的计数,用有界内存近似分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram divides the value range into buckets and tracks only per-bucket counts, approximating the distribution in bounded memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量数据分布中某个百分比位置的值,如 P95 表示 95% 的数据小于等于它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A percentile marks the value below which a given percentage of the data falls, so P95 means ninety-five percent of values are at or below it.

optionExplanations: 多数延迟都 <100ms 时,固定桶会让常见区间全挤进第一格,分不出高低。
三个粗桶只能看个大概健康度,毫秒级的常见区间里完全没有分辨力。
指数桶让每个数量级都保持相近的相对精度,正是幂律延迟数据的标准做法。
均值会被长尾拖高,连分位数最基本的形状信息都保留不了。
optionExplanations_en: With most latency under 100ms, fixed buckets crowd the common range into the first bucket with no resolution.
Three coarse buckets only give a rough health signal, no resolution in the common millisecond range.
Exponential buckets keep similar relative accuracy at every order of magnitude, the standard fit for power-law latency.
An average gets dragged up by the tail and loses even the basic shape of the percentile distribution.

scenario: 服务延迟分布已知且稳定(大多 1-500ms),在纠结要不要上动态桶边界。
scenario_en: The service's latency distribution is known and stable, mostly one to five hundred milliseconds, and you're debating dynamic bucket boundaries.
q: “动态直方图”(根据数据分布自动调整桶边界)为什么很少值得用?
q_en: Why are dynamic histograms rarely worth it?
options: 要周期性重平衡、重算边界
它的精度一定更差
它根本无法处理流式数据
它需要 GPU
options_en: It needs periodic rebalancing and recomputation.
Its accuracy is always worse.
It fundamentally cannot handle streaming data.
It requires a GPU.
why: 动态边界确实对未知/漂移分布更准,但重平衡、重算的工程复杂度大,通常不如选好静态的指数桶。
why_en: Dynamic histograms adapt bucket boundaries but require periodic rebalancing whose complexity is usually not worth it.
optionExplanations: 正确:动态边界需要周期性重平衡、重算,工程复杂度常配不上收益
精度不一定更差,动态边界对未知分布反而可能更准
动态直方图同样能处理流式数据,这不是它被弃用的原因
重平衡是 CPU 计算问题,不需要 GPU
optionExplanations_en: Correct: dynamic boundaries need periodic rebalancing and recomputation, and that engineering cost often outweighs the benefit.
Accuracy is not necessarily worse — dynamic boundaries can actually be more accurate for unknown distributions.
Dynamic histograms can still handle streaming data; that is not why they are avoided.
Rebalancing is a CPU computation problem and needs no GPU.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把值域切成若干区间(桶),只记录每个区间的计数,用有界内存近似分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram divides the value range into buckets and tracks only per-bucket counts, approximating the distribution in bounded memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 图形处理器,常用于并行计算,不是布隆过滤器/CMS 等结构的必需硬件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A GPU is a graphics processing unit used for parallel computation, not required by structures like Bloom filters or Count-Min Sketch.

scenario: 在用桶算法估计延迟分位数(如 P95),P95 落在一个 10ms 宽的桶里。
scenario_en: A bucket algorithm estimates a latency percentile such as P95, and the P95 falls inside a 10 ms-wide bucket.
q: 桶算法估计分位数时,误差上界由什么决定?
q_en: What determines the error bound when bucket algorithms estimate percentiles?
options: 数据总量
桶的宽度
哈希函数的质量
读取的并发度
options_en: The total data volume.
The bucket width.
The quality of the hash function.
The concurrency of reads.
why: 桶内的具体分布是未知的,只知道值落在桶范围内,所以误差上界就是桶宽——这也是桶边界设计如此重要的原因。
why_en: Quantile error is bounded by bucket width, so a ten-millisecond bucket means the estimate can be off by up to ten milliseconds.
optionExplanations: 数据再多,桶算法内存也是固定的,总量不是误差的来源。
桶内具体分布未知,只知道落在区间里,误差上限自然就是这段区间的宽度。
这里没有哈希函数参与,精度取决于分桶,不是哈希质量。
并发度影响的是吞吐和延迟,不改变分位数估计本身的误差范围。
optionExplanations_en: No matter how much data flows through, bucket-algorithm memory stays fixed, so volume is not the error source.
The distribution inside a bucket is unknown, only that a value falls in range, so bucket width is the error ceiling.
No hashing is involved here; accuracy comes from bucketing, not hash-function quality.
Read concurrency affects throughput and latency, not the error range of the percentile estimate itself.

scenario: 要在实时流上跟踪大数据集的 P99,内存必须有明确上界。
scenario_en: You track P99 on a large real-time stream where memory must have a hard upper bound.
q: 桶算法(近似分位数)适合哪些需求组合?(多选)
q_en: What requirement mix fits bucket-based approximate quantiles? (multi-select)
options: 在大数据集上跟踪百分位/分位数
内存必须有上界
需要逐条回放原始事件
需要实时的流式分析
options_en: Tracking percentiles or quantiles over big datasets.
Memory must have a hard upper bound.
Needing to replay raw events one by one.
Needing real-time streaming analysis.
why: 桶算法的甜蜜区:大数据分位数 + 有界内存 + 容忍近似 + 实时流式。但它丢弃了个体样本,永远无法回放原始事件。
why_en: Bucket algorithms shine for percentile tracking over big data with bounded memory and real-time streaming, but they discard individual events.
optionExplanations: 正确:大数据集上的百分位/分位数跟踪正是桶算法的目标场景
正确:内存必须有上界,才需要放弃精确排序换近似桶计数
桶算法丢弃了个体样本,永远无法逐条回放原始事件
正确:每条数据到达即可递增对应桶,天然支持实时流式
optionExplanations_en: Correct: tracking percentiles over big data is exactly the target use case for bucket algorithms.
Correct: bounded memory is the reason to trade exact sorting for approximate bucket counts.
Bucket algorithms discard individual samples, so they can never replay raw events.
Correct: each value increments its bucket on arrival, so it naturally supports real-time streaming.

scenario: 用固定桶直方图跟踪线上延迟 P99,数据分布事先只是估计出来的。
scenario_en: You track production P99 with a fixed-bucket histogram, and the data distribution was only guessed up front.
q: 使用桶算法的常见坑有哪些?(多选)
q_en: What are common pitfalls of bucket algorithms? (multi-select)
options: 桶边界与实际数据分布不匹配
没有为落在预期范围之外的数据留出口
极端分位数(极高/极低)处精度下降
桶算法无法用于分布式系统
options_en: Bucket boundaries do not match the real data distribution.
No catch-all bucket for data outside the expected range.
Accuracy drops at extreme percentiles (very high or very low).
Bucket algorithms cannot be used in distributed systems.
why: 三大坑:边界选得不贴分布、越界数据没处理、越靠近极端分位越不准。而分布式恰恰是它的强项(如 Prometheus 跨节点聚合)。
why_en: Common pitfalls are poorly chosen boundaries, unhandled out-of-range data, and reduced accuracy at extreme percentiles.
optionExplanations: 正确:桶边界如果不贴合真实数据分布,估计的分位数会很粗糙
正确:超出预设范围的数据如果没有兜底桶,会丢失或计数出错
正确:桶内具体分布未知,越靠近极端分位,误差占比越明显
分布式恰恰是桶算法的强项,如 Prometheus 可以跨节点直接聚合桶计数
optionExplanations_en: Correct: if bucket boundaries do not match the real data distribution, the estimated percentiles come out coarse.
Correct: data outside the expected range with no catch-all bucket gets lost or miscounted.
Correct: the distribution inside a bucket is unknown, so error is more pronounced near extreme percentiles.
Distributed use is actually a strength of bucket algorithms — Prometheus, for example, aggregates bucket counts directly across nodes.

scenario: 上百个服务实例各自记录延迟,要汇总出一个全局 P99。
scenario_en: Hundreds of service instances each record latency locally, and you need one global P99 out of them.
q: Prometheus 的 histogram 指标和分布式分位数有什么关系?
q_en: How do Prometheus histograms support distributed quantiles?
options: Prometheus 存原始样本再集中排序
Prometheus 不支持分位数
histogram 本质是桶算法,可跨节点聚合
Prometheus 用 HyperLogLog 算分位数

Prometheus does not support percentiles.
A histogram is a bucket algorithm, aggregatable across nodes.
Prometheus uses HyperLogLog to compute percentiles.

why_en: Prometheus histograms are bucket algorithms whose counts can be aggregated across machines to compute percentiles without centralized raw storage.
optionExplanations: Prometheus 不集中存储原始样本再排序,那样无法跨节点扩展
Prometheus 明确支持分位数,histogram 就是为此设计的指标类型
正确:histogram 本质是桶算法,桶计数可跨节点直接相加再求分位
Prometheus 的 histogram 用的是桶计数,不是 HyperLogLog
optionExplanations_en: Prometheus does not centrally store raw samples for sorting; that would not scale across nodes.
Prometheus explicitly supports percentiles; the histogram metric type exists for exactly this.
Correct: a histogram is fundamentally a bucket algorithm, and bucket counts can be summed directly across nodes before computing a percentile.
Prometheus histograms use bucket counts, not HyperLogLog.

scenario: SLO 定义为“99% 的请求要在 100ms 内完成”,系统维护着延迟直方图桶,要写一个合规检查。
scenario_en: The SLO says "99% of requests complete within 100 ms"; the system maintains latency histogram buckets and needs a compliance check.
q: 哪个调用能正确得到用于 SLO 判断的 P99 延迟?
q_en: Which call correctly gets P99 latency for an SLO check?
options: calculate_percentile(histogram_buckets, 0.99)
calculate_percentile(histogram_buckets, 99.0),接口按 0-1 定义却传了百分数
average(histogram_buckets)
max(histogram_buckets)
options_en: calculate_percentile(histogram_buckets, 0.99)
calculate_percentile(histogram_buckets, 99.0) — passing a percentage into an interface defined on 0-1.
average(histogram_buckets)
max(histogram_buckets)
why: SLO 检查 = 从桶里算出 P99,再与阈值比较;平均值会掩盖长尾,最大值又过于悲观,都不能代表“99% 的请求”。
why_en: SLO compliance reads the ninety-ninth percentile from the histogram buckets and compares it to the threshold, since averages hide the tail.
whenOtherWins: 若 SLO 罕见地定义在均值或最大值上,才用对应聚合;需要精确到单请求的审计时必须回到原始日志。
tradeoff: P99 反映长尾的真实体验 vs 均值/最大值各自的偏差
codeSample:
p99_latency = calculate_percentile(histogram_buckets, 0.99)
slo_compliance = "PASS" if p99_latency < 100 else "FAIL"

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统承诺达到的可度量服务水平目标,如“99% 请求在 100ms 内完成”。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLO is a measurable service-level target the system commits to, such as ninety-nine percent of requests completing within one hundred milliseconds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量数据分布中某个百分比位置的值,如 P95 表示 95% 的数据小于等于它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A percentile marks the value below which a given percentage of the data falls, so P95 means ninety-five percent of values are at or below it.

optionExplanations: 0.99 正好落在接口约定的 0-1 分位区间里,直接取出真实的 P99 延迟。
接口按 0-1 定义分位参数,传 99.0 会越界报错或算出完全错误的结果。
均值会被大量快请求拉低,恰恰掩盖了长尾请求的真实延迟。
最大值只反映单个极端点,拿它判断 99% 请求未免过于悲观。
optionExplanations_en: 0.99 sits inside the API's own 0-to-1 fraction convention, returning the actual P99 latency.
The API expects a 0-to-1 fraction, so passing 99.0 goes out of range and errors or returns nonsense.
An average gets pulled down by many fast requests, hiding exactly the tail latency you need to see.
The maximum reflects a single extreme point, too pessimistic a stand-in for a ninety-nine-percent target.

scenario: 服务响应大多在 100ms 内,直方图桶却设成 [0-1s, 1-10s, 10s+]。
scenario_en: Most responses land under a hundred milliseconds, but the histogram buckets were set to zero-to-one second, one-to-ten, and ten plus.
q: 响应时间大多在 100ms 内,却把桶设成 [0-1s, 1-10s, 10s+],会发生什么?
q_en: What happens if sub-100ms responses are bucketed into [0-1s, 1-10s, 10s+]?
options: 查询会变慢
内存会爆炸
会像布隆过滤器一样产生假阳性
全挤进第一个粗桶,精度全失
options_en: Queries get slower.
Memory usage explodes.
It produces false positives like a Bloom filter.
Everything piles into the first coarse bucket.
why: 桶要贴着数据分布切:大多数值 <100ms 时,0-1s 这个粗桶让你对 P50/P95/P99 一无所知;对数/指数间距才能覆盖全范围的精度。
why_en: Coarse buckets like zero-to-one-second lose all precision when most responses are under a hundred milliseconds, so use logarithmic or exponential spacing.
optionExplanations: 查询速度不是主要影响,读桶计数仍是常数次读取
内存不会爆炸,桶数量本身没变多,只是精度分布不合理
假阳性是布隆过滤器的概念,和分桶精度无关
正确:几乎所有请求挤进第一个粗桶,常见区间的分位数完全失真
optionExplanations_en: Query speed is not the main effect; reading bucket counts is still a constant number of lookups.
Memory does not blow up; the number of buckets is unchanged, only the precision is misallocated.
False positives are a Bloom-filter concept, unrelated to bucket precision.
Correct: almost every request piles into the first coarse bucket, so percentiles in the common range become meaningless.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量数据分布中某个百分比位置的值,如 P95 表示 95% 的数据小于等于它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A percentile marks the value below which a given percentage of the data falls, so P95 means ninety-five percent of values are at or below it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构判定元素“可能存在”,但实际上并不存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive is when the structure reports an element as present even though it is not.

scenario: 在大数据设计里按“要回答什么问题”给四种概率结构做选型。
scenario_en: In a big-data design you pick among four probabilistic structures purely by which question each one answers.
q: 以下“结构 → 它回答的问题”的配对,哪些是正确的?(多选)
q_en: Which "structure -> question answered" pairs are correct? (multi-select)
options: 布隆过滤器 → “这个元素之前见过吗”
Count-Min Sketch → 精确的出现总数
HyperLogLog → “一共有多少个不同元素”
直方图桶 → P95/P99 这类分位数
options_en: Bloom filter → 'have we seen this element before'.
Count-Min Sketch → the exact total occurrence count.
HyperLogLog → 'how many distinct elements exist in total'.
Histogram buckets → percentiles like P95/P99.
why: 选型口诀:成员查询→布隆;频次上界→CMS(不是精确!);去重计数→HLL;分位数→桶。共同前提:容忍误差、换取可扩展性。
why_en: Bloom filters answer membership, Count-Min Sketch gives approximate upper-bound counts rather than exact ones, HyperLogLog counts distinct items, and histograms give quantiles.
optionExplanations: 正确:成员查询正是布隆过滤器要回答的问题
说反了;CMS 给的是出现次数的上界估计,不是精确总数
正确:去重计数正是 HyperLogLog 的定位
正确:P95/P99 这类分位数正是直方图桶算法的目标
optionExplanations_en: Correct: membership queries are exactly what a Bloom filter answers.
Backwards — Count-Min Sketch gives an upper-bound estimate of occurrences, not an exact total.
Correct: counting distinct items is exactly HyperLogLog's role.
Correct: percentiles like P95/P99 are exactly the target of histogram bucket algorithms.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型集合结构,用位数组和多个哈希函数判断元素是否可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that uses a bit array and multiple hash functions to test whether an element is possibly present.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用二维计数器数组估计元素出现次数上界的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Count-Min Sketch is a probabilistic structure that uses a two-dimensional counter array to estimate an upper bound on how often an item appeared.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把值域切成若干区间(桶),只记录每个区间的计数,用有界内存近似分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram divides the value range into buckets and tracks only per-bucket counts, approximating the distribution in bounded memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量数据分布中某个百分比位置的值,如 P95 表示 95% 的数据小于等于它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A percentile marks the value below which a given percentage of the data falls, so P95 means ninety-five percent of values are at or below it.

scenario: 要在 Redis 里以极小的固定内存统计每日独立访客数,允许约 2% 的误差。
scenario_en: In Redis, you need to count daily unique visitors with tiny fixed memory and can tolerate about 2% error.
q: Redis 统计每日独立访客应该用哪组命令?
q_en: Which Redis commands should you use to count daily unique visitors?
options: SADD visitors user123 / SCARD visitors
PFADD visitors user123 / PFCOUNT visitors
INCR visitors
ZADD visitors 1 user123 / ZCARD visitors
options_en: SADD visitors user123 / SCARD visitors
PFADD visitors user123 / PFCOUNT visitors
INCR visitors
ZADD visitors 1 user123 / ZCARD visitors
why: PFADD/PFCOUNT 是 Redis 内置的 HyperLogLog:固定 KB 级内存、约 2% 误差,专为去重计数而生;INCR 数的是次数不去重。
why_en: Redis PFADD and PFCOUNT use HyperLogLog to count unique visitors in kilobytes of memory with about two percent error.
whenOtherWins: 访客量小或需要能列出精确访客名单时,用 SADD/SCARD——精确但内存随基数线性增长。
tradeoff: KB 级固定内存、约 2% 误差 vs 精确去重但内存随访客数线性增长
codeSample:
PFADD visitors:2026-07-01 user123
PFADD visitors:2026-07-01 user456
PFCOUNT visitors:2026-07-01   # ≈ 去重访客数,误差约 2%

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 内置 HyperLogLog 命令:PFADD 添加元素,PFCOUNT 估计基数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PFADD and PFCOUNT are Redis's built-in HyperLogLog commands for adding elements and estimating cardinality.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 精确集合命令:SADD 插入成员,SCARD 返回精确基数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SADD and SCARD are Redis exact-set commands that insert a member and return the exact cardinality.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 有序集合命令,按分数排序存储成员。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZADD and ZCARD are Redis sorted-set commands that store members ordered by score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的内存型 key-value 存储,常被用作缓存,原生支持 HyperLogLog。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory key-value store commonly used as a cache, with native HyperLogLog support.

optionExplanations: SADD/SCARD 给的是精确基数,但内存随访客数线性增长,量大时代价不小。
这条命令走的是 HLL 路径,几 KB 固定内存换来约 2% 误差,配得上这题的容忍度。
INCR 只是单纯加一,不做去重,同一用户多次访问会被重复计入。
有序集合按分数存储,是为排序设计的,不是为去重基数设计的,内存同样线性增长。
optionExplanations_en: SADD and SCARD give an exact cardinality, but memory grows linearly with visitors, costly at scale.
This pair takes the HLL path, a few kilobytes of fixed memory for about 2% error, matching this case tolerance.
INCR just adds one with no dedup, so the same visitor returning multiple times gets recounted.
A sorted set stores members by score for ranking, not dedup cardinality, and memory still grows linearly.

scenario: 布隆过滤器用 k 个哈希函数为每个元素生成签名位。一名工程师改成让每个哈希一次置很多位、把签名做得接近实心印章,以为元素更好区分。
scenario_en: A bloom filter uses k hash functions to set an element's signature bits. An engineer makes each hash set many bits so the signature is nearly a solid stamp, thinking elements get more distinguishable.
q: 让每个哈希都置很多位、签名接近实心,会怎样?
q_en: What happens if each hash sets many bits, making the signature nearly solid?
options: 过滤器迅速饱和:少量插入后多数位置 1,查询几乎都误报存在,假阳性近 100%。
产生假阴性:明明插入过的元素反被判为不存在,直接破坏布隆过滤器绝不漏报的核心保证。
插入吞吐下降:每次插入要翻转的位更多,写入变慢,在高并发下成为整个系统的瓶颈。
过滤器意外支持删除:密集签名可被整体清零,从而把已插入的元素也一并移除掉。
options_en: The filter saturates fast: after few inserts most bits are 1, so nearly every query returns possibly-present and the false-positive rate approaches 100%.
It produces false negatives: an element that was inserted gets judged as not present, breaking the bloom filter's never-miss guarantee.
Insert throughput drops: each insert flips more bits, writes slow down and become the system bottleneck under high concurrency.
The filter accidentally supports deletion: a dense signature can be zeroed out as a whole to remove an inserted element.
why: 签名越密,越少插入就把位数组填满;大部分位为 1 后任何查询都全中,假阳性逼近 100%。所以每个哈希只置一位,靠多个哈希拼出稀疏而独特的签名。
why_en: A dense signature fills the bit array after very few inserts; once most bits are 1 every lookup matches, so false positives approach 100%. That's why each hash sets just one bit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种空间高效的概率型集合结构,能判定元素一定不在集合,或可能在集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bloom filter is a space-efficient probabilistic set that can say an element is definitely not present, or possibly present.

termDefinitions.meaning: 布隆过滤器的底层存储:一串比特位,插入元素时把对应位置为 1。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The bit array is the bloom filter's backing store: a string of bits set to 1 as elements are inserted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构报告元素存在,但它实际并不在集合里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive is when the structure reports an element is present but it actually is not in the set.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构报告元素不存在,但它实际在集合里;标准布隆过滤器绝不会发生。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false negative is reporting an element absent when it is actually present; a standard bloom filter never does this.

optionExplanations: 密集签名让位数组极快填满,这正是实心印章退化,布隆过滤器由此失效。
布隆过滤器结构上永不漏报——置更多位只会多命中,不可能把已插入元素判成不存在。
吞吐不是这里的关键;就算慢一点,真正致命的是签名太密导致的饱和。
删除要用计数版本(counting bloom),标准布隆整体清零会连带抹掉其他元素,并非支持删除。
optionExplanations_en: A dense signature fills the bit array extremely fast — this is the solid-stamp degeneration that makes the filter useless.
A bloom filter structurally never misses — setting more bits only causes more matches, never a false negative.
Throughput is not the point here; even if slower, the fatal issue is saturation from an over-dense signature.
Deletion needs a counting bloom variant; zeroing a standard bloom would wipe out other elements too, so this is not deletion support.

scenario: 面试里你提出用 Count-Min Sketch 统计数十亿条目的频次来省内存,面试官追问它到底要占多少内存。
scenario_en: In an interview you propose Count-Min Sketch to count frequencies of billions of items to save memory, and the interviewer asks how much memory it actually needs.
q: 关于 CMS 的内存,你该主动说清什么?
q_en: About CMS memory, what should you proactively make clear?
options: 仍需可观内存:大小由为精度选定的 w×d 决定,不是近乎免费。
内存恒定且极小,与你设定的目标精度完全无关,基本可以直接忽略不计。
内存随不同条目(即唯一键)的数量线性增长,和它要替代的哈希表一样。
内存随数据流累计的总事件数增长,流处理运行得越久占用就越大。
options_en: It still needs sizeable memory: size is set by the width w times depth d chosen for accuracy, so saving space is not nearly free.
Memory is constant and tiny, independent of the target accuracy, and can basically be ignored.
Memory grows linearly with the number of distinct items (unique keys), just like a hash table.
Memory grows with the total number of events in the stream, so longer streams use more.
why: CMS 是 w×d 的计数器二维数组,w、d 为达到目标误差/置信度而定,与唯一键数、流长度都无关;它比哈希表省,但不是免费——面试要主动点出这块预算。
why_en: CMS is a w-by-d grid of counters whose w and d are sized for the target error and confidence, independent of key count or stream length; it saves versus a hash table but is not free.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全称 Count-Min Sketch:用固定的二维计数器网格估计元素频次上界的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Count-Min Sketch is a probabilistic structure that estimates an upper bound on item frequencies using a fixed 2D grid of counters.

termDefinitions.term: 宽度 w / 深度 d
termDefinitions.meaning: CMS 的两个尺寸参数:宽度控制碰撞概率(精度),深度控制估计的置信度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Width and depth are CMS's size parameters: width controls collision probability (accuracy) and depth controls confidence.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据集中互不相同的条目个数,也叫基数;哈希表内存随它线性增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Unique keys are the count of distinct items, also called cardinality; a hash table's memory grows linearly with it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为每个可能元素保留存储的精确结构,大集合下内存不可行,是 CMS 要替代的对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash table keeps storage for every possible element; infeasible at huge scale, it is what CMS replaces.

optionExplanations: 正解:内存等于 w×d 计数器,为精度而定;省是相对哈希表省,不是零成本。
恰恰相反:w、d 必须为目标精度调大,精度要求直接决定内存,不能忽略。
线性增长的是它要替代的哈希表;CMS 的固定网格正是为了摆脱这种线性。
计数只是往固定网格里累加,流再长网格大小也不变,不随事件数增长。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: memory equals w-by-d counters sized for accuracy; the saving is relative to a hash table, not zero cost.
The opposite: w and d must be enlarged for target accuracy, so the accuracy requirement directly sets memory.
Linear growth is the hash table it replaces; CMS's fixed grid exists precisely to escape that linearity.
Counting just increments a fixed grid; the grid size stays constant no matter how long the stream is.

scenario: 产品要一块随时展示当前 DAU(日活跃用户)的实时仪表盘,数据量数十亿,用 HyperLogLog 估算。
scenario_en: A product wants a real-time dashboard always showing the current DAU (daily active users) over billions of events, estimated with HyperLogLog.
q: HLL 该以哪种形态落地?
q_en: Which landing form should HLL take?
options: 流式预聚合:事件到达即 PFADD 进当日 HLL,查询用 PFCOUNT 读结果。
事后扫描:每次查询时扫一遍全部原始事件,现算一次基数。
每来一个事件就重扫一遍全量历史数据、从头彻底重建整个 HLL,借此保证结果时刻都最新。
改用精确 HashSet 实时维护访客集合,随时读它的大小当作 DAU。
options_en: Streaming pre-aggregation: PFADD each event into the day's HLL on arrival, then PFCOUNT the ready result at query time.
Batch scan: sweep all raw events on each query and estimate the cardinality fresh each time.
On every single event, rescan the entire history and rebuild the whole HLL from scratch to keep it current.
Switch to an exact HashSet maintained live and read its size as the DAU whenever needed.
why: 实时仪表盘要随时读到当前值,把 HLL 做成增量预聚合——写路径 O(1) 合并、读路径 O(1) 取数;代价是要长期维护这份状态。
why_en: A live dashboard needs the current value on demand, so keep HLL as an incremental pre-aggregate: O(1) merge on write, O(1) read; the cost is maintaining that state over time.
whenOtherWins: 若只是偶尔跑一次历史独立数、不想长期维护状态,事后扫描一遍数据现估基数更省事。
tradeoff: 增量维护状态、读写都 O(1) vs 无状态但每次查询扫全量数据现算

termDefinitions.meaning: 全称 HyperLogLog:用极小固定内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements (cardinality) with tiny fixed memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全称 Daily Active Users,每日活跃用户数,一个去重的独立用户计数指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DAU stands for Daily Active Users, a de-duplicated count of distinct users active in a day.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 内置 HyperLogLog 命令:PFADD 添加元素,PFCOUNT 估计基数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PFADD and PFCOUNT are Redis's built-in HyperLogLog commands to add elements and estimate cardinality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 精确保存每个成员的集合结构,能给出准确去重计数,但内存随成员数线性增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A HashSet stores every member exactly and gives an exact distinct count, but memory grows linearly with member count.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据集中互不相同元素的个数;HLL 就是为估计它而设计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cardinality is the number of distinct elements in a dataset; HLL is designed to estimate it.

optionExplanations: 正解:增量维护当日 HLL,查询即读,天然贴合实时仪表盘。
无状态、实现简单,适合偶尔的历史 ad-hoc 查询;但实时仪表盘每次都扫全量太慢。
重扫重建既贵又没必要——HLL 本可增量合并,这等于放弃它最大的优势。
HashSet 精确,但内存随访客数线性膨胀,正是数十亿量级下要避开的。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: keep the day's HLL incrementally, so a query just reads it — a natural fit for a live dashboard.
Stateless and simple, good for occasional historical ad-hoc queries; but scanning everything per query is too slow for a live dashboard.
Rescanning and rebuilding is costly and needless — HLL merges incrementally, so this throws away its biggest advantage.
A HashSet is exact but its memory balloons linearly with visitors, exactly what you must avoid at billions of scale.

scenario: 服务已用直方图桶维护延迟和 CPU 的近似分位数。现在要据此做自动扩缩容,并对异常报警。
scenario_en: A service already keeps approximate quantiles of latency and CPU via histogram buckets. Now it must drive auto-scaling from them and alert on anomalies.
q: 扩缩容和异常检测该盯直方图的哪个信号?
q_en: Which histogram signal should auto-scaling and anomaly detection watch?
options: 分位数:P95 CPU 超阈值就扩容,分位数骤然漂移就判异常。
平均值:只要 CPU 或延迟的算术均值超过设定阈值就触发扩容。
单次最大值:只要采样里出现过一次瞬时尖峰就立刻扩容。
请求总量计数:按一段时间内累计的请求条数来决定要不要扩容。
options_en: Percentiles: scale up when P95 CPU crosses a threshold, and flag an anomaly when percentiles shift sharply.
The mean: trigger scaling whenever the arithmetic average of CPU or latency crosses a set threshold.
The single maximum: scale up the instant any one transient spike appears in the samples.
Total request count: decide scaling from the cumulative number of requests over a window.
why: 扩缩容要保护尾部体验,均值会被大量快请求稀释、掩盖长尾;用 P95/P99 才反映真实压力,分位数漂移还能当异常信号;代价是要选对桶边界。
why_en: Scaling must protect the tail experience; the mean gets diluted by many fast requests and hides the long tail, while P95/P99 reflect real pressure and percentile drift signals anomalies.
whenOtherWins: 若只关心总吞吐容量、且负载分布均匀,用均值或总请求量做扩容信号更简单也更稳定。
tradeoff: 分位数反映尾部体验、可测漂移 vs 均值/总量简单但掩盖长尾

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据排序后某个百分比位置的值,如 P95 表示 95% 的样本都在它之下。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quantile is the value at a given percentage position in sorted data; P95 means 95% of samples fall below it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 第 95 / 99 百分位延迟或指标,用来衡量尾部(最慢一小撮)体验。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: P95/P99 are the 95th/99th percentile latency or metric, measuring the tail (the slowest slice) experience.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把取值切成若干区间、各自计数的结构,用固定内存近似分位数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Histogram buckets slice the value range into intervals with per-bucket counts, approximating quantiles in fixed memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据实时指标自动增加或减少服务实例数的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Auto-scaling automatically adds or removes service instances based on live metrics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 指标分布随时间明显偏移;分位数骤变常被当作异常信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Drift is a marked shift in a metric's distribution over time; a sudden percentile change is often used as an anomaly signal.

optionExplanations: 正解:P95/P99 直接反映尾部延迟,分位数漂移是很好的异常信号。
均值被大量快请求拉低,尾部变慢时它几乎不动,扩容会来得太晚。
单次尖峰噪声大,按它扩容会频繁抖动、过度扩容,稳定性差。
总请求量只说来了多少流量,不反映每请求的延迟或资源压力,方向就错了。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: P95/P99 directly reflect tail latency, and percentile drift is a strong anomaly signal.
The mean is dragged down by many fast requests, so it barely moves when the tail slows, making scaling too late.
A single spike is noisy; scaling on it causes frequent flapping and over-provisioning, hurting stability.
Total request count only says how much traffic arrived, not per-request latency or resource pressure — wrong axis.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: UUID v7 (RFC 9562): the first 48 bits are a big-endian Unix-millisecond timestamp, the rest random — so it sorts by creation time as a string/bytes and contains no MAC address. The modern recommendation for DB keys.

termDefinitions.meaning: 时间戳 + MAC 地址 + 时钟序。两个毛病:①时间戳被拆成低/中/高段、顺序错乱 → 字符串排序≠时间序;②嵌了机器的 MAC 地址 → 泄露是哪台机器生成的(隐私/安全)
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UUID v1: timestamp + MAC address + clock sequence. Two flaws: the timestamp is split into low/mid/high fields out of order, so string sort ≠ time order; and it embeds the machine MAC address, leaking which machine generated it.

termDefinitions.meaning: ID 按时间排序 → 顺序插入都落在索引「末尾」→ 索引/B树局部性好、少页分裂和碎片、插入快;还能按时间范围查询。随机 ID(如 v4)到处散 → 局部性差、碎片多。这正是 v7 相比全随机 v4 的价值
termDefinitions.meaningEn: When IDs sort by time, sequential inserts land at the end of the index → good B-tree locality, fewer page splits/fragmentation, faster inserts, plus time-range queries. Random IDs (v4) scatter inserts → poor locality. This is v7 value over fully random v4.

tradeoff: v7 的排序性与隐私优势 vs v1 的历史兼容性
optionExplanations: v7 和 v1 编码长度基本一样，长度从来不是它被推荐的原因。
v1 同样带毫秒级时间戳，精度从来不是问题所在。
时间戳前置带来字符串可排序，加上不含 MAC 地址避免隐私泄露，这两点才是真正被推荐的理由。
v7 是 RFC 9562 定义的公开标准，任何系统都能生成，跟 AWS 或 DynamoDB 没关系。
optionExplanations_en: v7 and v1 encode to roughly the same length -- length was never why it's recommended.
v1 also carries a millisecond timestamp, so precision was never the real issue.
Putting the timestamp first makes the string sortable, and dropping the MAC address avoids the privacy leak -- those are the two real reasons to prefer it.
v7 is defined in the public RFC 9562 standard, generatable by any system -- it has nothing to do with AWS.

q: 把 DynamoDB 分区写入的底层流程排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the underlying steps of a DynamoDB partition write in the correct order:
steps: 写请求路由到该分区的 leader 节点
quorum（3 个中的 2 个）持久化日志记录后，写入即确认成功
leader 生成 WAL（写前日志）条目
leader 把日志条目发送给复制组的 peer 节点
why: 每个分区是一个基于 Multi-Paxos 的 3 节点 leader 复制组：leader 写 WAL → 发给 peers → 2/3 quorum 持久化即 ack。这解释了强一致读为什么找 leader。
why_en: The partition leader writes a WAL entry, sends it to its peers, and acknowledges the write once a quorum of two out of three persists it.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as 客户端
    participant L as Leader
    participant F1 as Follower1
    participant F2 as Follower2
    C->>L: 写请求
    L->>L: 生成 WAL 条目
    L->>F1: 发送日志
    L->>F2: 发送日志
    F1-->>L: 已持久化
    Note over L: quorum 2/3 达成
    L-->>C: 确认写入

termDefinitions.meaning: 预写日志：写入先落日志再应用，保证持久性和可恢复性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A write-ahead log records a write before it is applied, guaranteeing durability and recoverability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 达成确认所需的最小副本数，这里是 3 副本中的 2 个。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quorum is the minimum number of replicas -- here two out of three -- that must acknowledge a write.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持连续多轮决议的 Paxos 共识协议变体，靠稳定 leader 做日志复制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multi-Paxos is a consensus protocol variant that agrees on a sequence of log entries via a stable leader.

q: 公开资料中，DynamoDB 每个分区复制组通常可以怎么理解？
q_en: Based on public information, how can DynamoDB's per-partition replication group generally be described?
options: Gossip 协议，节点间对等传播
两阶段提交，由跨节点的中央协调者收集并统计各方投票
leader 复制组，quorum 持久化
无协议，各副本异步尽力复制
why: 更稳妥的面试说法是：分区由 leader-based 复制组服务，写入经过日志和 quorum 持久化后确认。AWS 论文提到过相关共识实现，但 DynamoDB 是闭源服务，别把某个协议名当作永远不变的 API 语义。
why_en: Since DynamoDB is closed source, the safer answer is a leader-based replication group with quorum-backed writes, not a specific protocol name.
options_en: A gossip protocol propagating state peer to peer.
Two-phase commit with a central coordinator collecting and tallying votes across nodes.
A leader-based replica group with quorum-durable writes.
No protocol -- replicas just copy asynchronously, best effort.

termDefinitions.meaning: 节点间随机两两交换信息、最终扩散到全网的去中心化协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A gossip protocol lets nodes spread state by randomly exchanging information pairwise until it reaches the whole cluster.

termDefinitions.meaning: 达成确认所需的最小副本数，这里是 3 副本中的 2 个。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quorum is the minimum number of replicas -- here two out of three -- that must acknowledge a write.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分两阶段（准备+提交）让多个参与方达成一致的协议，常用于跨库事务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-phase commit coordinates multiple participants to agree via a prepare phase and a commit phase, often used for cross-database transactions.

termDefinitions.meaning: DynamoDB 每个分区的数据复制在 3 个节点(跨 3 AZ)上,组成一个「leader 复制组」:1 leader + 2 follower。写→leader 写 WAL→发给 follower→多数(2/3)持久化即 ack(quorum);强一致读走 leader、最终一致读走任意副本。底层是 Multi-Paxos 类共识,但 DynamoDB 闭源,面试稳妥说法=「leader 复制组 + quorum 持久化」,别把某个协议名当死语义
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Each DynamoDB partition is replicated on 3 nodes across 3 AZs as a leader-based replication group: 1 leader + 2 followers. Write → leader writes WAL → sends to followers → acked once a quorum (2/3) persist; strong reads go to the leader, eventual reads to any replica. It uses Multi-Paxos-style consensus, but DynamoDB is closed-source, so the safe interview phrasing is a leader-based replication group with quorum durability.

scenario: 被追问 DynamoDB 分区内部到底靠什么协议做复制。
scenario_en: Getting pressed on exactly what protocol DynamoDB's partitions use internally for replication.
optionExplanations: Gossip 更贴近去中心化的成员发现和状态传播，不是描述单个分区内的复制机制。
两阶段提交协调的是跨节点/跨库的多方一致，不是单个分区内部的日志复制。
更稳妥的说法是分区由带 leader 的复制组服务，写入要经过日志和多数派确认才算落盘——它闭源，别把某个协议名当成一成不变的事实。
没有 quorum 确认，写入的持久性和一致性都没法保证，这跟它宣称的可靠性不符。
optionExplanations_en: Gossip fits decentralized membership discovery and state propagation, not the replication mechanism inside one partition.
Two-phase commit coordinates agreement across separate nodes or databases, not log replication within a single partition.

The safer description is a leader-based replica group whose writes are durable once the log and quorum confirm -- DynamoDB is closed source, so no protocol name should be treated as a fixed guarantee.
Without a quorum acknowledgment, neither durability nor consistency of the write could be guaranteed, which doesn't match its reliability claims.
