scenario: 支付事件流是审计和对账的唯一来源，单台 broker 宕机时一条事件都不能丢。
scenario_en: The payment event stream is the only source for audit and reconciliation, so not a single event may be lost when one broker dies.

q: CDC（变更数据捕获）系统本身故障时，主要风险和缓解是什么？
options: 认为 CDC 停了不影响主库，等它自己恢复即可无需监控
API key 全部失效；重启 Gateway 即可
事件停止流向 Kafka，需要 lag 监控和日志回放恢复
iframe 会变成跨域；换浏览器
why: CDC 是审计链路关键点，必须监控滞后、冗余运行，并保留从 WAL/oplog 补读遗漏事件的能力。
why_en: CDC failure stops events from flowing, so lag monitoring, redundant readers, and log replay recovery are essential.
options_en: Assume CDC going down does not affect the primary DB and just wait for it to recover, no monitoring needed.
All API keys become invalid; just restart the gateway.
Events stop reaching Kafka; mitigate with lag monitoring and log replay recovery.
The iframe becomes cross-origin; switch browsers.
q_en: If the CDC system itself fails, what is the main risk and mitigation?
optionExplanations: CDC 停了主库仍在写，但下游 Kafka 会漏事件、审计出现空洞；必须监控滞后并从 WAL/oplog 回放。
CDC 是审计管道的一环，跟 API key 认证是两个完全独立的系统。
数据库写入照常提交，但没人把变更发布出去，需要 lag 监控发现问题，再靠日志回放补齐漏掉的事件。
CDC 故障发生在后端管道，跟浏览器里 iframe 的跨域问题完全不是一回事。
optionExplanations_en: When CDC stops the primary DB keeps writing, but downstream Kafka misses events and audit develops gaps; you must monitor lag and replay from the WAL/oplog.
CDC is part of the audit pipeline, an entirely separate system from API-key authentication.
Database writes keep committing fine, but nothing publishes the changes, so lag monitoring has to catch it and log replay has to backfill the missed events.
CDC failure happens in the backend pipeline, unrelated to a browser iframe's cross-origin behavior.
scenario: 审计、对账、webhook 都靠 CDC 把库变更推进 Kafka；CDC 进程挂了半小时才被发现。
scenario_en: Audit, reconciliation and webhooks all rely on CDC to push database changes into Kafka, and the CDC process died half an hour before anyone noticed.

q: CDC/Kafka 事件流可支持哪些下游消费者？（多选）
options: Audit Service 构建不可变历史
Analytics 构建业务分析视图
Reconciliation Service 对照外部网络
Webhook Service 生成商户通知
why: 同一条提交变更可被多个消费者按不同访问模式物化，避免把所有需求压在 OLTP 库上。
why_en: The same committed event stream can feed multiple materialized views without burdening the OLTP database.
options_en: The Audit Service builds an immutable history.
Analytics builds business-intelligence views.
The Reconciliation Service checks against the external network.
The Webhook Service generates merchant notifications.
q_en: Which downstream consumers can a CDC/Kafka event stream support? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: Audit Service 靠这条事件流建一份不可变、可举证的完整历史。
Analytics 把同一批事件物化成业务聚合视图，不用另外查询 OLTP 库。
Reconciliation Service 拿这些事件去核对外部支付网络的真实结果。
Webhook Service 消费同一条流，把状态变化转成商户通知。
optionExplanations_en: The Audit Service uses this event stream to build a complete, provable, immutable history.
Analytics materializes the same events into business-aggregate views without hitting the OLTP database directly.
The Reconciliation Service uses these events to check against the payment network's actual outcomes.
The Webhook Service consumes the same stream and turns status changes into merchant notifications.
scenario: 支付主库已被同步读写占满，团队又要审计历史、业务报表、对账和商户通知四类需求。
scenario_en: The payment database is already saturated with synchronous reads and writes, and the team now also needs audit history, reporting, reconciliation and merchant notifications.

scenario: 商户订阅 payment.succeeded 事件并提供 callback URL，系统要在 PaymentIntent 状态变化后可靠通知。
q: Webhook Service 应该从哪里获得触发事件？
options: 轮询商户浏览器
解析客户信用卡号
读取 CDN access log
消费 CDC/Kafka 事件流
why: 支付状态已经作为 CDC 事件进入 Kafka，Webhook Service 消费同一事件流即可避免额外耦合和漏通知。
why_en: Webhook delivery should consume the existing CDC event stream so status changes produce notifications without extra coupling.
whenOtherWins: 如果系统很小且没有事件流，短期可以直接在交易服务里同步触发，但会引入双写和延迟耦合。
options_en: Poll the merchant's browser.
Parse the customer's credit-card number.
Read the CDN access log.
Consume the CDC/Kafka event stream.
tradeoff: 复用已有事件流 vs 新建同步触发通道
q_en: Where should the Webhook Service get trigger events from?
scenario_en: A merchant subscribes to payment.succeeded and provides a callback URL; the system must reliably notify it after PaymentIntent state changes.
optionExplanations: 商户浏览器不是一个稳定可轮询的后端信号源，也不该被当作触发依据。
解析客户信用卡号属于卡数据处理路径，跟事件触发逻辑完全不搭边。
CDN 日志记录的是内容访问，看不到支付状态到底变成了什么。
状态变化本来就已经写成 CDC 事件，直接订阅这条流，就不用在交易服务里再埋一次同步触发。
optionExplanations_en: The merchant's browser isn't a reliable, pollable backend signal and shouldn't drive triggers at all.
Parsing a customer's card number belongs to card-data handling, unrelated to how events get triggered.
CDN logs capture content access, not what a payment's status actually changed to.
Status changes are already written as CDC events, so subscribing to that stream avoids hard-wiring a second synchronous trigger into the transaction service.

q: 可靠 webhook 投递通常需要哪些机制？（多选）
options: 商户返回 2xx 后仍无限重试
记录每次 delivery attempt 和状态
失败后指数退避重试
对 payload 签名供商户验证
why: 投递日志支持排查和重放，退避避免压垮商户，签名防伪造；2xx 表示已接收，应停止该次重试。
why_en: Delivery logs, exponential backoff, and signed payloads make webhook delivery reliable and verifiable.
options_en: Keep retrying forever even after the merchant returns 2xx.
Record every delivery attempt and its status.
Retry with exponential backoff after failures.
Sign the payload so the merchant can verify it.
q_en: Which mechanisms are usually needed for reliable webhook delivery? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 商户一旦返回 2xx 就说明这次投递已经成功，继续重试只会造成重复通知。
记录每次 delivery attempt 和状态，才有排查失败和重放事件的依据。
失败后指数退避重试，能在商户系统本就出问题时避免继续加压。
对 payload 签名让商户能验证事件确实来自支付平台、内容没被篡改。
optionExplanations_en: Once the merchant returns 2xx, that delivery already succeeded; retrying past that just duplicates the notification.
Logging every delivery attempt and its status is what makes debugging and replaying failed events possible.
Retrying with exponential backoff after a failure avoids piling more load onto a merchant system that's already struggling.
Signing the payload lets the merchant verify the event really came from the payment platform and wasn't tampered with.
scenario: 商户 endpoint 时好时坏，支付通知必须最终送达，且商户能验证是不是我们发的。
scenario_en: Merchant endpoints are flaky, so payment notifications must eventually arrive and merchants must be able to verify we really sent them.

q: 支付 webhook（服务器对服务器回调）和 WebSocket/SSE 的关键区别是什么？
options: webhook 是服务器间调用；WebSocket/SSE 面向客户端
两者本质上都是浏览器端的本地存储机制，只是接口名不同
webhook 通知必须由客户手机在线时才能接收
WebSocket 协议只能用于批量数据处理，不适合任何事件通知场景
why: 商户需要系统间通知来触发履约，webhook 不要求用户浏览器在线，也不是给客户 UI 的连接。
why_en: Webhooks are server-to-server callbacks for merchant systems, unlike client-facing persistent realtime connections.
options_en: Webhooks are server-to-server calls; WebSocket/SSE are client-facing.
Both are fundamentally browser-side local-storage mechanisms with different API names.
A webhook notification can only be received while the customer's phone is online.
The WebSocket protocol is only for batch data processing and never suits event notification.
tradeoff: 系统间异步通知 vs 客户端实时连接
q_en: What is the key difference between payment webhooks and WebSocket/SSE?
optionExplanations: webhook 是商户服务器之间的调用，WebSocket/SSE 是面向客户端浏览器的实时连接，服务对象完全不同。
两者都是网络通信协议，跟浏览器把数据存在本地这件事完全不沾边。
webhook 打到的是商户服务器，客户手机在不在线根本不影响投递。
WebSocket 正是为持续双向实时通信设计的，事件推送恰恰是它的主场。
optionExplanations_en: A webhook is a server-to-server call to the merchant, while WebSocket/SSE are realtime connections aimed at the browser client — they serve different audiences.
Both are network transport mechanisms and have nothing to do with a browser storing data locally.
A webhook lands on the merchant's server; whether the customer's phone is online never affects delivery.
WebSocket exists precisely for persistent two-way realtime traffic; event push is its core use case.
scenario: 商户后端要在支付成功时自动发货，此时商户员工和客户浏览器都没有打开页面。
scenario_en: The merchant backend must ship the order the moment a payment succeeds, with no browser session open on either side.

q: 基于 CDC（变更数据捕获）的 webhook 投递链路正确顺序是什么？
steps: Webhook Service 过滤商户订阅事件并构造签名 payload
支付状态更新提交到 operational DB
失败时记录 attempt 并指数退避重试
CDC/Kafka 发布 payment status change event
商户 endpoint 返回 2xx 后标记投递成功
why: 状态提交产生事件，Webhook Service 负责筛选、签名和投递；成功停止，失败进入重试队列。
why_en: A committed status change becomes an event, the webhook service signs and sends it, then marks success or schedules retries.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  E[Payment event]
  K[Kafka]
  W[Webhook worker]
  M[Merchant endpoint]
  R[Retry queue]
  E --> K --> W --> M
  M -->|fail| R
  R --> W

termDefinitions.meaning: 每次重试等待时间成倍增加的重试策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exponential backoff doubles the wait time between retries after each failure.

q_en: What is the correct order of a CDC-based webhook delivery flow?

scenario: 支付 operational DB 接近每秒 1 万写，商户数据天然隔离，绝大多数查询也按商户或支付 ID 定位。
q: 数据库扩展的合理分片键是什么？
options: 随机每行一个 shard
merchant_id
amountInCents
信用卡后四位
why: merchant_id 与租户边界和查询模式一致，能把商户流量分散到不同分片并保持相关数据局部性。
why_en: Sharding by merchant_id aligns with tenant boundaries and common query patterns while distributing write load.
whenOtherWins: 如果单个超大商户成为热点，可能需要再按 payment_id/time 做二级拆分或专属分片。
options_en: A random shard per row.
merchant_id.
amountInCents.
The last four digits of the card.
tradeoff: 按租户局部性分片 vs 按行随机打散负载
q_en: What is a reasonable sharding key for database scaling?
scenario_en: The payment operational database is near 10k writes per second; merchant data is naturally isolated, and most queries filter by merchant or payment ID.
optionExplanations: 随机分片打散了负载，却也把同一商户的数据撒到各个分片，查询要扇出到所有分片才能凑齐结果。
按 merchant_id 分片把租户边界和常见的按商户查询模式对齐，相关数据留在同一分片。
金额既不是数据归属维度，也不是查询过滤条件，用它分片没有意义。
卡片后四位是敏感数据，不该出现在分片键设计里。
optionExplanations_en: Random sharding spreads load, but it also scatters one merchant's rows across every shard, forcing queries to fan out everywhere to reassemble results.
Sharding by merchant_id aligns tenant boundaries with the common per-merchant query pattern, keeping related rows together.
The charge amount is neither a data-ownership dimension nor a common filter, so it makes a poor shard key.
The card's last four digits are sensitive data that shouldn't be part of a sharding-key design at all.

q: 这个增长量级最支持哪项存储策略？
options: 永久把所有历史都留在主 OLTP 库，靠加大磁盘和读副本硬扛
数据增长可忽略，不用规划归档
老数据应定期归档到低成本对象存储，主库只留近期数据
改用无限内存缓存替代磁盘存储
why: 日增约 500GB、年增约 180TB 意味着主库不能无限增长；老交易应归档到 S3 一类冷存储，主库只保留近期热数据。
why_en: At roughly 500GB a day and 180TB a year, the operational database cannot keep growing forever, so older transactions should move to cheap cold storage.
scenario: 按 10k TPS、每行约 500 bytes 估算，支付数据每天新增约 500GB，一年约 180TB。
options_en: Keep all history in the primary OLTP database forever and just scale it with bigger disks and read replicas.
The growth is negligible, so no archiving plan is needed.
Archive old data to low-cost object storage periodically and keep only recent data in the primary database.
Switch to unlimited in-memory caching instead of disk storage.
q_en: What storage strategy is best supported by this growth estimate?
scenario_en: With 10k TPS and roughly 500 bytes per row, payment data grows by about 500GB per day and about 180TB per year.
optionExplanations: 主库无限增长会拖慢近期热查询、放大备份和索引成本；老数据应归档到冷存储只留近期热数据。
这个增长量级完全不是可忽略的，不做归档规划主库迟早扛不住。
按这个量级，老交易该定期挪到低成本对象存储，主库只留近期热数据，查询和容量压力才能分开。
无限内存缓存既没有这么大容量也不持久，支撑不了这个体量的长期存储。
optionExplanations_en: Unbounded growth in the primary slows recent hot queries and inflates backup and index cost; old data should archive to cold storage, keeping only recent hot rows.
This growth rate is far from negligible; skipping an archiving plan means the primary database eventually can't keep up.
At this scale, older transactions should move periodically to low-cost object storage while the primary keeps only recent hot data, separating query load from capacity pressure.
Unlimited in-memory caching has neither the capacity nor the durability to hold data at this volume long-term.

scenario: 支付 operational DB 中 3-6 个月前的交易很少被在线查询，但合规和审计要求长期可访问。
q: 合理的数据生命周期策略是什么？
options: 所有交易只保留最近 24 小时数据
把全部交易数据常驻 Redis 内存，用内存容量换查询速度
把超期的老交易直接随机删除
老交易归档到 S3 等冷存储，减轻主库压力
why: 冷热分层让近期在线查询保持快，长期合规数据进入低成本对象存储并可按需检索。
why_en: Tiering old transactions to object storage keeps operational queries fast while preserving long-term audit access.
whenOtherWins: 如果老数据仍被高频在线查询，应保留在 warm store 或专门分析库中，而不是直接归档到冷存储。
options_en: Keep only the last 24 hours of transaction data.
Keep all transaction data resident in Redis memory, trading capacity for query speed.
Randomly delete old transactions once they age out.
Archive old transactions to cold storage such as S3, lightening the primary database.
tradeoff: 冷存储归档保留可查性 vs 主库无限增长
q_en: What is a reasonable data lifecycle strategy?
scenario_en: Transactions older than three to six months are rarely queried online in the operational database, but compliance and audits require long-term access.
optionExplanations: 合规审计常要求追溯数年，只留最近 24 小时数据远远不够。
内存成本随年增 180TB 无法线性堆叠，且断电即失；长期合规数据应进低成本对象存储。
随机删除会永久破坏审计完整性，属于不可接受的数据丢失。
把老交易挪到 S3 这类冷存储，成本低还能长期保留，同时给主库减负。
optionExplanations_en: Compliance audits often need to trace back years, so keeping only the last 24 hours falls far short.
Memory cost cannot scale with 180TB of yearly growth and is lost on power failure; long-term compliance data belongs in low-cost object storage.
Randomly deleting aged-out records permanently breaks audit integrity — an unacceptable form of data loss.
Moving old transactions to cold storage like S3 keeps them cheaply and durably while taking the load off the primary database.

scenario: 商户频繁查询近期支付状态和报表，写路径仍由主库保证一致提交。
q: 读扩展可以优先采用什么？
options: 只读副本和对近期状态的缓存
把所有读取发到主库且不加索引
让 Kafka 直接响应 HTTP GET
把支付状态写进浏览器 cookie
why: 状态查询和报表读多时可用 read replicas 分担，热点近期状态可缓存；权威写仍在主库。
why_en: Read replicas and short-lived caches can offload status reads while the primary database remains the write authority.
whenOtherWins: 若读取必须刚写后立即强一致，应路由到主库或实现 read-your-writes，而不是盲读副本。
options_en: Read replicas and caching for recent status.
Send all reads to the primary with no indexes.
Have Kafka respond directly to HTTP GET requests.
Store payment status in a browser cookie.
tradeoff: 只读副本+缓存分担读 vs 全部读写压在主库
q_en: What should be the first read-scaling approach?
scenario_en: Merchants frequently query recent payment status and reports, while the write path still commits through the primary database.
optionExplanations: 只读副本分担查询、对近期状态加缓存，能让报表和状态查询不挤占写路径，写权威仍留在主库。
把所有读都压到主库还不加索引，写和读会一起挤占同一份资源。
Kafka 是异步事件日志，不是能同步响应 HTTP GET 的查询数据库。
cookie 存在客户端，没法作为服务端的权威状态来源。
optionExplanations_en: Read replicas plus caching for recent status offload queries without touching the write path, and the primary stays the write authority.
Sending every read to the primary with no indexes piles read and write load onto the same resource.
Kafka is an asynchronous event log, not a query database that can answer HTTP GET requests synchronously.
A cookie lives on the client and can't serve as the server's authoritative source of state.

scenario: PaymentIntent、Transaction、Webhook 等服务大多不持有本地会话状态，峰值流量会随假日销售突增。
scenario_en: PaymentIntent, Transaction, and Webhook services usually avoid local session state, while holiday sales can create sudden traffic spikes.
q: 应用服务层的默认扩展方式是什么？
q_en: What is the default scaling approach for the application service layer?
options: 所有流量固定一台主机
无状态服务加负载均衡水平扩展
每个商户手动启动一台笔记本
只靠数据库触发器处理 HTTP
why: 无状态实例不记本地会话，LB 可把请求打到任意健康实例；流量高了就加实例。有状态服务要先设计状态放哪。
why_en: Stateless services behind load balancers can scale horizontally to absorb bursty payment traffic.
whenOtherWins: 若服务必须保留本地状态，就要先外置到 DB/Redis，或用粘性会话/分片路由固定相关请求。
options_en: Pin all traffic to a single host.
Stateless services behind a load balancer, scaled horizontally.
Manually spin up a laptop per merchant.
Handle HTTP entirely with database triggers.
tradeoff: 无状态水平扩展 vs 单实例纵向堆资源

termDefinitions.meaning: 实例本地不保存必须延续到下一次请求的会话状态，请求打到任意健康实例都能处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateless service keeps no required session state on one instance, so any healthy instance can handle the next request.

termDefinitions.meaning: 实例本地保存会话或任务状态；扩容时要外置状态，或把相关请求固定路由到同一实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateful service keeps session or task state locally, so scaling requires externalizing state or routing related requests to the same instance.

termDefinitions.meaning: Load Balancer（LB）：把请求分发给多台健康应用实例的入口组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A load balancer distributes incoming requests across healthy application instances.

optionExplanations: 所有流量固定一台主机，既扛不住突发流量也没有故障冗余。
无状态实例不记本地会话，负载均衡能把请求打到任意健康实例，流量高了直接加实例即可。
人工给每个商户开一台笔记本，既不能自动化也跟不上促销的突发速度。
数据库触发器运行在库内部，本来就不是设计来处理外部 HTTP 流量的。
optionExplanations_en: Pinning all traffic to one host can't absorb a burst and has no failover if that host dies.
Stateless instances keep no local session, so the load balancer can route to any healthy instance and scaling just means adding more.
Manually spinning up a laptop per merchant isn't automatable and can't keep pace with a promotion's burst.
Database triggers run inside the database engine; they were never meant to handle external HTTP traffic.

scenario: Transaction processing 需要判断是数据库写已经成功但 completed event 丢了，还是外部超时导致写根本没完成。
q: 文章提到的生产级强化模式是什么？
options: 只发一个 best-effort 日志，失败了也不重试不做任何补偿
每次都让商户人工确认
两阶段事件：created + completed 分别记录
每次重试都直接重跑全部副作用，靠数据库唯一键兜底去重
why: created 事件记录开始处理，completed 事件记录数据库写完成；重试时可比较事件和 DB 状态，避免重复执行副作用。
why_en: A created event and a completed event let retries distinguish a missing completion event from a transaction that never committed.
whenOtherWins: 普通非金融 workflow 可能不需要两阶段事件；支付一致性风险使它值得讨论。
options_en: Emit just one best-effort log line, with no retry or compensation on failure.
Have the merchant manually confirm every time.
A two-phase model: separate created and completed events.
On every retry just re-run all side effects and rely on a database unique key to dedupe.
tradeoff: 两阶段事件精确重试 vs 单阶段事件粗粒度重试
q_en: What production-grade hardening pattern is described here?
scenario_en: Transaction processing needs to tell whether the database write succeeded but the completed event was lost, or whether an external timeout meant the write never completed.
optionExplanations: best-effort 日志丢了就没了，无法在重试时判断副作用是否已执行，谈不上生产级强化。
人工每次都确认完全跟不上高吞吐、异步处理的速度。
created 和 completed 分开记录，重试时能对比事件和数据库真实状态，精确判断该补发事件还是重跑整个流程。
盲目重跑副作用可能重复扣款或发通知；两阶段 created/completed 事件才能安全判断是否已处理。
optionExplanations_en: A best-effort log is gone if lost and cannot tell you on retry whether side effects already ran, which is not production hardening.
Having a human confirm every transaction can't keep up with high-throughput asynchronous processing.
Recording created and completed as separate events lets a retry compare them against the real database state and decide precisely whether to resend the event or rerun the whole flow.
Blindly re-running side effects can double-charge or double-notify; the two-phase created/completed events let you safely tell whether work already ran.

q: 两阶段 transaction event 中，如果关键事件发射失败，为什么要把 transaction 置为 locked/failed 等待修复？
options: 让客户在同一笔订单上多付一次款
减少 audit 表里累积的数据库行数
替代 webhook payload 上的 HMAC 签名校验
阻止后续更新在事件链不完整时继续推进
why: 事件链缺口会让下游审计、对账和 webhook 视图不一致，锁住可防止错误状态继续扩散。
why_en: Locking a transaction when event emission is incomplete prevents later updates from compounding inconsistent downstream views.
options_en: Make the customer pay a second time on the same order.
Reduce the number of rows accumulating in the audit table.
Replace HMAC signature verification on the webhook payload.
Block later updates from proceeding while the event chain is incomplete.
q_en: Why lock or fail a transaction when a critical two-phase event emission fails?
optionExplanations: 锁定只是把这笔交易冻住，不会再向银行发起任何扣款动作。
locked 只是一个状态标记，审计表照常追加，行数一行都不会少。
签名解决的是"这条通知是谁发的"，锁定解决的是"事件链完不完整"，两回事。
事件链有缺口时先锁住交易，能挡住下游审计、对账、webhook 在证据不全时继续基于错误状态推进。
optionExplanations_en: Locking merely freezes the transaction; it never sends another charge to the bank.
Locked is only a status flag; the audit table keeps appending and no rows go away.
Signatures answer "who sent this notification"; locking answers "is the event chain complete" — different concerns.
Locking a transaction when the event chain has a gap stops downstream audit, reconciliation, and webhooks from building further on an incomplete, possibly wrong state.
scenario: 两阶段事件里 transaction 已落库，但发往 Kafka 的关键事件发射失败，后续更新还在排队。
scenario_en: In a two-phase event flow the transaction is already persisted but its critical Kafka event failed to emit, while later updates are still queued.

q: 支付系统的 financial integrity 需要防哪些问题？（多选）
options: 重复扣款
把状态查询做成分页
银行成功但商户看到失败
审计事件丢失
why: 核心风险是钱和记录不一致：双扣、漏履约、丢审计都会造成金融和合规事故。
why_en: Financial integrity is about preventing duplicate charges, mismatched outcomes, and missing audit records.
options_en: Duplicate charges.
Paginating the status-query API.
The bank succeeds but the merchant sees failure.
Missing audit events.
q_en: What problems must payment-system financial integrity prevent? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 同一笔款被扣了不止一次，是支付系统必须防住的核心风险。
状态查询要不要分页是接口设计细节，不是金融完整性问题。
银行那边成功了商户却看到失败，这种内外记录不一致会导致漏履约或客户投诉。
审计事件一旦丢失，后续举证和对账就失去了依据。
optionExplanations_en: The same charge being taken more than once is the core risk a payment system must prevent.
Whether the status API paginates is an interface design detail, not a financial-integrity concern.
When the bank succeeds but the merchant sees failure, that mismatch between internal and external records can cause missed fulfillment or complaints.
Once an audit event is lost, there's no basis left for proving what happened or reconciling it.
scenario: 支付平台上线前做风险评审，要挑出会直接造成资金损失或合规事故的失败模式。
scenario_en: Before launch we run a risk review on the payment platform and pick out the failure modes that directly cause money loss or a compliance incident.

scenario: 商户需要低延迟 API 当前状态，审计/对账/通知需要完整历史和异步消费。
q: 这两类需求应如何分层？
options: Operational DB 管当前态，事件流管历史
只用 Kafka 事件流响应所有同步状态查询，靠重放算当前态
只用 Redis 同时保存当前态和全部审计历史
把当前状态和完整历史都放在浏览器本地
why: OLTP 库优化同步读写，事件流优化追加历史和多消费者；分层后两边可独立扩展。
why_en: The operational database serves current synchronous state, while the event stream serves immutable history and asynchronous consumers.
whenOtherWins: 非常小的系统可以先合并在一个数据库中，但支付规模和审计要求会很快需要分离。
options_en: The operational DB owns current state; the event stream owns history.
Use the Kafka event stream alone to answer every synchronous status query by replaying to compute current state.
Use Redis alone to hold both current state and all audit history.
Keep both current state and the full history in browser local storage.
tradeoff: OLTP 服务当前态 vs 事件流服务历史与异步消费
q_en: How should these two requirement types be layered?
scenario_en: Merchants need a low-latency API for current status, while audit, reconciliation, and notification need full history and asynchronous consumption.
optionExplanations: Operational DB 服务同步读写的当前状态，事件流负责追加式历史，两边各自扩展互不拖累。
每次同步查询都重放事件流延迟高且难做点查；当前态应由 operational DB 直接返回。
Redis 是内存态，既没有 7 年留存的耐久性，也不适合当唯一的审计存储。
浏览器既不可靠也不权威，当前状态和历史都不该由它保管。
optionExplanations_en: The operational DB serves synchronous reads/writes of current state while the event stream carries append-only history, letting each scale on its own.
Replaying the event stream on every synchronous query is slow and awkward for point lookups; current state should come straight from the operational DB.
Redis is in-memory, lacking the durability for seven-year retention and unfit as the only audit store.
The browser is neither reliable nor authoritative, so neither current state nor history belongs there.

q: Audit Service 和 Analytics Consumer 消费同一 CDC（变更数据捕获）流时，目标差异是什么？
options: 二者都只负责发 webhook
Audit 存完整历史，Analytics 建业务聚合视图
Audit 只做临时缓存随时清空，Analytics 负责用户认证鉴权
二者都替代 payment network
why: 同源事件可以被不同消费者按不同查询模式存储，审计重完整性，分析重聚合与查询便利。
why_en: Audit stores complete provable history, while analytics materializes business-friendly aggregate views from the same events.
options_en: Both are only responsible for sending webhooks.
Audit stores complete history; Analytics builds business aggregate views.
Audit is just a scratch cache that gets cleared, and Analytics handles user authentication.
Both replace the payment network.
tradeoff: 完整可证明历史 vs 面向查询的业务聚合视图
q_en: How do Audit Service and Analytics Consumer differ when consuming the same CDC stream?
optionExplanations: 发 webhook 通知是另一个独立消费者的职责，不是 Audit 或 Analytics 该做的事。
Audit 追求完整可举证的历史，Analytics 追求方便查询的业务聚合视图，同一条事件流被两种不同目标物化。
这弄反了职责：审计要长期不可变地留全历史，分析做聚合视图，两者都不管认证或临时缓存。
两者都是内部事件消费者，都不直接对接银行网络，谈不上替代 payment network。
optionExplanations_en: Sending webhook notifications is a separate consumer's job, not something Audit or Analytics should own.
Audit aims for complete, provable history while Analytics aims for query-friendly business aggregates — the same event stream materialized toward two different goals.
This inverts the roles: audit must retain full immutable history long-term and analytics builds aggregate views; neither does authentication or scratch caching.
Both are internal event consumers that never talk to the bank network directly, so neither replaces the payment network.
scenario: 同一条 CDC 事件同时喂两个消费者：一个要 7 年不可变留存，一个要跨商户聚合查询。
scenario_en: The same CDC event feeds two consumers: one needs seven years of immutable retention, the other needs aggregate queries across merchants.

q: 补全 webhook 基本模型：
text: 商户配置 {{callback URL}} 和订阅事件列表；支付系统在状态变化时向该 URL POST 带 {{event type}}、payment data 和签名的 payload。
why: 这让商户系统可以在不轮询的情况下收到 payment.succeeded 等事件并触发履约。
why_en: A callback URL and subscribed event types let merchant systems receive signed payment events without polling.
q_en: Fill in the basic webhook model:

q: Webhook（服务器间事件通知）投递失败时为什么不能紧密无限重试？
options: 会让签名更安全
会自动修复 PaymentIntent
会在商户故障时放大流量并拖垮对方系统
会减少 Kafka 分区需求
why: 商户 endpoint 可能正在故障，指数退避能避免雪上加霜，同时保留最终投递机会。
why_en: Exponential backoff avoids overwhelming a failing merchant endpoint while preserving eventual delivery attempts.
options_en: It makes signing more secure.
It automatically fixes the PaymentIntent.
It floods a struggling merchant with even more traffic and can take it further down.
It reduces how many Kafka partitions are needed.
q_en: Why should failed webhook delivery not retry tightly forever?
optionExplanations: 重试的频率跟签名安全性完全是两回事，不会因为紧密重试就更安全。
重试策略改变不了 PaymentIntent 本身的业务状态，不会自动修好任何东西。
商户 endpoint 本来就可能正在故障，无退避的密集重试会在它最脆弱的时候把更多流量砸过去，雪上加霜。
投递重试策略跟 Kafka 该开几个分区是两个独立的配置决定。
optionExplanations_en: How often something retries has nothing to do with signature security; retrying tightly doesn't make signing any safer.
A retry policy can't change the PaymentIntent's underlying business state; it fixes nothing automatically.
The merchant's endpoint may already be struggling, and retrying tightly with no backoff dumps even more traffic on it right when it's weakest.
How webhook delivery retries and how many Kafka partitions to run are two independent configuration decisions.
scenario: 某大商户 endpoint 整体宕机，我们队列里已堆了几十万条待投递的 webhook。
scenario_en: A large merchant's endpoint is completely down and hundreds of thousands of webhooks are already queued for it.

scenario: 商户收到一个 payment.succeeded HTTP POST，需要确认它确实来自支付平台且内容未被篡改。
q: Webhook payload 应该包含什么安全机制？
options: 只靠请求来源的 IP 地址白名单做判断
把完整卡号和 CVV 明文写进 payload 传给商户
发短信让客户手动确认这笔通知是否真实
用共享 secret 给 payload 和时间戳签名
why: 签名让商户能验证来源和完整性，timestamp 还能限制重放窗口；仅靠 IP 很脆弱。
why_en: A webhook signature over payload and timestamp lets merchants verify origin and integrity and limit replay.
whenOtherWins: 私有专线内的固定集成可以叠加 IP allowlist，但不应替代 payload 签名。
options_en: Judge authenticity from a source-IP allowlist alone.
Put the full card number and CVV in clear text in the payload sent to the merchant.
Text the customer to manually confirm whether this notification is genuine.
Sign the payload and timestamp with a shared secret.
tradeoff: 共享密钥签名验证 vs 仅信任来源 IP
q_en: What security mechanism should a webhook payload include?
scenario_en: A merchant receives a payment.succeeded HTTP POST and needs to confirm it really came from the payment platform and was not tampered with.
optionExplanations: 来源 IP 容易被伪造，也会随商户上游代理变化，单靠白名单非常脆弱。
卡号和 CVV 是最高敏感级别数据，写进通知等于把商户拖进 PCI 范围。
webhook 是系统间调用，客户根本看不到这次请求，无从确认。
用共享 secret 给 payload 和时间戳签名，商户既能验证事件确实来自平台，又能靠时间戳挡住重放。
optionExplanations_en: Source IPs are easy to spoof and shift whenever an upstream proxy changes, so an allowlist alone is fragile.
Card number and CVV are the most sensitive data there is; putting them in a notification drags the merchant into PCI scope.
A webhook is a system-to-system call the customer never sees, so there is nothing for them to confirm.
Signing the payload and timestamp with a shared secret lets the merchant verify the event truly came from the platform and blocks replay via the timestamp.

scenario: 商户后台只是偶尔查看某个 PaymentIntent 当前状态，不需要秒级业务触发。
q: 最简单的状态读取方式是什么？
options: GET 查询 /payment-intents/{id}
必须等商户 webhook 回调推送过来，客户端才能看到最新状态
直接查询 Visa 的内部授权数据库
重新提交一次 charge 把结果读回来
why: 当前状态查询是普通读路径，由 PaymentIntent Service 从 operational DB 返回即可。
why_en: Occasional current-state lookup is a normal read path served by GET from the operational database.
whenOtherWins: 需要自动触发履约时 webhook 更合适；需要历史审计时查 audit/event store。
options_en: GET /payment-intents/{id}.
The client can only see the latest status after the merchant webhook callback is pushed.
Query Visa's internal authorization database directly.
Resubmit the charge to read the result back.
tradeoff: 按需 GET 查询 vs 被动等待 webhook 推送
q_en: What is the simplest way to read current payment status?
scenario_en: A merchant dashboard only occasionally checks the current status of one PaymentIntent and does not need second-level business triggers.
optionExplanations: 偶尔查看当前状态就是标准的读路径，GET /payment-intents/{id} 直接从主库返回结果就够了。
webhook 是异步通知机制，不是唯一读路径；当前态是普通同步读，随时可直接查到。
银行的授权库对外部商户完全不可见，压根没有这条访问路径。
重新提交 charge 会真的再动一次钱，那是写路径不是查询。
optionExplanations_en: Occasionally checking current status is a plain read path — GET /payment-intents/{id} returning straight from the primary database is enough.
The webhook is an async notification mechanism, not the only read path; current state is an ordinary synchronous read available anytime.
The bank's authorization database is invisible to outside merchants; that access path simply does not exist.
Resubmitting a charge actually moves money again — that is a write path, not a query.

q: 让原始卡号经过商户服务器，除了技术风险外还会带来什么后果？
options: 支付系统吞吐自动提升
商户 PCI 合规范围和泄露责任大幅增加
Kafka 不再需要分区
商户能自建卡号库做一键复购，用户支付体验反而更好
why: 敏感卡数据触达商户基础设施会扩大审计、合规和攻击面，平台支付通常要帮商户避开这一点。
why_en: Letting raw card data touch merchant servers expands PCI scope, liability, and attack surface.
options_en: Payment system throughput automatically improves.
The merchant's PCI compliance scope and breach liability grow sharply.
Kafka no longer needs partitions.
The merchant can build its own card vault for one-click reorders, so the payment experience is actually better.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式事件流平台，用来异步、按顺序传递事件消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed event-streaming platform used to pass events asynchronously and in order.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器在事件发生时主动向另一台服务器的 URL 发起 HTTP 请求通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A webhook is a server-to-server HTTP callback that fires when an event occurs.

q_en: Besides technical risk, what consequence comes from routing raw card numbers through merchant servers?
optionExplanations: 卡数据走哪条路径和系统吞吐没有因果关系，不会因此自动变快。
卡号一旦触达商户基础设施，商户就进入更重的 PCI 合规范围，泄露责任也跟着大幅上升。
Kafka 该开几个分区取决于事件吞吐和有序性，跟卡数据怎么收集无关。
自建卡号库看似方便，实则把商户拉进 PCI 范围并承担泄露责任，正是平台要帮商户避免的。
optionExplanations_en: Which path card data takes has no bearing on system throughput; nothing speeds up because of it.
Once the card number touches merchant infrastructure, the merchant falls into a heavier PCI scope and its breach liability rises sharply.
Kafka partition count depends on event throughput and ordering needs, unrelated to how card data gets collected.
A self-built card vault looks convenient but pulls the merchant into PCI scope and breach liability, exactly what the platform aims to spare them.
scenario: 商户想自己在页面上收集卡号再转发给我们的 API，法务正在评审这个集成方案。
scenario_en: A merchant wants to collect card numbers on its own page and forward them to our API, and legal is reviewing that integration.

q: 安全收集并处理卡数据的链路正确顺序是什么？
steps: 支付服务器用 HSM 中的私钥解密并进入 PCI 受控处理路径
SDK 用支付平台 public key 在浏览器内加密卡数据
客户在支付域名 iframe 中输入卡信息
密文经 HTTPS 发送到支付平台而非商户服务器
why: iframe 先隔离商户页面，端上加密再保证离开设备就是密文，最后只在受控支付环境解密。
why_en: The secure card flow isolates entry in an iframe, encrypts on the client, sends ciphertext to the payment platform, and decrypts only in controlled infrastructure.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Browser
  participant I as Secure iframe
  participant P as Payment API
  participant H as HSM
  B->>I: enter card
  I->>I: encrypt card
  I->>P: token or ciphertext
  P->>H: decrypt when needed
  P->>B: payment result

termDefinitions.meaning: 专用硬件安全模块，用来安全存储密钥并执行加解密运算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An HSM is dedicated hardware that securely stores keys and performs encryption or decryption.

q_en: What is the correct order for securely collecting and processing card data?

q: 补全支付超时处理原则：
text: 支付网络 timeout 表示结果{{未知}}，不是失败；系统应记录 attempt、进入 {{pending_verification}}，并通过对账最终收敛。
why: 这是避免双扣和漏履约的核心思维：承认外部网络异步，而不是假装它是内部 RPC。
why_en: The core payment insight is that external-network timeouts create uncertainty, so the system must reconcile rather than guess.
q_en: Fill in the payment-timeout handling principle:

scenario: Kafka 保存热事件 7-30 天，但金融审计可能多年后还要查看完整支付历史。
q: 长期审计数据应该如何保存？
options: 只依赖 Kafka 永久保存所有数据
把全部审计事件常驻应用内存，重启时再从上游重放恢复
把 Kafka 事件归档到 S3 对象存储
打印到控制台
why: Kafka 适合热事件流，长期合规数据应归档到低成本持久对象存储，必要时可重建历史。
why_en: Kafka is a hot event log, while long-term compliance history belongs in durable object storage archives.
whenOtherWins: 如果事件保留窗口内的在线重放足够，Kafka 本身可服务近期恢复；多年审计需要归档。
options_en: Rely on Kafka alone to store everything forever.
Keep all audit events resident in application memory and replay from upstream to recover on restart.
Archive Kafka events to S3 object storage.
Print events to the console.
tradeoff: 归档到对象存储保长期 vs 只信任 Kafka 短期保留
q_en: How should long-term audit data be stored?
scenario_en: Kafka keeps hot events for seven to thirty days, but financial audits may need complete payment history years later.
optionExplanations: Kafka 默认只保留 7-30 天的热事件，当成永久存储会在保留期后丢数据。
应用内存容量有限且重启即失，靠重放恢复既慢又不可靠；长期合规数据应归档到 S3 对象存储。
把 Kafka 事件归档到 S3 这类对象存储，能用低成本满足多年后仍要查完整支付历史的要求。
控制台输出既不可搜索也不持久，没法支撑合规查询。
optionExplanations_en: Kafka keeps hot events for only about 7 to 30 days by default; treating it as permanent storage loses data once that window passes.
Application memory is limited and lost on restart, and replay recovery is slow and fragile; long-term compliance data belongs archived in S3 object storage.
Archiving Kafka events to object storage like S3 meets a years-later full-history audit requirement at low cost.
Console output is neither searchable nor durable — it can't support a compliance query.

q: 支付系统高级面试答案应主动讲清哪些点？（多选）
options: 敏感卡数据不碰商户服务器
超时是未知态，需要幂等和对账
所有失败都直接标 failed
当前状态与不可变审计历史分层
why: 支付系统的高信号点是安全边界、异步金融一致性和审计可追溯性；把超时当失败是反例。
why_en: Strong payment-system answers emphasize card-data isolation, uncertainty-aware reconciliation, and immutable audit history.
options_en: Sensitive card data never touches merchant servers.
A timeout is an unknown outcome that needs idempotency and reconciliation.
Every failure should immediately be marked failed.
Current state and immutable audit history are layered separately.
q_en: Which points should a strong payment-system interview answer proactively cover? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 敏感卡数据不碰商户服务器，是高信号候选人会主动强调的安全边界设计。
承认超时是未知态、需要靠幂等和对账收敛，是应对异步支付网络的核心思路。
把所有失败都直接标 failed，正是会造成双扣或漏履约的反面做法。
当前状态和不可变审计历史分层存储，是同时支撑低延迟查询和长期审计的关键设计。
optionExplanations_en: Keeping sensitive card data away from merchant servers is a security-boundary point a strong candidate raises proactively.
Recognizing a timeout as an unknown outcome that needs idempotency and reconciliation is the core mindset for an asynchronous payment network.
Marking every failure as failed outright is exactly the anti-pattern that causes duplicate charges or missed fulfillment.
Layering current state apart from immutable audit history is what supports both low-latency queries and long-term audit at once.
scenario: 45 分钟资深轮讲 Stripe 类支付系统，要挑最能体现判断力的点主动展开。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute senior round on a Stripe-like payment system, you pick the points that best show judgment and raise them yourself.

q: 一次支付的端到端主路径，正确顺序是什么？
steps: 商户查询状态或通过 webhook 收到 payment.succeeded/failed
商户创建 PaymentIntent
Transaction Service 记录 attempt 并调用支付网络
客户卡数据通过安全 iframe/加密 token 提交
结果提交到 operational DB，CDC 发布事件供审计/对账/通知消费
why: 主路径先建立收款意图，再安全收集卡数据并处理外部网络，最后用提交事件驱动状态查询、审计和通知。
why_en: The payment path creates an intent, securely collects card data, processes the network attempt, emits committed events, and exposes the result to merchants.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  C[Create intent]
  S[Collect secure card]
  T[Create transaction]
  N[Call network]
  E[Emit event]
  W[Webhook merchant]
  C --> S --> T --> N --> E --> W

termDefinitions.meaning: 从数据库提交日志捕获变更并发布为事件流的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC reads committed database changes from the log and publishes them as events.

termDefinitions.meaning: 网页里嵌入的独立文档窗口，受浏览器同源策略保护。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An iframe is an embedded document in a page that is isolated by the browser's same-origin policy.

q_en: What is the correct end-to-end main path for one payment?

scenario: 一笔卡支付要走授权、捕获、结算多个阶段，每个阶段都可能单独失败，而已经捕获的钱无法靠回滚事务收回。
scenario_en: A card payment moves through authorization, capture and settlement; each stage can fail on its own, and money already captured cannot be pulled back by rolling back a transaction.
q: 多阶段支付流程的状态与失败该怎么管理？
q_en: How should state and failure be managed across a multi-stage payment flow?
options: 把三个阶段包进一个横跨支付网络的分布式事务，全成功才提交
为每个阶段单独记录状态，失败时重试或触发补偿动作
只记录最终成功或失败，中间阶段不落库
任一阶段失败就整笔标 failed，让商户换新 PaymentIntent 重来
options_en: Wrap all three stages in one distributed transaction spanning the payment network and commit only if everything succeeds.
Persist state per stage, then retry or run a compensating action when one fails.
Only record the final success or failure and keep intermediate stages out of the database.
Mark the whole payment failed on any stage failure and make the merchant start over with a new PaymentIntent.
optionExplanations: 支付网络是外部系统，不参与我们的两阶段提交，跨网络的分布式事务根本无法成立。
每个阶段各自持久化状态后就能单独重试；不可回滚的阶段用一个反向动作来补偿。
不落中间状态，重试时就无从判断钱是否已被授权，双扣风险全留给自己。
捕获已经成功却整笔标 failed，客户被扣的钱不会自动退回，还会诱发重复下单。
optionExplanations_en: The payment network is an external system that will never join our two-phase commit, so a distributed transaction across it cannot exist.
Persisting each stage lets it be retried alone, and stages that cannot be rolled back get a reverse action instead.
Without intermediate state, a retry cannot tell whether the money was already authorized, leaving you exposed to double charges.
Failing the whole payment after a successful capture does not return the customer's money and invites a duplicate order.
why: 外部网络不提供跨阶段回滚，只能让状态机逐段推进，失败处按需重试或补偿。代价是每个阶段都要写重试与反向动作，编排复杂度显著上升。
why_en: Payment networks give you no cross-stage rollback, so you advance a state machine stage by stage with retries and compensations, and you pay for that in orchestration complexity.
tradeoff: 逐阶段可重试可补偿 vs 单一事务语义更简单但外部网络不支持
whenOtherWins: 如果整条链路都在我们自己的数据库里、没有外部网络参与，一个 ACID 事务就够了，不必做补偿编排。

termDefinitions.meaning: authorization：向发卡行确认额度并冻结资金，但钱还没真正划走。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Authorization asks the issuing bank to reserve funds; the money has not actually moved yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: capture：把已授权的额度真正扣走，资金开始向商户流动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Capture actually collects the previously authorized amount and starts moving funds to the merchant.

termDefinitions.meaning: settlement：支付网络按批次把资金真正清算到商户账户。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Settlement is when the payment network actually clears funds into the merchant's account in batches.

termDefinitions.meaning: compensation：用一个反向业务动作（如退款）抵消已完成的步骤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Compensation undoes a completed step with a reverse business action such as a refund.

scenario: 卡号已经在我们域名的 iframe 里收集，商户服务器碰不到卡号；但安全评审仍要求 SDK 在浏览器里先用公钥加密再发出。
scenario_en: Card numbers are already collected inside an iframe served from our domain so merchant servers never touch them, yet the security review still requires the SDK to encrypt with a public key inside the browser.
q: iframe 隔离之后为什么还要端上加密？
q_en: Why add client-side encryption on top of iframe isolation?
options: iframe 已经隔离了，加密只是为了减少后端解析开销
iframe 内卡号仍是明文，被攻破就直接泄露，加密再加一层
端上加密可以取代 HTTPS，省掉 TLS 握手带来的延迟
浏览器的同源策略已经挡住了所有已知攻击，端上加密只是走个合规形式
options_en: The iframe already isolates the data, so encryption is only about reducing backend parsing cost.
Inside the iframe the card number is still plaintext, so encryption adds a layer if the frame is compromised.
Client-side encryption can replace HTTPS and save the latency of the TLS handshake.
The browser same-origin policy already blocks every known attack, so client-side encryption is a compliance formality.
optionExplanations: 加密是为了让攻破 iframe 的人拿不到可用数据，跟后端解析开销毫无关系。
iframe 的边界由浏览器策略维持，框内数据本身没加密，公钥加密让泄露出去的只是密文。
端上加密不提供服务器身份认证，也防不住中间人改包，替代不了 TLS。
同源策略只是浏览器层的一道策略，被复杂攻击绕过时就没有第二道防线了。
optionExplanations_en: Encryption exists so that whoever breaks the iframe gets nothing usable; backend parsing cost has nothing to do with it.
The iframe boundary is only enforced by browser policy and the data inside stays plaintext, so public-key encryption means a leak yields ciphertext.
Client-side encryption authenticates no server and stops no tampering in transit, so it cannot replace TLS.
The same-origin policy is one browser-level rule, and once a sophisticated attack bypasses it there is no second line of defense.
why: iframe 的安全性完全依赖浏览器策略，框内卡号仍是明文且只靠 HTTPS 保护传输；公钥在离开设备前加密，让被攻破时也只拿到密文。代价是要维护密钥对和 HSM 解密。
why_en: The iframe's protection rests entirely on browser policy and the card data inside is still plaintext, so encrypting with our public key before it leaves the device means a compromise yields only ciphertext, at the cost of running key pairs and HSM decryption.

termDefinitions.meaning: 网页里嵌入的独立文档窗口，受浏览器同源策略保护。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An iframe is an embedded document in a page that is isolated by the browser's same-origin policy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 硬件安全模块：专用硬件，私钥不出设备，在里面完成解密和签名。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HSM stands for Hardware Security Module, dedicated hardware that decrypts and signs without ever exposing the private key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浏览器规则：一个页面的脚本不能读取另一个来源文档里的内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The same-origin policy is a browser rule that stops one page's scripts from reading content from another origin's document.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 TLS 加密的 HTTP，保护数据在传输途中不被窃听篡改。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTPS is HTTP encrypted with TLS, protecting data from eavesdropping and tampering while in transit.

scenario: 某支付网络整体不可用约 20 分钟，这段时间发出的 charge 请求全部超时，商户还在 checkout 页等结果。
scenario_en: One payment network is fully down for about twenty minutes, every charge request sent in that window times out, and merchants are still waiting on the checkout page.
q: outage 期间这些超时请求该落成什么状态？
q_en: What state should those timed-out requests land in during the outage?
options: 统一标记为 failed 并提示客户重试，等支付网络恢复后再统一处理
置为 pending_verification，等对账给出结论
阻塞处理线程一直等待，直到支付网络恢复后再返回
先从我们自己的账上垫付，事后再向支付网络补提交这笔交易
options_en: Mark them all failed and tell customers to retry, then clean it up once the payment network is back.
Set pending_verification and let reconciliation decide.
Block the handling threads and wait until the payment network recovers before replying.
Front the money from our own account and resubmit the transaction to the network afterwards.
optionExplanations: outage 里的超时同样只代表我们没收到结果，批量标 failed 会把已扣款的客户推去重扣一次。
attempt 行里存着 network reference ID，恢复后按它逐笔查证再推到终态。
线程一直挂着会在 20 分钟内耗尽连接池，把不相关的商户请求一起拖垮。
垫付把外部网络的不确定变成我们自己的资金敞口，对不上账时损失由平台承担。
optionExplanations_en: A timeout during an outage still only means we got no answer, so bulk-failing them pushes already-charged customers into a second charge.
The attempt row holds the network reference ID, so afterwards each one is verified against it and driven to a final state.
Held threads exhaust the connection pool within those twenty minutes and drag unrelated merchant requests down with them.
Fronting the money converts the network's uncertainty into our own financial exposure, and the platform eats the loss when it does not reconcile.
why: outage 期间超时依旧是未知而非失败，正确做法是把 attempt 记下来交给对账服务，用支付网络的 settlement 文件做权威定论。代价是商户拿到终态的时间被拉长。
why_en: During an outage a timeout is still unknown rather than failed, so we record the attempt and let reconciliation settle it against the network's settlement file, which means merchants wait longer for a final answer.
tradeoff: 终态延迟换不双扣 vs 立刻给结论但可能判错
whenOtherWins: 如果支付网络明确返回了 decline 响应而不是超时，那就是确定的失败，直接标 failed 比挂 pending 更好。

termDefinitions.meaning: 为超时保留的中间状态：结果未知，等待对账查证后再定终态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pending_verification is an intermediate state for timeouts: the outcome is unknown until reconciliation verifies it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付网络按日或按小时投递的批量对账文件，是交易结果的权威记录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A settlement file is the batch reconciliation file a payment network delivers daily or hourly, and it is the authoritative record of what happened.

termDefinitions.meaning: 调用支付网络前先落库的一行：记下发了什么、何时发、网络给的 reference ID。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An attempt record is a row written before calling the network, capturing what we sent, when, and the network's reference ID.

scenario: 一个 PaymentIntent 底下会挂 Charge、Refund、Dispute、Payout 四类资金流动记录，而白板讨论只有 45 分钟。
scenario_en: A single PaymentIntent can own four kinds of money-movement records — Charge, Refund, Dispute and Payout — and the whiteboard discussion only has forty-five minutes.
q: 这四类资金记录在实体建模上怎么处理？
q_en: How should those four money-movement records be modeled?
options: 为 Charge、Refund、Dispute、Payout 各建一张独立表，各自定义状态机
用一张 polymorphic Transaction 表，按 type 区分
全部塞进 PaymentIntent 的一个 JSON 字段里
只保留 Charge，另外三类事后从支付网络的对账文件还原
options_en: Give Charge, Refund, Dispute and Payout their own separate tables, each with its own state machine.
Use one polymorphic Transaction table and tell them apart by a type column.
Stuff all of them into a single JSON column on the PaymentIntent.
Keep only Charge and rebuild the other three later from the network's reconciliation files.
optionExplanations: 四张表要各自维护外键、索引和状态机，在有限时间的设计讨论里换不来对应的表达力。
四类记录共享金额、币种、状态、时间戳和指回 intent 的外键，一个 type 列就能把它们区分开。
JSON 列查不动也约束不住，退款和拒付的金额没法参与数据库层的求和与校验。
对账文件是事后的、粗粒度的，还原不出每次退款和拒付的完整时间线，审计立刻断链。
optionExplanations_en: Four tables mean four sets of foreign keys, indexes and state machines, and in a time-boxed design discussion that buys you no extra expressiveness.
All four share amount, currency, status, timestamps and a foreign key back to the intent, so one type column separates them.
A JSON column cannot be queried or constrained, so refund and dispute amounts never participate in database-level sums or checks.
Reconciliation files arrive after the fact and too coarse to reconstruct each refund or dispute timeline, breaking the audit chain immediately.
why: 四类记录字段结构几乎一致，用一个 type 列区分能保住一对多关系和幂等推理；代价是各类型独有的字段在表里稀疏，规模上去后仍要拆。
why_en: The four record types share almost the same columns, so a single type column keeps the one-to-many relationship and idempotency reasoning intact, at the cost of sparse type-specific fields as you scale.
tradeoff: 单表模型心智负担小 vs 拆表让各类型状态机独立演进
whenOtherWins: 当拒付流程和 payout 的状态机差异大到互相干扰时，拆成独立类型并配上 LedgerEntry 才好维护。

termDefinitions.meaning: 多态记录：一张表用 type 列承载几种形状相近但语义不同的记录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A polymorphic record means one table holds several similar-shaped but semantically different record kinds, told apart by a type column.

termDefinitions.meaning: 拒付：持卡人向发卡行申诉，可能导致这笔钱被反向划走。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dispute is a cardholder challenging a charge with their bank, potentially reversing the money.

termDefinitions.meaning: 提现：把平台上积累的余额划到商户自己的银行账户。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A payout moves the balance accumulated on the platform out to the merchant's own bank account.

termDefinitions.meaning: 商户收款意图的记录，拥有 created→authorized→captured 的状态机。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A PaymentIntent records the merchant's intent to collect money and owns the created-to-authorized-to-captured state machine.

scenario: Transaction 表记下了「这笔 charge 成功收了 2499 分」，但财务还要回答商户可提现余额和平台手续费各自变动了多少。
scenario_en: The Transaction table records that a charge collected 2499 cents, but finance still needs to know how much the merchant's withdrawable balance and the platform's fee each moved.
q: 生产系统还需要补哪一层记录？
q_en: What extra layer of records does a production system still need?
options: 直接在 Transaction 行上加一个 balance 字段，不断往里累加
再加 double-entry LedgerEntry 行记录余额移动
每晚跑批扫全部 transaction 重算余额
把余额计算交给商户自己的系统，我们只回传成功或失败
options_en: Just add a balance column on the Transaction row and keep accumulating into it.
Add double-entry LedgerEntry rows that record the balance movement.
Run a nightly batch that rescans all transactions and recomputes balances.
Leave balance computation to the merchant's own system and just return success or failure.
optionExplanations: 在一行上累加余额会被并发写覆盖，而且累加错了之后没有任何记录能告诉你错在哪一笔。
每次资金事件写一组借贷成对的行，钱从哪个账户到哪个账户是显式记录而非推算出来的。
重算只能给出当下的数字，中途某笔算错时既发现不了也定位不到，还挡不住白天的查询。
手续费拆分和拒付回退发生在我们这一侧，商户手上根本没有足够信息算出正确余额。
optionExplanations_en: Accumulating into one column gets clobbered by concurrent writes, and once it drifts nothing tells you which payment broke it.
Each money event writes a matched pair of debit and credit rows, so which account the money left and entered is recorded, not inferred.
A recompute only gives you today's number; if one entry was wrong you neither detect nor locate it, and daytime queries still see nothing.
Fee splits and dispute reversals happen on our side, so the merchant simply lacks the information to compute a correct balance.
why: Transaction 说明发生了什么事件，LedgerEntry 用借贷成对的行说明钱从哪个账户移到哪个账户，任何时刻都能对平。代价是每笔资金事件的写入量翻倍。
why_en: A Transaction says what happened while ledger entries say which account the money left and which it entered, so the books always balance, and you pay for it with double the writes per money event.
tradeoff: 复式记账可对平可审计 vs 多一层写入与建模成本
whenOtherWins: 面试里时间只够讲核心链路时，收敛到单一 Transaction 模型足够表达幂等和审计，不必展开复式记账。

termDefinitions.meaning: 复式记账：每笔资金变动同时写一条借和一条贷，两边金额必须相等。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Double-entry bookkeeping writes one debit and one credit for every money movement, and the two sides must always be equal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 账本分录行：记录某个账户在某笔资金事件里增加或减少了多少。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LedgerEntry is a ledger line recording how much a specific account gained or lost in one money event.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付系统里一条资金流动记录，挂在某个 PaymentIntent 之下。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Transaction is one money-movement record in the payment system, attached to a PaymentIntent.

scenario: 商户拿到两把钥匙：公开 API key 用于标识身份，private secret key 用于给请求生成签名。现在要把支付 SDK 嵌进 checkout 页。
scenario_en: A merchant holds two keys: a public API key that identifies them and a private secret key that signs requests. Now the payment SDK has to be embedded in the checkout page.
q: 哪个标识可以出现在客户端代码里？
q_en: Which identifier is safe to appear in client-side code?
options: 把 secret key 也下发到前端，让浏览器直接生成签名，省掉一次后端往返
PaymentIntent ID 放前端，secret key 只留服务器
两把钥匙都放进前端，靠 JavaScript 代码混淆来防止被人读取
两个都不放前端，每次支付都让商户服务器转发客户输入的原始卡号
options_en: Ship the secret key to the frontend too so the browser can sign directly and save a backend round trip.
Put the PaymentIntent ID in the frontend and keep the secret key on the server.
Ship both keys to the frontend and rely on JavaScript obfuscation to keep them unreadable.
Ship neither, and have the merchant server relay the customer's raw card number on every payment.
optionExplanations: 前端代码任何人都能读，secret key 一进浏览器就等于公开，攻击者能伪造签名替商户扣款。
它只是一笔收款的引用，被别人看到也发起不了新扣款，正好用来串起后续 checkout 流程。
混淆只是把字符串换个样子，用浏览器开发者工具照样能在网络请求里抓到它。
让原始卡号回到商户服务器，等于把商户重新拖进 PCI 合规范围，方向恰好反了。
optionExplanations_en: Anyone can read frontend code, so a secret key in the browser is a published secret and lets an attacker forge signed charges.
It is only a reference to one charge: seeing it starts nothing, and it is what the rest of the checkout flow points at.
Obfuscation only rewrites the string, and devtools will still show it sitting in the outgoing network request.
Sending raw card numbers back through the merchant server drags the merchant into PCI scope again, which is the wrong direction.
why: secret key 一旦进客户端就等于公开，任何人都能伪造签名请求扣款；PaymentIntent ID 只是引用，泄露也无法凭它发起新收款。代价是签名必须在商户后端做，多一次后端往返。
why_en: A secret key in client code is a public key in practice and lets anyone forge a signed charge, while a PaymentIntent ID is only a reference that cannot start a new charge — the price is that signing has to happen on the merchant backend.
tradeoff: 服务端签名保住密钥 vs 前端签名少一次后端往返
whenOtherWins: 只有在商户完全受控的后端到后端调用里，secret key 才应该出现在代码中用于签名。

termDefinitions.meaning: 标识调用方身份的字符串，本身只回答「你是谁」不证明「请求没被改」。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API key is a string identifying the caller; it answers who you are but proves nothing about the request being unmodified.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只存在商户服务器的私密字符串，用来对请求内容生成签名。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A secret key is a private string kept only on the merchant server and used to sign request contents.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用密钥对请求内容做哈希得到的串，用于证明请求真实且未被篡改。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A signature is a hash of the request computed with a secret key, proving the request is authentic and untampered.

termDefinitions.meaning: 处理持卡人数据必须满足的一套安全标准与审计要求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PCI compliance is the set of security standards and audits required of anyone handling cardholder data.

scenario: 商户希望 POST 一次就同步拿到最终结果，但支付网络要跑欺诈检查、还要留 chargeback 窗口，终态可能几分钟到几天后才确定。
scenario_en: Merchants want one POST to return the final answer, but the payment network runs fraud checks and keeps a chargeback window, so the final state may only settle minutes or days later.
q: 这对状态模型和通知机制意味着什么？
q_en: What does that mean for the state model and the notification mechanism?
options: 把 HTTP 超时调到 5 分钟，等支付网络给出最终答案
授权响应只是第一步，状态机要长期演进并推送变更
在网关缓存上一次结果，商户重试时直接返回缓存
让商户不断轮询直到成功为止，系统就不用维护中间状态
options_en: Raise the HTTP timeout to five minutes and wait for the network's final answer.
Treat the authorization response as step one: the state machine keeps evolving and pushes changes.
Cache the last result at the gateway and return it directly when the merchant retries.
Let merchants poll until success so the system never has to keep intermediate state.
optionExplanations: 拒付可能在几天后才发生，再长的 HTTP 超时也等不到终态，只会先耗光连接。
PaymentIntent 需要一个未定态承载它，之后的变化由事件推送和对账补齐。
缓存只能挡住重复请求，它并不知道支付网络后来把这笔转成了什么状态。
轮询也得读某个状态，系统不维护中间态，商户轮到的就永远只是最初那个回答。
optionExplanations_en: A dispute can land days later, so no HTTP timeout is long enough to reach the final state — it just burns connections first.
The PaymentIntent needs an undecided state to sit in, and later changes arrive through pushed events and reconciliation.
A cache only absorbs duplicate requests; it has no idea what the network later turned that payment into.
Polling still has to read some state, and without intermediate state the merchant just keeps re-reading the original answer.
why: 欺诈检查、结算和拒付让终态可能在数分钟到数天后才确定，所以必须有 processing 这类中间态并靠 webhook/对账推进。代价是商户端要接受最终一致性并自己处理状态变更。
why_en: Fraud checks, settlement and chargebacks mean the final state can land minutes or days later, so you need an intermediate processing state pushed forward by webhooks and reconciliation, and merchants must accept eventual consistency.
tradeoff: 承认异步换正确性 vs 同步返回体验简单但会错判
whenOtherWins: 若某种支付方式在授权那一刻就是终态（例如内部钱包余额扣款），同步返回确实够用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 拒付：持卡人事后申诉，发卡行把已成功的钱反向划回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A chargeback is when a cardholder disputes a charge afterwards and the issuing bank pulls the money back.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付网络对交易做的风险评估，可能延后甚至事后推翻授权结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fraud checks are the network's risk assessment of a transaction, which can be delayed or even reverse an earlier approval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器对服务器的回调：事件发生时我们 POST 到商户预先登记的 URL。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A webhook is a server-to-server callback: we POST to a URL the merchant registered when an event happens.

termDefinitions.meaning: 各方状态不要求同时一致，但在有限时间后会收敛到同一结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventual consistency means parties are not consistent at every instant but converge to the same result after a bounded delay.

scenario: CDC 从数据库 WAL 抓变更发往 Kafka，某次 CDC 卡住 90 秒，一批已经提交的关键支付事件还没出现在 topic 里。
scenario_en: CDC tails the database WAL into Kafka, but one day CDC stalls for ninety seconds and a batch of already-committed critical payment events has not shown up in the topic.
q: 针对关键支付事件应该加什么兜底通道？
q_en: What fallback path should critical payment events get?
options: 应用在确认时限内没看到事件，就自己直写 Kafka 补位
把这些支付请求整体拒绝，直到 CDC 恢复为止
改由应用代码全权写事件，彻底不再使用 CDC
把 Kafka 的 replication factor 从 3 调到 5 来覆盖这种滞后
options_en: If the application does not see the event within a confirmation window, it writes to Kafka itself as a fallback.
Reject those payment requests entirely until CDC recovers.
Have application code own all event writes and drop CDC altogether.
Raise Kafka's replication factor from three to five to cover this kind of lag.
optionExplanations: 数据库照常提交，只是事件没流出去；应用补发一条，把缺口补上而不是等它自愈。
CDC 是审计旁路，不是收款主路径，为它拒绝真实收款是拿营收换一个可以补的缺口。
全靠应用写事件正是被 CDC 取代的那个方案：开发漏写一行，审计就静默丢失。
多副本解决的是 broker 挂掉的数据丢失，事件根本没进 Kafka 时副本再多也没用。
optionExplanations_en: The database commits fine and only the events stop flowing, so the application republishes to close the gap instead of waiting for self-healing.
CDC is the audit side-path, not the charging main path, so rejecting real payments trades revenue for a gap you could have backfilled.
Letting the application own all event writes is exactly the approach CDC replaced: one forgotten line and the audit trail silently disappears.
Extra replicas protect against a broker dying; when the event never reached Kafka at all, more copies change nothing.
why: CDC 是单点，库提交了但事件不流动；给关键事件设一个确认时限，超时就由应用直写 Kafka 补位。代价是同一事件可能出现两次，消费者必须按事件 id 幂等去重。
why_en: CDC is a single point of failure where commits succeed but events stop flowing, so critical events get a confirmation deadline after which the app publishes to Kafka itself — at the cost of duplicates that consumers must dedupe by event id.
tradeoff: 补位保证关键事件不缺 vs 引入重复事件与去重成本
whenOtherWins: 分析类的非关键变更不必加这条旁路，等 CDC 追上即可，省掉下游的去重负担。

termDefinitions.meaning: 变更数据捕获：从数据库提交日志读取已提交变更并发布为事件流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC stands for Change Data Capture: it reads committed changes from the database log and publishes them as events.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预写日志：数据库先把变更写进这个日志再改数据页，CDC 就从这里读。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WAL stands for Write-Ahead Log, the log a database writes changes into before applying them, and the place CDC reads from.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一个操作重复执行多次，结果和执行一次相同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotent means repeating the same operation many times leaves the same result as doing it once.

termDefinitions.meaning: Kafka 每个 partition 保存的副本份数，决定挂几台 broker 仍不丢数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The replication factor is how many copies Kafka keeps of each partition, deciding how many broker failures it survives without data loss.

scenario: 超时的支付被置为 pending_verification，再由财务团队每天人工比对银行文件后手改状态；Black Friday 当天堆积了数千笔。
scenario_en: Timed-out payments are set to pending_verification and a finance team manually reconciles them against bank files each day; on Black Friday thousands piled up.
q: 这套人工兜底暴露了什么运维缺陷？
q_en: What operational flaw does this manual backstop expose?
options: 人工核对量随交易峰值同步增长，恰好在最忙时压垮
pending_verification 这个状态本身会导致数据库锁表
银行投递的对账文件不能作为权威凭据
人工核对会要求 Kafka 分区数量同步扩容
options_en: The manual workload grows with the traffic peak and buckles exactly when volume is highest.
The pending_verification state itself causes database table locks.
The bank's reconciliation files cannot be treated as authoritative evidence.
Manual reconciliation forces Kafka's partition count to scale up with it.
optionExplanations: 待核对队列和交易量同比例膨胀，峰值日商户等终态的时间反而最长。
它只是 status 列上的一个枚举值，不涉及任何额外的锁语义。
settlement 文件恰恰是支付网络对交易结果的权威记录，人工流程正是在读它。
人工核对发生在数据库和财务流程一侧，跟事件流的分区并行度没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: The queue awaiting review swells in proportion to volume, so merchants wait longest for a final state exactly on the busiest day.
It is just one enum value in a status column and carries no extra locking semantics at all.
Settlement files are precisely the network's authoritative record of outcomes, and the manual process is reading them.
Manual reconciliation lives on the database and finance side and has nothing to do with event-stream partition parallelism.
why: 正常路径超时→置 pending_verification→等财务每日核对→手改终态，队列长度与交易量同增，峰值时最需要快结论却最慢。修法是把对账做成消费 timeout 事件的自动服务。
why_en: The loop is timeout, then pending_verification, then a daily manual review, then a hand-edited final state — and the queue grows with volume, so answers are slowest exactly when they matter most; the fix is a reconciliation service that consumes timeout events automatically.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为超时保留的中间状态：结果未知，等待对账查证后再定终态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pending_verification is an intermediate state for timeouts: the outcome is unknown until reconciliation verifies it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把我们内部的交易记录和支付网络的权威记录逐笔比对并纠正状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Reconciliation compares our internal transaction records against the network's authoritative records and corrects the state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付网络按日或按小时投递的批量交易结果文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A settlement file is the batch file of transaction outcomes a payment network delivers daily or hourly.

scenario: 对账逻辑直接查那台承载 10k TPS 支付写入的 PostgreSQL，扫的是几个月的历史 attempt 记录。
scenario_en: The reconciliation logic queries the same PostgreSQL instance that absorbs 10k TPS of payment writes, scanning months of historical attempt records.
q: 促销峰值时最先出现什么症状？
q_en: What symptom shows up first during a promotional peak?
options: 对账扫描抢占 IO，商户下单接口延迟同时抬高
对账查询会被数据库自动降级成只读
PostgreSQL 会自动把对账类查询路由到分析副本
写入 TPS 不受影响，只有对账本身变慢一点
options_en: The reconciliation scan steals IO and merchant checkout latency rises at the same time.
The database automatically downgrades reconciliation queries to read-only.
PostgreSQL automatically routes reconciliation-style queries to an analytics replica.
Write TPS is unaffected and only reconciliation itself gets a bit slower.
optionExplanations: 长扫描把缓冲池里的热页挤走，操作型查询被迫回磁盘，两类负载一起变慢。
数据库不会因为查询长就改它的权限，读写权限来自连接的角色配置。
路由到副本是应用或中间件要显式做的事，数据库自己不会分流。
共享缓冲池、连接数和磁盘带宽是有限资源，两边争抢时不可能只有一边变慢。
optionExplanations_en: Long scans evict hot pages from the buffer pool, pushing operational queries back to disk, so both workloads slow together.
A database does not change a query's privileges because it runs long; read-write access comes from the connection's role.
Routing to a replica is something the application or a proxy must do explicitly; the database does not split traffic itself.
Buffer pool, connections and disk bandwidth are shared finite resources, so contention cannot slow only one side.
why: 同一实例上 总负载 = 操作查询 + 对账长扫描，两者抢同一份连接池和缓冲池，峰值时下单延迟跟着抬高。修法是让对账消费 CDC 事件流或走独立副本。
why_en: On one instance total load equals operational queries plus long reconciliation scans, and they contend for the same connection pool and buffer pool, so checkout latency rises at peak — feed reconciliation from the CDC stream or a dedicated replica instead.

termDefinitions.meaning: 联机事务处理：面向大量短小读写的操作型数据库负载。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: OLTP stands for Online Transaction Processing, the operational database workload of many small short reads and writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒事务数，衡量支付系统吞吐的单位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TPS stands for Transactions Per Second, the unit used to measure payment system throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库在内存里缓存数据页的区域，命中它才能避免读磁盘。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The buffer pool is the in-memory cache of data pages; hitting it is what saves you a disk read.

termDefinitions.meaning: 变更数据捕获：从数据库提交日志读取已提交变更并发布为事件流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC stands for Change Data Capture: it reads committed changes from the database log and publishes them as events.

numberAnchors.risk: 单主写瓶颈、索引/事务变重

scenario: Reconciliation、Audit、Webhook 三个服务都要消费同一条约 10k TPS 的支付事件流，而且每个服务都要能独立扩容。
scenario_en: Reconciliation, Audit and Webhook services all consume the same roughly 10k TPS payment event stream, and each must be able to scale independently.
q: Kafka 侧的消费者该怎么组织？
q_en: How should the Kafka consumers be organized?
options: 每服务一个 consumer group，组内多实例分担 partition
三个服务共用一个 consumer group，靠 partition 数平分消息
每个服务各建一条独立 topic，事件重复写三份
所有服务共用同一个消费实例串行消费，以保证顺序绝不乱
options_en: One consumer group per service, with instances inside a group splitting the partitions.
All three services share one consumer group and split messages across the partitions.
Give each service its own topic and write every event three times.
Have all services share one consumer instance reading serially so ordering can never break.
optionExplanations: 每个组独立维护 offset，可以各自回放和扩容；组内实例数最多用满 partition 数。
共用一个组等于三个服务分食同一批消息，审计会漏掉被 webhook 拿走的那些事件。
重复写三份让生产者承担扇出成本，还要保证三条 topic 之间不出现分歧。
单实例串行消费在 10k TPS 下必然堆积，而顺序其实已由按 payment_intent_id 分区保证。
optionExplanations_en: Each group tracks its own offset so it can replay and scale on its own, and instances inside a group scale up to the partition count.
Sharing one group makes three services split the same messages, so audit silently misses whatever the webhook service consumed.
Writing three copies pushes fan-out cost onto the producer and forces you to keep three topics from diverging.
One serial instance will fall behind at 10k TPS, and ordering is already guaranteed by partitioning on payment_intent_id.
why: 每个服务独占一个 consumer group 才能各自维护 offset、独立扩容并保持 exactly-once 处理语义；上限是组内实例数不能超过 partition 数，多出来的实例只能空转。
why_en: Giving each service its own consumer group is what lets it track its own offset, scale independently and keep exactly-once processing, with the ceiling that instances beyond the partition count just sit idle.
tradeoff: 各组独立回放与扩容 vs 共用一组能均摊但会互相抢走消息
whenOtherWins: 同一个服务的多个副本要分担负载时，才应该共用一个 consumer group 而不是各建一个。

termDefinitions.meaning: Kafka 里共享一份消费进度的一组消费者，组内成员各分到不同 partition。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A consumer group is a set of Kafka consumers sharing one consumption position, with each member assigned different partitions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 消费者在某个 partition 上已读到的位置编号，决定重启后从哪继续。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An offset is the position a consumer has read up to in a partition, deciding where it resumes after a restart.

termDefinitions.meaning: topic 的并行分片，是 Kafka 里顺序保证和并行度的基本单位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A partition is a parallel slice of a topic and the unit of both ordering guarantees and parallelism in Kafka.

termDefinitions.meaning: 恰好一次语义：即使发生重试，同一条消息的处理效果只生效一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exactly-once semantics means a message takes effect only once even when retries happen.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒事务数，衡量支付系统吞吐的单位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TPS stands for Transactions Per Second, the unit used to measure payment system throughput.

scenario: 商户处理完 payment.succeeded 并发货了，但它返回的 2xx 在回程丢失，我们的退避重试又把同一条 webhook 投了一次。
scenario_en: A merchant handled payment.succeeded and shipped the order, but its 2xx was lost on the way back, so our backoff retry delivered the same webhook again.
q: 商户侧该靠什么避免重复履约？
q_en: What should the merchant rely on to avoid fulfilling twice?
options: 按 webhook payload 里的事件 id 做幂等去重
收到重复就忽略之后所有 webhook 投递
让我们保证 exactly-once 投递，商户完全不必处理
比较 payload 里的 created 时间戳，只处理最近五分钟内的事件
options_en: Deduplicate idempotently on the event id carried in the webhook payload.
Once a duplicate arrives, ignore every webhook delivered afterwards.
Have us guarantee exactly-once delivery so the merchant needs no logic at all.
Compare the created timestamp in the payload and only process events from the last five minutes.
optionExplanations: 事件 id 在重投时保持不变，商户记下已处理过的 id，再来就直接回 2xx 不再发货。
忽略后续投递会连真正的新事件（比如随后的 chargeback）一起丢掉，问题从重复变成漏处理。
网络重试注定产生重复投递，投递方最多保证至少一次，把幂等推给对方是不成立的承诺。
商户 endpoint 宕机一小时后积压的事件全会超窗被丢，时间窗口不是身份判据。
optionExplanations_en: The event id stays the same across redelivery, so the merchant records ids it has handled and just returns 2xx the next time.
Ignoring later deliveries also drops genuinely new events such as a later chargeback, turning duplication into lost processing.
Network retries inevitably produce duplicates, so the sender can only promise at-least-once; pushing idempotency away is a promise nobody can keep.
After the merchant endpoint is down an hour, the whole backlog falls outside the window and is dropped — a time window is not an identity check.
why: 重试机制天然产生重复投递，投递方只能保证至少一次；商户用 payload 里的事件 id 建幂等键，重复到达时直接确认而不重复发货。代价是商户要维护一张已处理事件表。
why_en: Retries inevitably duplicate deliveries and the sender can only promise at-least-once, so the merchant keys off the event id and acknowledges duplicates without re-shipping, at the cost of keeping a processed-events table.
tradeoff: 至少一次投递加消费端幂等 vs 追求投递端 exactly-once 的复杂度
whenOtherWins: 如果该事件的处理本身天然幂等（例如把订单状态覆盖写成 succeeded），就可以省掉去重表。

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器对服务器的回调：事件发生时我们 POST 到商户预先登记的 URL。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A webhook is a server-to-server callback: we POST to a URL the merchant registered when an event happens.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一个操作重复执行多次，结果和执行一次相同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotent means repeating the same operation many times leaves the same result as doing it once.

termDefinitions.meaning: 恰好一次语义：即使发生重试，同一条消息的处理效果只生效一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exactly-once semantics means a message takes effect only once even when retries happen.

termDefinitions.meaning: 重试间隔逐次成倍拉长（5s、25s、125s），避免压垮对方。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exponential backoff multiplies the retry interval each time — 5s, 25s, 125s — so the receiver is not overwhelmed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 拒付：持卡人事后申诉，发卡行把已成功的钱反向划回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A chargeback is when a cardholder disputes a charge afterwards and the issuing bank pulls the money back.

scenario: Transaction Service 既维护内部 PaymentIntent/Transaction 状态机，又直接握着到 Visa/Mastercard 的私有网络连接和 HSM 密钥；拆成两个服务能各自独立扩展部署。
scenario_en: The Transaction Service both owns the internal PaymentIntent/Transaction state machine and directly holds the private network connection and HSM keys to Visa/Mastercard; splitting it into two services would let each scale and deploy independently.
q: 把内部记录管理和外部网络交互合并进一个服务，代价是什么？
q_en: What is the cost of merging internal record management and external network integration into one service?
options: 省一次内部网络跳转、把 PCI 合规边界收进一个服务，但两类关注点耦合进了同一份代码
外部支付网络的证书和 HSM 密钥必须复制到每个调用方服务，合并反而让密钥分布更广
合并后内部状态查询和外部网络调用共用同一批数据库连接，峰值时互相抢占连接池
只要内部方法命名清楚，合并成一个服务在后续独立扩展上和拆成两个服务没有实质差别
options_en: It saves one internal hop and narrows the PCI compliance boundary to one service, but it couples the two concerns into the same codebase.
The external network’s certificates and HSM keys would have to be copied to every calling service, so merging actually spreads the keys wider.
After merging, internal state queries and external network calls share the same pool of database connections and contend for it at peak.
As long as internal method names are clear, merging into one service makes no real difference to independently scaling it later.
optionExplanations: 文章明确指出：合并减少了不必要的网络跳转，也把 PCI 合规范围收窄到一处，代价是内部记录变更和外部协议变更被绑进同一份代码，谁改动都要小心影响另一边。
这是反的：密钥和证书恰恰因为合并而只需集中在一个服务里管理，拆成多个服务才会让密钥分布面变大。
文章没有把两者拆成不同数据库连接池来讨论；这里混淆了服务边界耦合和数据库连接争用两个不同问题。
命名清楚解决的是可读性，不解决部署边界；两个关注点仍在同一次发布、同一个进程里，独立扩展和独立发版做不到。
optionExplanations_en: The article says the merge cuts an unnecessary hop and narrows the PCI boundary to one service, at the cost of tying internal record changes and external protocol changes to the same codebase.
This is backwards: merging is what lets keys stay centralized in one service; splitting into more services is what would spread key distribution wider.
The article never frames this as separate connection pools; it conflates service-boundary coupling with database connection contention, a different problem.
Clear naming fixes readability, not deployment boundaries; the two concerns still ship together in the same release and process, so independent scaling is not actually possible.
why: 合并省了一次网络跳转、把 PCI 合规边界收窄到一处，但内部记录的变更节奏被绑进外部支付网络协议的变更节奏，任何一边升级都要碰同一份代码。
why_en: Merging saves a hop and narrows the PCI boundary to one place, but it ties the pace of internal record changes to external network protocol changes, so upgrading either side touches the same code.
tradeoff: 单服务减少跳转/收窄合规边界 vs 拆分服务解耦内部记录与外部协议演进节奏
whenOtherWins: 如果要接入十几个国家的本地支付网络，外部对接逻辑复杂到需要专门团队维护时，拆出独立 Network Gateway 服务能让两边独立发版。

termDefinitions.fullName: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
termDefinitions.meaning: 支付卡行业数据安全标准，规定如何处理、存储、传输持卡人数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PCI DSS is the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard that governs how cardholder data must be handled, stored, and transmitted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 硬件安全模块：专用硬件安全生成/存储密钥并执行加解密，密钥不出硬件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An HSM, or Hardware Security Module, is dedicated hardware that generates and stores keys and performs crypto operations without the key ever leaving the device.

scenario: pending_verification 方案里，对账是财务团队每天手工核对银行文件补的例外流程；CDC 方案里，Reconciliation Service 是常驻消费 timeout 事件的服务，和支付主链路平级。
scenario_en: In the pending_verification design, reconciliation is an exception process finance runs by hand against bank files each day; in the CDC design, the Reconciliation Service is a standing service consuming timeout events alongside the main payment path.
q: 为什么"把对账当异常处理"是 pending_verification 方案的根因缺陷？
q_en: Why is "treating reconciliation as exception handling" the root architectural flaw of the pending_verification design?
options: 对账没有事件入口感知超时，只能靠人工每天扫一遍，核对量随交易量线性增长但系统没跟着扩容
pending_verification 状态会在数据库里一直持有行锁，把其它支付请求堵住
人工核对出的结论权威性高于支付网络的 settlement 文件，事后要用它覆盖 CDC 事件
把人工核对频率从每天一次提到每小时一次，就能补上这个架构缺口
options_en: Reconciliation has no event entry point to sense timeouts, so it relies on a daily human sweep whose workload grows linearly with volume while the system never scales with it.
The pending_verification status holds a database row lock indefinitely, blocking other payment requests.
The conclusion from manual reconciliation outranks the payment network’s settlement file, so it should overwrite CDC events afterward.
Raising the manual reconciliation cadence from daily to hourly would close this architectural gap.
optionExplanations: 文章明确写出这条因果链：超时置为 pending_verification → 财务每日人工核对 → 手改终态，核对量随交易量同增，Black Friday 峰值时反而最慢。
文章没有讨论行锁；这只是一个状态标记，真正的问题是靠人工节奏推进它，不是数据库层面锁住了别的请求。
这是反的：文章说 settlement 文件是"definitive record"、权威的网络记录，人工核对结论应该被它核对而不是反过来覆盖它。
提高核对频率只是缩短了延迟，核对量依旧随交易量线性增长且靠人力完成，峰值一来照样被压垮，没有解决系统不随量扩容的根因。
optionExplanations_en: The article spells out exactly this chain: timeout → pending_verification → daily manual review by finance → manual status fix, with review load growing with volume and getting slowest at the Black Friday peak.
The article never discusses row locks; this is just a status marker, and the real problem is that it depends on human cadence, not that it blocks other requests at the database level.
This is backwards: the article calls the settlement file the definitive, authoritative network record that manual conclusions should be checked against, not the other way around.
A faster cadence only shortens the delay; the review load still grows linearly with volume and is still done by hand, so it still buckles at peak — the scaling root cause is untouched.
why: 对账被绑在人工核对这条例外分支上，核对能力不会随交易量自动扩容，促销峰值反而最慢；CDC 方案把它做成消费 timeout 事件的常驻服务，核对能力随事件流一起水平扩展。
why_en: Reconciliation is bolted onto a manual exception path whose capacity never scales with transaction volume and gets slowest exactly at promotion peaks; the CDC design makes it a standing service consuming timeout events, so its capacity scales horizontally with the event stream.
tradeoff: 对账作为人工例外流程 vs 对账作为消费事件流的常驻服务
whenOtherWins: 如果交易量长期很低（比如内部小额结算），人工每日核对的成本可能低于搭建独立对账服务的工程投入。

termDefinitions.meaning: 变更数据捕获：从数据库 WAL/oplog 读出已提交的变更，生成事件流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC, or Change Data Capture, reads committed changes from the database’s write-ahead log and turns them into an event stream.

termDefinitions.meaning: 超时但结果未知的中间状态，等待对账服务确认最终结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pending_verification is an interim status for a timed-out payment whose outcome is still unknown, awaiting reconciliation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付网络定期交付的批量对账文件，是交易结果的权威记录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A settlement file is a batch reconciliation file the payment network delivers on a schedule, serving as the authoritative record of what happened.

scenario: 已经有 CDC 事件触发 Webhook Service，并带指数退避重试；这只是最基础的形态。要把它做到生产级，发送侧还要补哪些能力？
scenario_en: A CDC event already triggers the Webhook Service with exponential-backoff retries — that is only the baseline. To make it production-grade, what must the sending side add?
q: 生产级 webhook 投递系统在基本重试之外还需要补哪些能力？（多选）
q_en: Beyond basic retries, what does a production-grade webhook delivery system still need? (Select all that apply)
options: 为每个事件生成可去重的唯一事件 id（idempotency key）
投递状态的详细监控与失败告警
商户可查询、可手动 replay 失败投递的 webhook 日志和看板
把商户的 webhook 签名密钥写进事件 payload 方便调试
options_en: Generate a unique, dedupe-able event id (idempotency key) for every event.
Detailed monitoring and failure alerting on delivery status.
Merchant-queryable webhook logs with a dashboard to manually replay failed deliveries.
Embed the merchant’s webhook signing secret in the event payload to make debugging easier.
optionExplanations: 每个事件带唯一 id，商户端凭它去重；没有这个 id，商户没法分清是新事件还是同一条重投。
投递失败率、延迟这些指标要能被监控告警，否则某个商户端点挂了几个小时也不会有人发现。
商户端点故障恢复后要能翻查失败记录并手动重放，不然只能干等下一次事件触发才补上缺口。
签名密钥的作用恰恰是让商户验证 payload 没被篡改；把密钥写进 payload，等于让任何拿到 payload 的人都能伪造后续签名。
optionExplanations_en: A unique id on every event lets the merchant deduplicate; without it the merchant cannot tell a genuinely new event from a redelivery of the same one.
Delivery failure rate and latency need to be monitored and alertable, otherwise a merchant endpoint can be down for hours before anyone notices.
After a merchant endpoint recovers, someone needs to browse failures and replay them by hand, otherwise the gap only gets filled by the next unrelated event.
The whole point of the signing secret is letting the merchant verify the payload was not tampered with; putting the secret inside the payload lets anyone who sees the payload forge future signatures.
why: 基本重试只解决"投递失败要不要再试"；生产级还要让商户能去重、让我们能发现投递在变差、让商户能补上错过的事件，三者缺一都会在故障时放大成事故。
why_en: Basic retries only answer "should a failed delivery be retried"; production-grade also needs the merchant able to dedupe, the sender able to see delivery quality degrading, and the merchant able to backfill missed events — missing any one turns an outage into an incident.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器对服务器的回调：事件发生时我们 POST 到商户预先登记的 URL。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A webhook is a server-to-server callback: we POST to a URL the merchant registered when an event happens.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让重复执行的操作只生效一次的去重标识。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotency key is an identifier that lets a repeated operation take effect only once.

scenario: 这道支付系统面试题里 webhook 只被当成配角一笔带过；如果换成一场专门的"设计 webhook 投递系统"面试，考察深度完全不同。
scenario_en: In this payment-system interview, webhooks are only a brief supporting topic; a dedicated "design a webhook delivery system" interview would probe far deeper.
q: 独立的 webhook 系统设计面试通常还会重点深挖哪些点？（多选）
q_en: What would a standalone webhook-system design interview typically probe deeper on? (Select all that apply)
options: exactly-once 投递语义能逼近到什么程度
商户 endpoint 长时间宕机后，积压队列该怎么处理
adaptive rate limiting 防止投递压垮商户系统
把 webhook 整体换成给每个商户建一条 WebSocket 长连接
options_en: How close delivery can actually get to exactly-once semantics.
How to handle the backlog that builds up after a merchant endpoint is down for a long stretch.
Adaptive rate limiting so delivery does not overwhelm merchant systems.
Replacing webhooks entirely with a persistent WebSocket connection to every merchant.
optionExplanations: 投递方最多只能保证至少一次；专门面试会追问怎么靠幂等 key、去重窗口把重复处理概率压到接近于零。
商户端点挂几小时后，退避重试会攒下一大批待投递事件；面试会问队列怎么限流、怎么做补偿式批量重放。
商户容量各不相同，固定速率要么打爆小商户要么浪费大商户带宽；面试会问怎么按商户历史成功率动态调它。
